note: Statements Hiraia already teaches per competency (model-written, model-reviewed). Context only; packs cite primary sources from data/references.json.

statements.text: Mixing vinegar and baking soda is a chemical change! Watch it fizz and give off carbon dioxide gas.
statements.tl: Ang paghahalo ng suka at baking soda ay kemikal na pagbabago! Panoorin itong bumula at maglabas ng carbon dioxide gas.

statements.text: Caramel has a wonderful, toasty smell and a rich taste that plain, white sugar just does not have!
statements.tl: Ang caramel ay may bagong mabangong amoy at masarap na lasa na wala sa karaniwang puting asukal!

statements.text: Pure iron is naturally silver in color, but it reacts easily with oxygen in the air to form reddish rust.
statements.tl: Ang purong bakal ay natural na kulay pilak, ngunit madali itong tumutugon sa oxygen sa hangin upang bumuo ng mapulang kalawang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TWPNn_eVOFWneGPsmeg4whEowrdaYxyo), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A change in color, like a shiny nail turning rusty orange, is a clue that a chemical change has happened.
statements.tl: Ang pagbabago ng kulay, tulad ng makintab na pako na nagiging kalawanging orange, ay isang clue na may naganap na chemical change.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p14fifuRi_R46pcCqk16LsU8_8PzgYx3), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Combining ammonia and vinegar is a chemical change because the two liquids react to form new substances with a different odor.
statements.tl: Ang pagsasama ng ammonia at suka ay isang chemical change dahil ang dalawang liquid ay nagre-react para bumuo ng mga bagong substance na may ibang amoy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p14fifuRi_R46pcCqk16LsU8_8PzgYx3), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Crepe paper loses its color fastest in the highest concentration of household bleach because more bleach particles are available to react.
statements.tl: Pinakamabilis mawalan ng kulay ang crepe paper sa pinakamataas na concentration ng household bleach dahil mas maraming bleach particles ang available para mag-react.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-18532), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why does chewing betel turn the mouth red?

The deep red color happens when betel nut, leaf, and lime mix together in the mouth — it's a chemical reaction, not a red dye.
statements.tl:
Bakit namumula ang bibig kapag nganga?

Lumalabas ang malalim na pulang kulay kapag naghalo ang betel nut, dahon, at apog sa loob ng bibig — resulta ito ng reaksyon, hindi dahil sa tina.

statements.text:
Why does bread dough rise?

As yeast ferments in the dough, it releases carbon dioxide gas, which gets trapped by the stretchy gluten in the flour — making the bread rise and fill with holes.
statements.tl:
Bakit umaalsa ang minasang tinapay?

Habang nagfe-ferment ang lebadura sa masa, naglalabas ito ng carbon dioxide na nakukulong ng nababanat na gluten ng harina — kaya umaalsa at nagiging butas-butas ang tinapay.
statements.source: Consensus food science; AAAS Benchmarks Ch.8

statements.text:
How does yeast turn sugar into gas?

When yeast eats sugar, it breaks the sugar apart inside its cell and makes carbon-dioxide gas plus a little alcohol. This process is called fermentation.
statements.tl:
Paano ginagawang gas ng yeast ang asukal?

Kapag kumakain ng asukal ang yeast, hinahati nito ang asukal sa loob ng selula nito at nakakagawa ng carbon-dioxide na gas at kaunting alcohol. Tinatawag itong fermentation.

statements.text: A durian's smell gets stronger as it ripens, so a strong smell can be a sign it's ready to eat.
statements.tl: Lumalakas ang amoy ng durian habang ito ay humihinog, kaya ang malakas na amoy ay maaaring tanda na handa na itong kainin.

statements.text:
What happens when you mix baking soda and vinegar?

Baking soda is a base! When mixed with vinegar, it fizzes and bubbles because of a cool chemical reaction.
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag hinhaluan mo ng suka ang baking soda?

Ang baking soda ay isang base! Kapag hinaluan ng suka, bumubula ito dahil sa isang nakakatuwang reaksyon.

statements.text: In hard water, soap reacts with minerals to form a sticky white scum that is super hard to rinse off!
statements.tl: Sa matigas na tubig, nakikipagsama ang sabon sa mga mineral at gumagawa ng maputing latak na mahirap banlawan!

statements.text: Clues of a chemical change include a color change, bubbles or gas, heat or light, smoke, or a new smell!
statements.tl: Mga palatandaan ng kemikal na pagbabago: pagbabago ng kulay, bula o gas, init o liwanag, usok, o bagong amoy!

statements.text: Fruit ripening and rotting, like in a banana, are chemical changes! You can see it when the color, taste, and smell change.
statements.tl: Ang paghinog at pagkabulok ng prutas, tulad ng saging, ay kemikal na pagbabago! Makikita mo ito sa pagbabago ng kulay, lasa, at amoy.

statements.text: Cooking heat makes bread and fried or grilled food turn brown! It forms new substances that give a tasty color, smell, and flavor—a chemical change.
statements.tl: Ang init sa pagluluto ang nagpapakulay-kayumanggi sa tinapay, prito, at iniihaw! Bumubuo ito ng bagong sangkap na nagbibigay ng masarap na kulay, amoy, at lasa.

statements.text:
Why do bread and cake rise when baked?

Baking soda or yeast produces carbon-dioxide gas! This leaves tiny holes, making the baked food soft and fluffy.
statements.tl:
Bakit umaalsa ang tinapay at cake kapag niluto?

Ang baking soda o lebadura ay bumubuo ng carbon-dioxide na gas! Nag-iiwan ito ng maliliit na butas, kaya nagiging malambot at mataas.

statements.text:
What happens when you mix baking soda and vinegar?

They fizz strongly! The bubbles are carbon-dioxide gas made by the chemical reaction between the two ingredients.
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag pinaghalo ang baking soda at suka?

Bumubula ito nang malakas! Ang bula ay carbon-dioxide gas na gawa sa chemical reaction ng dalawang sangkap.

statements.text: See bubbling or fizzing when mixing things? It is a clue that a new gas is made and a chemical reaction is happening!
statements.tl: May pagbula o pag-fizz kapag naghahalo? Ito ay palatandaan na may bagong gas na nabubuo at may chemical reaction na nangyayari!

statements.text:
What happens if your blood pressure suddenly drops?

Receptors in your blood vessels sense the change and signal your brain, which then tells your heart to beat faster to bring the pressure back up.
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kung biglang bumaba ang blood pressure mo?

Nararamdaman ng receptors sa iyong blood vessels ang pagbabago at nagsesenyas sa utak, na siyang magsasabi sa puso na bumilis ang tibok para maibalik ang pressure.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JCyVks5ixq17_y2S2UX9Mu-Am9UjKPHt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The body keeps blood sugar balanced by using insulin to lower it and glucagon to raise it.
statements.tl: Pinananatiling balanse ng katawan ang asukal sa dugo — ang insulin ang nagpapababa nito at ang glucagon ang nagpapataas.

statements.text:
What is homeostasis?

Homeostasis is how your body keeps things like temperature and water stable using feedback — like sweating when you're hot!
statements.tl:
Ano ang homeostasis?

Ang homeostasis ay ang pagpapanatili ng katawan ng matatag na kalagayan tulad ng temperatura at tubig gamit ang feedback — gaya ng pagpapawis kapag mainit!

statements.text: The human body works hard to keep its temperature around 37 degrees Celsius, even when it's cold outside.
statements.tl: Sinisikap ng katawan ng tao na panatilihin ang init nito sa mga 37 degrees Celsius, kahit malamig sa labas.

statements.text: Homeostasis only works within a limited range — at too high or too low a temperature, the body can no longer balance itself, and life is put in danger.
statements.tl: Gumagana lamang ang homeostasis sa loob ng limitadong saklaw; sa sobrang init o sobrang lamig, hindi na ito kayang ibalanse ng katawan at nanganganib ang buhay.
statements.source: NRC Ch.9 (homeostasis breaks down at too high/low temperature)

statements.text: Your body temperature, glucose level, and blood pressure are key indicators that show whether your body is in balance.
statements.tl: Ang body temperature, glucose level, at blood pressure mo ay mga pangunahing senyales na nagpapakita kung balanse ang katawan mo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-f35Ip58lbnXGBLLKKflfcH3xVkNIJdX), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Thermoregulation is how your body balances heat generation with heat loss to keep your core body temperature steady.
statements.tl: Ang thermoregulation ay paraan ng katawan para balansehin ang paggawa ng init at pagkawala ng init para manatiling steady ang core body temperature.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-f35Ip58lbnXGBLLKKflfcH3xVkNIJdX), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What happens if your body cannot keep its balance?

Without homeostasis, your cells cannot work properly, so your health and even your survival are at risk!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kung hindi mapanatili ng katawan mo ang balanse?

Kung walang homeostasis, hindi gagana nang maayos ang mga cells mo, kaya nanganganib ang kalusugan at maging ang buhay mo!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-f35Ip58lbnXGBLLKKflfcH3xVkNIJdX), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Endocrine organs like the pancreas and thyroid gland release hormones into the blood, acting as chemical messengers that help regulate homeostasis.
statements.tl: Ang mga endocrine organ tulad ng pancreas at thyroid gland ay naglalabas ng hormones sa dugo, na nagsisilbing chemical messengers na tumutulong sa pag-regulate ng homeostasis.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JCyVks5ixq17_y2S2UX9Mu-Am9UjKPHt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Homeostasis is the body's way of keeping internal conditions stable, and it uses opposing changes to restore balance whenever something shifts too far.
statements.tl: Ang homeostasis ay paraan ng katawan para panatilihing stable ang mga kondisyon sa loob, at gumagamit ito ng magkasalungat na pagbabago para ibalik ang balanse kapag may lumihis nang sobra.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1KsAzHUz0Z8VH9Hnwq8G7jH9VCg4f2O19), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Your body keeps its temperature steady through thermoregulation, where your skin, blood vessels, and brain work together to cool you down or warm you up.
statements.tl: Pinapanatili ng katawan mo ang steady na temperatura sa pamamagitan ng thermoregulation, kung saan nagtutulungan ang balat, mga blood vessel, at utak para palamigin o painitin ka.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_kCfn7PCkPbU0bXigbGQCHJgtBJKYc-c), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Eating too much salty food, over time, can raise your blood pressure.
statements.tl: Ang sobrang pagkain ng maalat ay maaaring magpataas ng presyon ng dugo sa paglipas ng panahon.

statements.text: Hormones work even in very tiny amounts, so the body must always keep them in just the right balance.
statements.tl: Gumagana ang mga hormone kahit napakaliit lang ng dami nila, kaya kailangang laging tama ang balanse ng mga ito sa katawan.

statements.text:
How does your body cool down in the heat?

When it's hot, the body sweats and its skin blood vessels widen to release heat and lower the temperature.
statements.tl:
Paano lumalamig ang katawan sa init?

Kapag mainit, pinapawisan ang katawan at lumalapad ang mga ugat sa balat para mailabas ang init at bumaba ang temperatura.
statements.source: Encyclopedia-stable consensus; NRC LS1.A feedback mechanisms

statements.text:
Why does breathing speed up sometimes?

When carbon dioxide builds up in the blood, breathing automatically speeds up to push it out and keep the body's gases balanced.
statements.tl:
Bakit bumibilis ang hininga minsan?

Kapag tumaas ang carbon dioxide sa dugo, awtomatikong bumibilis ang hininga para maialis ito at mapanatili ang tamang balanse ng gas.

statements.text:
What makes your body run a fever?

When germs invade, your body releases chemicals called pyrogens that tell your brain to raise your temperature — that's a fever!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagpapataas ng temperatura mo kapag may sakit?

Kapag pumasok ang mikrobyo, naglalabas ang katawan ng kemikal na pyrogens na nagpapasenyas sa utak na itaas ang init — iyon ang lagnat!

statements.text:
Where does the name 'glucagon' come from?

It comes from 'glucose' (sugar), because its job is to raise your blood sugar.
statements.tl:
Saan nanggaling ang pangalang 'glucagon'?

Nagmula ito sa salitang glucose (asukal), dahil ang trabaho nito ay pataasin ang asukal sa dugo.

statements.text: Like two people pulling opposite ends of a rope, glucagon and insulin work together to keep blood sugar balanced — never too high, never too low.
statements.tl: Tulad ng dalawang taong humihila sa magkabilang dulo ng lubid, sabay na gumagana ang glucagon at insulin para panatilihing balanse ang asukal sa dugo — hindi sobrang taas, hindi rin sobrang baba.

statements.text: Positive feedback amplifies a change, pushing the body further away from its starting state until a specific event is completed.
statements.tl: Pinalalakas ng positive feedback ang isang pagbabago, kaya mas lalong lumalayo ang katawan mula sa panimulang estado hanggang matapos ang isang partikular na pangyayari.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JCyVks5ixq17_y2S2UX9Mu-Am9UjKPHt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Is all feedback in the body negative?

No! Childbirth uses positive feedback. Stretching of the cervix stimulates uterine contractions that further stretch the cervix, continuing until the baby is born.
statements.tl:
Lahat ba ng feedback sa katawan ay negative?

Hindi! Gumagamit ang panganganak ng positive feedback. Ang pag-unat ng cervix ay nagpapasigla sa contractions ng uterus na lalong nag-uunat sa cervix, nagpapatuloy hanggang sa maisilang ang sanggol.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zTLH_Vnz7U9IC2WEFzQ9wKdvk-SrS7eH), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In negative feedback, when something in your body drifts away from normal, your body responds by reversing the change and bringing it back to balance.
statements.tl: Sa negative feedback, kapag may lumihis sa normal sa katawan, tumutugon ito sa pamamagitan ng pagbabalik sa dating balanse.

statements.text: The nervous system and endocrine system work together to coordinate feedback mechanisms that keep your body stable.
statements.tl: Ang nervous system at endocrine system ay nagtutulungan para i-coordinate ang mga feedback mechanism na nagpapanatiling stable ng katawan mo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-f35Ip58lbnXGBLLKKflfcH3xVkNIJdX), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Negative feedback counteracts a change from the body's set point, working like a thermostat that turns off the heater when the room gets warm enough.
statements.tl: Kinokontra ng negative feedback ang pagbabago mula sa set point ng katawan, parang thermostat na pinapatay ang heater kapag sapat na ang init ng kwarto.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JCyVks5ixq17_y2S2UX9Mu-Am9UjKPHt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A feedback loop has three main parts: a receptor that detects a change, a control center that processes the signal, and an effector that carries out the response.
statements.tl: May tatlong pangunahing bahagi ang feedback loop: ang receptor na dumidetekta ng pagbabago, ang control center na nagpoproseso ng signal, at ang effector na nagsasagawa ng tugon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JCyVks5ixq17_y2S2UX9Mu-Am9UjKPHt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Lactation uses positive feedback: suckling stimulates milk production, which causes further feeding, continuing until the baby stops feeding.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang lactation ng positive feedback: ang pagsuso ay nagpapasigla sa paggawa ng gatas, na nagdudulot ng karagdagang pagpapakain, nagpapatuloy hanggang tumigil ang sanggol sa pagsuso.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zTLH_Vnz7U9IC2WEFzQ9wKdvk-SrS7eH), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is glucagon?

When blood sugar is low, the pancreas releases glucagon to raise it back up — insulin and glucagon work oppositely to keep it balanced!
statements.tl:
Ano ang glucagon?

Kapag mababa ang asukal sa dugo, naglalabas ang pancreas ng glucagon para itaas ito — magkasalungat ang insulin at glucagon para mapanatiling balanse ang asukal!

statements.text: When you're hot, blood vessels in your skin widen to release heat; when you're cold, they narrow to trap heat inside.
statements.tl: Kapag mainit, lumalapad ang mga ugat sa balat para lumabas ang init; kapag malamig naman, kumikipot ang mga ito para mapanatili ang init.

statements.text: When your body runs low on water, it releases the hormone ADH to save water in your urine, plus it makes you feel thirsty so you drink.
statements.tl: Kapag kulang sa tubig ang katawan, naglalabas ito ng hormone na ADH para hindi masyadong mawala ang tubig sa ihi, at nararamdaman mo ang uhaw para uminom.

statements.text: The pancreas senses when blood sugar is low and releases glucagon to raise it. Once sugar rises again, it stops — like an automatic switch.
statements.tl: Nararamdaman ng pancreas kapag mababa ang asukal at naglalabas ito ng glucagon para itaas ito. Pagtaas na ng asukal, tumitigil na ito — parang awtomatikong switch.

statements.text:
Why do you feel thirsty?

Thirst is your brain's signal that your body is running low on water — it's telling you to drink before you get too dry, so don't wait until you're very thirsty!
statements.tl:
Bakit ka nauuhaw?

Ang pagkauhaw ay senyales ng utak na kulang ka na sa tubig — sinasabi nitong uminom ka na bago pa lumala, kaya huwag hintaying sobrang uhaw bago uminom.

statements.text:
Why do we feel thirsty?

Feeling thirsty is your body's way of telling you it's running low on water — your brain sends that signal so you drink before dehydration gets worse.
statements.tl:
Bakit tayo nauuhaw?

Ang pakiramdam na uhaw ay paraan ng katawan para sabihing kulang na ang tubig mo — nagpapadala ang utak ng senyales na ito para uminom ka bago lumala ang dehydration.

statements.text:
What tells your body to make more blood?

Your kidneys release a chemical that tells your body to make more red blood cells.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagsasabi sa katawan na gumawa ng dugo?

Naglalabas ang mga bato ng kemikal na nagsasabi sa katawan na gumawa ng mas maraming pulang selula ng dugo.

statements.text:
How does the body control temperature?

The body uses feedback: when temperature rises or falls too much, the body responds to bring it back to the right level.
statements.tl:
Paano kinokontrol ng katawan ang temperatura?

Gumagamit ang katawan ng feedback: kapag tumaas o bumaba ang temperatura, tumutugon ang katawan para ibalik ito sa tamang antas.

statements.text: The body uses feedback so hormones don't become too much or too little — keeping everything in balance.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang katawan ng feedback para hindi maging sobra o kulang ang hormone — kaya nananatili itong balanse.

statements.text: Your body controls hormones through feedback, like a thermostat that switches off once there's enough heat — keeping everything inside balanced (homeostasis).
statements.tl: Kinokontrol ng katawan ang antas ng hormone sa pamamagitan ng feedback, parang thermostat na huminto kapag sapat na — kaya nananatiling balanse ang loob ng katawan (homeostasis).

statements.text: Your brain needs a steady supply of sugar to work, and glucagon helps keep that supply going even when you haven't eaten.
statements.tl: Kailangan ng utak ng tuloy-tuloy na asukal para gumana, at ang glucagon ang tumutulong na sapat ito kahit hindi ka pa kumakain.

statements.text: Natural selection changes the whole population over many generations — not a single individual.
statements.tl: Ang natural na seleksyon ay nagbabago sa buong populasyon sa paglipas ng maraming henerasyon — hindi sa iisang indibidwal.

statements.text: Natural selection needs four things to happen: traits must vary, some traits must help survival, traits must be passed down, and those with better traits must reproduce more.
statements.tl: Apat ang kailangan para magkaroon ng natural selection: magkaiba ang katangian, may katangiang nakakatulong sa survival, namamana ang katangian, at ang may mas magandang katangian ay nagpaparami nang mas marami.

statements.text: The peppered moth of England shows natural selection in action — before pollution, light moths were common because they blended into pale tree bark, but as trees turned dark with soot, dark moths became more common instead.
statements.tl: Ang peppered moth sa England ay klasikong halimbawa ng natural selection — bago ang polusyon, mas marami ang maliliwanag na moth dahil nakatago sila sa maputing balat ng puno, pero nang naging maitim ang mga puno dahil sa usok, mas dumami ang mga madilim na moth.

statements.text: The sea turtles that make it are usually the strongest, fastest, or just the luckiest ones that got away from predators.
statements.tl: Ang mga pawikan na nakakaligtas ay kadalasang ang pinakamalakas, pinakamabilis, o pinakamasuwerteng nakaiwas sa mga mananakmal.

statements.text: Using antibiotics too much or the wrong way is the top cause of resistance — it lets the toughest bacteria survive and spread faster.
statements.tl: Ang sobra at maling paggamit ng antibiotiko ang pangunahing dahilan ng resistensya — nakakaligtas at kumakalat ang matitigas na bacteria.
statements.source: WHO; CDC antibiotic resistance threats; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
Why do some traits survive over others?

Not every individual lives to reproduce; those with traits suited to their environment are more likely to survive and pass those traits to more offspring.
statements.tl:
Bakit nananatili ang ibang katangian kaysa iba?

Hindi lahat ng indibidwal ay nabubuhay para magkaanak; ang may katangiang akma sa kapaligiran ang mas malamang mabuhay at maipasa ang katangian nito sa mas maraming anak.

statements.text:
What is natural selection?

In natural selection, animals with traits that fit their environment survive and have young more often, so more offspring inherit that helpful trait over time.
statements.tl:
Ano ang natural selection?

Sa natural selection, ang mga hayop na may katangiang bagay sa kapaligiran ay mas malamang mabuhay at magkaanak, kaya paulit-ulit na naipapasa ang kapaki-pakinabang na katangiang ito.
statements.source: AAAS BSL 5F/H3; NRC LS4.B/LS4.C; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: Antibiotic-resistant bacteria show natural selection in action — bacteria with helpful mutations survive antibiotics, then reproduce and pass on their resistance.
statements.tl: Ang mga bacteria na lumalaban sa antibiotic ay halimbawa ng natural selection sa aksyon — nabubuhay ang mga bacteriang may kapaki-pakinabang na mutasyon kahit may antibiotic, at ipinapasa nila ito sa kanilang mga anak.

statements.text: People with just one sickle cell gene get partial protection from malaria — a reason a harmful gene can survive in a population through natural selection.
statements.tl: Ang taong may isang sickle cell gene ay may bahagyang proteksyon laban sa malaria — kaya nananatili ang isang nakakapinsalang gene sa populasyon dahil sa natural selection.

statements.text:
What does 'survival of the fittest' mean?

In Darwin's theory, 'survival of the fittest' means animals best suited to their environment survive and reproduce!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng 'survival of the fittest'?

Sa teorya ni Darwin, ang 'survival of the fittest' ay nangangahulugang nabubuhay at dumarami ang mga hayop na pinakamahusay umangkop sa kapaligiran!

statements.text:
Why do bark-colored moths survive more?

Birds can't spot them! Moths whose color matches the tree bark hide better, so more survive and reproduce — that's natural selection at work.
statements.tl:
Bakit mas nakaliligtas ang mga gamu-gamong kulay-puno?

Dahil hindi sila madaling makita ng ibon! Ang gamu-gamong kulay ay tugma sa balat ng puno kaya mas marami silang nakaliligtas at nagpaparami — natural selection ito.
statements.source: NRC LS4.B Natural Selection; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
What is Darwin's natural selection?

In Darwin's idea of natural selection, animals that fit their environment best are more likely to survive and have babies of their own.
statements.tl:
Ano ang natural selection ni Darwin?

Sa natural selection ni Darwin, ang mga hayop na mas angkop sa kanilang kapaligiran ay mas malamang mabuhay at magkaroon ng sariling anak.

statements.text:
Why is the tamaraw smaller than a carabao?

The tamaraw lives on the small island of Mindoro where food and space are limited. Over a very long time, smaller animals survived better because they needed less food — a process called island dwarfism.
statements.tl:
Bakit mas maliit ang tamaraw kaysa kalabaw?

Nakatira ang tamaraw sa isla ng Mindoro kung saan limitado ang pagkain at espasyo. Sa paglipas ng mahabang panahon, mas nabuhay ang mas maliliit na hayop dahil mas kaunti ang kailangan nilang pagkain — tinatawag itong island dwarfism.

statements.text:
Why do mutations matter for evolution?

Mutations create new traits, like tougher fur or faster running—and helpful ones get passed on, slowly driving evolution over long ages.
statements.tl:
Bakit mahalaga ang mutation sa ebolusyon?

Ang mutation ay lumilikha ng bagong katangian, tulad ng mas matibay na balahibo o mas mabilis na takbo—kapag nakakatulong, naipapasa ito at unti-unting nagbubunga ng ebolusyon.

statements.text: For natural selection to produce inherited changes over generations, the traits involved must be passed down through genes.
statements.tl: Para magdulot ang natural selection ng namamanang pagbabago sa maraming henerasyon, dapat naipapasa sa mga gene ang mga katangiang sangkot.

statements.text:
What is Charles Darwin known for?

Charles Darwin is famous for the theory of evolution by natural selection.
statements.tl:
Bakit tanyag si Charles Darwin?

Tanyag si Charles Darwin sa teorya ng ebolusyon sa pamamagitan ng natural na seleksyon.

statements.text: Scientists accept evolution itself, how life forms change over time, as a well-proven fact, while natural selection explains one mechanism of how it happens.
statements.tl: Tinatanggap ng mga siyentipiko ang ebolusyon mismo, ang pagbabago ng mga anyo ng buhay sa paglipas ng panahon, bilang napatunayang katotohanan, habang ang natural selection ang nagpapaliwanag ng isang paraan kung paano ito nangyayari.
statements.source: AAAS BSL Ch.5F (evolution vs natural selection distinction)

statements.text: Bacteria become resistant to antibiotics through mutation, the survivors reproduce and pass on their resistance, slowly creating stronger superbugs.
statements.tl: Nagiging lumalaban ang bacteria sa antibiotics dahil sa mutasyon, nagpaparami ang mga nakaligtas at ipinapasa nila ang resistensya, unti-unting lumilikha ng mas matibay na superbug.

statements.text:
What is an adaptation?

An adaptation is an inherited trait that helps survival in a certain environment — it builds up over many generations because natural selection favors helpful traits.
statements.tl:
Ano ang adaptasyon?

Ang adaptasyon ay isang namamanang katangian na nagpapadali sa pagkabuhay sa isang kapaligiran — unti-unti itong nabubuo sa maraming henerasyon dahil pinipili ng natural selection ang mga katangiang nakakatulong.

statements.text:
Can an animal choose to adapt?

No! Adaptations aren't a choice — they appear through variation and selection across many generations.
statements.tl:
Puwede bang piliin ng hayop na mag-adapt?

Hindi! Hindi maaaring piliin ang adaptasyon — lumilitaw ito sa pamamagitan ng baryasyon at seleksyon sa maraming henerasyon.

statements.text: Behavioral adaptations are actions animals do to survive, like changing feeding habits, moving in groups, or being active only at night.
statements.tl: Ang behavioral adaptations ay mga kilos na ginagawa ng mga hayop para mabuhay, tulad ng pagbabago ng paraan ng pagkain, paggalaw nang magkakasama, o pagiging aktibo lamang sa gabi.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 13Sptr3F3jL0ujhlSb1ZD_t655htMXkf7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Adaptation is a characteristic that improves an organism's ability to survive and reproduce in its environment.
statements.tl: Ang adaptation ay isang katangian na nagpapabuti sa kakayahan ng isang organismo na mabuhay at magparami sa kanyang kapaligiran.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Jc4Sdf8bdrcOxRsX1DlJHAjYuMNKIwVD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Selection occurs when conditions favor the survival and reproduction of organisms with a particular genotype, or set of genes.
statements.tl: Nangyayari ang selection kapag pinapaboran ng mga kondisyon ang kaligtasan at pagpaparami ng mga organismong may partikular na genotype, o set ng genes.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ub3H0VbyYvTg1w2u83MfbZCHsClH2PYi), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do people look so different from each other but are all the same species?

There is tremendous morphological variation within Homo sapiens! Morphological means the physical form and structure of organisms.
statements.tl:
Bakit magkakaiba ang itsura ng mga tao pero pareho silang lahat ng species?

May napakalaking morphological variation sa loob ng Homo sapiens! Ang morphological ay tumutukoy sa physical na anyo at istruktura ng mga organismo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dBQpOszdgrtdRnSc3og-fPATCM_Xi_Ur), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Darwin based his theory of evolution on three key observations: variation among individuals, competition for limited resources, and survival of those best suited to their environment.
statements.tl: Ibinatay ni Darwin ang kanyang teorya ng ebolusyon sa tatlong pangunahing obserbasyon: ang pagkakaiba-iba ng mga indibidwal, ang kompetisyon para sa limitadong resources, at ang kaligtasan ng mga pinaka-angkop sa kanilang kapaligiran.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1gRkskQGghVa5DKQ479ATr7DwhCh8LKhe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The Philippines is home to many endemic shrew species, each island often having its own kind — the result of islands being cut off from each other for ages.
statements.tl: Maraming endemikong shrew ang mayroon ang Pilipinas — iba-iba ang uri sa bawat pulo — dahil sa mahabang paghihiwalay ng mga pulo sa isa't isa.

statements.text:
How can animals end up so different from their ancient ancestors?

Tiny differences between parents and their offspring can build up over many generations — so distant descendants end up very different from their ancient ancestors!
statements.tl:
Paano nagiging ibang-iba ang mga hayop sa kanilang sinaunang ninuno?

Naiipon ang maliliit na pagkakaiba ng magulang at anak sa sunud-sunod na henerasyon — kaya ang malalayong inapo ay nagiging ibang-iba na sa sinaunang ninuno!

statements.text:
What is speciation?

It's when a group of one species gets cut off so long that it can no longer breed with the rest — creating a brand-new species!
statements.tl:
Ano ang speciation?

Nangyayari ito kapag nahiwalay nang matagal ang isang grupo ng species hanggang hindi na sila makapag-breed sa iba — kaya nagkakaroon ng bagong species!

statements.text: The Philippines is one of the world's most biodiverse places because its many islands isolated plants and animals, letting unique species evolve that exist nowhere else.
statements.tl: Ang Pilipinas ay isa sa mga pinaka-biodiverse na lugar sa mundo dahil ang maraming isla nito ay naghiwalay sa mga hayop at halaman, kaya nakapag-evolve ang mga natatanging species na wala sa ibang bansa.

statements.text:
Why does the Philippines have so many kinds of animals?

Because we're islands! Separated by the sea, animals on different islands slowly change over time and become new kinds.
statements.tl:
Bakit napakaraming uri ng hayop sa Pilipinas?

Dahil kapuluan tayo! Hiwalay ng dagat ang mga isla, kaya unti-unting nagbabago ang mga hayop sa magkaibang isla at nagiging bagong uri.

statements.text: In artificial selection, people -- not nature -- decide which animals or plants get to reproduce.
statements.tl: Sa artipisyal na seleksyon, ang tao ang pumipili kung aling hayop o halaman ang magpaparami, hindi ang kalikasan.

statements.text: Different subspecies of the Visayan warty pig came from different islands — the Cebu subspecies is extinct, while the surviving subspecies lives on Negros and Panay.
statements.tl: Mula sa iba't ibang pulo ang mga subspecies ng Visayan warty pig — lipol na ang subspecies sa Cebu, habang nasa Negros at Panay ang nabubuhay pang subspecies.

statements.text: A Chihuahua and a Saint Bernard are both the same species -- dogs! Yet they can differ hugely in size, from tiny to giant.
statements.tl: Ang Chihuahua at Saint Bernard ay parehong aso -- iisang species lang! Pero sobrang laki ng pagkakaiba nila sa sukat, mula maliit hanggang higante.

statements.text:
Why are some male birds so colorful?

Over many generations, female birds kept choosing the brightest-feathered males — and that choice is what made those feathers grow even more showy.
statements.tl:
Bakit kay ganda ng balahibo ng ibong lalaki?

Sa loob ng maraming henerasyon, pinili ng mga babaeng ibon ang pinakamatingkad na lalaki — kaya lalo pang gumanda ang kanilang mga balahibo.

statements.text:
What is selective breeding?

Selective breeding means choosing plants or animals with the best traits to reproduce — like picking rice plants with higher yields to improve crops over time.
statements.tl:
Ano ang selective breeding?

Ang selective breeding ay ang pagpili ng mga hayop o halamang may pinakamagandang katangian para mag-anak — tulad ng pagpili ng mas mataas ang ani na palay.

statements.text:
Why does Rafflesia look so strange?

Long ago, Rafflesia's ancestor had leaves and made its own food. By stealing food from a vine instead, it slowly lost its leaves and chlorophyll — now it looks so strange!
statements.tl:
Bakit kakaiba ang anyo ng Rafflesia?

Dati, may dahon ang ninuno ng Rafflesia at gumagawa ito ng sariling pagkain. Nang umasa na sa pagkuha ng pagkain mula sa baging, unti-unting nawala ang dahon at chlorophyll nito — kaya ganito na ang anyo nito ngayon!

statements.text: Biogeography studies where species live on Earth and how they ended up there, helping us understand why islands have unique animals.
statements.tl: Pinag-aaralan ng biogeography kung saan nakatira ang mga species sa Earth at paano sila nakarating doon, na tumutulong sa ating maunawaan kung bakit may kakaibang mga hayop sa mga isla.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Nkkgt98-p-tJOwjXyoRNNqVNYNANo_C4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Homologous structures are body parts that look similar because the organisms inherited them from a common ancestor, even if the parts now do different jobs.
statements.tl: Ang homologous structures ay mga bahagi ng katawan na magkatulad dahil namana ito ng mga organismo mula sa iisang ninuno, kahit magkaiba na ang trabaho ng mga bahaging ito ngayon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1gRkskQGghVa5DKQ479ATr7DwhCh8LKhe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: By comparing fossils from different time periods, scientists can see how kinds of living things changed over very long stretches of time!
statements.tl: Sa pamamagitan ng paghahambing ng fossil mula sa iba't ibang panahon, nakikita ng mga siyentista kung paano nagbago ang mga uri ng buhay sa napakahabang panahon!

statements.text: The fossil record is like a stack of old photographs, giving a chronological record of the history of life on Earth.
statements.tl: Ang fossil record ay parang salansan ng mga lumang litrato, nagbibigay ng chronological record ng kasaysayan ng buhay sa Earth.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Nkkgt98-p-tJOwjXyoRNNqVNYNANo_C4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Biogeography studies the distribution of species in geographic space and through geological time, often used to understand the processes that influence species dispersal and evolution.
statements.tl: Pinag-aaralan ng biogeography ang distribusyon ng mga species sa geographic space at sa paglipas ng geological time, na kadalasang ginagamit para maunawaan ang mga prosesong nakakaapekto sa dispersal at ebolusyon ng species.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Nkkgt98-p-tJOwjXyoRNNqVNYNANo_C4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Fossils of ancient horses show that over millions of years, their skulls grew longer and their legs changed from having several toes to a single strong hoof.
statements.tl: Ipinapakita ng mga fossil ng mga sinaunang kabayo na sa loob ng milyon-milyong taon, humaba ang kanilang bungo at nagbago ang kanilang mga binti mula sa pagkakaroon ng maraming daliri hanggang sa iisang malakas na hoof.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1T1xzN1ufrsWI6eI-vB-8QVNpzTm4Conw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The fossil record is incomplete because most organisms never fossilize, and many fossils are destroyed by geological processes or never reach the surface.
statements.tl: Hindi kumpleto ang fossil record dahil karamihan ng mga organismo ay hindi nagiging fossil, at maraming fossil ang nasisira ng geological processes o hindi na umaabot sa ibabaw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1T1xzN1ufrsWI6eI-vB-8QVNpzTm4Conw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Indirect evidence for evolution comes from comparing structures like homologous, analogous, and vestigial body parts, where scientists infer change without watching it happen.
statements.tl: Ang indirect evidence para sa ebolusyon ay nagmumula sa paghahambing ng mga bahagi ng katawan tulad ng homologous, analogous, at vestigial structures, kung saan hinihinuha ng mga scientist ang pagbabago kahit hindi nila ito direktang nakikita.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1T1xzN1ufrsWI6eI-vB-8QVNpzTm4Conw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Fossils show that simple algae appeared first in Earth's waters, and later plants developed vascular tissues, then seeds, and finally flowers.
statements.tl: Ipinapakita ng mga fossil na ang simpleng algae ay unang lumitaw sa tubig ng Earth, at kalaunan nagkaroon ang mga halaman ng vascular tissues, pagkatapos ay mga buto, at sa huli ay mga bulaklak.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1T1xzN1ufrsWI6eI-vB-8QVNpzTm4Conw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Scientists combine fossils, body structures, DNA, and embryo development to build a stronger picture of how living things are related than any one clue alone could give.
statements.tl: Pinagsasama ng mga scientist ang fossils, body structures, DNA, at embryo development para makabuo ng mas matibay na larawan kung paano magkakaugnay ang mga living things kaysa sa kaya ng iisang clue lamang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1kHlP13l7oYUp9JX7tprlxhZTQwgSzHLg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Genetics, comparative anatomy, embryology, and biogeography are indirect evidence of evolution because scientists infer that evolution happened through careful analysis, not direct observation.
statements.tl: Ang genetics, comparative anatomy, embryology, at biogeography ay indirect evidence ng evolution dahil ini-infer ng mga siyentista na nangyari ang evolution sa pamamagitan ng maingat na pagsusuri, hindi direktang pagmamasid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1pE7BwEIzZGX2_0cLz83FIe1SpdTtbr-0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Where did the cuttlebone come from?

Long ago, cuttlefish ancestors had an outer shell like a nautilus — over time it shrank and moved inside the body, becoming today's cuttlebone.
statements.tl:
Saan nanggaling ang cuttlebone?

Noong unang panahon, ang ninuno ng cuttlefish ay may panlabas na kabibe tulad ng nautilus — sa paglipas ng panahon, lumiit ito at napunta sa loob ng katawan, kaya naging cuttlebone.

statements.text:
What do arms, wings, and flippers share?

A human arm, a bat's wing, and a whale's flipper all share the same bone pattern — proof they came from one common ancestor.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakatulad ng braso, pakpak, at palikpik?

Ang braso ng tao, pakpak ng paniki, at palikpik ng balyena ay may magkatulad na ayos ng buto — patunay na nagmula sila sa iisang ninuno.

statements.text:
Why do an arm and a wing look alike?

Because a human arm, bat wing, whale flipper, and horse leg all came from one shared ancestor. Scientists call these matching bones homologous structures.
statements.tl:
Bakit magkahawig ang braso at pakpak?

Dahil ang braso ng tao, pakpak ng paniki, palikpik ng balyena, at binti ng kabayo ay nagmula sa iisang ninuno. Tinatawag itong homologous structures.

statements.text: Fossils in higher, newer rock layers usually look like species alive today, while fossils in deeper, older layers are often very different.
statements.tl: Ang mga fosil sa mas itaas at bagong patong ng bato ay kadalasang kahawig ng mga species na buhay pa ngayon, habang ang nasa mas malalim at lumang patong ay malimit na ibang-iba.

statements.text: The genetic code is nearly the same in every living thing, from bacteria to humans — one of the clues that all life on Earth shares a common origin.
statements.tl: Halos pareho ang genetic code ng lahat ng buhay na bagay, mula bacteria hanggang tao — isa itong patunay na may iisang pinagmulan ang lahat ng buhay sa Earth.
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 5C/H4b (genetic code virtually the same for all life forms)

statements.text: The more alike two species' DNA is, the more closely related they are — this molecular evidence backs up what anatomy already shows about how life branched from common ancestors.
statements.tl: Kung magkahawig ang DNA ng dalawang species, mas malapit ang kanilang ugnayan — sinusuportahan ng molekular na ebidensyang ito ang ipinapakita na ng anatomiya tungkol sa pagsanga-sanga ng buhay mula sa iisang ninuno.

statements.text:
What does a paleontologist do?

A paleontologist studies fossils to learn how dinosaurs and other ancient animals once lived!
statements.tl:
Ano ang paleontologist?

Nag-aaral ang paleontologist ng mga fossil para malaman kung paano nabuhay ang mga dinosaur noong unang panahon!

statements.text: Sodium hydroxide, also called lye, is a strong base found in drain cleaners and oven cleaners because it can dissolve grease and hair.
statements.tl: Ang sodium hydroxide, na tinatawag ding lye, ay malakas na base na matatagpuan sa mga drain cleaner at oven cleaner dahil kaya nitong tunawin ang mantika at buhok.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MYaLgSE_YYmBN5qhDusz5Apc1H3LxCAc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Acid-base indicators are substances that show one color in an acidic medium and another color in a basic medium.
statements.tl: Ang mga acid-base indicator ay mga substance na nagpapakita ng isang kulay sa acidic medium at ibang kulay sa basic medium.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10BX88I18RFjCKARGQ2-7WDSQNVJPyVf2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Universal indicator is a liquid that turns deep red in strong acids, green in neutral solutions, and dark blue or purple in strong bases.
statements.tl: Ang universal indicator ay isang likido na nagiging deep red sa malakas na acid, berde sa neutral na solution, at dark blue o purple sa malakas na base.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Gk0mDNGWvNBiaBxYE63i1dsmf9rEEeMt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Are there different kinds of indicators?

Yes! Natural indicators come from plants, synthetic indicators are made in laboratories, and olfactory indicators change smell instead of color.
statements.tl:
May iba't ibang uri ba ng indicator?

Oo! Ang natural indicators ay galing sa halaman, ang synthetic indicators ay gawa sa laboratoryo, at ang olfactory indicators ay nagbabago ng amoy imbes na kulay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1HwyVYwJYNsRDWdD9Hw9AUo_0WYsFGOLG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do food labels list ingredients you cannot see?

Many ingredients in food are compounds with chemical formulas, like sodium chloride for salt or acetic acid for vinegar!
statements.tl:
Bakit may mga sangkap sa food label na hindi mo nakikita?

Maraming sangkap sa pagkain ay mga compound na may chemical formula, tulad ng sodium chloride para sa asin o acetic acid para sa suka!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1KiyHKY5i6coJnOnbN9Ymf6YS0VMUX4xN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Common acids include sulfuric acid in car batteries, hydrochloric acid in our stomachs, acetic acid in vinegar, citric acid in fruits, and carbonic acid in soda.
statements.tl: Kabilang sa mga karaniwang acid ang sulfuric acid sa baterya ng sasakyan, hydrochloric acid sa ating tiyan, acetic acid sa suka, citric acid sa prutas, at carbonic acid sa soda.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MYaLgSE_YYmBN5qhDusz5Apc1H3LxCAc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Common bases include sodium hydroxide in drain cleaners, calcium hydroxide in cement, magnesium and aluminum hydroxides in antacids, and ammonium hydroxide in cleaning products.
statements.tl: Kabilang sa mga karaniwang base ang sodium hydroxide sa drain cleaners, calcium hydroxide sa semento, magnesium at aluminum hydroxides sa antacids, at ammonium hydroxide sa mga panlinis.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MYaLgSE_YYmBN5qhDusz5Apc1H3LxCAc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Vanilla extract is an olfactory indicator because its smell disappears in a basic solution but remains in an acidic one.
statements.tl: Ang vanilla extract ay olfactory indicator dahil nawawala ang amoy nito sa basic solution pero nananatili sa acidic solution.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MYaLgSE_YYmBN5qhDusz5Apc1H3LxCAc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is the pH level of pure water?

Pure water has a pH of 7! This means it is perfectly neutral, so it is neither an acid nor a base.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pH level ng purong tubig?

Ang purong tubig ay may pH na 7! Ibig sabihin, ito ay neutral, kaya hindi ito asido at hindi rin base.

statements.text: Red cabbage juice is a natural indicator that changes color when it meets acids and bases!
statements.tl: Ang katas ng pulang repolyo ay natural na indicator na nagbabago ng kulay kapag nakaharap sa asido at base!

statements.text:
What do farmers add when the soil is too acidic for plants?

Every plant needs the right soil pH, so farmers add lime when the soil is too acidic!
statements.tl:
Ano ang idinadagdag ng magsasaka kapag masyadong asido ang lupa para sa mga halaman?

Kailangan ng tamang soil pH ang bawat halaman, kaya naglalagay ng apog ang magsasaka kapag masyadong asido ito!

statements.text: Red cabbage is a natural indicator! Its juice turns pink in an acid, and green or blue in a base.
statements.tl: Ang pulang repolyo ay isang natural indicator! Ang katas nito ay nagiging kulay-rosas sa acid, at nagiging berde o asul sa base.

statements.text:
How do we know if a liquid is an acid or a base?

We use an indicator! It’s a special substance that changes color to show if a liquid is an acid or a base.
statements.tl:
Paano natin malalaman kung ang isang likido ay asido o base?

Gumagamit tayo ng indicator! Ito ay isang sangkap na nagbabago ng kulay para ipakita kung asido o base ang likido.

statements.text:
Can a vegetable tell us if something is an acid or a base?

Yes! Red cabbage juice is a natural indicator. It turns pink in an acid and green or blue in a base.
statements.tl:
Kaya ba ng isang gulay na sabihin kung asido o base ang isang bagay?

Oo! Ang katas ng pulang repolyo ay isang likas na indicator. Nagiging rosas ito sa asido at berde o asul sa base.

statements.text: Phenolphthalein is a cool chemical! It stays clear in acids but turns bright pink when it meets a base. Magic science!
statements.tl: Ang phenolphthalein ay isang kemikal! Nanatili itong malinaw sa asido pero nagiging makulay na rosas kapag nakaharap sa base. Mahika ng agham!

statements.text: You can make your own acid-base indicator at home! Use flowers or turmeric to test if a liquid is an acid or a base. Easy science experiment!
statements.tl: Maaari kang gumawa ng sarili mong indikador sa bahay! Gumamit ng mga bulaklak o luyang-dilaw para subukan kung asido o base ang isang likido. Madaling eksperimento sa agham!

statements.text: Dip a pH strip into a liquid! Match its new color to a chart to find the pH.
statements.tl: Isawsaw ang pH strip sa likido! Ihambing ang bagong kulay nito sa tsart para malaman ang pH.

statements.text:
Can plants tell us if something is acidic or basic?

Yes! Dyes from red cabbage or purple yam change color when mixed with acid like vinegar or a base — they work as a natural pH indicator!
statements.tl:
Kaya ba ng halaman malaman kung acidic o basic ang isang bagay?

Oo! Ang pangkulay mula sa pulang repolyo o ube ay nagbabago ng kulay kapag inihalo sa asido tulad ng suka o sa base — natural na pH indicator!

statements.text:
What happens in a single replacement reaction?

A more reactive element takes the place of another in a compound, like iron displacing copper!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa single replacement reaction?

Pumapalit ang mas aktibong elemento sa ibang elemento sa compound, gaya ng bakal na pumapalit sa tanso!

statements.text: In a decomposition reaction, one compound breaks apart into simpler substances! For example, electricity can split water into hydrogen and oxygen.
statements.tl: Sa reaksyong dekomposisyon, isang compound ang nahahati sa mas simpleng sangkap! Halimbawa, hinati ng kuryente ang tubig sa hydrogen at oxygen.

statements.text: In a combination or synthesis reaction, two or more substances join together to form a single new product, like hydrogen and oxygen forming water!
statements.tl: Sa combination o synthesis reaction, dalawa o higit pang sangkap ang nagsasama upang bumuo ng iisang bagong product, gaya ng hydrogen at oxygen na nagiging tubig!
statements.source: Encyclopedia-stable chemistry consensus; DepEd G10 reaction types

statements.text: In a decomposition reaction, a single substance breaks down into two or more simpler substances, which is often caused by heat or electricity!
statements.tl: Sa decomposition reaction, ang iisang sangkap ay nahahati sa dalawa o higit pang mas simpleng sangkap, madalas dahil sa init o kuryente!
statements.source: Encyclopedia-stable chemistry consensus; DepEd G10 reaction types

statements.text:
What happens in a double replacement reaction?

Two compounds exchange their parts, called ions, to form two new compounds, and it often produces a solid precipitate!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa double replacement reaction?

Dalawang compound ang nagpapalitan ng kanilang mga bahagi (ions) upang bumuo ng dalawang bagong compound, na kadalasang nagbubuo ng latak!
statements.source: Encyclopedia-stable chemistry consensus; DepEd G10 reaction types

statements.text: In a double replacement reaction, two compounds exchange ions with each other, like magnesium oxide and calcium sulfide swapping partners to form calcium oxide and magnesium sulfide.
statements.tl: Sa double replacement reaction, dalawang compound ang nagpapalitan ng ions sa isa't isa, tulad ng magnesium oxide at calcium sulfide na nagpalit ng partners para maging calcium oxide at magnesium sulfide.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BQCuvWD7BOk3HdRbVvQ1Y6JzCpQRKOnD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The activity series of nonmetals ranks elements like fluorine, chlorine, bromine, and iodine from most active to least active, helping predict single replacement reactions.
statements.tl: Ang activity series ng nonmetals ay nagraranggo ng mga element tulad ng fluorine, chlorine, bromine, at iodine mula sa pinaka-active hanggang sa pinaka-hindi active, na tumutulong sa paghula ng single replacement reactions.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BQCuvWD7BOk3HdRbVvQ1Y6JzCpQRKOnD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a combination reaction, two or more simple substances join together to form one more complex substance.
statements.tl: Sa combination reaction, dalawa o higit pang simpleng substances ang nagsasama upang bumuo ng isang mas complex na substance.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ttrkje8TiEM3yJUXzzVjmv4g-RhZDD1k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Single replacement reactions are used in silver plating, where copper replaces silver in a compound, causing silver crystals to form on the copper.
statements.tl: Ang single replacement reactions ay ginagamit sa silver plating, kung saan pinapalitan ng copper ang silver sa isang compound, na nagiging sanhi ng pagbuo ng silver crystals sa copper.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ttrkje8TiEM3yJUXzzVjmv4g-RhZDD1k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Water can be broken down into hydrogen gas and oxygen gas by passing direct electricity through it, a process called electrolysis.
statements.tl: Ang tubig ay maaaring hatiin para maging hydrogen gas at oxygen gas sa pamamagitan ng pagdaan ng direktang kuryente dito, isang proseso na tinatawag na electrolysis.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1xOFNnbUdar22wbDQyi72ODfZsUX922j_), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Nitrogen alone isn't enough to make nitrogen oxides -- oxygen is needed too. When lightning strikes, its heat pushes the air's nitrogen and oxygen together to combine and form them.
statements.tl: Hindi sapat ang nitrogen lang para makabuo ng nitrogen oxides -- kailangan din ng oxygen. Kapag tumama ang kidlat, itinutulak ng init nito ang nitrogen at oxygen sa hangin para magsama at bumuo nito.

statements.text: In a synthesis or combination reaction, two or more substances join to form a single new compound. For example, hydrogen and oxygen form water!
statements.tl: Sa isang synthesis o combination reaction, dalawa o higit pang sangkap ang nagsasama upang bumuo ng iisang bagong compound, gaya ng hydrogen at oxygen na nagiging tubig!

statements.text: Decomposition is a chemical change where bacteria break down dead leaves into nutrient-rich soil during composting!
statements.tl: Ang decomposition ay isang chemical change kung saan ang bacteria ay nagbubungkag ng patay na dahon para gawing nutrient-rich na lupa!

statements.text: In a single replacement reaction, one element takes the place of another in a compound, like a more active metal replacing a less active one!
statements.tl: Sa single replacement reaction, ang isang elemento ay pumapalit sa isa pang elemento sa loob ng isang compound, gaya ng mas aktibong metal na pumapalit sa mas mahinang metal!
statements.source: Encyclopedia-stable chemistry consensus; DepEd G10 reaction types

statements.text: When an acid reacts with many metals, hydrogen gas comes out as fun bubbles! A dissolved salt is left behind in the water.
statements.tl: Kapag nag-react ang acid sa maraming metal, lumalabas ang hydrogen gas bilang mga bula! May naiiwang dissolved salt sa tubig.
statements.source: Consensus chemistry; DepEd Science CG (Matter, JHS)

statements.text:
What can help a decomposition reaction break a compound apart?

An energy input can help! Heat, light, or electricity can break a compound apart into simpler substances.
statements.tl:
Ano ang makakatulong sa decomposition reaction para mahati ang compound?

Makakatulong ang energy input! Ang init, liwanag, o kuryente ay maaaring humati sa compound para maging mas simpleng substance.

statements.text: A metal can only swap places in a single replacement reaction if it is more reactive! Check the activity series to see the ranking.
statements.tl: Ang isang metal ay pwedeng makipag-swap sa single replacement reaction kung mas reactive ito! Tingnan ang activity series para sa ranking.

statements.text: Double replacement reactions happen when they form a solid precipitate, a gas, or water! This removes ions from the solution.
statements.tl: Nangyayari ang double replacement reactions kapag nabubuo ang solid precipitate, gas, o tubig! Inaalis nito ang mga ions mula sa solution.

statements.text: When soaked in vinegar, the acid reacts with the shell's calcium carbonate. It releases carbon dioxide bubbles until the hard shell dissolves!
statements.tl: Kapag inilubog sa suka, ang asido ay tumutugon sa calcium carbonate ng balat. Naglalabas ito ng mga bula ng carbon dioxide hanggang matunaw ang matigas na balat!

statements.text: When wood or gas burns completely, it produces carbon dioxide and water vapor!
statements.tl: Kapag kumpleto ang pagsunog ng kahoy o gas, nakabubuo ito ng carbon dioxide at singaw ng tubig!

statements.text: Acid rain harms living and nonliving things, damaging leaves, dissolving eggshells and limestone, and corroding metals like paperclips.
statements.tl: Nakakasira ang acid rain sa mga bagay na may buhay at walang buhay, sinisira ang mga dahon, tinutunaw ang eggshells at limestone, at kinakalawang ang mga metal tulad ng paperclips.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BQCuvWD7BOk3HdRbVvQ1Y6JzCpQRKOnD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Burning fossil fuels provides energy for vehicles and factories, but it releases chemicals that cause global warming and pollute the air.
statements.tl: Ang pagsunog ng fossil fuels ay nagbibigay ng enerhiya para sa mga sasakyan at pabrika, pero naglalabas ito ng mga kemikal na nagdudulot ng global warming at nagpaparumi sa hangin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1I4pg_DtFgp6VlwOgJYk0tdqQ17z_6_wa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Acids can corrode materials, which means they can slowly wear away or dissolve things like metal and stone.
statements.tl: Ang mga acid ay kayang i-corrode ang mga materyales, na nangangahulugang kaya nilang unti-unting sirain o tunawin ang mga bagay tulad ng bakal at bato.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1do6lXrzBewAHaGiswgjpPGWqnfnDwJtz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Can cooking in an iron pan add iron to food?

Yes! Cooking in an old iron pan, especially with acidic dishes, can add a small amount of iron to your food.
statements.tl:
Nakakadagdag ba ng iron ang lumang kawaling bakal?

Oo! Kapag nagluto gamit ang lumang kawali o kalderong bakal, lalo na sa maasim na ulam, may kaunting iron na naidadagdag sa pagkain.

statements.text: Acids can react with metals and slowly wear them away, breaking them down bit by bit!
statements.tl: Ang mga asido ay maaaring tumugon sa metal at unti-unting sirain ito nang dahan-dahan!

statements.text: Chemical changes also happen inside living things! This includes photosynthesis in plants and digesting food right inside our stomach.
statements.tl: May mga kemikal na pagbabago rin sa loob ng mga buhay na bagay! Kabilang dito ang potosintesis sa halaman at panunaw ng pagkain sa ating tiyan.

statements.text: When fuel like wood or gasoline burns, it uses up oxygen from the air and releases carbon dioxide!
statements.tl: Kapag nasusunog ang panggatong tulad ng kahoy o gasolina, ginagamit nito ang oxygen sa hangin at naglalabas ng carbon dioxide!

statements.text: Combustion is a chemical reaction where fuel combines with oxygen to release energy!
statements.tl: Ang pagsunog ay isang reaksyong kemikal kung saan nakikipagsanib ang panggatong sa oxygen at naglalabas ng enerhiya!

statements.text:
What happens when acids touch things like chalk or marble?

Acids react with things made of calcium carbonate like chalk, seashells, and marble! They bubble and slowly dissolve. Acids can also damage the different minerals in your teeth.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag ang acid ay tumutugon sa tisa o marmol?

Tumutugon ang acid sa mga bagay na gawa sa calcium carbonate tulad ng tisa, kabibe, at marmol! Bumubula at unti-unting natutunaw ang mga ito. Nasisira rin ng acid ang ibang mineral sa ngipin.

statements.text:
Why does a flame go out when it runs out of oxygen?

Burning is a chemical reaction where fire eats oxygen from the air. When the oxygen runs out, the flame dies!
statements.tl:
Bakit namamatay ang apoy kapag naubusan ng oxygen?

Ang pagkasunog (combustion) ay isang chemical reaction kung saan kumakain ang apoy ng oxygen. Kapag naubusan ng oxygen, namamatay ito!
statements.source: NRC PS1.B; AAAS BSL Ch.4D; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
Did you know burning wood or gas also releases water?

Yes! Many fuels contain hydrogen, so burning them releases water vapor — another invisible gas floating into the air.
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba na kapag nasusunog ang kahoy o gas, naglalabas din ito ng tubig?

Oo! Maraming gatong ang may hydrogen, kaya kapag nasusunog ay naglalabas ng singaw ng tubig — isa pang hindi nakikitang gas.

statements.text:
What dangerous gas is released when fuel doesn't burn completely?

Carbon monoxide! It's a poisonous gas with no smell or color — very dangerous to breathe in.
statements.tl:
Anong delikadong gas ang lumalabas kapag hindi ganap na nasusunog ang gatong?

Carbon monoxide! Isang nakakalasong gas na walang amoy o kulay — napakadelikado kapag nalanghap.

statements.text: A yellow, smoky flame means incomplete combustion — there's too little oxygen, so it makes lots of soot and smoke.
statements.tl: Ang madilaw at mausok na apoy ay tanda ng incomplete combustion — kulang ang oxygen kaya maraming agiw at usok ang nagagawa.

statements.text: The blue flame on a gas stove means complete combustion — plenty of oxygen, almost no smoke, and a hotter burn!
statements.tl: Ang asul na apoy sa gas stove ay tanda ng complete combustion — sapat ang oxygen, halos walang usok, at mas mainit!

statements.text: That black stain under a pot or on a wall near the stove is soot! It is carbon that collected from the smoke of burning fuel.
statements.tl: Ang itim na mantsa sa ilalim ng kaldero o sa dingding malapit sa kalan ay agiw! Ito ay carbon na naipon mula sa usok ng nasusunog na gatong.

statements.text: Burning coal and oil that contain sulfur releases sulfur dioxide! This gas goes up into the sky and can cause acid rain.
statements.tl: Ang pagsunog ng karbon at langis na may sulfur ay naglalabas ng sulfur dioxide! Ang gas na ito ay maaaring magdulot ng acid rain.

statements.text: In a chemical reaction, starting substances (reactants) rearrange atoms to form new substances (products) with different properties!
statements.tl: Sa isang reaksyong kemikal, ang mga panimulang sangkap (reactant) ay nag-aayos-muli ng atomo para bumuo ng bagong sangkap (product) na may ibang katangian!

statements.text: Chemists use chemical equations to represent chemical reactions, showing the reactants and products.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang mga chemist ng chemical equations upang kumatawan sa mga chemical reaction, na nagpapakita ng mga reactant at product.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TWPNn_eVOFWneGPsmeg4whEowrdaYxyo), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A word equation uses the names of substances to summarize a reaction, with plus signs separating substances and an arrow meaning 'produces'.
statements.tl: Ang word equation ay gumagamit ng mga pangalan ng substance para ibuod ang isang reaksyon, kung saan pinaghihiwalay ng plus sign ang mga substance at ang arrow ay nangangahulugang 'bumubuo ng'.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UiCPHswL1cD_ZE7PzxVhcbowQSB0zZxX), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What do the little letters (s), (l), (g), and (aq) mean in an equation?

They are state symbols that tell the physical form: solid, liquid, gas, or aqueous, which means dissolved in water!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng maliliit na letrang (s), (l), (g), at (aq) sa isang equation?

Ang mga ito ay state symbol na nagsasabi ng physical na anyo: solid, liquid, gas, o aqueous na ibig sabihin natunaw sa tubig!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UiCPHswL1cD_ZE7PzxVhcbowQSB0zZxX), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do scientists write down a chemical reaction without drawing pictures?

They use a chemical equation, a symbolic representation that shows the substances before and after the reaction!
statements.tl:
Paano isinusulat ng mga scientist ang chemical reaction nang hindi nagdodrowing ng mga larawan?

Gumagamit sila ng chemical equation, isang symbolic representation na nagpapakita ng mga substance bago at pagkatapos ng reaction!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1efA4vU1-Icb_vSzYlvyUghF7YJNKZF6v), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A chemical reaction is the process where starting materials called reactants break and form bonds to become new substances called products.
statements.tl: Ang chemical reaction ay proseso kung saan ang mga panimulang materyal na tinatawag na reactants ay sumisira at bumubuo ng bond upang maging mga bagong substance na tinatawag na products.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1z2snovWRiI1dnyaqnmGQh0awrOqbnh8z), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When an acid meets a base, two things form: a salt and water. The basic recipe is: acid + base = salt + water!
statements.tl: Kapag naghalo ang asido at base, dalawang bagay ang nabubuo: asin at tubig. Ang basic na recipe ay: acid + base = salt + water!

statements.text: In a chemical equation, reactants are the starting substances before a reaction. Products are the new substances formed after, and they are separated by an arrow!
statements.tl: Sa isang chemical equation, ang mga reactant ay ang mga sangkap bago ang reaksyon. Ang mga product ay ang mga bagong sangkap pagkatapos, na pinaghihiwalay ng palaso!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable consensus; NRC PS1.B (conservation in reactions)

statements.text:
How do we read a chemical equation?

Reactants go on the left of the arrow, and products on the right! The arrow simply means 'yields' or 'becomes.'
statements.tl:
Paano natin binabasa ang isang ekwasyong kemikal?

Ang mga reactant ay nasa kaliwa ng palaso, at ang mga product sa kanan! Ang palaso ay nangangahulugang 'nagiging.'

statements.text: A chemical equation is like a recipe! It tells scientists which ingredients react and what new substances they make.
statements.tl: Ang chemical equation ay parang recipe! Sinasabi nito sa mga siyentista kung aling sangkap ang magre-react at anong bagong substance ang magagawa.

statements.text:
How do scientists write down a chemical reaction at first?

They start by writing the names of the substances in words before switching to chemical symbols!
statements.tl:
Paano muna isinulat ng mga siyentista ang isang chemical reaction?

Nagsisimula sila sa pagsulat ng mga pangalan ng substance sa mga salita bago lumipat sa chemical symbols!

statements.text:
What does the arrow in a chemical equation mean?

It points from the starting substances to the new substances, showing the direction the reaction goes!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng arrow sa isang chemical equation?

Tumuturo ito mula sa panimulang substance papunta sa bagong substance, na nagpapakita ng direksyon ng reaction!

statements.text:
How do scientists show if something is a gas or dissolved in water?

They add small letters in parentheses like (g) for gas or (aq) for dissolved in water to show each substance's physical state!
statements.tl:
Paano ipinapakita ng mga scientist kung ang isang bagay ay gas o natunaw sa tubig?

Naglalagay sila ng maliliit na letra sa parentheses tulad ng (g) para sa gas o (aq) para sa natunaw sa tubig — para ipakita ang physical state ng bawat substance!

statements.text:
Why do scientists add numbers in front of chemical formulas?

Balancing a chemical equation is like bookkeeping! Scientists add numbers in front of formulas so atoms match on both sides.
statements.tl:
Bakit naglalagay ng mga numero ang mga scientist sa harap ng mga chemical formula?

Ang pagbalanse ng chemical equation ay parang bookkeeping! Naglalagay ang mga scientist ng mga numero sa harap ng mga formula para magkapareho ang atoms sa magkabilang panig.

statements.text: Writing a word equation first helps scientists check they have the right substances before worrying about formulas and numbers!
statements.tl: Ang pagsulat muna ng word equation ay tumutulong sa mga scientist na masuri kung tama ang mga substance bago isipin ang mga formula at numero!

statements.text: Scientists group reactions into types like combination, decomposition, and combustion — the equation pattern helps them spot the type!
statements.tl: Pinapangkat ng mga scientist ang mga reaction sa mga uri tulad ng combination, decomposition, at combustion — ang equation pattern ang tumutulong sa kanila na matukoy ang uri!

statements.text:
Where do scientists write a catalyst's name in a chemical equation?

If a reaction needs a catalyst to speed it up, scientists write the catalyst's name above the arrow instead of counting it as a reactant!
statements.tl:
Saan isinusulat ng mga scientist ang pangalan ng isang catalyst sa chemical equation?

Kung kailangan ng reaction ng catalyst para bumilis, isinusulat ng mga scientist ang pangalan ng catalyst sa itaas ng arrow sa halip na bilangin ito bilang reactant!

statements.text: To verify a formula equation, scientists count the atoms of each element on the left and right — the counts must be equal!
statements.tl: Upang masuri ang formula equation, binibilang ng mga scientist ang atoms ng bawat elemento sa kaliwa at kanan — dapat magkapareho ang mga bilang!

statements.text: In a chemical change, atoms aren't destroyed! They just rearrange to form new substances, keeping the total amount of matter the same.
statements.tl: Sa chemical change, hindi nasisira ang mga atomo! Nagbabago lang ang pagkakaayos nila para sa bagong sangkap, kaya pareho ang kabuuang dami.

statements.text: In any chemical reaction, the number of each kind of atom is the same before and after! The total mass does not change, only the arrangement does.
statements.tl: Sa anumang reaksiyong kemikal, pareho ang bilang ng bawat uri ng atomo bago at pagkatapos! Hindi nagbabago ang kabuuang masa, nagbabago lang ang pagkakaayos.

statements.text: The law of conservation of mass applies to everyday processes like fire and biological metabolism, where atoms are rearranged but never created or destroyed.
statements.tl: Ang law of conservation of mass ay nalalapat sa pang-araw-araw na proseso tulad ng apoy at biological metabolism, kung saan ang mga atom ay inaayos muli ngunit hindi kailanman nalilikha o nasisira.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 14w62SBRue4gXWXDBxgYB8zTWAhjZM7zf), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The Law of Conservation of Mass says that in a chemical reaction, the total mass of the starting materials, called reactants, is always equal to the total mass of what is made, called products.
statements.tl: Sinasabi ng Law of Conservation of Mass na sa isang chemical reaction, ang kabuuang mass ng mga panimulang materyales, na tinatawag na reactants, ay laging katumbas ng kabuuang mass ng mga nabubuo, na tinatawag na products.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jPi34V4kaIWmGhyTOIDGhuOazbMV64z1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
If I use up 20 grams of reactants, how much product should I get?

According to the Law of Conservation of Mass, you should theoretically get 20 grams of product, because mass is never lost or gained.
statements.tl:
Kung naubos ko ang 20 grams ng reactants, gaano karaming product ang dapat kong makuha?

Ayon sa Law of Conservation of Mass, dapat ay 20 grams ng product ang makuha mo, dahil ang mass ay hindi nawawala o nadadagdagan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jPi34V4kaIWmGhyTOIDGhuOazbMV64z1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: During any chemical reaction, the total mass of a closed system remains constant, meaning the mass of all reactants equals the mass of all products.
statements.tl: Sa anumang chemical reaction, ang kabuuang mass ng isang saradong system ay nananatiling pareho, ibig sabihin ang mass ng lahat ng reactant ay katumbas ng mass ng lahat ng product.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jPi34V4kaIWmGhyTOIDGhuOazbMV64z1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: If you know the masses of all reactants except one, you can find the missing mass by subtracting the known masses from the total product mass.
statements.tl: Kung alam mo ang mass ng lahat ng reactant maliban sa isa, mahahanap mo ang nawawalang mass sa pamamagitan ng pagbabawas ng mga alam na mass mula sa kabuuang mass ng product.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jPi34V4kaIWmGhyTOIDGhuOazbMV64z1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
When wood burns and turns to ash, does the matter just disappear?

Nope! Matter is never lost or created. The wood becomes ash and gases — their total mass equals the original wood plus the air it used!
statements.tl:
Kapag nasunog ang kahoy at naging abo, nawawala ba ang matter?

Hindi! Hindi nawawala o nalilikha ang matter. Ang kahoy ay nagiging abo at gases — ang kabuuang mass ay katumbas ng orihinal na kahoy at hangin na ginamit!

statements.text:
Does matter really vanish when things change?

Nope! Atoms don't disappear — they just rearrange into a new pattern, so the total mass stays the same when nothing enters or leaves!
statements.tl:
Nawawala ba talaga ang matter kapag nagbabago?

Hindi! Hindi nawawala ang mga atom — nag-aayos lang sila sa bagong paraan, kaya pareho pa rin ang kabuuang mass kapag walang pumapasok o lumalabas!

statements.text:
Does matter disappear when things change?

Nope! In both physical and chemical changes, matter is never lost. The total mass stays exactly the same before and after!
statements.tl:
Nawawala ba ang materya kapag nagbabago ang mga bagay?

Hindi! Sa parehong physical at kemikal na pagbabago, hindi nawawala ang materya. Pareho pa rin ang kabuuang mass bago at pagkatapos!
statements.source: NRC PS1.B; conservation of mass; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: In any chemical reaction, mass is never lost or gained! The total mass before equals the total mass after because atoms just rearrange, not disappear.
statements.tl: Sa anumang chemical reaction, hindi nawawala o nadadagdagan ang mass! Pantay ang mass bago at pagkatapos dahil nagbabago lang ng ayos ang mga atomo, hindi sila nawawala.

statements.text:
Does the mixture really lose matter?

It seems lighter because gas escapes into the air, but no matter is truly lost!
statements.tl:
Nawawalan ba talaga ng matter ang timpla?

Tila gumagaan dahil tumatakas ang gas sa hangin, pero walang matter na talagang nawawala!
statements.source: NRC PS1.B conservation of matter; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: When you mix baking soda and vinegar in a sealed bag, the fizzing gas forms but the weight stays the same because it cannot escape!
statements.tl: Kapag pinaghalo ang baking soda at suka sa selyadong supot, may bumubulang gas pero pareho pa rin ang timbang dahil hindi makatakas!

statements.text: To see conservation of mass when a reaction makes gas, the container must be sealed! If it is open, the gas escapes and the measured mass drops.
statements.tl: Para makita ang konserbasyon ng masa kapag may gas ang reaksyon, dapat selyado ang sisidlan! Kung bukas, tumatakas ang gas at bumababa ang nasusukat na masa.

statements.text:
Why is ash lighter than unburned wood?

Much of the mass left as smoke and gas! It is not lost, it just moved into the air.
statements.tl:
Bakit mas magaan ang abo kaysa sa hindi pa nasusunog na kahoy?

Maraming masa ang umalis bilang usok at gas! Hindi ito nawawala, lumipat lang sa hangin.

statements.text: By the law of conservation of mass, matter cannot be created or destroyed in an ordinary change! It can only change its form.
statements.tl: Ayon sa batas ng konserbasyon ng masa, hindi maaaring likhain o sirain ang materya sa karaniwang pagbabago! Maaari lang itong magbagong-anyo.

statements.text: When fruit rots, it looks like it disappears! But its matter turns into gases, water, and other substances that spread around — nothing is truly lost!
statements.tl: Kapag nabubulok ang prutas, parang naglaho! Pero ang materya nito ay nagiging gas, tubig, at iba pang sangkap na kumakalat sa paligid — hindi talaga nawawala!

statements.text: During a physical change like melting or freezing, mass stays the same — nothing is added or removed, only the form changes!
statements.tl: Sa pisikal na pagbabago tulad ng pagtunaw o pagyeyelo, pareho pa rin ang masa — walang nadadagdag o nababawas, anyo lang ang nagbabago!

statements.text: We balance a chemical equation by adding coefficients! This makes sure the number of each atom is exactly the same on the reactant and product sides.
statements.tl: Binabalanse natin ang isang ekwasyong kemikal sa paglalagay ng mga coefficient! Ginagawa ito para magkapareho ang bilang ng bawat atomo sa reactant at product.
statements.source: Encyclopedia-stable chemistry consensus; follows from AAAS 4D/M7 conservation

statements.text: To check if an equation is balanced, count each element's atoms! Just multiply the coefficient by the subscript in each formula.
statements.tl: Para malaman kung balanced ang equation, bilangin ang mga atom! I-multiply lang ang coefficient sa subscript sa bawat formula.

statements.text: A compound is represented by a chemical formula that shows the symbols of the atoms of the elements present and their numbers as subscripts.
statements.tl: Ang isang compound ay kinakatawan ng isang chemical formula na nagpapakita ng mga simbolo ng atoms ng mga elementong naroroon at ang kanilang mga bilang bilang mga subscript.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1NH0eUpQRtoiRyTPtQz3L7ThhnsuGPtx0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A chemical formula uses element symbols and small lowered numbers called subscripts to show exactly how many atoms of each element are in a compound.
statements.tl: Ang chemical formula ay gumagamit ng mga symbol ng element at maliliit na numerong nakababa na tinatawag na subscript para ipakita kung ilang atom ng bawat element ang nasa isang compound.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UiCPHswL1cD_ZE7PzxVhcbowQSB0zZxX), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do we balance a chemical equation?

We use the inspection method: count the atoms of each element on both sides, then change the big numbers in front, called coefficients, until both sides match!
statements.tl:
