Paano ko malalaman kung alin ang pinakamaikli at pinakamahabang dahon?

Ikumpara mo ang haba ng mga ito sa pamamagitan ng pagsukat mula dulo hanggang base sa pinakamahabang bahagi.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1eSQ6gBQvFtu0-RQZbhrBVwOqmlEx8tXV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Measuring is the act of determining the size, length, weight, or capacity of something, like using a ruler to check a leaf's length or a scale to weigh collected trash.
statements.tl: Ang measuring ay pagtukoy sa laki, haba, bigat, o capacity ng isang bagay, tulad ng paggamit ng ruler para sukatin ang dahon o paggamit ng timbangan para sa basura.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1reQGjD4XizkxFl0QlhofkTk0c-bJmRol), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Kids use an insect net in the garden to gently catch bugs, take a close look, then set them free again.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ng lambat-panghuli ang mga bata sa hardin para dahan-dahang mahuli ang mga kulisap, tignan itong mabuti, at pakawalan ulit.

statements.text: Science starts with good questions like 'Why?' and 'How?' — they push us to investigate and search for answers.
statements.tl: Nagsisimula ang agham sa magagandang tanong tulad ng 'Bakit?' at 'Paano?', na nagtutulak sa atin na mag-imbestiga at humanap ng sagot.
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 1A; NRC Framework science practices

statements.text: Try this at home! Pour water into a glass, add a little cooking oil, and watch it quickly rise and float on top!
statements.tl: Subukan mo sa bahay! Magbuhos ng tubig sa baso, lagyan ng kaunting mantika, at panoorin mong agad itong aakyat at lalutang sa ibabaw!

statements.text:
How can you build a simple anemometer to measure wind strength?

Use four cups on a spinning stick! Count how many turns it makes in one minute to tell how strong the wind is.
statements.tl:
Paano ka makakagawa ng simpleng anemometer para sukatin ang lakas ng hangin?

Gumamit ng apat na tasa sa umiikot na stick! Bilangin kung ilang ikot sa isang minuto para malaman kung gaano kalakas ang hangin.

statements.text:
How can small pieces of cardboard become one big useful thing?

When you join pieces with tape or glue, they stick together and form a larger, stronger object. Joining changes the size and shape of the material!
statements.tl:
Paano nagiging isang malaking kapaki-pakinabang na bagay ang maliliit na piraso ng karton?

Kapag pinagdikit mo ang mga piraso gamit ang tape o glue, nagkakadikit ang mga ito at bumubuo ng mas malaki at mas matibay na bagay. Binabago ng pagdikit ang laki at hugis ng materyal!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1B_MYfU2LyjNNncWwyUWbHt7K4UCZGPCt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do scientists use a hand lens or ruler when they already have eyes?

Because tools like hand lenses and rulers extend the senses! They help us see tiny details and measure length more accurately than our eyes alone.
statements.tl:
Bakit gumagamit ang mga scientist ng hand lens o ruler kung may mata naman na sila?

Dahil ang mga tools tulad ng hand lens at ruler ay nagpapalawak ng ating senses! Tinutulungan tayo nitong makita ang maliliit na detalye at masukat ang haba nang mas tama kaysa sa mata lang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1I-0H1t3GyEVh8CJwTK4mXAYaMtx_MTvz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Scissors are used to cut cloth, paper, cardboard, and other thin materials.
statements.tl: Ang gunting ay ginagamit upang putulin ang tela, papel, karton, at iba pang maninipis na materyales.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1l_ecim7S-HjRcWCKNNwJ7ZRCYxNmgU-h), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A ruler is a handy tool for measuring length! It has centimeter and millimeter marks to show exactly how long an object is.
statements.tl: Ang ruler ay isang handy na kasangkapan para sa pagsukat ng haba! May mga marka ito ng sentimetro at milimetro para malaman kung gaano kahaba ang isang bagay.

statements.text: A ruler measures short lengths in centimeters, like the length of a pencil.
statements.tl: Ginagamit ang ruler sa pagsukat ng maiikling length gamit ang centimeters, tulad ng haba ng lapis.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Can one ruler measure everything?

No! Different rulers or tapes are suited for different objects. A short ruler works for a pencil, but a long tape measure is better for a cabinet.
statements.tl:
Kaya bang sukatin ng isang ruler ang lahat?

Hindi! Iba't ibang ruler o tape ang bagay sa iba't ibang bagay. Ang maikling ruler ay para sa lapis, pero mas bagay ang mahabang tape measure sa cabinet.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ubQhpZzmC4_n-2ZlvCP0JtV59jKQ3MH2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Entomologists use a butterfly net with a long handle and fine mesh to safely catch and study flying insects.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang mga entomologist ng butterfly net na may mahabang hawakan at pinong mesh para ligtas na mahuli at mapag-aralan ang mga lumilipad na insekto.

statements.text:
What is a stethoscope used for?

A stethoscope lets doctors listen to sounds inside your body, like your heartbeat and the breath in your lungs!
statements.tl:
Para saan ginagamit ang stethoscope?

Ginagamit ang stethoscope para pakinggan ang tunog sa loob ng katawan, tulad ng tibok ng puso at hininga sa baga!

statements.text: A pitfall trap is a cup buried level with the ground, so small crawling soil animals fall in and scientists can count them.
statements.tl: Ang pitfall trap ay isang lalagyang ibinabaon nang pantay sa lupa, para mahulog dito ang maliliit na hayop na gumagapang at mabilang ito ng mga siyentipiko.

statements.text: Goggles are protective glasses you wear over your eyes to shield them from chemical splashes or flying bits during experiments.
statements.tl: Ang goggles ay salaming isinusuot sa mata para protektahan ito sa tilamsik ng kemikal o maliliit na bagay sa eksperimento.
statements.source: DepEd science safety guidelines; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: A petri dish is a shallow glass or plastic container scientists use to grow bacteria and microbes so they can study them closely.
statements.tl: Ang petri dish ay isang mababaw na lalagyan na salamin o plastic na ginagamit ng mga siyentista para patubuin ang bacteria at mikrobyo para mapag-aralan.

statements.text: A thermometer measures temperature, or how hot or cold something is. We read it by checking where the liquid or number reaches in Celsius!
statements.tl: Ang termometro ay sumusukat ng temperatura o kung gaano kainit o kalamig. Binabasa natin ito sa pamamagitan ng pagtingin kung saan umaabot ang likido o numero sa Celsius!

statements.text:
What tool do we use to check how hot or cold something is?

A thermometer! It is a very handy tool that measures the exact temperature of things.
statements.tl:
Anong kasangkapan ang ginagamit natin para malaman kung gaano kainit o kalamig ang isang bagay?

Ang termometro! Ito ay isang kasangkapan na sumusukat kung gaano kainit o kalamig ang isang bagay.

statements.text: A balloon has three parts: the big body, the narrow neck, and the mouth! When you knot the neck, the air gets trapped inside the body so it cannot escape.
statements.tl: May tatlong bahagi ang lobo: ang malaking katawan, ang makitid na leeg, at ang bibig! Kapag binuhol mo ang leeg, naiipit ang hangin sa loob kaya hindi ito tumatakas.

statements.text:
What is a beaker used for in the lab?

A beaker is a glass container with measuring marks on the side! It is used to hold, heat, and roughly measure liquids.
statements.tl:
Para saan ang beaker sa laboratoryo?

Ang beaker ay basong salamin na may mga markang panukat sa gilid! Ginagamit ito para maglagay, magpainit, at tantiyahin ang dami ng likido.

statements.text:
What tool helps you pour liquids without spilling?

A funnel! It is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, guiding liquids or sand into small openings.
statements.tl:
Anong kagamitan ang tumutulong magbuhos ng likido nang hindi tumatapon?

Ang embudo! Malapad ito sa itaas at makitid sa ibaba, kaya madali ibuhos ang likido o buhangin sa maliit na butas.

statements.text:
What protects your eyes from splashes in the lab?

Goggles! These close-fitting eyewear shield your eyes from chemical splashes or flying bits in the laboratory.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagpoprotekta sa mata mo mula sa tilamsik sa lab?

Goggles! Ang mahigpit ang lapat na salamin na ito ay nagpoprotekta sa mata mula sa tilamsik ng kemikal o lumilipad na bagay.

statements.text: A triple beam balance is a school lab scale that measures mass accurately to tenths of a gram using three sliding weights on three beams!
statements.tl: Ang triple beam balance ay isang timbangan sa school lab na sumusukat ng mass nang tumpak hanggang ikasampu ng gramo gamit ang tatlong sliding weights sa tatlong beams!

statements.text: The symbol for centimeter is "cm"! You see it all the time on your school rulers.
statements.tl: Ang simbolo para sa sentimetro ay "cm"! Madalas itong makita sa mga ruler.

statements.text: One meter equals exactly 100 centimeters! You can fit 100 small centimeters inside one big meter.
statements.tl: Isang metro ay katumbas ng 100 sentimetro! Pwede kang maglagay ng 100 maliit na sentimetro sa loob ng isang metro.

statements.text: Look closely at your ruler! One centimeter equals exactly 10 millimeters. Count them yourself!
statements.tl: Tumingin nang mabuti sa ruler mo! Isang sentimetro ay katumbas ng 10 milimetro. Bilangin mo!

statements.text:
How do scientists observe carefully?

They look, listen, and touch carefully! Then, they write down exactly what they notice without adding any guesses.
statements.tl:
Paano nag-oobserve nang mabuti ang mga scientist?

Tumitingin, nakikinig, at humahawak sila nang mabuti! Tapos, isinusulat nila nang eksakto ang napapansin nang walang dagdag na hula.

statements.text:
How do scientists predict and check?

They use what they know to guess what happens next in a test, then they measure to check!
statements.tl:
Paano nag-predict at nag-check ang mga scientist?

Ginagamit nila ang alam nila para hulaan ang susunod na mangyayari sa test, tapos sinusukat nila para i-check!

statements.text: When you press a button and listen to the sound it makes, you are using your sense of hearing to observe.
statements.tl: Kapag pinindot mo ang isang button at pinakinggan ang tunog nito, ginagamit mo ang iyong pandinig para mag-observe.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17L1W4QsuxQmlAkIVoiYHyG5fKX7HpIqY), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does it mean to predict in science?

Predicting is using your observations to tell what will happen next!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng pag-predict sa science?

Ang predicting ay ang paggamit ng iyong mga obserbasyon para sabihin kung ano ang susunod na mangyayari!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17L1W4QsuxQmlAkIVoiYHyG5fKX7HpIqY), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Do you use observing only in science class?

No! You use observing in your daily life whenever you look, listen, smell, taste, or touch things around you!
statements.tl:
Ginagamit mo ba ang observing sa science class lang?

Hindi! Ginagamit mo ang observing sa iyong pang-araw-araw na buhay tuwing tumitingin ka, nakikinig, umaamoy, tumitikim, o humahawak ng mga bagay sa paligid mo!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17L1W4QsuxQmlAkIVoiYHyG5fKX7HpIqY), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What makes a measurement complete?

A measurement always has two parts: a magnitude, which is the number, and a unit, which tells you what scale was used. For example, in 10 meters, 10 is the magnitude and meters is the unit.
statements.tl:
Ano ang bumubuo sa isang kumpletong measurement?

Ang isang measurement ay laging may dalawang bahagi: ang magnitude, na siyang numero, at ang unit, na nagsasabi kung anong scale ang ginamit. Halimbawa, sa 10 meters, ang 10 ang magnitude at ang meters ang unit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18JhqAzYFZar9YfM9vODOjZCyyRtDDKnP), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you observe a candle, you use your senses to note its properties, like its white color and waxy texture.
statements.tl: Kapag nag-oobserve ka ng kandila, ginagamit mo ang iyong mga pandama upang pansinin ang mga katangian nito, tulad ng puting kulay at waxy na tekstura.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1OSgczAaDPaJCjr64sbnEKss8H38P7Yjw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you infer that a candle is made of wax, you are using your observations of its look and feel to explain what it is made of.
statements.tl: Kapag nag-iinfer ka na ang kandila ay gawa sa wax, ginagamit mo ang iyong mga obserbasyon sa itsura at pakiramdam nito upang ipaliwanag kung saan ito gawa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1OSgczAaDPaJCjr64sbnEKss8H38P7Yjw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Observing means using your senses—like seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, and tasting—to gather information about an object or event.
statements.tl: Ang pag-obserba ay ang paggamit ng iyong mga senses—tulad ng paningin, pandinig, paghawak, pang-amoy, at panlasa—para mangalap ng impormasyon tungkol sa isang bagay o pangyayari.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RBw-M1zdZxcBtYpujI1UyzYclna6zmYR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Measuring uses standard units like centimeters or grams, or nonstandard units like paper clips, to describe the length, mass, or amount of something.
statements.tl: Ang pagsukat ay gumagamit ng standard units tulad ng centimeters o grams, o nonstandard units tulad ng paper clips, para ilarawan ang haba, bigat, o dami ng isang bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RBw-M1zdZxcBtYpujI1UyzYclna6zmYR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Predicting is a science process skill where you forecast future events based on patterns of evidence, like expecting heavy rain and strong winds when a typhoon is coming.
statements.tl: Ang predicting ay isang science process skill kung saan hinuhulaan mo ang mga mangyayari sa hinaharap batay sa mga pattern ng ebidensya, tulad ng pag-asa ng malakas na ulan at hangin kapag may paparating na bagyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Wa1ixBDOg5r6ZT_rikGxD6A7eo-Y3Bx9), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Measuring is a science process skill that makes your observations more accurate, so you can describe things with numbers instead of just guesses.
statements.tl: Ang pagsukat ay isang science process skill na ginagawang mas accurate ang iyong mga obserbasyon, kaya mailalarawan mo ang mga bagay gamit ang numero imbes na hula lang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YBVxDp316Myg5H-FyBBsW2Dv9MDlyvBp), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do you need good observations before making a prediction?

Because you must first identify patterns in what you see, and those patterns are what make your prediction reliable!
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangan mo ng mabuting obserbasyon bago gumawa ng prediction?

Dahil kailangan mo munang makita ang mga pattern sa iyong nakikita, at ang mga pattern na iyon ang gumagawa sa iyong prediction na mapagkakatiwalaan!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YBVxDp316Myg5H-FyBBsW2Dv9MDlyvBp), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do scientists start learning about something new?

They start by making observations, which means obtaining information using their senses like sight, hearing, and touch.
statements.tl:
Paano nagsisimula ang mga scientist na matuto tungkol sa isang bagong bagay?

Nagsisimula sila sa paggawa ng observation, ibig sabihin ay pagkuha ng impormasyon gamit ang kanilang mga senses tulad ng paningin, pandinig, at pandama.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Length and width can be recorded in millimeters or centimeters.
statements.tl: Ang haba at lapad ay maaaring isulat sa millimeters o centimeters.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1eSQ6gBQvFtu0-RQZbhrBVwOqmlEx8tXV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What do we call the bright, shiny surface of clean metals?

Metals are usually shiny, and their bright surface is called a metallic luster when they are clean!
statements.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa makintab at makinang na ibabaw ng malinis na metal?

Ang mga metal ay karaniwang makintab, at ang makinang nilang ibabaw ay tinatawag na metallic luster kapag malinis!

statements.text:
What happens when you blow into a balloon?

It fills with air, which is a gas! The rubber stretches to hold all that air inside.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag hinihipan ang isang lobo?

Napupuno ito ng hangin na isang gas! Ang goma nito ay lumalapad para tumanggap ng lahat ng hangin.

statements.text: The hardness of a mineral simply means how hard it is to scratch!
statements.tl: Ang tigas ng isang mineral ay kung gaano ito kahirap gasgasan o kalmutin!

statements.text: Stretchable objects become longer when pulled, while non-stretchable objects do not change length when pulled.
statements.tl: Ang mga stretchable na bagay ay humahaba kapag hinihila, habang ang mga non-stretchable na bagay ay hindi nagbabago ng haba kapag hinila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10LFqsIW6crBt9IsIpk2WKQaeD0HDYQnH), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Copper is a metal with a shiny reddish-orange color, which makes it easy to recognize among other metals.
statements.tl: Ang tanso ay isang metal na may makintab na mapula-kahel na kulay, kaya madali itong makilala sa ibang mga metal.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 19ud8YWxu8JwOoW80NZUjmx8WhBWyabBy), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Stiff objects resist bending, like a pencil or a wooden ruler.
statements.tl: Ang mga stiff na bagay ay hindi madaling mabaluktot, tulad ng lapis o wooden ruler.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1B543t9tiPLivfPCi2oryaovfKda4c-S8), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Objects can be grouped or classified based on observable properties, like putting all hard objects together or all shiny objects together.
statements.tl: Ang mga bagay ay maaaring pangkatin o i-classify batay sa mga nakikitang property, tulad ng pagsasama-sama ng lahat ng matigas na bagay o lahat ng makintab na bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1B543t9tiPLivfPCi2oryaovfKda4c-S8), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Tissue paper is porous and soft, so it can quickly absorb water and is gentle enough for wiping your face.
statements.tl: Ang tissue paper ay porous at malambot, kaya mabilis itong sumipsip ng tubig at banayad para sa pagpupunas ng mukha.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1F3bvG5Br6uwLIMJtaWuD9H3HxFctilIs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Soft objects yield easily when you apply a force, so they can be squashed, bent, or stretched. A sponge and a piece of bread change shape quickly.
statements.tl: Ang mga soft object ay madaling bumigay kapag nilalapatan ng force, kaya maaari silang mapisat, mabaluktot, o maunat. Ang sponge at tinapay ay mabilis magbago ng hugis.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Few1mrc1EHKyGtW6iC7BKVgL5CyRCTxD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Metals are special materials that are often shiny, strong, and do not break easily, which is why we use them for many things.
statements.tl: Ang mga metal ay espesyal na materyales na kadalasang makintab, matibay, at hindi madaling masira, kaya ginagamit natin ang mga ito sa maraming bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Lbvb-vA-e5w7s9UI5xtuhHOA5mSjC5Rx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gold and silver are shiny metals that reflect light beautifully, making them sparkle and stand out.
statements.tl: Ang ginto at pilak ay mga makintab na metal na magandang nagpapakita ng liwanag, kaya kumikinang at kapansin-pansin ang mga ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Lbvb-vA-e5w7s9UI5xtuhHOA5mSjC5Rx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The physical properties of a material, like being hard, flexible, or shiny, determine what we use it for.
statements.tl: Ang mga physical na katangian ng isang materyales, tulad ng pagiging matigas, flexible, o makintab, ang nagtatakda kung saan natin ito ginagamit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Lbvb-vA-e5w7s9UI5xtuhHOA5mSjC5Rx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does texture mean?

Texture is how something feels when you touch it, and it can be smooth, rough, soft, or hard!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng texture?

Ang texture ay kung paano nararamdaman ang isang bagay kapag hinawakan mo ito, at maaari itong smooth, rough, soft, o hard!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RXQj0EGi5rGj4BqLyzJRJ3Gv2U9hySIz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Hardness is how hard or soft an object is, and you can test it by pressing or tapping the object with your hand.
statements.tl: Ang hardness ay kung gaano katigas o kalambot ang isang bagay, at maaari mo itong subukan sa pamamagitan ng pagdiin o pagtapik sa bagay gamit ang iyong kamay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RXQj0EGi5rGj4BqLyzJRJ3Gv2U9hySIz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cardboard is an absorbent material because it is porous, meaning it has small holes that let water pass through.
statements.tl: Ang karton ay isang absorbent na materyal dahil ito ay porous, ibig sabihin may maliliit itong butas na dinadaanan ng tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ull0CVd2ky4xy8LpDpmxg1RTFVFN9eQ7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cotton balls are soft, fluffy pieces of cotton used for cleaning small wounds, applying medicine, and removing makeup.
statements.tl: Ang cotton balls ay malalambot at mabalahibong piraso ng bulak na ginagamit sa paglilinis ng maliliit na sugat, paglalagay ng gamot, at pagtanggal ng makeup.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YphT_Kq1e974IQObPFWgmGp7J4wsaWzq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Plastic bags are stretchable, which means they can be pulled longer without breaking.
statements.tl: Ang mga plastic bag ay nababanat, ibig sabihin kaya silang hilahin nang humaba nang hindi napupunit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1mNz2fpfVXmKVasGp-mHRmOAmEB7McRFT), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cotton is a solid with a soft texture, while a stone is a solid with a hard texture.
statements.tl: Ang bulak ay solid na may malambot na tekstura, samantalang ang bato ay solid na may matigas na tekstura.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-18564), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Recycling reduces pollution! When we recycle, less trash is burned or left in nature to harm our air and water.
statements.tl: Nakakabawas ng polusyon ang recycling! Kapag nag-recycle, mas kaunting basura ang nasusunog o naiiwan sa kalikasan na makakasama sa hangin at tubig.

statements.text: Throwing trash like plastic anywhere clogs drains and waterways! Because rainwater cannot flow, flooding happens.
statements.tl: Ang pagtatapon ng basura tulad ng plastic kung saan-saan ay nagbabara sa mga kanal! Dahil hindi makaagos ang tubig-ulan, nagkakaroon ng baha.

statements.text: Burning dried leaves releases fine particulate matter into the air! Avoid breathing it in to prevent coughing and asthma attacks.
statements.tl: Ang pagsunog ng tuyong dahon ay naglalabas ng fine particulate matter sa hangin! Iwasan itong malanghap para iwas ubo at asthma.

statements.text: Improper waste disposal pollutes the air when rotting trash releases bad-smelling gases that spread through the neighborhood.
statements.tl: Ang improper waste disposal ay nagpaparumi sa hangin kapag ang nabubulok na basura ay naglalabas ng mabahong gas na kumakalat sa buong lugar.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-TjSUZwAQU67D3yXiJdNo6BQBFe5XE3Y), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Improper waste disposal pollutes soil and water and attracts disease-carrying organisms like insects and rodents.
statements.tl: Ang hindi tamang pagtatapon ng basura ay nagpaparumi sa lupa at tubig at umaakit ng mga organismong may dalang sakit tulad ng mga insekto at daga.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-no61y9dxoPJ7SWcCytj1misiuSI2hgn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Throwing chemical wastes from factories into rivers harms the fish and other aquatic organisms that live there.
statements.tl: Ang pagtatapon ng chemical wastes mula sa mga pabrika sa mga ilog ay nakakasira sa mga isda at iba pang aquatic organisms na naninirahan doon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 14NK3OukciGv0HJMPZL9IvVYucZRP1oQ9), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Waste management is the practice of proper waste disposal, keeping our environment clean and helping everybody stay healthy.
statements.tl: Ang waste management ay ang wastong pagtatapon ng basura para manatiling malinis ang kapaligiran at malusog ang lahat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15Df6imiyxW6aY4jSyU-Clrrwz_aMVxk0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Students can help their school become more sustainable by launching campaigns to install renewable energy or reduce waste.
statements.tl: Matutulungan ng mga estudyante ang kanilang paaralan na maging mas sustainable sa pamamagitan ng paglulunsad ng mga kampanya para mag-install ng renewable energy o mabawasan ang basura.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GeBNfUkD7aIxwv_GZTGzoieGpq-GInAn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Improper waste disposal can cause dirty surroundings, sickness, and injuries to people.
statements.tl: Ang hindi tamang pagtatapon ng basura ay maaaring magdulot ng maruming paligid, sakit, at pagkakasugat ng mga tao.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1L9xfhm0Y4O4Qpm7hAGNthK0WNA67SIuk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Burning dried leaves, paper, tires, and plastics releases dirty smoke into the air, causing pollution that makes the air unsafe to breathe.
statements.tl: Ang pagsusunog ng tuyong dahon, papel, gulong, at plastic ay naglalabas ng maruming usok sa hangin, na nagdudulot ng pollution at ginagawang hindi ligtas ang hanging nilalanghap.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MPQBda_k94ghGAoJMio6R1WIKOc7BUf-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Dumping garbage on vacant land harms the environment by making the soil dirty, attracting pests, and producing bad smells.
statements.tl: Ang pagtatapon ng basura sa bakanteng lupa ay nakakasira sa kapaligiran dahil pinarurumi nito ang lupa, inaakit ang mga peste, at nagdudulot ng masamang amoy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MPQBda_k94ghGAoJMio6R1WIKOc7BUf-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Burning plastics and other garbage releases harmful smoke that pollutes the air and can make the surroundings unhealthy for living things.
statements.tl: Ang pagsusunog ng plastic at iba pang basura ay naglalabas ng mapanganib na usok na nagpaparumi sa hangin at maaaring maging hindi malusog ang paligid para sa mga may buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YAktm1Kl8QiPMQM60mTuzEUjZhFWK0nF), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Waste treatment means processing garbage using scientific methods like mechanical-biological treatment, so it becomes less harmful before it is thrown away.
statements.tl: Ang waste treatment ay nangangahulugang pagproseso ng basura gamit ang siyentipikong pamamaraan tulad ng mechanical-biological treatment, para maging mas hindi mapanganib bago ito itapon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Z9AV7sY2i7grgStgfG96je4ynCWEpxPA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What happens to garbage that is not collected?

It can cause land, water, and air pollution, which harms all living things.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa basurang hindi nakokolekta?

Maaari itong magdulot ng polusyon sa lupa, tubig, at hangin, na nakakasama sa lahat ng may buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dGQSm5kEkEn4U1a-Cwja8OsD97sqXTaT), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Burning waste releases harmful pollutants into the air, soil, and water, and these pollutants can harm plants, animals, and people.
statements.tl: Ang pagsunog ng basura ay naglalabas ng mapanganib na pollutants sa hangin, lupa, at tubig, at ang mga pollutant na ito ay maaaring makasakit sa halaman, hayop, at tao.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1guT5m7ok1XkbtKMI0xXYpiMg945oTzEC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Burning household materials can cause burns when someone touches hot burning trash.
statements.tl: Ang pagsunog ng mga gamit sa bahay ay maaaring magdulot ng paso kapag nahawakan ng tao ang mainit na sinusunog na basura.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1mNz2fpfVXmKVasGp-mHRmOAmEB7McRFT), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Pieces of broken glass are harmful waste because their sharp edges can cut skin and cause serious injuries.
statements.tl: Ang mga piraso ng basag na salamin ay harmful waste dahil ang matatalim na gilid nito ay maaaring makasugat ng balat at magdulot ng malubhang pinsala.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p03nwfCVZwgxLNP9rxHLrvU4hTVB0xWW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Improper waste dumping creates breeding grounds for disease-causing organisms and may contaminate the surrounding area.
statements.tl: Ang hindi tamang pagtatapon ng basura ay lumilikha ng pamugaran ng mga organismong nagdudulot ng sakit at maaaring magparumi sa paligid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qtfxmHM6xbdQiHASBhgu-Sv0vU8oPD3T), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why can't we pour used cooking oil down the sink?

Oil can clog the pipes and harm the environment, so it should be sealed in a container and thrown in the garbage.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi natin maaaring itapon ang ginamit na mantika sa lababo?

Ang mantika ay maaaring makabara sa mga tubo at makasira sa kalikasan, kaya dapat itong ilagay sa lalagyan na may takip at itapon sa basurahan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1L9xfhm0Y4O4Qpm7hAGNthK0WNA67SIuk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How can we help reduce pollution?

Buy less plastic and reuse what we already have!
statements.tl:
Paano natin mababawasan ang polusyon?

Bumili ng mas kaunting plastic at gamitin muli ang mga gamit natin!

statements.text: Always separate your paper from other trash! Putting it in its own bin makes it super easy to recycle.
statements.tl: Ihiwalay palagi ang papel sa ibang basura! Kapag nasa sariling basurahan ito, mas madali itong ma-recycle.

statements.text: Recycling means making new things out of old waste, like making new paper from used paper!
statements.tl: Ang pag-recycle ay paggawa ng bagong bagay mula sa lumang basura, gaya ng paggawa ng bagong papel mula sa lumang papel!

statements.text: Local recyclable solid and liquid materials can be designed into useful products, turning trash into something valuable for the community.
statements.tl: Ang mga lokal na recyclable na solid at liquid na materyales ay maaaring gawing mga kapaki-pakinabang na produkto, na ginagawang mahalagang bagay ang basura para sa komunidad.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 11PRT-9noBBR0A8PsTQyIlFuWSvBH-LmE), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Old plastic bottles can be reused as plant pots, and empty soda bottles can be used for a garden fence.
statements.tl: Ang mga lumang plastic bottle ay maaaring gamitin muli bilang paso ng halaman, at ang mga boteng soda na walang laman ay maaaring gamitin bilang bakod sa hardin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15Df6imiyxW6aY4jSyU-Clrrwz_aMVxk0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Empty soda bottles can be recycled into lanterns, converting waste materials into new decorative objects.
statements.tl: Ang mga boteng soda na walang laman ay maaaring i-recycle para maging parol, na ginagawang bagong pampalamuting bagay ang mga waste materials.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15Df6imiyxW6aY4jSyU-Clrrwz_aMVxk0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Reuse means finding a new purpose for an old item, like turning an abandoned tire into a colorful flower planter filled with soil and seeds.
statements.tl: Ang reuse ay nangangahulugang paghahanap ng bagong gamit para sa lumang bagay, tulad ng paggawa sa lumang gulong bilang makulay na paso ng bulaklak na may lupa at mga buto.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16QZCST315MzfjPLu_hZINLWxdt0D4Sh7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To reuse means to find a new purpose for an item instead of throwing it away, like using an empty glass jar to store food.
statements.tl: Ang pag-reuse ay nangangahulugang humanap ng bagong gamit para sa isang bagay imbes na itapon ito, tulad ng paggamit ng basyong garapon para pag-imbakan ng pagkain.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BBoPyYA_X4X8fmMdVk5M0tDztVT9UVmw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Practicing the 5Rs saves energy and money because making new products from raw materials costs more than reusing or recycling what we already have.
statements.tl: Ang pagsasagawa ng 5Rs ay nakakatipid ng enerhiya at pera dahil mas mahal ang paggawa ng bagong produkto mula sa hilaw na materyales kaysa sa pag-reuse o pag-recycle ng mayroon na tayo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Bq6t9oIYOJbZ5cRc8A4ZyoH4crVIynBa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Aluminum and cardboard are recyclable materials, which means they can be collected and made into new products instead of being thrown away.
statements.tl: Ang aluminum at cardboard ay mga recyclable materials, ibig sabihin maaari itong kolektahin at gawing bagong produkto sa halip na itapon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Bq6t9oIYOJbZ5cRc8A4ZyoH4crVIynBa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Instead of throwing paper in the bin, you can reuse it as scratch paper for computing mathematical equations or making origami.
statements.tl: Sa halip na itapon ang papel sa basurahan, maaari mo itong i-reuse bilang scratch paper sa pagsasagot ng mathematical equations o paggawa ng origami.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Bq6t9oIYOJbZ5cRc8A4ZyoH4crVIynBa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Is an old newspaper useful or harmful?

It is useful because it can be recycled into new paper or used for cleaning and wrapping things.
statements.tl:
Ang lumang diyaryo ba ay useful o harmful?

Ito ay useful dahil kaya itong i-recycle para maging bagong papel o gamitin sa paglilinis at pagbabalot ng mga bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1F3bvG5Br6uwLIMJtaWuD9H3HxFctilIs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Recycling helps preserve natural resources for future generations by using less energy and fewer raw materials.
statements.tl: Nakakatulong ang pag-recycle para mapanatili ang likas na yaman para sa susunod na henerasyon sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng mas kaunting enerhiya at raw materials.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1KHQhQOXtIFBU_oZr6wKMMPn1bxUD5k8u), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Glass bottles can be washed and reused or recycled, but broken glass goes in a labeled glass bin to prevent injuries.
statements.tl: Ang mga glass bottle ay maaaring hugasan at gamitin muli o i-recycle, ngunit ang basag na glass ay dapat ilagay sa glass bin na may label upang maiwasan ang pagkakasugat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1L9xfhm0Y4O4Qpm7hAGNthK0WNA67SIuk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Do not throw away used newspapers or writing pads because they can still be reused for wrapping, cleaning, or making crafts.
statements.tl: Huwag itapon ang mga lumang diyaryo o writing pad dahil maaari pa itong magamit muli sa pagbabalot, paglilinis, o paggawa ng crafts.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MPQBda_k94ghGAoJMio6R1WIKOc7BUf-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Talahib and cogon have sharp leaves that can cut your skin, which protects the plant from being touched or eaten.
statements.tl: Ang talahib at cogon ay may matatalas na dahon na maaaring makasugat sa iyong balat, na nagpoprotekta sa halaman mula sa paghawak o pagkain.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MzX57zZ5PswjHsAam-unYb8H0YzRgGk7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A broken glass jar can cause cuts or injury, so it must be handled carefully and disposed of properly.
statements.tl: Ang basag na garapon ng salamin ay pwedeng magdulot ng sugat o injury, kaya dapat itong hawakan nang maingat at itapon nang maayos.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RPRl-ejwnasgenxGQJBw8OYvLSp5_qrv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The hard trunk of an old coconut tree is cut into "coco lumber," used as posts and boards for building houses.
statements.tl: Ang matigas na tangkay ng matandang puno ng niyog ay pinuputol at ginagawang "coco lumber" para sa poste at tabla ng bahay.

statements.text: Did you know shape matters? A sinking ball of clay can actually float when you shape it like a bowl!
statements.tl: Alam mo ba na mahalaga ang hugis? Ang lumulubog na bola ng luad ay lulutang kapag hinubog mong parang mangkok!

statements.text: Most solid metals are malleable — you can bend or hammer them into new shapes without breaking!
statements.tl: Karamihan sa mga solidong metal ay malleable — maaari mong baluktutin o pukpukin ang mga ito upang magbago ng hugis nang hindi nababasag!

statements.text: The paper in your notebook is made from tiny wood fibers mashed into pulp, pressed flat, and dried!
statements.tl: Ang papel sa kwaderno mo ay gawa sa pinong himaymay ng kahoy na dinurog, pinipis, at pinatutuyo!

statements.text: An anvil is a heavy, solid metal tool! It provides a hard surface for hammering and shaping other heated metals.
statements.tl: Ang anvil ay isang mabigat, solidong metal na kasangkapan! Nagbibigay ito ng matigas na ibabaw para sa pagmartilyo at paghubog ng pinainit na metal.

statements.text:
How can small pieces of cardboard become one big useful thing?

When you join pieces with tape or glue, they stick together and form a larger, stronger object. Joining changes the size and shape of the material!
statements.tl:
Paano nagiging isang malaking kapaki-pakinabang na bagay ang maliliit na piraso ng karton?

Kapag pinagdikit mo ang mga piraso gamit ang tape o glue, nagkakadikit ang mga ito at bumubuo ng mas malaki at mas matibay na bagay. Binabago ng pagdikit ang laki at hugis ng materyal!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1B_MYfU2LyjNNncWwyUWbHt7K4UCZGPCt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Pressing modelling clay changes only its size and shape, not the material itself, so no new material is formed.
statements.tl: Ang pagpisa sa modelling clay ay nagbabago lamang ng laki at hugis nito, hindi ang materyales mismo, kaya walang bagong materyales na nabubuo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-RKC65zDEaCw6-9Xe30uD8gVeDgKiC3u), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Crumpling or folding a sheet of paper changes its shape, and that new shape changes how the paper moves through the air.
statements.tl: Ang paglamukos o pagtiklop ng papel ay nagbabago ng hugis nito, at ang bagong hugis na iyon ang nagpapabago kung paano gumagalaw ang papel sa hangin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 135_FeVlZjkU5nIMJlLvHwjOSV0yEIY1W), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When a baker presses dough, the dough changes its size and shape, becoming flatter and wider for baking.
statements.tl: Kapag pinindot ng panadero ang dough, nagbabago ang size at shape nito, nagiging mas lapat at mas malapad para sa pagluluto.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15YqrU486yo6zzoeAZOHYk_gxYTHef07U), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How can cutting paper make banderitas?

Cutting or tearing paper into triangles creates the shapes, and the paper is still paper even after it is cut.
statements.tl:
Paano nakakagawa ng banderitas ang paggupit ng papel?

Ang paggupit o pagpunit ng papel na hugis tatsulok ang lumilikha ng mga hugis, at ang papel ay papel pa rin kahit naputol na.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16o9hXUA0qrtNufe0JVld35l43Wdhhx7h), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Malleable materials can be hammered and formed into shapes, like gold and silver being made into jewelry.
statements.tl: Ang mga malleable na materyales ay maaaring martilyuhin at hubugin sa iba't ibang hugis, tulad ng ginto at pilak na ginagawang alahas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17CLJbOf1T9xM25Dcwc80bWFxNloPjFTr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cutting solid materials is useful in industries like tailoring, where cloth is cut to make clothes.
statements.tl: Ang paggupit ng mga solid na materyales ay mahalaga sa mga industriya tulad ng tailoring, kung saan ang tela ay ginugupit para makagawa ng damit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17CLJbOf1T9xM25Dcwc80bWFxNloPjFTr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you cut a piece of paper, it changes its size and shape, but the paper's color and texture stay the same.
statements.tl: Kapag ginupit mo ang isang piraso ng papel, nagbabago ang laki at hugis nito, pero ang kulay at texture ng papel ay nananatiling pareho.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17CLJbOf1T9xM25Dcwc80bWFxNloPjFTr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gold and silver are malleable, so they can be hammered into thin sheets and shaped into beautiful jewelry.
statements.tl: Ang ginto at pilak ay malleable, kaya maaari silang martilyuhin para maging manipis na sheets at hubugin para maging magandang alahas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17CLJbOf1T9xM25Dcwc80bWFxNloPjFTr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Iron and steel bars are too hard for ordinary scissors, so workers use metal cutters or machine cutters to cut them.
statements.tl: Ang bakal at steel bars ay masyadong matigas para sa ordinaryong gunting, kaya gumagamit ang mga manggagawa ng metal cutters o machine cutters para putulin ang mga ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17CLJbOf1T9xM25Dcwc80bWFxNloPjFTr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Candy wrappers are thin and easy to cut with scissors, changing their size and shape without forming a new material.
statements.tl: Ang mga candy wrapper ay manipis at madaling gupitin gamit ang gunting, na nagbabago ang laki at hugis nito nang walang nabubuong bagong materyal.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17CLJbOf1T9xM25Dcwc80bWFxNloPjFTr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Force can change the size of objects, like cutting wood into smaller pieces or pounding garlic into a paste.
statements.tl: Ang force ay maaaring magbago ng laki ng mga bagay, tulad ng pag-cut ng kahoy sa maliliit na piraso o pagpukpok ng bawang para maging paste.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17O3rcpvR-g47KVDRjj6pBepFHZAQn_k_), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cutting cardboard with scissors or a cutter changes its size and shape, making smaller pieces that can be joined to build something new.
statements.tl: Ang paggupit ng karton gamit ang gunting o cutter ay nagbabago sa laki at hugis nito, na gumagawa ng mas maliliit na piraso na maaaring pagdikitin upang makabuo ng bagong bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1B_MYfU2LyjNNncWwyUWbHt7K4UCZGPCt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Long ago, people used silver as money and coins because it was super valuable and easy to carry around!
statements.tl: Noong unang panahon, ginamit ang pilak bilang pera at barya dahil napakahalaga nito at madaling dalhin!

statements.text: Steel is a super strong alloy made of iron mixed with just a small amount of carbon!
statements.tl: Ang asero ay isang napakalakas na aleasyon na gawa sa bakal na hinaluan ng kaunting karbon!

statements.text: The wires in your house are made of copper because it conducts electricity super well!
statements.tl: Ang mga alambre sa bahay ninyo ay gawa sa tanso dahil napakahusay nitong magpadaloy ng kuryente!

statements.text: Iron is a super strong metal! We use it to build tall buildings, big bridges, and vehicles.
statements.tl: Ang iron o bakal ay isang matibay na metal! Ginagamit ito sa mga gusali, tulay, at sasakyan.

statements.text: Gold is a shiny, valuable metal! We use it to make beautiful jewelry like rings and necklaces.
statements.tl: Ang gold o ginto ay isang makintab at mahalagang metal! Ginagawa natin itong magagandang alahas tulad ng singsing.

statements.text: Malleable materials can be hammered and formed into shapes, like gold and silver being made into jewelry.
statements.tl: Ang mga malleable na materyales ay maaaring martilyuhin at hubugin sa iba't ibang hugis, tulad ng ginto at pilak na ginagawang alahas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17CLJbOf1T9xM25Dcwc80bWFxNloPjFTr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Bending is used in industry, such as bending steel bars or iron to make vehicle parts and home appliances.
statements.tl: Ginagamit ang pag-bend sa industry, tulad ng pag-bend ng steel bars o bakal para gumawa ng mga piyesa ng sasakyan at appliances sa bahay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15YqrU486yo6zzoeAZOHYk_gxYTHef07U), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Copper is perfect for electrical wires because it conducts electricity super well!
statements.tl: Ang tanso ay angkop para sa mga kawad ng kuryente dahil napakahusay nitong magpadaloy ng kuryente!

statements.text:
Why is aluminum used for cans and airplanes?

Because aluminum is a light metal, it is perfect for making cans and airplanes!
statements.tl:
Bakit ginagamit ang aluminum sa mga lata at eroplano?

Dahil ang aluminum ay isang magaan na metal, perfect ito para sa mga lata at eroplano!

statements.text:
Why is gold perfect for making beautiful jewelry?

Gold does not rust, so it always stays shiny and beautiful!
statements.tl:
Bakit ang ginto ay perfect para sa paggawa ng magagandang alahas?

Ang ginto ay hindi kinakalawang, kaya laging nananatili itong makintab at maganda!

statements.text: Metals are super strong and hard to break! That's why we use them to make awesome tools and machines.
statements.tl: Ang metal ay matibay at hindi madaling masira! Kaya ginagamit natin ito sa paggawa ng mga kasangkapan at makina.

statements.text:
Why do we use steel for buildings and bridges?

Steel is a super strong metal that doesn't bend easily! It keeps our houses and bridges safe.
statements.tl:
Bakit ginagamit ang asero sa mga gusali at tulay?

Ang asero ay matibay na metal na hindi madaling mabaluktot! Kaya matatag ang mga bahay at tulay.

statements.text:
Why does gold stay beautiful for so long?

Gold is a shiny metal element that never rusts! Because it stays perfect, we use it to make pretty jewelry and coins.
statements.tl:
Bakit nananatiling maganda ang gold nang napakatagal?

Ang gold ay isang makintab na metal element na hindi kinakalawang! Kaya ginagamit ito para sa magagandang alahas at barya.

statements.text: Iron is a super strong metal element that magnets love to attract! We use this tough iron to build huge bridges, tall buildings, and cool vehicles.
statements.tl: Ang iron ay isang napakatibay na metal element na nadadani ng magnet! Ginagamit natin ang matibay na bakal na ito sa pagtatayo ng tulay, gusali, at sasakyan.

statements.text:
Is iron the only metal that corrodes?

Nope! Silver turns dark and copper turns green. These changes are also forms of corrosion!
statements.tl:
Bakal lang ba ang nagco-corrode?

Hindi! Nangingitim ang pilak at nagiging berde ang tanso. Ang mga pagbabagong ito ay korosyon din!

statements.text: Gold is perfect for jewelry because it never rusts or spoils! It stays shiny and beautiful even after many years — that's what makes it so precious and valuable.
statements.tl: Ginagamit ang gold sa alahas dahil hindi ito kinakalawang ni nasisira! Nananatili itong makintab kahit lumipas ang maraming taon — kaya napakahalaga at mahal nito.

statements.text:
What fills the big middle block of the periodic table?

It's full of transition metals like iron, copper, and zinc! These strong metals are widely used to build buildings and make tools.
statements.tl:
Ano ang puno sa malaking gitnang bahagi ng periodic table?

Puno ito ng transition metals tulad ng iron, copper, at zinc! Ang matitibay na metal na ito ay malawakang ginagamit sa mga gusali at kagamitan.

statements.text:
Why is steel so strong?

Steel is iron mixed with a little carbon! This makes it stronger and harder to break than pure iron for big buildings and bridges.
statements.tl:
Bakit napakatibay ng asero (steel)?

Ang asero (steel) ay bakal na hinaluan ng kaunting carbon! Mas matibay at mahirap baliin ito kaysa dalisay na bakal para sa malalaking gusali at tulay.

statements.text:
Is coral a rock or a plant?

Neither! Coral is actually made of tiny living animals called polyps.
statements.tl:
Bato ba o halaman ang coral?

Wala sa dalawa! Ang coral ay gawa sa maliliit na buhay na hayop na tinatawag na polyp.

statements.text:
Is coral a rock?

No -- coral is a living animal! Each tiny polyp has a mouth and tentacles to catch food; the hard part is just the house it builds around itself.
statements.tl:
Bato ba ang coral?

Hindi! Buhay na hayop ang coral! Ang bawat maliit na polyp ay may bibig at galamay para humuli ng pagkain; ang matigas na bahagi ay bahay lang na ginawa nito.

statements.text:
A carabao pulls a wooden cart — are they both alive?

Nope! The carabao eating grass is living, but the wooden cart is non-living — it can't eat or grow!
statements.tl:
Humihila ang kalabaw ng kahoy na kariton — buhay ba silang dalawa?

Hindi! Buhay ang kalabaw na kumakain ng damo, pero hindi buhay ang kahoy na kariton — hindi ito makakain o lumaki!

statements.text: Common pets at home include dogs, cats, turtles, parrots, doves, and fish, and these animals are kept for companionship and care.
statements.tl: Ang mga karaniwang alagang hayop sa bahay ay aso, pusa, pagong, loro, kalapati, at isda, at sila ay inaalagaan bilang kasama at pinangangalagaan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16HN1B-ZpPyhE5QwZnfpxirY00Cuf3dpK), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An environment is everything around a living thing, including both living things like plants and animals and nonliving things like rocks and water.
statements.tl: Ang kapaligiran ay ang lahat ng bagay sa paligid ng isang may buhay, kasama ang mga may buhay tulad ng halaman at hayop at mga walang buhay tulad ng bato at tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1g9NmHIKRcjEnh-mqnT4R0Se53LBsv4mZ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cats can be pets and companions, staying close to their owners and giving them comfort and joy.
statements.tl: Ang mga pusa ay maaaring maging alagang hayop at kasama, nananatiling malapit sa kanilang may-ari at nagbibigay ng kapanatagan at kasiyahan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-22563), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Is coral a rock or something alive?

Surprise — coral is actually a living animal, not a rock, even though it feels hard like one!
statements.tl:
Bato ba ang coral o buhay na bagay?

Sorpresa — ang coral pala ay buhay na hayop, hindi bato, kahit matigas ang tingin nito!

statements.text: The brown dog tick is one of the most common ticks in the Philippines, often spotted crawling on dogs' skin.
statements.tl: Ang garapatang aso ay isa sa pinakakaraniwang garapata sa Pilipinas, madalas itong makita sa balat ng mga aso.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; Rhipicephalus sanguineus (brown dog tick) widespread in PH

statements.text:
Is yeast actually alive?

Yes! It's a tiny living fungus made of just one cell — that's why it needs to eat and grow, unlike a plain powder.
statements.tl:
Buhay ba talaga ang yeast?

Oo! Isa itong napakaliit na buhay na fungus na gawa sa iisang selula lang — kaya kailangan nitong kumain at lumaki, hindi tulad ng ordinaryong pulbos.

statements.text:
Is the green stuff on a pond just trash?

No! That green floating stuff is actually a living plant with leaves and roots, making its own food from sunlight just like other plants!
statements.tl:
Basura lang ba ang berdeng lumulutang sa lawa?

Hindi! Ang berdeng lumulutang na iyon ay buhay na halaman na may dahon at ugat, gumagawa ng sariling pagkain mula sa sikat ng araw gaya ng ibang halaman!

statements.text: Yeast and baking soda both make dough rise, but differently: yeast is alive and needs sugar and time, while baking soda is a fast-acting chemical.
statements.tl: Parehong nagpapaalsa ng minasa ang yeast at baking soda, pero magkaiba: buhay ang yeast at kailangan nito ng asukal at oras, habang mabilis na kemikal naman ang baking soda.

statements.text: The kakawate, also called madre de cacao, is a tree found in many farms and yards across the Philippines.
statements.tl: Ang kakawate, na tinatawag ding madre de cacao, ay isang punong matatagpuan sa maraming bukid at bakuran sa Pilipinas.

statements.text: All living things, from plants to people, are made of tiny units called cells.
statements.tl: Ang lahat ng buhay na bagay, mula sa halaman hanggang tao, ay binubuo ng maliliit na yunit na tinatawag na cell o selula.

statements.text:
Is coral a rock, a plant, or something else?

Coral is neither! It's made of thousands of tiny animals called polyps. Each one builds a hard skeleton, and together they form a whole reef.
statements.tl:
Bato ba, halaman ba, o iba ang coral?

Wala sa dalawa! Ang coral ay gawa sa libo-libong napakaliit na hayop na tinatawag na polyp. Bawat isa ay gumagawa ng matigas na kalansay, at magkakasama silang bumubuo ng isang bahura.

statements.text: A rocky reef is just dead stone, but a coral reef is built by living animals that keep growing and adding new skeleton — so it can heal and spread, unlike plain rock.
statements.tl: Ang batuhan sa dagat ay patay na bato lang, pero ang coral reef ay gawa ng buhay na hayop na patuloy na lumalaki at gumagawa ng bagong balangkas — kaya kaya nitong gumaling at lumawak, di gaya ng bato.

statements.text:
Where do beautiful pearls actually come from?

A pearl is made by a living oyster or mollusk, not mined from rock like other gems!
statements.tl:
Saan ba talaga nagmumula ang mga perlas?

Ang perlas ay likha ng buhay na talaba o mollusk, hindi galing sa bato gaya ng ibang hiyas!

statements.text: Unlike gold that is mined from hard rock, pearls are actually made by living oysters! Nature is full of amazing surprises.
statements.tl: Hindi tulad ng ginto na minimina sa bato, ang perlas ay ginagawa ng mga buhay na talaba! Nakakamangha ang kalikasan.

statements.text: Even if a stalactite 'grows,' it’s not alive like a plant! It’s just rock getting bigger as mineral layers pile up. It doesn't eat or breathe.
statements.tl: Kahit 'lumalaki' ang stalactite, hindi ito buhay parang halaman! Bato lang ito na nadadagdagan ng mineral. Hindi ito kumakain o humihinga.

statements.text: Objects can move closer to or farther from their original position in relation to a reference point.
statements.tl: Ang mga bagay ay maaaring gumalaw palapit o palayo sa kanilang orihinal na position kaugnay ng isang reference point.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12FuBYkCcswduAa9LkzkJ8y-FdVvloN5Y), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Objects can move to the left or to the right in relation to their original position.
statements.tl: Ang mga bagay ay maaaring gumalaw pakaliwa o pakanan kaugnay ng kanilang orihinal na position.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12FuBYkCcswduAa9LkzkJ8y-FdVvloN5Y), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To measure distance traveled in a straight line without turning back, mark the starting position and final position of a moving object, then use a ruler or tape measure to find the length between them.
statements.tl: Para sukatin ang distance na nilakbay nang tuwid at walang pagbalik, markahan ang panimulang posisyon at huling posisyon ng gumagalaw na bagay, pagkatapos ay gumamit ng ruler o tape measure para malaman ang haba sa pagitan nila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1nPutGxCOe1uMlUH_NqPw7N1ZJluKcwup), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An object is in motion when its position changes relative to a reference point over a time interval, so motion needs a reference point, a change in position, and time.
statements.tl: Ang isang bagay ay gumagalaw kapag nagbago ang posisyon nito kumpara sa isang reference point sa loob ng isang time interval, kaya kailangan ng motion ang reference point, pagbabago ng posisyon, at oras.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10RceE2-9x2EyYbB-Fx92ZUqPChnxFrIR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Motion is a change in position from a reference point, meaning an object has moved from where it started compared to a fixed object.
statements.tl: Ang motion ay pagbabago ng posisyon mula sa reference point, ibig sabihin gumalaw ang isang bagay mula sa pinanggalingan nito kumpara sa isang nakatigil na bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 14zw_95rYNthk6chR26KgUV038PuASAlA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do we know what's closer with just one eye?

Easy — if one object covers up another one behind it, we know the covering object is closer to us.
statements.tl:
Paano natin alam kung ano ang mas malapit gamit lang ang isang mata?

Madali lang — kapag tinatakpan ng isang bagay ang iba pang bagay sa likod nito, alam nating mas malapit ang tumatakip.

statements.text: An object is in motion when its position changes relative to a reference point, like a car moving past a post! If it doesn't change, it's at rest.
statements.tl: Ang isang bagay ay in motion kapag nagbabago ang posisyon nito relative sa isang reference point, tulad ng sasakyang dumaan sa poste! Kapag hindi, ito ay at rest.

statements.text: Living things grow and change over time, like a seed becoming a plant or a puppy becoming a dog.
statements.tl: Ang mga living things ay lumalaki at nagbabago sa paglipas ng panahon, tulad ng buto na nagiging halaman o tuta na nagiging aso.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yby7Z8q6CQggJuyz147pCPkhxk2JXspd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does one rice seedling become a bush?

From just one seedling, a rice plant grows many stems, until the single plant becomes a full, bushy clump.
statements.tl:
Paano nagiging kumpol ang isang punla ng palay?

Mula sa isang punla lang, sumusupling ang palay ng maraming tangkay, hanggang maging makapal na kumpol ang isang halaman.

statements.text: It's not just touch — strong wind, raindrops, or heat can also make makahiya's leaves fold, since it reacts to any sudden disturbance.
statements.tl: Hindi lang paghipo ang nagpapasara sa dahon ng makahiya — pati malakas na hangin, patak ng ulan, o init ay nakakapagpasara rin nito, dahil ito'y umaaksyon sa anumang biglang gulo sa paligid.

statements.text: Some animals, like chickens and other birds, make babies by laying eggs.
statements.tl: Ang ilang hayop tulad ng manok at ibon ay nagpaparami sa pamamagitan ng pangingitlog.

statements.text: The adrenal glands produce adrenaline, which is involved in stress reactions and the fight-or-flight response.
statements.tl: Ang adrenal glands ay gumagawa ng adrenaline na kasangkot sa stress reactions at sa fight-or-flight response.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16BHBHsKMlFGS-vRrk6c_TtuLJFsMFIGH), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What happens in spring in temperate regions?

As the weather warms after winter, many plants grow new leaves or flowers, and many animals have their young.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa spring sa mga lugar sa temperate zone?

Habang umiinit ang panahon pagkatapos ng winter, maraming halaman ang nagkakaroon ng bagong dahon o bulaklak, at maraming hayop ang nagkakaroon ng mga anak.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18BZA96BdwbHWntZDEdUwBxxq1dQ6rad9), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Plants are living things that grow, need water and sunlight, and make new plants of their own kind.
statements.tl: Ang mga halaman ay mga living thing na lumalaki, nangangailangan ng tubig at sikat ng araw, at gumagawa ng bagong halaman na katulad nila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ARpJ81MwhDzee2vUGsdFtQpT3jEgELGy), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Male and female reproductive systems can be compared by their primary organs, which make sex cells, their secondary organs, and their accessory organs that support reproduction.
statements.tl: Ang male at female reproductive systems ay maaaring paghambingin sa pamamagitan ng primary organs na gumagawa ng sex cells, secondary organs, at accessory organs na tumutulong sa reproduction.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1AUF3RC2RybR4OdSRjUgIhkk_8VY5CjM3), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Living things are alive, and they can grow, move on their own, and reproduce to make new living things.
statements.tl: Ang mga living thing ay buhay, at kaya nilang lumaki, gumalaw nang mag-isa, at magparami para makagawa ng bagong buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1AuOVhkK6XjVWF66eJcoDMnko_0rL95Tm), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Living things reproduce, which means they can make new living things like themselves, such as a dog having puppies or a plant making seeds.
statements.tl: Ang mga living thing ay nagpaparami, na nangangahulugang kaya nilang gumawa ng bagong living thing na katulad nila, tulad ng aso na nanganganak ng mga tuta o halaman na gumagawa ng mga buto.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1AuOVhkK6XjVWF66eJcoDMnko_0rL95Tm), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Non-living things cannot reproduce, so a rock can never make a baby rock, and water can never make new water on its own.
statements.tl: Ang mga non-living thing ay hindi maaaring magparami, kaya ang isang bato ay hindi kailanman makakagawa ng batang bato, at ang tubig ay hindi kailanman makakagawa ng bagong tubig nang mag-isa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1AuOVhkK6XjVWF66eJcoDMnko_0rL95Tm), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Living things grow, move by themselves, breathe, need food, and can reproduce - make new living things of their own kind.
statements.tl: Ang mga bagay na may buhay ay lumalaki, gumagalaw mag-isa, humihinga, nangangailangan ng pagkain, at nagpaparami - gumagawa ng bagong may buhay na katulad nila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BD7EWEiy5ur5h9L3B_GcDCT4s71gw9ov), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In binary fission, each daughter cell continues to grow until it becomes as large as the parent cell, and then it can divide again.
statements.tl: Sa binary fission, ang bawat daughter cell ay patuloy na lumalaki hanggang sa maging kasinglaki ito ng parent cell, at pagkatapos ay maaari na itong mahati muli.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GQmxhExnxB89Wkrpnkrp62rlrE5sw8Gc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A receptor is a specialized structure on or inside cells that detects a specific stimulus, like heat on your skin, and starts the body's response.
statements.tl: Ang receptor ay isang specialized structure sa o loob ng cells na dumidetekta ng partikular na stimulus, tulad ng init sa iyong balat, at nagsisimula ng tugon ng katawan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JCyVks5ixq17_y2S2UX9Mu-Am9UjKPHt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does a cat respond when it sees or smells food?

It uses its nose to smell and its eyes to see, then it walks or runs toward the food to eat it!
statements.tl:
Paano tumutugon ang pusa kapag nakakita o nakaamoy ng pagkain?

Ginagamit nito ang ilong para umamoy at ang mga mata para makakita, pagkatapos ay lumalakad o tumatakbo ito patungo sa pagkain para kainin ito!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ONZWJrxUoE043vnyn6_ZgaWBF3ZFN7LR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A kitten grows into an adult cat by becoming bigger, with longer legs, a larger head, and a longer tail.
statements.tl: Ang kuting ay lumalaki bilang adult na pusa sa pamamagitan ng paglaki ng katawan, paghaba ng mga binti, paglaki ng ulo, at paghaba ng buntot.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ONZWJrxUoE043vnyn6_ZgaWBF3ZFN7LR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The zygote, or fertilized egg, develops into an embryo, which undergoes continuous development until it grows into a newborn animal.
statements.tl: Ang zygote, o fertilized egg, ay nagde-develop bilang embryo, na sumasailalim sa tuloy-tuloy na pag-unlad hanggang sa ito ay lumaki bilang isang bagong silang na hayop.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VfKfAe5sIyDdyQEhkjEy4ACC8ySm7dFH), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cells are the basic units of life—the smallest things that can carry out all the activities of living organisms, like taking in food, growing, and reproducing.
statements.tl: Ang cells ang basic units ng buhay—ang pinakamaliit na bagay na kayang gawin ang lahat ng gawain ng mga buhay na organismo, tulad ng pagkain, paglaki, at pagpaparami.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_EtP8HytXKZBF-b7gyIZACRQqCSSv9tS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Milkfish are strong, fast swimmers thanks to their wide, forked tail.
statements.tl: Ang bangus ay malakas at mabilis lumangoy gamit ang malapad at hati nitong buntot.

statements.text: A bird's beak shape matches the kind of food it eats!
statements.tl: Ang hugis ng tuka ng ibon ay bagay sa uri ng pagkaing kinakain nito!

statements.text: A crab has ten legs in total — eight for walking and two that are pincer claws!
statements.tl: May sampung paa ang alimango — walo ang panlakad at dalawa ang sipit!

statements.text: A frog's strong, long back legs are what let it jump so far!
statements.tl: Ang malakas at mahabang likurang binti ng palaka ang dahilan kaya ito ay malayong makatalon!

statements.text: Rats use their long tail to keep their balance while climbing.
statements.tl: Ginagamit ng daga ang mahabang buntot nito para mapanatili ang balanse habang umaakyat.

statements.text: Many insects have wings that let them fly through the air.
statements.tl: Maraming insekto ang may pakpak na ginagamit nila para lumipad.

statements.text: Cats and dogs both have sharp teeth built for eating meat.
statements.tl: Ang aso at pusa ay may matatalas na ngipin na angkop sa pagkain ng karne.

statements.text: Swifts have long, narrow wings shaped perfectly for flying very fast.
statements.tl: May mahaba at makitid na pakpak ang mga swift na nakakatulong sa kanila para makalipad nang napakabilis.

statements.text: A swallow's forked tail helps it turn quickly while flying through the air.
statements.tl: Ang nakasangang buntot ng layang-layang ay tumutulong dito na mabilis na lumiko sa hangin.

statements.text: The carabao uses its four strong legs to walk and run, helping farmers work in the field all day.
statements.tl: Ginagamit ng kalabaw ang kanyang apat na malalakas na binti para maglakad at tumakbo, na tumutulong sa mga magsasaka na magtrabaho sa bukid buong araw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 129VZMEtIfpilZy5zXFBmO5k3ExsK2gnx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Animals move by walking, crawling, flying, hopping, running, or swimming, and they use body parts such as legs and wings to move.
statements.tl: Ang mga hayop ay gumagalaw sa pamamagitan ng paglakad, paggapang, paglipad, paglundag, pagtakbo, o paglangoy, at ginagamit nila ang mga bahagi ng katawan tulad ng paa at pakpak.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16HN1B-ZpPyhE5QwZnfpxirY00Cuf3dpK), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Butterflies have colorful wings and like to fly over flowers in the garden, using their wings to move from one flower to another.
statements.tl: Ang mga paru-paro ay may makukulay na pakpak at mahilig lumipad sa mga bulaklak sa hardin, ginagamit ang mga pakpak upang lumipat mula sa isang bulaklak patungo sa iba.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16HN1B-ZpPyhE5QwZnfpxirY00Cuf3dpK), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A bird uses its wings to fly away from danger, a fish uses its fins to swim away, and a cat uses its legs to run.
statements.tl: Ang ibon ay gumagamit ng mga pakpak para lumipad palayo sa panganib, ang isda ay gumagamit ng mga palikpik para lumangoy palayo, at ang pusa ay gumagamit ng mga binti para tumakbo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ONZWJrxUoE043vnyn6_ZgaWBF3ZFN7LR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What can an animal with big hind legs do?

Animals like frogs and rabbits use their strong back legs to hop and jump long distances.
statements.tl:
Ano ang kaya ng isang hayop na may malalaking hulihang binti?

Ang mga hayop tulad ng palaka at kuneho ay ginagamit ang malalakas nilang hulihang binti para lumukso at tumalon sa malalayong distansya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1U1a7i2D3QbjvqwYUjuUQL9aOcw37FTGs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Land animals like horses and carabaos use their strong legs to walk, run, and carry their bodies across the ground.
statements.tl: Ang mga hayop sa lupa tulad ng kabayo at kalabaw ay gumagamit ng malalakas na binti para maglakad, tumakbo, at dalhin ang kanilang katawan sa lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1gO9YyI3d7Pfy_DG4DPqAjZJoVKEzAwVf), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mammals have specialized teeth, like sharp incisors for cutting and flat molars for grinding, which help them eat different kinds of food.
statements.tl: Ang mga mammal ay may specialized teeth, tulad ng matatalas na incisors para sa paghiwa at mga flat na molars para sa paggiling, na tumutulong sa kanila na kumain ng iba't ibang uri ng pagkain.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j0eZi4Jq2ZWac_LboNInoUIjFz_czlvV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A toucan has a large, broad beak that helps it reach and pick fruits from branches.
statements.tl: Ang toucan ay may malaki at malapad na tuka na tumutulong sa kanya na maabot at mapitas ang mga prutas mula sa mga sanga.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1k6DG5rn-F7ve-MCduGPOIwIbOALR2j6S), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What do horses use for running?

Horses use their long, strong legs for running fast, which helps them escape from danger.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ginagamit ng mga kabayo sa pagtakbo?

Ginagamit ng mga kabayo ang kanilang mahahaba at malalakas na binti para tumakbo nang mabilis, na tumutulong sa kanila na makatakas sa panganib.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-19826), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Just like other plants, an orchid makes its own food using its green leaves and sunlight.
statements.tl: Tulad ng ibang halaman, gumagawa ng sariling pagkain ang orkidya gamit ang berde nitong dahon at sikat ng araw.

statements.text: The green leaves of a rice plant use sunlight to make their own food.
statements.tl: Ginagamit ng berdeng dahon ng palay ang liwanag ng araw para gumawa ng sarili nitong pagkain.

statements.text: A tree trunk is really just a big, hard, woody stem — it still carries water all the way up even in a very tall tree.
statements.tl: Ang katawan ng puno ay isang matigas at malaking kahoy na tangkay — dinadala pa rin nito ang tubig pataas kahit napakatangkad ng puno.

statements.text: The stem carries water up from the roots all the way to the leaves.
statements.tl: Ang tangkay ang nagdadala ng tubig mula sa mga ugat paitaas patungo sa mga dahon.

statements.text: Roots soak up water and nutrients from the soil so the plant can stay alive and grow.
statements.tl: Sumisipsip ang ugat ng tubig at sustansya mula sa lupa para mabuhay ang halaman.
statements.source: NRC LS1.A; DepEd G3; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: A plant's roots soak up water and nutrients from the soil so the whole plant can use them.
statements.tl: Ang ugat ng halaman ang humihigop ng tubig at mga sustansya mula sa lupa para magamit ng buong halaman.
statements.source: NRC LS1.A; AAAS BSL Ch.5; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
What is a tree's trunk, really?

It's actually one giant, hard stem — strong enough to support the whole tree!
statements.tl:
Ano talaga ang katawan ng puno?

Ito pala ay isang malaki at matigas na tangkay — sapat ang lakas para suportahan ang buong puno!

statements.text: Many desert plants grow very long roots that dig deep into the ground to reach hidden water.
statements.tl: Maraming halaman sa disyerto ang may napakahabang ugat na sumisid nang malalim sa lupa para maabot ang nakatagong tubig.

statements.text:
Which plant part soaks up water?

The roots absorb water and nutrients from the soil and hold the plant firmly in place.
statements.tl:
Aling bahagi ng halaman ang humihigop ng tubig?

Ang ugat ang humihigop ng tubig at sustansya mula sa lupa at nagpapatatag sa halaman.

statements.text:
Do roots only soak up water?

Not quite—besides soaking up water and nutrients, roots have a second important job: holding the whole plant steady and keeping it standing.
statements.tl:
Sumisipsip lang ba ng tubig ang ugat?

Hindi pala—bukod sa sumisipsip ng tubig at sustansya, may pangalawang mahalagang trabaho ang ugat: hawakan at panatilihing nakatayo ang buong halaman.

statements.text: Roots soak up water from the soil, and it travels all the way up to the leaves to be used in photosynthesis.
statements.tl: Sumisipsip ang mga ugat ng tubig mula sa lupa, at umaakyat ito hanggang sa dahon para magamit sa photosynthesis.

statements.text:
Why are vegetable leaves green?

Because of chlorophyll — the green substance leaves use to make food from sunlight.
statements.tl:
Bakit luntian ang mga dahon ng gulay?

Dahil sa klorofila — ang berdeng sangkap na ginagamit ng dahon para gumawa ng pagkain mula sa araw.

statements.text: The leaf is like the plant's own kitchen — it cooks up the plant's food through photosynthesis!
statements.tl: Ang dahon ay parang kusina ng halaman — dito ginagawa ang pagkain nito sa pamamagitan ng potosintesis!

statements.text: A plant drinks water through its roots — they soak it up straight from the soil!
statements.tl: Umiinom ang halaman ng tubig sa pamamagitan ng ugat nito — sinisipsip nito ang tubig mula sa lupa!

statements.text:
What is chlorophyll?

Chlorophyll is the green substance in leaves that absorbs energy from sunlight to use in photosynthesis.
statements.tl:
Ano ang chlorophyll?

Ang chlorophyll ang berdeng sangkap sa dahon na sumisipsip ng enerhiya mula sa araw para magamit sa potosintesis.

statements.text: Roots don't just soak up water — they also absorb minerals from the soil that plants need to grow, make green leaves, and bear fruit.
statements.tl: Hindi lang tubig ang sinisipsip ng ugat — sinisipsip din nito ang mga mineral sa lupa na kailangan ng halaman para lumago, gumawa ng dahon, at magbunga.

statements.text: Put a celery stalk or white flower in colored water and watch the color climb up the stem — proof that water flows upward inside it!
statements.tl: Ilagay ang tangkay ng kintsay o puting bulaklak sa may-kulay na tubig, at makikita mong umaakyat ang kulay sa tangkay — patunay na umaakyat ang tubig sa loob!

statements.text: Plant roots grow downward toward gravity — this is called positive gravitropism — helping them reach water and minerals in the soil.
statements.tl: Lumalago pababa ang ugat ng halaman patungo sa gravity — tinatawag itong positive gravitropism — para maabot nito ang tubig at mineral sa lupa.

statements.text: Protein-rich foods like fish, eggs, and beans help muscles grow strong.
statements.tl: Ang mga pagkaing mayaman sa protina tulad ng isda, itlog, at munggo ay tumutulong para lumakas ang kalamnan.

statements.text: Hunger goes away when you eat enough food.
statements.tl: Nawawala ang gutom kapag kumain tayo ng sapat na pagkain.

statements.text: A seed needs three things to sprout: water, warmth, and air.
statements.tl: Kailangan ng buto ng tatlong bagay para tumubo: tubig, init, at hangin.

statements.text: Your skin keeps water inside your body so you don't dry out.
statements.tl: Ang balat mo ay pumipigil sa tubig na lumabas sa katawan para hindi ka matuyo.

statements.text: Cloud rats shelter and rest in holes or hollows inside old, large trees.
statements.tl: Nagtatago at namamahinga ang cloud rat sa mga butas o lungga sa loob ng matatandang puno.

statements.text: Dogs, cats, and birds have lungs too, and they breathe air just like you do.
statements.tl: Ang aso, pusa, at ibon ay may baga rin at humihinga ng hangin tulad mo.

statements.text: Forest trees like the narra become homes for birds and many other animals.
statements.tl: Ang mga puno sa gubat tulad ng narra ay nagiging tahanan ng mga ibon at iba pang hayop.

statements.text: Dogs need clean food, fresh water, and good care to stay healthy.
statements.tl: Kailangan ng aso ng malinis na pagkain, tubig, at maayos na pag-aalaga para manatiling malusog.

statements.text: Almost all animals, including us humans, need oxygen to stay alive.
statements.tl: Halos lahat ng hayop, kasama na ang tao, ay nangangailangan ng oxygen para mabuhay.

statements.text: A coral reef is a home and shelter for many fish and other sea creatures.
statements.tl: Ang coral reef ay tahanan at kanlungan ng maraming isda at iba pang hayop sa dagat.

statements.text: Most rice grows in fields flooded with water, called paddies.
statements.tl: Karamihan ng palay ay itinatanim sa palayan na binabahaan ng tubig, tinatawag na paddy.

statements.text: Migration is when animals move from one habitat to another to find food, better weather, or safe places to reproduce.
