Burning trash, especially plastic, releases poisonous smoke bad for our health! It's better to sort, recycle, or compost it instead.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi dapat sunugin ang basura?

Ang pagsunog ng basura, lalo na ang plastic, ay naglalabas ng nakakalasong usok! Mas mabuting ihiwalay, i-recycle, o i-compost ito.

statements.text:
Why should you never burn plastic trash?

Burning plastic releases toxic chemical gases into the air, so you should never burn trash in an open fire!
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi dapat sunugin ang plastic na basura?

Kapag sinunog mo ang plastic, naglalabas ito ng nakalalasong kemikal na gas sa hangin, kaya hindi dapat mag-burn ng basura sa bukas na apoy!

statements.text: Flammable materials like kerosene can easily catch fire, so they should never be played with or placed near a flame.
statements.tl: Ang mga materyal na flammable tulad ng gaas ay madaling magliyab, kaya hindi ito dapat paglaruan o ilagay malapit sa apoy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1E4KmrZp1u2qy6nnP-6tO6wvKfDlaw52V), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How can we prevent the harmful effects of burning garbage?

We can do waste segregation, separating biodegradable from non-biodegradable materials so less trash is burned!
statements.tl:
Paano natin maiiwasan ang masamang epekto ng pagsunog ng basura?

Maaari tayong magsagawa ng waste segregation, paghihiwalay ng biodegradable sa non-biodegradable na materyales para mas kaunti ang sinusunog na basura!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JsHH64DOPUIqVdTg5jAEH21_IP41OrqJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Flammable products, which can easily catch fire, such as paints, must be stored away from open flames.
statements.tl: Ang mga flammable na produkto, na madaling magliyab, tulad ng pintura, ay dapat itago malayo sa bukas na apoy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RPRl-ejwnasgenxGQJBw8OYvLSp5_qrv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mixing certain cleaning products at home can create a highly toxic gas, so you should never use two different cleaning products together.
statements.tl: Ang paghahalo ng ilang mga panlinis sa bahay ay maaaring lumikha ng lubhang nakakalasong gas, kaya hindi ka dapat gumamit ng dalawang magkaibang panlinis nang sabay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TWPNn_eVOFWneGPsmeg4whEowrdaYxyo), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Proper storage of materials based on their chemical properties keeps everyone safe from fire, rust, and harmful reactions.
statements.tl: Ang wastong pag-iimbak ng mga materyales batay sa kanilang chemical properties ay nagpapanatiling ligtas sa lahat mula sa sunog, kalawang, at mapanganib na reaksyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VnHPnOgQslhFKRbEg5TcfiyeaMSSuVoN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Keep flammable materials, breakable items, and toxic chemicals in a safe place before an earthquake.
statements.tl: Itago sa ligtas na lugar ang mga flammable materials, madaling mabasag na gamit, at toxic chemicals bago lumindol.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1u1I1UbBHMFuVfZWFYZ_5nVLB8gJtR0uq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Roofing sheets and iron are coated with zinc in a process called galvanizing. This zinc shield protects them from rust!
statements.tl: Ang yero at bakal ay binabalutan ng zinc sa prosesong tinatawag na galvanizing. Ang zinc na ito ang nagpoprotekta sa kanila sa kalawang!

statements.text: Never pour water on a kitchen grease fire! Oil floats on water and spreads the fire. Instead, cover it to cut off the oxygen.
statements.tl: Huwag bubuhusan ng tubig ang nagliliyab na mantika sa kusina! Lumulutang ang langis at kumakalat ang apoy. Takpan ito para maputol ang oxygen.

statements.text:
Why is open burning of trash banned in the Philippines?

Burning trash, especially plastic, releases toxic smoke! That is why open burning is banned in the Philippines under the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act (RA 9003).
statements.tl:
Bakit bawal ang open burning ng basura sa Pilipinas?

Ang pagsunog ng basura lalo na ng plastic ay naglalabas ng nakakalasong usok! Kaya bawal ang open burning sa Pilipinas sa ilalim ng Ecological Solid Waste Management Act (RA 9003).
statements.source: RA 8749 Philippine Clean Air Act; WHO; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
What happens if you mix bleach and vinegar?

Never mix bleach with vinegar or other acids because it makes a poisonous gas!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari paghahaluin ang bleach at suka?

Huwag ihalo ang bleach sa suka o ibang asido dahil makakabuo ito ng nakakalasong gas!

statements.text:
How does painting iron stop it from rusting?

The paint acts like a shield! It blocks out air and water to prevent rust from forming.
statements.tl:
Paano pinipigilan ng pintura ang kalawang sa bakal?

Ang pintura ay parang kalasag! Hinaharangan nito ang hangin at tubig para pigilan ang kalawang.

statements.text:
How can oil or grease protect iron tools?

Adding oil or grease to your iron tools helps stop rust from forming and keeps them safe!
statements.tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng langis o grasa ang mga kasangkapang bakal?

Ang paglalagay ng langis o grasa sa mga kasangkapang bakal ay pumipigil sa kalawang at nagpoprotekta!

statements.text:
How does zinc protect iron from rusting?

Coating iron with zinc, just like in galvanized roofing, creates a layer that keeps it from rusting!
statements.tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng zinc ang bakal?

Ang pagbalot ng bakal ng zinc, gaya sa yerong galvanized, ay pumipigil sa kalawang!

statements.text: Got a small pan fire? Just cover it with a lid! The fire loses its oxygen and goes out.
statements.tl: May maliit na sunog sa kawali? Takpan mo lang ng takip! Mawawalan ng oksiheno ang apoy at mamamatay.

statements.text: Leaking LPG in the kitchen can easily ignite or explode, so always close the tank tightly after use!
statements.tl: Ang tumatagas na LPG sa kusina ay madaling magliyab o sumabog, kaya isara ng mabuti ang tangke pagkatapos gamitin!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; LPG safety; PH common kitchen fuel

statements.text: Compost is dark, rich, soil-like material made from rotted plant and food scraps.
statements.tl: Ang compost ay maitim at mayamang materyales na parang lupa, na nabuo mula sa nabulok na tira ng halaman at pagkain.

statements.text: Compost returns nutrients to the soil so plants can grow stronger and healthier.
statements.tl: Ibinabalik ng compost ang mga sustansya sa lupa para mas malusog na tumubo ang mga halaman.

statements.text: Using proper toilets keeps human waste from mixing into the water we drink.
statements.tl: Ang paggamit ng tamang palikuran ay pumipigil sa dumi ng tao na makahalo sa tubig na iniinom natin.

statements.text: Recover means taking energy or materials from wastes that cannot be used anymore, converting waste into resources such as electricity, heat, compost, and fuel.
statements.tl: Ang Recover ay ang pagkuha ng enerhiya o materyales mula sa mga basurang hindi na magagamit, na ginagawang resources tulad ng kuryente, init, compost, at panggatong.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15Df6imiyxW6aY4jSyU-Clrrwz_aMVxk0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Households commonly generate food and kitchen wastes, papers, plastic bottles, metals and cans, boxes and cartons, glass bottles, cellophane and plastics, and yard or garden wastes.
statements.tl: Ang mga tahanan ay karaniwang gumagawa ng mga basura mula sa pagkain at kusina, papel, plastic na bote, metal at lata, kahon at karton, bote ng salamin, cellophane at plastic, at mga basura sa bakuran o hardin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16QZCST315MzfjPLu_hZINLWxdt0D4Sh7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Waste management uses five important actions called the 5Rs: reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, and repair, which all help lessen the trash we throw away.
statements.tl: Ang waste management ay gumagamit ng limang mahalagang aksyon na tinatawag na 5Rs: reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, at repair, na tumutulong lahat para mabawasan ang basurang itinatapon natin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16RSMP5-kMW5XH6IAxJgMvpVf9RrsJ1mu), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Proper waste management can help reduce flooding, air pollution, ozone depletion, and global warming, making our communities safer and healthier.
statements.tl: Ang maayos na waste management ay nakakatulong para mabawasan ang pagbaha, air pollution, ozone depletion, at global warming, kaya nagiging mas ligtas at malusog ang ating mga komunidad.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16RSMP5-kMW5XH6IAxJgMvpVf9RrsJ1mu), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Chemical wastes, not just trash, can pollute a tidal pool and poison the small animals living in it.
statements.tl: Ang mga chemical waste, hindi lamang basura, ay maaaring magpollute sa isang tidal pool at malason ang maliliit na hayop na naninirahan dito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18AtJakKpgkI14RwOpLJzBWGPEK64esRi), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Using both sides of paper when printing and buying items in refillable containers are simple ways to reduce waste.
statements.tl: Ang paggamit ng magkabilang bahagi ng papel sa pag-print at pagbili ng mga bagay na nasa refillable na lalagyan ay mga simpleng paraan upang mabawasan ang basura.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MPQBda_k94ghGAoJMio6R1WIKOc7BUf-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Having old furniture redeveloped or given a makeover instead of throwing it away is a useful way to reduce waste and keep it out of landfills.
statements.tl: Ang pagpapa-redevelop o pagbibigay ng makeover sa lumang furniture sa halip na itapon ito ay isang kapaki-pakinabang na paraan upang mabawasan ang basura at hindi ito mapunta sa landfill.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MPQBda_k94ghGAoJMio6R1WIKOc7BUf-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Having appliances, office equipment, and automotive parts repaired instead of buying new ones reduces waste and makes materials last longer.
statements.tl: Ang pagpapa-repair ng mga appliances, office equipment, at automotive parts sa halip na bumili ng bago ay nakakabawas ng basura at nagpapahaba ng buhay ng mga materyal.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MPQBda_k94ghGAoJMio6R1WIKOc7BUf-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Common environmental issues include water pollution, loss of soil quality, improper waste segregation, food waste, and disruptive noise from transportation and industry.
statements.tl: Ang mga karaniwang environmental issues ay kinabibilangan ng water pollution, pagkawala ng soil quality, improper waste segregation, food waste, at nakakagambalang ingay mula sa transportasyon at industriya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Wa1ixBDOg5r6ZT_rikGxD6A7eo-Y3Bx9), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do garbage bags get scattered along the street?

Improper solid waste disposal happens when garbage is not placed in proper bins, so stray animals can tear the bags and spread the trash around.
statements.tl:
Bakit nagkakalat ang mga garbage bag sa kalsada?

Nangyayari ang improper solid waste disposal kapag hindi inilalagay ang basura sa tamang basurahan, kaya maaaring sirain ng mga stray animals ang mga bag at ikalat ang basura.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Z9AV7sY2i7grgStgfG96je4ynCWEpxPA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Composting is a way of decomposing plant or animal matter into fertilizer, which is a good effect on the environment.
statements.tl: Ang composting ay paraan ng pagdecompose ng materyal mula sa halaman o hayop upang maging fertilizer, na mabuting epekto sa kapaligiran.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aJW5gOQGqf4lsrqyxRwTXIpaC4ZNP1Zt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When land is dumped with garbage, it becomes polluted and can become a breeding place for pests that carry germs.
statements.tl: Kapag ang lupa ay tinambakan ng basura, ito ay nagiging polluted at maaaring maging pugad ng mga peste na may dalang mikrobyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aJW5gOQGqf4lsrqyxRwTXIpaC4ZNP1Zt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Plants and trees can dry up and die when trash is dumped near them or when smoke from burning covers their leaves.
statements.tl: Ang mga halaman at puno ay maaaring matuyo at mamatay kapag tinambakan sila ng basura o kapag natakpan ng usok mula sa pagsunog ang kanilang mga dahon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1mNz2fpfVXmKVasGp-mHRmOAmEB7McRFT), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A used battery is harmful waste because it contains chemicals that can leak into the soil and poison the ground and water.
statements.tl: Ang gamit na baterya ay harmful waste dahil naglalaman ito ng mga kemikal na maaaring tumagas sa lupa at lasunin ang lupa at tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p03nwfCVZwgxLNP9rxHLrvU4hTVB0xWW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Families should be willing to spend a little more time and effort to segregate garbage if we want to improve our environment.
statements.tl: Ang mga pamilya ay dapat handang maglaan ng kaunting oras at pagsisikap para mag-segregate ng basura kung gusto nating mapabuti ang ating kapaligiran.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1piIdMN4Y72Y439lEbcQo9tycrd8-n_YE), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Survey questionnaires can help gather information about environmental issues and concerns in a school or community.
statements.tl: Ang survey questionnaire ay makakatulong sa pangangalap ng impormasyon tungkol sa mga isyu at problema sa kapaligiran sa paaralan o komunidad.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1LuEZ1gKjBKEASf0hjJyUgkW8ASbF473j), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Solutions to environmental problems can be shared through letters, songs, poems, posters, or diagrams so others can learn and help.
statements.tl: Ang mga solusyon sa problema sa kapaligiran ay maaaring ibahagi sa pamamagitan ng mga liham, kanta, tula, poster, o diagram para matuto at makatulong ang iba.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_S8Hli4mrjlLskBUGEH6hYf4R5RgjNK2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A good survey question is clear, relevant, and easy to answer, so people can give useful information without getting confused.
statements.tl: Ang isang magandang survey question ay malinaw, may kaugnayan sa paksa, at madaling sagutin para hindi malito ang mga tao sa pagbibigay ng impormasyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RGFRSvQYm-NwahgasMSOFf_p4Egn9gUw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A survey questionnaire includes a greeting, questions with answer choices, and a thank-you message for the people who shared their answers.
statements.tl: Ang survey questionnaire ay may greeting, mga tanong na may pagpipiliang sagot, at pasasalamat para sa mga taong nagbahagi ng kanilang mga sagot.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RGFRSvQYm-NwahgasMSOFf_p4Egn9gUw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Environmental issues and concerns, like waste segregation and recycling, can be investigated using survey questionnaires.
statements.tl: Ang mga isyu at problema sa kapaligiran, tulad ng waste segregation at recycling, ay maaaring imbestigahan gamit ang survey questionnaires.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RGFRSvQYm-NwahgasMSOFf_p4Egn9gUw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A guided survey is a way to collect information from people, and can include steps like formulating a hypothesis, ranking issues, computing averages, and writing a conclusion.
statements.tl: Ang guided survey ay isang paraan para mangalap ng impormasyon mula sa mga tao, at maaaring magsama ng mga hakbang tulad ng pagbuo ng hypothesis, pagra-rank ng mga isyu, pagkuha ng average, at pagsulat ng conclusion.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Wa1ixBDOg5r6ZT_rikGxD6A7eo-Y3Bx9), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Common materials around us can be classified into groups such as food, health and beauty products, cleaning agents, and gadgets.
statements.tl: Ang mga karaniwang materyales sa paligid natin ay maaaring pangkatin bilang pagkain, mga produktong pangkalusugan at pampaganda, mga panlinis, at gadget.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YphT_Kq1e974IQObPFWgmGp7J4wsaWzq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do we find out what environmental problems a community really has?

We use a survey, a special questionnaire that asks people questions to gather information about what they see and think.
statements.tl:
Paano natin malalaman kung anong mga problema sa kapaligiran ang talagang nararanasan ng isang komunidad?

Gumagamit tayo ng survey, isang espesyal na questionnaire na nagtatanong sa mga tao para mangalap ng impormasyon tungkol sa nakikita at iniisip nila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hQtJJTDas0j80sAeOBDFqvy96QRZSyDe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: You can sort seeds by looking at their size, shape, color, and texture, just like scientists do to identify different plant species.
statements.tl: Maaari mong pagbukud-bukurin ang mga buto sa pamamagitan ng pagtingin sa kanilang laki, hugis, kulay, at tekstura, tulad ng ginagawa ng mga scientist para makilala ang iba't ibang uri ng halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1luaUm8w46WUGFwtqtoCSkYxiU0cumsHk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Classifying means grouping objects or events into categories based on their characteristics or defined criteria, like sorting trash into biodegradable and non-biodegradable.
statements.tl: Ang classifying ay pagpapangkat ng mga bagay o pangyayari batay sa kanilang katangian o criteria, tulad ng paghihiwalay ng basura sa biodegradable at non-biodegradable.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1reQGjD4XizkxFl0QlhofkTk0c-bJmRol), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How can cleaning up show science process skills?

Going around to spot trash is observing, sorting waste is classifying, weighing collected trash is measuring, and taking photos is communicating!
statements.tl:
Paano naipapakita ng paglilinis ang science process skills?

Ang pag-ikot para makita ang basura ay observing, ang paghihiwalay ng basura ay classifying, ang pagtimbang ng nakolektang basura ay measuring, at ang pagkuha ng litrato ay communicating!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1reQGjD4XizkxFl0QlhofkTk0c-bJmRol), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The circulatory system transports oxygen, nutrients, and hormones to all parts of the body and removes waste products like carbon dioxide.
statements.tl: Ang circulatory system ay nagdadala ng oxygen, nutrients, at hormones sa lahat ng bahagi ng katawan at nag-aalis ng mga waste products tulad ng carbon dioxide.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18-zywcrj5tmMKcGZKq4kc5dIAD4r7KPR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Some of your bones act like hard armor, protecting the soft organs tucked safely inside your body.
statements.tl: Ang ilang buto mo ay parang matigas na panangga na nagpoprotekta sa malalambot na bahagi sa loob ng katawan mo.

statements.text: When a muscle pulls, the bone it's attached to moves like a lever turning at the joint.
statements.tl: Kapag humihila ang kalamnan, ang buto ay kumikilos na parang pingga na umiikot sa kasukasuan.

statements.text: Your respiratory system — nose, trachea, and lungs — works together to bring oxygen into your blood and remove carbon dioxide!
statements.tl: Ang respiratory system mo — ilong, trachea, at baga — ay nagtatrabaho nang magkasama para dalhin ang oxygen sa dugo at alisin ang carbon dioxide!

statements.text: Your digestive system is a team: mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine all work together to break down food and absorb nutrients.
statements.tl: Ang digestive system ay may koponan: bunganga, esophagus, tiyan, maliit na bituka, at malaking bituka — magkakasama silang nagtutunaw ng pagkain at sumisipsip ng sustansya.

statements.text: The respiratory system is responsible for the exchange of gases such as carbon dioxide and oxygen in the bloodstream.
statements.tl: Ang respiratory system ang responsable sa pagpapalitan ng mga gas tulad ng carbon dioxide at oxygen sa daloy ng dugo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15w_9XDs9Q8ye2-UAFQP0LpOxSgbkClFo), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The circulatory system is a transport system of the body responsible for the distribution of nutrients to the cells and carries away the waste products of the cells.
statements.tl: Ang circulatory system ay isang transport system ng katawan na responsable sa pamamahagi ng mga nutrients sa mga cells at nagdadala palayo ng mga dumi ng mga cells.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15w_9XDs9Q8ye2-UAFQP0LpOxSgbkClFo), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The brain monitors the respiratory process and controls the respiratory rate.
statements.tl: Binabantayan ng utak ang proseso ng paghinga at kinokontrol ang bilis ng paghinga.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15w_9XDs9Q8ye2-UAFQP0LpOxSgbkClFo), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Smooth muscles work without you thinking about them, digesting food in your stomach and keeping blood and air flowing through your body.
statements.tl: Ang smooth muscles ay gumagana nang hindi mo iniisip, tinutunaw ang pagkain sa tiyan at pinapanatili ang pagdaloy ng dugo at hangin sa katawan mo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1A_E9IWOj_GLrFcaWVy-bgRh0uaYCbnNQ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When a person eats, the digestive, nervous, and muscular systems mainly work together to break down food and move it through the body.
statements.tl: Kapag kumakain ang isang tao, ang digestive, nervous, at muscular systems ay pangunahing nagtutulungan para hatiin ang pagkain at ilipat ito sa katawan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1CdR6IaFsWxADHIcT6N2qRSoBurUZyku1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The digestive system changes food into smaller nutrients and supplies them to the blood, which delivers them to cells for cellular metabolism.
statements.tl: Binabago ng digestive system ang pagkain para maging mas maliliit na nutrients at ibinibigay ito sa dugo, na nagdadala nito sa mga cell para sa cellular metabolism.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1FcOOdp2k40ykuAOSL6NlfUsJcu3SfSRO), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The circulatory system transports oxygen and nutrients to your cells and collects waste materials from them, like a delivery and garbage service in one.
statements.tl: Ang circulatory system ay nagdadala ng oxygen at nutrients sa iyong mga cell at kumukuha ng mga waste materials mula sa mga ito, parang delivery at basurero sa iisang serbisyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IIMDuf3ISQ9muKYz6uRY8xIFEwEipbvB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The pancreas makes digestive enzymes, which are helpers that break down food, and bicarbonate, which lowers the acid from the stomach.
statements.tl: Ang pancreas ay gumagawa ng digestive enzymes, mga katulong na tumutunaw ng pagkain, at bicarbonate, na nagpapababa ng acid mula sa tiyan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b2pU3uKzvusMyNuV4GOGvho18sX8j3I2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The digestive system breaks down food into smaller pieces and simpler molecules so the body can absorb nutrients, which give us energy and help us stay strong and healthy.
statements.tl: Sinisira ng digestive system ang pagkain sa mas maliliit na piraso at mas simpleng molecule para ma-absorb ng katawan ang nutrients na nagbibigay sa atin ng lakas at nagpapanatiling malusog.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1flnVZiSU9TViRdA7SdAMUHCTl_AQXiCm), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The muscular system does more than move you - it also helps you stand straight, keeps you warm by producing heat, and pushes blood through your body.
statements.tl: Hindi lang para gumalaw ang muscular system - tinutulungan ka rin nitong tumayo nang tuwid, pinapainit ang katawan sa paggawa ng heat, at tinutulak ang dugo sa buong katawan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1gmi9x9C293oZUeJZaPBdRv7icAm0jFH8), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Undigested food materials become waste and leave the body through the anus.
statements.tl: Ang mga hindi natunaw na pagkain ay nagiging dumi at lumalabas sa katawan sa pamamagitan ng anus.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1lb1elvu6J0Mrx7WPOFpWN1f-x7RQqbdU), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The digestive system provides nutrients and energy to the body from the food we eat.
statements.tl: Ang digestive system ay nagbibigay ng nutrients at enerhiya sa katawan mula sa pagkain na ating kinakain.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1lb1elvu6J0Mrx7WPOFpWN1f-x7RQqbdU), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The quadriceps are the big muscles at the front of your thigh, and they straighten your knee when you walk, run, or kick a ball.
statements.tl: Ang quadriceps ay ang malalaking muscles sa harap ng hita, at sila ang nagpapatuwid ng tuhod kapag naglalakad, tumatakbo, o sumisipa ng bola.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1n5ziDcdftL-5I01eGaFt1xGkFi_w_Gsh), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The shoot system includes the stem, leaves, and other above-ground structures that help the plant grow and survive.
statements.tl: Ang shoot system ay binubuo ng tangkay, dahon, at iba pang bahaging nasa itaas ng lupa na tumutulong sa paglaki at pamumuhay ng halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Vs-sd6aktj6YKWjEcmAl_cMLWuCSY0ik), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: After the root grows, a shoot pushes upward out of the soil, reaching toward the sunlight!
statements.tl: Pagkatapos ng ugat, tumutubo ang usbong pataas mula sa lupa, patungo sa liwanag ng araw!

statements.text: A plant's roots soak up water and nutrients from the soil so the whole plant can use them.
statements.tl: Ang ugat ng halaman ang humihigop ng tubig at mga sustansya mula sa lupa para magamit ng buong halaman.
statements.source: NRC LS1.A; AAAS BSL Ch.5; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: Vascular bundles are strands inside stems and leaves that contain both xylem and phloem, acting as the plant's transport highway.
statements.tl: Ang vascular bundles ay mga hibla sa loob ng tangkay at dahon na naglalaman ng xylem at phloem, nagsisilbing transport highway ng halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Mad91Cs8BjYvUOcIvIBARlY55wSrXhtx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Kangkong shoots, the stems and leaves we eat, carry out photosynthesis and transpiration, which is releasing water vapor into the air.
statements.tl: Ang Kangkong shoots, ang mga tangkay at dahon na kinakain natin, ay nagsasagawa ng photosynthesis at transpiration, na paglalabas ng water vapor sa hangin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1WAImK6ZNraltM9EgmxmjZWeLPohRfEds), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cogon grass has thick roots that hold the soil tightly together underground. This helps stop soil from washing or blowing away.
statements.tl: Ang kogon ay may masusukal na ugat na mahigpit na humahawak sa lupa. Nakakatulong ito para hindi maanod o mabura ang lupa.

statements.text: In a vegetable garden, plants like tomatoes and eggplants stay in one spot because their roots hold them firmly in place, even when watered every day.
statements.tl: Sa gulayan, nakatayo sa iisang lugar ang mga halamang tulad ng kamatis at talong dahil hinahawakan sila ng ugat, kahit araw-araw silang diligan.

statements.text: Makahiya is related to beans! Tiny bumps on its roots help add nitrogen back into the soil, a nutrient other plants need to grow.
statements.tl: Kabilang ang makahiya sa pamilyang tulad ng beans! Ang maliliit na bukol sa mga ugat nito ay tumutulong magdagdag ng nitrogen sa lupa, isang sustansyang kailangan ng ibang halaman.

statements.text: Leaves and flowers grow attached to a plant's stem.
statements.tl: Ang mga dahon at bulaklak ay nakakabit sa tangkay ng halaman.

statements.text:
Why does corn stand so firm?

It has prop roots — extra roots that grow out from its lower stem to help it stand firmly in the soil!
statements.tl:
Bakit matatag tumayo ang mais?

May prop roots ito — mga karagdagang ugat na lumalabas mula sa ibabang tangkay para mas matatag itong tumayo sa lupa!

statements.text: Some plants have one deep taproot that goes far down, while others have shallow but wide-spreading roots — both keep the plant standing strong.
statements.tl: May mga halaman na isang malalim na ugat (taproot) na bumababa nang malayo, habang ang iba ay may mababaw pero malawak na ugat — pareho itong tumutulong panatilihing nakatayo ang halaman.

statements.text: Besides pako, Filipinos gather and eat many other wild greens, like edible shoots and leaves.
statements.tl: Bukod sa pako, marami pang ligaw na gulay ang pinupulot at kinakain ng mga Pilipino tulad ng talbos at dahon.

statements.text: Trees and grasses along a riverbank grip the soil with their roots. That stops erosion and filters out dirt before it reaches the water.
statements.tl: Ang mga puno at damo sa tabi ng ilog ay humahawak sa lupa gamit ang ugat nila. Napipigilan nito ang pagguho at nasasala ang dumi bago umabot sa tubig.

statements.text: Eggplant, tomato, and okra all grow in soil — that's where their roots take hold and anchor the plant.
statements.tl: Ang talong, kamatis, at okra ay tumutubo sa lupa — doon nakaugat ang kanilang halaman.

statements.text: The coconut palm has no single deep taproot — instead, thousands of thin roots spread near the surface, keeping it standing even in strong wind!
statements.tl: Ang niyog ay walang isang malalim na ugat kundi libu-libong manipis na ugat na kumakalat malapit sa ibabaw ng lupa, kaya nakatayo pa rin ito kahit malakas ang hangin!

statements.text: The mung bean or munggo is a vegetable rich in protein, and its roots help add nitrogen to the soil, making it more fertile for other crops!
statements.tl: Ang munggo ay halamang gulay na mayaman sa protina, at ang mga ugat nito ay tumutulong magdagdag ng nitroheno sa lupa para maging mas mataba ito!

statements.text: As a plant grows older, its roots grow longer and thicker, gripping the soil more and more firmly.
statements.tl: Habang tumatanda ang halaman, humahaba at kumakapal ang mga ugat nito, kaya lalong tumitibay ang paghawak nito sa lupa.

statements.text:
Can a stem make its own food?

Yes! Green stems can make food using sunlight too, just like leaves do.
statements.tl:
Kaya rin bang gumawa ng pagkain ang tangkay?

Oo! Ang berdeng tangkay ay puwede ring gumawa ng pagkain gamit ang sikat ng araw, tulad ng dahon.

statements.text: A baby chicken, called a chick, hatches out of an egg.
statements.tl: Ang batang manok na tinatawag na sisiw ay napipisa mula sa itlog.

statements.text: Both butterflies and moths go through four life stages: egg, caterpillar, pupa, and adult.
statements.tl: Parehong dumaraan ang paru-paro at gamu-gamo sa apat na yugto: itlog, uod, pupa, at ganap na hayop.

statements.text: A frog's life has four stages: eggs laid in water, a tadpole with a tail and gills, a froglet with four legs and a tail, then an adult frog with four legs and no tail.
statements.tl: Dumadaan ang palaka sa apat na yugto: itlog na inilalagay sa tubig, tadpole na may buntot at hasang, froglet na may apat na paa at buntot, at adult na palaka na may apat na paa at walang buntot.

statements.text: A life cycle flow chart uses arrows to show the correct order of stages, like egg to caterpillar to chrysalis to butterfly!
statements.tl: Ang flow chart ng life cycle ay gumagamit ng arrows para ipakita ang tamang pagkakasunod-sunod ng stages, tulad ng egg hanggang caterpillar hanggang chrysalis hanggang butterfly!

statements.text: The human life cycle has five major stages: birth, infancy, childhood, adolescence, and adulthood.
statements.tl: Ang life cycle ng tao ay may limang pangunahing yugto: birth, infancy, childhood, adolescence, at adulthood.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16si-zutkrpJC2NlWuB1w-nH5L-yeh4q2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A butterfly begins its life as a tiny egg, usually laid by the female butterfly on a leaf.
statements.tl: Nagsisimula ang buhay ng butterfly bilang isang maliit na egg, na karaniwang inilalagay ng babaeng butterfly sa isang dahon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16si-zutkrpJC2NlWuB1w-nH5L-yeh4q2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Humans, animals, and plants all have life cycles, but humans grow gradually without metamorphosis, while many insects and frogs change body forms completely.
statements.tl: Ang mga tao, hayop, at halaman ay lahat may life cycle, ngunit ang mga tao ay unti-unting lumalaki nang walang metamorphosis, habang maraming insekto at frog ang lubusang nagbabago ng anyo ng katawan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16si-zutkrpJC2NlWuB1w-nH5L-yeh4q2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is inside a chicken egg that helps a chick grow?

The egg white protects the developing chick, while the egg yolk gives it proteins and vitamins to grow strong and healthy!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nasa loob ng itlog ng manok na tumutulong sa paglaki ng sisiw?

Ang egg white ay nagpoprotekta sa lumalaking sisiw, habang ang egg yolk ay nagbibigay dito ng mga protina at bitamina para lumakas at maging malusog!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1OzDtLkLsKX_MbYysbvzy-EPWAMbKUvi2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The human life cycle includes foetus, baby, childhood, adolescence, adulthood, and old age.
statements.tl: Ang siklo ng buhay ng tao ay may mga yugtong fetus, pagkasanggol, pagkabata, pagbibinata o pagdadalaga, pagiging maygulang, at katandaan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1tJiUoim6ACOxl0Eeo15rLn0T0hCiFM3p), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Once the transformation is complete, the adult female butterfly breaks free from the chrysalis and can later lay eggs to start the life cycle all over again.
statements.tl: Kapag kumpleto na ang pagbabago, ang adult na babaeng paru-paro ay lalabas mula sa chrysalis at maaari itong mangitlog sa kalaunan upang simulan muli ang life cycle.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1tJiUoim6ACOxl0Eeo15rLn0T0hCiFM3p), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A grasshopper's life cycle has three stages: it starts as an egg, hatches into a nymph that looks like a small adult without wings, and then grows into an adult with wings.
statements.tl: Ang siklo ng buhay ng grasshopper ay may tatlong yugto: nagsisimula bilang itlog, napipisa bilang nymph na parang maliit na adult na walang pakpak, at pagkatapos ay lumalaki bilang adult na may pakpak.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yuutb9JJ2M71epJ6DlslnFmJHksak375), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A bug going through complete metamorphosis passes through four stages: egg, larva, pupa, then adult insect!
statements.tl: Ang isang insektong dumadaan sa ganap na metamorphosis ay may apat na yugto: itlog, uod (larva), pupa, at ganap na insekto!

statements.text: A chicken starts as an egg kept warm by the hen; after about three weeks a chick hatches and slowly grows into a full-grown chicken.
statements.tl: Nagsisimula ang manok bilang itlog na pinipisa ng inahin; pagkatapos ng mga tatlong linggo, lalabas ang sisiw na unti-unting lalaki hanggang maging ganap na manok.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable consensus; DepEd MATATAG Science G3

statements.text: Kids have 20 baby teeth that start falling out around age 6, replaced by 28 to 32 permanent teeth meant to last a lifetime.
statements.tl: Ang mga bata ay may 20 baby teeth na nagsisimulang matanggal sa edad na 6, papalitan ng 28 hanggang 32 permanenteng ngipin na dapat tumagal habambuhay.

statements.text:
What are the four stages of complete metamorphosis?

Egg, larva, pupa, and adult — that's the full journey of complete metamorphosis!
statements.tl:
Ano ang apat na yugto ng buong metamorphosis?

Itlog, uod (larva), pupa, at ganap na insekto — iyan ang buong daan ng complete metamorphosis!

statements.text:
How do some Philippine frogs protect their eggs?

Some, like tree frogs, build foam nests on branches or leaves over water to keep their eggs safe.
statements.tl:
Paano pinoprotektahan ng ilang palaka sa Pilipinas ang kanilang itlog?

Ang ilan, tulad ng tree frog, ay nagtatayo ng foam nest sa sanga o dahon na nakabitin sa ibabaw ng tubig para pangalagaan ang mga itlog.

statements.text: A butterfly goes through complete metamorphosis: from egg, it becomes a caterpillar, then a pupa, and finally a butterfly!
statements.tl: Dumaraan ang paru-paro sa ganap na metamorphosis: mula itlog, nagiging higad, pagkatapos ay pupa, at sa wakas ay paru-paro!

statements.text: A butterfly changes form in four stages: egg, caterpillar, pupa, and finally the adult butterfly. This is called complete metamorphosis!
statements.tl: Nagbabago ang anyo ng paruparo sa apat na yugto: itlog, higad, pupa, at ang ganap na paruparo. Ito ay tinatawag na complete metamorphosis!

statements.text: When you put two like poles together, they push apart and repel each other!
statements.tl: Kapag pinagdikit mo ang dalawang magkaparehong polo, nagtataboy o nag-iiwasan ang mga ito!

statements.text: Test it yourself! Touch paper clips to a magnet. The most clips stick at the ends or poles, proving the poles are the strongest parts!
statements.tl: Subukan mo! Idikit ang paper clips sa magnet. Pinakamaraming clip ang kakapit sa dulo o poles, na nagpapatunay na doon pinakamalakas!

statements.text: Some objects have both magnetic and non-magnetic parts! A magnet sticks to the steel blades of scissors, but not the plastic handles. It depends on the part you test!
statements.tl: May mga bagay na may mga bahaging magnetic at hindi magnetic! Dumidikit ang magnet sa mga talim na asero ng gunting, pero hindi sa mga hawakang plastik. Depende ito sa bahaging tinitest mo!

statements.text:
What happens when you test different objects with a magnet?

Things made of iron are attracted! But plastic, rubber, and wood will not be pulled.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag sinusubukan ang iba't ibang bagay gamit ang magnet?

Nahihila ang mga gawa sa bakal! Pero ang plastic, goma, at kahoy ay hindi.

statements.text: Everyday objects like paper clips, nails, bolts, and keys can be magnetic because they are often made of iron or steel.
statements.tl: Ang mga pang-araw-araw na bagay tulad ng paper clips, pako, bolts, at susi ay maaaring magnetic dahil kadalasang gawa ang mga ito sa bakal o steel.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-uGwlpxeG8xSFSfJbfNMdzi30EhtLOa_), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Are all metals attracted to magnets?

No! Some metals like iron are attracted to magnets, but not all metals are magnetic.
statements.tl:
Lahat ba ng metal ay nadadagit ng magnet?

Hindi! Ang ilang metal tulad ng bakal ay nadadagit ng magnet, ngunit hindi lahat ng metal.

statements.text: Magnets ignore plastic, paper, and sand completely! This is exactly why they are perfect for separating iron from those materials.
statements.tl: Hindi inaakit ng magneto ang plastic, papel, o buhangin! Kaya naman napakagaling nitong maghiwalay ng bakal sa mga ito.

statements.text: Not all metals stick to magnets! Iron is attracted, but other metals like aluminum and copper are not.
statements.tl: Hindi lahat ng metal ay dumidikit sa magneto! Ang bakal ay naaakit, pero ang aluminyo at tanso ay hindi.

statements.text:
What happens when a magnet gets close to a mixture?

Tiny pieces of iron will magically cling right to the magnet!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag inilapit ang magneto sa isang halo?

Ang maliliit na piraso ng bakal ay didikit mismo sa magneto!

statements.text:
Can a magnet pull iron through a barrier?

Yes! A magnet's force passes right through thin paper or a cup to pull iron!
statements.tl:
Kaya bang humila ng magneto ng bakal kahit may harang?

Oo! Dumadaan ang puwersa ng magneto sa manipis na papel o tasa para hanguin ang bakal!

statements.text:
What makes the black sand on some Philippine beaches special?

It contains an iron mineral called magnetite that a magnet easily attracts!
statements.tl:
Ano ang espesyal sa itim na buhangin sa ilang baybayin ng Pilipinas?

Mayroon itong iron mineral na tinatawag na magnetite na naaakit ng magneto!

statements.text: A stronger magnet can pull out way more iron than a weak magnet can!
statements.tl: Mas maraming bakal ang kayang hanguin ng malakas na magneto kaysa sa mahinang magneto!

statements.text: Besides iron, nickel and cobalt are attracted to magnets too. Many types of steel are also attracted because they contain iron!
statements.tl: Bukod sa bakal, ang nikel at cobalt ay naaakit din ng magneto. Maraming uri ng asero ang naaakit din dahil may bakal ang mga ito!

statements.text: When a magnet gets too hot, it loses its strength and can no longer pull iron!
statements.tl: Kapag masyadong mainit ang isang magneto, nawawalan ito ng lakas at hindi na kayang humila ng bakal!

statements.text: Not all metals stick to magnets! Some stainless steel, especially with nickel, barely attracts magnets. It depends on what the steel is mixed with.
statements.tl: Hindi lahat ng metal ay dumidikit sa magnet! Ang ilang stainless steel, lalo na ang may nickel, ay hindi gaanong dinadikitan. Depende ito sa sangkap nito.

statements.text: Only a few transition metals are magnetic: iron, nickel, and cobalt! That's why a magnet sticks to iron but not to copper or gold. Not every metal is pulled by magnets!
statements.tl: Ilang transition metals lang ang magnetiko: iron, nickel, at cobalt! Kaya nakakabit ang magnet sa iron pero hindi sa copper o gold. Hindi lahat ng metal nahihila ng magnet!

statements.text:
Does steel still stick to magnets?

Yes! Even with carbon, steel keeps iron's trait of sticking to magnets. That's why magnets pick up steel clips! But some special stainless steel sticks weakly.
statements.tl:
Kumakapit pa ba ang steel sa magnet?

Oo! Kahit may carbon, pinapanatili ng steel ang katangian ng bakal na dumikit sa magnet. Kaya nakukuha ng magnet ang steel clips! Pero mahina ang ilang stainless steel.

statements.text: Magnetism is a property of some materials! Iron and some metals can be attracted by magnets and can become magnets. But gold, silver, copper, aluminium, and most non-metals are not magnetic!
statements.tl: Ang magnetismo ay isang katangian ng ilang materyales! Ang bakal at ilang metal ay naaakit ng magneto at pwedeng maging magneto. Pero ang ginto, pilak, tanso, aluminyo, at karamihan sa hindi-metal ay hindi magnetic!

statements.text: A magnet is amazing because it can pull iron even without directly touching it!
statements.tl: Nakakamangha! Ang magnet ay kayang humila ng bakal kahit hindi ito direktang nadidikit dito.

statements.text: Very loud sounds can damage the tiny parts inside your ear and weaken your hearing.
statements.tl: Ang sobrang lakas na tunog ay maaaring makasira sa maliliit na bahagi sa loob ng tainga at makabawas sa pandinig.

statements.text: The Sun warms your skin through radiation! It sends invisible infrared waves right through the empty vacuum of space to reach you.
statements.tl: Pinapainit ng Sun ang balat mo through radiation! Nagpapadala ito ng invisible infrared waves sa empty vacuum ng space para makarating sa'yo.

statements.text: Our ears catch sound waves and then send signals to the brain, which understands them as sounds.
statements.tl: Sinasalo ng ating mga tenga ang sound waves at nagpapadala ito ng signals sa utak, na siyang umuunawa sa mga tunog.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 13B5-eOIrBv9RttyTRQ3Wu32Xxaqpz8G9), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Iron filings, thumb tacks, staple wire, pins, some coins, and needles are common objects that are attracted to a magnet.
statements.tl: Ang iron filings, thumb tacks, staple wire, pins, ilang barya, at needles ay mga karaniwang bagay na naaakit ng magnet.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 19q-MLHUFXp2_rTgRbSrGWEfUt79qg_JS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do moths fly around lamps?

Moths are often drawn to lights at night — that's why we see them flying around lamps.
statements.tl:
Bakit umiikot ang gamu-gamo sa ilaw?

Madalas lumalapit ang mga gamu-gamo sa ilaw kapag gabi, kaya nakikita natin silang umiikot sa paligid ng ilawan.

statements.text:
How do migrating birds find their way?

Many migrating birds have an inner 'compass' that senses Earth's magnetic field, helping them find their way even on cloudy nights.
statements.tl:
Paano nakakahanap ng daan ang lumilipat na ibon?

Maraming lumilipat na ibon ang may parang panloob na kompas na nakakaramdam ng magnetikong larangan ng Mundo, kaya hindi sila naliligaw kahit maulap ang gabi.

statements.text: Many animals find their way on long journeys using smell, the sun and stars, Earth's magnetic field, and memory — this skill is called navigation.
statements.tl: Maraming hayop ang nakakahanap ng tamang daan sa malalayong paglalakbay gamit ang amoy, posisyon ng araw at bituin, magnetic field ng Earth, at alaala — tinatawag itong navigation.
statements.source: AAAS BSL Ch.5; NRC LS1.A; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
How can we see things?

Light enters our eye, and the eye sends a message to the brain so we can understand what we are looking at.
statements.tl:
Paano tayo nakakakita ng mga bagay?

Pumapasok ang liwanag sa ating mata, at ipinapadala nito ang mensahe sa utak para maintindihan natin ang ating nakikita.

statements.text:
Why do magnets stick to the fridge door?

Iron is pulled by magnets! That is why it is used in the magnets that stick to fridge doors.
statements.tl:
Bakit dumidikit ang magnet sa pinto ng ref?

Ang iron ay nahihila ng magnet! Kaya ginagamit ito sa mga magnetong dumidikit sa pinto ng ref.

statements.text:
Why does a magnet attract iron paperclips?

Its magnetic field forces the random magnetic domains inside the iron to line up and pull together!
statements.tl:
Bakit humihila ang magnet ng mga iron paperclips?

Pinapilit ng magnetic field nito ang mga magnetic domains sa bakal na mag-ayos at magsama!

statements.text:
How does a magnet pull a paperclip?

It creates an invisible magnetic field that pulls the iron atoms inside the steel paperclip right to it!
statements.tl:
Paano humihila ang magnet sa paperclip?

Gumagawa ito ng hindi nakikitang magnetic field na humihila sa iron atoms sa loob ng steel paperclip papunta sa kanya!

statements.text:
Can a magnet move things without touching them?

Yes! A magnet can pull or push objects without touching them because its invisible force reaches across the space around it.
statements.tl:
Kaya bang gumalaw ng mga bagay ang magnet nang hindi hawak?

Oo! Kayang humila o magtulak ng bagay ang magnet nang hindi dinidikit, dahil umaabot ang puwersa nito sa paligid.

statements.text:
What is the invisible area around a magnet called?

It's the magnetic field! This is the region where another magnet or piece of iron feels its pulling force.
statements.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa di-nakikitang lugar sa paligid ng magnet?

Magnetikong larangan! Ito ang lugar kung saan nararamdaman ng ibang magnet o bakal ang puwersa nito.

statements.text:
Why are metal objects not allowed near an MRI machine?

Its magnet is so strong it can pull metal across the room fast and dangerously!
statements.tl:
Bakit bawal magdala ng metal objects malapit sa MRI machine?

Napakalakas ng magnet nito kaya kayang hilahin nang mabilis at mapanganib ang metal sa kabuuan ng silid!

statements.text: In a junkyard, a crane uses a giant electromagnet to lift whole cars, then drops them by switching off the current!
statements.tl: Sa junkyard, gumagamit ang crane ng giant electromagnet para buhatin ang buong kotse, at bitawan ito sa pag-off ng current!

statements.text: A magnet's pull still works through water, glass, or paper! That's why it can move a clip inside a glass of water.
statements.tl: Gumagana pa rin ang puwersa ng magnet kahit may tubig, baso, o papel sa pagitan! Kaya kayang gumalaw ang clip sa loob ng basong may tubig.

statements.text: A magnet's force works even without touching the object, like pulling things right through paper or air!
statements.tl: Ang puwersa ng magnet ay gumagana kahit hindi nakadikit sa bagay, gaya ng pagdaan nito sa papel o hangin!

statements.text: Crocodiles are carnivores — they eat meat like fish, birds, and other animals.
statements.tl: Ang mga buwaya ay karnivoro — kumakain sila ng karne tulad ng isda, ibon, at iba pang hayop.

statements.text: Pigs are omnivores, so they eat both plants and meat.
statements.tl: Ang baboy ay omnivore, kaya kumakain ito ng halaman at karne.

statements.text: Cattle are herbivores, so they eat grass and leafy plants.
statements.tl: Ang baka ay herbivore o kumakain ng halaman, kaya damo at dahon ang kinakain nito.

statements.text: A goat is a herbivore -- it eats grass, leaves, and small plants.
statements.tl: Ang kambing ay herbivore -- kumakain ito ng damo, dahon, at maliliit na halaman.

statements.text: The civet, or alamid, is an omnivore that eats fruit, insects, small animals, and eggs.
statements.tl: Ang alamid ay omnivore na kumakain ng prutas, insekto, maliliit na hayop, at mga itlog.

statements.text: A raccoon is an omnivore with sharp claws and teeth for climbing trees and grabbing snacks like fruits, nuts, insects, fish, and small animals.
statements.tl: Ang raccoon ay isang omnivore na may matatalas na claws at ngipin para umakyat sa mga puno at kumuha ng mga pagkain tulad ng prutas, nuts, insekto, isda, at maliliit na hayop.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MbmB7dTTMfpvIL0ZsZ50FgmSPuKWegpq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Besides grass, a carabao can also eat banana leaves and stalks and other soft, leafy plants on the farm.
statements.tl: Bukod sa damo, kaya ring kainin ng kalabaw ang dahon at puno ng saging at iba pang malambot na halaman sa bukid.

statements.text: Crickets eat plants, plus tiny bits of many different kinds of food.
statements.tl: Kumakain ang kuliglig ng mga halaman at maliliit na piraso ng iba't ibang pagkain.

statements.text: A centipede moves fast and hunts small insects to eat.
statements.tl: Ang alupihan ay mabilis gumalaw at humahabol ng maliliit na insekto na kinakain nito.

statements.text: The carabao eats grass and other plants, which makes it a herbivore.
statements.tl: Kumakain ang kalabaw ng damo at iba pang halaman, kaya ito ay herbivore.

statements.text:
What does a civet eat?

Not just fruit! A civet also eats small animals like insects, worms, and sometimes tiny birds — that mixed diet makes it an omnivore.
statements.tl:
Ano ang kinakain ng musang?

Hindi lang prutas! Kumakain din ang musang ng maliliit na hayop tulad ng insekto, bulate, at minsan maliliit na ibon — dahil dito, tinatawag itong omnivore.

statements.text: A herbivore eats only plants (like a carabao), a carnivore eats only meat (like a lion), and an omnivore eats both (like people)—giving omnivores the widest choice of food.
statements.tl: Halaman lang ang kinakain ng herbivore (gaya ng kalabaw), karne lang ng carnivore (gaya ng leon), at pareho ng omnivore (gaya ng tao)—kaya pinakamalawak ang pagpipilian ng pagkain ng omnivore.

statements.text: The ostrich eats plants, seeds, and every now and then, small insects too.
statements.tl: Kumakain ang ostrich ng mga halaman, buto, at paminsan-minsan ng maliliit na insekto.

statements.text: The monitor lizard is a meat-eater, feeding on eggs, chickens, fish, snails, and other small animals.
statements.tl: Kumakain ng karne ang bayawak, tulad ng itlog, manok, isda, kuhol, at iba pang maliliit na hayop.

statements.text:
What is a herbivore?

A herbivore is an animal that eats only plants — like a carabao munching on grass.
statements.tl:
Ano ang herbivore?

Ang herbivore ay hayop na kumakain lamang ng halaman, gaya ng kalabaw na kumakain ng damo.

statements.text: Tyrannosaurus was a giant hunting dinosaur with big, sharp teeth built for tearing and eating meat.
statements.tl: Ang Tyrannosaurus ay isang malaking dinosaur na mangangaso na may matataas at matatalim na ngipin para sa pagkain ng karne.

statements.text:
What's the difference between a stick insect and a mantis?

Both are thin and long, but stick insects eat leaves, while the mantis is a hunter that catches other insects.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng stick insect at mantis?

Pareho silang manipis at mahaba, pero ang stick insect ay kumakain ng dahon, habang ang mantis ay mandaragit na humuhuli ng ibang insekto.

statements.text: When plants are scarce, an omnivore can eat animals; when animals are scarce, it eats plants instead. This flexible diet helps omnivores survive even when the season or food supply changes.
statements.tl: Kapag kaunti ang halaman, kumakain ng hayop ang omnivore; kapag kaunti naman ang hayop, kumakain ito ng halaman. Dahil sa flexible na diyeta na ito, mas madali silang mabuhay kahit magbago ang panahon o ang available na pagkain.

statements.text: People are part of food chains too — as omnivores we eat plants like rice and vegetables and animals like fish and chicken, connecting us to the Sun through our food.
statements.tl: Kabilang din ang tao sa food chain — bilang omnivore, kumakain tayo ng halaman tulad ng kanin at gulay, at hayop tulad ng isda at manok, kaya konektado tayo sa araw sa pamamagitan ng pagkain.
statements.source: NRC LS2.A; AAAS BSL Ch.5; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
Why does the food chain arrow point that way?

In a food chain, the arrow always points to the eater — because that's the direction energy flows, from food to the one eating it.
statements.tl:
Bakit doon nakaturo ang palaso sa food chain?

Sa food chain, laging nakaturo ang palaso sa kumakain — dahil doon dumadaloy ang enerhiya, mula sa pagkain papunta sa kumakain nito.

statements.text: Some animals eat rice. Chickens and birds peck at cooked rice or raw palay grains on the ground.
statements.tl: May mga hayop na kumakain ng kanin. Ang mga manok at ibon ay tumutuka ng kanin o hilaw na palay sa lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 11YbvWI0H7WF5Jt1lNPDwWxnmh153aX6N), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A food chain from the Philippines could be: rice plant eaten by a rat, which is then eaten by a Philippine cobra.
statements.tl: Ang isang food chain mula sa Pilipinas ay maaaring: halaman ng palay na kinakain ng daga, na pagkatapos ay kinakain ng Philippine cobra.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1znwaI4eUCKLob1xb5cHylyr_1Hh1-5dd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The Philippine eagle, one of the world's largest eagles, hunts big prey like flying lemurs, monkeys, and other large forest animals.
statements.tl: Ang Philippine eagle, isa sa pinakamalaking agila sa mundo, ay kumakain ng malalaking hayop tulad ng flying lemur, unggoy, at iba pang malaking nilalang sa gubat.

statements.text: In a grassland, a grasshopper eats grass, a bird eats the grasshopper, and a snake or hawk eats the bird — that's a food chain!
statements.tl: Sa grassland, kinakain ng tipaklong ang damo, kinakain ng ibon ang tipaklong, at kinakain ng ahas o lawin ang ibon — iyan ang kadena ng pagkain!

statements.text: The Philippine bulbul is a native bird found only here, feasting on fruits and insects in our forests.
statements.tl: Ang Philippine bulbul ay isang katutubong ibon na matatagpuan lamang dito, kumakain ng prutas at insekto sa mga gubat.

statements.text: A simple food chain follows this order: Sun to plant to plant-eating animal to meat-eating animal. For example: Sun to grass to mouse to snake.
statements.tl: Ang simpleng food chain ay sumusunod sa ganitong ayos: araw, halaman, hayop na kumakain ng halaman, hayop na kumakain ng karne. Halimbawa: araw, damo, daga, ahas.
statements.source: NRC LS2.B; AAAS BSL Ch.5; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: Birds and frogs love to eat grasshoppers and crickets — it's part of their diet in the wild.
statements.tl: Kumakain ang mga ibon at palaka ng tipaklong at kuliglig bilang bahagi ng kanilang pagkain.

statements.text:
Do herons only eat fish?

Nope! Herons also eat frogs, insects, shrimp, small snakes, and even tiny mice sometimes.
statements.tl:
Isda lang ba ang kinakain ng tagak?

Hindi pala! Kumakain din ang tagak ng palaka, insekto, hipon, maliliit na ahas, at minsan pa nga maliliit na daga.

statements.text:
What is an apex predator?

An apex predator is a carnivore at the very top of the food chain — an animal that almost nothing else hunts, like a lion or a shark.
statements.tl:
Ano ang apex predator?

Ang apex predator ay carnivore na nasa pinakatuktok ng food chain — hayop na halos walang ibang hayop na nanghuhuli rito, tulad ng leon o pating.

statements.text: In a Philippine forest food chain: sun → plants → a monkey that eats fruit and leaves → the Philippine eagle that eats the monkey. The eagle sits at the very top.
statements.tl: Sa gubat ng Pilipinas, may food chain na ganito: araw → halaman → unggoy na kumakain ng prutas at dahon → Philippine eagle na kumakain ng unggoy. Ang agila ang nasa tuktok.

statements.text: In the Philippines, white herons often stand in rice paddies and canals, hunting small fish, frogs, and insects among the plants.
statements.tl: Sa Pilipinas, madalas makita ang puting tagak na nakatayo sa mga palayan at kanal, nanghuhuli ng maliliit na isda, palaka, at insekto sa pagitan ng mga halaman.

statements.text: The tarsier eats insects such as grasshoppers and crickets, hunting for them at night!
statements.tl: Kumakain ang tarsier ng mga insekto tulad ng tipaklong at kuliglig, habang nangangaso sa gabi!

statements.text: Sea snails crawl along seagrass leaves and eat the algae that sticks to them.
statements.tl: Ang mga susô sa dagat ay gumagapang sa mga dahon ng damong-dagat at kinakain ang lumot na dumidikit dito.

statements.text: Green plants are called producers because they make their own food using sunlight, water, and air!
statements.tl: Ang mga berdeng halaman ay tinatawag na producers dahil gumagawa sila ng sarili nilang pagkain gamit ang sikat ng araw, tubig, at hangin!

statements.text:
What is a carnivore?

A carnivore is an animal that eats mainly other animals, like the Philippine eagle hunting snakes and small birds!
statements.tl:
Ano ang carnivore?

Ang carnivore ay isang hayop na pangunahing kumakain ng ibang hayop, tulad ng Philippine eagle na nanghuhuli ng ahas at maliliit na ibon!

statements.text:
Why do most food chains only have three or four steps?

Most food chains are short because a lot of energy is lost at each step!
statements.tl:
Bakit may tatlo o apat na hakbang lang ang karamihan sa food chain?

Karamihan sa food chain ay maikli dahil maraming energy ang nawawala sa bawat hakbang!

statements.text: Rigid objects are hard and cannot be easily bent, deformed, or compressed, like a stone or a chair.
statements.tl: Ang rigid objects ay matigas at hindi madaling baluktutin, baguhin ang hugis, o siksikin, tulad ng bato o upuan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UCI7b9j81myy50SsqUYKBVVj_7bUwGz0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Soft objects can be easily bent, deformed, or compressed, like a sponge, bread, or cloth.
statements.tl: Ang soft objects ay madaling baluktutin, baguhin ang hugis, o siksikin, tulad ng sponge, tinapay, o tela.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UCI7b9j81myy50SsqUYKBVVj_7bUwGz0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A great record for a shape-change test is a table! It needs columns for the object, shape before, force used, and shape after.
statements.tl: Magandang tala para sa pagsubok ng pagbabago ng hugis ang talahanayan! Kailangan nito ng mga kolum para sa bagay, hugis bago subukan, puwersang ginamit, at hugis pagkatapos.

statements.text: A hand lens helps learners see tiny dents or bends that appear on a soft object after just a gentle push!
statements.tl: Ang hand lens ay tumutulong sa mga learners na makita ang maliliit na dents o bends na lumilitaw sa soft object pagkatapos ng gentle push!

statements.text: Before testing, sort your objects into rigid and soft groups! Then, guess which group will change shape more easily.
statements.tl: Bago mag-test, pagbukod-bukod muna ng mga bagay sa rigid at soft na grupo! Hulaan kung alin ang mas madaling magbago ng hugis.

statements.text: For a shape-change test, a class follows the steps in order: look at the object, press it, look again, and write down the change!
statements.tl: Para sa shape-change test, sinusunod ng klase ang mga hakbang: tingnan ang bagay, pindutin ito, tingnan ulit, at isulat ang nabago!

statements.text: We can classify objects as rigid or soft by observing their physical characteristics. A chair and a floor are rigid, while cotton and cloth are soft.
statements.tl: Maaari nating uriin ang mga bagay bilang rigid o soft sa pamamagitan ng pagmamasid sa kanilang physical na katangian. Ang upuan at sahig ay rigid, habang ang bulak at tela ay soft.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Few1mrc1EHKyGtW6iC7BKVgL5CyRCTxD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Modeling clay and dough are easily pressed because they are soft and can be squashed into new shapes with your hands.
statements.tl: Ang modeling clay at dough ay madaling mapisil dahil malambot ang mga ito at kayang mapisil sa mga bagong hugis gamit ang iyong mga kamay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1mnq6jOf3nknatwHDVPG05iie8PTX-ZSU), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do truss bridges use steel triangles?

Triangles are rigid shapes that resist changing form! This gives the steel bridge amazing strength and stability.
statements.tl:
Bakit gumagamit ng mga tatsulok na asero ang truss bridge?

Ang tatsulok ay matibay na hugis na hindi madaling magbago ng hugis! Kaya nagbibigay ito ng lakas at katatagan sa tulay.

statements.text:
How do we make a fair test for shape change?

Keep the pushing force the same and only change the object being pressed! This way, the results really compare the objects fairly.
statements.tl:
Paano tayo gumagawa ng fair test para sa shape change?

Panatilihin ang pushing force na pareho at palitan lang ang object na pinipisil! Sa ganitong paraan, talagang patas ang pagkumpara ng mga results.

statements.text:
How can we measure how much a soft object squashes?

Place the object on a flat table! Then, use a ruler to record its height before and after pressing to see the squashed height.
statements.tl:
Paano natin masusukat kung gaano kalaki ang pagka-squash ng isang soft object?

Ilagay ang object sa flat table! Pagkatapos, gumamit ng ruler para i-record ang height nito bago at pagkatapos pindutin para makita ang squashed height.

statements.text:
What do learners do first in a guided shape-change activity?

First, they predict which objects will change shape! Then, they test each one to check if their prediction was right.
statements.tl:
Ano ang unang ginagawa ng mga learners sa isang guided shape-change activity?

Una, hinuhulaan nila kung aling objects ang magbabago ng shape! Pagkatapos, susubukan nila ang bawat isa para i-check kung tama ang prediction.

statements.text: A spring scale lets the class apply the exact same measured force to different objects, keeping the shape-change test fair for everyone!
statements.tl: Ang spring scale ay nagpapahintulot sa klase na mag-apply ng parehong measured force sa iba't ibang objects, kaya nananatiling fair ang shape-change test!

statements.text: To tell elastic from permanent change, press an object once and release it! Watch closely to see if it springs back to its first shape.
statements.tl: Para malaman kung elastic o permanent ang change, pindutin ang object nang isang beses at bitawan ito! Panoorin kung babalik ba ito sa first shape.

statements.text:
Want to see exactly where a soft object bends?

Draw a straight line on it first! When you apply force, the line shows exactly where the shape changes.
statements.tl:
Gusto mo bang makita kung saan eksaktong nababaluktot ang malambot na bagay?

Guhitan mo muna ng tuwid na linya! Kapag nilagyan ng puwersa, ipapakita ng linya kung saan eksaktong nagbago ang hugis.

statements.text:
How can you see clearly how an object's shape changes after a push?

Draw its outline before and after the push! This gives you a clear picture of the shape change.
statements.tl:
Paano mo malilinaw na makikita kung paano nagbago ang hugis ng bagay pagkatapos itulak?

Iguhit ang outline nito bago at pagkatapos itulak! Makakakuha ka ng malinaw na larawan ng pagbabago ng hugis.

statements.text:
How do you know if a spring returns to its original length?

Use a ruler to measure its length when relaxed, stretched, and released! This shows if it goes back to its first length.
statements.tl:
Paano mo malalaman kung bumabalik ba ang spring sa orihinal niyang haba?

Gamitin ang ruler para sukatin ang haba nito nang nakarelax, nakaunat, at binitawan! Makikita mo kung bumabalik ba ito sa unang haba.

statements.text:
What is the easiest way to see which materials are soft and which are rigid?

Make a bar chart of how much each object changed shape! It makes comparing soft and rigid materials super easy.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pinakamadaling paraan para makita kung aling materyales ang soft at alin ang rigid?

Gumawa ng bar chart kung gaano kalaki ang pagbabago ng hugis ng bawat bagay! Mas madali mong makikita kung alin ang soft at rigid.

statements.text: Solid materials can be changed by cutting, tearing, folding, twisting, bending, stretching, and pressing.
statements.tl: Ang mga solid material ay maaaring baguhin sa pamamagitan ng pag-cut, pagpunit, pagtupi, pagpilipit, pag-bend, pag-unat, at pag-press.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15YqrU486yo6zzoeAZOHYk_gxYTHef07U), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Pulling the ends of a rubber band apart applies a stretching force that makes the band longer and thinner.
statements.tl: Ang paghila sa magkabilang dulo ng rubber band palayo sa isa't isa ay naglalapat ng stretching force na nagpapahaba at nagpapanipis dito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1NnWebsLQumPaI6KvmoBPqDTJ98ttKqEr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you bend a piece of clay, you apply force that changes its shape by folding or curving it without breaking it apart.
statements.tl: Kapag binaluktot mo ang isang piraso ng clay, naglalapat ka ng force na nagbabago sa hugis nito sa pamamagitan ng pagtiklop o pagkurba nang hindi ito napuputol.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1NnWebsLQumPaI6KvmoBPqDTJ98ttKqEr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you squeeze clay with your hands, the force changes its shape, making it flat or forming a new figure.
statements.tl: Kapag pinisil mo ang clay gamit ang iyong mga kamay, binabago ng force ang hugis nito, kaya ito ay pumapatag o nagkakaroon ng bagong anyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1cJMpfTKPT3HCec6tU1xv0x3sVn_cFoSs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Stretching a rubber band or a spring uses a pulling force that makes the object longer without breaking it.
statements.tl: Ang pag-unat ng rubber band o spring ay gumagamit ng pulling force na nagpapahaba sa bagay nang hindi ito napipigtas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1cJMpfTKPT3HCec6tU1xv0x3sVn_cFoSs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Bending a piece of clay or a soft wire changes its shape by curving it without cutting or breaking it.
statements.tl: Ang pagbaluktot ng clay o malambot na wire ay nagbabago ng hugis nito sa pamamagitan ng pagkurba nang hindi pinuputol o binabali.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1cJMpfTKPT3HCec6tU1xv0x3sVn_cFoSs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A stretched rubber band stores elastic potential energy. When released within its elastic limit, it returns toward its original shape. This ability to recover its shape is called elasticity.
statements.tl: Nag-iimbak ng elastic potential energy ang inunat na goma. Kapag binitiwan sa loob ng elastic limit nito, bumabalik ito sa dating hugis. Elasticity ang kakayahang ito na bumalik sa dating hugis.

statements.text: Bending is a physical change because only the physical appearance of the material changes, and no new material is formed.
statements.tl: Ang pagbaluktot ay isang physical change dahil ang physical na anyo lamang ng material ang nagbabago, at walang bagong material na nabubuo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 107ehSDo68VuI9KEikJ0uVgelAoRqvCcg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Rubber slippers can bend easily when you walk, changing their shape a little with every step.
statements.tl: Ang rubber slippers ay madaling ma-bend kapag naglalakad ka, nagbabago nang kaunti ang hugis nito sa bawat hakbang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15YqrU486yo6zzoeAZOHYk_gxYTHef07U), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Rubber slippers are flexible and elastic, so they can bend with your feet and return to their shape after every step.
statements.tl: Ang rubber slippers ay flexible at elastic, kaya kaya nitong yumuko kasama ng iyong mga paa at bumalik sa dating hugis pagkatapos ng bawat hakbang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1F3bvG5Br6uwLIMJtaWuD9H3HxFctilIs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Soft objects like clay and rubber bands change shape when you apply force, such as squeezing, stretching, or bending them.
statements.tl: Ang malalambot na bagay tulad ng clay at rubber band ay nagbabago ng hugis kapag nilalapatan mo ng force, gaya ng pagpisil, pag-unat, o pagbaluktot sa mga ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1NnWebsLQumPaI6KvmoBPqDTJ98ttKqEr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you squeeze a soft rubber ball or stretch a rubber band, the force changes the object's shape and size.
statements.tl: Kapag pinisil mo ang malambot na rubber ball o iniunat ang rubber band, binabago ng force ang hugis at sukat ng bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TUjnIi4TLNx1MqEM0WYuZvlEJ-Ri6f35), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Wood has flexibility, the ability to bend without breaking, which is why thin strips of wood can be curved to make furniture like chairs.
statements.tl: Ang kahoy ay may flexibility, ang kakayahang yumuko nang hindi nababali, kaya ang manipis na piraso ng kahoy ay maaaring hubugin para makagawa ng muwebles tulad ng upuan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p03nwfCVZwgxLNP9rxHLrvU4hTVB0xWW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Bending solid materials like steel bars is useful in construction, helping build strong houses and buildings.
statements.tl: Ang pagbaluktot sa solid materials tulad ng steel bars ay kapaki-pakinabang sa construction, nakatutulong ito sa paggawa ng matitibay na bahay at gusali.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-18738), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Stretching pulls an object to make it longer or wider, like pulling a rubber band to make it bigger.
statements.tl: Ang pag-stretch ay paghila sa isang bagay para humaba o lumapad ito, tulad ng paghila sa rubber band para lumaki ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-25236), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does it mean to bend a solid material?

Bending forces a material from a straight form into a curved or angular form, like bending a wire into a hook.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng pag-bend ng solid material?

Ang pag-bend ay pagpupwersa sa isang material mula sa tuwid na anyo para maging kurbado o angular, tulad ng pagbebend ng wire para maging hook.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-25236), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Bending changes the size and shape of solid materials, but it does not form a new material.
statements.tl: Ang pag-bend ay nagbabago sa sukat at hugis ng solid materials, pero hindi ito bumubuo ng bagong material.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-25236), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A toothbrush handle is made of plastic that is flexible enough to bend a little without breaking.
statements.tl: Ang hawakan ng toothbrush ay gawa sa plastic na sapat ang flexibility para ma-bend nang kaunti nang hindi nababali.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-25236), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Distance tells you how far an object travels, and you can measure it using a ruler, a meter stick, or a tape measure.
statements.tl: Sinasabi ng distance kung gaano kalayo ang nilakbay ng isang bagay, at masusukat mo ito gamit ang ruler, meter stick, o tape measure.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 14zw_95rYNthk6chR26KgUV038PuASAlA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A digital clock tells the time of day, while a stopwatch measures how many seconds an event lasts, like a classmate walking across the room.
statements.tl: Ang digital clock ay nagsasabi ng oras ng araw, habang ang stopwatch ay sumusukat kung ilang segundo tumatagal ang isang pangyayari, tulad ng paglalakad ng kaklase sa buong silid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zRw0X_WQRBNC-ueq3sC-QBf9lK-HCEUa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Distance is measured using simple tools like a ruler for short lengths or a meterstick for longer ones.
statements.tl: Ang distance ay sinusukat gamit ang mga simpleng tools tulad ng ruler para sa maiikling haba o meterstick para sa mas mahahabang haba.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-20381), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What units do we use to measure distance?

We measure distance in units such as meters and kilometers!
statements.tl:
Sa anong yunit natin sinusukat ang distansya?

Sinusukat natin ang distansya sa mga yunit tulad ng metro at kilometro!

statements.text: We measure time in units such as seconds, minutes, and hours! Tick-tock!
statements.tl: Sinusukat natin ang oras sa mga yunit tulad ng segundo, minuto, at oras!

statements.text: Length can be measured in many metric units, including millimeters, centimeters, decimeters, meters, and kilometers, depending on the size of the object or distance.
statements.tl: Ang length ay maaaring sukatin sa maraming metric unit, kabilang ang millimeters, centimeters, decimeters, meters, at kilometers, depende sa laki ng bagay o distansya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18JhqAzYFZar9YfM9vODOjZCyyRtDDKnP), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In science, motion is described accurately by two important quantities: the distance travelled and the time of travel.
statements.tl: Sa science, ang motion ay inilalarawan nang tama gamit ang dalawang mahalagang bagay: ang distansiyang nilakbay at ang oras ng paglalakbay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-20381), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Which animal migrates the farthest each year?

The Arctic tern wins! It flies about 70,000 kilometers every year, traveling all the way between the Arctic and Antarctic.
statements.tl:
Aling hayop ang may pinakamahabang paglipat bawat taon?

Ang Arctic tern! Lumilipad ito ng mga 70,000 kilometro bawat taon, mula Arctic hanggang Antarctic.

statements.text:
How do we measure how long something takes to move?

We use a stopwatch or clock to measure exactly how long it takes to move!
statements.tl:
Paano natin susukatin kung gaano katagal gumalaw ang isang bagay?

Gumagamit tayo ng stopwatch o orasan para sukatin kung gaano katagal itong gumalaw!

statements.text:
How do we find out how fast something runs?

We use a stopwatch! It measures time in seconds to see how fast an object moves.
statements.tl:
Paano natin malalaman kung gaano kabilis tumakbo ang isang bagay?

Gumagamit tayo ng stopwatch! Sumusukat ito ng oras sa segundo para malaman kung gaano kabilis gumalaw.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable consensus; NRC PS2.A (measuring motion, speed = distance/time)

statements.text:
How can you tell how far away lightning is?

Since sound is slower, every 3 seconds between the lightning flash and thunder means it's about 1 kilometer away!
statements.tl:
Paano mo malalaman kung gaano kalayo ang kidlat?

Dahil mas mabagal ang tunog, bawat 3 seconds sa pagitan ng kidlat at kulog ay katumbas ng halos 1 kilometrong layo!

statements.text:
What is Usain Bolt's 100-meter world record?

Usain Bolt's 100-meter world record is 9.58 seconds, which was set in 2009!
statements.tl:
Ano ang 100-meter world record ni Usain Bolt?

Ang 100-meter world record ni Usain Bolt ay 9.58 seconds, na itinakda noong 2009!

statements.text:
How do we measure speed in the SI system?

The SI unit of speed is the meter per second, and its symbol is m/s!
statements.tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang bilis (speed) sa SI?

Ang yunit ng bilis (speed) sa SI ay metro kada segundo, at ang simbolo nito ay m/s!

statements.text:
How do we know exactly how fast someone runs in a race?

We use a stopwatch! It's a clock that measures how long something takes — like counting seconds in a race — to tell us how fast or slow it is.
statements.tl:
Paano natin malalaman kung gaano kabilis tumakbo ang isang tao sa karera?

Gumagamit tayo ng stopwatch! Ito ay orasan na sumusukat kung gaano katagal ang isang bagay — tulad ng bilang ng segundo sa takbuhan — para malaman kung gaano kabilis o kabagal.
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 9C; DepEd G4 motion and measurement

statements.text: Count the seconds from lightning to thunder, then divide by 3. Every 3 seconds means the lightning is about 1 kilometer away!
statements.tl: Bilangin ang mga segundo mula kidlat hanggang kulog, tapos hatiin sa 3. Bawat 3 segundo, mga 1 kilometro ang layo ng kidlat!

statements.text:
What is the deepest part of our ocean?

The Mariana Trench in the Pacific Ocean is the deepest part, reaching the Challenger Deep at almost 11 kilometers deep!
statements.tl:
