statements.text: You can roll an empty can across a table using only a charged balloon, because the balloon's charge pulls on the can's charges without touching it.
statements.tl: Maaari mong pagulungin ang isang empty can sa mesa gamit lamang ang charged balloon, dahil hinihila ng charge ng balloon ang mga charge sa lata nang hindi ito hinahawakan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1HWbyV8nW8P0PADW_zQ0p-orx19z-vGHi), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A neutral electroscope touched with a negatively charged rod becomes negatively charged after the rod is removed.
statements.tl: Ang isang neutral electroscope na hinawakan ng isang negatively charged rod ay nagiging negatively charged pagkatapos alisin ang rod.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jvBT9OYJ-poYyAvXpaUmAAk3OM5_ZPsi), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Rubbing a balloon on your hair builds static electricity to stick it to a wall! This force comes from tiny electric charges, not the air inside.
statements.tl: Kapag kinuskos ang lobo sa buhok, nagkakaroon ito ng static electricity para dumikit sa dingding! Galing ito sa maliliit na electric charges, hindi sa hangin sa loob.

statements.text: Hair conditioner contains positively charged (cationic) compounds! These are attracted to negatively charged hair, smoothing the surface and reducing static electricity.
statements.tl: Ang hair conditioner ay naglalaman ng positively charged (cationic) compounds! Naakit ang mga ito sa negatively charged na buhok, na nagpapakinis at nagpapababa ng static electricity.

statements.text:
What makes static electricity?

Static electricity appears when two things rub together, building up electric charge that can pull at hair or bits of paper!
statements.tl:
Paano lumilitaw ang static na kuryente?

Lumilitaw ito kapag nagkiskisan ang dalawang bagay, naipon ang karga na pwedeng humila ng buhok o papel!

statements.text:
How do electric charges interact?

There are two kinds of electric charge, positive and negative; like charges repel each other and opposite charges attract!
statements.tl:
Paano nagtutugon ang mga elektrikal na karga?

May dalawang uri: positibo at negatibo. Ang magkaparehong karga ay nagtataboy, at ang magkasalungat ay umaakit!

statements.text:
How does an object get an electric charge?

An object becomes negatively charged when it gains extra electrons and positively charged when it loses electrons!
statements.tl:
Paano nagkakaroon ng charge ang isang bagay?

Nagiging negatibo ito kapag nakakuha ng dagdag na elektron, at positibo kapag nawalan ng elektron!

statements.text: Static electricity builds up when objects rub together and tiny charges move. This stored charge stays on the surface, making it 'static' or still!
statements.tl: Nabubuo ang static electricity kapag nagkiskis ang mga bagay at lumilipat ang maliliit na charge. Nananatili ito sa ibabaw, kaya 'static' o nakatigil!

statements.text: Static charge comes from moving tiny particles called electrons. When objects rub, one loses electrons (positive) and the other gains them (negative)!
statements.tl: Ang static charge ay galing sa paglipat ng maliliit na particles na electrons. Kapag nagkiskis, ang isa ay nawawalan (positibo) at ang isa ay nadadagdagan (negatibo)!

statements.text: Rubbing a balloon on your hair gives it a static charge, making it stick to walls or make your hair stand up—a safe everyday static electricity trick!
statements.tl: Kapag kinuskos mo ang lobo sa buhok mo, nakakakuha ito ng static charge para dumikit sa dingding o magpatayo ng buhok—isang ligtas na halimbawa ng static electricity!

statements.text: A spark happens when built-up static charge suddenly jumps between objects, sometimes crossing the air! This quick movement of charge is called a discharge.
statements.tl: Ang spark ay nangyayari kapag biglang lumukso ang naipong static charge sa pagitan ng mga bagay, kahit tumatawid sa hangin! Itong mabilis na paglipat ay tinatawag na discharge.

statements.text:
Why do clothes sometimes cling to each other or your skin?

Fabrics rub together in the dryer or while worn, building up a static charge that makes them stick together!
statements.tl:
Bakit minsan dumidikit ang damit sa isa't isa o sa balat?

Nagkikiskisan ang tela sa dryer o habang isinusuot, kaya nakakaipon ng static charge na nagpapadikit sa kanila!

statements.text:
How does the water cycle work?

In the water cycle, water evaporates from the sea, condenses into clouds, and falls back down as rain!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagana ang siklo ng tubig?

Sa siklo ng tubig, sumisingaw ang tubig mula sa dagat, namumuo bilang ulap, at bumabalik sa atin bilang ulan!

statements.text: Rain from the water cycle refills dams like Angat! This supplies fresh drinking water to Manila.
statements.tl: Ang ulan mula sa siklo ng tubig ang nagpupuno sa mga dam tulad ng Angat! Nagbibigay ito ng tubig-inumin sa Maynila.

statements.text:
Where does a pond's water come from?

A pond fills up with water from rain, streams, and water that flows down from the land.
statements.tl:
Saan nanggagaling ang tubig ng lawa?

Napupuno ang lawa ng tubig mula sa ulan, sapa, at tubig na dumadaloy mula sa lupa.

statements.text:
How does a sealed terrarium reuse its own water?

Inside, plants release oxygen and water vapor that condenses back into water — so the terrarium recycles its own air and water with almost nothing added!
statements.tl:
Paano nire-recycle ng saradong terrarium ang sarili nitong tubig?

Naglalabas ng oxygen at singaw ng tubig ang mga halaman sa loob, na muling nagiging tubig — kaya nagre-recycle ito ng sarili nitong hangin at tubig nang halos walang dagdag!
statements.source: NRC LS2.B; AAAS Benchmarks 5D (cycling of matter); encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
Can cutting down forests really change the rain?

Yes — trees release huge amounts of moisture into the air through transpiration, so cutting down forests can lower how much it rains locally!
statements.tl:
Nakaka-apekto ba talaga sa ulan ang pagputol ng puno?

Oo — ang mga puno ay naglalabas ng napakaraming halumigmig sa hangin sa pamamagitan ng transpiration, kaya ang pagputol ng kagubatan ay maaaring magpababa ng lokal na pag-ulan!

statements.text: Transpiration adds water vapor to the air, making it part of the water cycle.
statements.tl: Nagdaragdag ng singaw ng tubig sa hangin ang transpirasyon, kaya bahagi ito ng siklo ng tubig.

statements.text:
Why is ocean water salty?

For millions of years, rain has slowly dissolved minerals from rocks on land, and rivers carried them to the sea — the salt built up as the water evaporated.
statements.tl:
Bakit maalat ang tubig ng dagat?

Sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon, unti-unting nilulusaw ng ulan ang mga mineral mula sa mga bato sa lupa, at dinadala ito ng mga ilog patungo sa dagat — naiipon ang asin habang sumisingaw ang tubig.

statements.text: Distillation is just like nature's water cycle! Water evaporates, forms clouds, and falls back down as rain.
statements.tl: Ang distillation ay parang siklo ng tubig sa kalikasan! Ang tubig ay sumisingaw, lumilikha ng ulap, at bumabagsak bilang ulan.

statements.text: Rain forms when condensed water droplets in clouds grow large enough to fall!
statements.tl: Nabubuo ang ulan kapag lumalaki nang sapat ang mga patak ng tubig na namuo sa ulap upang mahulog!

statements.text:
How do clouds make rain?

Inside clouds, tiny water droplets hug and join together until they grow heavy enough to fall down as rain!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng ulan ang mga ulap?

Sa loob ng ulap, nagsasama-sama ang maliliit na patak hanggang sa bumigat ang mga ito at bumagsak bilang ulan!

statements.text:
How does plastic on land end up in the sea?

Plastic thrown on land is often washed by rain into rivers and finally reaches the sea!
statements.tl:
Paano napupunta sa dagat ang plastic na itinapon sa lupa?

Ang plastic na itinapon sa lupa ay madalas naaanod ng ulan papunta sa ilog at sa wakas ay umaabot sa dagat!

statements.text: Frost is part of the water cycle! Water vapor freezes into frost on cold surfaces. When it warms up, it melts or turns back into vapor, moving through its different forms!
statements.tl: Bahagi ng water cycle ang frost! Nag-freeze ang water vapor sa malamig na ibabaw. Kapag uminit, natutunaw ito o nagiging singaw ulit, gumagalaw sa iba't ibang anyo!

statements.text:
Does water vapor become rain directly in the Philippine water cycle?

It first forms tiny cloud droplets, and ice crystals can also form high in cold clouds. Most precipitation reaches the ground as rain, though hail sometimes falls!
statements.tl:
Direkta bang nagiging ulan ang singaw sa siklo ng tubig sa Pilipinas?

Nabubuo muna ang maliliit na patak sa ulap, at maaari ring mabuo ang kristal ng yelo sa matataas at malamig na ulap. Kadalasang ulan ang umaabot sa lupa, pero may graniso rin kung minsan!

statements.text: Clouds form when water vapour rises to cooler altitudes and condenses into tiny water droplets. These droplets make up the cloud!
statements.tl: Nabubuo ang mga ulap kapag umaahon ang water vapour sa mas malamig na altitudes at nagko-condense sa maliliit na patak ng tubig!

statements.text: In the water cycle, rising water vapour condenses in the cooler upper atmosphere to form clouds, which then produce rain that falls back to the ground!
statements.tl: Sa water cycle, ang umaahon na water vapour ay nag-co-condense sa malamig na atmospera para mabuo ang ulap, na nagbibigay ng ulan na babalik sa lupa!

statements.text:
How do clouds form in the water cycle?

Condensation is the water cycle stage where cooling water vapor in the atmosphere changes back into liquid water droplets to form clouds!
statements.tl:
Paano nabubuo ang mga ulap sa water cycle?

Ang condensation ay yugto ng water cycle kung saan ang malamig na water vapor sa atmospera ay nagiging likidong patak muli para bumuo ng mga ulap!

statements.text:
Did you know the sun secretly powers almost all renewable energy?

The sun's heat stirs up wind for wind power, and evaporates water that returns as rain to fill the dams!
statements.tl:
Alam mo bang ang araw ang lihim na pinagmulan ng halos lahat ng renewable energy?

Ang init ng araw ang gumagawa ng hangin para sa wind power, at nagpapasingaw ng tubig na bumabalik bilang ulan para punuin ang mga dam!

statements.text: Hydropower is renewable! Rain and the water cycle keep refilling the dam's reservoir after the water flows out to make electricity.
statements.tl: Renewable ang hydropower! Ang ulan at water cycle ay patuloy na nagpupuno sa reservoir ng dam pagkatapos dumaloy palabas ang tubig.

statements.text:
How does a simple bag show the water cycle?

In a water-cycle-in-a-bag experiment, the Sun's heat evaporates the water, and the vapor condenses on the cool sides to trickle down like real rain!
statements.tl:
Paano ipinapakita ng simpleng supot ang water cycle?

Sa water-cycle-in-a-bag experiment, pinapasingaw ng init ng araw ang tubig, at ang singaw ay namumuo sa malalamig na bahagi upang tumulo parang tunay na ulan!

statements.text: The water cycle has four main stages: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection, each moving water in a different way.
statements.tl: Ang water cycle ay may apat na pangunahing yugto: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, at collection, na bawat isa ay nagpapagalaw sa tubig sa iba't ibang paraan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1DJHlf197qWUf2m4GkFmPb7-OcHpSRaRB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A sealed plastic bag with water, sand, and a rock placed in the sun can show evaporation and condensation, just like the water cycle on Earth.
statements.tl: Ang isang selyadong plastic bag na may tubig, buhangin, at bato na inilagay sa araw ay maaaring magpakita ng evaporation at condensation, tulad ng water cycle sa mundo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1DJHlf197qWUf2m4GkFmPb7-OcHpSRaRB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A water cycle model placed in sunlight shows more evaporation and condensation than one kept in the shade.
statements.tl: Ang modelo ng water cycle na nakalagay sa sikat ng araw ay nagpapakita ng mas maraming evaporation at condensation kaysa sa modelong nasa lilim.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ft1xL_dsc0eFe6HzkdlcvTfNEMeJLGIf), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In the water cycle, evaporation turns water into vapor, condensation turns vapor into clouds, and precipitation brings rain down!
statements.tl: Sa water cycle, ginagawang singaw ng evaporation ang tubig, ginagawang ulap ng condensation ang singaw, at pinababagsak ng precipitation ang ulan!

statements.text:
Why must a water cycle model be sealed tight?

Sealing it keeps the same water cycling inside, showing that Earth's water is a closed system!
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangang nakasarado ang modelo ng water cycle?

Pagsasarado ito para paulit-ulit na umiikot ang parehong tubig, na nagpapakita na ang tubig ng Earth ay isang closed system!

statements.text: Using a shallow dish with a wide mouth increases the surface area, making evaporation happen faster and easier to observe!
statements.tl: Ang paggamit ng mababaw na plato na may malapad na bibig ay nagpapalaki ng surface area, kaya mas mabilis ang evaporation at mas madaling obserbahan!

statements.text:
How can we make condensation visible in a model?

Place clear plastic wrap with ice cubes on top! The cold surface makes the vapor turn back to liquid droplets.
statements.tl:
Paano natin makikita ang condensation sa isang modelo?

Maglagay ng malinaw na plastic wrap na may ice cubes sa itaas! Ginagawa nitong patak na likido ang vapor.

statements.text: Sloping the plastic wrap makes condensed drops run to one corner and fall, mimicking real precipitation!
statements.tl: Ang pagtagilid ng plastic wrap ay nagpapadaloy ng mga patak sa isang sulok at bumabagsak, na ginagaya ang tunay na precipitation!

statements.text:
How do we measure evaporation in a model?

Mark the water level on the container with a marker, then measure the drop each hour with a ruler!
statements.tl:
Paano natin susukatin ang evaporation sa modelo?

Markahan ang lebel ng tubig sa lalagyan gamit ang marker, at sukatin ang pagbaba nito bawat oras gamit ang ruler!

statements.text:
How do we do a fair test on a water cycle model?

Change only the heat source, like a lamp versus shade! Keep the water amount and container exactly the same.
statements.tl:
Paano tayo gagawa ng fair test sa modelo ng water cycle?

Baguhin lang ang pinagmumulan ng init, tulad ng lamp kumpara sa lilim! Panatilihing pareho ang dami ng tubig at lalagyan.

statements.text:
What does a line graph of water level over time tell us?

A steady downward slope means evaporation is happening at a constant rate!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ipinapakita ng line graph ng lebel ng tubig sa paglipas ng panahon?

Ang tuloy-tuloy na pababang linya ay nangangahulugang ang evaporation ay nangyayari sa pare-parehong bilis!

statements.text: To build a water cycle model: add water, seal the container, put it in the sun, wait, then observe and record the changes!
statements.tl: Sa paggawa ng water cycle model: maglagay ng tubig, isara ang lalagyan, ilagay sa araw, maghintay, tapos obserbahan at itala ang mga pagbabago!

statements.text: A lamp can replace the Sun in your water cycle model! Just place it at a safe distance to warm the water without melting the plastic.
statements.tl: Pwede mong palitan ng lampara ang Sun sa water cycle model! Ilagay lang ito sa ligtas na distansya para uminit ang tubig nang hindi natutunaw ang plastic.

statements.text:
Why use a closed container for your water cycle model?

An open container loses water vapor to the air, missing the full cycle. A closed one recycles all the water!
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangang sarado ang lalagyan sa water cycle model?

Ang bukas na lalagyan ay nawawalan ng water vapor sa hangin, kaya hindi kumpleto ang cycle. Ang sarado naman ay inuulit ang lahat ng tubig!

statements.text:
Why add sand and a rock to your model?

Adding them mimics the ground where water collects, helping you clearly see the collection stage of the water cycle!
statements.tl:
Bakit maglalagay ng buhangin at bato sa modelo?

Ginagaya nito ang lupa kung saan naiipon ang tubig, na tumutulong ipakita ang collection stage ng water cycle!

statements.text: Make your model awesome by adding labels for evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection so everyone can see each process clearly!
statements.tl: Gawing astig ang modelo mo sa paglalagay ng labels para sa evaporation, condensation, precipitation, at collection para makita nang malinaw ang bawat proseso!

statements.text:
How do you make a fair test for your model?

Keep the amount of water, container size, and wrap type the same. Only change the heat for a fair test!
statements.tl:
Paano gumawa ng fair test para sa modelo?

Panatilihing pareho ang dami ng tubig, laki ng lalagyan, at uri ng pambalot. Ang init lang ang babaguhin para sa fair test!

statements.text: A flood is simply water that covers land which is usually dry!
statements.tl: Ang baha ay tubig na tumatabon sa lupang karaniwang tuyo!

statements.text:
Can a typhoon change how many animals an area can support?

Yes, because a typhoon can destroy food and shelter, which lowers the carrying capacity, so the ecosystem can support fewer organisms.
statements.tl:
Maaari bang baguhin ng bagyo kung gaano karaming hayop ang kayang suportahan ng isang lugar?

Oo, dahil kayang sirain ng bagyo ang pagkain at shelter, na nagpapababa sa carrying capacity, kaya mas kaunting organismo na ang kayang suportahan ng ecosystem.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UiuKKBB4tA64TmCnG3huY6iD6IlDjqmg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Typhoons like Typhoon Ulysses can destroy homes, flood large areas, and damage the habitats of many organisms in places like Cagayan Valley and Central Luzon.
statements.tl: Ang mga bagyo tulad ng Typhoon Ulysses ay maaaring sumira ng mga tahanan, bumaha sa malalawak na lugar, at makasira sa mga tirahan ng maraming organismo sa mga lugar tulad ng Cagayan Valley at Central Luzon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YAktm1Kl8QiPMQM60mTuzEUjZhFWK0nF), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Tropical cyclones bring heavy rains, flooding, strong winds, casualties, and destruction to crops and properties.
statements.tl: Ang mga tropical cyclone ay nagdadala ng malakas na ulan, pagbaha, malakas na hangin, pinsala sa buhay, at pagkasira ng mga pananim at ari-arian.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1i5vRVxrZ3XW-EE-wu8mS3ImblRLLKfqO), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A tropical cyclone can bring strong winds, flooding, landslides, storm surge, and even epidemics, which are outbreaks of disease.
statements.tl: Ang tropical cyclone ay maaaring magdala ng malakas na hangin, pagbaha, landslides, storm surge, at maging epidemics, na mga paglaganap ng sakit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1juOZ4ZBxhJg6zHNzmr1XaltJn-RGyrMR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Typhoons can damage power lines, communication lines, roads, bridges, and crops, which causes food shortages.
statements.tl: Maaaring sirain ng bagyo ang mga linya ng kuryente, linya ng komunikasyon, kalsada, tulay, at pananim, na nagdudulot ng kakulangan sa pagkain.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-16352), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: After a typhoon, check the damaged parts of your house and have them repaired, replacing them if necessary.
statements.tl: Pagkatapos ng bagyo, tingnan ang mga nasirang bahagi ng bahay at ipaayos, palitan kung kinakailangan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-16352), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Typhoons can damage roads and bridges due to heavy rainfall and flooding, making it hard for people to travel.
statements.tl: Maaaring masira ng bagyo ang mga kalsada at tulay dahil sa malakas na ulan at pagbaha, kaya mahirap maglakbay ang mga tao.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-16352), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: More Filipinos catch leptospirosis during rainy season and floods, so be extra careful when the water rises.
statements.tl: Mas maraming Pilipino ang nagkakasakit ng leptospirosis kapag tag-ulan at may baha, kaya mag-ingat kapag tumataas ang tubig.

statements.text: A low pressure area often brings clouds, rain, and storms! That is why PAGASA always watches out for a low pressure area.
statements.tl: Ang isang low pressure area ay madalas nagdadala ng ulap, ulan, at bagyo! Kaya laging binabantayan ito ng PAGASA.

statements.text:
Why can typhoons blow roofs right off?

Fast wind flowing over a roof creates upward lift. Poorly fastened roofs can be blown off by this upward force!
statements.tl:
Bakit kayang tanggalin ng bagyo ang bubong?

Ang mabilis na hangin sa ibabaw ng bubong ay gumagawa ng pataas na puwersa. Ang mga bubong na hindi maayos ang pagkakakabit ay maaaring matanggal pataas!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; PAGASA; PH context; NRC PS2.A

statements.text: Strong wind isn't the only danger! Heavy rain from typhoons causes floods and landslides, which often harm even more people.
statements.tl: Hindi lang malakas na hangin ang panganib! Ang malakas na ulan ng bagyo ay nagdudulot ng baha at landslide, na kadalasang mas marami pang napapahamak.

statements.text: A strong habagat can bring many days of non-stop rain, which sometimes causes flooding in parts of the Philippines!
statements.tl: Ang malakas na habagat ay maaaring magdala ng maraming araw ng ulan, na minsan nagdudulot ng baha sa ilang bahagi ng Pilipinas!

statements.text:
What happens to the habagat when a typhoon is near?

It gets even stronger! This makes the rain over the Philippines much, much heavier.
statements.tl:
Anong nangyayari sa habagat kapag may malapit na bagyo?

Lumalakas pa ito! Kaya mas tumitindi at nagiging mas mabigat ang ulan sa Pilipinas.

statements.text: Most landslides happen during heavy, long rain! Water soaks into the ground, making it heavy and slippery, so it easily slides downhill.
statements.tl: Karamihan sa landslide ay nangyayari sa malakas at matagal na ulan! Sumisipsip ang tubig sa lupa, ginagawa itong mabigat at madulas, kaya madaling gumuho pababa.

statements.text:
Why does the Philippines often have landslides?

The Philippines is mountainous and hit by many strong typhoons! Steep land plus very heavy rain causes many slides, especially in the Cordillera, Bicol, and Eastern Visayas.
statements.tl:
Bakit madalas magkaroon ng landslide sa Pilipinas?

Ang Pilipinas ay mabundok at madalas tamaan ng malalakas na bagyo! Ang pinagsamang matarik na lupa at sobrang ulan ay nagiging sanhi ng maraming landslide, lalo na sa Cordillera, Bicol, at Eastern Visayas.

statements.text:
Why are landslides so dangerous?

Landslides are very fast and heavy! They can bury houses and villages in just seconds, which is why you must stay away from slide-prone places during heavy rain.
statements.tl:
Bakit napakadelikado ng mga landslide?

Napakabilis at mabigat ng landslide! Kayang-kaya nitong tabunan ang mga bahay at baryo sa loob lang ng ilang segundo, kaya mahalagang lumayo sa madaling guho na lugar.

statements.text: When it rains for a long time, water builds up underground and soaks the whole slope. Wet, heavy, and weak ground is the most dangerous time for a landslide!
statements.tl: Kapag matagal na umuulan, naiipon ang tubig sa ilalim ng lupa hanggang mabasa ang buong dalisdis. Ang mabigat at mahinang lupang puno ng tubig ay pinakadelikadong oras para sa landslide!

statements.text: As the storm signal number goes up, the wind becomes stronger and the possible damage to houses, trees, and power lines becomes greater.
statements.tl: Habang tumataas ang numero ng storm signal, lalong lumalakas ang hangin at lalong lumalaki ang posibleng pinsala sa mga bahay, puno, at linya ng kuryente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1FzobQHAG72btFDbj2VENjqSwUZ4TsXqu), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: During Storm Signal No. 2, some coconut trees may tilt or break, and many nipa and cogon houses may be partially or totally unroofed.
statements.tl: Sa Storm Signal No. 2, ang ilang puno ng niyog ay maaaring tumagilid o mabali, at maraming bahay na nipa at cogon ang maaaring masiraan ng bubong.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dunegsHcUrRtcQx19AlZVm1xSUtkJKDv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Tropical Cyclone Wind Signals are numbered from 1 to 5, with 5 being the strongest and most dangerous.
statements.tl: Ang mga Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal ay may bilang mula 1 hanggang 5, kung saan ang 5 ang pinakamalakas at pinakamapanganib.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1kXbnIJXIvIq3Bro-VZUkscL6Hbx7ISid), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Signal No. 2 means moderately strong storm winds may arrive within about 24 hours, and they can be strong enough to break tree branches!
statements.tl: Ang Signal No. 2 ay nangangahulugang may katamtamang lakas na hangin na maaaring dumating sa loob ng mga 24 oras at maaaring magpabali ng mga sanga ng puno!

statements.text:
What happens when Signal No. 3 is raised?

Signal No. 3 means strong, dangerous storm winds may arrive within about 18 hours, and they can tear off roofs and topple trees!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin kapag nakaangat ang Signal No. 3?

Ang Signal No. 3 ay nangangahulugang may malakas at delikadong hangin na maaaring dumating sa loob ng mga 18 oras, na pwedeng tumanggal ng bubong at magpabagsak ng puno!

statements.text: Signal No. 4 means very strong, destructive storm winds may arrive within about 12 hours and can heavily damage many houses!
statements.tl: Ang Signal No. 4 ay nangangahulugang may napakalakas at nakasisirang hangin na maaaring dumating sa loob ng mga 12 oras at maaaring sumira ng maraming bahay!

statements.text: A tropical cyclone wind signal tells you how strong the wind will be — the faster the wind speed, the higher the signal number that gets raised!
statements.tl: Ang tropical cyclone wind signal ay nagsasabi kung gaano kalakas ang hangin — kapag mas mabilis ang hangin, mas mataas ang signal na itinataas!

statements.text:
How does PAGASA warn us about typhoon winds?

They raise a Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal from No.1 to No.5! The higher the number, the stronger the wind and greater the danger.
statements.tl:
Paano tayo babalaan ng PAGASA tungkol sa hangin ng bagyo?

Naglalabas sila ng Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal mula No.1 hanggang No.5! Mas mataas ang numero, mas malakas ang hangin at mas malaki ang panganib.

statements.text: Signal No.1 is PAGASA's lowest warning! It means strong winds are coming, so it’s the perfect time to start preparing early.
statements.tl: Ang Signal No.1 ang pinakamababang babala ng PAGASA! Nangangahulugan itong may darating na malakas na hangin, kaya panahon na para maghanda nang maaga.

statements.text:
How does PAGASA warn us about strong winds?

PAGASA raises five levels of storm signal, from Signal No. 1 up to Signal No. 5, based on expected wind strength!
statements.tl:
Paano tayo binabalaan ng PAGASA tungkol sa malakas na hangin?

Naglalabas ang PAGASA ng limang antas ng storm signal, mula Signal No. 1 hanggang 5, batay sa inaasahang lakas ng hangin!

statements.text: Signal No. 1 is the lowest warning! It means strong winds from a storm may arrive within about 36 hours.
statements.tl: Ang Signal No. 1 ay ang pinakamababang babala! Ibig sabihin, may malakas na hanging dala ng bagyo na maaaring dumating sa loob ng 36 na oras.

statements.text:
What does Signal No. 5 mean?

It's the highest warning! It means extremely strong super-typhoon winds are coming that can destroy many houses.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng Signal No. 5?

Ito ang pinakamataas na babala! Nangangahulugan ito ng napakalakas na hangin ng super typhoon na maaaring sumira ng maraming bahay.

statements.text:
Who watches out for us when a typhoon is on its way?

PAGASA is the agency that warns the whole country! They use wind signals to tell everyone just how strong the wind will be.
statements.tl:
Sino ang nagbabantay sa atin kapag may paparating na bagyo?

Ang PAGASA ang ahensya na nagbababala sa buong bansa! Gumagamit sila ng wind signals para sabihin kung gaano kalakas ang hangin.
statements.source: PAGASA Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal system; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
How many wind signal levels does PAGASA use for typhoons?

There are five tropical cyclone wind signals, from Signal No. 1 to Signal No. 5. The higher the number, the stronger the wind!
statements.tl:
Ilan ang antas ng wind signal na ginagamit ng PAGASA para sa bagyo?

May limang tropical cyclone wind signal, mula Signal No. 1 hanggang Signal No. 5. Mas mataas ang numero, mas malakas ang hangin!

statements.text: At Signal No. 1, expect winds of 39 to 61 km/h within 36 hours. Time to start preparing and staying safe!
statements.tl: Sa Signal No. 1, inaasahan ang hanging 39 hanggang 61 km/h sa loob ng 36 oras. Panahon na para maghanda at maging ligtas!
statements.source: PAGASA TCWS No. 1 definition (39-61 km/h, 2022); encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: At Signal No. 2, winds of 62 to 88 km/h are expected within 24 hours. Be careful — tree branches may break!
statements.tl: Sa Signal No. 2, inaasahan ang hanging 62 hanggang 88 km/h sa loob ng 24 oras. Mag-ingat — maaaring mabali ang mga sanga ng puno!
statements.source: PAGASA TCWS No. 2 definition (62-88 km/h, 2022); encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
What happens at Signal No. 3?

Winds of 89 to 117 kilometers per hour are expected within 18 hours! Roofs can be torn off and trees toppled.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa Signal No. 3?

May hanging 89 hanggang 117 kilometro kada oras sa loob ng 18 oras! Maaaring matanggal ang mga bubong at mabuwal ang mga puno.
statements.source: PAGASA TCWS No. 3 definition (89-117 km/h, 2022); encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
How strong is Signal No. 4?

Winds of 118 to 184 kilometers per hour are expected within 12 hours, making severe damage to houses likely!
statements.tl:
Gaano kalakas ang Signal No. 4?

May hanging 118 hanggang 184 kilometro kada oras sa loob ng 12 oras, kaya malubha ang maaaring pinsala sa mga bahay!
statements.source: PAGASA TCWS No. 4 definition (118-184 km/h, 2022); encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
What is the weather like during a cyclone?

It can bring very strong, gusty wind! This can break branches, peel roofs, and make walking outdoors totally unsafe.
statements.tl:
Ano ang panahon habang may bagyo?

Maaari itong magdala ng napakalakas at pabugsu-bugsong hangin! Kaya nitong baliin ang mga sanga, tangayin ang mga bubong, at gawing mapanganib ang paglalakad sa labas.

statements.text: Even when the sky looks calmer, floodwater may still stand in streets and fields! The after-weather includes leftover water, not just sunshine.
statements.tl: Pagkatapos humupa ang bagyo, maaaring manatili pa ang tubig sa mga kalye at bukirin, kaya hindi lang araw ang makikita, may naiwang baha pa!

statements.text: After the cyclone, it's messy outside! You'll see fallen branches, mud, and downed lines, even if the wind is lighter.
statements.tl: Pagkatapos ng bagyo, magulo sa labas! Makikita ang nabagsak na sanga, putik, at downed lines, kahit bahagyang hangin pa.

statements.text: Early before-the-storm hours can trick you! One town might look fine, while the cyclone is already wet and windy nearby.
statements.tl: Malilinlang ka sa unang oras bago ang bagyo! Mukhang maayos ang isang bayan, kahit basa at mahangin na sa kabilang lugar.

statements.text:
Why should ordinary people know the parts of a cyclone?

Because if you know the eye is calm but the eyewall is the most dangerous part, you will not go outside during the false calm!
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangang malaman ng ordinaryong tao ang mga bahagi ng bagyo?

Dahil kung alam mong kalmado ang eye pero ang eyewall ang pinakamapanganib na bahagi, hindi ka lalabas sa panahon ng mapanlinlang na katahimikan!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ui7Kx0pIuIjFEShfEQIue6HOTWsJIzev), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: During a typhoon, the sky becomes dark and cloudy, and heavy rainfall comes with strong winds that can uproot trees and crops.
statements.tl: Kapag may bagyo, dumidilim at nagiging maulap ang langit, at may malakas na ulan na may kasamang malakas na hangin na kayang bumunot ng mga puno at pananim.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-16352), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Right at the center of a strong typhoon is the 'eye' — a calm, clear part! But surrounding it is the strongest wind and rain.
statements.tl: Sa gitna ng malakas na bagyo ay may 'mata' — isang tahimik at maaliwalas na bahagi! Pero nakapaligid dito ang pinakamalakas na hangin at ulan.

statements.text: The eye of the storm is the calm, clear center of a typhoon. It has almost no rain or wind!
statements.tl: Ang mata ng bagyo ang tahimik at malinaw na gitna nito. Halos walang ulan o hangin sa loob nito!

statements.text:
What is the eyewall?

The eyewall is the part of the typhoon that has the absolute strongest winds and the heaviest rain!
statements.tl:
Ano ang eyewall?

Ang eyewall ang bahagi ng bagyo na may pinakamalakas na hangin at pinakamabigat na ulan!

statements.text:
Is the eye of the storm completely safe?

The calm is deceptive! Strong winds will quickly return once the other side of the eyewall passes over.
statements.tl:
Ligtas ba talaga sa loob ng mata ng bagyo?

Mapanlinlang ang katahimikan! Babalik agad ang malakas na hangin kapag dumaan na ang kabilang pader ng mata.

statements.text: Inside the eye of the storm, the sky is sometimes clear! You can even see the sun or stars.
statements.tl: Sa loob ng mata ng bagyo, minsan ay malinaw ang langit! Nakikita mo pa ang araw o mga bituin.

statements.text: Air inside the eye slowly sinks down! This dries it out, which is why there are almost no clouds inside the eye.
statements.tl: Ang hangin sa loob ng mata ay dahan-dahang bumababa! Natutuyo ito, kaya halos walang ulap sa loob ng mata ng bagyo.

statements.text: The eyewall is a giant ring of very tall thunderstorm clouds! It brings intense rain and bright lightning.
statements.tl: Ang pader ng mata ay isang singsing ng napakataas na ulap! Nagdadala ito ng matinding pagbuhos ng ulan at maliwanag na kidlat.

statements.text:
What happens when the eye passes over your town?

It stays calm for several minutes to hours! But be careful, the strong winds will rise again soon.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag dumaan ang mata ng bagyo sa inyong lugar?

Tumatahimik ito nang ilang minuto hanggang oras! Pero mag-ingat, muling lalakas ang hangin pagkatapos.

statements.text: The rainbands bring waves of heavy rain, with short pauses in between each wave.
statements.tl: Nagdadala ang rainbands ng sunod-sunod na buhos ng ulan, na may mga sandaling tigil sa pagitan.

statements.text:
What is the eye of a typhoon?

The eye is the calm, quiet center of a typhoon, but the ring of clouds around it has the strongest winds and rain!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mata ng bagyo?

Ang mata ay ang tahimik at kalmadong gitna ng bagyo, ngunit ang paligid nito ang may pinakamalakas na hangin at ulan!

statements.text: Weather stations warn people before a typhoon arrives! When air pressure drops and winds get stronger, scientists know a storm is coming—so people can prepare and evacuate early!
statements.tl: Ang weather station ay nagbabala bago dumating ang bagyo! Kapag bumababa ang presyon ng hangin at lumalakas ang hangin, alam ng mga siyentista na may paparating na bagyo—kaya nakakapaghanda at nakakalikas nang maaga!

statements.text: Right inside the eyewall is the eye of the storm, strangely calm and often sunny! The air sinks instead of rising here, so there are often few clouds, even surrounded by the violent storm.
statements.tl: Sa loob mismo ng eyewall ay ang mata ng bagyo, kakaibang tahimik at maaaraw! Bumababa ang hangin dito sa halip na umakyat, kaya madalas kakaunti ang ulap kahit napapalibutan ito ng malakas na bagyo.

statements.text: From the Sun outward: first come the four rocky planets (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars), then the asteroid belt, then the four giant planets (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune). Rocky first, then giants!
statements.tl: Mula sa Sun palabas: una ang apat na batuhing planeta (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars), sunod ang asteroid belt, tapos ang apat na higanteng planeta (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune). Batuhin muna, higante sa huli!

statements.text:
What's the difference between inner and outer planets?

The four inner planets — Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars — are rocky with solid surfaces. The four outer planets — Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune — are gas or ice giants with no solid ground. The asteroid belt sits between them!
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng inner at outer planets?

Ang inner planets (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars) ay rocky planets na may solid surface. Ang outer planets (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune) ay gas o ice giants na walang solid ground. Ang asteroid belt ang nasa pagitan nila!

statements.text:
Where is the Sun in our solar system?

The Sun is at the center of the solar system, with the planets orbiting around it!
statements.tl:
Nasaan ang Araw sa ating solar system?

Ang Araw ang nasa gitna ng solar system, at umiikot ang mga planeta sa paligid nito!

statements.text: The four inner planets are rocky! These are Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars.
statements.tl: Ang apat na inner planets ay rocky o batuhan! Sila ay Mercury, Venus, Earth, at Mars.

statements.text: An asteroid is made of rock and metal, while a comet is made of ice, dust, and rock!
statements.tl: Ang asteroid ay gawa sa bato at metal, samantalang ang kometa ay gawa sa yelo, alikabok, at bato!

statements.text: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, with an average distance of about 58 million kilometers and a grey color.
statements.tl: Ang Mercury ang pinakamalapit na planeta sa Araw, na may average na layo na mga 58 million kilometers at kulay grey.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BjCstIl7c2MJMi076ps6Q11_L0bEa9t9), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gas giants like Jupiter and Saturn have incredibly dense and powerful atmospheres compared to rocky planets.
statements.tl: Ang mga gas giant tulad ng Jupiter at Saturn ay may napakakapal at napakalakas na atmosphere kumpara sa mga rocky planet.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IT7l4-DlPez1yvusvumepF8cwqd553ZP), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Comets contain frozen gases such as ammonia, methane, and carbon dioxide, along with dust, rock, and metals.
statements.tl: Ang mga kometa ay naglalaman ng mga frozen gas tulad ng ammonia, methane, at carbon dioxide, kasama ang alikabok, bato, at mga metal.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hvK3KZUGBy-bNBaW3hzrp6nkhtOldi3a), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Planets are large, round celestial bodies that travel around the Sun in a path called an orbit.
statements.tl: Ang mga planeta ay malalaki at bilog na celestial body na umiikot sa Araw sa isang landas na tinatawag na orbit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p5OmMO4B7A1fpP3FulKEhHVDTsBgUarN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is the Sun mostly made of?

The Sun is composed of plasma, a superheated state of matter making up over 99 percent of its mass!
statements.tl:
Ano ang karamihang bumubuo sa Araw?

Ang Araw ay binubuo ng plasma, isang sobrang init na anyo ng matter na bumubuo ng higit sa 99 porsyento ng bigat nito!

statements.text: Mercury's surface gravity is about 3.7 m/s², which is only about 38% of Earth's gravity!
statements.tl: Ang surface gravity ng Mercury ay mga 3.7 m/s², na halos 38% lang ng gravity ng Daigdig!

statements.text:
What makes up our solar system?

The Sun and eight planets orbiting it: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. The Sun is a star — our source of light and heat!
statements.tl:
Ano ang bumubuo sa ating solar system?

Ang Araw (Sun) at walong planeta na umiikot (orbit) dito: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, at Neptune. Ang Araw ay isang bituin (star) — pinagmumulan ng liwanag at init natin!

statements.text: Mercury is the smallest planet and closest to the Sun! With almost no air, it is scorching by day and freezing at night.
statements.tl: Ang Mercury ang pinakamaliit na planeta at pinakamalapit sa Araw! Halos walang hangin dito, kaya napakainit sa araw at napakalamig sa gabi.
statements.source: NASA Solar System; DepEd G5 Q4

statements.text: Mercury races around the Sun faster than any other planet, finishing a whole year in just 88 Earth days!
statements.tl: Umiikot ang Mercury sa Araw nang mas mabilis kaysa ibang planeta, tinatapos ang isang buong taon sa loob lamang ng 88 araw sa Earth!

statements.text:
Why is Venus the hottest planet?

It's wrapped in a thick carbon dioxide atmosphere that traps heat! Venus is about the same size as Earth, but much hotter.
statements.tl:
Bakit pinakamainit ang Venus?

Nababalot ito ng makapal na atmosferang puno ng carbon dioxide na nagkukulong ng init! Halos kasinlaki ng Earth ang Venus, pero mas mainit.
statements.source: NASA; DepEd G6 (why Venus is hottest)

statements.text: The four inner planets (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars) are small and rocky, while the four outer planets are huge balls of gas and ice!
statements.tl: Ang apat na panloob na planeta (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars) ay maliliit at batuhin, habang ang apat na panlabas ay malalaking bola ng gas at yelo!

statements.text:
How many moons do the giant planets have?

Earth has one moon, but the giant planets have dozens! Jupiter and Saturn each have more than 90 known moons.
statements.tl:
Ilang buwan ang mga higanteng planeta?

Ang Earth ay may isang buwan, pero ang mga higanteng planeta ay may dose-dosena! Ang Jupiter at Saturn ay may tig-mahigit 90 na kilalang buwan.

statements.text: Between Mars and Jupiter lies the asteroid belt, a wide ring of rocky leftovers from when the planets first formed!
statements.tl: Sa pagitan ng Mars at Jupiter ay ang asteroid belt, isang malapad na singsing ng batuhing tira mula noong nabuo ang mga planeta!

statements.text:
Why does the Moon change shape?

The Moon seems to change shape because, as it orbits Earth, we see different amounts of its sunlit half!
statements.tl:
Bakit nagbabago ang anyo ng Buwan?

Mukhang nagbabago ang anyo ng Buwan dahil, habang umiikot ito sa Earth, nakikita natin ang iba't ibang bahagi ng kalahating naliliwanagan ng Araw nito!

statements.text: You can show Moon phases with a ball and a lamp! As the ball circles you, you see different amounts of its lit half — just like the real Moon lit by the Sun.
statements.tl: Maipapakita ang mga yugto ng Buwan gamit ang bola at ilaw! Habang umiikot ang bola sa paligid mo, nagbabago ang nakikita mong bahaging naliliwanagan — gaya ng tunay na Buwan sa Araw.
statements.source: NRC ESS1.B; AAAS Benchmarks (models of sky motions)

statements.text:
Why can't we see the Moon during a new moon?

During a new moon, the Moon is between the Earth and the Sun, hiding its lit side from us!
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi natin nakikita ang Buwan sa new moon?

Sa new moon, nasa pagitan ng Earth at Araw ang Buwan, kaya nakatago ang naliliwanagang bahagi nito!

statements.text: The Moon revolves around Earth, traveling in a path called an orbit while Earth also moves around the Sun.
statements.tl: Ang Buwan ay umiikot sa paligid ng Daigdig, dumadaan sa isang daan na tinatawag na orbit habang ang Daigdig ay umiikot naman sa Araw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1OOljMRiEn6dGwQ1wxns3wb_ZgyPKepvG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The Moon has no light of its own — it reflects sunlight! As it orbits Earth, the lit part facing us changes size, giving us phases like new moon, half, and full.
statements.tl: Walang sariling liwanag ang buwan (moon) — sumasalamin lang ito ng sinag ng Araw! Habang umiikot sa Earth, nagbabago ang laki ng naliliwanagang bahagi — kaya may phases: bagong buwan, kalahati, at kabilugan.

statements.text: At new moon, we can barely see it in the sky because its sunlit side is turned completely away from us!
statements.tl: Sa bagong buwan, halos hindi natin ito makita sa langit dahil ang panig na naliliwanagan ng Araw nito ay nakatalikod sa atin!

statements.text:
Why does the Moon change shape?

The Moon doesn't really change shape! We just see different amounts of its sunlit side as it orbits Earth, making its phases.
statements.tl:
Bakit nagbabago ng hugis ang buwan?

Hindi talaga nagbabago ng hugis ang buwan! Iba-iba lang ang nakikita nating bahagi na naliliwanagan ng araw habang umiikot ito sa Earth, kaya may phases.

statements.text:
Does the moon really disappear during a new moon?

Nope! The moon is always circling Earth. During a new moon, it sits between Earth and the sun, so its dark side faces us and it looks gone!
statements.tl:
Nawawala ba talaga ang buwan tuwing new moon?

Hindi! Palaging umiikot ang buwan sa Earth. Tuwing new moon, nasa pagitan ng Earth at araw ito, kaya ang madilim nitong panig ang nakaharap sa atin at parang nawala!

statements.text: We see a full moon when Earth lies between the Sun and the Moon, so the whole face of the Moon turned toward us is fully lit by sunlight!
statements.tl: Nakikita natin ang full moon kapag nasa pagitan ng Sun at Moon ang Earth, kaya buong mukha ng Moon na nakaharap sa atin ay ganap na niliwanagan ng sikat ng araw!

statements.text:
How do the Sun, Earth, and Moon move together?

Earth orbits the Sun once a year, and the Moon orbits Earth — so all three move together in a connected system!
statements.tl:
Paano magkasamang gumagalaw ang Sun, Earth, at Moon?

Ang Earth ay umiikot sa Sun nang isang beses sa isang taon, at ang Moon naman ay umiikot sa Earth — kaya magkaugnay ang galaw ng tatlo!

statements.text: During a full moon, the Earth is between the Sun and the Moon, letting us see its entire bright, lit face!
statements.tl: Sa full moon, nasa pagitan ng Araw at Buwan ang Earth, kaya nakikita natin ang buong maliwanag na mukha ng Buwan!

statements.text:
What happens during a new moon?

It's the start of the lunar cycle! The Moon hides between Earth and the Sun, hiding its bright side.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa new moon?

Ito ang simula ng lunar cycle! Nagtatago ang buwan sa pagitan ng Earth at Sun, kaya hindi nakikita ang liwanag nito.

statements.text: The Moon orbits Earth counterclockwise when seen from above the North Pole! This is why its phases progress in such a steady, perfect order.
statements.tl: Ang Buwan ay umiikot sa Earth nang counterclockwise kapag tiningnan mula sa itaas ng North Pole! Kaya ang mga phase nito ay sumusulong sa maayos na pagkakasunod-sunod.

statements.text: At new moon, the Moon rises and sets right with the Sun! It's in the daytime sky, completely hidden by the bright sunlight.
statements.tl: Sa new moon, ang Buwan ay sumisikat at lumulubog kasama ng Araw! Kaya ito ay nasa kalangitan sa araw, natatago ng liwanag ng araw.

statements.text: At full moon, the Moon rises at sunset and sets at sunrise! It stays in the night sky, shining bright all night long.
statements.tl: Sa full moon, ang Buwan ay sumisikat sa paglubog ng araw at lumulubog sa pagsikat ng araw! Kaya nananatili ito sa kalangitan sa gabi buong magdamag.

statements.text:
Does everyone on Earth see the same moon phase on the same day?

Yes! Everyone sees the same moon phase because the Moon is so far away that the viewing angle is almost the same everywhere.
statements.tl:
Nakikita ba ng lahat sa Earth ang parehong phase ng buwan sa isang araw?

Oo! Nakikita ng lahat ang parehong phase dahil napakalayo ng Buwan kaya halos pareho ang anggulo nito kahit saan ka man.

statements.text:
Can a crescent moon help you find the Sun?

Yes! The bright edge of a crescent moon always points toward the Sun. This helps you find it even after sunset!
statements.tl:
Maaari bang tumulong ang crescent moon na mahanap ang Araw?

Oo! Ang maliwanag na gilid ng crescent moon ay laging nakaturo sa Araw. Tumutulong ito na mahanap ang Araw kahit pagkatapos ng sunset!

statements.text: At first quarter, the Moon is highest in the sky at sunset! It sets around midnight, making it perfectly visible in the early evening.
statements.tl: Sa first quarter, ang Buwan ay pinakamataas sa langit sa sunset! Lumulubog ito bandang hatinggabi, kaya nakikita ito nang maayos sa maagang gabi.

statements.text: For electricity to flow, it needs a complete closed path called a circuit, going out from the battery and back!
statements.tl: Para dumaloy ang kuryente, kailangan ng kompletong saradong daanan na sirkito, mula sa baterya at pabalik dito!

statements.text: A battery stores chemical energy and turns it into electrical energy when connected in a circuit!
statements.tl: Ang baterya ay nag-iimbak ng kemikal na enerhiya at ginagawa itong elektrikal na enerhiya kapag ikinabit sa sirkito!

statements.text: When a switch is turned off, it breaks the path so electricity can no longer flow through the wire!
statements.tl: Kapag pinatay ang switch, naputol ang daanan ng kuryente kaya hindi na ito dumadaloy sa kable!

statements.text:
How do we draw a battery in a circuit diagram?

A cell is drawn as a long line (positive!) and a short line (negative!). Several cells in series? That's alternating long-short-long-short lines!
statements.tl:
Paano natin iguhit ang baterya sa circuit diagram?

Ang cell ay iginuguhit bilang mahabang guhit (positive!) at maikling guhit (negative!). Maraming cell sa series? Pattern iyan ng mahaba-maikli-mahaba-maikli na guhit!

statements.text: In a closed circuit, electrical energy is distributed to loads - devices like bulbs or motors - that convert it into light, heat, or motion.
statements.tl: Sa isang closed circuit, ang electrical energy ay ipinamamahagi sa mga load - mga gamit tulad ng bombilya o motor - na ginagawang light, heat, o motion ang energy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JI1oktnS7tPces0ag9jSNbSJ3TWDK2ja), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Wires are the paths that connect the components of a circuit, allowing electricity to travel from the source to the bulb and back.
statements.tl: Ang mga wire ang daanan na nagkokonekta sa mga bahagi ng circuit, para makapaglakbay ang kuryente mula sa source papunta sa bulb at pabalik.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1KqEFKz1EEpn7Qo_W8bbixkjj6n0-lUQw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A simple circuit has four main parts: a source for energy, wires for a path, a switch for control, and a bulb to use the electricity.
statements.tl: Ang simpleng circuit ay may apat na pangunahing bahagi: source para sa energy, wires para sa daanan, switch para sa control, at bulb para gamitin ang kuryente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1KqEFKz1EEpn7Qo_W8bbixkjj6n0-lUQw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A simple direct current (DC) circuit has four main parts: a power source, a connector wire, a load like a bulb, and a switch.
statements.tl: Ang simpleng direct current (DC) circuit ay may apat na pangunahing bahagi: power source, connector wire, load na gaya ng bulb, at switch.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MCvBx-FwOV283XAfOSlTM4uXWyGLu9QL), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Electric current is the flow of electrical charges, and it flows only in a closed or complete circuit.
statements.tl: Ang electric current ay ang daloy ng electrical charges, at ito ay dumadaloy lamang sa closed o kumpletong circuit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MCvBx-FwOV283XAfOSlTM4uXWyGLu9QL), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Some devices, like flashlights and remote controls, get their electricity from batteries stored inside them.
statements.tl: Ang ilang gamit, tulad ng flashlight at remote control, ay kumukuha ng kuryente mula sa mga bateryang nakalagay sa loob nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UfW6o5Rjb5rfFPqn_Ey_gMB5MXqTapKA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Can a radio work with both a battery and an outlet?

Yes! Some devices, like certain radios and electric fans, can use either batteries or be plugged into an electrical outlet.
statements.tl:
Maaari bang gumana ang radyo gamit ang baterya at outlet?

Oo! Ang ilang gamit, tulad ng ilang radyo at electric fan, ay maaaring gumamit ng baterya o isaksak sa electrical outlet.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UfW6o5Rjb5rfFPqn_Ey_gMB5MXqTapKA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An electric circuit has at least three parts: a voltage source like a battery, conducting wires for the current to pass through, and loads like light bulbs that use the energy.
statements.tl: Ang electric circuit ay may hindi bababa sa tatlong bahagi: voltage source tulad ng battery, conducting wires na dinadaanan ng current, at mga load tulad ng light bulbs na gumagamit ng enerhiya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UttxIkiwIPS4n47V68cHOV_nEmoMGBAR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Batteries and generators are the primary sources of voltage that supply energy in an electric circuit.
statements.tl: Ang mga baterya at generator ang pangunahing pinagmumulan ng voltage na nagsu-supply ng enerhiya sa isang electric circuit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1e8Ctezr0fbjNb_buiwB0amgpUFRK3BCn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Schematic diagrams use simple symbols to represent parts of a circuit: a zigzag line for a resistor, a circle with an X for a bulb, and long and short lines for a battery.
statements.tl: Ang schematic diagrams ay gumagamit ng simpleng symbols para kumatawan sa mga bahagi ng circuit: zigzag line para sa resistor, bilog na may X para sa bulb, at mahaba at maikling linya para sa battery.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1g429tyGCPy0seeW_b44IfSlLfONkL245), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An electrical schematic diagram is a drawing that uses symbols to show how the components of a circuit are arranged and connected.
statements.tl: Ang electrical schematic diagram ay isang drawing na gumagamit ng mga simbolo para ipakita kung paano nakaayos at nakakonekta ang mga bahagi ng isang circuit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1n1edItwUB0gZNTZu3qyKz0ABbHACm0xC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An electric circuit is a closed loop that gives electric current a complete return path from the source, through the load, and back again.
statements.tl: Ang electric circuit ay isang saradong loop na nagbibigay sa electric current ng kumpletong daanan pabalik mula sa source, papunta sa load, at pabalik muli.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1nhjKo5pixZnt1rXfCL3Cce_ZFVPvpu37), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A simple circuit is composed of a voltage source like a battery, connecting wires, a switch, and a load such as a bulb or resistor.
statements.tl: Ang simpleng circuit ay binubuo ng voltage source tulad ng battery, connecting wires, switch, at load gaya ng bulb o resistor.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1vIIFvq1RbOyvek7hgkFhi3krt1Ng-xGx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Circuit schematic diagrams use standard symbols for wires, bulbs, resistors, switches, and batteries to show how a circuit is connected.
statements.tl: Ang circuit schematic diagrams ay gumagamit ng standard symbols para sa wires, bulbs, resistors, switches, at batteries upang ipakita kung paano nakakabit ang circuit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1vIIFvq1RbOyvek7hgkFhi3krt1Ng-xGx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Electrical wires have a rubber coating because rubber is an insulator that prevents dangerous electric shocks.
statements.tl: May rubber coating ang mga kable ng kuryente dahil ang rubber ay isang insulator na pumipigil sa mapanganib na electric shock.

statements.text: A conductor is a material that lets electricity flow through it easily—like copper and other metals!
statements.tl: Ang conductor ay materyal na madaling pinagdadaluyan ng kuryente, gaya ng tanso at iba pang metal!

statements.text: Place an object in a circuit, and if the light turns on, it is a conductor! This means it lets electricity flow, just like metal.
statements.tl: Ilagay ang isang bagay sa circuit, at kung sumindi ang ilaw, ito ay isang conductor! Ibig sabihin, pinapadaloy nito ang electricity, tulad ng metal.

statements.text: Metals like copper, iron, gold, silver, steel, aluminum, brass, and nickel are good conductors, meaning they allow heat and electricity to flow freely through them.
statements.tl: Ang mga metal tulad ng copper, iron, gold, silver, steel, aluminum, brass, at nickel ay magagaling na conductor, ibig sabihin pinapadaan nila nang maayos ang init at kuryente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UX7ANIJYpgoPKlabuMkgSItczXQs0HI1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In tools like flat irons, tongs, wires, and spatulas, the metal parts act as conductors to carry heat or electricity, while the rubber or plastic parts act as insulators to protect your hand.
statements.tl: Sa mga gamit tulad ng flat iron, sipit, wires, at spatula, ang mga parte na metal ay nagsisilbing conductor para magdala ng init o kuryente, habang ang mga parte na rubber o plastic ay insulator para protektahan ang iyong kamay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UX7ANIJYpgoPKlabuMkgSItczXQs0HI1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Insulators are materials that do not allow electricity to flow through them easily, and common examples include rubber, plastic, glass, wood, ceramic, paper, cloth, and dry soil.
statements.tl: Ang insulators ay mga materyales na hindi madaling dumaanan ng kuryente. Kabilang sa mga halimbawa nito ang rubber, plastic, salamin, kahoy, ceramic, papel, tela, at tuyong lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VTuRq-Szo6gPpf1JyYjmp_YJsQuNvvT5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Nonmetal items such as erasers and paper bills do not complete a circuit, so the bulb stays dark when they are in the path.
statements.tl: Ang mga bagay na hindi metal tulad ng erasers at paper bills ay hindi kumukumpleto ng circuit, kaya nananatiling madilim ang bulb kapag sila ang nasa daanan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b9DpG4yEl1W8xDAvwJRg1z0jka_copeq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a circuit test, materials like paper, wood, and plastic will not make the bulb light up because they are insulators.
statements.tl: Sa pagsusuri ng circuit, ang mga materyales tulad ng papel, kahoy, at plastic ay hindi magpapailaw sa bombilya dahil sila ay mga insulators.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1tiSsNowPhRjNIgrz9Y53HicbPLVL8ZV5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Zinc and iron are electrical conductors used as parts of electrical and electronic devices.
statements.tl: Ang zinc at bakal ay mga electrical conductors na ginagamit bilang bahagi ng mga electrical at electronic devices.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1tiSsNowPhRjNIgrz9Y53HicbPLVL8ZV5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why is ceramic used as an insulator on power poles?

Because ceramic does not let electricity flow through it! That is why it is used as an insulator on power poles.
statements.tl:
Bakit ginagamit ang seramika bilang insulator sa mga poste ng kuryente?

Dahil hindi dinadaluyan ng kuryente ang seramika! Kaya ginagamit ito bilang insulator sa mga poste ng kuryente.

statements.text: Electricity cannot pass easily through rubber, making it a great insulator! That is why rubber wraps electrical wires and is used in electricians' gloves to prevent shocks.
statements.tl: Hindi madaling dumaan ang kuryente sa goma, kaya magandang insulator ito! Kaya binabalot ng goma ang mga kable at ginagamit sa electricians' gloves para iwas kuryente.

statements.text:
Can a non-metal conduct electricity?

Yes! Graphite, the black core of a pencil, is an exception. It’s not a metal, but it has free electrons that move, letting it conduct electricity!
statements.tl:
Pwede bang magdala ng kuryente ang hindi metal?

Oo! Ang graphite, ang itim na laman ng lapis, ay bukod. Hindi ito metal, pero may malayang electron na gumagalaw, kaya nakakapagdala ito ng kuryente!

statements.text:
Why do we use porcelain ceramics on high-voltage power lines?

Because ceramics are excellent electrical insulators! They don't conduct electricity, making them perfect for keeping high-voltage power lines safe.
statements.tl:
Bakit gumagamit tayo ng porcelain ceramics sa mga high-voltage power lines?

Dahil magaling na electrical insulator ang mga ceramic! Hindi ito nagpapadaan ng kuryente, kaya perpekto ito para sa high-voltage power lines.

statements.text: Silicon is a cool semiconductor, meaning it’s not a pure conductor or insulator! It’s the main material used to make computer chips, solar cells, and electronic devices.
statements.tl: Ang silicon ay isang semiconductor, kaya hindi ito purong conductor o insulator! Ito ang pangunahing materyales para sa mga computer chip, solar cell, at electronic devices.

statements.text: Insulators like rubber and plastic stop electrical current from flowing easily. But conductors like copper wire let electrons move freely!
statements.tl: Ang mga insulators tulad ng goma at plastic ay humahadlang sa electrical current na dumaloy. Pero ang mga conductors tulad ng copper wire ay nagpapahintulot sa mga electron na gumalaw nang malaya!

statements.text:
Why shouldn't you touch electrical appliances with wet hands?

Water with dissolved salt conducts electricity much better than pure water! So, sweaty or wet hands can be dangerous.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi dapat hawakan ang electrical appliances kapag basa ang kamay?

Mas magaling mag-conduct ng kuryente ang tubig na may asin kaysa purong tubig! Kaya delikado ang basa o pawis na kamay.

statements.text:
Can pencil lead power a lightbulb?

Yes! Graphite, the material in pencil lead, is a non-metal that conducts electricity to power a small lightbulb when connected to a battery.
statements.tl:
Kayang mapailaw ng lapis ang maliit na bombilya?

Oo! Ang graphite sa lapis ay isang non-metal na nag-co-conduct ng kuryente para mapailaw ang maliit na bombilya kapag nakakabit sa baterya.

statements.text: Conductors like copper and other metals let electricity pass through easily, which is why wires are made from them!
statements.tl: Ang mga conductor gaya ng tanso at ibang metal ay nagpapadaloy ng kuryente nang madali, kaya ginagawa silang alambre!

statements.text: When electric current flows through a wire, it magically creates a magnetic field all around the wire!
statements.tl: Kapag may dumadaloy na electric current sa isang wire, lumilikha ito ng magnetic field sa paligid ng wire!

statements.text: Placing a piece of iron inside the wire coil makes the electromagnet much, much stronger!
statements.tl: Ang paglalagay ng pirasong iron sa loob ng wire coil ay nagpapalakas nang marami sa electromagnet!

statements.text: An electromagnet is a magnet made by electricity, so it can grab iron and drop it when the power is switched off!
statements.tl: Ang electromagnet ay magneto na gawa sa kuryente, kaya kaya nitong humila ng bakal at bitiwan ito kapag pinatay ang kuryente!

statements.text: Unlike an ordinary magnet, you can turn an electromagnet on and off just by switching the electric current!
statements.tl: Hindi tulad ng ordinaryong magnet, kayang i-on at i-off ang electromagnet sa pamamagitan lang ng pag-switch ng electric current!

statements.text: Wind wire around an iron nail and add current to make an electromagnet! It’s a cool magnet you can easily switch on and off.
statements.tl: Ikot ang alambre sa pako at lagyan ng kuryente para gumawa ng electromagnet! Ito ay magnet na pwede mong i-on at i-off.

statements.text: Want a stronger electromagnet? Just add more turns of wire or send more current flowing through it to boost its power!
statements.tl: Gusto mo ng mas malakas na electromagnet? Dagdagan lang ang ikot ng alambre o damihan ang kuryenteng dumadaloy para lumakas ito!

statements.text: An electromagnet is a cool magnet made by electricity! It is only magnetic while electric current flows through it.
statements.tl: Ang electromagnet ay isang magnet na gawa sa kuryente! Ito ay magnetiko lamang habang may dumadaloy na kuryente.

statements.text:
How can you make an electromagnet even stronger?

The stronger the electric current flowing, the stronger the electromagnet becomes!
statements.tl:
Paano mo gagawing mas malakas ang isang electromagnet?

Kapag mas malakas ang electric current na dumadaloy, mas lumalakas din ang electromagnet!

statements.text:
What happens when you turn off the electric current?

The electromagnet loses its magnetism! This means you can easily switch it on and off.
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag pinatay mo ang electric current?

Nawawala ang magnetism ng electromagnet! Kaya naman madali mo itong ma-on at ma-off.

statements.text: An electromagnet has a north pole and a south pole, just like your ordinary magnet!
statements.tl: Ang electromagnet ay may north pole at south pole, tulad ng ordinaryong magnet!

statements.text:
What happens if you reverse the current in an electromagnet?

The north and south poles switch places! It's like the magnet does a quick flip.
statements.tl:
Anong mangyayari kapag binaligtad mo ang kuryente sa electromagnet?

Nagpapalitan ang hilaga at timog na polo! Parang nag-flip ang magnet.

statements.text:
How did scientists first notice that electricity creates magnetism?

In 1820, Hans Christian Oersted saw a compass needle move near a wire carrying electric current!
statements.tl:
Paano unang napansin ng mga siyentipiko na ang kuryente ay gumagawa ng magnetismo?

Noong 1820, nakita ni Hans Christian Oersted na gumalaw ang karayom ng kompas malapit sa kawad na may kuryente!

statements.text: MRI machines in hospitals use very strong electromagnets to take detailed pictures of the inside of your body!
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang mga MRI machine sa ospital ng napakalakas na electromagnet para kumuha ng larawan ng loob ng katawan!

statements.text:
Why do electromagnets use soft iron for their core?

Soft iron becomes a magnet super fast when current flows, but loses its magnetism just as quickly when you switch it off!
statements.tl:
Bakit malambot na bakal ang ginagamit bilang ubod ng electromagnet?

Mabilis itong nagiging magnet kapag may kuryente, at mabilis ding mawalan nito kapag pinatay!

statements.text: You can build a simple electromagnet by wrapping wire around a nail and connecting the ends to a battery!
statements.tl: Makakagawa ka ng simpleng electromagnet sa pag-ikot ng kawad sa pako at pagdurugtong nito sa baterya!

statements.text: You can make a magnet using electricity! Just wrap wire around iron and pass an electric current through the wire to create an electromagnet.
statements.tl: Pwede kang gumawa ng magneto gamit ang kuryente! Ipaikot lang ang kawad sa bakal at padaanin dito ang kuryente para makagawa ng electromagnet.

statements.text: At junk shops, big cranes use a super strong electromagnet at the end! The pull at its face is so powerful it can lift whole wrecked cars and scrap metal.
statements.tl: Sa mga junk shop, gumagamit ang malalaking crane ng napakalakas na electromagnet! Sobrang lakas ng hila kaya kayang buhat ang mga sirang kotse at bakal.

statements.text:
How can you make an electromagnet stronger?

Put an iron nail in the middle of the coil! The iron boosts the magnetic force from the electricity, making it strong enough to pull more objects.
statements.tl:
Paano mo papalakasin ang isang electromagnet?

Maglagay ng bakal na pako sa gitna ng coil! Pinapalakas ng bakal ang magnetic force mula sa kuryente, kaya mas marami itong nahihilang bagay.

statements.text:
How do rivers shape the land?

As water flows downhill in rivers, it slowly carves and reshapes the land, forming valleys over time!
statements.tl:
Paano hinuhubog ng mga ilog ang lupa?

Habang dumadaloy ang tubig pababa sa ilog, dahan-dahan nitong inuukit at binabago ang lupa, na gumagawa ng mga lambak sa paglipas ng panahon!
statements.source: NRC ESS2.A; AAAS BSL Ch.4C; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: The Cordillera in northern Luzon is a large mountain range and home of the famous rice terraces!
statements.tl: Ang Cordillera sa hilagang Luzon ay isang malaking hanay ng bundok at tahanan ng sikat na hagdan-hagdang palayan!

statements.text: When a river overflows, it leaves rich mud on both banks, building a fertile flat land called a floodplain!
statements.tl: Kapag umaapaw ang ilog, naiiwan niya ang mayamang lapok sa magkabilang pampang, kaya nabubuo ang matabang kapatagan na tinatawag na floodplain!

statements.text: The Bicol region has highly fertile volcanic soil that was enriched by past eruptions of Mount Mayon!
statements.tl: Ang Bicol region ay may highly fertile volcanic soil na pinayaman ng mga nakaraang eruption ng Bulkang Mayon!

statements.text: The tangled roots of mangroves trap mud carried by water, slowly building up and stabilizing the coastal land!
statements.tl: Hinuhuli ng magkakabuhol na ugat ng mangrove ang putik na dala ng tubig, unti-unting pinapatatag ang lupa sa baybayin!

statements.text: Landforms give us marble for building, potatoes and carrots for food, and many other useful things from the soil.
statements.tl: Ang mga anyong lupa ay nagbibigay sa atin ng marmol para sa paggawa ng bahay, patatas at carrots para sa pagkain, at marami pang kapaki-pakinabang na bagay mula sa lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-3qJjNaCu-zNCXOwCXHu9YNTn8mcrqoy), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mountains are high land habitats where the air is cooler, and animals like mountain goats have strong hooves to climb steep rocky slopes.
statements.tl: Ang mga bundok ay matataas na tirahan sa lupa kung saan mas malamig ang hangin, at ang mga hayop tulad ng mountain goat ay may malalakas na kuko para umakyat sa matarik na bato.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YGgY42idGzxe6M-YpebDK67bOlvRGIoG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A plain is a broad area of relatively flat land, so farmers often plant rice and other crops there because the soil is easy to work.
statements.tl: Ang plain ay malawak at patag na lupain, kaya madalas doon nagtatanim ng palay at iba pang pananim ang mga magsasaka dahil madaling bungkalin ang lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yWuGxRZUihVCmF2CKAxpML1I-BZgBiNV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Human activities differ across landforms because people farm on plains, climb mountains, and build houses on hills where the ground is higher.
statements.tl: Iba-iba ang gawain ng tao sa bawat anyong lupa dahil nagsasaka sila sa kapatagan, umaakyat ng bundok, at nagtatayo ng bahay sa burol kung saan mas mataas ang lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yWuGxRZUihVCmF2CKAxpML1I-BZgBiNV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The Ifugao of the Cordillera grow heirloom rice like tinawon in their world-famous rice terraces carved into the mountains.
statements.tl: Ang mga Ifugao sa Cordillera ay nagtatanim ng heirloom rice tulad ng tinawon sa kanilang mga rice terraces na inukit sa bundok, kilala sa buong mundo.

statements.text: A saltmarsh is a coastal ecosystem with special plants that can live in salty water — home to birds and small animals, and protection for the coast from erosion.
statements.tl: Ang saltmarsh ay isang coastal ecosystem na may espesyal na halaman na kayang mabuhay sa maalat na tubig — tahanan ito ng mga ibon at proteksyon ng baybayin mula sa erosion.

statements.text:
What can deep-sea pressure do?

Deep in the ocean, the water above is so heavy that its pressure could crush an ordinary animal or object from the surface!
statements.tl:
Ano ang kaya ng presyon sa kailaliman?

Sa kailaliman ng dagat, napakabigat ng tubig sa itaas kaya kayang durugin ng presyon doon ang karaniwang hayop o gamit mula sa ibabaw!

statements.text: Puerto Princesa's Underground River in Palawan is a UNESCO World Heritage Site with a hidden cave world full of birds, bats, and other cave-loving creatures!
statements.tl: Ang Puerto Princesa Underground River sa Palawan ay isang UNESCO World Heritage Site na may lihim na mundo sa yungib, puno ng ibon, paniki, at ibang hayop na nakaangkop sa buhay-yungib!

statements.text: Migrating birds are also guided by land features like coastlines, rivers, and mountains as they find their way!
statements.tl: Ginagabayan din ng mga tanawin tulad ng baybayin, ilog, at bundok ang mga ibon habang sila ay lumilipat!

statements.text:
What kind of home is a river?

A river is a flowing freshwater home for fish, shrimp, and other animals strong enough to handle the current.
statements.tl:
Anong klaseng tahanan ang ilog?

Ang ilog ay tirahan ng umaagos na tubig-tabang kung saan nakatira ang mga isda, hipon, at iba pang hayop na nakakalaban sa agos ng tubig.

statements.text: A wetland acts like a giant sponge, soaking up and storing water — which helps reduce flooding.
statements.tl: Ang latian ay parang espongha na sumisipsip at nag-iimbak ng tubig, na tumutulong para mabawasan ang baha.

statements.text: In the Philippines, many hills and mountainsides are covered with tall cogon and talahib grasses.
statements.tl: Sa Pilipinas, maraming burol at kabundukan ang natatakpan ng matataas na damong cogon at talahib.

statements.text: On a high mountain, water boils below 100°C! This happens because the air pressure there is lower.
statements.tl: Sa mataas na bundok, kumukulo ang tubig nang mas mababa sa 100°C! Mas mahina kasi ang presyon ng hangin doon.

statements.text: Sandstone is a sedimentary rock formed from tiny grains of sand that were pressed together and hardened!
statements.tl: Ang sandstone ay isang sedimentary rock na nabuo mula sa mga butil ng buhangin na nadiin at tumigas!

statements.text: Comparing granite from two different provinces shows that the same rock type can vary in color and grain size from place to place!
statements.tl: Ang pagkukumpara ng granite mula sa dalawang magkaibang probinsya ay nagpapakita na ang parehong uri ng bato ay maaaring mag-iba ng kulay at laki ng butil!

statements.text: Grain size is the size of the particles that make up a rock, and it affects whether the rock feels smooth or rough.
statements.tl: Ang grain size ay ang laki ng mga particle na bumubuo sa bato, at ito ang nagsasabi kung makinis o magaspang ang bato.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p0ox-Tii6r0meLth3M0lBb1BmLlCk2Gb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A rock may have one color or several colors at the same time, depending on the particles that make it up.
statements.tl: Ang isang bato ay maaaring may isang kulay o maraming kulay nang sabay-sabay, depende sa mga particle na bumubuo rito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p0ox-Tii6r0meLth3M0lBb1BmLlCk2Gb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Ochre is a natural soil or clay with iron oxide! This gives it red, yellow, or brown color, making it one of the oldest pigments!
statements.tl: Ang ochre ay likas na lupa o luad na may iron oxide! Kaya ito pula, dilaw, o kayumanggi, at isa sa pinakamatandang pigment!

statements.text: Garnet is a beautiful mineral that is most commonly known for its deep red color!
statements.tl: Ang garnet ay isang mineral na kadalasang kilala sa kanyang malalim na pula na kulay!

statements.text:
What color is the gem rock lapis lazuli?

Lapis lazuli is a beautiful gem rock that has a very deep blue color!
statements.tl:
Anong kulay ang batong-hiyas na lapis lazuli?

Ang lapis lazuli ay isang magandang batong-hiyas na may malalim na asul na kulay!

statements.text: The birthstone for December is the turquoise, a beautiful gem with a lovely blue-green color!
statements.tl: Ang birthstone para sa Disyembre ay ang turquoise (turkesa), isang magandang bato na asul-berde ang kulay!
statements.source: American Gem Society / Jewelers of America 1912 list

statements.text: Some minerals look like ordinary rocks, but they glow with bright colors when an ultraviolet (UV) or blacklight shines on them!
statements.tl: Mukhang ordinaryong bato ang ilang mineral, pero nagliliwanag sila ng matingkad na kulay kapag tinapatan ng ultraviolet (UV) o blacklight!

statements.text: Fast-cooling lava makes tiny crystals, while magma cooling slowly underground makes big crystals like in granite!
statements.tl: Kung mabilis lumamig ang lava, maliliit ang crystal; kung mabagal sa ilalim ng lupa, malalaki ang crystal tulad sa granite!

statements.text: In sedimentary rock, minerals glue the grains of sand together as they are pressed, turning them into solid rock!
statements.tl: Sa sedimentary rock, naididikit ng mga mineral ang mga butil ng buhangin habang ipinipit sila, kaya sila tumitigas na bato!

statements.text: A mineral's streak color is often different from its surface color, making streak more reliable!
statements.tl: Madalas na naiiba ang kulay ng streak sa kulay ng ibabaw ng mineral, kaya mas maaasahan ang streak!

statements.text:
Why can't we always trust a mineral's color?

Color alone isn't always reliable for identifying a mineral because one mineral can come in many different colors!
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi laging maaasahan ang kulay ng mineral?

Hindi laging maaasahan ang kulay sa pagkilala ng mineral dahil ang isang mineral ay pwedeng magkaroon ng iba't ibang kulay!

statements.text:
Can sunlight change amethyst's color?

Yes! If amethyst sits in strong sunlight too long, its purple color can fade. That's why it's best kept away from places with constant bright light.
statements.tl:
Pwede bang baguhin ng araw ang kulay ng amethyst?

Oo! Kung matagal na nakalantad sa matinding sikat ng araw ang amethyst, maaaring kumupas ang lilang kulay nito. Kaya mas mabuti itong itago sa lugar na hindi laging tinatamaan ng matinding liwanag.

statements.text:
How do you care for your amethyst?

Clean it with cool water and a soft cloth! Keep it away from heat and too much sunlight so its lovely purple color won't fade.
statements.tl:
Paano mo aalagaan ang iyong amethyst?

Linisin ito gamit ang malamig na tubig at malambot na tela! Iwasan ang init at matagal na sikat ng araw para hindi kumupas ang lila.

statements.text: Obsidian is a black glassy rock that forms when lava cools so rapidly that no crystals can grow. It is extremely sharp and was used by ancient people for tools and weapons!
