statements.tl: Ang obsidian ay isang itim na glassy rock na nabubuo kapag ang lava ay lubhang mabilis na lumamig at walang pagkakataong lumago ang mga crystal. Napakatalim nito at ginamit noon ng mga sinaunang tao para sa mga kagamitan at armas!

statements.text:
What rock makes up most of the land beneath our feet?

Granite! It's the main rock of continental crust, made of quartz, feldspar, and mica, with large crystals and a white-to-gray speckled look.
statements.tl:
Anong bato ang bumubuo sa karamihan ng lupa sa ilalim ng ating mga paa?

Granite! Ito ang pangunahing bato ng continental crust, gawa sa quartz, feldspar, at mica, na may malalaking crystal at kulay-abong mantsa.

statements.text: Sandstone is a sedimentary rock full of pore spaces between sand grains. These pores fill with water, making sandstone an important aquifer for our drinking water!
statements.tl: Ang sandstone ay sedimentary rock na puno ng puwang sa pagitan ng mga butil ng buhangin. Napupuno ng tubig ang mga puwang na ito, kaya mahalagang aquifer ito para sa inuming tubig!

statements.text:
What makes a good rock classification record?

A great record lists the rock's properties, the exact answers you chose in the key, and the final rock name!
statements.tl:
Ano ang bumubuo sa isang magandang tala ng pag-uuri ng bato?

Ang magandang tala ay naglilista ng mga katangian ng bato, ang mga sagot na pinili mo sa key, at ang huling pangalan ng bato!

statements.text: Every question in a dichotomous key asks about something you can see or test on the rock — never its name!
statements.tl: Ang bawat tanong sa isang dichotomous key ay tungkol sa nakikita o nasusubok mo sa bato — hindi kailanman sa pangalan nito!

statements.text: Many igneous rocks are hard and often contain shiny crystals that sparkle when light hits them.
statements.tl: Maraming igneous rock ang matigas at kadalasang may makikintab na crystals na kumikinang sa liwanag.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p0ox-Tii6r0meLth3M0lBb1BmLlCk2Gb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Sedimentary rocks are usually the softest type, have visible layers, and may contain fossils of ancient living things.
statements.tl: Ang sedimentary rocks ay kadalasang pinakamalambot na uri, may nakikitang mga layer, at maaaring may fossils ng mga sinaunang nabubuhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p0ox-Tii6r0meLth3M0lBb1BmLlCk2Gb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What are the three main kinds of rock?

Based on how they form, there are three main kinds of rock: igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks!
statements.tl:
Ano ang tatlong pangunahing uri ng bato?

Ayon sa kung paano sila nabuo, may tatlong pangunahing uri ng bato: igneous, sedimentary, at metamorphic na bato!

statements.text: To start using a dichotomous key, look at the rock's visible features! Check its grain size, color, and if it has layers.
statements.tl: Para magsimulang gumamit ng dichotomous key, titingnan mo muna ang mga nakikitang katangian ng bato! Suriin ang laki ng butil, kulay, at kung mayroon itong mga layer.

statements.text:
How does a dichotomous key work?

It gives you two choices at each step! You pick the one that matches your rock to move to the next pair.
statements.tl:
Paano gumagana ang isang dichotomous key?

Nagbibigay ito ng dalawang pagpipilian sa bawat hakbang! Pipiliin mo ang tumutugma sa iyong bato para lumipat sa susunod na pares.

statements.text: To test hardness, try scratching the rock! Use a fingernail, a copper coin, and a steel nail, going from softest to hardest.
statements.tl: Para malaman kung gaano katigas, subukan mong kaskasin ang bato! Gamitin ang kuko, baryang tanso, at pako, mula sa pinakalambot hanggang pinakamatigas.

statements.text: For a fair test, always use the same lighting and a plain background! This helps you judge every rock's color and texture exactly the same way.
statements.tl: Para sa patas na pag-uuri, gumamit ng parehong liwanag at simpleng background! Paraan ito para makita nang pareho ang kulay at texture ng bawat bato.

statements.text:
How do you start a dichotomous key?

Always start at the very first pair of questions and never skip steps! Each answer narrows down your choices to find the right one.
statements.tl:
Paano mo sisimulan ang isang dichotomous key?

Laging magsimula sa unang pares ng tanong at huwag maglaktaw! Bawat sagot ay nagpapaliit ng mga pagpipilian para makita ang tamang sagot.

statements.text:
Will two people get the same rock name?

Yes! If two people use the same key on the same rock and observe carefully and honestly, they will get the exact same name.
statements.tl:
Magkakaroon ba ng parehong pangalan ang dalawang tao sa bato?

Oo! Kung dalawang tao ang gagamit ng parehong key sa parehong bato at maingat at totoong titingin, magkakaroon sila ng parehong pangalan.

statements.text:
How do you see a rock's true color?

Don't judge by its stained surface! Look at a fresh break to see the true color hiding inside the rock.
statements.tl:
Paano mo makikita ang totoong kulay ng bato?

Huwag maghusga sa mantsang ibabaw! Tingnan ang bagong biyak para makita ang totoong kulay na nakatago sa loob ng bato.

statements.text:
Why is a rock's texture important?

The texture—whether grains are coarse, fine, or glassy—is a key feature! It directs you straight to the next question in the key.
statements.tl:
Bakit mahalaga ang texture ng isang bato?

Ang texture—kung magaspang, pino, o parang salamin ang butil—ay mahalagang katangian! Dadalhin ka nito diretso sa susunod na tanong sa key.

statements.text: See interlocking crystals? The key likely leads to igneous! See rounded grains? It might be a sedimentary rock instead.
statements.tl: May magkakadikit na crystals? Malamang na igneous ang bato batay sa key! Kung bilugan naman ang mga butil, baka sedimentary ito.

statements.text: Hold a small magnet near the rock to check for magnetic minerals. A strong pull means it might be magnetite or iron-rich!
statements.tl: Hawakan ang maliit na magnet malapit sa bato para sa magnetic minerals. Ang malakas na hatak ay nangangahulugang magnetite o mayaman sa bakal!

statements.text:
How do you know the key gave the right rock name?

You confirm it by checking if the rock's properties match the description in your rock guide!
statements.tl:
Paano mo malalaman kung tama ang pangalang ibinigay ng key?

Kumpirmahin mo ito sa pamamagitan ng pagsuri kung ang mga katangian ng bato ay tugma sa paglalarawan sa rock guide!

statements.text:
How does a dichotomous key actually work?

It works like a flowchart! Each pair of questions leads to another pair until you finally reach the rock's name.
statements.tl:
Paano ba gumagana ang isang dichotomous key?

Gumagana ito parang flowchart! Bawat pares ng tanong ay papunta sa isa pang pares hanggang makuha mo ang pangalan ng bato.

statements.text: When classifying, place the rock on a paper towel! This keeps tiny grains from falling off and changing your observation of its texture.
statements.tl: Kapag nag-uuri, ilagay ang bato sa paper towel! Para hindi mawala ang maliliit na butil na puwedeng magbago sa iyong obserbasyon ng texture nito.

statements.text: Soil is a cool mix of fine rock bits and decayed plants and animals!
statements.tl: Ang lupa ay timpla ng pinong tipik ng bato at mga bulok na halaman at hayop!

statements.text: Waves pounding the shore slowly break large rocks into smaller and smaller pieces!
statements.tl: Ang mga alon na humahampas sa baybayin ay unti-unting nagdudurog ng malalaking bato!

statements.text:
Is soil just crushed rock?

Nope! Soil is a cool mix of weathered minerals, decaying organic matter, water, and trapped air!
statements.tl:
Durog na bato lang ba ang lupa?

Hindi! Ang lupa ay halo-halong weathered minerals, decaying organic matter, tubig, at nakulong na hangin!

statements.text: Volcanic ash is actually useful! After many years, it breaks down into the soil and brings mineral nutrients. That is why land near volcanoes is super fertile and great for farming!
statements.tl: Ang volcanic ash ay kapaki-pakinabang! Pagkalipas ng maraming taon, nababasag ito sa lupa at nagdadala ng mga sustansyang mineral. Kaya ang lupa malapit sa bulkan ay mataba at maganda para sa pagsasaka!

statements.text: Abrasion breaks rocks as fragments rub against each other in moving water like streams and rivers.
statements.tl: Ang abrasion ay nagbabasag ng mga bato habang ang mga piraso nito ay nagkikiskisan sa isa't isa sa umaagos na tubig tulad ng mga sapa at ilog.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Fzj1MNl0oS5h2DLBDQLzHYfah9jA_afM), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Rocks crumble into smaller fragments or fine particles known as soil.
statements.tl: Ang mga bato ay gumuguho sa mas maliliit na piraso o pinong mga particle na kilala bilang lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Fzj1MNl0oS5h2DLBDQLzHYfah9jA_afM), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Parent rock is made of large or slightly broken rocks and lacks the humus found in topsoil.
statements.tl: Ang parent rock ay gawa sa malalaki o bahagyang basag na mga bato at walang humus na nasa topsoil.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Za94nzfB57w5kaaNAZF3_72VizGfkzAZ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Rocks are made of grains of minerals, and over time these rocks break down into smaller pieces that become soil.
statements.tl: Ang mga bato ay binubuo ng mga grain ng minerals, at sa paglipas ng panahon, ang mga batong ito ay nadudurog at nagiging lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p0ox-Tii6r0meLth3M0lBb1BmLlCk2Gb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Lichens are among the very first living things to grow on bare rock, slowly breaking it down to help form soil for other plants.
statements.tl: Ang mga lichen ay kabilang sa mga unang nabubuhay sa hubad na bato, at unti-unti nilang dinudurog ito upang makabuo ng lupa para sa ibang halaman.

statements.text:
What's the first life to grow on rock?

Lichens are among the first living things to grow on bare rock, slowly breaking it down to help start new soil!
statements.tl:
Ano ang unang tumutubo sa bato?

Ang lichen ay isa sa unang bagay na tumutubo sa hubad na bato, dahan-dahan itong dinudurog para makatulong magsimula ang lupa!

statements.text:
What's the first living thing to grow on bare rock?

Lichen is usually the very first organism to grow on bare rock! It slowly wears down the rock's surface, turning it into soil where other plants can finally grow.
statements.tl:
Ano ang unang tumutubo sa hubad na bato?

Ang lichen ang karaniwang unang organismong tumutubo sa hubad na bato! Dahan-dahan nitong dinudurog ang ibabaw ng bato, at nagiging lupa ito kung saan makakapagtubo na ang ibang halaman.

statements.text: When water seeps into a rock crack and freezes, it expands and pushes the sides apart, slowly breaking the rock into pieces over time!
statements.tl: Kapag pumasok ang tubig sa bitak ng bato at nagyelo, lumalaki ito at itinutulak ang mga gilid, dahan-dahang binabasag ang bato sa paglipas ng panahon!

statements.text: Water in rock cracks freezes and expands, forcing cracks wider to split the rock. This amazing process is called frost weathering!
statements.tl: Ang tubig sa mga bitak ng bato ay lumalawak kapag nagyelo, pinipilit ang bitak na lumaki para mabasag ang bato. Ito ay frost weathering!

statements.text: Citrine is the beautiful yellow or golden variety of the mineral quartz!
statements.tl: Ang citrine ay ang magandang kulay-dilaw o gintong uri ng quartz!

statements.text:
What happens to the large limestone rocks at the cliffs of El Nido?

Strong waves crash against them! This physically breaks the large solid rocks into smaller pebbles and sand.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa malalaking bato ng limestone sa mga bangin ng El Nido?

Binabangga sila ng malalakas na alon! Physical na binabasag nito ang malalaking bato sa mas maliliit na pebbles at buhangin.

statements.text:
How can water break apart solid rocks?

In the rock cycle, physical weathering happens when water freezes inside granite cracks. The freezing water expands, pushing the solid rock apart!
statements.tl:
Paano kayang basagin ng tubig ang matitigas na bato?

Sa rock cycle, nangyayari ang physical weathering kapag nagyeyelo ang tubig sa mga bitak ng granite. Lumalawak ang yelo, kaya nagkakalas ang matigas na bato!

statements.text:
How does freezing water break solid rocks during physical weathering?

In the rock cycle, freezing water inside cracks expands and breaks solid rocks like granite!
statements.tl:
Paano binabasag ng freezing water ang matitigas na bato during physical weathering?

Sa rock cycle, ang freezing water sa cracks ay lumalawak at binabasag ang solid rocks tulad ng granite!

statements.text:
How do big solid rocks become tiny soil particles?

In the rock cycle, wind and liquid water break solid rocks into smaller soil particles through a process called weathering.
statements.tl:
Paano nagiging maliliit na butil ng lupa ang malalaking bato?

Sa rock cycle, hinahati ng hangin at likidong tubig ang matitigas na bato sa mas maliliit na butil ng lupa sa prosesong tinatawag na weathering.

statements.text: Erosion is the carrying away of broken rock and soil by water, wind, or ice to a completely new place!
statements.tl: Ang erosion ay ang pagdadala ng mga durog na bato at lupa palayo ng tubig, hangin, o yelo patungo sa ibang lugar!

statements.text: A glacier is a huge mass of ice that slowly moves and carves out wide valleys as it drags rock!
statements.tl: Ang glacier ay malaking masa ng yelo na dahan-dahang gumagalaw at umuukit ng malalawak na lambak habang dinadala nito ang bato!
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 4C/M2b (glacial ice carves and carries material)

statements.text: Soil erosion happens when wind or water carries away topsoil, and it can reduce the land's ability to grow plants and support agriculture.
statements.tl: Ang soil erosion ay nangyayari kapag tinatangay ng hangin o tubig ang pang-ibabaw na lupa, at nababawasan nito ang kakayahan ng lupa na magpatubo ng halaman at suportahan ang agrikultura.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12RIQW0JsfoCFULxYyBTkyLFNWrXV1t6e), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Erosion carries broken pieces of rock to new places, and these transported pieces are called sediments.
statements.tl: Ang erosion ay nagdadala ng mga piraso ng bato sa ibang lugar, at ang mga pirasong ito ay tinatawag na sediments.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p0ox-Tii6r0meLth3M0lBb1BmLlCk2Gb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Sediments are the materials like rock fragments and soil that are transported by erosion.
statements.tl: Ang sediments ay ang mga materyales tulad ng mga piraso ng bato at lupa na dinadala ng erosion.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-18887), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Water is a major agent of soil erosion, carrying away soil and rock fragments as it flows.
statements.tl: Ang tubig ay isang pangunahing agent ng soil erosion, dinadala nito ang lupa at mga piraso ng bato habang umaagos.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-18887), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Wind is an agent of soil erosion when it carries rock pieces and soil to other places.
statements.tl: Ang hangin ay isang agent ng soil erosion kapag dinadala nito ang mga piraso ng bato at lupa sa ibang lugar.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-18887), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When heavy rain falls on land with no plants left, soil washes into rivers and the sea — smothering coral reefs and lowering water quality.
statements.tl: Kapag umuulan nang malakas sa lupang walang halaman, natatangay ang lupa papunta sa ilog at dagat — natatakpan nito ang coral reef at bumababa ang kalidad ng tubig.

statements.text: Ipil-ipil trees are planted in rows on hillsides to stop soil erosion — their roots hold the soil firmly in place.
statements.tl: Itinatanim ang ipil-ipil sa hilera sa mga burol para pigilan ang pagguho ng lupa, dahil hinahawakan ng ugat nito ang lupa.

statements.text: The ocean is salty because rivers carry minerals and salt from land and rocks into it over a very long time!
statements.tl: Maalat ang dagat dahil dala-dala ng mga ilog ang mga mineral at asin mula sa lupa at bato sa napakahabang panahon!

statements.text: In the rock cycle, sedimentation happens when flowing water carries solid sand and gravel to settle at the river bottom!
statements.tl: Sa rock cycle, nangyayari ang sedimentation kapag dinadala ng dumadaloy na tubig ang buhangin at graba para lumapag sa ilalim ng ilog!

statements.text: The white sedimentary rocks of Kapurpurawan experience physical change! Strong wind and water waves erode them into smooth shapes.
statements.tl: Ang puting sedimentary rocks ng Kapurpurawan ay nagbabago! Matinding hangin at alon ang nag-ero sa kanila hanggang maging makinis.

statements.text:
What happens to a dam's reservoir over time?

Over time, mud and silt carried by the river slowly fill the reservoir, reducing the water it can store for electricity!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa lawa ng dam sa paglipas ng panahon?

Unti-unting pinupuno ng putik at latak na dala ng ilog ang lawa, na nagpapababa ng tubig na maaaring iimbak para sa kuryente!

statements.text: River rocks become smooth and rounded over time! Flowing water and friction with other rocks gradually wear down their rough edges.
statements.tl: Ang mga bato sa ilog ay nagiging makinis at bilugan sa paglipas ng panahon! Unti-unting pinupudpod ng daloy ng tubig at friction sa ibang bato ang magagaspang na gilid.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; NRC ESS2.A; DepEd G5 Science

statements.text:
How do weathering and erosion change the land?

Weathering slowly breaks rocks using water, wind, or temperature! Erosion moves those broken pieces to new places, changing the land's shape over time.
statements.tl:
Paano binabago ng weathering at erosion ang lupa?

Ang weathering ay dahan-dahang dumudurog ng bato gamit ang tubig, hangin, o temperatura! Ang erosion ay naglilipat ng mga durog na piraso, nagbabago ng hugis ng lupa.

statements.text:
Can sand dunes actually move?

Yes, big sand hills called sand dunes slowly move! Wind pushes sand grains up one side, and they tumble down the other, making the whole dune travel.
statements.tl:
Gumagalaw ba talaga ang mga sand dunes?

Oo, dahan-dahang gumagalaw ang malalaking tumpok ng buhangin na tinatawag na sand dunes! Itinutulak ng hangin ang butil paitaas sa isang gilid at pababa sa kabila, kaya naglalakbay ang buong bunton ng buhangin.

statements.text: Erosion is when heavy rain and strong wind wash away our rich and healthy topsoil!
statements.tl: Ang erosion ay nangyayari kapag ang malakas na ulan at hangin ay tumatangay ng matabang topsoil!

statements.text: The gold in rivers actually comes from rocks! Flowing water slowly wears the rocks away to release it.
statements.tl: Ang ginto sa ilog ay galing sa mga bato! Unti-unting kinakain ng umaagos na tubig ang mga bato para lumabas ito.

statements.text: When an ice cube melts from solid to liquid, its total mass stays exactly the same!
statements.tl: Kapag natunaw ang ice cube mula sa solid papuntang liquid, ang total mass ay nananatiling pareho!

statements.text: Water molecules can evaporate into a gas at room temperature without even reaching the boiling point!
statements.tl: Kaya ng mga molekula ng tubig na mag-evaporate at maging gas sa room temperature, hindi na kailangang umabot sa boiling point!

statements.text: Morning fog in Baguio City forms when warm, moist air cools down and condenses!
statements.tl: Ang umaga na fog sa Baguio City ay nabubuo kapag ang mainit at mahalumigmig na hangin ay lumalamig at nagko-condense!

statements.text: During evaporation, a liquid changes into gas or vapor when it is heated, and this gas rises into the air.
statements.tl: Sa evaporation, ang liquid ay nagiging gas o vapor kapag ito ay nainitan, at ang gas na ito ay tumataas sa hangin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15w5PXh-RJNCw0UBoYEOLXOIhT8dP42dW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A phase change flowchart uses arrows to show the direction matter changes, like solid to liquid for melting and liquid to gas for evaporation.
statements.tl: Ang phase change flowchart ay gumagamit ng mga arrow para ipakita ang direksyon ng pagbabago ng matter, tulad ng solid papuntang liquid para sa melting at liquid papuntang gas para sa evaporation.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JXL65i5_vZGjj3uVhy-MXpK4nYRVnVb1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The melting point is the temperature at which a solid material changes from solid state to a liquid, or melts.
statements.tl: Ang melting point ay ang temperatura kung saan ang isang solidong materyal ay nagbabago mula solid patungong likido, o natutunaw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PwjUW3R405DUgGyXVaGHlwEyATnierCG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Volatility is the tendency of a liquid to evaporate or turn into gas, and acetone is more volatile than water because it dries up much faster.
statements.tl: Ang volatility ay ang tendensya ng isang liquid na mag-evaporate o maging gas, at ang acetone ay mas volatile kaysa tubig dahil mas mabilis itong matuyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1eA7gMm2xFJfapSa3sCYHxZaKQnvEochN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Drying clothes on a clothesline is an example of evaporation, where the water in the clothes turns into gas and disappears into the air.
statements.tl: Ang pagsasampay ng mga damit sa sampayan ay isang halimbawa ng evaporation, kung saan ang tubig sa mga damit ay nagiging gas at nawawala sa hangin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1gikwPP2s6k4s-1e3Jv5jOhTtgffUn41J), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Butter, ice cream, ice cubes, crayons, and candles can melt when they are heated.
statements.tl: Ang butter, ice cream, ice cubes, crayons, at kandila ay maaaring matunaw kapag sila ay nainitan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1i3P_q-mQqwvUrJO_E1RFPaqVCA3s4X94), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Freezing happens by decreasing the temperature of a liquid material until it hardens and changes into a solid.
statements.tl: Ang freezing ay nangyayari sa pamamagitan ng pagpapababa ng temperature ng isang liquid na materyal hanggang sa ito ay tumigas at maging solid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1i3P_q-mQqwvUrJO_E1RFPaqVCA3s4X94), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why does a fan cool you down?

Moving air from a fan helps sweat evaporate faster, so your body cools down more quickly.
statements.tl:
Bakit mas malamig kapag may pamaypay?

Tumutulong ang hangin ng pamaypay para mas mabilis sumingaw ang pawis, kaya mas mabilis lumalamig ang katawan.

statements.text:
Why do we feel hotter on humid days?

Humid air already holds lots of water, so our sweat evaporates slowly — the body cools less and we feel even hotter!
statements.tl:
Bakit mas mainit ang pakiramdam sa basang hangin?

Puno na ng tubig ang basang hangin, kaya mabagal sumingaw ang pawis natin — mas mahirap lumamig ang katawan at parang mas mainit ang pakiramdam!

statements.text: Sweat travels up tiny openings called pores to reach the skin's surface, where it spreads out before evaporating.
statements.tl: Umaakyat ang pawis sa maliliit na butas na tinatawag na pores papunta sa ibabaw ng balat, kung saan ito kumakalat bago sumingaw.

statements.text: In the hot, humid Philippines we sweat a lot to cool down — but the moist air makes sweat evaporate slowly, so we may not feel cool right away!
statements.tl: Sa mainit at maalinsangan na Pilipinas, madalas tayong pumawis para lumamig — pero dahil basa na rin ang hangin, mabagal sumingaw ang pawis, kaya di tayo agad presko!

statements.text:
Why doesn't your eye dry out fast?

A thin oily layer sits on top of your tears like a lid, stopping the water underneath from evaporating quickly—so your eye stays wet even between blinks.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi agad natutuyo ang mata mo?

May manipis na langis sa ibabaw ng luha na parang takip, pumipigil sa tubig na sumingaw agad—kaya nananatiling basa ang mata mo kahit hindi ka palaging kumukurap.

statements.text: Matter isn't lost when its state changes! Melted ice in a sealed container has the same mass because the number of particles stays the same.
statements.tl: Hindi nawawala ang matter kapag nagbabago ang state nito! Ang natunaw na yelo sa saradong lalagyan ay may parehong mass dahil pareho pa rin ang dami ng particle.

statements.text:
Why does a puddle of water on the road dry up?

It dries up because the water slowly evaporates into the air!
statements.tl:
Bakit natutuyo ang tubig sa kalsada?

Natutuyo ito dahil dahan-dahang sumisingaw ang tubig sa hangin!

statements.text:
Does water need to boil to evaporate?

Nope! Evaporation happens only at the surface of the water, even when the water is not boiling!
statements.tl:
Kailangan bang kumulo ang tubig para sumingaw?

Hindi! Ang pagsingaw ay nangyayari lamang sa ibabaw ng tubig, kahit hindi ito kumukulo!

statements.text: Blood carries oxygen and nutrients to every part of your body.
statements.tl: Ang dugo ang nagdadala ng oxygen at sustansya sa bawat bahagi ng katawan.

statements.text:
What do arteries do?

Arteries carry blood away from your heart and out to the rest of your body!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ginagawa ng arterya?

Dinadala ng arterya ang dugo palabas mula sa puso patungo sa buong katawan!

statements.text: Hypertension is when the force of blood pushing against your vessel walls is consistently too high, making the heart work harder and possibly leading to stroke or heart failure.
statements.tl: Ang hypertension ay kapag ang lakas ng pagtulak ng dugo sa mga dingding ng ugat ay palaging masyadong mataas, kaya mas nahihirapan ang puso at maaaring mauwi sa stroke o heart failure.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SHMpBY-LDiMWzop7keknsWbyhnrZtUER), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Blood vessels are the pathways, like roads in a city, that carry blood throughout the body.
statements.tl: Ang blood vessels ang mga daanan, parang mga kalsada sa isang lungsod, na nagdadala ng dugo sa buong katawan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SlarzgwYSuW9SVThB6tXh_rt8lkCcU_m), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Physical activity increases heart rate, which you can feel as a faster pulse at your wrist.
statements.tl: Ang physical activity ay nagpapabilis ng heart rate, na mararamdaman mo bilang mas mabilis na pulse sa iyong pulso.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SlarzgwYSuW9SVThB6tXh_rt8lkCcU_m), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Arteries have thick, muscular walls to withstand the high pressure of blood pumped from the heart.
statements.tl: Ang arteries ay may makakapal at muscular na pader upang makayanan ang mataas na pressure ng dugo na binobomba mula sa puso.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SlarzgwYSuW9SVThB6tXh_rt8lkCcU_m), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The heart pumps thousands of liters of blood into all parts of the body every day.
statements.tl: Ang puso ay nagbobomba ng libo-libong litro ng dugo sa lahat ng bahagi ng katawan araw-araw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SlarzgwYSuW9SVThB6tXh_rt8lkCcU_m), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What are the two major veins that return blood to the heart?

The superior vena cava drains the upper body and the inferior vena cava drains the lower body, both emptying into the right atrium!
statements.tl:
Ano ang dalawang pangunahing veins na nagbabalik ng dugo sa puso?

Ang superior vena cava ay nagdadala ng dugo mula sa itaas na bahagi ng katawan at ang inferior vena cava mula sa ibabang bahagi, parehong pumapasok sa right atrium!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SlarzgwYSuW9SVThB6tXh_rt8lkCcU_m), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Blood carries oxygen and nutrients and helps remove wastes from the body, keeping the inside clean.
statements.tl: Ang dugo ay nagdadala ng oxygen at nutrients at tumutulong mag-alis ng mga dumi mula sa katawan, kaya nananatiling malinis ang loob nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1flnVZiSU9TViRdA7SdAMUHCTl_AQXiCm), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Arteries branch into smaller vessels called arterioles, which then enter tissues and branch into the smallest blood vessels, the capillaries.
statements.tl: Ang arteries ay sumasanga sa mas maliliit na vessels na tinatawag na arterioles, na pumapasok sa tissues at sumasanga sa pinakamaliit na blood vessels, ang capillaries.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qM1AjLxGzXE5df8AXKo-XJxgzEUVP0Zg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Systemic circulation sends blood from the left side of the heart to all body parts except the lungs, then back to the right side.
statements.tl: Ang systemic circulation ay nagpapadala ng dugo mula sa kaliwang bahagi ng puso papunta sa lahat ng bahagi ng katawan maliban sa baga, pagkatapos ay pabalik sa kanang bahagi.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-19555), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Red blood cells are tiny biconcave disks, shaped like donuts without a hole, which helps them carry more oxygen.
statements.tl: Ang red blood cells ay maliliit na biconcave disks, hugis donut na walang butas, na tumutulong sa kanila na magdala ng mas maraming oxygen.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-19555), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Where do gases and nutrients actually get exchanged in the body?

In the capillaries, the smallest blood vessels that connect the smallest arteries to the smallest veins!
statements.tl:
Saan ba talaga nagpapalitan ang mga gases at nutrients sa katawan?

Sa capillaries, ang pinakamaliliit na blood vessels na nagdudugtong sa pinakamaliliit na arteries sa pinakamaliliit na veins!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-25237), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The atria are the receiving chambers of the heart: blood from the body enters the right atrium and blood from the lungs enters the left atrium.
statements.tl: Ang atria ay ang receiving chambers ng puso: tumatanggap ng dugo mula sa katawan papunta sa right atrium at mula sa baga papunta sa left atrium.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-25237), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Carbon dioxide is given off when cells release energy, and the blood delivers this carbon dioxide to the right portion of the heart to be pumped to the lungs.
statements.tl: Ang carbon dioxide ay inilalabas kapag naglalabas ng enerhiya ang mga cells, at dinadala ng dugo ang carbon dioxide na ito sa kanang bahagi ng puso para ibomba sa baga.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-25237), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What makes your heart keep beating on its own?

Your heart has its own tiny electrical signal made by a part called the pacemaker—it tells your heart to beat on its own, even when you're not thinking about it!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagpapatibok sa puso kahit hindi mo iniisip?

May sarili itong parang 'kuryente' na ginagawa ng maliit na bahagi ng puso na tinatawag na pacemaker—ito ang nagpapatibok dito kahit hindi mo iniisip o inuutusan!

statements.text: Red blood cells are your body's delivery trucks — they carry oxygen from your lungs all the way to every part of your body.
statements.tl: Ang pulang selula ng dugo ay parang mga delivery truck — dala nila ang oxygen mula sa baga papunta sa buong katawan mo.

statements.text: White blood cells are your body's soldiers — they hunt down and destroy the germs that try to make you sick.
statements.tl: Ang puting selula ng dugo ang mga sundalo ng katawan — hinahanap nila at pinapatay ang mga germ na sumusubok magpasakit sa iyo.

statements.text: Seeds come from a plant's flower and are often found inside its fruit.
statements.tl: Ang mga buto ay nagmumula sa bulaklak ng halaman at madalas matatagpuan sa loob ng prutas.

statements.text: Kamote and cassava are usually grown from a piece of stem or cutting, not from seeds!
statements.tl: Ang kamote at cassava ay madalas itinatanim mula sa piraso ng tangkay o sanga, hindi mula sa buto!

statements.text:
What is pollination?

It's when pollen from a flower's stamens reaches the stigma of a flower. Bees, wind, and other insects are the tiny helpers that carry the pollen from one flower to another.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pollination?

Ito ay kapag ang pollen mula sa stamens ay napupunta sa stigma ng bulaklak. Ang mga pukyutan, hangin, at ibang insekto ang tumutulong magdala ng pollen mula bulaklak papuntang bulaklak.

statements.text:
What is germination?

Germination is when a seed starts to grow into a new plant.
statements.tl:
Ano ang germination?

Ang germination ay ang pagsisimula ng pagtubo ng binhi para maging bagong halaman.

statements.text:
Why did Mendel choose garden peas for his experiments?

Garden peas have several easy-to-study traits, they grow quickly, and they can reproduce through self-pollination.
statements.tl:
Bakit garden peas ang pinili ni Mendel para sa kanyang mga eksperimento?

Ang garden peas ay may ilang madaling pag-aralang katangian, mabilis tumubo, at kaya nilang magparami sa pamamagitan ng self-pollination.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16DvTOACFxsb4TUvvlzSyNOKbdCeAiMbx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A fruit is the ripened ovary of a flower, which means it is the part that grew and swelled around the seeds after fertilization.
statements.tl: Ang bunga ay ang ripened ovary ng bulaklak, ibig sabihin ito ang bahaging lumaki at bumukol sa paligid ng mga buto pagkatapos ng fertilization.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ARpJ81MwhDzee2vUGsdFtQpT3jEgELGy), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Banana plants reproduce through suckers, which are upright shoots that grow from buds at the base of the parent stem.
statements.tl: Ang banana plants ay nagpaparami sa pamamagitan ng suckers, na mga tuwid na shoot na tumutubo mula sa mga bud sa base ng stem ng parent plant.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GA1do9DktUoJfHmsQMsNkps6uWZeoEai), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The Kataka-taka plant grows plantlets, which are small new plants that appear on the edges of its leaves.
statements.tl: Ang halamang Kataka-taka ay nagpapatubo ng plantlets, na maliliit na bagong halaman na lumilitaw sa mga gilid ng dahon nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GA1do9DktUoJfHmsQMsNkps6uWZeoEai), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Vegetative propagation allows plants to reach maturity faster than plants grown from seeds, and it keeps the same good agricultural traits like taste and yield.
statements.tl: Ang vegetative propagation ay nagpapahintulot sa mga halaman na mas mabilis na umabot sa maturity kaysa sa mga halamang mula sa buto, at napapanatili nito ang parehong magagandang katangiang pang-agrikultura tulad ng lasa at ani.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GQmxhExnxB89Wkrpnkrp62rlrE5sw8Gc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Removing the lower leaves from a cutting helps it save energy for growing roots, and dipping the cut end in rooting hormone can speed up root growth.
statements.tl: Ang pag-alis ng mga dahon sa ibaba ng cutting ay nakakatulong para makatipid ito ng enerhiya sa pagpapatubo ng ugat, at ang pagsawsaw sa rooting hormone ay makakapagpabilis ng pagtubo ng ugat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IIQpgv8y3ohKeHt1pG_SHU-odhzmgJiv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The layered branch needs regular watering to keep the soil moist while it develops roots, and you should observe it over time to monitor root growth.
statements.tl: Ang layered na sanga ay nangangailangan ng regular na pagdidilig para manatiling basa ang lupa habang ito ay nagpapatubo ng ugat, at dapat mo itong obserbahan sa paglipas ng panahon para masubaybayan ang pagtubo ng ugat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IIQpgv8y3ohKeHt1pG_SHU-odhzmgJiv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Plants reproduce through seeds that germinate, meaning the seed cracks open and a tiny root and shoot emerge, then the seedling grows into a mature plant.
statements.tl: Ang mga halaman ay nagpaparami sa pamamagitan ng mga buto na gumegerminate, ibig sabihin bumibitak ang buto at lumalabas ang maliit na ugat at shoot, pagkatapos ang seedling ay lumalaki bilang mature na halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1J4b7Zhoxa3U-lH-CMdVXykZxsYapMdzp), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Fertilization happens when one sperm cell unites with one egg cell in the ovule, forming a fertilized egg that can grow into a seed.
statements.tl: Nangyayari ang fertilization kapag ang isang sperm cell ay nakikipag-isa sa isang egg cell sa ovule, na bumubuo ng fertilized egg na maaaring maging buto.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1NySrhe73k7fMUgGROXR99UXSz1i3CSsD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Layering is a method where a stem is covered with soil until it grows roots, then it is cut from the parent plant and planted in a new location.
statements.tl: Ang layering ay paraan kung saan tinatakpan ng lupa ang isang stem hanggang tumubo ito ng ugat, pagkatapos ay pinuputol mula sa parent plant at itinatanim sa bagong lugar.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1c4-mRHviyTmr7YWOsWozdOmZHgC20gB6), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Budding is done by making a T-shaped cut in the stem of a parent plant and inserting a mature bud called a scion under the bark.
statements.tl: Ang budding ay ginagawa sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng T-shaped cut sa stem ng parent plant at pagpasok ng mature bud na tinatawag na scion sa ilalim ng bark.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1c4-mRHviyTmr7YWOsWozdOmZHgC20gB6), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The seed protects the tiny embryo plant inside it and stores food for the embryo until it is ready to germinate.
statements.tl: Pinoprotektahan ng seed ang maliit na embryo plant sa loob nito at nag-iimbak ng pagkain para sa embryo hanggang handa na itong tumubo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dCuqCT9lLxiXcuVYVzIhEbSIJnLZNI3c), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Stolons are stems that grow horizontally along or just below the soil surface, and they can produce new plants at their tips, like Bermuda grass and strawberries.
statements.tl: Ang stolons ay mga stem na tumutubo nang pahalang sa ibabaw o bahagyang ilalim ng lupa, at maaari silang gumawa ng mga bagong halaman sa kanilang mga dulo, tulad ng Bermuda grass at strawberries.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dCuqCT9lLxiXcuVYVzIhEbSIJnLZNI3c), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Farmers and gardeners choose between seeds and methods like cuttings or grafting to grow crops faster, keep good traits, or create new plant varieties.
statements.tl: Pinipili ng mga magsasaka at hardinero ang pagitan ng buto at mga paraan tulad ng cuttings o grafting upang mapabilis ang pagpapatubo ng mga pananim, mapanatili ang magagandang katangian, o makalikha ng mga bagong variety ng halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dGxuaeN9MY5hKYq0xb0UQPXDuFpqRbWS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In layering, a branch is bent down and covered with soil while still attached to the parent plant, and it grows roots right there.
statements.tl: Sa layering, ang isang sanga ay binabaluktot pababa at tinatabunan ng lupa habang nakakabit pa sa magulang na halaman, at doon mismo ito tumutubo ng mga ugat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17rviy3E-k9GdJJGe_w4NdPKO-GvpIVcm), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Budding is done by making a T-shaped cut in the stem of a parent plant and inserting a mature bud called a scion under the bark.
statements.tl: Ang budding ay ginagawa sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng T-shaped cut sa stem ng parent plant at pagpasok ng mature bud na tinatawag na scion sa ilalim ng bark.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1c4-mRHviyTmr7YWOsWozdOmZHgC20gB6), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Kamote and cassava are usually grown from a piece of stem or cutting, not from seeds!
statements.tl: Ang kamote at cassava ay madalas itinatanim mula sa piraso ng tangkay o sanga, hindi mula sa buto!

statements.text: In grafting, parts of two plants are joined to grow as one, like attaching a shoot of one tree onto another tree's trunk.
statements.tl: Sa grafting, pinagdurugtong ang bahagi ng dalawang halaman para lumaki bilang isa, gaya ng pagdikit ng sanga sa katawan ng ibang puno.

statements.text: Doing at least three trials, or replication, makes a fair test more reliable because similar results each time show the outcome was not just luck.
statements.tl: Ang paggawa ng hindi bababa sa tatlong trials, o replication, ay nagpapaganda sa pagiging maaasahan ng fair test dahil ang magkakatulad na resulta ay nagpapatunay na hindi ito tsamba lang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 182TIOnxSBmc2-60rTNPz2NaGOOivCpQd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A fair test in a scientific investigation keeps all environmental conditions the same for each group of plants, so only the propagation method being tested is different.
statements.tl: Sa isang fair test sa scientific investigation, pinananatiling pareho ang lahat ng kondisyon ng kapaligiran para sa bawat grupo ng mga halaman, kaya ang paraan lang ng propagation na sinusuri ang naiiba.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1F1Z7UMz74NDQ83Mo42Dr35HJTsdVYvTf), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Replication in a scientific investigation means repeating the experiment with multiple plants for each propagation method, so results are more reliable.
statements.tl: Ang replication sa scientific investigation ay nangangahulugang inuulit ang eksperimento gamit ang maraming halaman para sa bawat paraan ng propagation, kaya mas maaasahan ang mga resulta.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1F1Z7UMz74NDQ83Mo42Dr35HJTsdVYvTf), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Many animals around us -- milkfish, the maya bird, dogs, carabaos, and frogs -- are all vertebrates because they have a backbone!
statements.tl: Marami sa mga hayop sa ating paligid -- bangus, maya, aso, kalabaw, palaka -- ay vertebrates dahil may gulugod sila!

statements.text: Animals with no backbone — like insects, worms, and shrimp — are all called invertebrates.
statements.tl: Ang mga hayop na walang gulugod — gaya ng insekto, bulate, at hipon — ay tinatawag na invertebrate.

statements.text: A vertebrate is any animal with a backbone inside its body, like a dog, a fish, or a bird.
statements.tl: Ang vertebrate ay hayop na may gulugod sa loob ng katawan, gaya ng aso, isda, o ibon.

statements.text: Poriferans, like sponges, are simple invertebrates covered in tiny pores that let water flow through their bodies.
statements.tl: Ang mga poriferan, gaya ng sponge, ay mga simpleng invertebrate na puno ng maliliit na pores na nagpapadaan ng tubig sa kanilang katawan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qhpqGgYo6UUHDqQHtqyJiguKeo4NzR1R), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Which backboned animal lives the longest?

The Greenland shark is believed to live more than 300 years, growing so slowly in the cold ocean that it may be the longest-living animal with a backbone.
statements.tl:
Aling hayop na may gulugod ang pinakamatagal mabuhay?

Ang Greenland shark ay pinaniniwalaang nabubuhay ng mahigit 300 taon dahil sa napakabagal nitong paglaki sa malamig na karagatan — marahil ang pinakamatagal mabuhay na hayop na may gulugod.

statements.text: There are many invertebrates all around us too, like ants, mosquitoes, spiders, snails, crabs, and shrimp — none of them have a backbone.
statements.tl: Marami ring invertebrate sa ating paligid, gaya ng langgam, lamok, gagamba, kuhol, alimango, at hipon — wala silang gulugod.

statements.text:
What is an invertebrate?

An invertebrate is an animal without a backbone — like an insect, a worm, or a shrimp.
statements.tl:
Ano ang invertebrate?

Ang invertebrate ay hayop na walang gulugod (backbone), gaya ng insekto, bulate, at hipon.

statements.text:
Is a starfish really a fish?

No! A sea star has no backbone or fins like a fish, which is why scientists call it a 'sea star' instead.
statements.tl:
Isda ba talaga ang starfish?

Hindi! Wala itong buto o palikpik na katulad ng isda, kaya mas tama itong tawaging 'sea star'.

statements.text: There are five main classes of vertebrates — animals with backbones: fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals!
statements.tl: May limang pangunahing klase ng vertebrate — mga hayop na may gulugod: isda, amphibian, reptile, ibon, at mammal!

statements.text: An invertebrate is an animal with NO backbone — like worms, snails, crabs, and insects. More than 9 out of every 10 animals on Earth are invertebrates!
statements.tl: Ang invertebrate ay hayop na walang gulugod — gaya ng bulate, kuhol, alimango, at insekto. Higit sa 9 sa bawat 10 hayop sa mundo ay invertebrate!
statements.source: AAAS BSL Ch.5 (diversity of life); NRC LS4.D

statements.text:
How can an octopus squeeze through tiny gaps?

Since it has no bones, an octopus can squeeze its soft body through any gap as small as its beak — the only hard part of its body!
statements.tl:
Paano kasya ang pugita sa maliit na siwang?

Dahil walang buto, kaya ng pugita na ipasok ang malambot nitong katawan sa siwang na kasinlaki lang ng tuka nito — ang tanging matigas na bahagi nito!

statements.text:
Is a turtle's shell like a crab's?

No — a turtle's shell is bone covered in skin, but a crab has no bones inside; its hard outer crust is its skeleton.
statements.tl:
Magkatulad ba ang talukab ng pagong at ng alimango?

Hindi — ang talukab ng pagong ay buto na may balat sa labas, pero ang alimango ay walang buto sa loob — ang matigas nitong balat ang siyang skeleton.

statements.text:
What's the smartest animal without a backbone?

The octopus! It's one of the smartest invertebrates and can even solve problems.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pinakamatalinong hayop na walang gulugod?

Ang pugita! Isa ito sa pinakamatalinong walang gulugod, at marunong itong lumutas ng mga suliranin.

statements.text:
Is the cuttlebone really a backbone?

People think the cuttlebone is like our backbone, but it's not! Cuttlefish have no spine at all — the cuttlebone actually just helps them float.
statements.tl:
Gulugod ba talaga ang cuttlebone?

Akala ng marami parang gulugod natin ang cuttlebone, pero hindi! Walang gulugod ang cuttlefish — pantulong lang ang cuttlebone para makalutang ito.

statements.text:
Is a crab a fish?

Nope! A fish has bones or cartilage inside and fins outside, but a crab has no inner bones—its hard shell is on the outside, with claws and many legs!
statements.tl:
Isda ba ang alimango?

Hindi pala! May buto o kartilago ang isda sa loob at palikpik sa labas, pero ang alimango ay walang buto sa loob—matigas na balat ang nasa labas nito, may sipit at maraming paa!

statements.text: A crab has no bones inside its body—instead, its hard outer shell supports it!
statements.tl: Ang alimango ay walang buto sa loob ng katawan—sa halip, ang matigas nitong balat ang sumusuporta rito!

statements.text: Humans are vertebrates too — we have a backbone in our spine, just like fish, birds, and dogs.
statements.tl: Vertebrate din ang tao — may gulugod tayo sa ating likod, tulad ng isda, ibon, at aso.

statements.text:
Does a jellyfish have a brain?

No! A jellyfish has no bones and no brain at all — that's why its whole body is soft.
statements.tl:
May utak ba ang dikya?

Wala! Ang dikya ay walang buto at walang utak, kaya malambot ang buong katawan nito.

statements.text: When water vapor condenses back into liquid, it actually releases a cozy burst of heat into the surrounding air!
statements.tl: Kapag namumuo ang singaw pabalik sa likido, naglalabas ito ng init sa paligid na hangin!

statements.text: Melting needs heat! That is why ice melts when its surroundings are warm.
statements.tl: Kailangan ng init para matunaw! Kaya natutunaw ang yelo kapag mainit ang paligid.
statements.source: NRC PS3.A energy and heat transfer; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
What is condensation?

Condensation is when water vapor, a gas, turns back into liquid water when it cools down!
statements.tl:
Ano ang paghalay?

Ang paghalay ay kapag ang singaw o gas ay nagiging likidong tubig kapag lumamig!

statements.text: A large part of the sun's energy reaching the sea surface is used in evaporation, which supplies moisture to typhoons.
statements.tl: Malaking bahagi ng energy ng araw na umaabot sa dagat ay ginagamit sa evaporation, na nagbibigay ng moisture sa mga bagyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Dv6qP76YdRMt23Bf2zj5GoCHy7vFmidY), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When butter or lard is heated near a flame, it absorbs heat and changes from a solid to a liquid.
statements.tl: Kapag ang butter o lard ay ininit malapit sa apoy, sumisipsip ito ng init at nagbabago mula solid patungong liquid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1WlUc-vwin-7tox1tG4razIHf_JZNq15n), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Changing states of matter happens when matter loses or absorbs energy, usually in the form of heat or thermal energy.
statements.tl: Ang pagbabago ng state ng matter ay nangyayari kapag ang matter ay nawalan o sumipsip ng energy, kadalasan sa anyo ng init o thermal energy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yWbcz4sDgd-YD5Cxmmb5_2N_2fQf32Jh), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why does sweating cool you down?

Turning sweat into vapor needs heat — so evaporation pulls that heat right from your skin, leaving you feeling cooler!
statements.tl:
Bakit lumalamig ang balat mo kapag nagpapawis?

Kailangan ng init para masingaw ang pawis — kaya kinukuha ng evaporation ang init mula sa iyong balat, na iniiwan itong mas malamig!
statements.source: AAAS BSL; physics of evaporative cooling

statements.text: When sweat evaporates from your skin, it takes heat away from your body with it, which cools you down.
statements.tl: Kapag sumisingaw ang pawis sa balat, nadadala nito ang init mula sa katawan, kaya tayo lumalamig.

statements.text:
How are evaporation and condensation related?

They are opposites! Heat causes evaporation, while cooling causes condensation.
statements.tl:
Paano magkaugnay ang pagsingaw at paghalay?

Magkasalungat sila! Ang init ay nagdudulot ng pagsingaw, at ang lamig ay nagdudulot ng paghalay.

statements.text:
Ever wonder why clothes dry so fast on a sunny day?

Water evaporates faster when it's hotter! The sun's heat makes the water turn into vapor quickly.
statements.tl:
Napapaisip ka ba kung bakit mabilis matuyo ang damit sa maaraw na araw?

Mas mabilis sumingaw ang tubig kapag mas mainit! Kaya mabilis matuyo ang mga damit sa araw.

statements.text:
Where does morning dew on the grass come from?

It forms when water vapor in the air cools down and turns into tiny water droplets!
statements.tl:
Saan nagmula ang hamog sa damo tuwing umaga?

Nabubuo ito kapag ang singaw sa hangin ay lumamig at naging mga patak ng tubig!

statements.text:
Why do we feel cooler when we sweat?

When sweat evaporates from our skin, it carries away heat, making us feel cooler!
statements.tl:
Bakit nakakaramdam tayo ng lamig kapag pinawisan?

Kapag sumingaw ang pawis sa ating balat, inaalis nito ang init, kaya nakakaramdam tayo ng lamig!

statements.text: Sweat cools you down! As it evaporates, it carries heat away from your skin and into the air.
statements.tl: Pinapalamig ka ng pawis! Kapag sumisingaw ito, dala-dala nito ang init mula sa balat mo papunta sa hangin.

statements.text: Fish dries much faster on sunny days! That's why it's hard to dry food when it's rainy or cool.
statements.tl: Mas mabilis matuyo ang isda kapag maaraw! Kaya mahirap magpatuyo kapag maulan o malamig ang panahon.

statements.text: Condensing is when a gas or steam cools down and magically turns into a liquid, just like morning dew!
statements.tl: Ang kondensasyon ay kapag ang gas o singaw ay lumalamig at nagiging likido, katulad ng mga hamog sa umaga!

statements.text:
How do you melt a solid?

You must add heat! Adding heat helps the solid change into a liquid.
statements.tl:
Paano matutunaw ang isang solido?

Kailangan mong bigyan ito ng init! Tumutulong ang init na baguhin ang solido tungo sa likido.

statements.text:
What does water need to do to freeze?

It must lose heat! Water needs to lose heat until it becomes very cold.
statements.tl:
Ano ang kailangan gawin ng tubig para mag-yelo?

Kailangan mawalan ito ng init! Lumalamig ito nang husto.

statements.text: Different materials melt at different temperatures! Wax melts easily with a little heat, but metal needs much more heat to melt.
statements.tl: Iba't ibang bagay ay natutunaw sa iba't ibang init! Mabilis matunaw ang kandila, ngunit mas mainit ang kailangan para sa metal.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; melting points vary by material

statements.text: Oxidation is a chemical change because it creates a brand new substance that cannot easily be turned back!
statements.tl: Ang oksihenasyon ay isang kemikal na pagbabago dahil gumagawa ito ng bagong sangkap na hindi na basta maibabalik!

statements.text:
Is melting a chocolate bar a chemical change?

Nope, it's a physical change! It only changes its state and forms no new substance.
statements.tl:
Ang pagtunaw ng chocolate bar ba ay chemical change?

Hindi, physical change iyan! Nagbabago lang ng estado at walang bagong substance na nabubuo.

statements.text:
Can melting and freezing be reversed?

Yes! Ice can become water, and water can become ice again.
statements.tl:
Pwede bang babaligtarin ang pagtunaw at pagyeyelo?

Oo! Pwedeng maging tubig ang yelo, at pwedeng maging yelo ulit ang tubig.
statements.source: NRC PS1.B reversible physical change; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: Chemical changes are generally irreversible, meaning the new substance cannot easily be turned back into the original materials.
statements.tl: Ang mga chemical change ay karaniwang irreversible, ibig sabihin ang bagong substance ay hindi madaling maibalik sa orihinal na mga materyales.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1DuoLolR1JszFvzSHEt0ZYM8HXdooqncD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A chemical change is a change in which at least one new substance forms, like a banana turning brown.
statements.tl: Ang chemical change ay pagbabago kung saan may nabubuong kahit isang bagong substance, tulad ng saging na nagiging kulay brown.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TWPNn_eVOFWneGPsmeg4whEowrdaYxyo), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Heating materials can cause a chemical change, which means a new kind of material is produced.
statements.tl: Ang pag-init ng mga materyales ay maaaring magdulot ng chemical change, ibig sabihin may nabubuong bagong uri ng materyal.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VnHPnOgQslhFKRbEg5TcfiyeaMSSuVoN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The ripening of a fruit is a chemical change because its color, taste, and odor change as new substances form inside it.
statements.tl: Ang paghinog ng prutas ay isang chemical change dahil ang kulay, lasa, at amoy nito ay nagbabago habang nabubuo ang mga bagong substance sa loob nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1p14fifuRi_R46pcCqk16LsU8_8PzgYx3), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a mixture, each substance keeps its own chemical identity, meaning it does not change into a new substance.
statements.tl: Sa isang mixture, napapanatili ng bawat substance ang sarili nitong chemical identity, ibig sabihin hindi ito nagbabago bilang bagong substance.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1x2jH-D-XKvvh9Vh94FCMhZgw1I_Kn2qc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What makes some animals glow in the dark?

It's a chemical reaction — a substance called luciferin combines with oxygen to produce their glowing light.
statements.tl:
Ano ang dahilan kaya nagniningning ang ilang hayop?

Isang reaksyong kemikal — ang sangkap na luciferin ay nakikipagsama sa oksiheno para makagawa ng kanilang ilaw.

statements.text:
Is rusting a chemical change?

Yes! It makes a new substance that cannot simply turn back into the original iron.
statements.tl:
Ang pagkakalawang ba ay isang pagbabagong kemikal?

Oo! Bumubuo ito ng bagong sangkap na hindi basta maibabalik sa dating bakal.

statements.text: Salt dissolving in water is a physical change, not a new substance! It is still salt, and you can get it back by evaporating the water.
statements.tl: Ang pagtunaw ng asin sa tubig ay isang physical change, hindi bagong sangkap! Asin pa rin ito, at mababawi mo ito kapag pinasingaw ang tubig.

statements.text:
How do we choose the right way to separate mixtures?

We pick a method based on properties like size, weight, magnetism, dissolving, or boiling points! No new substance forms—it's just a physical change.
statements.tl:
Paano tayo pumipili ng tamang paraan para maghiwalay ng mga timpla?

Pumipili tayo base sa katangian tulad ng laki, bigat, pagiging magnetic, pagkatunaw, o boiling point! Walang bagong sangkap na nabubuo—physical change lang ito!

statements.text:
If you change an object's shape, does it become a new substance?

Nope! In a physical change, only the form, shape, or size changes. It looks different, but it is still the exact same substance.
statements.tl:
Kung babaguhin mo ang hugis ng isang bagay, magiging bagong sangkap ba ito?

Hindi! Sa physical na pagbabago, anyo, hugis, o laki lang ang nagbabago. Iba na ang itsura, pero pareho pa rin itong sangkap.

statements.text:
What is the biggest difference between physical and chemical changes?

In a physical change, no new substance is made! But in a chemical change, a totally new substance is formed.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pinakamalaking pagkakaiba ng physical at kemikal na pagbabago?

Sa physical na pagbabago, walang bagong sangkap! Samantalang sa kemikal na pagbabago, may nabubuong bagong sangkap.

statements.text: Physical changes can often be reversed back to the original form! Think of water that freezes into ice, then melts again.
statements.tl: Madalas na nababalik ang physical na pagbabago sa dating anyo! Gaya ng tubig na nagyeyelo, tapos muling natutunaw.

statements.text: Chemical changes are usually hard to reverse! You cannot un-burn a piece of paper to make it paper again.
statements.tl: Karaniwang mahirap nang ibalik ang kemikal na pagbabago sa dati! Hindi mo na maibabalik ang nasunog na papel sa dating papel.

statements.text:
How does cooking an egg cause a chemical change?

The runny inside turns firm and can never go back to the way it was!
statements.tl:
Paano nagiging kemikal na pagbabago ang pagluluto ng itlog?

Ang malabnaw na loob ay nagiging matigas at hindi na maibabalik sa dati!

statements.text:
Is mixing sand and water a physical or chemical change?

It's usually a physical change because you can still separate them again!
statements.tl:
Physical ba o kemikal ang paghahalo ng buhangin at tubig?

Kadalasan itong physical na pagbabago dahil maaari pa silang paghiwalayin muli!

statements.text: A glass of calamansi juice with water and sugar is one of the Philippines' favorite drinks.
statements.tl: Ang katas ng kalamansi na hinaluan ng tubig at asukal ay isa sa mga paboritong inumin ng mga Pilipino.

statements.text: Muddy water is an example of a suspension because the mud settles when the water stands still!
statements.tl: Ang maputik na tubig ay halimbawa ng suspensyon dahil lumulubog ang putik kapag tumahimik ang tubig!

statements.text: When making a saltwater solution, the dissolving step is where solid salt crystals mix evenly into the liquid water!
statements.tl: Sa paggawa ng saltwater solution, ang dissolving step ay kung saan ang solid salt crystals ay pantay na nahahalo sa likidong tubig!

statements.text: Alcohol and water mix completely with each other, forming a homogeneous mixture that looks the same throughout.
statements.tl: Ang alcohol at tubig ay lubusang naghahalo sa isa't isa, na bumubuo ng homogeneous mixture na pareho ang anyo sa kabuuan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-RKC65zDEaCw6-9Xe30uD8gVeDgKiC3u), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Flour mixed with cold water does not dissolve completely, so it forms a heterogeneous mixture where the flour settles at the bottom.
statements.tl: Ang harina na hinalo sa malamig na tubig ay hindi lubusang natutunaw, kaya bumubuo ito ng heterogeneous mixture kung saan ang harina ay lumalagak sa ilalim.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-RKC65zDEaCw6-9Xe30uD8gVeDgKiC3u), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When sugar dissolves in water, the water separates whole sugar molecules from each other, but it does not break the covalent bonds holding the atoms together inside each molecule.
statements.tl: Kapag natunaw ang asukal sa tubig, pinaghihiwalay ng tubig ang buong sugar molecules sa isa't isa, ngunit hindi nito sinisira ang covalent bonds na nagdidikit sa mga atom sa loob ng bawat molecule.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-d2_6H1lqaek20CR3b1CmOrCIAZTvVrM), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Carbonated water is a gas-in-liquid solution, where carbon dioxide gas is dissolved in water.
statements.tl: Ang carbonated water ay isang gas-in-liquid solution, kung saan ang carbon dioxide gas ay natunaw sa tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 14G3Aq2H7Q_XfQKcQjZG5SNEGog81rtDV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A solution has only one phase, meaning you cannot see separate layers or parts in it.
statements.tl: Ang solution ay may iisang phase lang, ibig sabihin hindi mo makikita ang magkahiwalay na layer o bahagi nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 14G3Aq2H7Q_XfQKcQjZG5SNEGog81rtDV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Soda is a common household solution, with carbon dioxide gas dissolved in flavored liquid water.
statements.tl: Ang soda ay isang karaniwang solution sa bahay, na may carbon dioxide gas na natunaw sa may lasa na likidong tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1DsGX-c96FPFCxChd4nILOZx9acDCwNrn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Wine is a solution made of alcohol, water, and flavor compounds all mixed evenly into one liquid.
statements.tl: Ang wine ay isang solution na gawa sa alcohol, tubig, at mga sangkap na nagbibigay lasa na pantay-pantay na nagkahalo sa iisang likido.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1DsGX-c96FPFCxChd4nILOZx9acDCwNrn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does it mean when a solution has a single phase?

It means you see only one part, like a clear liquid with no separate layers or floating bits!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin kapag ang solution ay may iisang phase?

Ibig sabihin isang bahagi lang ang nakikita mo, tulad ng malinaw na likido na walang hiwalay na patong o lumulutang na piraso!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1DsGX-c96FPFCxChd4nILOZx9acDCwNrn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Common household examples of solutions include soda, vinegar, and wine, which all look like single liquids even though they contain several substances.
statements.tl: Ang mga karaniwang halimbawa ng solution sa bahay ay ang soda, suka, at wine, na lahat ay mukhang iisang likido kahit naglalaman ng iba't ibang sangkap.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1DsGX-c96FPFCxChd4nILOZx9acDCwNrn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The rubbing alcohol you use to disinfect your hands is a homogeneous mixture because it is a combination of water and alcohol that looks the same throughout.
statements.tl: Ang alcohol na ginagamit mong pang-disinfect ng kamay ay homogeneous mixture dahil kombinasyon ito ng tubig at alcohol na pare-pareho ang itsura sa kabuuan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1E0smuOHS7SdgNDQJ6omcdIKkx61pUEBA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Vinegar is a homogeneous mixture because only one colorless liquid is seen after its components are mixed evenly throughout.
statements.tl: Ang suka ay homogeneous mixture dahil isang walang kulay na likido lang ang nakikita matapos magkahalo nang pantay ang mga sangkap nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IKHyjt6yyztGPpXDaQNv5_Ec_8htiAj3), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Beach sand is a heterogeneous mixture because you can see different colored particles that are not evenly distributed.
statements.tl: Ang buhangin sa dalampasigan ay heterogeneous mixture dahil nakikita mo ang iba't ibang kulay na mga particle na hindi pantay ang pagkakalat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IKHyjt6yyztGPpXDaQNv5_Ec_8htiAj3), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Salad dressing is a heterogeneous mixture because its components are not uniformly distributed, and vinegar and oil form two separate liquid layers.
statements.tl: Ang salad dressing ay heterogeneous mixture dahil hindi pantay ang pagkakalat ng mga sangkap nito, at ang suka at mantika ay bumubuo ng dalawang magkahiwalay na layer ng likido.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IKHyjt6yyztGPpXDaQNv5_Ec_8htiAj3), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why is pizza a heterogeneous mixture?

Because you can easily see and identify its different parts like the crust, cheese, sauce, and toppings, and they are not evenly spread.
statements.tl:
Bakit heterogeneous mixture ang pizza?

Dahil madali mong makita at makilala ang iba't ibang bahagi nito tulad ng crust, cheese, sauce, at toppings, at hindi pantay ang pagkakalat ng mga ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ncm1elPtlgDTruOLnyx4GViV1zjtQkQe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A vegetable salad is a heterogeneous mixture because the combined ingredients are not evenly spread and each vegetable stays easy to see and identify.
statements.tl: Ang vegetable salad ay heterogeneous mixture dahil hindi pantay ang pagkakasama ng mga sangkap at bawat gulay ay madaling makita at makilala.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ncm1elPtlgDTruOLnyx4GViV1zjtQkQe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Air is a mixture of gases! It is mostly nitrogen and oxygen, not just one pure substance.
statements.tl: Ang hangin ay isang mixture ng mga gas! Karamihan itong nitrogen at oxygen, hindi isang purong sangkap.

statements.text: Carbon dioxide (CO2) is super tiny! It makes up only about 0.04% of the air we breathe.
statements.tl: Napakaliit lang ng carbon dioxide (CO2)! Mga 0.04% lang ito ng hangin na ating hinihinga.

statements.text: Did you know air holds some water vapor? The amount of water vapor changes with the weather!
statements.tl: Alam mo bang may kaunting water vapor sa hangin? Ang dami nito ay nagbabago depende sa panahon!

statements.text: Oxygen makes up about 21% of the air in Earth's atmosphere!
statements.tl: Ang oxygen (oksiheno) ay bumubuo ng mga 21% ng hangin sa atmosphere ng Earth!

statements.text: Water vapor is an invisible gas! Because our eyes cannot see it, we can't spot it floating in the air.
statements.tl: Ang water vapor ay isang di-nakikitang gas! Dahil hindi ito nakikita ng mata, hindi natin ito makita na lumulutang sa hangin.

statements.text: The atmosphere, the layer of air around Earth, contains elements like oxygen and nitrogen as gases, and helium as a very light gas.
statements.tl: Ang atmosphere, ang layer ng hangin sa paligid ng Earth, ay naglalaman ng mga element tulad ng oxygen at nitrogen bilang gas, at helium bilang napakagaan na gas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1CjelWcxW4JPq8g6e9k-jq4Eo05sAKeDr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Air is a mixture of different gases, so even though you cannot see them, they are physically combined and can be separated.
statements.tl: Ang hangin ay mixture ng iba't ibang gases, kaya kahit hindi mo sila nakikita, sila ay physically combined at maaaring paghiwalayin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Mp2MU2u71DAEh3xm_bIq7faZrPIzu2Rv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Earth's atmosphere is a blanket of gases, mostly nitrogen and oxygen, that makes life possible by giving us air to breathe and protecting us from the sun's harmful rays.
statements.tl: Ang atmosphere ng Earth ay isang kumot ng mga gas, karamihan ay nitrogen at oxygen, na ginagawang posible sa buhay dahil nagbibigay ito ng hanging nilalanghap natin at proteksyon mula sa mapaminsalang sinag ng araw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1fnBPm0a4vWRyjhqAy1IuHg0ckvR53nGl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Nitrogen is the most abundant gas in the air, and all living things need it to grow and build their bodies.
statements.tl: Ang nitrogen ang pinakamaraming gas sa hangin, at kailangan ito ng lahat ng may buhay para lumaki at mabuo ang kanilang katawan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hyyWqLKchzvjmg66R5ZrOl9CJzC3Bl6O), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding Earth, providing oxygen for animals and carbon dioxide for plants.
statements.tl: Ang atmosphere ay ang layer ng mga gas na nakapalibot sa Earth, na nagbibigay ng oxygen para sa mga hayop at carbon dioxide para sa mga halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1te3x8uYBO71qextfwGbK3Ed0IA4vNfs4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Air is a gas-in-gas solution made of several gases mixed together: nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide, argon, and small amounts of water vapor, methane, and ammonia.
statements.tl: Ang hangin ay isang gas-in-gas solution na binubuo ng ilang gas na magkakahalo: nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide, argon, at kaunting water vapor, methane, at ammonia.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-18201), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What form does carbon take in the air?

In the air, carbon exists as a gas—it's called carbon dioxide, or CO2!
statements.tl:
Anong anyo ng carbon ang nasa hangin?

Sa hangin, ang karbon ay nasa anyo ng gas na tinatawag na carbon dioxide o CO2!

statements.text: When you breathe in, your body takes in oxygen from the air; when you breathe out, it releases carbon dioxide it no longer needs.
statements.tl: Kapag huminga ka, kumukuha ang katawan mo ng oksiheno mula sa hangin; kapag huminga ka palabas, inilalabas nito ang carbon dioxide na hindi na kailangan.

statements.text:
What can lightning do to the air?

The intense heat of lightning changes nitrogen gas in the air into a form that rain carries down to the soil for plants to use!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagagawa ng kidlat sa hangin?

Ang matinding init ng kidlat ay nagbabago ng nitrogen gas sa hangin tungo sa anyong dinadala ng ulan pababa sa lupa para magamit ng halaman!

statements.text:
Can plants use nitrogen straight from the air?

Plants can't use nitrogen gas from the air directly — it first has to be changed into a different form they can absorb.
statements.tl:
Kaya bang gamitin ng halaman ang nitrogen gas sa hangin?

Hindi direktang magagamit ng halaman ang nitrogen gas sa hangin — kailangan muna itong mabago sa ibang anyo.

statements.text:
Is the air we breathe just one single gas?

Nope, air is a mixture! It's mostly nitrogen, plus the oxygen we breathe, and tiny amounts of carbon dioxide and other gases.
statements.tl:
Ang hangin ba na hinihinga natin ay isang solong gas lang?

Hindi, timpla ang hangin! Karamihan ay nitrogen, kasama ang oksihenong hinihinga natin, at kaunting carbon dioxide at iba pang gas.

statements.text: Air is not just one gas! It is a mixture of several gases, mainly nitrogen and oxygen blended together.
statements.tl: Ang hangin ay hindi iisang gas! Ito ay isang halo ng ilang gas, pangunahin ang nitrogen at oxygen na magkahalo.
statements.source: AAAS BSL Ch.4D; NRC PS1.A; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: Oxygen makes up about 21 percent of air, just one fifth! Yet, it is the gas we need to stay alive.
statements.tl: Ang oxygen ay bumubuo ng halos 21 porsyento ng hangin, mga ikalimang bahagi lang! Pero ito ang gas na kailangan natin para mabuhay.

statements.text: Picking is the simplest separation technique, where you use your hands or a tool to choose and remove substances from a mixture one by one.
statements.tl: Ang picking ang pinakasimpleng pamamaraan ng paghihiwalay, kung saan ginagamit mo ang iyong mga kamay o isang kasangkapan para piliin at alisin ang mga bagay mula sa mixture isa-isa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Wjs7Zf3dWNxNd4i1UXQRkyCGBOSXWvds), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Scooping is a separation technique where you use a scoop or spoon to remove an easily recognized substance from the rest of a mixture.
statements.tl: Ang scooping ay isang pamamaraan ng paghihiwalay kung saan gumagamit ka ng sandok o kutsara para alisin ang isang madaling makitang bagay mula sa iba pang bahagi ng mixture.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Wjs7Zf3dWNxNd4i1UXQRkyCGBOSXWvds), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In decanting, the heavy solid settles at the bottom. Then, the clear liquid is gently poured off!
statements.tl: Sa pagsalin, hinahayaang lumubog ang mabigat na solido sa ilalim. Pagkatapos, marahang ibinubuhos ang malinaw na likido!

statements.text: The particles in a suspension are large, so you can easily separate them by filtering!
statements.tl: Malalaki ang mga particle sa suspensyon, kaya madali silang maihiwalay gamit ang salaan!

statements.text: In Philippine salt beds, seawater is left in the hot sun. It evaporates, leaving the yummy salt behind!
statements.tl: Sa mga asinan sa Pilipinas, ang tubig-dagat ay iniwan sa araw. Sumisingaw ito para maiwan ang masarap na asin!

statements.text:
How does sieving separate mixtures?

Fine bits fall through small holes, while bigger pieces stay on top!
statements.tl:
Paano naghihiwalay ang pagsasala ng mga halo?

Dumadaan sa maliliit na butas ang pinong butil, habang naiiwan sa itaas ang malalaki!
statements.source: DepEd MATATAG Science (separating mixtures); encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: During winnowing, grain is tossed in a flat tray! The moving air blows away the light husks, while the heavier rice grains fall right back down.
statements.tl: Sa pagtatahip, itinataas ang butil sa bilao! Tinatangay ng hangin ang magaang ipa, habang ang mas mabigat na butil ng palay ay nahuhulog pabalik sa ilalim.
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 4D (separating mixtures by properties); encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: You can use a magnet to easily separate tiny bits of iron from sand or any mixture!
statements.tl: Pwede mong gamitin ang magnet para ihiwalay ang mga piraso ng bakal mula sa buhangin o ibang halo!

statements.text: Mixtures can be separated based on differences in properties such as density, magnetism, and how easily wind can carry a material away.
statements.tl: Ang mga mixture ay pwedeng paghiwalayin batay sa pagkakaiba ng properties tulad ng density, magnetism, at kung gaano kadaling tangayin ng hangin ang isang materyal.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12g_3va1JNnMPA7W8jA77xzTCcVZlLBNV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Decantation can help remove oil or gasoline from an oil spill by separating the floating layer from the water.
statements.tl: Ang decantation ay makatutulong sa pag-alis ng langis o gasolina mula sa oil spill sa pamamagitan ng paghihiwalay ng lumulutang na layer mula sa tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15S7f1kRiLLWlvsOAOBUbX3cwiz08748N), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Is decantation applicable to all types of mixtures?

No! It only works when one part is less dense and floats, or settles at the bottom.
statements.tl:
Maaari bang gamitin ang decantation sa lahat ng uri ng mixture?

Hindi! Gumagana lamang ito kapag ang isang parte ay less dense at lumulutang, o naiipon sa ilalim.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15S7f1kRiLLWlvsOAOBUbX3cwiz08748N), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Evaporation works best for homogeneous mixtures, where a solid is completely dissolved in a liquid, because heating removes the liquid and leaves the solid.
statements.tl: Pinakamahusay ang evaporation para sa homogeneous mixture, kung saan ang solid ay lubos na natunaw sa liquid, dahil inaalis ng init ang liquid at iniiwan ang solid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15w5PXh-RJNCw0UBoYEOLXOIhT8dP42dW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Engineers use electromagnets in recycling plants to separate magnetic metals like iron and steel from non-magnetic materials.
statements.tl: Ginagamit ng mga engineer ang electromagnets sa recycling plants para paghiwalayin ang mga magnetic na metal tulad ng bakal at steel mula sa mga hindi magnetic na materyales.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1F_oyHC6pMzDJcMf96hcSfzi1EWXVopGi), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mixtures can be separated by physical means, like using your hands, a filter, or a sieve, without changing the substances themselves.
statements.tl: Ang mga mixture ay maaaring paghiwalayin sa physical na paraan, tulad ng paggamit ng kamay, filter, o sieve, nang hindi binabago ang mismong mga sangkap.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MbwHlYnzEV4I_TkP2D416oXBC2mNlDMW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why can't we just use our hands to filter a liquid?

Because filtration needs a porous material - something with tiny holes - that lets the liquid pass through but traps the solid particles.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi natin pwedeng gamitin ang ating mga kamay para mag-filter ng liquid?

Dahil ang filtration ay nangangailangan ng porous na materyal - isang bagay na may maliliit na butas - na nagpapadaan sa liquid pero sumasalo sa mga solidong particles.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MbwHlYnzEV4I_TkP2D416oXBC2mNlDMW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card
