statements.text: To separate calamansi seeds from calamansi juice, you can use filtering, where the liquid juice passes through a strainer and the solid seeds are caught.
statements.tl: Para paghiwalayin ang mga buto ng calamansi sa calamansi juice, maaari kang gumamit ng filtering, kung saan dumadaan ang liquid na juice sa strainer at ang mga solidong buto ay nasasalo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MbwHlYnzEV4I_TkP2D416oXBC2mNlDMW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Sieves can have different sizes of holes, so you can choose the right sieve to separate fine sand from rocks or larger gravel from small pebbles.
statements.tl: Ang mga sieve ay maaaring magkaroon ng iba't ibang laki ng butas, kaya maaari mong piliin ang tamang sieve upang paghiwalayin ang pinong buhangin mula sa mga bato o ang mas malaking graba mula sa maliliit na bato.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MbwHlYnzEV4I_TkP2D416oXBC2mNlDMW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The floating fats in sinigang can be removed by decantation or by scooping them off the top with a spoon.
statements.tl: Ang mga lumulutang na taba sa sinigang ay maaaring alisin sa pamamagitan ng decantation o sa pagsandok sa mga ito mula sa itaas gamit ang kutsara.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1N_9H0cyQZ4wWiOi8AARdQjyukYSBRrKJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Magnets are used in food like rice or flour to pull out tiny iron bits and keep it safe!
statements.tl: Ginagamit ang magneto sa pagkain tulad ng bigas o harina para hanguin ang maliliit na piraso ng bakal at gawing ligtas ito!

statements.text:
How does decanting separate clear fish sauce from its sediment?

In decanting, the clear liquid like fish sauce is poured off slowly. This leaves the settled sediment safely behind at the bottom of the container!
statements.tl:
Paano hinahati ng decanting ang malinaw na patis sa latak nito?

Sa decanting, dahan-dahang ibinubuhos ang malinaw na likido tulad ng patis. Naiiwan nito ang lumubog na latak sa ilalim ng lalagyan!

statements.text:
How is traditional coconut oil made?

By boiling coconut milk! As it boils, the water evaporates and the oil is left behind. This uses evaporation to separate oil from water.
statements.tl:
Paano ginagawa ang tradisyonal na langis ng niyog?

Sa pagkulo ng gata! Habang kumukulo, ang tubig ay sumasingaw at ang langis ay naiiwan. Gumagamit ito ng evaporation para ihiwalay ang langis sa tubig.

statements.text: A coffee filter is a porous tool! It separates insoluble solid coffee grounds from liquid water in your yummy mixture.
statements.tl: Ang coffee filter ay isang porous na kagamitan! Naghihiwalay ito ng hindi natutunaw na coffee grounds mula sa likidong tubig sa timpla.

statements.text: A flour sieve easily separates solid lumps from fine powder! It does this by passing the smaller particles through its mesh holes.
statements.tl: Ang flour sieve ay naghihiwalay ng malalaking tipak mula sa pinong pulbos! Ginagawa nito ito sa pamamagitan ng pagdaan ng maliliit na butil sa mga butas ng mesh.

statements.text: Fishers use nets with small holes to trap fish, while the water flows right out through the openings.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang mga mangingisda ng lambat na may maliliit na butas para mahuli ang isda, habang lumalabas naman ang tubig sa mga butas nito.
statements.source: DepEd MATATAG Science (animals and human use of resources); encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: Crushed malunggay seeds added to muddy water bind small particles together so they settle out — a process called coagulation, useful where clean water is scarce.
statements.tl: Ang dinurog na buto ng malunggay, kapag idinagdag sa maputik na tubig, ay nagbubuklod sa maliliit na particle para bumaba ang mga ito — tinatawag itong coagulation, na kapaki-pakinabang kung kulang ang malinis na tubig.

statements.text:
How do we make seawater drinkable?

Removing salt from seawater is called desalination! One cool way to do this is through distillation.
statements.tl:
Paano natin gagawing mainom ang tubig-dagat?

Ang pagtanggal ng asin sa tubig-dagat ay tinatawag na desalination! Isa sa mga paraan nito ay ang distillation.

statements.text:
What are the parts of a simple distillation setup?

It has a container to boil water, a tube for the vapor to travel, and a cool part where clean water forms!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mga bahagi ng simpleng distillation setup?

May sisidlan ito na pinagpapakuluan, isang tubo na dinadaluyan ng singaw, at isang malamig na bahagi kung saan namumuo ang malinis na tubig!

statements.text: Distilled water is used in irons, car batteries, and laboratories because it is pure and has no minerals to leave deposits!
statements.tl: Ginagamit ang distiladong tubig sa mga plantsa, baterya ng sasakyan, at laboratoryo dahil malinis ito at walang minerales na mag-iiwan ng latak!

statements.text: Distillation gives very clean water but is slow and costly, so for everyday cleaning, filtering and boiling are used more often!
statements.tl: Nagbibigay ang distilasyon ng napakalinis na tubig ngunit mabagal at magastos, kaya para sa araw-araw, mas madalas gamitin ang pagsala at pagpapakulo!

statements.text: Scientists use chromatography to find out exactly what substances are hiding inside ink, food, or medicine!
statements.tl: Ginagamit ng mga siyentista ang chromatography para malaman kung anong mga sangkap ang nasa tinta, pagkain, o gamot!

statements.text:
Can chromatography separate the natural colors of plants?

Yes! Chromatography can be used to separate the beautiful natural colors found in flowers and vegetables.
statements.tl:
Maaari bang ihiwalay ng chromatography ang likas na kulay ng mga halaman?

Oo! Magagamit ang chromatography para ihiwalay ang magagandang likas na kulay mula sa mga bulaklak at gulay.

statements.text: Rock candy is made of big sugar crystals grown from very sweet sugar water!
statements.tl: Ang rock candy ay malalaking crystal ng asukal na pinatubo sa matamis na tubig!

statements.text:
How do we split crude oil into parts?

We use a method called fractional distillation! The oil is heated and separated based on the different boiling points of its parts.
statements.tl:
Paano natin pinaghihiwalay ang crude oil?

Ginagamit natin ang paraan na tinatawag na fractional distillation! Pinapainit at pinaghihiwalay ang langis ayon sa kani-kanilang boiling point.

statements.text:
What useful products do we get from crude oil?

From a single batch of crude oil, we get many useful products! These include everyday fuels like gasoline, diesel, and kerosene.
statements.tl:
Anong mga kapaki-pakinabang na produkto ang nakukuha natin mula sa crude oil?

Mula sa iisang crude oil, nakukuha natin ang maraming kapaki-pakinabang na produkto! Kasama rito ang mga gasolina, diesel, at kerosene.

statements.text:
What fuels our big trucks and jeepneys?

Diesel! It is a heavier fraction than gasoline, used to power trucks, jeepneys, and boats.
statements.tl:
Ano ang gatong ng malalaking trak at jeepney?

Diesel! Ito ay isang mas mabigat na bahagi kaysa gasolina, na ginagamit sa mga trak, jeepney, at bangka.

statements.text:
Why can we separate crude oil?

Its molecules come in different sizes and weights! This gives them different boiling points, making separation possible.
statements.tl:
Bakit kayang ihiwalay ang crude oil?

Magkakaiba ang laki at bigat ng mga molekula nito! Kaya magkakaiba rin ang kanilang boiling point para maihiwalay.

statements.text: The independent variable is the factor that is changed or manipulated in an experiment to see what will happen.
statements.tl: Ang independent variable ay ang salik na binabago o minamanipula sa isang experiment para makita kung ano ang mangyayari.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Controlled variables are kept the same throughout an experiment so changes in them do not affect the comparison.
statements.tl: Ang controlled variables ay pinananatiling pareho sa buong experiment para hindi makaapekto sa paghahambing ang pagbabago sa mga ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-24677), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What do I measure in an experiment?

You measure the dependent variable, because it is the factor that responds to the change you made.
statements.tl:
Ano ang sinusukat ko sa isang experiment?

Sinusukat mo ang dependent variable, dahil ito ang factor na tumutugon sa pagbabagong ginawa mo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 182TIOnxSBmc2-60rTNPz2NaGOOivCpQd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a fair test, you change only the independent variable, so any difference in the dependent variable can be traced back to that one change.
statements.tl: Sa fair test, ang independent variable lang ang binabago mo, kaya ang anumang pagkakaiba sa dependent variable ay maaaring maiugnay sa isang pagbabagong iyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 182TIOnxSBmc2-60rTNPz2NaGOOivCpQd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The dependent variable is the one factor you measure in a fair test, because it shows the effect of the change you made.
statements.tl: Ang dependent variable ay ang isang factor na sinusukat mo sa fair test, dahil ito ang nagpapakita ng epekto ng pagbabagong ginawa mo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 182TIOnxSBmc2-60rTNPz2NaGOOivCpQd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Keeping all other factors the same as control variables ensures that only the independent variable can affect the dependent variable in a fair test.
statements.tl: Ang pagpapanatili ng lahat ng ibang factor bilang control variables ay tumitiyak na ang independent variable lang ang makakaapekto sa dependent variable sa fair test.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 182TIOnxSBmc2-60rTNPz2NaGOOivCpQd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Two river communities can act like a fair test, where the clean river is the control group and the polluted river is the experimental group, with pollution as the one changed factor.
statements.tl: Ang dalawang komunidad sa tabing-ilog ay maaaring kumilos tulad ng isang fair test, kung saan ang malinis na ilog ay ang control group at ang maruming ilog ay ang experimental group, na ang polusyon ang isang binagong factor.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 182TIOnxSBmc2-60rTNPz2NaGOOivCpQd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Controlled variables are all the conditions kept the same so that only the independent variable affects the result.
statements.tl: Ang controlled variables ay lahat ng kondisyon na pinananatiling pareho para ang independent variable lang ang makaapekto sa resulta.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GeT_SzMMzI3lTQDY5NXk7IclKAoxc25J), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do you know if Abbey's bean sprout design is valid?

She must keep soil, light, temperature, and amount of liquid the same, so only the type of liquid is changed.
statements.tl:
Paano mo malalaman kung valid ang disenyo ng bean sprout experiment ni Abbey?

Dapat panatilihin niyang pareho ang lupa, liwanag, temperatura, at dami ng liquid, para ang uri lang ng liquid ang binago.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GeT_SzMMzI3lTQDY5NXk7IclKAoxc25J), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do you design a valid and reliable investigation?

Identify the independent and dependent variables, control other conditions, make a hypothesis, and repeat trials to average results.
statements.tl:
Paano ka nagdidisenyo ng valid at reliable na investigation?

Tukuyin ang independent at dependent variables, kontrolin ang ibang kondisyon, gumawa ng hypothesis, at ulitin ang trials para i-average ang resulta.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GeT_SzMMzI3lTQDY5NXk7IclKAoxc25J), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a controlled experiment, you change only the manipulated variable while keeping all other variables the same, so you know what caused the result.
statements.tl: Sa isang controlled experiment, ang manipulated variable lang ang binabago mo habang pinananatiling pareho ang ibang variables, para malaman mo kung ano ang sanhi ng resulta.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Mt4DpoTBjzwl8kKQgJQROj-akcPJTd7x), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Designing a fair test requires keeping everything the same except for the one variable you want to know about.
statements.tl: Ang pagdidisenyo ng isang fair test ay nangangailangan na panatilihing pareho ang lahat maliban sa isang variable na nais mong malaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1OSgczAaDPaJCjr64sbnEKss8H38P7Yjw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What do you call the effect that changes because of what you did in an experiment?

It is the dependent variable, the effect that arises from the changes in the independent variable.
statements.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa epekto na nagbabago dahil sa ginawa mo sa isang experiment?

Ito ang dependent variable, ang epekto na nagmumula sa mga pagbabago sa independent variable.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Controlled variables are the things in an experiment that must be kept the same to make it a fair test.
statements.tl: Ang controlled variables ay ang mga bagay sa isang experiment na dapat panatilihing pareho para maging patas ang pagsubok.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is a fair experiment?

A fair experiment changes only one variable at a time, while keeping all other factors the same.
statements.tl:
Ano ang patas na experiment?

Ang patas na experiment ay nagbabago lamang ng isang variable sa isang pagkakataon, habang pinapanatiling pareho ang lahat ng iba pang salik.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The dependent variable is what you measure or observe to see the result, such as which pancake tastes better.
statements.tl: Ang dependent variable ay ang sinusukat o inoobserbahan mo para makita ang resulta, tulad ng kung aling pancake ang mas masarap.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1eQU2n_YCgzFv2BH--BhflrDACIR5rykt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Controlled variables are the factors you keep exactly the same in every set-up, like using the same type of soil and the same amount of water for all plants.
statements.tl: Ang controlled variables ay ang mga salik na pinananatili mong parehong-pareho sa bawat set-up, tulad ng paggamit ng parehong uri ng lupa at parehong dami ng tubig para sa lahat ng halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1gqetaTPgok_D7FVjiTpNsDuCHlUneex4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do scientists keep some things exactly the same in an experiment?

These are controlled variables, and they are kept constant to ensure a fair test!
statements.tl:
Bakit may mga bagay na pinananatiling pareho sa isang experiment?

Ito ang mga controlled variables, at pinananatili silang constant para maging patas ang pagsubok!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hmWPMIg897zJuzj4R9q-QBcQ0Hu0mbjs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Three trials means doing the exact same test three times! It doesn't mean trying three different ideas just once each.
statements.tl: Ang tatlong pagsubok ay ang pag-ulit ng parehong eksperimento ng tatlong beses, hindi pagsubok ng tatlong magkaibang ideya ng isang beses lang.

statements.text: Accurate measuring means using the marks on your tool carefully! Never guess the last digit from far away.
statements.tl: Ang accurate measuring ay paggamit ng mga marka sa tool nang maingat! Huwag hulaan ang huling digit mula sa malayo.

statements.text:
How do you get an accurate reading from a thermometer?

Look at the thermometer at the exact same level as your eye!
statements.tl:
Paano makakuha ng tamang pagbasa sa termometro?

Tingnan ang termometro nang kalebel ng iyong mata para sa tamang pagbasa!

statements.text: Doing multiple trials in an experiment helps double-check the results so they are more reliable and not just a one-time accident.
statements.tl: Ang paggawa ng maraming trials sa isang experiment ay nakakatulong na i-double-check ang mga resulta para mas mapagkakatiwalaan at hindi lang isang aksidente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why wash your glassware between science trials?

Leftover powder can secretly change your next result! Always wash and dry your glassware between trials to keep it fair.
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangang hugasan ang mga baso pagkatapos ng pagsubok?

Ang natirang pulbos ay pwedeng magpabago ng resulta! Hugasan at patuyuin ang mga baso pagkatapos ng bawat pagsubok para patas.

statements.text:
When should you write your experiment steps?

Before you mix anything! Write your steps and data table first so you don't invent a new method halfway through.
statements.tl:
Kailan dapat isulat ang mga hakbang ng eksperimento?

Bago pa maghalo! Isulat muna ang mga hakbang at talahanayan ng datos para hindi ka mag-imbento ng bagong paraan sa gitna.

statements.text:
Why write units like grams beside every number?

So readers don't mix up measurements! Always write units like grams or milliliters beside every single number you record.
statements.tl:
Bakit dapat isulat ang yunit tulad ng gramo katabi ng bawat numero?

Para hindi magkamali sa paghahambing! Isulat ang yunit tulad ng gramo o mililitro katabi ng bawat numerong isinusulat mo.

statements.text: Team up! Have your partner watch the scale while you pour, then record the number together to avoid reading mistakes.
statements.tl: Makipagtulungan! Pwede mong hilingin sa kapareha na bantayan ang timbangan habang nagbubuhos, tapos pareho ninyong isulat ang numero para iwas mali.

statements.text: Never pick just your favorite trial! Honest science means keeping all your good measurements in the report for a fair result.
statements.tl: Huwag piliin lang ang paboritong pagsubok! Ang tapat na agham ay naglilista ng lahat ng magagandang sukat para maging patas ang ulat.

statements.text:
Why drop an object from the exact same height every time?

If the height changes, it becomes a hidden variable! Always drop objects from the exact same height to test fairly.
statements.tl:
Bakit dapat ihulog ang bagay mula sa parehong taas sa bawat pagsubok?

Kung magbabago ang taas, magiging nakatagong variable ito! Palaging ihulog ang bagay mula sa parehong taas upang maging patas ang pagsubok.

statements.text: Always check your tools first! Make sure your timer matches a real clock and your ruler starts exactly at zero before testing.
statements.tl: Laging i-check ang mga kagamitan! Siguraduhing tama ang timer sa orasan at nagsisimula sa zero ang ruler bago magsimula ng maraming pagsubok.

statements.text:
Why agree on a quiet count when counting bubbles or drips?

When counting bubbles or drips, agree on a quiet count so two people don't add extra events that only one of them heard!
statements.tl:
Bakit magkasundo sa tahimik na bilang kapag nagbibilang ng bula o patak?

Kapag nagbibilang ng bula o patak, magkasundo sa tahimik na bilang para hindi magdoble ang bilang ng isang pangyayari na iisa lang ang narinig!

statements.text: Cut or weigh samples so they start the same size! A bigger piece can change at a different rate and trick you about the method.
statements.tl: Putulin o timbangin ang mga sample nang pareho ang laki! Mas malaking piraso ay maaaring magbago sa ibang bilis at maaaring magpalinlang sa paraan.

statements.text: If the power flickers or someone bumps the table, write that in the notes beside the trial instead of pretending the number is clean!
statements.tl: Kung mag-flicker ang ilaw o may tumama sa mesa, isulat iyan sa tala sa tabi ng pagsubok imbes na isipin na tama ang numero!

statements.text: Start with a question you can test fairly! Ask which solid dissolves faster in the same warm water, not a question you cannot measure.
statements.tl: Magsimula sa tanong na kayang subukan ng patas! Tulad ng kung aling solidong natutunaw nang mas mabilis sa parehong mainit na tubig, hindi sa hindi masukat.

statements.text: A surprising result is a reason to repeat the trial! Don't stop and tell a story that has only one measurement behind it.
statements.tl: Ang nakakagulat na resulta ay dahilan para ulitin ang pagsubok! Huwag itigil at magkwento lang na iisa lang ang sukat.

statements.text: Ask watchers not to stir, heat, or add water 'to help'! Extra help is an unplanned change that spoils a fair test.
statements.tl: Sabihin sa mga tumitingin na huwag haluin, painitin, o magdagdag ng tubig 'para tumulong'! Ang dagdag na tulong ay hindi planadong pagbabago na sumisira sa patas na pagsubok.

statements.text: Say 'start' only when everything is ready! This ensures one trial does not secretly include extra mixing time that the others did not get.
statements.tl: Sabihin ang 'simula' lang kapag handa na lahat! Para walang trial na may lihim na dagdag na paghalo na wala sa iba.

statements.text: The main decomposers in nature are fungi, like molds and mushrooms, and bacteria.
statements.tl: Ang pangunahing mga decomposer sa kalikasan ay ang fungi, tulad ng amag at kabute, at ang bacteria.

statements.text: Animals are called consumers because they can't make their own food — they must eat other living things.
statements.tl: Tinatawag na consumer ang mga hayop dahil hindi sila makagawa ng sariling pagkain — kailangan nilang kumain ng ibang bagay na buhay.

statements.text: Decomposers get all their food and energy from breaking down dead plants and animals.
statements.tl: Kinukuha ng mga decomposer ang pagkain at enerhiya nila mula sa pagbulok ng mga patay na halaman at hayop.

statements.text: Scavengers might seem gross, but they're vital -- they keep a healthy ecosystem clean and balanced.
statements.tl: Baka mukhang kadiri ang mga scavenger, pero mahalaga sila -- pinapanatili nilang malinis at balanse ang isang malusog na ekosistema.

statements.text: A food web is a diagram showing how many food chains connect, with each arrow pointing from the food to the living thing that eats it.
statements.tl: Ang food web ay larawan na nagpapakita kung paano nag-uugnay-ugnay ang maraming kadena ng pagkain, kung saan ang bawat palaso ay nagtuturo mula sa kinakain patungo sa kumakain.

statements.text:
Why are plants called producers?

They make their own food—and they're the start of many food chain.
statements.tl:
Bakit tinatawag na producers ang mga halaman?

Gumagawa sila ng sariling pagkain—at sila ang simula ng maraming food chain.
statements.source: NRC LS2.B; AAAS BSL Ch.5E; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: Energy flows from producers to consumers and eventually to decomposers, which break down dead organisms and return nutrients to the soil.
statements.tl: Ang energy ay dumadaloy mula sa mga producer patungo sa mga consumer at sa huli ay sa mga decomposer, na sumisira sa mga patay na organismo at nagbabalik ng nutrients sa lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15axOWvFMWNAqsADbczE00z9QRWLyVjWi), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Producers, consumers, and decomposers play important roles in the cycling of materials in the environment.
statements.tl: Ang mga producer, consumer, at decomposer ay may mahalagang papel sa pag-ikot ng mga materyales sa kapaligiran.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17vVB3STqrffR_jsAYvIE9mIYPPfrbSJf), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: First-order consumers are animals that feed directly on producers, meaning they eat plants, vegetables, or fruits.
statements.tl: Ang first-order consumers ay mga hayop na direktang kumakain sa producers, ibig sabihin kumakain sila ng halaman, gulay, o prutas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1QY-fwPsIBtYV15fzaE64LQe3tDjnyLD4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Microorganisms are tiny living things you can only see through a microscope, and they help decompose organic matter in soil into nutrients for plants.
statements.tl: Ang mga microorganism ay napakaliit na bagay na may buhay na makikita lang sa pamamagitan ng microscope, at tinutulungan nilang maagnas ang organic matter sa lupa para maging nutrients ng mga halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1baGq0NS5IR0kAd-LSD2_TxktvEBWSodP), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A local ecosystem like a pond or coral reef contains producers, consumers, scavengers, and decomposers all working together in one food web.
statements.tl: Ang isang lokal na ecosystem tulad ng lawa o coral reef ay naglalaman ng mga producer, consumer, scavenger, at decomposer na sama-samang gumagana sa iisang food web.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1oUWGXkiCp0Q_zjOAc2rI2dKWSJ95j94b), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Decomposers help maintain carrying capacity by breaking down and recycling dead organisms and organic matter, preventing them from accumulating and taking up space.
statements.tl: Ang mga decomposer ay tumutulong na mapanatili ang carrying capacity sa pamamagitan ng pagbubulok at pag-recycle ng mga patay na organismo at organic matter, para hindi ito maipon at sumakop ng espasyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qMGrTEkUwKVew99gHfBoabbhdVeLWCFy), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Destroying forests to build houses removes the producers, so herbivores lose their food and the whole food web suffers.
statements.tl: Ang pagsira sa mga kagubatan upang magtayo ng mga bahay ay nag-aalis sa mga producer, kaya nawawalan ng pagkain ang mga herbivore at naghihirap ang buong food web.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1znwaI4eUCKLob1xb5cHylyr_1Hh1-5dd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A pitcher plant is a producer that can also trap insects, showing that some plants get extra nutrients in unusual ways.
statements.tl: Ang pitcher plant ay isang producer na maaari ring manghuli ng mga insekto, na nagpapakita na ang ilang mga halaman ay nakakakuha ng karagdagang sustansya sa hindi pangkaraniwang paraan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1znwaI4eUCKLob1xb5cHylyr_1Hh1-5dd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When seagrass leaves die and break down into tiny bits called detritus, they become food for animals living on the seafloor.
statements.tl: Kapag namatay at nabulok ang mga dahon ng damong-dagat, ito'y nagiging pagkain ng mga hayop na nakatira sa sahig ng dagat.

statements.text: When plants and animals die, decomposers break down their remains and return the nitrogen to the soil.
statements.tl: Kapag namatay ang mga halaman at hayop, binubulok ng mga decomposer ang kanilang mga labi at ibinabalik ang nitrogen sa lupa.

statements.text:
Is a millipede a hunter?

No — a millipede is not a predator. It eats decaying plants and leaves, making it important for decomposing things in nature.
statements.tl:
Mandaragit ba ang millipede?

Hindi — hindi mandaragit ang millipede. Kumakain ito ng mga bulok na halaman at dahon, kaya mahalaga ito sa pagbubulok sa kalikasan.

statements.text: Some farmers raise earthworms on purpose — the worms turn plant scraps into natural fertilizer for their crops.
statements.tl: Inaalagaan ng ilang magsasaka ang bulati nang sinasadya — ginagawa ng mga ito na likas na abono ang basurang halaman para sa kanilang pananim.

statements.text: Wavelength is simply the exact distance from one wave's crest to the very next crest!
statements.tl: Ang wavelength (haba ng alon) ay ang distansya mula sa isang taluktok hanggang sa susunod na taluktok ng alon!
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 4F/M7; NRC PS4.A grade-5 endpoint

statements.text: When a wave moves from air to water, its frequency stays exactly the same! Only the speed and wavelength change, but the waves per second never change.
statements.tl: Kapag lumipat ang wave mula hangin papuntang tubig, ang frequency niya ay nananatiling pareho! Bilis at wavelength lang ang magbabago, pero ang waves per second ay hindi.

statements.text: The speed of sound in a medium equals frequency multiplied by wavelength. Higher frequency means shorter wavelength, and vice versa!
statements.tl: Ang bilis ng tunog sa isang medium ay katumbas ng frequency na pinarami ng wavelength. Kung mataas ang frequency, maikli ang wavelength at kabaliktaran!

statements.text: Pitch and loudness are totally different! Pitch depends on the frequency of vibration, while loudness depends on the amplitude, or the size of the vibration.
statements.tl: Magkaiba ang pitch at loudness! Ang pitch ay nakasalalay sa frequency ng vibration, habang ang loudness ay nakasalalay sa amplitude o laki ng vibration.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; NRC PS4.A; DepEd G5 Q3

statements.text: A shout travels way farther than a whisper! That's because a shout has larger amplitude — it carries more energy and stays strong over a bigger distance.
statements.tl: Ang sigaw ay nakakarating nang mas malayo kaysa bulong! Iyon ay dahil ang sigaw ay may mas malaking amplitude — mas maraming enerhiya ang dala nito at mas matagal nananatiling malakas.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; DepEd G3 Q3; NRC PS4.A

statements.text: The frequency of sound is measured in Hertz (Hz), meaning the number of cycles per second!
statements.tl: Ang dalas (frequency) ng tunog ay sinusukat sa Hertz (Hz), na ang ibig sabihin ay bilang ng beses bawat segundo!

statements.text: Modulation is when a sound or picture signal changes a carrier wave's amplitude or frequency so the information can be sent through the air.
statements.tl: Ang modulation ay ang pagbabago ng sound o picture signal sa amplitude o frequency ng carrier wave para maipadala ang impormasyon sa hangin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 155iY1mMJh_jPmfUWC7IPFdT-7MGY91jk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Amplitude is how tall a wave is from its middle resting line! A larger amplitude means the wave carries more energy.
statements.tl: Ang amplitude ay ang taas ng alon mula sa gitnang linya nito! Kapag mas malaki ang amplitude, mas malaki ang enerhiyang dala ng alon.
statements.source: NRC PS4.A grade-5 endpoint; AAAS Benchmarks 4F/M7

statements.text:
What is frequency?

Frequency is exactly how many waves pass a point in one second, measured in hertz!
statements.tl:
Ano ang frequency (dalas)?

Ang frequency (dalas) ay kung ilang alon ang dumadaan sa isang punto sa isang segundo, sinusukat sa hertz!
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 4F/M7; NRC PS4.A grade-8 endpoint

statements.text:
How do frequency and wavelength connect?

At the same wave speed, a higher frequency means a shorter wavelength, while a lower frequency means a longer one!
statements.tl:
Paano nagkonekta ang frequency at wavelength?

Sa parehong bilis ng alon, mas mataas na frequency ay may mas maikling wavelength, at mas mababa ay mas mahaba!
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 4F (grades 9-12 discussion); NRC PS4.A grade-12 endpoint

statements.text:
How do we calculate wave speed?

A wave's speed equals its wavelength multiplied by its frequency (speed = wavelength × frequency)!
statements.tl:
Paano natin kinakalkula ang bilis ng alon?

Ang bilis ng alon ay katumbas ng wavelength nito na minultiply sa frequency nito (bilis = wavelength × frequency)!
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 4F (grades 9-12); NRC PS4.A grade-12 endpoint

statements.text:
Does a wave travel at the same speed everywhere?

Waves travel at different speeds in different materials! Sound goes faster in water and metal than in air.
statements.tl:
Pare-pareho ba ang bilis ng alon sa lahat ng lugar?

Nagkakaiba ang bilis ng alon sa iba't ibang materyal! Mas mabilis ang tunog sa tubig at metal kaysa sa hangin.
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 4F/M4; NRC PS4.A grade-12 endpoint

statements.text:
How is a wave's energy linked to its amplitude?

A wave's energy is linked to its amplitude! A louder sound has a larger amplitude than a soft sound of the same pitch.
statements.tl:
Paano konektado ang enerhiya ng alon sa amplitude nito?

Ang enerhiya ng alon ay konektado sa amplitude nito! Ang mas malakas na tunog ay may mas malaking amplitude kaysa sa mahinang tunog na may parehong pitch.
statements.source: NRC PS4.A; AAAS Benchmarks 4F/H6c (energy of waves)

statements.text: Light from almost all distant galaxies has a longer wavelength called redshift. That's why astronomers believe the whole universe is expanding!
statements.tl: Ang liwanag mula sa halos lahat ng malalayong galaksi ay may mas mahabang wavelength na tinatawag na redshift. Kaya naniniwala ang mga astronomo na lumalawak ang buong uniberso!

statements.text: Resonance happens when something is pushed at its natural frequency. The waves add up and grow in amplitude, like a guitar string or air inside a flute!
statements.tl: Ang resonance ay nangyayari kapag ang isang bagay ay tinutulak sa natural frequency nito. Ang mga alon ay nagdadagdag at lumalaki ang amplitude, tulad sa kuwerdas ng gitara o hangin sa plawta!

statements.text: Light travels as waves! The color we see depends on the wavelength of that light.
statements.tl: Naglalakbay ang liwanag bilang mga alon! Ang kulay na nakikita natin ay nakadepende sa haba ng alon nito.

statements.text: Red light has the longest wavelength, while violet light has the shortest of the colors we can see!
statements.tl: Ang pulang liwanag ang may pinakamahabang alon, habang ang lila ang may pinakamaikli sa mga kulay na nakikita natin!

statements.text: The number of vibrations each second is called frequency, and it is measured in hertz (Hz)!
statements.tl: Ang bilang ng yanig kada segundo ay tinatawag na prekwensiya, at sinusukat ito sa hertz (Hz)!

statements.text:
Why do seeds spread far from the plant?

So they don't have to compete with their parent plant for water, light, and space to grow!
statements.tl:
Bakit kumakalat ang mga binhi?

Para hindi na sila mag-agawan ng tubig, liwanag, at espasyo sa kanilang magulang na halaman!

statements.text: A snake doesn't chew its food at all — it swallows its prey whole.
statements.tl: Hindi ngumunguya ng pagkain ang ahas; nilululon nito nang buo ang biktima.

statements.text: If there are more predators, the animals that hunt other animals, in a community, the prey population may decrease too much and upset the ecosystem's balance.
statements.tl: Kung mas marami ang predators, ang mga hayop na nangangaso ng ibang hayop, sa isang komunidad, maaaring bumaba nang husto ang population ng prey at masira ang balanse ng ecosystem.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 11OTAeqQ0vf1fDViwtzvNIOHY9a9Ptxd-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Plants growing too close together compete for limited space, water, and soil nutrients, so some may become weak and small.
statements.tl: Ang mga halamang tumutubo nang magkakadikit ay naglalaban-laban para sa limitadong espasyo, tubig, at nutrients sa lupa, kaya ang iba ay maaaring maging mahina at maliit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12FHuKsOK6hSd6JFjx4ptfPqQ59wOlsVL), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What happens if you put too many fish in one aquarium?

There is not enough food, space, and oxygen for everyone, so the fish compete and may fight or become weak!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kung maglalagay ka ng napakaraming isda sa isang aquarium?

Walang sapat na pagkain, espasyo, at oxygen para sa lahat, kaya ang mga isda ay naglalaban-laban at maaaring mag-away o manghina!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12FHuKsOK6hSd6JFjx4ptfPqQ59wOlsVL), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Competition is the striving or vying between organisms for the things needed for survival, like food, water, sunlight, and space.
statements.tl: Ang competition ay ang pag-aagawan o paglalaban ng mga organismo para sa mga bagay na kailangan upang mabuhay, tulad ng pagkain, tubig, sikat ng araw, at espasyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1K4m1qAjqoifZyU4O9r3_PigMzbOQwgPN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When carabaos and goats eat on the same grassland, their relationship is called competition because they are vying for the same food.
statements.tl: Kapag ang mga kalabaw at kambing ay kumakain sa parehong damuhan, ang kanilang relasyon ay tinatawag na competition dahil nag-aagawan sila para sa parehong pagkain.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1K4m1qAjqoifZyU4O9r3_PigMzbOQwgPN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Fishes compete to feed on other animals, which is an example of competition for food in an ecosystem.
statements.tl: Ang mga isda ay nagko-compete upang kumain ng ibang mga hayop, na isang halimbawa ng competition para sa pagkain sa isang ecosystem.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1K4m1qAjqoifZyU4O9r3_PigMzbOQwgPN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The struggle for survival among organisms of the same kind means they have to compete for food and other resources, and some are eliminated in the process.
statements.tl: Ang struggle for survival sa mga organism ng parehong uri ay nangangahulugang kailangan nilang makipagkumpitensya para sa pagkain at iba pang resources, at ang iba ay natatanggal sa proseso.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ub3H0VbyYvTg1w2u83MfbZCHsClH2PYi), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Competition happens when organisms fight for the same limited resource, like janitor fish and native fish battling for the same food in a river.
statements.tl: Ang competition ay nangyayari kapag nag-aagawan ang mga organismo sa iisang limitadong resource, tulad ng janitor fish at native fish na naglalaban para sa parehong pagkain sa ilog.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UiuKKBB4tA64TmCnG3huY6iD6IlDjqmg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Competition is an interaction where organisms compete for survival, like grass, shrubs, flowers, and trees growing together and competing for water, sunlight, and soil nutrients.
statements.tl: Ang competition ay isang interaksyon kung saan ang mga organismo ay naglalaban-laban para mabuhay, tulad ng damo, shrubs, bulaklak, at puno na tumutubo nang magkakasama at nag-aagawan sa tubig, sikat ng araw, at nutrients sa lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1rY-XtNU1Un9SRq86Dnc45oKMN5ZHTeO_), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A uniform distribution pattern happens when organisms are spaced evenly apart, often because they compete for the same resources like water or space.
statements.tl: Ang uniform distribution pattern ay nangyayari kapag ang mga organismo ay pantay-pantay ang pagitan, kadalasan dahil nag-aagawan sila sa parehong resources tulad ng tubig o espasyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1slX0_5odwVm9TJNZKhzhwWApgttgOCxD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Plants in a small pot compete with each other for limited nutrients and space to grow.
statements.tl: Ang mga halaman sa maliit na paso ay nag-aagawan sa isa't isa para sa limitadong nutrients at espasyo upang lumaki.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-22548), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A python doesn't chase its food—it hides quietly and waits, then strikes fast to grab prey that comes near.
statements.tl: Hindi humahabol ang sawa sa kanyang biktima—tahimik itong nagtatago at naghihintay, tapos biglang sumasakmal sa lumalapit na biktima.

statements.text:
How does the pilandok mark its territory?

The pilandok rubs its face on branches, using scent glands near its eyes to mark its territory.
statements.tl:
Paano minamarkahan ng pilandok ang teritoryo?

Kinukuskos ng pilandok ang mukha nito sa mga sanga, gamit ang mga glandula ng amoy malapit sa mata para markahan ang teritoryo.

statements.text: A predator doesn't always succeed — often its prey escapes and it has to hunt all over again.
statements.tl: Hindi laging matagumpay ang mandaragit; madalas nakakatakas ang biktima at kailangan nitong manghuli ulit.

statements.text:
What is a bat's 'feeding buzz'?

When a bat closes in on an insect, it sends out clicks super fast, almost blurring together — called a feeding buzz. More clicks mean more info on exactly where the prey is.
statements.tl:
Ano ang 'feeding buzz' ng paniki?

Kapag papalapit na ang paniki sa insekto, mas pinapabilis nito ang mga klik hanggang halos magsanib — tinatawag itong 'feeding buzz.' Mas maraming klik, mas eksaktong nalalaman kung nasaan ang biktima.

statements.text:
Are all wasps bad?

Not all! Many wasps eat pests and caterpillars that damage crops, so they actually help farmers.
statements.tl:
Masama ba ang lahat ng putakti?

Hindi lahat! Marami sa kanila ang kumakain ng mga peste at uod na sumisira sa pananim, kaya nakatutulong pa sila sa mga magsasaka.

statements.text: An ecosystem is made of biotic parts, like plants and animals, and abiotic parts, like water, light, temperature, and soil.
statements.tl: Ang isang ekosistema ay binubuo ng mga biotic na bahagi gaya ng halaman at hayop, at mga abiotic na bahagi gaya ng tubig, liwanag, temperatura, at lupa.

statements.text: Most seaweed grows in shallow water close to shore, where sunlight can still reach down to it.
statements.tl: Karamihan ng damong-dagat ay tumutubo sa mababaw na tubig malapit sa baybayin, kung saan umaabot pa ang sikat ng araw.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; algae need light, grow in photic zone

statements.text: Many kinds of ants build their nests underground, deep beneath the soil.
statements.tl: Maraming langgam ang gumagawa ng pugad sa ilalim ng lupa.

statements.text: A marsh is a wetland filled with grasses and water plants -- not tall trees like a forest.
statements.tl: Ang marsh ay isang latian na puno ng mga damo at halamang-tubig -- hindi malalaking puno tulad ng gubat.

statements.text: Tilapia is cold-blooded, so its body temperature simply follows the water around it.
statements.tl: Malamig ang dugo ng tilapia, kaya sumusunod ang init ng katawan nito sa tubig sa paligid.

statements.text: Tilling loosens the soil so air and water can get in, making it easier for plant roots to grow!
statements.tl: Ang pagbungkal ng lupa ay nagluluwag dito para makapasok ang hangin at tubig, kaya mas madaling tumubo ang ugat ng pananim!

statements.text: Organisms survive within specific temperature ranges, and extreme heat can cause dehydration and death in plants and animals.
statements.tl: Ang mga organismo ay nabubuhay sa loob ng tiyak na saklaw ng temperatura, at ang matinding init ay maaaring magdulot ng dehydration at kamatayan sa mga halaman at hayop.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12RIQW0JsfoCFULxYyBTkyLFNWrXV1t6e), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Tropical rainforests, swamps, estuaries, mangrove forests, and coral reefs are types of ecosystems where living and nonliving things interact.
statements.tl: Ang tropical rainforests, swamps, estuaries, mangrove forests, at coral reefs ay mga uri ng ecosystem kung saan nag-uugnayan ang mga bagay na may buhay at walang buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 183cZqCldp2AVmvrvnAY392YKRBeSqC6i), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Nematodes are round, unsegmented worms that live in soil, water, or as parasites inside plants and animals.
statements.tl: Ang mga nematode ay mga bilog at hindi naka-segment na bulate na nabubuhay sa lupa, tubig, o bilang parasite sa loob ng mga halaman at hayop.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 19dbDBnYNWQiScQFm-RWQxi6Zy8yTgr8G), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Biotic factors are the living components of an ecosystem, including all the plants, animals, and microorganisms found there.
statements.tl: Ang biotic factors ay ang mga buhay na bahagi ng isang ecosystem, kasama na ang lahat ng halaman, hayop, at microorganisms na makikita rito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TX79kAgz5ykLUsthHNy-Va0wtA7GV1gv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Can the color and type of soil affect how many organisms live in a place?

Yes! Abiotic factors like soil, water, and temperature influence the ecosystem and can affect the number of organisms living in an area.
statements.tl:
Nakakaapekto ba ang kulay at uri ng lupa sa dami ng organismong nakatira sa isang lugar?

Oo! Ang abiotic factors tulad ng lupa, tubig, at temperatura ay nakakaimpluwensya sa ecosystem at nakakaapekto sa bilang ng mga organismong naninirahan sa isang lugar.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ln8v5I61MGuZsaS8nxl0k96VBBSwtDQe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Temperature, a measure of how hot or cold something is, is an abiotic factor that affects the kind of living organisms that can survive in a certain place.
statements.tl: Ang temperatura, isang sukat ng init o lamig ng isang bagay, ay isang abiotic factor na nakakaapekto sa uri ng mga organismong maaaring mabuhay sa isang lugar.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ln8v5I61MGuZsaS8nxl0k96VBBSwtDQe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An organism is any individual living thing that can carry out life processes on its own, like a single dog, a single tree, or a single bacterium.
statements.tl: Ang organismo ay anumang indibidwal na bagay na may buhay na kayang magsagawa ng mga proseso ng buhay nang mag-isa, tulad ng isang aso, isang puno, o isang bacterium.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1n_na2R8mjL1ylpfiUIZ6jsZCWh7I-bH5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An organism is a biotic component of an ecosystem and can be a plant, an animal, or a microorganism, but it is never a nonliving thing.
statements.tl: Ang organism ay isang biotic component ng ecosystem at maaaring halaman, hayop, o microorganism, ngunit hindi ito kailanman isang bagay na walang buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1r9_sEAlACCr7-n_B8boyXu62_j5GQplw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do some plants in the garden look different after a few weeks?

Because the ecosystem is always changing! Biotic factors like pests and abiotic factors like sunlight and rain work together to shape how every plant grows.
statements.tl:
Bakit nagkakaiba ang itsura ng ilang halaman sa hardin pagkalipas ng ilang linggo?

Dahil ang ecosystem ay laging nagbabago! Ang mga biotic factors gaya ng pests at abiotic factors gaya ng sikat ng araw at ulan ay nagtutulungan upang hubugin kung paano tumutubo ang bawat halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ruwka6bNCNNEjsrA8qNvcrSD4LUzmkH_), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Soil type is an abiotic factor that affects which plants can grow in a place, because different soils hold different amounts of water and nutrients.
statements.tl: Ang uri ng lupa ay isang abiotic factor na nakakaapekto kung aling mga halaman ang maaaring tumubo sa isang lugar, dahil ang iba't ibang lupa ay nagtataglay ng iba't ibang dami ng tubig at nutrients.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1wt4AqWCGIjXujtAi4dg4LPyyHXz_vXWw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What are the living parts of an ecosystem called?

They are called biotic components. These include all plants, animals, and tiny organisms like bacteria.
statements.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa mga buhay na bahagi ng ecosystem?

Tinatawag silang biotic components. Kabilang dito ang lahat ng halaman, hayop, at maliliit na organismo tulad ng bacteria.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zGIaVRAM1RKK6qE1r5nHD9GewfRDJtu1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What are edaphic factors?

They are the soil conditions, like its texture and nutrients, that help plants and other organisms grow and survive.
statements.tl:
Ano ang edaphic factors?

Ito ang mga kondisyon ng lupa, tulad ng texture at sustansya nito, na tumutulong sa paglaki at pamumuhay ng mga halaman at ibang organismo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zGIaVRAM1RKK6qE1r5nHD9GewfRDJtu1), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mangrove roots filter dirt right out of the water, keeping the coast cleaner!
statements.tl: Sinasala ng ugat ng bakawan ang dumi sa tubig, kaya nagiging mas malinis ang baybayin!

statements.text: Constant cleaning on the reef helps keep the number of parasites on fish under control.
statements.tl: Ang patuloy na paglilinis sa bahura ay tumutulong kontrolin ang dami ng parasito sa mga isda.

statements.text: Earthworm tunnels make it easier for plant roots to grow down into the soil.
statements.tl: Ang mga lungga ng bulate ay nagbibigay-daan para mas madaling lumago ang ugat ng halaman papunta sa lupa.

statements.text: The clownfish makes its home inside a sea anemone to stay protected from predators!
statements.tl: Nakatira ang clownfish sa loob ng sea anemone para maprotektahan mula sa mga mandaragit!

statements.text: Some egg-laying animals stand guard over their eggs so predators can't get to them.
statements.tl: May mga hayop na nangingitlog na nagbabantay sa kanilang itlog para hindi ito makain ng kaaway.

statements.text: Tree roots hold soil firmly in place, helping prevent erosion and landslides!
statements.tl: Hinahawakan ng mga ugat ng puno ang lupa kaya napipigilan nito ang pagguho ng lupa at landslide!

statements.text: Mutualism is an ecological relationship where both organisms benefit, while predation is when one organism kills and eats another.
statements.tl: Ang mutualism ay isang ecological relationship kung saan parehong nakikinabang ang dalawang organismo, habang ang predation ay kapag pinapatay at kinakain ng isang organismo ang isa pa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-jkIyOW3x1iJKEt7w4KULAfIIS1KR7FO), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Volcanic eruptions can produce fertile soil and plant nutrients excellent for farming, but they also release sulfur dioxide that causes acid rain harmful to fish and wildlife.
statements.tl: Ang pagsabog ng bulkan ay maaaring lumikha ng matabang lupa at nutrients para sa halaman na mainam sa pagsasaka, ngunit naglalabas din ito ng sulfur dioxide na nagdudulot ng acid rain na nakakasama sa isda at wildlife.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12RIQW0JsfoCFULxYyBTkyLFNWrXV1t6e), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do floods change an ecosystem?

Floods bring too much water too quickly, which can drown plants, wash away soil, and destroy the homes of animals that live on land!
statements.tl:
Paano binabago ng baha ang isang ecosystem?

Ang baha ay nagdadala ng sobrang dami ng tubig nang napakabilis, na maaaring lumunod sa mga halaman, magtanggal ng lupa, at sumira sa mga tahanan ng mga hayop na nakatira sa lupa!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12RIQW0JsfoCFULxYyBTkyLFNWrXV1t6e), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Logging can reduce prey availability and affect predator populations, because cutting down trees destroys the homes of the animals that predators eat.
statements.tl: Ang logging ay maaaring magbawas ng prey at makaapekto sa mga predator, dahil ang pagputol ng mga puno ay sumisira sa tirahan ng mga hayop na kinakain ng mga predator.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15axOWvFMWNAqsADbczE00z9QRWLyVjWi), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Soil fosters biodiversity, meaning it is home to many living things like earthworms, ants, beetles, and tiny organisms we cannot see.
statements.tl: Ang lupa ay nagtataguyod ng biodiversity, ibig sabihin tahanan ito ng maraming buhay na bagay tulad ng bulate, langgam, salagubang, at maliliit na organismo na hindi natin nakikita.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15b3YF1ra-GBLZjwriX36TTjr6dajYnNS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Removing contaminated bottom sediments is one way to repair an estuary, because it takes away the toxic mud that poisons the water and the animals living there.
statements.tl: Ang pag-alis ng mga contaminated bottom sediments ay isang paraan upang ayusin ang isang estuary, dahil inaalis nito ang nakakalasong putik na lumalason sa tubig at sa mga hayop na nakatira doon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18AtJakKpgkI14RwOpLJzBWGPEK64esRi), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is the difference between an ectoparasite and an endoparasite?

An ectoparasite lives on the outside of its host, like a tick, while an endoparasite lives inside, like a tapeworm.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng ectoparasite at endoparasite?

Ang ectoparasite ay nabubuhay sa labas ng katawan ng host, tulad ng garapata, habang ang endoparasite ay nabubuhay sa loob, tulad ng tapeworm.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GO3-_Qc28AsEUbcr9XkVDPzyriYr0Swl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Parasites can live on the outside of a host as ectoparasites, like ticks, or inside as endoparasites, like tapeworms.
statements.tl: Ang mga parasite ay maaaring mabuhay sa labas ng host bilang ectoparasite, tulad ng garapata, o sa loob bilang endoparasite, tulad ng tapeworm.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GO3-_Qc28AsEUbcr9XkVDPzyriYr0Swl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Environmental conditions such as food, water, temperature, and calamities affect the life cycle of organisms.
statements.tl: Ang mga kondisyon ng kapaligiran tulad ng pagkain, tubig, temperatura, at mga kalamidad ay nakakaapekto sa life cycle ng mga organismo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IqtRthEHa0dLtv1KAIMH1I-CfoymJSmS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Lice and ticks are external parasites because they live outside the body of their host, like on the skin or hair.
statements.tl: Ang kuto at garapata ay mga external parasite dahil nabubuhay sila sa labas ng katawan ng kanilang host, tulad ng sa balat o buhok.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1K4m1qAjqoifZyU4O9r3_PigMzbOQwgPN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In intertidal zones, abiotic factors like waves, salinity, sunlight, temperature, and soil type affect the organisms living there, just as they do in estuaries.
statements.tl: Sa intertidal zones, ang mga abiotic factor tulad ng alon, salinity, sikat ng araw, temperatura, at uri ng lupa ay nakakaapekto sa mga organism na nakatira doon, tulad din sa estuary.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TX79kAgz5ykLUsthHNy-Va0wtA7GV1gv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: During a drought, the water in a pond can evaporate, and the fertilized eggs of frogs will not survive.
statements.tl: Kapag may tagtuyot, ang tubig sa lawa ay maaaring sumingaw, at ang mga fertilized egg ng palaka ay hindi mabubuhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YAktm1Kl8QiPMQM60mTuzEUjZhFWK0nF), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A wedge is used to cut or split things, just like a knife, an axe, or scissors!
statements.tl: Ginagamit ang wedge para humiwa o magbiyak, tulad ng kutsilyo, palakol, at gunting!

statements.text: Our sharp front teeth act just like wedges that help us cut and bite our food!
statements.tl: Ang matatalas nating ngipin sa harap ay parang wedge na tumutulong sa atin na humiwa ng pagkain!

statements.text: We use a screw to hold things tightly together, like pieces of wood!
statements.tl: Ginagamit ang turnilyo para pagdugtungin at hawakang mahigpit ang mga bagay, gaya ng kahoy!

statements.text: A pulley at the top of a flagpole makes it easy to raise and lower the flag each school morning!
statements.tl: Ang pulley sa itaas ng flagpole ay nagpapadali sa pag-angat at pagbaba ng watawat tuwing umaga sa school!

statements.text:
What simple machine helps you roll heavy things up easily?

A ramp is a type of inclined plane!
statements.tl:
Anong simple machine ang tumutulong para madaling gulongin ang mga mabibigat na bagay?

Ang rampa (ramp) ay isang uri ng inclined plane!

statements.text: A bolt and a twist-on jar lid are types of screw!
statements.tl: Ang turnilyo (bolt) at ang pihit-takip ng garapon ay mga uri ng screw!

statements.text: An inclined plane is widely used at home and in workplaces because it can move heavy objects easily, overcome obstacles with little effort, and raise or lower a load.
statements.tl: Ang inclined plane ay malawakang ginagamit sa bahay at trabaho dahil kaya nitong ilipat ang mabibigat na bagay nang madali, malampasan ang mga hadlang nang may kaunting effort, at itaas o ibaba ang isang karga.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-806AsjWRCThbofCp0dU0VwZ5zoal8Wa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Pulleys are used to raise or lower loads such as construction materials, using a rope that runs over a grooved wheel to change the direction of the pulling force.
statements.tl: Ang mga pulley ay ginagamit para itaas o ibaba ang mga kargamento tulad ng mga construction materials, gamit ang lubid na dumadaan sa isang ukit na gulong para baguhin ang direksyon ng puwersa ng paghila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 194wiPGw4U0Xa_5pVGgMGrjvcme3oqpBz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Stairs, slides, ladders, and driveways are all examples of inclined planes that help us move between different heights.
statements.tl: Ang hagdan, slide, ladder, at driveway ay mga halimbawa ng inclined planes na tumutulong sa atin na lumipat sa pagitan ng magkakaibang taas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Hc2OuR7WozEGjlaP8UzRaBd6kzm971_U), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A wedge is a double inclined plane sharpened at the end, which is why it can cut and split materials.
statements.tl: Ang wedge ay isang double inclined plane na pinatalas sa dulo, kaya kaya nitong maghiwa at maghati ng mga materyales.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Hc2OuR7WozEGjlaP8UzRaBd6kzm971_U), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A pulley uses grooved wheels and ropes or chains to raise, lower, or move a load.
statements.tl: Ang pulley ay gumagamit ng mga grooved wheels at lubid o kadena upang itaas, ibaba, o ilipat ang isang load.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Hc2OuR7WozEGjlaP8UzRaBd6kzm971_U), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A screw is used to fasten or hold things together, like a jar lid that tightens onto a jar or a bolt that holds parts in place.
statements.tl: Ang screw ay ginagamit upang pagdikitin o hawakan ang mga bagay, tulad ng takip ng garapon na humihigpit sa garapon o isang bolt na humahawak sa mga bahagi sa lugar.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UjUSHe1lYrRvhFooUBZRXGZsiP5eP9gA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Levers are used for lifting, removing, or pulling out objects easily, like using a crowbar to lift a heavy rock or tweezers to pull out a splinter.
statements.tl: Ang mga lever ay ginagamit sa pagbubuhat, pagtanggal, o pagbunot ng mga bagay nang madali, tulad ng paggamit ng crowbar upang iangat ang isang mabigat na bato o sipit upang bunutin ang isang tinik.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UjUSHe1lYrRvhFooUBZRXGZsiP5eP9gA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: If the threads of a screw become loose or worn down, the screw can no longer grip properly and will not work well.
statements.tl: Kung ang mga thread ng screw ay maluwag o napudpod na, hindi na makakapit nang maayos ang screw at hindi na ito gagana nang mahusay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Y5Rf1S8KhON3T2ZDIaMdDPvrURh922PE), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A ladder is an inclined plane that helps a person reach a high place by spreading the climb over a longer, slanted distance.
statements.tl: Ang hagdan ay isang inclined plane na tumutulong sa isang tao na maabot ang mataas na lugar sa pamamagitan ng pagpapahaba ng pag-akyat sa mas mahabang nakahilig na distansya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Y5Rf1S8KhON3T2ZDIaMdDPvrURh922PE), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mechanical balances use springs, levers, and reference weights to measure mass without needing electricity.
statements.tl: Ang mechanical balances ay gumagamit ng springs, levers, at reference weights upang sukatin ang mass nang hindi nangangailangan ng kuryente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aM3wMlrxKITYVpGo1SlU8jHV3DHz-gGA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A zipper's slider uses wedge-shaped parts to push interlocking teeth together to fasten clothing and bags, or to separate the teeth to open them.
statements.tl: Ang slider ng zipper ay gumagamit ng mga bahaging hugis-wedge upang pagdugtungin ang mga ngipin para isara ang damit at bag, o paghiwalayin ang mga ngipin para buksan ang mga ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jqGGCpgafgYfXXmc3uDVSrl5lSPoHxnG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A pencil can act as a lever when you use it to pry something, with your finger as the fulcrum and the pencil as the rigid rod.
statements.tl: Ang lapis ay maaaring kumilos bilang lever kapag ginamit mo ito sa pagpry, na ang iyong daliri ang fulcrum at ang lapis ang matigas na baras.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ojP1YOasi1mMXjwPY1eZL_RLLQ9LNRCx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: On a lever, the force we apply is called the effort, and the thing we are trying to move is called the load!
statements.tl: Sa palanca, ang puwersang ibinibigay natin ay tinatawag na effort, at ang bagay na ginagalaw natin ay ang load!

statements.text: Levers don't give free strength! When you use less force, you must move the effort end through a longer distance.
statements.tl: Hindi libre ang lakas sa palanca! Kapag mas kaunti ang force, kailangan mong galawin ang effort sa mas mahabang distansiya.

statements.text: It takes less force to push a heavy load up a ramp than to lift it straight up!
statements.tl: Mas kaunting puwersa ang kailangan para itulak ang mabigat na bagay sa dahilig kaysa buhatin ito nang diretso!

statements.text:
What is the trade-off when using a ramp?

A ramp lets you use less force, but you must move the load over a longer distance!
statements.tl:
Ano ang kapalit sa paggamit ng ramp?

Mas kaunting puwersa ang kailangan sa pagtulak sa rampa, pero kailangan mong itulak ito sa mas mahabang distansya!

statements.text: A longer, gentler ramp needs less force to use than a short, steep one!
statements.tl: Ang mas mahaba at banayad na dahilig ay nangangailangan ng mas kaunting puwersa kaysa sa maikli at matarik!

statements.text: A wedge is a simple machine made of two inclined planes joined to form a sharp edge!
statements.tl: Ang wedge ay isang payak na makina na gawa sa dalawang dahilig na pinagsama para mabuo ang matalas na dulo!

statements.text: A long, thin wedge splits things much more easily than a short, thick wedge!
statements.tl: Ang manipis at mahabang wedge ay mas madaling pumunit kaysa sa makapal at maikling wedge!

statements.text: A fixed pulley changes the direction of force! You can pull down to lift a load up.
statements.tl: Ang nakapirming pulley ay nagbabago ng direksyon ng force! Pwede kang humila pababa para makaangat ng load pataas.

statements.text: A single fixed pulley changes the direction of a pull but ideally does not reduce the force needed. A movable pulley supported by two rope segments can ideally halve the effort, but you pull twice as much rope as the load rises. Real pulleys have friction. No pulley creates energy or reduces the ideal work needed to lift the same load to the same height.
statements.tl: Binabago ng isang fixed pulley ang direksiyon ng hila ngunit hindi nito binabawasan ang kailangang puwersa sa ideal na kalagayan. Maaaring hatiin sa dalawa ng movable pulley na suportado ng dalawang bahagi ng lubid ang effort, ngunit doble ang haba ng lubid na hihilahin kaysa taas ng bagay. May friction ang tunay na pulley. Walang pulley na lumilikha ng enerhiya o nagpapababa ng ideal na work para sa parehong bigat at taas.

statements.text: When you push a wedge downward, it redirects the force to both sides, pushing the material apart!
statements.tl: Kapag itinutulak mo ang wedge pababa, binabago nito ang direksyon ng puwersa sa magkabilang gilid para ihiwalay ang materyal!
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; AAAS BSL Ch.8 (force vectors / wedge)

statements.text: On a real ramp, you need a little extra force compared to a perfect one because friction resists the motion!
statements.tl: Sa totoong rampa, kailangan mo ng kaunting dagdag na puwersa kaysa sa perpektong rampa dahil may friction na humahadlang sa paggalaw!
statements.source: NRC PS2.A (friction); AAAS BSL Ch.8 (real vs ideal machines)

statements.text: A third-class lever always has a mechanical advantage of less than 1, multiplying distance instead of force!
statements.tl: Ang third-class lever ay laging may mechanical advantage na mas mababa sa 1, pinapalaki ang distansya kaysa puwersa!

statements.text: A vegetable peeler is a wedge, with two inclined planes joined back-to-back to slice through the skin of fruits and vegetables.
statements.tl: Ang vegetable peeler ay isang wedge, na may dalawang inclined plane na pinagdugtong nang magkatalikod para humiwa sa balat ng mga prutas at gulay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Y5Rf1S8KhON3T2ZDIaMdDPvrURh922PE), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A wedge is two inclined planes joined at a common base, forming a sharp edge that can separate, split, cut, lift, or hold objects.
statements.tl: Ang wedge ay dalawang inclined plane na pinagsama sa iisang base, na bumubuo ng matalim na gilid na kayang maghiwalay, maghati, maghiwa, mag-angat, o humawak ng mga bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jqGGCpgafgYfXXmc3uDVSrl5lSPoHxnG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A thinner wedge has a greater mechanical advantage because its length is much larger than its thickness, so it needs less effort to cut.
statements.tl: Ang mas manipis na wedge ay may mas malaking mechanical advantage dahil mas mahaba ito kaysa sa kapal nito, kaya mas kaunting effort ang kailangan para pumutol.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jqGGCpgafgYfXXmc3uDVSrl5lSPoHxnG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A toothpick is a tiny wedge that slides between teeth to remove food particles, using its thin pointed tip to push them out.
statements.tl: Ang toothpick ay isang maliit na wedge na dumadausdos sa pagitan ng mga ngipin para tanggalin ang mga tinga, gamit ang manipis at matulis nitong dulo para itulak ang mga ito palabas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jqGGCpgafgYfXXmc3uDVSrl5lSPoHxnG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A crane uses a block and tackle pulley system to lift heavy objects like steel beams and big containers.
statements.tl: Ang crane ay gumagamit ng block and tackle pulley system para iangat ang mabibigat na bagay tulad ng steel beams at malalaking container.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1vh-OYaK9TGUJ_KoihnJNFGX3fTwm6s-R), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A metal lever, like a crowbar, lifts heavy rocks by multiplying the force you apply!
statements.tl: Ang metal na lever, tulad ng crowbar, kayang buhatin ang mabigat na bato sa pamamagitan ng pag-multiply ng puwersa mo!

statements.text:
How do simple machines like a lever make work easier?

They change the size or direction of the force needed!
statements.tl:
Paano pinapadali ng mga simpleng makina gaya ng lever ang trabaho?

Binabago nila ang laki o direksyon ng puwersa na kailangan!

statements.text: Want to test the load side? Keep your hand in the exact same spot, and just move the load closer to or farther from the fulcrum!
statements.tl: Gusto mo subukan ang load side? Panatilihin ang kamay mo sa parehong lugar, at ilipat lang ang load papalapit o papalayo sa fulcrum!

statements.text: Testing direction change is fun! Watch the load move up when you push the lever down, and record this opposite motion in your notes.
statements.tl: Masaya mag-test ng direction change! Panoorin ang load na umakyat kapag tinulak mo pababa ang lever, at isulat ang opposite motion sa notes.

statements.text: Grab a meter stick! Measure the distance from the fulcrum to the load, and from the fulcrum to your hand.
statements.tl: Kumuha ng meter stick! Sukatin ang distansya mula sa fulcrum papunta sa karga, at mula sa fulcrum papunta sa iyong kamay.

statements.text: In a lever fair test, the distance you change is the independent variable. The force you measure is the dependent variable!
statements.tl: Sa patas na pagsubok ng lever, ang distansyang binabago mo ay ang independent variable. Ang pwersang sinusukat mo ay ang dependent variable!

statements.text: When the fulcrum sits between the load and your hand, pushing down makes the load go up! It changes the force's direction.
statements.tl: Kapag ang fulcrum ay nasa pagitan ng load at kamay mo, ang pagtulak pababa ay nagpapaangat sa load! Binabago nito ang direksyon ng force.

statements.text: The mechanical advantage of simple machines helps us understand how much a tool multiplies our effort to make a task easier.
statements.tl: Ang mechanical advantage ng simple machines ay tumutulong sa atin na maunawaan kung gaano kalaki ang pagpaparami ng isang kasangkapan sa ating effort para mapadali ang isang gawain.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-806AsjWRCThbofCp0dU0VwZ5zoal8Wa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does distance affect a lever's turning effect?

It depends on force strength and distance from the fulcrum! The farther from the fulcrum, the bigger the turning effect.
statements.tl:
Paano nakakaapekto ang layo sa turning effect ng lever?

Nakadepende ito sa lakas ng puwersa at layo mula sa fulcrum! Mas malayo sa fulcrum, mas malaki ang turning effect.
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; AAAS BSL Ch.8; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: Lifting is easier when the lever arm to your hand is longer! That's why a crowbar has a long handle to keep you far from the fulcrum.
statements.tl: Mas madaling magbuhat kapag mas mahaba ang lever arm sa kamay mo! Kaya may mahabang hawakan ang barreta para malayo ka sa fulcrum.

statements.text: Torque is force multiplied by the perpendicular lever arm distance! A longer lever arm produces greater torque using the exact same force.
statements.tl: Ang torque ay puwersa na pinarami sa perpendikular na distansya ng lever arm! Ang mas mahabang lever arm ay nagbibigay ng mas malaking torque sa parehong puwersa.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; NRC PS2.A; DepEd G7 Science

statements.text: A crowbar acts as a first-class lever! It multiplies your applied force so you can easily pry heavy objects apart.
statements.tl: Ang crowbar ay isang first-class lever! Pinapalakas nito ang applied force mo para madaling mapabuka ang mabibigat na bagay.

statements.text:
How do you make a fair lever test?

Keep the same lever, fulcrum, and load! Only change the distance from the fulcrum to your hand to make it a fair test.
statements.tl:
Paano gumawa ng patas na pagsubok sa lever?

Gamitin ang parehong lever, fulcrum, at load! Palitan lang ang layo mula sa fulcrum papunta sa kamay mo para maging patas ang test.

statements.text: To change the effort distance, just slide your hand along the lever! But remember, you must keep the load weight exactly the same.
statements.tl: Para baguhin ang effort distance, islide lang ang kamay mo sa lever! Pero tandaan, dapat eksaktong pareho pa rin ang bigat ng load.

statements.text: How do scientists record data? They use a neat table listing the effort distance, load distance, and measured force for every single trial!
statements.tl: Paano nagre-record ng data ang mga scientist? Gumagamit sila ng table na naglilista ng effort distance, load distance, at measured force sa bawat trial!

statements.text:
Why do scientists repeat lever measurements three times?

They use the average force! This way, random measurement errors can have less effect on their final answer.
statements.tl:
Bakit inuulit ng mga scientist ang sukat sa lever ng tatlong beses?

Ginagamit nila ang average force! Kaya maaaring mabawasan ang epekto ng random na pagkakamali sa pagsukat sa huling sagot.

statements.text: When you graph effort force against effort distance, you'll see a curve going down as the distance gets longer!
statements.tl: Kapag nag-graph ng effort force laban sa effort distance, makikita mo ang isang curve na bumababa habang humahaba ang distansya!

statements.text:
Why use the same ruler for every trial?

A heavier lever needs a different force to lift the same load! So, keep your ruler or board the same.
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangang pareho ang ruler sa bawat trial?

Kailangan ng ibang pwersa para buhatin ang karga kung mas mabigat ang lever! Kaya gamitin ang parehong ruler o board.

statements.text: Use a pencil to mark the exact spot where the lever rests on the fulcrum. This way, you measure all distances from that same point!
statements.tl: Markahan ng lapis ang eksaktong lugar kung saan nakapatong ang lever sa fulcrum. Para masukat mo ang lahat ng distansya mula sa parehong punto!

statements.text: A wave is a disturbance that travels outward from a source, like ripples spreading across a basin when you tap the water.
statements.tl: Ang wave ay isang disturbance na kumakalat mula sa pinagmulan, parang mga alon na lumalaganap sa palanggana kapag tinapik mo ang tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ue8q_SYRJXOhSSZdvSVQXAaxRZh5mu36), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is a wave?

A wave is a disturbance that carries energy from one place to another through a medium or space.
statements.tl:
Ano ang wave?

Ang wave ay isang disturbance na nagdadala ng energy mula sa isang lugar papunta sa iba sa pamamagitan ng medium o space.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1V3Wig2544AHbtE5W0oS6hquDI7zHd-6m), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why does sound get fainter as it moves away?

Its energy spreads out over a wider space as the sound wave moves away from its source!
statements.tl:
Bakit humihina ang tunog habang lumalayo ito?

Kumakalat ang enerhiya nito sa mas malawak na espasyo habang lumalayo ang alon ng tunog mula sa pinanggalingan!

statements.text: A surface water wave carries energy through the water. Water particles move in roughly circular or elliptical paths, rather than travelling along with the crest over its whole journey. Currents and breaking waves can also transport water. A floating marker helps you compare local water motion with the travelling wave pattern.
statements.tl: Nagdadala ng enerhiya ang alon sa ibabaw ng tubig. Gumagalaw ang mga particle ng tubig sa halos pabilog o pahabang bilog na landas, sa halip na sumabay sa crest sa buong paglalakbay nito. Maaari ring magdala ng tubig ang agos at bumabasag na alon. Makatutulong ang lumulutang na marka upang ihambing ang lokal na galaw ng tubig at naglalakbay na alon.

statements.text: When a lamp is switched on, light waves travel into the room, carrying energy from the lamp to everything they reach.
statements.tl: Kapag binuksan ang lampara, naglalakbay ang light waves sa kuwarto, nagdadala ng energy mula sa lampara papunta sa lahat ng naaabot nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18CyfwIEpXeqURKivjQcnWbB3k8ocoVQP), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Light energy travels through space in all directions in the form of waves, spreading out from its source like ripples on a pond.
statements.tl: Ang light energy ay naglalakbay sa space sa lahat ng direksyon bilang waves, kumakalat mula sa pinagmulan nito tulad ng mga alon sa lawa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JI1oktnS7tPces0ag9jSNbSJ3TWDK2ja), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Electromagnetic waves carry energy without needing a rope or slinky, and people use them for radio, television, and mobile phone signals.
statements.tl: Ang electromagnetic waves ay nagdadala ng enerhiya nang hindi nangangailangan ng lubid o slinky, at ginagamit ito ng tao para sa radyo, telebisyon, at signal ng cellphone.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Vl8G2TwVap0pevMXdHG9-VI1gHnbh3-y), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Light and sound are similar because both are forms of energy that travel in waves.
statements.tl: Ang liwanag at tunog ay magkatulad dahil pareho silang mga anyo ng enerhiya na naglalakbay sa pamamagitan ng waves.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Wxd_1dqht8qbrVgrHuabsPv3Z9W_phqk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Does a wave carry the medium along with it?

Waves transfer energy without carrying the medium! A floating cork just bobs up and down in place as the wave passes.
statements.tl:
Dala ba ng alon ang medium papunta sa iba?

Naglilipat ang alon ng enerhiya nang hindi dinadala ang medium! Ang lumulutang na tapon ay tumataas-bumababa lang sa lugar nito habang dumadaan ang alon.
statements.source: NRC PS4.A grade-2 and grade-8 endpoints; AAAS Benchmarks 4F/H6c

statements.text: In radiation, heat travels as waves that cross even empty space. This is how the sun's heat reaches us through the vacuum of space!
statements.tl: Sa radiation, gumagalaw ang heat bilang waves na tumatawid kahit sa empty space. Ganyan naaabot tayo ng heat ng araw sa kabila ng vacuum ng space!
statements.source: AAAS BSL Ch.4E (M3, H7); encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: Wave energy is different from tidal energy! It comes from wind-made waves on the sea, and their up-and-down bobbing is turned into electricity.
statements.tl: Iba ang wave energy sa tidal energy! Galing ito sa mga alon na ginagawa ng hangin sa dagat, at ang taas-baba ng bawat alon ang ginagawang kuryente.

statements.text: Sound is a form of energy that travels through the air as invisible waves!
statements.tl: Ang tunog ay isang uri ng energy na naglalakbay sa hangin bilang mga wave!

statements.text: A returning echo is quieter than the original sound because it spreads out and loses energy while traveling!
statements.tl: Ang bumabalik na alingawngaw ay mas mahina kaysa orihinal na tunog dahil kumakalat at nawawalan ng lakas habang naglalakbay!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; sound intensity decreases with distance

statements.text:
Why can we feel a loud drum or speaker?

Sound carries energy! That is why we can feel the vibration from a loud speaker or drum nearby.
statements.tl:
