statements.text: In the Philippines, mango trees often bear fruit during the hot dry season, like April and May.
statements.tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang mangga ay madalas namumunga tuwing tag-init, tulad ng Abril at Mayo.

statements.text: In the Philippines, rice can be harvested twice a year — a wet season crop from July to November, and a dry season crop from January to May where there's irrigation.
statements.tl: Sa Pilipinas, dalawang beses maaaring mag-ani ng palay sa isang taon—ang wet season crop mula Hulyo hanggang Nobyembre, at ang dry season crop mula Enero hanggang Mayo kung may irigasyon.

statements.text: In the Philippines, lanzones and rambutan are usually harvested during the rainy months of August to October.
statements.tl: Sa Pilipinas, karaniwang inaani ang lanzones at rambutan sa panahon ng tag-ulan, mula Agosto hanggang Oktubre.

statements.text: In the Philippines, people tend to catch colds and flu more often during the rainy, cooler months.
statements.tl: Sa Pilipinas, mas madalas magkasipon at magka-trangkaso ang mga tao tuwing tag-ulan at malamig na panahon.
statements.source: CDC seasonality of respiratory viruses; PH PAGASA wet season; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: Panagbenga happens every February in Baguio, when the cool weather and coming dry season bring many flowers into bloom for the festival.
statements.tl: Ginaganap ang Panagbenga tuwing Pebrero sa Baguio, kapag malamig pa ang panahon at papalapit na ang tag-init, kaya maraming bulaklak ang namumukadkad para sa pista.

statements.text: In the Philippines, rice can be harvested twice a year—once in the rainy season and once in the dry season, if there's enough irrigation.
statements.tl: Sa Pilipinas, kayang anihin ang palay nang dalawang beses sa isang taon—isa tuwing tag-ulan at isa tuwing tag-init, kung may sapat na patubig.

statements.text:
When do we harvest more salt in the Philippines?

In the dry season! We need many days without rain to harvest lots of salt.
statements.tl:
Kailan mas maraming asin na naaani sa Pilipinas?

Sa tag-init! Kailangan ng maraming araw na walang ulan para makapag-ani ng maraming asin.
statements.source: PH-relevant; solar salt depends on dry weather (PAGASA seasons)

statements.text:
Why do we have day and night?

Earth spins (rotation)! The side facing the Sun gets day, and the side facing away gets night.
statements.tl:
Bakit may araw at gabi?

Umiikot ang Earth (rotation)! Ang bahaging nakaharap sa Araw ay may araw, at ang bahaging nakatalikod ay may gabi.

statements.text:
What causes day and night on Earth?

Earth rotates once in about 24 hours!
statements.tl:
Ano ang dahilan ng araw at gabi sa Mundo?

Umiikot ang Mundo nang isang beses sa loob ng halos 24 na oras!

statements.text: Earth has two main movements: rotation, spinning on its axis, and revolution, traveling around the sun.
statements.tl: May dalawang pangunahing galaw ang Earth: rotation, ang pag-ikot sa axis nito, at revolution, ang paglalakbay sa paligid ng araw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ayeVnWxGqXrby_5v0Gbsygi3eDsOQA9y), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Earth's axis is for rotation, while its orbit is the path it follows for revolution around the Sun.
statements.tl: Ang axis ng Earth ay para sa rotation, habang ang orbit nito ay ang daang sinusundan para sa revolution sa paligid ng Araw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1fQ5-W3GtFuxu52ObmmJ5EXq2TbaBgmLN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does a Foucault pendulum show us?

It is a long pendulum whose swing direction slowly shifts, showing that the Earth rotates!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ipinapakita sa atin ng Foucault pendulum?

Ito ay mahabang pendulum na unti-unting nagbabago ng direksyon, na nagpapakitang umiikot ang Mundo!

statements.text: The Earth spins like a giant top, taking about a day for one full turn! This gives us day and night—one side faces the Sun while the other is dark.
statements.tl: Ang Mundo ay umiikot na parang malaking trumpo, at isang buong ikot ay halos isang araw! Kaya may umaga at gabi—isang bahagi ay nakaharap sa Araw habang nasa dilim ang kabila.

statements.text: Earth rotates on its axis once a day — that's why we have daytime and night! It also revolves around the Sun yearly, and its tilt causes the different seasons.
statements.tl: Umiikot (rotation) ang Earth sa axis nito isang beses kada araw — kaya may araw (day) at gabi (night)! Umiikot din sa Araw (revolution) taon-taon, at ang pagkakatagilid nito ang nagdudulot ng seasons.

statements.text:
Why is it warm and bright during the day, but cool and dark at night?

During the day, your part of Earth faces the Sun — warm and bright! At night, Earth has spun around, and your part faces away — cool and dark!
statements.tl:
Bakit mainit at maliwanag sa araw, pero malamig at madilim sa gabi?

Tuwing araw, nakaharap sa Araw ang bahagi ng Earth natin — mainit at maliwanag! Tuwing gabi, tumalikod na ang ating bahagi sa Araw habang umiikot ang Earth — malamig at madilim!

statements.text: The Sun doesn't disappear at night! The Earth simply turns around, making our side face away from it.
statements.tl: Hindi nawawala ang Araw sa gabi! Umiikot lang ang Mundo, kaya ang ating panig ay humaharap palayo sa kanya.

statements.text:
What's the difference between Earth's spin and its orbit?

Two different moves! Spinning on its axis makes day and night, while orbiting the Sun makes the year and the seasons.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng pag-ikot at pag-inog ng Mundo?

Dalawang magkaibang galaw! Pag-ikot sa ehe ang gumagawa ng araw at gabi, pag-inog sa Araw ang gumagawa ng taon at panahon.

statements.text:
Why do constellations seem to move across the sky at night?

Constellations seem to slowly move across the sky at night because the Earth is rotating on its axis!
statements.tl:
Bakit mukhang gumagalaw ang mga konstelasyon sa langit tuwing gabi?

Mukhang dahan-dahang gumagalaw ang mga konstelasyon sa langit tuwing gabi dahil umiikot ang Earth sa sarili nitong axis!

statements.text:
Why do different countries have different times?

Because Earth spins, the Sun doesn't reach every place at once! That's why we have 'time zones' so clocks match the Sun's position in each place.
statements.tl:
Bakit magkakaiba ang oras sa iba't ibang bansa?

Dahil umiikot ang Earth, hindi sabay na tumatama ang Araw sa lahat ng lugar! Kaya may mga 'time zone' para tumugma ang orasan sa posisyon ng Araw sa bawat lugar.

statements.text:
Why can we only see stars at night?

Our part of Earth turns away from the Sun! Stars are still there in the daytime, but hidden by the bright light of our Sun.
statements.tl:
Bakit sa gabi lang tayo nakakakita ng mga bituin?

Tumatalikod ang ating bahagi ng Earth sa Araw! Nandito pa ang mga bituin sa araw, pero natatakpan ng maliwanag na sinag ng Araw.

statements.text: The Sun never stops making energy from fusion! It’s only night for us because our side of the Earth spun away from it.
statements.tl: Hindi kailanman tumitigil ang Araw sa paggawa ng enerhiya mula sa fusion! Gabi lang sa atin dahil tumalikod ang ating bahagi ng Earth.

statements.text:
Does the sun travel across the sky to give us day and night?

Nope, Earth is the one spinning! When our side faces the sun, it’s daytime. When we turn away, it’s night!
statements.tl:
Naglalakad ba ang araw sa langit para magkaroon tayo ng araw at gabi?

Hindi, ang Earth ang umiikot! Kapag nakaharap tayo sa araw, araw; kapag tumalikod tayo, gabi na!

statements.text:
Why does the Sun always rise in the east and set in the west?

Earth spins toward the east! This makes the Sun look like it's moving the opposite way across the sky, rising in the east and setting in the west.
statements.tl:
Bakit lagi nating nakikitang sumisikat ang Araw sa silangan at lumulubog sa kanluran?

Umiikot ang Earth papuntang silangan! Kaya tila gumagalaw ang Araw sa kabilang direksyon sa langit, sumisikat sa silangan at lumulubog sa kanluran.

statements.text:
Why do different countries have different times?

Because Earth rotates! When it's noon in the Philippines, it's night in America, and a totally different time of day in other countries.
statements.tl:
Bakit magkakaiba ang oras sa iba't ibang bansa?

Dahil umiikot ang Earth! Kapag tanghali sa Pilipinas, gabi na sa Amerika, at iba ang oras ng araw sa ibang mga bansa.

statements.text:
Where does the sun go at night?

The sun doesn't go away! Earth just turns, making our side face away. While it's night here, it's daytime on the other side of the world!
statements.tl:
Saan napupunta ang araw sa gabi?

Hindi umaalis ang araw! Umiikot lang ang Earth kaya tumatalikod ang ating panig. Habang gabi sa atin, araw naman sa kabilang panig ng mundo!

statements.text: Models can represent objects that are too big to see all at once, like the whole Earth.
statements.tl: Ang mga model ay maaaring kumatawan sa mga bagay na napakalaki para makitang lahat nang sabay-sabay, tulad ng buong mundo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ul8BVSjzHq7NqYd68r5A-41PFVD-aVhs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Models may be physical objects, drawings, or mathematical equations, and they are not perfect copies.
statements.tl: Ang mga model ay maaaring physical na bagay, drawing, o mathematical equation, at hindi ito perpektong kopya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ul8BVSjzHq7NqYd68r5A-41PFVD-aVhs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A model is not an exact copy! It leaves out extra details so scientists can focus on the most important parts.
statements.tl: Ang model ay hindi eksaktong kopya! Inaalis nito ang mga sobrang detalye para makapag-focus ang mga scientist sa mga mahahalagang bahagi.

statements.text: A magnetic field model draws curved lines around a magnet to show the invisible force that pulls or pushes other magnets!
statements.tl: Ang magnetic field model ay gumuguhit ng mga kurbadong linya sa paligid ng magnet para ipakita ang di-nakikitang puwersa na humihila o tumutulak sa ibang magnet!

statements.text:
Why do scientists make models?

Models represent objects or systems that are too large, small, complex, or difficult to observe directly, like the solar system.
statements.tl:
Bakit gumagawa ng mga modelo ang mga scientist?

Ang mga modelo ay kumakatawan sa mga bagay o sistema na masyadong malaki, maliit, komplikado, o mahirap obserbahan nang direkta, tulad ng solar system.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MLgvDZnYidMMOnbhLMAOxjx2JQtLLVO8), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How can you remember all the soil layers?

Building a model, like an edible soil profile with cookies and chocolate, helps you see and compare each horizon from top to bottom!
statements.tl:
Paano mo matatandaan ang lahat ng layer ng lupa?

Ang paggawa ng modelo, tulad ng edible soil profile na may cookies at tsokolate, ay nakakatulong sa iyo na makita at maikumpara ang bawat horizon mula itaas hanggang ibaba!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1muxFnwxsHn-8T4F5-t12dhW_24ogEDCz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A scientific model is a simplified version of something complicated, helping scientists predict and learn about the real thing.
statements.tl: Ang isang scientific model ay isang pinasimpleng bersyon ng isang komplikadong bagay, na tumutulong sa mga scientist na mahulaan at matutunan ang tungkol sa tunay na bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1phoVj4AIetsn7KiBDsWfsfdnplOmaDUb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Are scientific models exact copies of reality?

No, models are tools, not exact replicas, and they use the best information scientists have at the time.
statements.tl:
Eksaktong kopya ba ng realidad ang mga scientific model?

Hindi, ang mga model ay mga tool, hindi eksaktong replika, at ginagamit nila ang pinakamahusay na impormasyon na mayroon ang mga scientist sa ngayon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1w5bN-E8TLyq7pNLugNpfbXj1tHxwkolg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A molecule model uses balls and sticks to show how atoms join together through bonds to form a cool molecule!
statements.tl: Ang molecule model ay gumagamit ng mga bola at patpat para ipakita kung paano nagkakabit ang atoms sa pamamagitan ng bonds para gumawa ng molecule!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable consensus; NRC PS1.A (atoms and molecules)

statements.text:
How does soap wash away grease?

In oily water, soap molecules form micelles! These are spherical clusters that trap grease in the center and use water-loving ends on the outside to wash it all away.
statements.tl:
Paano tinatanggal ng sabon ang mantika?

Sa tubig na may mantika, gumagawa ang soap molecules ng micelles! Ito ay mga bilog na grupo na nakukulong ang mantika sa gitna at hinuhugasan ito palayo gamit ang water-loving ends.

statements.text: Niels Bohr created the famous Bohr model of the atom in 1913! It shows electrons orbiting the nucleus like planets around the sun.
statements.tl: Si Niels Bohr ang gumawa ng sikat na Bohr model ng atom noong 1913! Ipinapakita nito ang mga electron na umiikot sa nucleus.

statements.text:
How can we picture electrical current?

Think of water in a pipe! The wire is the pipe, and current is the water flowing inside. A stronger flow means more current, just like more water passing through!
statements.tl:
Paano natin maipapakita ang current?

Isipin mo ang tubig sa tubo! Ang wire ang tubo, at ang current ang tubig na dumadaloy. Mas malakas ang daloy, mas maraming current—gaya ng mas maraming tubig na dumadaan!

statements.text: Scientists use the ray model of light! They draw straight arrows to show the exact direction that light travels.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang mga siyentipiko ng ray model ng liwanag! Nagdodrawing sila ng mga tuwid na palaso para ipakita ang direksyon ng liwanag.

statements.text: Light behaves as both a wave and as tiny energy packets called photons! Scientists use both models together to explain how light works.
statements.tl: Ang liwanag ay kumikilos bilang wave at bilang maliliit na pakete ng enerhiya na tinatawag na photons! Ginagamit ng mga siyentipiko ang dalawang modelo para ipaliwanag kung paano gumagana ang liwanag.
statements.source: NRC PS4.B grade-12 endpoint (wave and particle models)

statements.text:
How do scientists show what type of rock is hiding under the ground?

They use a geologic map! Different colors and symbols show the type and age of rocks, made here by the Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB).
statements.tl:
Paano ipinapakita ng mga siyentipiko kung anong uri ng bato ang nakatago sa ilalim ng lupa?

Gumagamit sila ng geologic map! Ang iba't ibang kulay at simbolo ay nagpapakita ng uri at edad ng bato, ginawa ng Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB).

statements.text:
What is a globe?

A globe is a small, round model of Earth showing its ball shape and where lands and oceans are!
statements.tl:
Ano ang globo?

Ang globo ay isang maliit at bilog na modelo ng Daigdig na nagpapakita ng hugis-bola nito at ng mga lupain at karagatan!

statements.text: Scientists use models to test ideas about things they cannot observe directly! This includes the inside of a cell or the path of a typhoon.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang mga scientist ng models para subukan ang mga ideya tungkol sa mga bagay na hindi nila direktang nakikita! Kabilang dito ang loob ng cell o ang dadaanan ng bagyo.

statements.text: Models are not permanent! Scientists revise them when new observations do not fit the old picture.
statements.tl: Ang mga model ay hindi permanente! Binabago ito ng mga scientist kapag ang mga bagong obserbasyon ay hindi tugma sa lumang larawan.

statements.text: A glass of water can only hold so much sugar! Past that limit, extra sugar just won't dissolve.
statements.tl: May hangganan kung gaano karaming asukal ang matutunaw sa isang basong tubig. Kapag sobra na, hindi na ito matutunaw!

statements.text:
Does water dissolve the same amount of every substance?

No! In the same amount of water, much more sugar dissolves than salt because water dissolves different amounts of each substance.
statements.tl:
Pareho ba ang natutunaw na dami ng bawat sangkap sa tubig?

Hindi! Sa parehong dami ng tubig, mas maraming asukal ang natutunaw kaysa asin dahil iba-iba ang kayang tunawin ng tubig.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; solubility values (sucrose ~200 g vs NaCl ~36 g per 100 mL at 25C)

statements.text: A saturated solution is formed when the amount of dissolved solute is exactly equal to its solubility, so no more solute can dissolve at that temperature.
statements.tl: Ang saturated solution ay nabubuo kapag ang dami ng natunaw na solute ay eksaktong katumbas ng solubility nito, kaya wala nang ibang solute ang matutunaw sa temperaturang iyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aL4m3rOAsYmp0jcm-yY3PXU4JGhUwRmJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The nature of the solvent also affects solubility, because a solute tends to dissolve better in a solvent that matches its own nature.
statements.tl: Ang nature ng solvent ay nakakaapekto rin sa solubility, dahil ang solute ay karaniwang mas natutunaw sa solvent na katugma ng sarili nitong nature.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1kfavqjuUES7kXDoOI5L4q-QVnsHTC0j-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A saturated solution has dissolved as much solute as it can hold at a given temperature, so any extra solute settles at the bottom.
statements.tl: Ang saturated solution ay nakatunaw na ng pinakamaraming solute na kaya nitong hawakan sa isang temperatura, kaya ang sobrang solute ay naiipon sa ilalim.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_8scE0SSF8kpGAPKf6oPvOd3lk1kg6Ip), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Salt dissolves faster in warm water than in cold water! The warmer the water gets, the quicker the salt spreads out.
statements.tl: Mas mabilis matunaw ang asin sa mainit na tubig kaysa sa malamig! Mas mabilis kumalat ang asin kapag mas mainit ang tubig.

statements.text: Warm water holds less dissolved gas than cold water! When water gets hot, the dissolved oxygen escapes, making it harder for fish to breathe.
statements.tl: Mas kaunti ang gas na kayang itago ng mainit na tubig kaysa sa malamig! Kapag uminit, lumalabas ang natunaw na oksiheno, kaya nahihirapan huminga ang mga isda.

statements.text:
How can you make a solute dissolve faster?

A solute dissolves faster in warm water and when it is stirred, compared to cold, still water!
statements.tl:
Paano mapapabilis ang pagkatunaw ng isang solute?

Mas mabilis matunaw ang solute sa mainit na tubig at kapag hinahalo, kaysa sa malamig at tahimik na tubig!

statements.text:
Want to dissolve things faster?

Most solid solutes dissolve much faster in warm water than in cold water!
statements.tl:
Gusto mo mas mabilis matunaw ang mga bagay?

Mas mabilis matunaw ang mga solidong solute sa mainit na tubig kaysa sa malamig!

statements.text: There is a limit to how much solute can dissolve! When it is full, it is called saturated, and extra solute will not dissolve.
statements.tl: May hangganan kung gaano karaming solute ang matutunaw! Kapag puno na, tinatawag itong saturated at hindi na matutunaw ang dagdag.

statements.text: Solubility is the largest amount of solute that can dissolve in a given amount of solvent at a certain temperature!
statements.tl: Ang solubility ay ang pinakamaraming solute na matutunaw sa isang tiyak na dami ng solvent sa isang temperatura!

statements.text:
Why does a warm soft drink fizz out more?

Unlike solids, more gas dissolves in cold water! That is why a warm soft drink fizzes out more.
statements.tl:
Bakit mas umaalsa ang bula sa mainit na softdrink?

Kabaligtaran ng solido, mas maraming gas ang natutunaw sa malamig na tubig! Kaya umaalsa ang bula sa mainit na softdrink.

statements.text:
Does the amount of water change how much solute can dissolve?

Yes! More solute can dissolve when there is more water. A small amount of water gets saturated much sooner.
statements.tl:
Nakakaapekto ba ang dami ng tubig sa pagkatunaw ng solute?

Oo! Mas maraming solute ang matutunaw kapag mas marami ang tubig. Mas mabilis mapupuno kapag kaunti lang ang tubig.

statements.text:
How can you make sugar dissolve faster in water?

A solid dissolves faster when the liquid is heated, stirred, and the solid is in smaller pieces. That's why sugar dissolves faster in hot, stirred water!
statements.tl:
Paano mapapabilis ang pagkatunaw ng asukal sa tubig?

Mas mabilis matunaw ang solid kapag iniinit ang likido, hinahalo, at pinino sa maliliit na piraso. Kaya mas mabilis matunaw ang asukal sa mainit na tubig na hinahalo!

statements.text: Hot water can dissolve more salt or sugar than cold water can, making it super helpful!
statements.tl: Mas maraming asin o asukal ang kayang tunawin ng mainit na tubig kaysa sa malamig na tubig!

statements.text:
What can happen when hot, saturated sugar water cools down?

The water may no longer hold all the sugar anymore, so the extra sugar can come out as crystals!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag lumamig ang mainit na tubig na puno ng asukal?

Hindi na kayang hawakan ng tubig ang lahat ng asukal, kaya lumalabas ang sobra bilang mga crystal!

statements.text: Tree bark and roots often hold brown or red color! By boiling them, we can draw out a natural dye to color our cloth.
statements.tl: Ang balat ng puno (bark) at mga ugat ay may kayumanggi o pulang kulay! Kapag pinakuluan, nakukuha natin ang tina para sa tela.

statements.text: Did you know sugar dissolves much faster in warm water than it does in cold water?
statements.tl: Alam mo ba na mas mabilis matunaw ang asukal sa mainit na tubig kaysa sa malamig?

statements.text:
What happens to red litmus paper in a base?

It turns blue in a base!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa pulang litmus paper sa base?

Nagiging asul ito sa base!

statements.text: Vinegar is acidic! It has a pH of about 3.
statements.tl: Ang suka ay asido! May pH ito na halos 3.

statements.text: Salts are produced by the reaction of an acid with a base.
statements.tl: Ang mga salt ay nabubuo sa reaksyon ng isang acid at isang base.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10BX88I18RFjCKARGQ2-7WDSQNVJPyVf2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Sodium chloride, or table salt, and calcium carbonate, found in chalk, are common examples of salts.
statements.tl: Ang sodium chloride, o table salt, at calcium carbonate, na matatagpuan sa chalk, ay mga karaniwang halimbawa ng mga asin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aL4m3rOAsYmp0jcm-yY3PXU4JGhUwRmJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Litmus paper usually comes in two colors, red and blue, and each color reacts differently to acids and bases.
statements.tl: Ang litmus paper ay karaniwang may dalawang kulay, pula at asul, at ang bawat kulay ay iba ang reaksyon sa mga acid at base.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1do6lXrzBewAHaGiswgjpPGWqnfnDwJtz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Curd, a common food made from milk, is acidic, which gives it a slightly sour taste.
statements.tl: Ang curd, isang karaniwang pagkain na gawa sa gatas, ay acidic, kaya mayroon itong bahagyang maasim na lasa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1do6lXrzBewAHaGiswgjpPGWqnfnDwJtz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Ammonia reacts with an acid to form an ammonium salt, which is another type of neutralization reaction.
statements.tl: Ang ammonia ay nagre-react sa acid para makabuo ng ammonium salt, na isa pang uri ng neutralization reaction.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1xOFNnbUdar22wbDQyi72ODfZsUX922j_), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A salt is a neutral ionic compound, which means it is made of charged particles that balance each other out, and it is produced when an acid and a base react.
statements.tl: Ang asin ay isang neutral ionic compound, ibig sabihin ito ay gawa sa mga charged particles na nagbabalanse sa isa't isa, at ito ay nabubuo kapag nag-react ang acid at base.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-17950), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What's Vitamin C's real name?

Its official science name is ascorbic acid — the same Vitamin C you get from citrus fruits!
statements.tl:
Ano ang tunay na pangalan ng Vitamin C?

Ang siyentipikong pangalan nito ay ascorbic acid — ito rin ang Vitamin C na galing sa mga citrus na prutas!

statements.text:
Which weak acids are found in nature?

Many weak acids occur naturally in living things — citric acid in calamansi, acetic acid in vinegar, and lactic acid in souring milk!
statements.tl:
Anong mahihinang acid ang matatagpuan sa kalikasan?

Maraming mahinang acid ang likas na matatagpuan sa mga bagay na buhay — citric acid sa kalamansi, acetic acid sa suka, at lactic acid sa naaasim na gatas!
statements.source: Consensus chemistry; DepEd Science CG (Matter/Living Things, JHS)

statements.text:
Why is sinigang sour?

Sinigang gets its sour tang from tamarind — a tropical fruit whose pods are rich in tartaric acid.
statements.tl:
Bakit maasim ang sinigang?

Nakukuha ng sinigang ang maasim nitong lasa mula sa tamarind — isang prutas na mayaman sa tartaric acid.

statements.text:
Why is tamarind so sour?

Tamarind's sweet-sour taste comes from tartaric acid in its pulp! It's used to flavor sinigang and other Filipino dishes.
statements.tl:
Bakit maasim ang sampalok?

Ang tamis-asim na lasa ng sampalok ay galing sa tartaric acid na nasa pulp nito! Ginagamit ito sa sinigang at iba pang lutuing Pilipino.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; Philippine cuisine; DepEd G4 Science

statements.text: Tamarind is the fruit of a tall tree that tastes sour from its natural acid — people turn it into candy or use it to sour dishes.
statements.tl: Ang sampaloc ay bunga ng matangkad na puno na maasim ang lasa dahil sa likas na asido nito, at ginagawa itong kendi o pampaasim ng ulam.

statements.text:
Why is it called 'formic acid'?

Some ants, like wood ants, spray formic acid to defend themselves — 'formic' comes from the Latin word 'formica,' meaning ant!
statements.tl:
Bakit 'formic acid' ang tawag dito?

Ang ilang langgam gaya ng wood ants ay nagse-spray ng formic acid bilang pananggol — mula ito sa Latin na 'formica' na ibig sabihin ay langgam!

statements.text: Salted eggs are made by coating eggs in salty clay, or soaking them in salt water for several weeks.
statements.tl: Ginagawa ang itlog na maalat sa pamamagitan ng pagbabalot dito sa putik na may asin, o pagbababad sa tubig-asin ng ilang linggo.

statements.text: Did you know acids usually taste super sour? You can find this yummy sourness in everyday things like calamansi and vinegar!
statements.tl: Alam mo bang karaniwang maasim ang lasa ng mga asido? Makikita mo ang asim na ito sa kalamansi at suka!

statements.text: Bases often taste bitter and feel slippery when you touch them. You can feel this slippery texture every time you use soap!
statements.tl: Ang mga base ay kadalasang mapait at madulas kapag hinawakan. Nararamdaman mo ang pagiging madulas na ito tuwing gumagamit ka ng sabon!

statements.text:
How does litmus paper change color?

Litmus paper is a cool tester! It turns red when it touches an acid, and turns blue in a base.
statements.tl:
Paano nagbabago ng kulay ang litmus paper?

Ang litmus paper ay isang magandang tester! Namumula ito kapag nahawakan ang asido, at nagiging asul naman sa base.

statements.text: Wear safety goggles and a lab coat or apron during experiments, and always wash your hands with soap and water after you finish.
statements.tl: Magsuot ng safety goggles at lab coat o apron habang nag-eeksperimento, at laging maghugas ng kamay gamit ang sabon at tubig pagkatapos.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1scCmnhkNxjEIO525Iui1n81WbSvzlqik), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Place a graduated cylinder on a flat surface before reading the volume, because holding it can tilt it and give a wrong measurement.
statements.tl: Ilagay ang graduated cylinder sa patag na surface bago basahin ang volume, dahil ang paghawak nito ay maaaring tumagilid at magbigay ng maling sukat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1scCmnhkNxjEIO525Iui1n81WbSvzlqik), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do some indicators need to be stored in dark places?

Strong light and air can make an indicator's color fade or spoil over time. An old or spoiled indicator gives wrong answers — so always use a fresh one!
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangang itago sa madidilim na lugar ang ilang indicator?

Ang sobrang liwanag at hangin ay nakakapagpa-fade o nakakasira sa kulay ng indicator sa paglipas ng panahon. Ang luma o sirang indicator ay nagbibigay ng maling sagot — kaya laging gumamit ng sariwa!

statements.text: Proper handling of fire includes putting out the candle after using it, so it cannot start an accidental fire.
statements.tl: Ang wastong paghawak ng apoy ay kasama ang pagpatay ng kandila pagkatapos gamitin, para hindi ito makapagsimula ng aksidenteng sunog.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-RKC65zDEaCw6-9Xe30uD8gVeDgKiC3u), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why use a special flask to make a solution?

A volumetric flask is designed to hold one exact volume, like 500 ml, so when you fill it to the line, you know the solution's volume is correct!
statements.tl:
Bakit espesyal na flask ang gamit sa paggawa ng solution?

Ang volumetric flask ay dinisenyo upang maglaman ng isang eksaktong volume, tulad ng 500 ml, kaya kapag pinuno mo ito hanggang sa linya, alam mong tama ang volume ng solution!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MyWpd7t1I0np0BvlaucGDasc-iJ3p8tv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why must you always label a solution you prepared?

So anyone who sees it later knows what is inside, how strong it is, and when it was made, which keeps everyone safe!
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangan mong laging lagyan ng label ang isang solution na iyong inihanda?

Para malaman ng sinumang makakakita nito mamaya kung ano ang laman, gaano ito katapang, at kailan ito ginawa, na nagpapanatiling ligtas sa lahat!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MyWpd7t1I0np0BvlaucGDasc-iJ3p8tv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A beaker is used for holding, mixing, or pouring liquids, but it is not advisable to use it as a measuring tool.
statements.tl: Ang beaker ay ginagamit para hawakan, haluin, o ibuhos ang mga liquid, pero hindi ito mainam gamitin bilang panukat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An Erlenmeyer flask is used for heating or mixing liquids, and its narrow neck helps prevent splashes.
statements.tl: Ang Erlenmeyer flask ay ginagamit para painitin o haluin ang mga liquid, at ang makitid nitong leeg ay nakakatulong para hindi tumalsik ang liquid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A beaker is not advisable as a measuring tool because its markings are only approximate, not precise.
statements.tl: Ang beaker ay hindi mainam gamitin bilang panukat dahil ang mga marking nito ay tinatayang sukat lamang, hindi eksakto.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Light the wick of an alcohol lamp with a match, and use the cap to cover the wick when putting out the flame.
statements.tl: Sindihan ang wick ng alcohol lamp gamit ang posporo, at gamitin ang cap para takpan ang wick kapag pinapatay ang apoy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Never leave a lit Bunsen burner or alcohol lamp unattended, because an unwatched flame can cause accidents.
statements.tl: Huwag iwanan ang nakasinding Bunsen burner o alcohol lamp nang walang nagbabantay, dahil ang apoy na hindi binabantayan ay maaaring magdulot ng aksidente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A dropper, also called a pipette, is a tool used to transfer small amounts of liquid drop by drop.
statements.tl: Ang dropper, na tinatawag ding pipette, ay isang tool na ginagamit upang maglipat ng maliliit na dami ng likido nang patak-patak.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ubQhpZzmC4_n-2ZlvCP0JtV59jKQ3MH2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Use heat-resistant gloves or tongs when handling hot equipment to prevent burns from hot surfaces or glassware.
statements.tl: Gumamit ng heat-resistant gloves o tongs kapag humahawak ng mainit na equipment upang maiwasan ang paso mula sa mainit na surface o glassware.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ubQhpZzmC4_n-2ZlvCP0JtV59jKQ3MH2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Never use glassware with visible cracks or chips, because it can shatter suddenly when heated or pressed.
statements.tl: Huwag gumamit ng glassware na may nakikitang crack o pingas, dahil maaari itong biglang mabasag kapag ininit o diniinan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yAIpM18HwjcTfD-BRQ6KJsClukbz2yLu), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Always wear protective gear like a laboratory coat, gloves, and goggles during experiments to keep chemicals away from your skin and eyes.
statements.tl: Laging magsuot ng protective gear tulad ng laboratory coat, gloves, at goggles habang nag-e-eksperimento upang maprotektahan ang iyong balat at mata mula sa mga kemikal.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yAIpM18HwjcTfD-BRQ6KJsClukbz2yLu), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do I avoid contaminating liquids when using a pipette?

Use a new pipette for each different solution, so you never mix one liquid into another by accident!
statements.tl:
Paano ko maiiwasan ang pagkontamina ng mga likido kapag gumagamit ng pipette?

Gumamit ng bagong pipette para sa bawat iba't ibang solution, upang hindi mo aksidenteng maihalo ang isang likido sa isa pa!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yAIpM18HwjcTfD-BRQ6KJsClukbz2yLu), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What should I do if I see a crack in a glass beaker before using it?

Report it and ask for a replacement, because a cracked beaker can break during your experiment.
statements.tl:
Ano ang dapat kong gawin kung makakita ako ng crack sa glass beaker bago ito gamitin?

I-report ito at humingi ng kapalit, dahil ang may crack na beaker ay maaaring mabasag habang ginagawa mo ang iyong eksperimento.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yAIpM18HwjcTfD-BRQ6KJsClukbz2yLu), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does a yellow, smoky Bunsen burner flame mean?

It means the burner needs more air, because a clean, hot flame should be almost invisible blue with a bright blue cone inside.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng dilaw at mausok na apoy ng Bunsen burner?

Ibig sabihin nito ay kailangan ng burner ng mas maraming hangin, dahil ang malinis at mainit na apoy ay dapat halos hindi nakikitang asul na may maliwanag na asul na kono sa loob.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yAIpM18HwjcTfD-BRQ6KJsClukbz2yLu), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cover the microscope when not in use and store it in a clean, dry place away from corrosive chemical fumes.
statements.tl: Takpan ang microscope kapag hindi ginagamit at itago ito sa malinis at tuyong lugar na malayo sa corrosive chemical fumes.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-24681), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A microscope magnifies tiny objects hundreds of times — that's how we can see the micro-organisms living in pond water.
statements.tl: Pinapalaki ng mikroskopyo ang maliliit na bagay nang daan-daang beses — kaya nakikita natin ang mga mikroorganismo sa tubig-lawa.

statements.text: A compound microscope uses two convex lenses! The objective lens near the specimen forms an enlarged image, and the eyepiece magnifies it even further!
statements.tl: Ang compound microscope ay gumagamit ng dalawang convex lens! Ang objective lens na malapit sa specimen ay gumagawa ng enlarged na imahe, at ang eyepiece ay nagpapalaki pa nito!

statements.text:
How do you find the total magnification of a microscope?

Multiply the eyepiece magnification by the objective lens magnification, so a 10x eyepiece and 50x objective give 500x.
statements.tl:
Paano makukuha ang total magnification ng microscope?

I-multiply ang magnification ng eyepiece sa magnification ng objective lens, kaya ang 10x eyepiece at 50x objective ay 500x.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-jkIyOW3x1iJKEt7w4KULAfIIS1KR7FO), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why should you start focusing with the lowest power objective?

It gives a wider view, so you can find your specimen first before zooming in with higher power lenses.
statements.tl:
Bakit dapat magsimula sa lowest power objective kapag nag-focus?

Mas malawak ang nakikita nito, kaya mahahanap mo muna ang specimen bago mag-zoom in gamit ang mas matataas na power lenses.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-jkIyOW3x1iJKEt7w4KULAfIIS1KR7FO), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why can't I use the coarse adjustment knob on high power?

The lens is very close to the slide, so a big movement can crack the glass or scratch the lens!
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi ko pwedeng gamitin ang coarse adjustment knob sa high power?

Napakalapit ng lens sa slide, kaya ang malaking galaw ay maaaring makabasag ng glass o makagasgas ng lens!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1506uADDop0Ct_T3ci4_PPZeedNoSs7ZD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Clean all glass surfaces of the microscope with lens paper, starting with the eyepiece and then the objectives.
statements.tl: Linisin ang lahat ng glass surfaces ng microscope gamit ang lens paper, simula sa eyepiece at pagkatapos ay ang mga objectives.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1506uADDop0Ct_T3ci4_PPZeedNoSs7ZD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The stage is the small platform where the specimen is placed for evaluation under the microscope.
statements.tl: Ang stage ay ang maliit na platform kung saan inilalagay ang specimen para suriin sa ilalim ng microscope.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1506uADDop0Ct_T3ci4_PPZeedNoSs7ZD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The arm supports the upper part of the microscope, while the base is the bottom part that supports the entire microscope.
statements.tl: Sinusuportahan ng arm ang itaas na bahagi ng microscope, habang ang base ay ang ilalim na bahagi na sumusuporta sa buong microscope.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1506uADDop0Ct_T3ci4_PPZeedNoSs7ZD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The body tube is the part of the microscope that connects the eyepiece to the objective lenses.
statements.tl: Ang body tube ay ang bahagi ng microscope na nagdudugtong sa eyepiece sa mga objective lenses.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1506uADDop0Ct_T3ci4_PPZeedNoSs7ZD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The inclination joint is the part you adjust if you need to tilt the microscope for a more comfortable viewing angle.
statements.tl: Ang inclination joint ay ang bahagi na inaadjust mo kung kailangan mong itagilid ang microscope para sa mas komportableng anggulo ng pagtingin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1506uADDop0Ct_T3ci4_PPZeedNoSs7ZD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The diaphragm is located under the stage and controls the amount of light allowed to pass through the specimen.
statements.tl: Ang diaphragm ay matatagpuan sa ilalim ng stage at kinokontrol nito ang dami ng liwanag na pinapayagang dumaan sa specimen.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1506uADDop0Ct_T3ci4_PPZeedNoSs7ZD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The mirror reflects light from a lamp or natural light source up through the stage window to illuminate the specimen.
statements.tl: Sinasalamin ng mirror ang liwanag mula sa lampara o natural na liwanag pataas sa stage window para mailawan ang specimen.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1506uADDop0Ct_T3ci4_PPZeedNoSs7ZD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why does the image stay blurry when you use the big knob at high power?

At high magnification, you need the fine adjustment knob, the small knob that makes tiny, precise focus changes without crashing the lens into the slide!
statements.tl:
Bakit malabo pa rin ang imahe kapag ginagamit mo ang malaking knob sa high power?

Sa high magnification, kailangan mo ang fine adjustment knob, ang maliit na knob na gumagawa ng maliliit at tiyak na pagbabago sa focus nang hindi sumasayad ang lens sa slide!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1WJdDut8Z0DgcouCnIlFxPN5xLNqRewDB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The magnifying parts of a microscope are the lenses that enlarge the image: the eyepiece and the objective lenses.
statements.tl: Ang magnifying parts ng microscope ay ang mga lens na nagpapalaki ng imahe: ang eyepiece at ang objective lenses.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1WJdDut8Z0DgcouCnIlFxPN5xLNqRewDB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The illuminating parts of a microscope are the mirror, iris diaphragm, and condenser, which work together to provide and control the light on the specimen.
statements.tl: Ang illuminating parts ng microscope ay ang mirror, iris diaphragm, at condenser, na nagtutulungan para magbigay at kumontrol ng liwanag sa specimen.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1WJdDut8Z0DgcouCnIlFxPN5xLNqRewDB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When storing the microscope, rotate the nosepiece so the lowest objective is in place, remove the slide, and cover the microscope to protect it from dust.
statements.tl: Kapag itinatago ang microscope, iikot ang nosepiece para ang pinakamababang objective ang nasa lugar, alisin ang slide, at takpan ang microscope para protektahan ito sa alikabok.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1WJdDut8Z0DgcouCnIlFxPN5xLNqRewDB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The arm is the curved part that connects the lenses to the base, and the base is the wide, flat bottom that supports the whole microscope.
statements.tl: Ang arm ay ang kurbadong bahagi na nagdudugtong sa mga lens papunta sa base, at ang base ay ang malapad at patag na ilalim na sumusuporta sa buong microscope.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1WJdDut8Z0DgcouCnIlFxPN5xLNqRewDB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why are mitochondria the cell's powerhouse?

Mitochondria are called the 'powerhouse of the cell' because they produce energy from food.
statements.tl:
Bakit tinatawag na 'powerhouse' ang mitochondria?

Tinatawag na 'powerhouse ng selula' ang mitochondria dahil gumagawa ito ng enerhiya mula sa pagkain.

statements.text: Chlorophyll is found tucked inside tiny cell parts called chloroplasts.
statements.tl: Ang klorophil ay natatagpuan sa loob ng maliliit na bahagi ng selula na tinatawag na kloroplast.

statements.text: Cytoplasm is a jelly-like fluid that fills the cell, and the cell's parts float around inside it.
statements.tl: Ang sitoplasma ay parang jelly na likido na pumupuno sa loob ng selula, at doon lumulutang ang mga bahagi nito.

statements.text: Every cell has a thin covering called the cell membrane that controls what goes in and out.
statements.tl: Ang bawat selula ay may manipis na balot na tinatawag cell membrane na kumokontrol sa pumapasok at lumalabas.

statements.text: The nucleus often looks like the darkest round spot inside the cell under the microscope!
statements.tl: Ang nucleus ay kadalasang mukhang pinakamadilim na bilog na tuldok sa loob ng cell sa ilalim ng microscope!

statements.text: Muscle cells contain more mitochondria than other cells because they need more energy to move the body.
statements.tl: Ang muscle cells ay may mas maraming mitochondria kaysa ibang cells dahil kailangan nila ng mas maraming energy para mapakilos ang katawan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 175yYtWJJrcnYynJKuYSCSnTamoucMKB8), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The cell membrane is made of phospholipids and proteins, forming a flexible boundary that controls what enters and leaves the cell.
statements.tl: Ang cell membrane ay gawa sa phospholipids at proteins, bumubuo ng isang flexible na hangganan na kumokontrol sa pumapasok at lumalabas sa cell.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BdAL9RUFb7tC-YRSg4w5BAM0e1dprSI7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The nucleolus is a dark spot inside the nucleus where ribosomes are produced before they move out to make proteins.
statements.tl: Ang nucleolus ay isang madilim na bahagi sa loob ng nucleus kung saan ginagawa ang ribosomes bago sila lumabas para gumawa ng mga protina.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BdAL9RUFb7tC-YRSg4w5BAM0e1dprSI7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Never let the objective lens touch the slide, because the lens can scratch the glass or damage the specimen.
statements.tl: Huwag hayaang sumayad ang objective lens sa slide, dahil maaaring magasgasan ng lens ang salamin o masira ang specimen.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1WJdDut8Z0DgcouCnIlFxPN5xLNqRewDB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Focusing a specimen should begin with the lowest power objective lens, such as 4x, clicked into position on the revolving nosepiece.
statements.tl: Ang pag-focus sa specimen ay dapat magsimula sa pinakamababang power na objective lens, tulad ng 4x, na naka-click sa posisyon sa revolving nosepiece.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YmBmm2PouVf0OkvXiAApQir1uguk3dod), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When moving the stage upward, stop before the objective lens touches the coverslip, because the glass slide will break.
statements.tl: Kapag itinataas ang stage, huminto bago dumikit ang objective lens sa coverslip, dahil mababasag ang glass slide.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YmBmm2PouVf0OkvXiAApQir1uguk3dod), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Humans belong to Domain Eukarya, which includes all organisms whose cells have a true nucleus, a protected compartment that holds their DNA.
statements.tl: Ang tao ay kabilang sa Domain Eukarya, na kinabibilangan ng lahat ng organismo na ang mga cell ay may true nucleus, isang protektadong bahagi na naglalaman ng kanilang DNA.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j0eZi4Jq2ZWac_LboNInoUIjFz_czlvV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Place the microscope slide on the stage and fasten it with the stage clips before viewing.
statements.tl: Ilagay ang microscope slide sa stage at ikabit ito gamit ang stage clips bago tumingin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1kqzsY0JrFUQqPxQcoSw8Cw7xldYQK_ud), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Microscope slides are pieces of transparent glass or plastic that support a sample so it can be viewed using a compound microscope.
statements.tl: Ang microscope slides ay mga piraso ng malinaw na salamin o plastic na sumusuporta sa sample para matingnan ito gamit ang compound microscope.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-20280), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Before looking through the eyepiece, look from the side and turn the coarse adjustment knob to lower the objective until it is very close to the slide.
statements.tl: Bago tumingin sa eyepiece, tumingin muna mula sa gilid at i-turn ang coarse adjustment knob para ibaba ang objective hanggang napakalapit na ito sa slide.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-20280), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To switch to the high power objective, rotate the nosepiece carefully while watching from the side to make sure the lens does not hit the slide.
statements.tl: Para lumipat sa high power objective, maingat na i-rotate ang nosepiece habang nakatingin mula sa gilid para siguraduhing hindi tatama ang lens sa slide.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-20280), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To make a wet mount, place a drop of fluid in the middle of the slide, then use tweezers to position the specimen in the drop if it is not already liquid.
statements.tl: Para gumawa ng wet mount, maglagay ng isang patak ng likido sa gitna ng slide, pagkatapos ay gumamit ng tweezers para iposisyon ang specimen sa patak kung hindi pa ito likido.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-20280), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: If a dry mount sample is soft, a squash slide may be made by gently pressing down on the coverslip to flatten the specimen.
statements.tl: Kung malambot ang sample sa dry mount, maaaring gumawa ng squash slide sa pamamagitan ng marahang pagdiin sa coverslip para mapatag ang specimen.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-20280), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How many cells are in you?

Your whole body is built from trillions of tiny cells, all working together as a team to keep you alive and healthy.
statements.tl:
Ilang selula ang katawan mo?

Ang buo mong katawan ay ginawa mula sa trilyong maliliit na selula, na magkakasamang nagtutulungan para panatilihin kang buhay.

statements.text: Bacteria are tiny living things made of just one single cell!
statements.tl: Ang bacteria ay napakaliit na nabubuhay na binubuo lamang ng isang selula!

statements.text: The cell is the smallest unit of life — every living thing is made of one cell or many cells working together!
statements.tl: Ang selula ang pinakamaliit na yunit ng buhay — lahat ng nabubuhay na bagay ay gawa sa isa o maraming selula!

statements.text: A multicellular organism is made of many cells that each do a special job, like muscle cells for moving and skin cells for covering.
statements.tl: Ang multicellular organism ay gawa sa maraming cells na may kanya-kanyang espesyal na trabaho, tulad ng muscle cells para gumalaw at skin cells para bumalot.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BFpzEVD4iAshuvXm9Y8Orgn_WkW-OSVQ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Bacteria and Euglena are examples of unicellular organisms, each one a complete living thing inside a single cell.
statements.tl: Ang bacteria at Euglena ay mga halimbawa ng unicellular organisms, bawat isa ay buong nabubuhay na bagay sa loob ng iisang cell.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1BFpzEVD4iAshuvXm9Y8Orgn_WkW-OSVQ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Organisms with millions of cells, like animals, plants, fungi, and protists, are called multicellular.
statements.tl: Ang mga organism na may milyon-milyong cells, tulad ng mga hayop, halaman, fungi, at protists, ay tinatawag na multicellular.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1LjE7J1arKizDqj78MFr_wHCkV96NzvI6), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Unicellular organisms often reproduce by splitting into two identical cells, while multicellular organisms usually reproduce through special sex cells that join to form a new individual.
statements.tl: Ang mga unicellular organism ay madalas dumami sa pamamagitan ng paghati sa dalawang magkaparehong cells, habang ang mga multicellular organism ay karaniwang dumadami sa pamamagitan ng special sex cells na nagsasama para makabuo ng bagong indibidwal.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1teSN_mfGUJ9PIenhjvkG2agMRBjGtVbX), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why can't antibiotics kill viruses?

Bacteria are living cells that antibiotics can kill, but viruses are much smaller and aren't true living cells at all!
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi kayang patayin ng antibiotics ang virus?

Ang bacteria ay buhay na selula kaya kayang patayin ng antibiotiko, pero ang virus ay napakaliit at hindi tunay na buhay na selula!

statements.text:
Is Euglena a plant or animal?

Neither exactly — Euglena can photosynthesize in light like a plant, or eat other organisms in the dark like an animal.
statements.tl:
Halaman ba o hayop ang Euglena?

Wala talaga — kaya ng Euglena na gumawa ng sariling pagkain sa liwanag tulad ng halaman, o kumain ng ibang organismo sa dilim tulad ng hayop.

statements.text:
How are bacteria different from viruses?

Bacteria are alive and can eat and multiply on their own, while viruses are even tinier and can only multiply inside another cell — bacteria are bigger than viruses.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng bacteria sa virus?

Buhay ang bacteria at kayang kumain at dumami nang mag-isa, habang mas maliit pa ang virus at hindi ito makakadami kung wala itong ibang cell na sasakyan — mas malaki ang bacteria kaysa virus.

statements.text: Foraminifera are single-celled organisms with shells; when they die, their shells sink to the ocean floor and over millions of years build up to form limestone rock.
statements.tl: Ang foraminifera ay mga single-celled na organismong may balangkas—kapag namatay sila, lumulubog ang kanilang mga balangkas sa dagat at sa paglipas ng milyun-milyong taon ay nagiging bato ng limestone.

statements.text: Fungi and bacteria both digest food outside their bodies. But fungi are bigger with thread-like hyphae, while bacteria are tiny single-celled organisms.
statements.tl: Parehong tumutunaw ng pagkain sa labas ng katawan ang fungi at bacteria. Pero mas malaki ang fungi at may sinulid na hyphae, samantalang napakaliit ng bacteria at iisang selula lang.

statements.text:
Why aren't algae counted as plants?

Even though algae make food from sunlight like plants, most belong to kingdom Protista because their bodies are simple — often just one cell, without true roots, stems, or leaves.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi itinuturing na halaman ang algae?

Kahit gumagawa ng pagkain mula sa araw ang algae gaya ng halaman, karamihan sa kanila ay nasa kingdom Protista dahil simple lang ang katawan nila — kadalasan iisang selula, walang tunay na ugat, tangkay, at dahon.

statements.text:
How can just one cell do everything?

An amoeba is made of only one cell, and that single cell eats, moves, and even makes babies — all by itself!
statements.tl:
Paano may kayang gawin ang isang selula lang?

Ang amoeba ay iisang selula lamang, pero ginagawa nito ang lahat — kumakain, gumagalaw, at nagpaparami!

statements.text:
What is a paramecium?

A paramecium is a tiny living thing made of just one cell — it swims in fresh water using thousands of tiny hairs called cilia.
statements.tl:
Ano ang paramecium?

Ang paramecium ay isang maliit na nilalang na iisang selula lang — lumalangoy ito sa tubig-tabang gamit ang libu-libong maliliit na buhok na tinatawag na cilia.

statements.text:
Is bread yeast even alive?

Yes! The yeast that makes bread rise is a fungus made of just one single cell.
statements.tl:
Fungus ba ang yeast na panggawa ng tinapay?

Oo! Ang yeast na ginagamit sa paggawa ng tinapay ay isang fungus na iisang selula lamang.

statements.text: A single-celled organism like an amoeba must do all the jobs of life — feeding, moving, reproducing, and responding to its surroundings — using just one cell.
statements.tl: Ang isang single-celled na organismo tulad ng amoeba ay ginagawa ng iisang selula ang lahat ng gawain ng buhay — kumain, gumalaw, magparami, at tumugon sa kapaligiran.

statements.text:
Can a living thing be just one cell?

Yes! A bacterium is a tiny living thing made of just ONE cell, yet it can eat, grow, and multiply all by itself — no trillions of cells needed like us!
statements.tl:
Pwede bang isang cell lang ang isang buhay na bagay?

Oo! Ang bacteria ay isang napakaliit na nilalang na iisa lang ang cell, pero kaya niyang kumain, lumaki, at dumami mag-isa — hindi tulad natin na trilyon-trilyong cell!

statements.text: Both plant and animal cells have a cell membrane, cytoplasm, a nucleus, and mitochondria.
statements.tl: Ang selula ng halaman at hayop ay parehong may lamad ng selula, sitoplasma, nukleyus, at mitokondriya.

statements.text:
What does the vacuole do in a plant cell?

Plant cells have a big central vacuole that stores water and helps keep the whole plant firm and standing upright.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ginagawa ng vacuole sa plant cell?

Ang mga plant cell ay may malaking sentral na vacuole na nag-iimbak ng tubig at tumutulong para manatiling matatag at nakatayo ang buong halaman.

statements.text: Animals are multicellular and heterotrophic, meaning they get energy by ingesting other organisms, and they lack cell walls.
statements.tl: Ang mga hayop ay multicellular at heterotrophic, ibig sabihin kumukuha sila ng enerhiya sa pamamagitan ng pagkain ng ibang organismo, at wala silang cell walls.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1NYLEzK0BqU3nEkZH_jL9gYwuYJs0e0wV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Chloroplasts are found in plant cells, and they make food from sunlight through photosynthesis.
statements.tl: Ang chloroplast ay matatagpuan sa mga selula ng halaman, at ito ang gumagawa ng pagkain mula sa sikat ng araw.

statements.text:
How do animal and plant vacuoles differ?

Animal cells hold many small temporary vacuoles for food and waste, while plant cells have just one big permanent one!
statements.tl:
Paano magkaiba ang vacuole ng hayop at halaman?

Ang selula ng hayop ay may maraming maliliit na pansamantalang vacuole, samantalang isa lang ang malaki at permanenteng vacuole ng selula ng halaman!

statements.text:
What does the vacuole do in a cell?

The vacuole is a storage sac inside the cell. It holds water, food, and other substances the cell needs.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ginagawa ng bakuwol sa selula?

Ang bakuwol ay parang lalagyan sa loob ng selula. Nag-iimbak ito ng tubig, pagkain, at iba pang sangkap na kailangan ng selula.

statements.text: Plant cells have a cell wall, and many have chloroplasts — animal cells don't have either!
statements.tl: May dingding ng selula ang mga selula ng halaman, at marami sa mga ito ay may kloroplast — wala ang mga ito sa selula ng hayop!

statements.text:
What does the vacuole do in a plant cell?

The vacuole is a big space inside a plant cell that stores water and nutrients, helping keep the whole plant firm and upright.
statements.tl:
Ano ang gawain ng vacuole sa selula?

Ang vacuole ay malaking espasyo sa loob ng selula ng halaman na nag-iimbak ng tubig at sustansya, kaya matigas at tuwid ang buong halaman.

statements.text:
Do animal cells have a cell wall?

No — which is why they are softer and often rounder in shape.
statements.tl:
May cell wall ba ang selula ng hayop?

Wala — kaya mas malambot at madalas na bilog ang hugis ng selula ng hayop.

statements.text:
What do plant cells have that animal cells don't?

Three things! Plant cells have a cell wall, chloroplasts, and a large central vacuole — animal cells don't, but they have centrioles that help with cell division instead.
statements.tl:
Ano meron ang selula ng halaman na wala sa hayop?

Tatlo! May cell wall, chloroplasts, at malaking central vacuole ang selula ng halaman — wala nito ang hayop, pero may centrioles ito na tumutulong sa cell division.

statements.text:
How is a plant cell different from an animal cell?

Both plant and animal cells have a nucleus, cell membrane, and cytoplasm—but a plant cell also has a stiff cell wall and chloroplasts for photosynthesis, which animal cells don't have.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng plant cell sa animal cell?

Parehong may nucleus, cell membrane, at cytoplasm ang plant at animal cell—pero may dagdag na matigas na cell wall at chloroplasts ang plant cell para sa photosynthesis, na wala sa animal cell.

statements.text:
Why do plant cells often look boxy?

Animal cells are round or odd-shaped, but plant cells often look boxy because of their sturdy cell wall.
statements.tl:
Bakit parang kahon ang hugis ng selula ng halaman?

Bilog o hindi tiyak ang hugis ng selula ng hayop, pero madalas kahon-kahon ang selula ng halaman dahil sa matibay nitong dingding.

statements.text: A plant cell has a stiff cell wall and chloroplasts that an animal cell doesn't have — that's why the two look so different.
statements.tl: Ang selula ng halaman ay may matigas na cell wall at chloroplast na wala sa selula ng hayop — kaya iba ang hitsura ng dalawa.

statements.text:
Why don't plant cells burst?

Plant cells have a tough wall made of cellulose. It keeps their shape strong and stops them from bursting even when they swell up with water.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi pumuputok ang selula ng halaman?

May matibay na cell wall na gawa sa cellulose ang selula ng halaman. Ito ang nagpapanatili ng hugis nito at pumipigil sa pagputok kahit lumobo ito dahil sa tubig.

statements.text:
What does a vacuole do inside a cell?

The vacuole is like a storage bag inside the cell — it holds water and food for the cell to use.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ginagawa ng vacuole sa loob ng cell?

Ang vacuole ay parang lalagyan sa loob ng cell — nag-iimbak ito ng tubig at pagkain na gagamitin ng cell.

statements.text:
What gives plant cells their shape?

A stiff outer layer called the cell wall wraps around each plant cell, giving it shape and support.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagbibigay-hugis sa selula ng halaman?

Isang matigas na balot na tinatawag na cell wall ang bumabalot sa selula ng halaman, na nagbibigay dito ng hugis at suporta.

statements.text:
Why does a plant wilt without water?

The vacuole inside its cells presses against the cell wall to keep it firm — when water is lost, that pressure drops and the plant droops.
statements.tl:
Bakit naglalanta ang halaman kapag kulang sa tubig?

Ang vacuole sa loob ng selula nito ay dumidiin sa cell wall para manatiling matibay ito — kapag nawala ang tubig, bumababa ang presyon at naglalanta ang halaman.

statements.text: Plant cells usually have one large central vacuole full of water that helps keep the plant firm and upright.
statements.tl: Karaniwang may isang malaking gitnang bakuwol na puno ng tubig ang mga selula ng halaman, na tumutulong para manatiling matikas ang halaman.

statements.text: When you dissolve salt in water, you are making a mixture, not a pure substance!
statements.tl: Kapag tinunaw mo ang asin sa tubig, gumagawa ka ng mixture, hindi purong sangkap!

statements.text: Did you know everything around us is made of countless atoms?
statements.tl: Alam mo ba na lahat ng bagay sa paligid natin ay gawa sa napakaraming atomo?

statements.text: A pure substance is made of just one kind of particle! But a mixture physically combines two or more different substances together.
statements.tl: Ang purong sangkap ay gawa sa iisang uri ng particle! Samantalang ang halo naman ay physical na pinagsamang dalawa o higit pang magkakaibang sangkap.

statements.text: Each pure substance has its own kind of particles, so the particles in gold are different from the particles in water.
statements.tl: Ang bawat purong substance ay may sariling uri ng particle, kaya ang mga particle sa ginto ay iba sa mga particle sa tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12Opfi2qxR62ixWWwpPkiyVkkX13cVYi0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A compound is a pure substance made of two or more elements chemically combined in a fixed ratio.
statements.tl: Ang compound ay isang pure substance na gawa sa dalawa o higit pang element na chemically combined sa fixed ratio.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15LZaP0B9dTOMUiUzAP0GWFfd3-pbisjq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: All matter, whether solid, liquid, or gas, is made of tiny particles called atoms, molecules, or ions.
statements.tl: Ang lahat ng matter, solid man, liquid, o gas, ay gawa sa napakaliliit na particles na tinatawag na atoms, molecules, o ions.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15pMwYkMQl0wMZjzuH60KvYT497oEzrmJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Helium inside a balloon is a pure substance made of only helium atoms, so it is an element in the gas state.
statements.tl: Ang helium sa loob ng lobo ay isang pure substance na gawa lamang sa helium atoms, kaya ito ay isang element na nasa gas state.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15pMwYkMQl0wMZjzuH60KvYT497oEzrmJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Salt crystals are tiny, uniform, and cube-shaped, while ground black pepper has small, irregularly shaped granules, showing differences in the physical properties of these materials.
statements.tl: Ang salt crystals ay maliliit, pare-pareho, at hugis cube, habang ang ground black pepper ay may maliliit at hindi pantay na granules, na nagpapakita ng pagkakaiba sa mga pisikal na katangian ng mga materyales na ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15pMwYkMQl0wMZjzuH60KvYT497oEzrmJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The fizz in soda comes from carbon dioxide gas particles escaping from the liquid and rising to the surface as bubbles.
statements.tl: Ang fizz sa soda ay nagmumula sa carbon dioxide gas particles na tumatakas mula sa liquid at umaakyat sa surface bilang mga bula.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15pMwYkMQl0wMZjzuH60KvYT497oEzrmJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Atoms are incredibly small—about two million atoms can fit across the period at the end of a sentence.
statements.tl: Napakaliit ng atoms—humigit-kumulang dalawang milyong atoms ang kayang magkasya sa tuldok sa dulo ng isang pangungusap.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1HQQtE_IPwA_sr4_4V5Nt2bfZaSZ1-idA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A crystal lattice is a highly ordered, repeating three-dimensional arrangement of atoms, and in metallic crystals, this lattice is made of positive ions held together by delocalized electrons.
statements.tl: Ang crystal lattice ay isang maayos at paulit-ulit na three-dimensional na pagkakaayos ng mga atom, at sa metallic crystals, ang lattice na ito ay gawa sa mga positive ion na pinagsasama-sama ng mga delocalized electron.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IIRcY8Mf1r8GQDgkc7YgacvZq5uxNuqj), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cotton candy dissolving in your mouth is an example of dissolving, because the sugar particles mix with your saliva and spread out.
statements.tl: Ang cotton candy na natutunaw sa iyong bibig ay halimbawa ng dissolving, dahil ang mga particle ng asukal ay humahalo sa iyong laway at kumakalat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_8scE0SSF8kpGAPKf6oPvOd3lk1kg6Ip), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gold, oxygen, and water are pure substances, but a chocolate drink is a mixture because it combines different ingredients.
statements.tl: Ang ginto, oxygen, at tubig ay mga pure substances, ngunit ang chocolate drink ay isang mixture dahil pinagsasama nito ang iba't ibang sangkap.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_LnzlBwcQbqOi1uCnI_k5imk4grNHxcy), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Methane is the simplest organic compound, made of one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms, and it is the main component of natural gas used as fuel.
statements.tl: Ang methane ay ang pinakasimpleng organic compound, na gawa sa isang carbon atom na nakabond sa apat na hydrogen atoms, at ito ang pangunahing sangkap ng natural gas na ginagamit bilang fuel.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1eA7gMm2xFJfapSa3sCYHxZaKQnvEochN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Solid particles vibrate in fixed positions, and this limited motion is what gives solids their rigidity and fixed shape.
statements.tl: Ang mga particle ng solid ay nagva-vibrate sa kinatatayuan, at ang limitadong paggalaw na ito ang nagbibigay sa solid ng tigas at sariling hugis.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1iwvpMOygUvRBGhWE4KEIpkSFdE9kKZgt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gas molecules exert pressure on the walls of their container by colliding with them.
statements.tl: Ang mga molecule ng gas ay nagbibigay ng pressure sa dingding ng lalagyan sa pamamagitan ng pagbangga sa mga ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qbUoKa3pkKVw_g4_HpknWSwb-yvENx1q), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Atoms, made of protons, neutrons, and electrons, are the building blocks of matter, and they combine to form molecules like water.
statements.tl: Ang mga atom, na gawa sa protons, neutrons, at electrons, ay ang building blocks ng matter, at nagsasama-sama sila para makabuo ng molecules tulad ng tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1w5bN-E8TLyq7pNLugNpfbXj1tHxwkolg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Molecules can be made of the same type of atom, like oxygen gas, or different types of atoms, like a water molecule.
statements.tl: Ang mga molecule ay maaaring gawa sa parehong uri ng atom, tulad ng oxygen gas, o iba't ibang uri ng atom, tulad ng water molecule.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1w5bN-E8TLyq7pNLugNpfbXj1tHxwkolg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: All atoms and molecules are always moving or vibrating! They move even faster when the material gets hotter.
statements.tl: Ang lahat ng atomo at molekula ay laging gumagalaw o nanginginig! Mas mabilis silang gumalaw kapag mas mainit ang bagay.

statements.text: During expansion, the particles themselves don't get bigger—only the space between them increases!
statements.tl: Sa paglawak, hindi lumalaki ang mismong partikulo—lumalaki lang ang puwang sa pagitan nila!

statements.text:
Why does water stick to itself and to other surfaces around it?

Water's cohesion is water molecules attracting each other through hydrogen bonding, while adhesion is water attracting other surfaces. Both forces drive capillary action!
statements.tl:
Bakit nagkakapit ang tubig sa sarili niya at sa ibang mga bagay sa paligid?

Ang cohesion ng tubig ay pagkapit ng water molecules sa isa't isa dahil sa hydrogen bonding, habang ang adhesion ay pagkapit sa ibang surfaces. Pareho itong nagdudulot ng capillary action!

statements.text: Water molecules stick together through hydrogen bonds! These are special attractions between the H of one molecule and the O of another, giving water high surface tension.
statements.tl: Nagkakahawak ang mga water molecules sa pamamagitan ng hydrogen bonds! Ito ay espesyal na pag-akit sa pagitan ng H ng isang molekula at O ng ibang molekula, kaya mataas ang surface tension ng tubig.

statements.text: When an object is cooled without a change of state, the average kinetic energy of its molecules decreases, making them move slower and lowering the object’s temperature.
statements.tl: Kapag pinalamig ang isang bagay nang hindi nagbabago ang estado nito, bumababa ang average na kinetic energy ng mga molecule nito, kaya mas mabagal silang gumagalaw at bumababa ang temperatura ng bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 11oTyewwJZih_WEAAMSO83gQw9Ta7HVR5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The spaces between particles in a solid are very small, which is why solids are hard to compress or squeeze.
statements.tl: Napakaliit ng mga espasyo sa pagitan ng mga particle sa solid, kaya mahirap i-compress o pisilin ang mga solid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 13RIbDwRHyFfb97NGsljnuUHcx2k5On4a), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Intermolecular forces, the pulls between particles, are extremely weak in gases, so gas particles move about freely.
statements.tl: Ang intermolecular forces, ang hatakan sa pagitan ng mga particle, ay napakahina sa gas, kaya malayang gumagalaw ang mga particle ng gas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 13RIbDwRHyFfb97NGsljnuUHcx2k5On4a), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Vapor particles are widely dispersed and have very weak attractions, so they move freely and fill all the space available to them.
statements.tl: Ang mga vapor particle ay napakalayo sa isa't isa at napakahina ng atraksyon, kaya malaya silang gumagalaw at pinupuno ang lahat ng espasyong magagamit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1AI6stkAv0ZRTM59t0hPAt-JYKsh-81c-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Particles of matter attract each other, and this force of attraction is strongest in solids and weakest in gases.
statements.tl: Ang mga particles ng matter ay umaakit sa isa't isa, at ang puwersa ng atraksyon na ito ay pinakamalakas sa solids at pinakamahina sa gases.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1FKmkD6yyp2OsUw97Q718lXDZ4GmOULa4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In gases, particle attraction is weakest, allowing particles to move freely and far apart, so gases have no fixed shape or volume.
statements.tl: Sa gas, pinakamahina ang atraksyon ng mga particle, kaya malaya silang gumagalaw at magkakalayo, kaya walang tiyak na hugis o volume ang gas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1HkkDad9oIvBgsAC1h_BXz1xDZdYdIJDn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gas particles move faster at higher temperatures because heat gives them more kinetic energy - the energy of movement.
statements.tl: Mas mabilis gumalaw ang gas particles sa mas mataas na temperature dahil binibigyan sila ng init ng mas maraming kinetic energy - ang energy ng paggalaw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ms3ePqYvEzzED_-E-uLtvTGEyvNeO24I), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In the ideal-gas model, particles are in constant, perfectly elastic motion - they bounce off each other and container walls without losing any movement energy.
statements.tl: Sa ideal-gas model, ang mga particle ay palaging gumagalaw sa perfectly elastic motion - nagbabanggaan sila sa isa't isa at sa dingding ng container nang hindi nawawalan ng energy ng paggalaw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ms3ePqYvEzzED_-E-uLtvTGEyvNeO24I), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When a gas is put under pressure by reducing the volume of its container, the space between particles is reduced and the gas is compressed.
statements.tl: Kapag ang gas ay nilagyan ng pressure sa pamamagitan ng pagbawas ng volume ng lalagyan nito, ang espasyo sa pagitan ng mga particle ay nababawasan at ang gas ay naco-compress.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ul8BVSjzHq7NqYd68r5A-41PFVD-aVhs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Adding energy makes particles move faster and spread out, while removing energy makes them move slower and settle closer together.
statements.tl: Kapag dinagdagan ng energy, bumibilis at kumakalat ang particles, habang kapag inalisan ng energy, bumabagal sila at nagdidikit-dikit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1XPsep6pac9dLGnh1BresRgf5YqLdWA_Y), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When heat is added to a material, its molecules and atoms vibrate faster and the space between them increases.
statements.tl: Kapag nilagyan ng heat ang isang materyal, mas mabilis na nagva-vibrate ang mga molecule at atom nito at lumalaki ang pagitan ng mga ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aJW5gOQGqf4lsrqyxRwTXIpaC4ZNP1Zt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In gases, the intermolecular forces are very weak or negligible, so particles move freely and independently of each other.
statements.tl: Sa gas, ang intermolecular forces ay napakahina o halos wala, kaya malayang gumagalaw ang mga particle nang hiwalay sa isa't isa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1iwvpMOygUvRBGhWE4KEIpkSFdE9kKZgt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gas particles have large spaces between them, which is why gases can expand to fill any container and be easily compressed into a smaller space.
statements.tl: Ang mga gas particle ay may malalaking espasyo sa pagitan nila, kaya ang gas ay maaaring lumawak para punuin ang anumang lalagyan at madaling ma-compress sa mas maliit na espasyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1o6pAejATyc2UePn5oBKV8Z35lA581NIb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When air is heated, its particles gain energy, move faster, and spread farther apart, so the air expands and takes up more space.
statements.tl: Kapag nainitan ang hangin, nagkakaroon ng enerhiya ang mga particle nito, mas mabilis gumalaw, at nagkakalayo, kaya lumalawak ang hangin at sumasakop ng mas malaking espasyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1rhJ66gSUAAwIfKtEYQ4x-QqcyHpqTvRd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cooling a liquid can change it back to a solid, because the particles slow down and lock into fixed positions again.
statements.tl: Ang pagpapalamig ng liquid ay maaaring magpabalik nito sa pagiging solid, dahil ang particles ay bumabagal at kumakapit muli sa kanilang puwesto.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VIb0TGVyVCV2FrfBzqmj01dTANEXBoHw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Increasing pressure on a fixed amount of gas at constant temperature moves gas molecules closer together, decreasing the volume they occupy.
statements.tl: Kapag dinagdagan ang pressure sa nakapirming dami ng gas sa hindi nagbabagong temperatura, naglalapit ang mga molecule nito, kaya bumababa ang volume na sinasakop nila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qbUoKa3pkKVw_g4_HpknWSwb-yvENx1q), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When making rock candy, dissolved sugar molecules slowly arrange themselves into a structured solid lattice during the crystallization stage!
statements.tl: Sa paggawa ng rock candy, dahan-dahang nag-aayos ang mga dissolved sugar molecules sa isang structured solid lattice habang nangyayari ang crystallization!

statements.text: Gas particles are far apart and have no fixed arrangement, so they spread out to fill all the space they are given.
statements.tl: Ang mga particle sa gas ay magkakalayo at walang nakatakdang ayos, kaya kumakalat sila para punuin ang lahat ng espasyong ibinigay sa kanila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 13RIbDwRHyFfb97NGsljnuUHcx2k5On4a), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gas particles are far apart, have weak attractive force, flow easily, and are easily compressed.
statements.tl: Ang mga particles ng gas ay magkakalayo, mahina ang attractive force, madaling dumaloy, at madaling i-compress.
