statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IcyUPBzLyDB68zJTQuSoPnwbR3mMlz54), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Fish bubbles expand as they rise because water pressure decreases near the surface, letting the gas inside take up more space.
statements.tl: Lumalaki ang bubbles ng isda habang umaakyat ito dahil bumababa ang water pressure malapit sa surface, kaya mas lumalawak ang gas sa loob.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ms3ePqYvEzzED_-E-uLtvTGEyvNeO24I), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Liquid particles can slide past one another, rotate, and move within their volume, giving them more freedom than solid particles.
statements.tl: Ang mga particle ng liquid ay kayang dumausdos, umikot, at gumalaw sa loob ng volume nito, kaya mas malaya sila kaysa sa solid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1iwvpMOygUvRBGhWE4KEIpkSFdE9kKZgt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Tiny particles (atoms and molecules) make up all matter and never stop moving! Solids: packed tight, just vibrating. Liquids: close but sliding. Gases: far apart and zooming fast!
statements.tl: Lahat ng matter ay gawa sa maliliit na particles (atoms at molecules) na laging gumagalaw! Solid: magkakadikit, nanginginig lang. Liquid: magkalapit, nakakadausdos. Gas: malalayuan at mabilis!

statements.text:
Why are solids so firm?

In a solid, tiny particles are packed close together and vibrate in place, keeping it firm!
statements.tl:
Bakit matigas ang mga solido?

Sa solido, magkasiksik ang mga partikulo at nanginginig sa kanilang puwesto, kaya nananatili itong matigas!

statements.text: Most solid materials are hard to squeeze smaller! Their particles are already packed close together. That's why solids keep nearly the same volume—they resist being squished down!
statements.tl: Mahirap pisilin nang mas maliit ang karamihan ng solidong materyal! Magkakalapit na ang mga particle nito. Kaya halos hindi nagbabago ang bolyum ng solid—hindi ito basta napapaliit sa pagpisil!

statements.text:
How do particles act in a solid?

In a solid like rock, tiny particles are packed close together. They only vibrate in place and do not move away from each other!
statements.tl:
Paano kumikilos ang particles sa isang solid?

Sa isang solid tulad ng bato, ang maliliit na particles ay dikit-dikit. Kumikibo lang sila sa pwesto nila at hindi gumagalaw palayo sa isa't isa!

statements.text:
Did you know there are two types of solids?

Crystalline solids like salt have a regular atom pattern, while amorphous solids like glass have a messy, irregular atomic arrangement!
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba na may dalawang uri ng solids?

Ang crystalline solids tulad ng asin ay may regular na atom pattern, habang ang amorphous solids tulad ng salamin ay may magulo at irregular na atomic arrangement!

statements.text:
Do old windows get thicker at the bottom because glass flows?

Nope! Glass is an amorphous solid lacking a crystalline structure, so it doesn't slowly flow to make old windows thicker.
statements.tl:
Nakakapal ba ang ilalim ng lumang bintana dahil dumadaloy ang salamin?

Hindi! Ang salamin ay isang amorphous solid na walang crystalline structure, kaya hindi ito dahan-dahang dumadaloy para lumapad ang lumang bintana.

statements.text: When a solid melts, heat makes its particles vibrate faster! They vibrate so much that they finally break free from their fixed positions.
statements.tl: Kapag natutunaw ang solid, pinapabilis ng init ang pag-vibrate ng mga particle! Mabilis silang nagva-vibrate hanggang makawala sa nakapirming posisyon.

statements.text: Evaporation happens at the surface of a liquid! Some particles gain enough energy to break free and escape right into the air.
statements.tl: Nangyayari ang evaporation sa ibabaw ng likido! Nakukuha ng ilang particle ang sapat na energy para makatakas at lumipad sa hangin.

statements.text: In a gas, particles are super spread out! They are about ten times farther apart from each other than in a liquid or solid.
statements.tl: Sa gas, ang mga particle ay sobrang layo sa isa't isa! Halos sampung beses na mas malayo kaysa sa likido o solid.

statements.text: Even in ice, particles still vibrate in place! The cold does not completely stop their tiny, wiggly motion.
statements.tl: Kahit sa yelo, nagva-vibrate pa rin ang mga particle sa lugar nila! Hindi lubusang pinipigilan ng lamig ang paggalaw nila.

statements.text: A solid has a fixed shape and volume. A liquid has fixed volume but takes the container's shape, and a gas takes both!
statements.tl: Ang solid ay may nakapirming hugis at volume. Ang likido ay may fixed volume pero sumusunod sa hugis ng lalagyan, at ang gas ay sumusunod sa pareho!

statements.text: During melting and evaporation, particle arrangement changes from tightly packed to loosely arranged to far apart as heat is added.
statements.tl: Sa panahon ng melting at evaporation, nagbabago ang ayos ng mga particle mula sa mahigpit na pagkakasiksik patungong maluwag na ayos patungong magkakalayo habang dinadagdagan ng init.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ZlXUAJD27JN9wt0eeajD00CthklJJ-fw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Putting water in a freezer removes heat, making molecules slow down and lock into solid ice!
statements.tl: Kapag inilagay mo ang tubig sa freezer, kinukuha nito ang init kaya bumabagal ang mga molekula at nagiging matigas na yelo!

statements.text:
How does distillation separate mixtures?

Distillation separates mixtures because substances with different boiling points turn to vapor at different temperatures!
statements.tl:
Paano hinihiwalay ng distilasyon ang mga halo?

Ang distilasyon ay naghihiwalay ng halo dahil ang mga sangkap na may iba't ibang punto ng pagkulo ay sumisingaw sa magkakaibang temperatura!

statements.text: Ice is a solid with a fixed shape. But when it melts, its particles loosen into water with no fixed shape, showing the fixed shape is lost when states change!
statements.tl: Ang yelo ay solid na may tiyak na hugis. Pero kapag natunaw, lumuluwag ang pagkakaayos ng mga particle nito at nagiging tubig na walang sariling tiyak na hugis, kaya nawawala ang tiyak na hugis kapag nagbago ang estado!

statements.text: Steam can turn back into water! When it cools, the molecules join together again. That’s why water drips from a pot lid!
statements.tl: Maaaring bumalik sa tubig ang singaw! Kapag lumamig, nagtitipon ulit ang mga molekula. Kaya may tumutulong na tubig sa takip ng kaldero!

statements.text: In a solid, tiny particles are packed tightly and just wiggle. When heated, they vibrate harder, break free, and slide around. That’s how a solid melts into a liquid!
statements.tl: Sa solid, magkadikit ang maliliit na particle at umuugoy lang. Kapag ininitan, mas malakas silang umaalog, kumakawala, at gumagalaw. Ganyan natutunaw ang solid papuntang liquid!

statements.text: At high places like mountains, water boils at a lower temperature than 100°C because the air pressure is lower!
statements.tl: Sa mataas na lugar gaya ng bundok, kumukulo ang tubig sa mas mababa sa 100°C dahil mas mababa ang presyon ng hangin!

statements.text: In the Kelvin scale, water boils at about 373 Kelvin (373 K) at standard atmospheric pressure!
statements.tl: Sa sukat na Kelvin, ang tubig ay kumukulo sa mga 373 Kelvin (373 K) sa karaniwang presyon sa lebel ng dagat!

statements.text: When you add heat to solid butter, its molecules get enough energy to break their rigid structure and flow as a liquid!
statements.tl: Kapag pinainit ang solid na butter, ang molecules nito ay nakakakuha ng sapat na enerhiya para masira ang matigas na estruktura at maging likido!

statements.text:
How does liquid sweat cool your body when it evaporates?

The highest-energy water molecules escape into the air, lowering the average energy of the remaining liquid!
statements.tl:
Paano pinalalamig ng liquid sweat ang katawan kapag nag-evaporate?

Ang highest-energy water molecules ay tumatakas papunta sa hangin, kaya bumababa ang average energy ng natitirang liquid!

statements.text: When you remove heat from melted candle wax, its molecules slow down and lock into a rigid arrangement, changing the liquid back into a solid!
statements.tl: Kapag inalisan ng init ang natunaw na candle wax, bumabagal ang molecules nito at nagla-lock sa isang rigid arrangement, kaya nagiging solid muli ang liquid!

statements.text: Ice cubes absorb heat from a warm room! Their water molecules gain energy and break free to become liquid water.
statements.tl: Sumisipsip ang mga ice cube ng init mula sa mainit na silid! Nagkakaroon ng enerhiya ang mga water molecules para maging likido.

statements.text:
What happens to water molecules when we heat them up?

Heating liquid water gives its molecules enough kinetic energy to overcome attractive forces, letting them escape into the air as water vapor!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa mga molekula ng tubig kapag pinainit natin ito?

Ang pag-init ng tubig ay nagbibigay sa mga molekula nito ng sapat na kinetic energy para mapagtagumpayan ang mga puwersang humahawak, kaya nakakalusot sila sa hangin bilang water vapor!

statements.text: Boiling water is just a physical change! The bubbling steam is still made of the exact same water molecules.
statements.tl: Ang pag-boil ng tubig ay physical change lang! Ang umuusok na singaw ay gawa pa rin sa parehong water molecules.

statements.text: When you cool a liquid, its particles lose energy and slow down until they lock tightly together — that's freezing! It's how water becomes ice in your freezer.
statements.tl: Kapag pinalamig mo ang isang likido, nawawalan ng lakas ang mga particle nito at bumabagal hanggang sa mag-lock nang mahigpit — iyon ang freezing! Ganito nagiging yelo ang tubig sa freezer.

statements.text: Cooling liquid water below zero degrees Celsius removes kinetic energy from its molecules, causing them to lock into a fixed, hexagonal crystalline structure as ice.
statements.tl: Kapag pinalamig ang tubig sa ilalim ng zero degrees Celsius, nawawalan ang molecules ng kinetic energy at naglo-lock sa isang hexagonal crystalline structure bilang yelo.

statements.text:
How do dew drops form?

Cooling warm water vapor removes energy from gas molecules! They slow down and clump together into liquid dew drops.
statements.tl:
Paano nabubuo ang mga patak ng hamog?

Kapag pinalamig ang mainit na water vapor, nawawala ang enerhiya ng gas molecules! Bumabagal sila at nagbubuo ng liquid na dew drops.

statements.text:
What happens when you heat solid butter?

Heating it adds thermal energy, making its molecules vibrate faster and slide past each other to form a liquid!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag pinainit ang solid butter?

Nadadagdag ang thermal energy kaya mas mabilis ang pag-vibrate ng mga molecule at nag-slide sila para maging likido!

statements.text: Show your teacher the problem and materials list before mixing! This fixes any unsafe or untestable plans right away.
statements.tl: Ipakita sa guro ang problema at listahan ng materyales bago maghalo! Para maayos agad kung may hindi ligtas o di kayang subukan.

statements.text: In the conclusion, compare your actual results with your aim! Say plainly what the data show, even if it is not what you wanted.
statements.tl: Sa conclusion, ikumpara mo ang iyong aktwal na resulta sa iyong aim! Sabihin nang malinaw kung ano ang ipinapakita ng data, kahit hindi ito ang gusto mo.

statements.text:
How do you choose your materials and steps?

Your aim guides you! What you want to find out decides what you measure and how.
statements.tl:
Paano ka pumipili ng materials at steps?

Ang aim ang gumagabay! Kung ano ang gusto mong malaman ang nagdedesisyon kung ano ang susukatin mo at paano.

statements.text: Write your aim as a question! Name the exact thing you will change and the thing you will measure.
statements.tl: Isulat ang layunin bilang isang tanong! Pangalanan ang bagay na babaguhin mo at ang bagay na susukatin mo.

statements.text: Writing a procedure? Use action words like 'measure', 'pour', and 'mix' so your steps are super clear!
statements.tl: Nagsusulat ng procedure? Gumamit ng action words tulad ng 'sukatin', 'ibuhos', at 'haluin' para malinaw ang mga hakbang!

statements.text: For repeated trials, give each trial its own row in the data table. Label each column with the measurement and its unit!
statements.tl: Para sa mga paulit-ulit na trial, bigyan ang bawat trial ng sarili nitong row sa data table. Lagyan ng label ang bawat column ng sukat at unit!

statements.text: Reliability means that repeated experiments under the same conditions give results that agree with each other.
statements.tl: Ang reliability ay nangangahulugang ang paulit-ulit na experiment sa parehong kondisyon ay nagbibigay ng mga resultang magkakasundo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GeT_SzMMzI3lTQDY5NXk7IclKAoxc25J), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To get reliable results, Abbey should repeat her experiment in at least two trials and average the size of the sprouts from each liquid.
statements.tl: Para makakuha ng maaasahang resulta, dapat ulitin ni Abbey ang kanyang experiment sa hindi bababa sa dalawang trials at i-average ang laki ng sprouts mula sa bawat liquid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GeT_SzMMzI3lTQDY5NXk7IclKAoxc25J), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Scientific investigation is a sequential process, meaning you follow its steps in order, starting with the aim and ending with the conclusion.
statements.tl: Ang scientific investigation ay isang sequential process, ibig sabihin sinusunod mo ang mga hakbang nito nang magkakasunod, simula sa aim at nagtatapos sa conclusion.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1My4b2WkUuwo_H0dOdwiuwKUf9-9S00fT), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The method or procedure is the series of steps you perform to obtain data, such as cutting, pounding, and squeezing the leaves to get their extract.
statements.tl: Ang method o procedure ay ang serye ng mga hakbang na ginagawa mo para makakuha ng data, tulad ng paghiwa, pagdikdik, at pagpiga sa mga dahon para makuha ang extract nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1My4b2WkUuwo_H0dOdwiuwKUf9-9S00fT), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The conclusion is the final statement summarizing the outcomes of the investigation, like saying mayana leaves extract could be a possible alternative source of ink.
statements.tl: Ang conclusion ay ang huling pahayag na nagbubuod sa mga kinalabasan ng investigation, tulad ng pagsasabing ang dahon ng mayana ay maaaring maging alternatibong pagkukunan ng tinta.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1My4b2WkUuwo_H0dOdwiuwKUf9-9S00fT), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: After an investigation, scientists communicate their results by telling others what they found out, often using a graph to show patterns or trends.
statements.tl: Pagkatapos ng isang investigation, ibinabahagi ng mga scientist ang kanilang mga resulta sa pamamagitan ng pagsasabi sa iba kung ano ang kanilang natuklasan, kadalasan gamit ang graph para ipakita ang mga pattern o trend.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RBw-M1zdZxcBtYpujI1UyzYclna6zmYR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A good experiment has a clear procedure, the step-by-step instructions you follow to test your hypothesis safely.
statements.tl: Ang isang mabuting experiment ay may malinaw na procedure, ang mga hakbang-hakbang na panuto na sinusunod mo para subukan ang iyong hypothesis nang ligtas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ZlXUAJD27JN9wt0eeajD00CthklJJ-fw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The scientific method is like a road map you follow to get to your target destination, a step-by-step process for answering questions and solving problems.
statements.tl: Ang scientific method ay parang road map na sinusundan mo para makarating sa iyong pupuntahan, isang hakbang-hakbang na proseso para sagutin ang mga tanong at lutasin ang mga problema.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To test a hypothesis, you design and conduct an experiment — a scientific procedure to test an idea and make a discovery.
statements.tl: Para masubok ang hypothesis, nagdidisenyo at nagsasagawa ka ng experiment — isang siyentipikong pamamaraan para subukin ang isang ideya at gumawa ng pagtuklas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: After an experiment, you record the observations and data, then analyze the results, often using graphs to see patterns clearly.
statements.tl: Pagkatapos ng experiment, itinatala mo ang mga observation at data, pagkatapos ay sinusuri ang mga resulta, madalas gamit ang mga graph para makita nang malinaw ang mga pattern.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What makes a question a good scientific question?

A good scientific question is one you can test with an experiment, like: Does the amount of salt in water affect the temperature at which it boils?
statements.tl:
Ano ang gumagawa sa isang tanong na maging magandang siyentipikong tanong?

Ang magandang siyentipikong tanong ay isa na maaari mong subukin sa pamamagitan ng experiment, tulad ng: Nakakaapekto ba ang dami ng asin sa tubig sa temperatura kung kailan ito kumukulo?
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b3Nb2PWiQmBZlrJSHmazBPXgq_BwKr5k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is a conclusion in science?

It is a statement summing up what you have learned from an experiment, and it should be consistent with the aim or problem.
statements.tl:
Ano ang conclusion sa science?

Ito ay isang pahayag na nagbubuod sa iyong natutunan mula sa isang experiment, at dapat itong naaayon sa aim o problem.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hmWPMIg897zJuzj4R9q-QBcQ0Hu0mbjs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The meter (m) is the official SI base unit we use to measure length or distance!
statements.tl: Ang metro (m) ang SI base unit na ginagamit para sukatin ang haba o distansya!

statements.text: For repeated trials, give each trial its own row in the data table. Label each column with the measurement and its unit!
statements.tl: Para sa mga paulit-ulit na trial, bigyan ang bawat trial ng sarili nitong row sa data table. Lagyan ng label ang bawat column ng sukat at unit!

statements.text: Magnitude is the numerical value and unit of a quantity, like the 30 and meters in 30 meters.
statements.tl: Ang magnitude ay ang numerical value at unit ng isang quantity, tulad ng 30 at metro sa 30 metro.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10RceE2-9x2EyYbB-Fx92ZUqPChnxFrIR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does it mean when my measurement is accurate?

Accuracy means your measurement is close to the true value, like a dart landing near the bullseye.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin kapag accurate ang sukat ko?

Ang accuracy ay nangangahulugang malapit ang sukat mo sa totoong value, tulad ng dart na tumama malapit sa bullseye.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 182TIOnxSBmc2-60rTNPz2NaGOOivCpQd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When using measurement tools like weighing scales and tape measures, your readings must be as close as possible to the true value to be accurate.
statements.tl: Kapag gumagamit ng mga panukat tulad ng weighing scale at tape measure, ang iyong mga reading ay dapat malapit hangga't maaari sa totoong value para maging accurate.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 182TIOnxSBmc2-60rTNPz2NaGOOivCpQd), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do you make accurate measurements?

Use the most appropriate measuring equipment and read it correctly, like reading the volume of a liquid at eye level.
statements.tl:
Paano ka gumagawa ng accurate na measurements?

Gumamit ng pinakaangkop na kagamitan sa pagsukat at basahin ito nang tama, tulad ng pagbasa ng volume ng liquid sa eye level.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GeT_SzMMzI3lTQDY5NXk7IclKAoxc25J), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: After making a line graph, you should review and revise it by checking that the axes are labeled, the scale is equal, and the points are plotted correctly.
statements.tl: Pagkatapos gumawa ng line graph, dapat mong i-review at i-revise ito sa pamamagitan ng pag-check na may labels ang mga axes, pantay ang scale, at tama ang pagkaka-plot ng mga points.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1LvwK7XMmEaaPiZD5Dg3GqAQxpv7J6oRk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When preparing a solution in the laboratory, use a graduated cylinder or pipette to accurately measure the needed volume of a liquid solute.
statements.tl: Kapag naghahanda ng solution sa laboratoryo, gumamit ng graduated cylinder o pipette upang tumpak na masukat ang kinakailangang volume ng isang liquid solute.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MyWpd7t1I0np0BvlaucGDasc-iJ3p8tv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Measurements should be organized in tables with a title and labeled columns so the data is clear and easy to understand.
statements.tl: Dapat ayusin ang mga sukat sa isang table na may title at may label ang bawat column para malinaw at madaling maintindihan ang data.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why does a data table need a title and labeled columns?

A title explains what the data is about, and labeled columns tell you exactly what each number means.
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangan ng title at labeled columns ang isang data table?

Ang title ay nagpapaliwanag kung tungkol saan ang data, at ang labeled columns ay nagsasabi kung ano ang ibig sabihin ng bawat numero.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Keep data neat and aligned in a table so it is easy to read and compare measurements.
statements.tl: Panatilihing maayos at nakahanay ang data sa table para madaling basahin at ikumpara ang mga sukat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What if everyone used different-sized spoons to measure medicine?

It would be dangerous because the amounts would not be the same. Scientists use standardized tools and metric units like centimeters and milliliters so measurements are accurate and consistent everywhere.
statements.tl:
Paano kung iba-ibang laki ng kutsara ang gamitin ng lahat para sumukat ng gamot?

Delikado iyon dahil hindi magkakapareho ang dami. Gumagamit ang mga scientist ng standardized na mga tool at metric units tulad ng centimeters at milliliters para maging tumpak at pare-pareho ang sukat kahit saan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1WlUc-vwin-7tox1tG4razIHf_JZNq15n), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
If two leaves look almost the same size, how can you tell which is longer or wider?

Measure them with a ruler! Comparing their measured length and width in a table shows the real difference.
statements.tl:
Kung halos magkapareho ang laki ng dalawang dahon, paano mo malalaman kung alin ang mas mahaba o mas malapad?

Sukatin mo sila gamit ang ruler! Ang paghahambing ng kanilang nasukat na haba at lapad sa isang table ay nagpapakita ng totoong pagkakaiba.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YBVxDp316Myg5H-FyBBsW2Dv9MDlyvBp), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: On a graph, the independent variable goes on the x-axis, the horizontal line, and the dependent variable goes on the y-axis, the vertical line.
statements.tl: Sa graph, ang independent variable ay nasa x-axis, ang pahalang na linya, at ang dependent variable ay nasa y-axis, ang patayong linya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Ze3xgTqtC755O4IDvL9lZlblXqES9WUs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The average distance between Earth and the Sun is about 149.6 million kilometers, a distance scientists call one astronomical unit.
statements.tl: Ang average na distansya sa pagitan ng Earth at Araw ay mga 149.6 million kilometers, isang distansyang tinatawag ng mga scientist na isang astronomical unit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1b2QHWI2leanNK5CHJFDMAoBFvSV81iMb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A run is a group of similar symbols in a row when recording species, like XXXXOOXO, which has four runs.
statements.tl: Ang run ay grupo ng magkakaparehong simbolo sa isang hanay kapag nagtatala ng species, tulad ng XXXXOOXO na may apat na runs.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1bmb-qmRVtMuetCuFvMwyJlSymZfXg9D6), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do chemists use a special unit just for counting tiny particles?

Atoms and molecules are far too small to count one by one, so chemists use the mole - the SI unit for amount of substance - to count huge piles of them at once.
statements.tl:
Bakit may espesyal na unit ang mga chemist para sa pagbilang ng maliliit na particle?

Napakaliit ng mga atom at molecule para bilangin isa-isa, kaya ginagamit ng mga chemist ang mole - ang SI unit para sa amount ng substance - para bilangin ang napakarami nito nang sabay-sabay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1brcFRgQfC-AXvdgp7wTDwJD1TO0jDVXb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Experimental data can be organized and presented in tables, which makes it easier to see patterns and compare results.
statements.tl: Ang experimental data ay maaaring ayusin at ipakita sa mga table, na nagpapadali upang makita ang mga pattern at maihambing ang mga resulta.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hmWPMIg897zJuzj4R9q-QBcQ0Hu0mbjs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Water is the "universal solvent" because more substances dissolve in it than in any other liquid!
statements.tl: Ang tubig ang "universal solvent" dahil mas maraming bagay ang natutunaw dito kaysa sa ibang likido!
statements.source: NRC PS1.A (grade-5 endpoint: sugar in solution); encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: When something dissolves, the substance dissolving is the solute, and the liquid dissolving it is the solvent!
statements.tl: Kapag may natutunaw, ang sangkap na natutunaw ay ang solute, at ang likido na tumutunaw nito ay ang solvent!

statements.text: A solution is a special mixture where the solute is spread evenly throughout the whole solvent!
statements.tl: Ang solution ay isang halo kung saan ang solute ay pantay na nakakalat sa buong solvent!

statements.text: A solution forms when a solute dissolves in a solvent into a single uniform phase that looks the same throughout.
statements.tl: Nabubuo ang solution kapag ang solute ay natunaw sa solvent at naging isang uniform na phase na pareho ang itsura sa buong halo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 11MSD3CrY_S6FDrz5nQkVi7d9MBup8VJa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Percent by volume/volume is used for liquid-liquid or gas-gas solutions and tells how many milliliters of solute are in 100 mL of solution.
statements.tl: Ang percent by volume/volume ay ginagamit para sa liquid-liquid o gas-gas na solution at nagsasabi kung ilang milliliter ng solute ang nasa 100 mL ng solution.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16lkl3nkTfePMjLyFXATMZEm_pD-fbVXB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Solubility is the ability of a substance, the solute, to dissolve in a solvent, and it depends on the nature of both substances.
statements.tl: Ang solubility ay ang kakayahan ng isang substance, ang solute, na matunaw sa solvent, at nakadepende ito sa nature ng dalawang substance.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 19C65PCknCLdP7SalHlAQ3SNckc_h01Xw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Pressure has little effect on the solubility of solid solutes, but it strongly affects the solubility of gases in liquids.
statements.tl: Maliit lang ang epekto ng pressure sa solubility ng solid solute, pero malaki ang epekto nito sa solubility ng gas sa liquid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Iklxj7THlnJIelFQuw_DspX1v9KWtZxL), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In carbonated drinks like soda, carbon dioxide gas is the solute that is dissolved in water, which acts as the solvent.
statements.tl: Sa mga carbonated drinks tulad ng soda, ang carbon dioxide gas ang solute na natutunaw sa tubig, na siyang nagsisilbing solvent.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1O3NvDxyemqrvjKomzSpok-fZwly0t86P), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Hydrogen gas can dissolve in the solid metal palladium, making a solid solution where hydrogen is the solute and palladium is the solvent.
statements.tl: Ang hydrogen gas ay maaaring matunaw sa solid na metal na palladium, na bumubuo ng solid solution kung saan ang hydrogen ang solute at ang palladium ang solvent.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1O3NvDxyemqrvjKomzSpok-fZwly0t86P), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Ether is used as a solvent, a liquid that dissolves other substances, and as a coolant in some machines.
statements.tl: Ang ether ay ginagamit bilang solvent, isang likido na tumutunaw ng ibang substance, at bilang coolant sa ilang mga makina.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PwjUW3R405DUgGyXVaGHlwEyATnierCG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Whether a solute dissolves in a solvent depends on the nature of both substances, because similar particles tend to mix well together.
statements.tl: Kung matutunaw ba ang isang solute sa solvent ay nakadepende sa kalikasan ng dalawang substance, dahil ang magkatulad na particle ay madaling maghalo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_8scE0SSF8kpGAPKf6oPvOd3lk1kg6Ip), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Heating, stirring, and crushing a solute into smaller pieces help it dissolve faster in a solvent.
statements.tl: Ang pag-init, paghalo, at pagdurog sa solute sa mas maliliit na piraso ay nakakatulong para mas mabilis itong matunaw sa solvent.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1a54n5uWw39pWvYx_jIpU6PkyxXbfxVde), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The nature of the solute matters because some substances, like gasoline, do not dissolve in water, while others, like sugar, dissolve easily.
statements.tl: Mahalaga ang uri ng solute dahil ang ilang sangkap, tulad ng gasolina, ay hindi natutunaw sa tubig, habang ang iba, tulad ng asukal, ay madaling matunaw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hfzNFL3HlcWx_eVn46U9gJWfQdMCIHFI), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A solution is when a solute fully dissolves in a solvent — like sugar in water! But there's a limit: once no more dissolves, it's saturated.
statements.tl: Ang solution ay kapag ganap na natutunaw ang solute sa solvent — tulad ng asukal sa tubig! Pero may limitasyon: kapag wala nang karagdagang solute na natutunaw, saturated na ito.

statements.text: In a solution, the solute is the substance that dissolves, like sugar! The solvent does the dissolving, usually water. Together, they make the solution.
statements.tl: Sa isang solution, ang solute ang sangkap na natutunaw gaya ng asukal! Ang solvent naman ang nagpapatunaw, kadalasang tubig. Magkasama silang bumubuo ng solution.

statements.text: Water is often called the 'universal solvent'! More substances dissolve in it than any other liquid, which is why salt, sugar, and many things dissolve in water.
statements.tl: Madalas tawaging 'universal solvent' ang tubig! Mas maraming sangkap ang natutunaw dito kaysa ibang likido, kaya natutunaw sa tubig ang asin, asukal, at marami pang bagay.

statements.text:
What do we call the parts of a solution?

The substance that dissolves is the solute, and the liquid that dissolves it is the solvent!
statements.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa mga bahagi ng isang solusyon?

Ang bagay na natutunaw ay ang solute, at ang likidong nagtutunaw nito ay ang solvent!

statements.text:
Why does stirring a drink make the sugar dissolve faster?

Stirring speeds up dissolving because it spreads the solute through the solvent much faster!
statements.tl:
Bakit mas mabilis natutunaw ang asukal sa inumin kapag hinahalo?

Nagpapabilis ang paghahalo ng pagkatunaw dahil mas mabilis kumalat ang solute sa solvent!

statements.text: Concentration can be expressed quantitatively by comparing the exact number of drops or grams of solute per volume of solution.
statements.tl: Ang concentration ay maaaring ipahayag nang quantitative sa pamamagitan ng paghahambing ng eksaktong bilang ng mga patak o gramo ng solute sa bawat volume ng solution.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1OYzCcGjBe0IJJPMl641lljkmBVHKtq30), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: At room temperature, 100 mL of water can dissolve about 36 grams of table salt. That's the limit!
statements.tl: Sa room temperature, kaya ng 100 mL na tubig na tunawin ang mga 36 grams ng table salt. 'Yun lang ang kaya!

statements.text:
How do you find the volume of a liquid solute in a solution?

Multiply the percent concentration as a decimal by the total solution volume. For example, 12% of 355 mL is 0.12 times 355, which gives 42.6 mL.
statements.tl:
Paano mo makukuha ang volume ng liquid solute sa isang solution?

I-multiply ang percent concentration bilang decimal sa kabuuang volume ng solution. Halimbawa, ang 12% ng 355 mL ay 0.12 times 355, na nagbibigay ng 42.6 mL.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16lkl3nkTfePMjLyFXATMZEm_pD-fbVXB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does concentration of a solution actually tell you?

It tells you how much solute is packed into a certain amount of solution, so a higher percentage means more solute is present!
statements.tl:
Ano ba talaga ang sinasabi ng concentration ng isang solution?

Sinasabi nito kung gaano karaming solute ang nakalagay sa isang tiyak na dami ng solution, kaya ang mas mataas na porsyento ay nangangahulugang mas maraming solute ang naroroon!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16lkl3nkTfePMjLyFXATMZEm_pD-fbVXB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
If you dissolve 90 mL of hydrogen peroxide to make 3000 mL of solution, what is the concentration?

It is 3%, because 90 divided by 3000 is 0.03, and 0.03 times 100 is 3!
statements.tl:
Kung magtunaw ka ng 90 mL ng hydrogen peroxide sa 3000 mL na solution, ano ang concentration?

Ito ay 3%, dahil ang 90 na hinati sa 3000 ay 0.03, at ang 0.03 na minultiplika sa 100 ay 3!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16lkl3nkTfePMjLyFXATMZEm_pD-fbVXB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a 762.5 mL solution that is 38% calcium azide, the volume of the solute is 289.75 mL, found by multiplying 0.38 by 762.5.
statements.tl: Sa isang 762.5 mL na solution na may 38% calcium azide, ang volume ng solute ay 289.75 mL, na nakuha sa pag-multiply ng 0.38 sa 762.5.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16lkl3nkTfePMjLyFXATMZEm_pD-fbVXB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A solution labeled 0.25% ethanol means that in 100 mL of the solution, only 0.25 mL is ethanol.
statements.tl: Ang isang solution na may label na 0.25% ethanol ay nangangahulugang sa 100 mL ng solution, 0.25 mL lamang ang ethanol.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16lkl3nkTfePMjLyFXATMZEm_pD-fbVXB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
If a juice drink says 3% mass-by-volume ascorbic acid, how much Vitamin C do you get?

In a 100 ml drink, you get 3 grams of ascorbic acid, which is another name for Vitamin C!
statements.tl:
Kung ang isang juice drink ay nagsasabing 3% mass-by-volume ascorbic acid, gaano karaming Vitamin C ang makukuha mo?

Sa isang 100 ml na inumin, makakakuha ka ng 3 gramo ng ascorbic acid, na isa pang pangalan para sa Vitamin C!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MyWpd7t1I0np0BvlaucGDasc-iJ3p8tv), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: If 81 milliliters of ethanol is added to make 180 milliliters of solution, the volume percent is 45 percent.
statements.tl: Kung 81 milliliters ng ethanol ang idinagdag para makabuo ng 180 milliliters ng solution, ang volume percent ay 45 percent.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PXxFmIp28lcIhWUQOYMzeZh2qQ2PJZwS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How can percent concentration help us find the amount of solute?

If a bottle is 40% alcohol by volume, in 100 milliliters of it, 40 milliliters are the alcohol solute!
statements.tl:
Paano nakakatulong ang percent concentration para malaman ang dami ng solute?

Kung ang bote ay 40% alcohol by volume, sa 100 milliliters nito, 40 milliliters ang alcohol na solute!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ibYBfwesxhuXWubKIs2Jv3CbUpdijEZG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do scientists measure tiny amounts of pollution in water and air?

They use parts per million (ppm)! One ppm equals one drop of substance in one million drops of water — that's super tiny!
statements.tl:
Paano sinusukat ng mga scientist ang napakaliit na halaga ng polusyon sa tubig at hangin?

Gumagamit sila ng parts per million (ppm)! Ang isang ppm ay katumbas ng isang drop ng sangkap sa isang milyong drop ng tubig — napakaliit niyan!

statements.text: Molarity is the number of moles of solute dissolved in one liter of solution — it's the standard way scientists express concentration in the lab!
statements.tl: Ang molarity ay ang dami ng solute (sa moles) na natutunaw sa isang liter ng solution — ito ang standard na paraan ng mga scientist sa lab!

statements.text: Seawater has about 35 grams of salt per liter! It's too salty to drink because your body uses more water to flush out the extra salt than the seawater gives you.
statements.tl: Ang tubig-dagat ay may humigit-kumulang 35 gramo ng asin bawat liter! Masyado itong maalat para inumin dahil mas maraming tubig ang ginagamit ng katawan para ilabas ang sobrang asin.

statements.text:
How much table salt can water dissolve before it gets completely full?

At 20 degrees Celsius, water can dissolve a maximum of about 360 grams of table salt per liter of water before the liquid solution becomes completely saturated!
statements.tl:
Ilang gramo ng table salt ang kayang tunawin ng tubig bago ito mapuno nang tuluyan?

Sa 20 degrees Celsius, kayang tunawin ng tubig ang maximum na mga 360 gramo ng asin bawat litro ng tubig bago tuluyang mapuno ang liquid solution!

statements.text:
How much sugar can water hold before it's full?

At about 20°C, you can dissolve up to 204 grams of solid sugar into 100 milliliters of water before the solution becomes saturated!
statements.tl:
Gaano karaming asukal ang kayang tunawin ng tubig bago maging saturated?

Sa mga 20°C, pwede kang mag-dissolve ng hanggang 204 gramo ng solidong asukal sa 100 milliliters ng tubig bago maging saturated ang solusyon!

statements.text: One liter of seawater contains about 35 grams of dissolved salt, making it far saltier than most tap water!
statements.tl: Sa isang litro ng seawater, may humigit-kumulang 35 gramo ng natunaw na asin, kaya mas maalat ito kaysa karamihan ng tubig-gripo!

statements.text:
How much sugar can water dissolve?

At 20°C, 100 milliliters of water can dissolve up to 200 grams of sugar!
statements.tl:
Gaano karaming asukal ang kayang tunawin ng tubig?

Sa 20°C, kayang tunawin ng 100 milliliters ng tubig ang hanggang 200 grams ng asukal!

statements.text: At 20 degrees Celsius, 100 milliliters of water can dissolve about 200 grams of table sugar! That's a lot of sweetness.
statements.tl: Sa 20 degrees Celsius, kayang tunawin ng 100 milliliters ng tubig ang halos 200 grams ng table sugar! Nakakagulat, 'di ba?

statements.text: In meiosis, each sex cell gets only half the chromosomes — just one from every pair found in the parent cell.
statements.tl: Sa meiosis, ang bawat sex cell ay tumatanggap lamang ng kalahati ng chromosome — isa lang sa bawat pares mula sa magulang na selula.

statements.text:
Mitosis vs meiosis — what's the difference?

Mitosis makes exact copies of cells for growing and healing. Meiosis makes different sex cells, made for reproduction.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng mitosis at meiosis?

Gumagawa ang mitosis ng eksaktong kopya ng selula para sa paglaki at paggaling. Ang meiosis naman ay gumagawa ng iba't ibang sex cell para sa pagpaparami.

statements.text: When a cell divides through mitosis, its two daughter cells each get an exact copy of the same DNA.
statements.tl: Kapag naghati ang isang selula sa mitosis, ang dalawang anak na selula nito ay parehong nakakatanggap ng eksaktong kopya ng DNA.

statements.text: When your skin gets wounded, it can heal itself and grow brand-new skin to cover the spot.
statements.tl: Kapag nasugatan ang balat, kaya nitong gumaling at magpatubo ng bagong balat sa sarili.

statements.text: Meiosis is a special type of cell division that produces four haploid cells, each with half the number of chromosomes of the parent cell.
statements.tl: Ang meiosis ay isang espesyal na uri ng cell division na gumagawa ng apat na haploid cells, bawat isa ay may kalahati ng bilang ng chromosomes ng parent cell.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16a7dmIFwwX-sxKxyF092mTrviO3viAgU), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In metaphase I, homologous chromosome pairs line up together, not in a single row like in mitosis.
statements.tl: Sa metaphase I, ang mga homologous chromosome pairs ay magkakasamang pumipila, hindi sa iisang hanay tulad ng sa mitosis.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17aVmKg3nvJlvgDxJLfUfayrpBb_u6d0q), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Primary oocytes in a girl's ovaries pause in prophase I of meiosis until she reaches puberty and her menstrual cycle begins.
statements.tl: Ang primary oocytes sa ovaries ng isang babae ay humihinto sa prophase I ng meiosis hanggang sa siya ay magdalaga at magsimula ang kanyang menstrual cycle.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ZNSEtEe3ihwQZtOQQxkMm35kVTwKsljU), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Interphase includes three stages: G1 for initial cell growth, S phase for DNA replication, and G2 for rapid growth and preparation for cell division.
statements.tl: Ang interphase ay may tatlong stages: G1 para sa unang paglaki ng cell, S phase para sa DNA replication, at G2 para sa mabilis na paglaki at paghahanda sa cell division.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_W6gIaE8Zij9DTNPVFgBJtJAR1nWLPtR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: During metaphase, chromosomes align at the equatorial plane, and spindle fibers attach to each chromosome at its kinetochore.
statements.tl: Sa metaphase, ang chromosomes ay pumipila sa equatorial plane, at ang spindle fibers ay kumakabit sa bawat chromosome sa kinetochore nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_W6gIaE8Zij9DTNPVFgBJtJAR1nWLPtR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Meiosis II separates sister chromatids and results in four haploid daughter cells, each with a single set of chromosomes.
statements.tl: Hinihiwalay ng Meiosis II ang sister chromatids at nagreresulta sa apat na haploid daughter cells, bawat isa ay may isang set ng chromosomes.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_W6gIaE8Zij9DTNPVFgBJtJAR1nWLPtR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mitosis is important for growth, repair of damaged cells and tissues, and asexual reproduction in unicellular organisms.
statements.tl: Mahalaga ang mitosis para sa paglaki, pag-aayos ng mga nasirang cells at tissues, at asexual reproduction sa mga unicellular organisms.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_W6gIaE8Zij9DTNPVFgBJtJAR1nWLPtR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cells reproduce through two main types of cell division: mitosis for growth and repair, and meiosis for making reproductive cells.
statements.tl: Ang mga cell ay dumarami sa pamamagitan ng dalawang uri ng cell division: mitosis para sa paglaki at repair, at meiosis para sa paggawa ng reproductive cells.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1acsPCUic_8irwFNoEHN_ieFjGV1FiiZS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In prophase, the first stage of mitosis, the chromosomes condense into thick shapes, the nuclear envelope breaks down, and the spindle begins to form.
statements.tl: Sa prophase, ang unang yugto ng mitosis, ang mga chromosome ay kumakapal, ang nuclear envelope ay nawawala, at ang spindle ay nagsisimulang mabuo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1acsPCUic_8irwFNoEHN_ieFjGV1FiiZS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Meiosis produces four daughter cells, each with half the number of chromosomes as the parent cell, which is important for making sperm and egg cells.
statements.tl: Ang meiosis ay gumagawa ng apat na daughter cells, bawat isa ay may kalahati ng bilang ng chromosomes ng parent cell, na mahalaga para sa paggawa ng sperm at egg cells.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1acsPCUic_8irwFNoEHN_ieFjGV1FiiZS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In Anaphase I of meiosis, homologous chromosome pairs separate and move to opposite poles, but the sister chromatids stay attached to each other.
statements.tl: Sa Anaphase I ng meiosis, naghihiwalay ang mga pares ng homologous chromosomes at pumupunta sa magkabilang dulo, ngunit ang mga sister chromatids ay nananatiling magkadikit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1acsPCUic_8irwFNoEHN_ieFjGV1FiiZS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In Anaphase II of meiosis, the centromeres split, allowing the sister chromatids to finally separate and move to opposite poles of the cell.
statements.tl: Sa Anaphase II ng meiosis, nahahati ang mga centromere, na nagpapahintulot sa mga sister chromatids na tuluyang maghiwalay at pumunta sa magkabilang dulo ng cell.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1acsPCUic_8irwFNoEHN_ieFjGV1FiiZS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mitosis is essential for life because it allows organisms to grow from a single cell into a body, and it constantly replaces old, worn-out cells.
statements.tl: Mahalaga ang mitosis sa buhay dahil pinapayagan nito ang mga organismo na lumaki mula sa isang cell hanggang maging isang katawan, at patuloy nitong pinapalitan ang mga luma at pagod nang cells.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1acsPCUic_8irwFNoEHN_ieFjGV1FiiZS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mitosis makes two identical cells with the parent's chromosome number for growth and repair, while meiosis makes four different haploid cells for reproduction.
statements.tl: Ang mitosis ay gumagawa ng dalawang magkaparehong cell na may chromosome number ng parent cell para sa paglaki at pag-aayos, habang ang meiosis ay gumagawa ng apat na magkakaibang haploid cell para sa reproduction.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1eaRSWbyPbQMSO-tJp6RT9NSrXkowqkTl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An unbalanced force is a push or pull that is not canceled out by another force, and it is what changes an object's speed or direction of motion.
statements.tl: Ang unbalanced force ay isang tulak o hatak na hindi napapantayan ng ibang puwersa, at ito ang nagpapabago sa bilis o direksyon ng paggalaw ng isang bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1sJr7EA2T0BNWbhi_KhQRzKLQWHVcW22h), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What happens when the forces on an object are unbalanced?

When forces are unbalanced, an object's motion changes! It can start moving, speed up, slow down, or change direction.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag hindi balanse ang mga pwersa sa isang bagay?

Kapag hindi balanse ang mga pwersa, nagbabago ang galaw ng bagay! Maaari itong magsimulang gumalaw, bumilis, bumagal, o magpalit ng direksyon.

statements.text: Unbalanced forces produce a nonzero net force: the forces do not cancel when their magnitudes and directions are combined, so the object's motion changes.
statements.tl: May nonzero net force kapag hindi balanse ang mga puwersa: hindi nagkakansela ang mga ito kapag pinagsama ayon sa lakas at direksiyon, kaya nagbabago ang galaw ng bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-qY_z10GH5wroNqZLv_SRb2Xe-p8rhv0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Pushing a box on a smooth, frictionless surface creates unbalanced forces, so the box speeds up in the direction of the push.
statements.tl: Ang pagtulak ng kahon sa makinis at frictionless na surface ay lumilikha ng unbalanced forces, kaya bumibilis ang kahon sa direksyon ng pagtulak.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-qY_z10GH5wroNqZLv_SRb2Xe-p8rhv0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When one force is stronger than the other, they are unbalanced, and the object's motion changes!
statements.tl: Kapag mas malakas ang isang puwersa kaysa sa kabila, di-balanse sila at magbabago ang galaw ng bagay!

statements.text:
Why does a rolling ball eventually stop in real life?

It stops because friction is an unbalanced force that pushes against it!
statements.tl:
Bakit sa totoong buhay ay humihinto ang gumugulong na bola?

Humihinto ito dahil ang friction ay isang di-balanseng pwersang pumipigil dito!

statements.text:
What happens when the forces on an object aren't balanced?

When forces are unbalanced, an object's motion changes in the direction of the net force! The object's acceleration points in the direction of the net force.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag hindi balanse ang mga pwersa?

Kapag di-balanse ang mga pwersa, nagbabago ang galaw ng bagay pasunod sa direksyon ng net force! Nakaturo ang acceleration ng bagay sa direksyon ng net force.

statements.text:
How hard do you need to push to move an object?

You must push harder than the friction holding it in place! Your push needs to beat the friction to get it moving.
statements.tl:
Gaano kalakas ang itulak mo para gumalaw ang isang bagay?

Kailangan mong itulak nang mas malakas kaysa sa friction na pumipigil dito! Talunin ng push mo ang friction para gumalaw ito.

statements.text:
Who wins in a game of tug-of-war?

The side with enough grip on the ground to pull the other side over the line wins!
statements.tl:
Sino ang nananalo sa hilahan ng lubid?

Ang panig na may sapat na kapit sa lupa para mahatak ang kabila lampas sa linya ang nananalo!

statements.text:
What is a net force?

When many forces act on an object, their combined effect is the net force. If forces are balanced, the net force is zero and motion stays the same. But if one side has extra force (unbalanced), the motion changes!
statements.tl:
Ano ang net force?

Kapag maraming force ang dumadapo sa isang bagay, ang pinagsamang epekto ay ang net force. Kung balanced ang mga force, zero ang net force at walang pagbabago sa galaw. Pero kung may sobrang force (unbalanced), nagbabago ang galaw!

statements.text:
What happens when many forces push at the same time?

They combine! If forces point the same way, they add up for a bigger change. If they oppose, they subtract. That's why two people pushing a cart together move it faster than one!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag maraming force ang tumutulak nang sabay-sabay?

Nagdaragdag sila! Kung magkadireksyon, nagdaragdag para mas malaking pagbabago. Kung magkasalungat, nagbabawasan. Kaya dalawang tao na sabay tumutulak sa kariton ay mas mabilis kaysa isang tao lang!

statements.text: An object is in equilibrium when all forces balance! The net force equals zero, so it doesn't accelerate.
statements.tl: Ang isang bagay ay nasa equilibrium kapag nagkakabalanse ang lahat ng puwersa — ang net force ay zero, kaya hindi ito nag-a-accelerate!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; NRC PS2.A; DepEd G7 Science

statements.text:
What makes the rope move in tug of war?

Two teams pull with opposite forces, and the rope moves toward whichever side pulls harder!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagpapagalaw sa lubid sa hilaang lubid?

Magkasalungat na puwersa ang hatak ng dalawang grupo, at gumagalaw ang lubid sa panig na mas malakas humihila!
statements.source: NRC PS2.A forces and motion; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
How does a parachute slow down a skydiver?

A parachute increases air resistance by catching air molecules, creating an upward frictional force that slows the skydiver's downward speed!
statements.tl:
Paano nagpapabagal ng parachute sa skydiver?

Ang parachute ay nagpapataas ng air resistance sa pagharang ng mga molekula ng hangin, na gumagawa ng upward frictional force para pabagalin ang skydiver!

statements.text:
What does the Coriolis effect change about a moving object?

It only changes the direction of a moving object — not how fast it goes!
statements.tl:
Ano ang binabago ng Coriolis effect sa gumagalaw na bagay?

Binabago lang nito ang direksyon ng gumagalaw na bagay — hindi ang bilis nito!

statements.text:
Why do sprinters start slowly and then get faster?

They accelerate - their velocity increases as they push harder against the ground!
statements.tl:
Bakit nagsisimula nang mabagal ang mga sprinter at pagkatapos ay bumibilis?

Nag-a-accelerate sila - tumataas ang kanilang velocity habang mas malakas silang tumutulak sa lupa!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1cR9AA2X4i7yw53qj_Yo-eu1c-c4MGZPe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When something slows down, it still has acceleration! The force points opposite to its motion, called deceleration.
statements.tl: Kapag bumabagal ang isang bagay, may aselerasyon pa rin ito! Nakaturo ang puwersa pabaliktad sa galaw, kaya tinatawag itong deceleration.
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; encyclopedia-stable consensus; DepEd G9-10 kinematics

statements.text:
Ever played tug-of-war?

If one team is stronger, the forces become unbalanced and the rope moves toward them!
statements.tl:
Nakapaglaro ka na ba ng tug-of-war?

Kung mas malakas ang isang grupo, di-balanse na ang pwersa at gumagalaw ang lubid patungo sa kanila!

statements.text:
Is it possible for your displacement to be zero even if you traveled a really long distance?

Yes! If an object returns to its exact starting point, its displacement is zero, even if the total distance traveled is large.
statements.tl:
Maaari bang maging zero ang displacement mo kahit na malaki ang kabuuang distansyang nilakbay mo?

Oo! Kung ang isang bagay ay bumalik sa eksaktong pinanggalingan nito, ang displacement nito ay zero kahit malaki ang kabuuang distansyang nilakbay.

statements.text:
What's the difference between distance and displacement?

Distance is the total path length you travel, while displacement is the straight-line gap from start to finish, plus its direction!
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng distansya at displacement?

Ang distansya ay kabuuang haba ng nilakbay mo, pero ang displacement ay ang tuwid na layo mula simula hanggang dulo, kasama ang direksyon!

statements.text: Distance can never be negative because it only counts how much ground you covered, and you cannot cover less than zero ground!
statements.tl: Ang distance ay hindi kailanman negative dahil binibilang lang nito kung gaano karaming lupa ang nadaanan mo, at hindi ka pwedeng dumaan sa mas mababa sa zero!

statements.text: Displacement is the shortest change in position from your starting point to your final point, so it is a vector quantity that needs both magnitude and direction.
statements.tl: Ang displacement ay ang pinakamaikling pagbabago ng posisyon mula sa iyong starting point papunta sa iyong final point, kaya ito ay vector quantity na nangangailangan ng magnitude at direction.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10RceE2-9x2EyYbB-Fx92ZUqPChnxFrIR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Can you travel a distance of 200 meters but still have zero displacement?

Yes! If you walk 100 meters East then 100 meters West, you return to your starting point. Your distance is 200 meters, but your displacement is zero because your initial and final positions are the same.
statements.tl:
Maaari ka bang maglakbay ng distance na 200 metro pero zero pa rin ang displacement mo?

Oo! Kung lumakad ka ng 100 metro papuntang East tapos 100 metro papuntang West, bumalik ka sa pinanggalingan mo. Ang distance mo ay 200 metro, pero ang displacement mo ay zero dahil pareho ang initial at final position mo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10RceE2-9x2EyYbB-Fx92ZUqPChnxFrIR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The location of an object can be described by naming a reference point, like a landmark, and telling where the object is compared to that point.
statements.tl: Ang lokasyon ng isang bagay ay maaaring ilarawan sa pamamagitan ng pagbanggit ng reference point, tulad ng landmark, at pagsasabi kung nasaan ang bagay kumpara sa puntong iyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 135_FeVlZjkU5nIMJlLvHwjOSV0yEIY1W), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Different people may describe the same object's location differently because they choose different reference points or landmarks to compare it with.
statements.tl: Maaaring magkaiba ang paglalarawan ng iba't ibang tao sa lokasyon ng parehong bagay dahil magkaiba ang pinipili nilang reference point o landmark na pinagkukumparahan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 135_FeVlZjkU5nIMJlLvHwjOSV0yEIY1W), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
If I walk around the whole park, why is my distance so big even though I end up where I started?

Distance is the total length of the path you traveled, so every step you took around the park is counted, no matter which way you were facing.
statements.tl:
Kung lilibot ako sa buong parke, bakit malaki ang distance ko kahit bumalik ako sa pinanggalingan?

Ang distance ay ang kabuuang haba ng dinaanan mo, kaya bawat hakbang mo sa paligid ng parke ay binibilang, kahit saang direksyon ka pa nakaharap.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dIjUPn_3UWveqrb9d-6zoCPhab0cJoCC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Displacement equals velocity multiplied by time, so a car moving at 60 km/h West for 5 hours will be 300 kilometers West of where it started.
statements.tl: Ang displacement ay katumbas ng velocity na minultiplika sa oras, kaya ang kotseng tumatakbo ng 60 km/h West sa loob ng 5 oras ay nasa 300 kilometers West mula sa pinanggalingan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dIjUPn_3UWveqrb9d-6zoCPhab0cJoCC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why is your displacement zero if you walk to a store and then walk back home?

Because displacement only cares about where you started and where you ended up, and those are the same spot!
statements.tl:
Bakit zero ang displacement mo kung naglakad ka papunta sa tindahan at bumalik sa bahay?

Dahil ang displacement ay tumitingin lang kung saan ka nagsimula at kung saan ka natapos, at iyon ay iisang lugar!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1gSX5vyR_lJJOrrk2sd3qy9e4jEzgcYxl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: If you drive at 80 km/h north for 6 hours, your displacement is 480 kilometers north, because displacement is velocity multiplied by time.
statements.tl: Kung magmamaneho ka sa 80 km/h papuntang hilaga sa loob ng 6 na oras, ang displacement mo ay 480 kilometers papuntang hilaga, dahil ang displacement ay velocity na minultiplika sa oras.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hzSMxKqOipB0vQfesN5jhNgpj47hMR89), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Position is the exact location of an object at a particular time, described by how far it is from a reference point and in which direction.
statements.tl: Ang position ay ang eksaktong lokasyon ng isang bagay sa isang partikular na oras, na inilalarawan kung gaano ito kalayo mula sa isang reference point at saang direksyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1twpfuJWe48vLFQW-kgQ9rnjllMyHCWkk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Distance is a scalar quantity, which means it only has magnitude - the size or amount of movement - and no direction.
statements.tl: Ang distance ay isang scalar quantity, ibig sabihin mayroon lamang itong magnitude - ang laki o dami ng galaw - at walang direksyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1twpfuJWe48vLFQW-kgQ9rnjllMyHCWkk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: For motion along one straight line, to find displacement, add the magnitudes of movements in the same direction, then subtract the magnitudes of movements in opposite directions and follow the direction of the bigger magnitude.
statements.tl: Sa galaw sa iisang tuwid na linya, pagsamahin ang mga magnitude sa parehong direksyon at ibawas ang sa kasalungat na direksyon; ang direksyon ng displacement ay ang sa mas malaking kabuuan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1twpfuJWe48vLFQW-kgQ9rnjllMyHCWkk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Objects that are fixed relative to Earth, such as a tree, a building, or a post, make good reference points for describing motion.
statements.tl: Ang mga bagay na fixed o hindi gumagalaw kumpara sa Earth, tulad ng puno, gusali, o poste, ay magandang gamitin bilang reference point sa paglalarawan ng galaw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1twpfuJWe48vLFQW-kgQ9rnjllMyHCWkk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you move along a straight path in only one direction, the distance you travel equals the magnitude, or size, of your displacement.
statements.tl: Kapag gumalaw ka sa tuwid na daan sa iisang direksyon lang, ang distance na nilakbay mo ay katumbas ng magnitude, o laki, ng displacement mo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1uUHJpS9WScYgZI-Rq8h_FgGLvtFr3usb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The total distance for a round trip is the sum of all the path lengths you traveled, so going to school and back adds both distances together.
statements.tl: Ang total distance sa isang round trip ay ang kabuuan ng lahat ng haba ng dinaanan mo, kaya ang pagpunta sa paaralan at pagbalik ay pinagsasama ang dalawang distance.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1uUHJpS9WScYgZI-Rq8h_FgGLvtFr3usb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: On a grid where each box is 2 meters, you can count boxes to find distance along a path, but displacement is the straight-line change in position from start to end.
statements.tl: Sa isang grid kung saan ang bawat kahon ay 2 meters, maaari kang magbilang ng mga kahon para malaman ang distance sa isang daan, ngunit ang displacement ay ang tuwid na pagbabago ng posisyon mula simula hanggang dulo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1uUHJpS9WScYgZI-Rq8h_FgGLvtFr3usb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does speed tell us?

Speed tells us exactly how fast an object is moving! Zoom!
statements.tl:
Ano ang sinasabi ng bilis?

Ang bilis ay nagsasabi kung gaano kabilis gumalaw ang isang bagay!

statements.text: Besides speed, the direction of movement also matters to fully describe motion!
statements.tl: Bukod sa speed, mahalaga rin ang direction ng paggalaw para ganap na mailarawan ang motion!

statements.text: Speed only tells how fast something is going, but velocity also includes the direction it is moving!
statements.tl: Ang speed ay nagsasabi lang kung gaano kabilis, pero ang velocity ay kasama ang direksyon kung saan papunta!

statements.text: Velocity is a measure of how fast an object moves and in what direction, so two objects with the same speed can have different velocities.
statements.tl: Ang velocity ay sukat kung gaano kabilis gumalaw ang isang bagay at sa anong direksyon, kaya ang dalawang bagay na may parehong speed ay maaaring magkaiba ang velocity.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-VqHzpF57I5RV_uO9Equuh8kTcgbLAld), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Velocity is the rate of change of displacement with time, so it is a vector quantity that tells you both the speed and the direction of motion.
statements.tl: Ang velocity ay ang rate ng pagbabago ng displacement sa paglipas ng oras, kaya ito ay vector quantity na nagsasabi sa iyo ng speed at direction ng paggalaw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10RceE2-9x2EyYbB-Fx92ZUqPChnxFrIR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do we say a car’s speed is 60 km/h but its velocity is 60 km/h North?

Because speed is a scalar quantity that only tells you how fast, while velocity is a vector quantity that also tells you the direction!
statements.tl:
Bakit sinasabi natin na ang speed ng kotse ay 60 km/h pero ang velocity nito ay 60 km/h North?

Dahil ang speed ay scalar quantity na nagsasabi lang kung gaano kabilis, habang ang velocity ay vector quantity na nagsasabi rin ng direksyon!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10RceE2-9x2EyYbB-Fx92ZUqPChnxFrIR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What does it mean when a car’s velocity is 20 meters per second East?

The car's displacement changes by 20 meters every second, and it is moving toward the East!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin kapag ang velocity ng kotse ay 20 metro bawat segundo papuntang East?

Ang displacement ng kotse ay nagbabago ng 20 metro bawat segundo, at ito ay gumagalaw papuntang East!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10RceE2-9x2EyYbB-Fx92ZUqPChnxFrIR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The velocity vector of an object in circular motion is always tangent to the circular path at the object's position.
statements.tl: Ang velocity vector ng isang bagay sa circular motion ay laging tangent sa pabilog na daan sa kinaroroonan ng bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 114Llmdgozj9TMcZXSSTV7dKE7UfAYt7Q), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Momentum and velocity are vector quantities, which means they have both a size and a direction, so a ball moving left has different momentum from one moving right.
statements.tl: Ang momentum at velocity ay vector quantities, ibig sabihin may sukat at direksyon ang mga ito, kaya ang bolang papunta sa kaliwa ay iba ang momentum sa bolang papunta sa kanan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15f54pBDlTb4wJnKOQdhwGWMdU1qPK_CV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Movement of a tropical cyclone is described by direction and speed in kilometers per hour, like moving west at 20 km/h.
statements.tl: Ang pagkilos ng isang tropical cyclone ay inilalarawan sa pamamagitan ng direksyon at bilis sa kilometers per hour, tulad ng pagkilos pakanluran sa 20 km/h.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MfwJf9_7izidt7mUKajvX7RS6p7F6EHR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Velocity tells you how fast an object is moving and in what direction, like a car going 60 kilometers per hour heading north.
statements.tl: Sinasabi ng velocity kung gaano kabilis gumagalaw ang isang bagay at sa anong direksyon, tulad ng kotse na tumatakbo ng 60 kilometers per hour papuntang hilaga.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Vd009F9Zj5-aFbtA_DBhdj9qKKux5Dkl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Speed is a scalar quantity because it only has magnitude, while velocity is a vector quantity because it has both magnitude and direction.
statements.tl: Ang speed ay isang scalar quantity dahil mayroon lamang itong magnitude, habang ang velocity ay isang vector quantity dahil mayroon itong magnitude at direksyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dIjUPn_3UWveqrb9d-6zoCPhab0cJoCC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How long will a train take to travel 30 miles at 10 miles per hour?

You divide the distance by the speed, so 30 miles divided by 10 miles per hour equals 3 hours.
statements.tl:
Gaano katagal bago makarating ang tren sa 30 milya kung 10 milya bawat oras ang speed nito?

Hinahati mo ang distansya sa speed, kaya 30 milya na hinati sa 10 milya bawat oras ay katumbas ng 3 oras.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dIjUPn_3UWveqrb9d-6zoCPhab0cJoCC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why can two runners have the same speed but different velocities?

Because they might run the same distance in the same time, but in different directions!
statements.tl:
Bakit maaaring magkapareho ang speed ng dalawang mananakbo pero magkaiba ang kanilang velocity?

Dahil maaaring tumakbo sila ng parehong distance sa parehong oras, pero sa magkaibang direksyon!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1gSX5vyR_lJJOrrk2sd3qy9e4jEzgcYxl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: If a football field is 100 meters long and a person runs its length in 20 seconds, their speed is 5 meters per second.
statements.tl: Kung ang football field ay 100 metro ang haba at tinakbo ito ng isang tao sa loob ng 20 segundo, ang speed niya ay 5 meters per second.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hzSMxKqOipB0vQfesN5jhNgpj47hMR89), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do we say a car's velocity is different from its speed?

Because velocity is speed with a direction! A car going 60 km/h north and another going 60 km/h south have the same speed but different velocities.
statements.tl:
Bakit sinasabi nating iba ang velocity ng sasakyan sa speed nito?

Dahil ang velocity ay speed na may direksyon! Ang sasakyang papuntang hilaga sa 60 km/h at ang isa namang papuntang timog sa 60 km/h ay pareho ang speed pero magkaiba ang velocity.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hzSMxKqOipB0vQfesN5jhNgpj47hMR89), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What exactly makes a quantity a vector or a scalar when we are studying motion?

Vectors like velocity, displacement, and force have size and direction. Scalars like speed and distance only have size, with no direction!
statements.tl:
Ano ba ang eksaktong nagiging vector o scalar sa mga dami kapag pinag-aaralan natin ang galaw?

Ang mga vector tulad ng velocity, displacement, at puwersa ay may laki at direksyon. Ang scalars tulad ng bilis at distansya ay may laki lang, walang direksyon!

statements.text: Average speed always has a unit like meters per second (m/s) or kilometers per hour (km/h)! We use km/h for vehicles and m/s for classroom experiments.
statements.tl: Ang average speed ay laging may yunit tulad ng metro kada segundo (m/s) o kilometro kada oras (km/h)! Ginagamit ang km/h para sa sasakyan at m/s para sa eksperimento sa klase.

statements.text: On a distance-time graph, a steeper line means faster motion, while a flat line means the object is standing still!
statements.tl: Sa distance-time graph, ang mas matarik na linya ay mas mabilis na galaw, habang ang patag na linya ay nakatigil ang bagay!

statements.text: Why does a straight line mean constant speed? Because the object adds the same distance every second — equal upward steps mean no curve, just a perfectly straight line!
statements.tl: Bakit tuwid na linya ang constant speed? Dahil pare-pareho ang idinadagdag na layo bawat segundo — pantay na hakbang, walang kurba, perpektong tuwid na linya!

statements.text:
How do you calculate the slope of a line on a motion graph?

Pick two points on the line, subtract their distance values, and divide that by the difference in their time values!
statements.tl:
Paano mo kinakalkula ang slope ng linya sa motion graph?

Pumili ng dalawang punto sa linya, ibawas ang kanilang mga distance value, at hatiin iyon sa pagkakaiba ng kanilang mga time value!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-VqHzpF57I5RV_uO9Equuh8kTcgbLAld), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When the dots on a ticker tape are evenly spaced, the object traveled the same distance in every equal time interval, showing constant velocity.
statements.tl: Kapag ang mga tuldok sa ticker tape ay magkakapantay ang pagitan, ang bagay ay naglakbay ng parehong distansya sa bawat pantay na pagitan ng oras, na nagpapakita ng constant velocity.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-v-t-wzEx7JK-SEVDbo61aSpY5ui8PMl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A line graph is a special science tool that shows trends and changes over a continuous interval, like how far a toy car moves as time passes.
statements.tl: Ang line graph ay isang espesyal na tool sa science na nagpapakita ng trends at pagbabago sa loob ng tuloy-tuloy na panahon, tulad ng layo ng laruang sasakyan habang lumilipas ang oras.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1LvwK7XMmEaaPiZD5Dg3GqAQxpv7J6oRk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a distance-time graph, time is always plotted on the x-axis, the horizontal line, while distance is plotted on the y-axis, the vertical line.
statements.tl: Sa distance-time graph, ang oras ay laging naka-plot sa x-axis, ang pahalang na linya, habang ang distansya ay naka-plot sa y-axis, ang patayong linya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1LvwK7XMmEaaPiZD5Dg3GqAQxpv7J6oRk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The title of a line graph describes what the graph is about, like "Distance vs. Time for a Moving Car," so anyone can understand it quickly.
statements.tl: Ang title ng line graph ay naglalarawan kung tungkol saan ang graph, tulad ng "Distance vs. Time para sa Gumagalaw na Sasakyan," para mabilis itong maintindihan ng sinuman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1LvwK7XMmEaaPiZD5Dg3GqAQxpv7J6oRk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The slope of a distance-time graph represents the speed of the object, because it shows how much distance changes for each unit of time.
statements.tl: Ang slope ng distance-time graph ay kumakatawan sa speed ng bagay, dahil ipinapakita nito kung gaano kalaki ang pagbabago ng distansya sa bawat yunit ng oras.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_Ga_ba-80mDInK-PW9dmrgOsRVxebwh6), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A ticker tape timer makes dots on a paper tape at regular time intervals, and the distance between the dots can show if an object is moving at a constant speed.
statements.tl: Ang ticker tape timer ay gumagawa ng mga tuldok sa isang paper tape sa regular na pagitan ng oras, at ang distansya sa pagitan ng mga tuldok ay makakapagpakita kung ang isang bagay ay gumagalaw sa constant na bilis.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_S4sbf1W4kZiIFOrg6lviN3HDQ91Ushk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: On a distance-time graph, the slope shows your average speed! A steeper line means you're going faster, while a flat line means you've stopped moving.
statements.tl: Sa isang distance-time graph, ang slope ang nagpapakita ng average speed! Mas matarik na linya, mas mabilis ka. Patag na linya naman, ibig sabihin ay nakatigil ka!

statements.text: To get speed from a distance-time graph, divide the line's rise (distance) by its sideways run (time). That ratio is the slope, which is exactly the speed!
statements.tl: Para makuha ang speed sa distance-time graph, hatiin ang taas na naabot ng linya (distance) sa lapad na natakbo nito (time). Ang ratio na iyon ay ang slope, na siyang speed!

statements.text: A downward line on a graph of distance from the start against time doesn't mean time goes backward! It means the object is getting closer to its start, so its distance from the starting point gets smaller.
statements.tl: Ang pababang linya sa grap ng distansya mula sa simula kaugnay ng oras ay hindi ibig sabihin na bumabalik ang oras! Papalapit ang bagay sa pinanggalingan, kaya lumiliit ang distansya nito mula roon.

statements.text:
Why can't a graph line go left?

On a distance-time graph, time on the horizontal axis always moves forward! It never goes back, so lines can never go left—time always flows right.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi pwedeng pumunta sa kaliwa ang linya sa graph?

Sa distance-time graph, ang oras sa horizontal axis ay palaging gumagalaw pasulong! Hindi ito bumabalik, kaya hindi pwedeng pumunta sa kaliwa ang linya—laging sa kanan.

statements.text: Distance-time and speed-time graphs are different! In distance-time, height is distance and slope is speed. In speed-time, height is speed, and a flat line means constant speed!
statements.tl: Magkaiba ang distance-time at speed-time graphs! Sa distance-time, ang taas ay layo at slope ang bilis. Sa speed-time, ang taas mismo ang bilis, at patag na linya ay constant speed!

statements.text: Think highest means fastest on a distance-time graph? Nope! Speed comes from the STEEPNESS of the line, not height. A high but flat line means you actually stopped!
statements.tl: Akala mo pinakamataas ay pinakamabilis sa distance-time graph? Hindi! Ang bilis ay nasa TARIK ng linya, hindi sa taas. Mataas pero patag na linya? Ibig sabihin, nakatigil ka na!

statements.text:
Why does a distance-time graph usually start at the origin?

Because at the very start, zero time has passed and the object hasn't traveled anywhere yet! The clock has just begun ticking.
statements.tl:
Bakit karaniwang nagsisimula ang distance-time graph sa origin?

Dahil sa simula pa lang, zero oras pa lang at wala pang nilalakbay ang bagay! Sisimula pa lang ng takda ng oras.

statements.text:
Can a perfectly vertical line exist on a distance-time graph?

No! That would mean jumping a distance in zero time. That means infinite speed, which is totally impossible in real life!
statements.tl:
Puwedeng magkaroon ng perpektong patindig na linya sa distance-time graph?

Hindi! Ibig sabihin niyon ay lumayo nang walang oras na lumipas. Walang-hangganang bilis iyon, na imposible sa totoong buhay!

statements.text: Want the average speed of a whole trip on a total distance-time graph? Just draw a straight line from the first point to the last point! The slope of that line is your average speed.
statements.tl: Gusto mo ng average speed ng buong biyahe sa graph ng kabuuang layo at oras? Iguhit mo lang ang tuwid na linya mula sa unang punto hanggang sa huli! Ang slope ng linyang iyon ang average speed.

statements.text: In fertilization, a sex cell from the female (the egg) joins with a sex cell from the male (the sperm) to form a single new cell.
statements.tl: Sa fertilization, nagsasanib ang sex cell mula sa babae (egg) at sex cell mula sa lalaki (sperm) para bumuo ng isang bagong selula.
