statements.text: During meiosis, chromosomes can swap sections with each other, mixing genes into new combinations and creating more genetic variety.
statements.tl: Sa meiosis, minsang nagpapalitan ng bahagi ang mga chromosome, kaya nabubuo ang bagong kombinasyon ng genes at mas maraming pagkakaiba-iba.

statements.text: Half of your chromosomes come from your mother, and the other half come from your father.
statements.tl: Kalahati ng iyong mga chromosome ay mula sa iyong ina, at kalahati naman ay mula sa iyong ama.

statements.text: An embryo is the earliest stage of a developing baby, formed right after a sperm and an egg unite during fertilization.
statements.tl: Ang embryo ay ang pinakaunang yugto ng lumalaking baby, na nabubuo pagkatapos magsama ang sperm at egg sa fertilization.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15AqVEWHjsIEDP6blInIpWJ9Kib-FgU8k), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Diploid organisms, like humans, have two alleles at each genetic locus, one inherited from the mother and one from the father.
statements.tl: Ang mga diploid organism, tulad ng tao, ay may dalawang alleles sa bawat genetic locus, isa mula sa ina at isa mula sa ama.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16DvTOACFxsb4TUvvlzSyNOKbdCeAiMbx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why are gametes haploid instead of diploid?

So that when a sperm and egg fuse during fertilization, the offspring gets the correct full set of 46 chromosomes, not double.
statements.tl:
Bakit haploid ang gametes sa halip na diploid?

Para kapag nagsama ang sperm at egg sa fertilization, makukuha ng anak ang tamang buong set ng 46 chromosomes, hindi doble.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17aVmKg3nvJlvgDxJLfUfayrpBb_u6d0q), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does a baby get back the full set of chromosomes?

When the sperm and egg join during fertilization, their 23 chromosomes each add up to 46 in the new zygote!
statements.tl:
Paano nakukuha ng baby ang buong set ng chromosomes?

Kapag nagsama ang sperm at egg sa fertilization, ang 23 chromosomes ng bawat isa ay nagiging 46 sa bagong zygote!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ZNSEtEe3ihwQZtOQQxkMm35kVTwKsljU), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Meiosis is important for sexual reproduction because it produces gametes, and fertilization restores the diploid chromosome number in the zygote.
statements.tl: Mahalaga ang meiosis para sa sexual reproduction dahil gumagawa ito ng gametes, at ibinabalik ng fertilization ang diploid chromosome number sa zygote.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_W6gIaE8Zij9DTNPVFgBJtJAR1nWLPtR), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does a baby get the right number of chromosomes?

A haploid sperm with 23 chromosomes joins a haploid egg with 23 chromosomes, making a diploid cell with 46 chromosomes!
statements.tl:
Paano nakukuha ng isang sanggol ang tamang bilang ng chromosomes?

Ang haploid sperm na may 23 chromosomes ay sumasama sa haploid egg na may 23 chromosomes, na bumubuo ng diploid cell na may 46 chromosomes!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1acsPCUic_8irwFNoEHN_ieFjGV1FiiZS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Fertilization happens when a sperm cell from a pollen grain fuses with an egg cell inside an ovule, creating the very first cell of a new plant.
statements.tl: Ang fertilization ay nangyayari kapag ang sperm cell mula sa pollen grain ay nagsanib sa egg cell sa loob ng ovule, na lumilikha ng pinakaunang cell ng bagong halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1dCuqCT9lLxiXcuVYVzIhEbSIJnLZNI3c), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The fallopian tube is the usual place where the egg cell unites with the sperm cell during fertilization.
statements.tl: Ang fallopian tube ay ang karaniwang lugar kung saan nagsasama ang egg cell at sperm cell sa panahon ng fertilization.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ebwgXvtSrpE9rJs-5AoPXfcgOHpmkTxm), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What happens when a sperm meets an egg?

They fuse together! This joining is called fertilization, and it forms the very first cell of a new organism.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag nagtagpo ang sperm at egg?

Nagsasama sila! Ang pagsasanib na ito ay tinatawag na fertilization, at ito ang bumubuo ng pinakaunang cell ng bagong organismo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jTdI-_7BqFvhHWYseOQPbsLhKvnta98Q), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When a sperm and egg fuse during fertilization, they form a zygote, the first cell of a new organism with genetic material from both parents.
statements.tl: Kapag nagsama ang sperm at egg sa fertilization, bumubuo sila ng zygote, ang unang cell ng bagong organismo na may genetic material mula sa parehong magulang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1jTdI-_7BqFvhHWYseOQPbsLhKvnta98Q), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is meiosis for?

Meiosis is a special cell division that produces sex cells, or gametes, like sperm and egg cells.
statements.tl:
Para saan ang meiosis?

Ang meiosis ay espesyal na paghahati ng selula na gumagawa ng sex cell o gamete tulad ng sperm at egg.

statements.text:
Why do identical twins look so alike?

Identical twins have almost the same DNA because they came from a single fertilized egg that split into two!
statements.tl:
Bakit magkamukha ang identical twins?

May halos parehong DNA ang identical twins dahil nagmula sila sa iisang fertilized egg na naghati!

statements.text:
Why isn't a child an exact copy of a parent?

Offspring look like their parents but are never exact copies — they get a mix of genes from both parents, making a combination unique to them.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi eksaktong kopya ng magulang ang anak?

Kahawig ng magulang ang anak pero hindi eksaktong kopya — nakukuha nito ang halo ng mga gene mula sa dalawang magulang, na gumagawa ng natatanging kombinasyon.

statements.text: When sex cells form, the two alleles separate so that only one gets passed on to the next generation.
statements.tl: Kapag bumubuo ng mga selula para sa pagpaparami, naghihiwalay ang dalawang alelo para isa lang ang maipasa sa susunod na henerasyon.

statements.text: When egg and sperm unite, the new cell ends up with two of each chromosome — one from the mother and one from the father.
statements.tl: Kapag nagsanib ang egg at sperm, ang bagong selula ay magkakaroon ng dalawang kopya ng bawat chromosome — isa mula sa ina at isa mula sa ama.

statements.text:
How do bacteria multiply so fast?

Bacteria reproduce by binary fission — one cell splits into two identical cells — letting their numbers grow incredibly quickly.
statements.tl:
Paano mabilis dumami ang bacteria?

Nagpaparami ang bacteria sa pamamagitan ng binary fission — naghahati ang isang selula sa dalawang magkapareho — kaya napakabilis nilang dumami.

statements.text: In sexual reproduction, two parents each contribute genes, so their offspring carries a mix of traits from both.
statements.tl: Sa sexual na pagpaparami, dalawang magulang ang nag-aambag ng kanilang genes, kaya ang anak ay may halong katangian mula sa pareho.

statements.text: Tissue culture grows plants in the lab — a tiny plant piece is placed in special nutrient gel to produce many identical copies.
statements.tl: Sa tissue culture, isang maliit na piraso ng halaman ay inilalagay sa espesyal na nutrient gel para makagawa ng maraming magkaparehong halaman sa laboratoryo.

statements.text: Mosquitoes reproduce sexually, not asexually, meaning they need two parents to produce offspring.
statements.tl: Ang mga lamok ay nagpaparami sa paraang sexual, hindi asexual, ibig sabihin kailangan nila ng dalawang magulang para magkaanak.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 13HSHMmXFqGJ7zTvEXHAUKzDInsPcxoOH), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Asexual reproduction usually produces little genetic variation, but it allows reproduction without depending on finding a mate.
statements.tl: Ang asexual reproduction ay karaniwang nagdudulot ng kaunting genetic variation, ngunit nagpapahintulot ng pagpaparami nang hindi umaasa sa paghahanap ng kapareha.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GQmxhExnxB89Wkrpnkrp62rlrE5sw8Gc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Fragmentation is the breaking of the body into two parts with subsequent regeneration, and if the animal is capable of fragmentation and the part is big enough, a separate individual will regrow.
statements.tl: Ang fragmentation ay ang pagkaputol ng katawan sa dalawang bahagi na may kasunod na regeneration, at kung kaya ng hayop ang fragmentation at sapat ang laki ng bahagi, isang hiwalay na indibidwal ang muling tutubo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1GQmxhExnxB89Wkrpnkrp62rlrE5sw8Gc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Butterflies reproduce sexually, meaning a male and a female butterfly must unite their sex cells to create a new butterfly.
statements.tl: Ang mga butterflies ay nagpaparami sa sekswal na paraan, ibig sabihin ang isang lalaki at isang babaeng butterfly ay dapat magsama ng kanilang sex cells para makalikha ng bagong butterfly.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VfKfAe5sIyDdyQEhkjEy4ACC8ySm7dFH), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Sea anemones, sea stars, and hydra are examples of animals that reproduce asexually, creating identical copies of themselves from a single parent.
statements.tl: Ang mga sea anemones, sea stars, at hydra ay mga halimbawa ng mga hayop na nagpaparami sa asekswal na paraan, na gumagawa ng mga kaparehong kopya ng kanilang sarili mula sa isang magulang lamang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VfKfAe5sIyDdyQEhkjEy4ACC8ySm7dFH), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Runners are stems that grow along the ground from the parent plant, and strawberry and ferns use them to make new plants.
statements.tl: Ang runners ay mga stem na gumagapang sa lupa mula sa parent plant, at ginagamit ito ng strawberry at ferns para makagawa ng bagong halaman.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1c4-mRHviyTmr7YWOsWozdOmZHgC20gB6), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Asexual reproduction involves only one parent plant, so the new plant is genetically identical to its single parent.
statements.tl: Ang asexual reproduction ay gumagamit lamang ng isang parent plant, kaya ang bagong halaman ay genetically identical sa nag-iisang magulang nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-16282), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Asexual reproduction is fast and needs no partner — but sexual reproduction mixes genes, giving offspring the variety they need to adapt to a changing world.
statements.tl: Mabilis ang asexual reproduction at hindi kailangan ng kapareha — pero ang sexual reproduction ay naghahalo ng genes, na tumutulong sa mga anak na mag-adapt sa pagbabago ng kapaligiran.

statements.text: Asexual reproduction is fast and needs no partner, but the offspring are almost identical since there's little variation.
statements.tl: Ang asexual na pagpaparami ay mabilis at hindi nangangailangan ng kapareha, pero halos magkakapareho ang mga anak dahil kaunti ang pagkakaiba.

statements.text:
Why do siblings look different from each other?

In sexual reproduction, genes from two parents mix in new ways each time — so children of the same parents can look different, even from their own siblings!
statements.tl:
Bakit magkaiba ang itsura ng magkapatid?

Sa sexual reproduction, naghahalo ang mga gene ng dalawang magulang sa bagong kombinasyon tuwing may anak — kaya magkaiba-iba ang mga anak ng iisang mag-asawa, kahit magkapatid sila!
statements.source: AAAS Benchmarks 5B/H2 (sorting and recombination of genes gives great variety in offspring)

statements.text:
How do bacteria multiply so fast?

Bacteria multiply by splitting in two! One grows bigger, copies its insides, then splits into two — then two become four, four become eight, and so on.
statements.tl:
Paano bumibilis dumami ang bacteria?

Dumarami ang bacteria sa pamamagitan ng paghahati sa dalawa! Lumalaki muna ito, kinokopya ang loob nito, tapos nahahati, ang dalawa nagiging apat, ang apat naging walo, at iba pa.

statements.text: Fungi make more of themselves using tiny spores, which drift on the wind like dust to reach new places.
statements.tl: Dumarami ang fungi gamit ang maliliit na spore na parang alikabok na tinatangay ng hangin papunta sa bagong lugar.

statements.text:
Can stick insects have babies without a mate?

Yes! Many female stick insects lay unfertilized eggs that hatch into female clones — no male needed at all.
statements.tl:
Puwede bang manganak ang stick insect nang walang kapareha?

Oo! Maraming babaeng stick insect ang naglalagay ng itlog na walang binhi mula sa lalaki, at napipisa pa rin ito bilang klonang babae.

statements.text:
What is budding in living things?

A tiny outgrowth forms on a parent like yeast or hydra — and over time, it grows into a whole new individual!
statements.tl:
Ano ang budding sa mga buhay na bagay?

May maliit na usbong na tumutubo sa magulang tulad ng yeast o hydra — at unti-unti, ito ay nagiging isang bagong indibidwal!

statements.text:
What's risky about cloned crops?

Plants grown from cuttings or grafting are all identical — so if one catches a disease, the rest catch it easily too, since they have no genetic variation!
statements.tl:
Bakit mapanganib ang cloning ng halaman?

Magkakapareho ang mga halamang galing sa cutting o grafting — kaya kung matablan ng sakit ang isa, madaling matatablan din ang lahat, dahil wala silang pagkakaiba-iba!

statements.text: The biosphere is the largest level of biological organization, and it is the sum of all ecosystems on Earth where life exists.
statements.tl: Ang biosphere ang pinakamalaking level ng biological organization, at ito ang kabuuan ng lahat ng ecosystems sa Earth kung saan may buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zeZhWlYZSGxjtBm4hlSZOlc5LKOIsmsr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Similar cells team up to form tissues, and tissues team up to build your organs.
statements.tl: Nagsasama-sama ang magkakatulad na selula para bumuo ng tisyu, at ang mga tisyu naman ay bumubuo ng mga organo.

statements.text: Similar cells group together to form tissues, and tissues build up into organs and body systems.
statements.tl: Ang magkakatulad na selula ay nagsasama-sama para bumuo ng tisyu, na bumubuo naman ng mga organo at sistema ng katawan.

statements.text: In your body, muscle cells join to make muscle tissue, which builds the heart organ — all part of your circulatory system!
statements.tl: Sa katawan mo, ang muscle cells ay nagtutulungan para gumawa ng muscle tissue, na bumubuo sa puso — lahat bahagi ng circulatory system mo!

statements.text: A population is just one species, like all Nile tilapia in a lake. A community includes many species, like tilapia, snails, and algae together!
statements.tl: Ang population ay isang species lang, tulad ng lahat ng Nile tilapia sa lawa. Ang community ay maraming species, tulad ng tilapia, snails, at algae!

statements.text:
What do arrows from cell to biosphere show in a labelled diagram?

They show that each higher level is made up of the smaller levels right below it!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ipinapakita ng arrows mula cell hanggang biosphere sa isang labelled diagram?

Ipinapakita nito na ang bawat mas mataas na level ay gawa sa mga level na nasa ilalim nito.

statements.text: Complex multicellular living things are organized from smallest to largest: cells form tissues, tissues form organs, organs form organ systems, and organ systems form an organism.
statements.tl: Ang mga komplikadong organismong maraming selula ay nakaayos mula sa pinakamaliit hanggang sa pinakamalaki: ang mga cells ay bumubuo ng tissues, ang tissues ay bumubuo ng organs, ang organs ay bumubuo ng organ systems, at ang organ systems ay bumubuo ng isang organism.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-jkIyOW3x1iJKEt7w4KULAfIIS1KR7FO), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The correct sequence from most basic to most complex is cells, tissues, organs, organ systems, and then the whole organism.
statements.tl: Ang tamang pagkakasunod-sunod mula sa pinakasimple hanggang sa pinakakumplikado ay cells, tissues, organs, organ systems, at pagkatapos ay ang buong organism.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-jkIyOW3x1iJKEt7w4KULAfIIS1KR7FO), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A population is a group of individuals of the same species living in the same area at the same time, like all the carabaos in one field.
statements.tl: Ang population ay grupo ng mga indibidwal na kabilang sa iisang species na naninirahan sa parehong lugar at oras, tulad ng lahat ng kalabaw sa isang bukid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17pRCRb7sVjySGKba39tFdhJGX9UdpEGE), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Population distribution describes how individuals are spread across an area, whether evenly spaced, clumped together, or random.
statements.tl: Ang population distribution ay naglalarawan kung paano nakakalat ang mga indibidwal sa isang lugar, pantay-pantay man, magkakasama, o random.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1A9P_vizXg_O7DWIA9Iy0aZZ9cbqj2puD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Is my heart an organ or an organ system?

It is an organ! The heart is one organ that belongs to the circulatory system, which also includes veins and arteries.
statements.tl:
Ang puso ko ba ay isang organ o isang organ system?

Ito ay isang organ! Ang puso ay isang organ na kabilang sa circulatory system, na kasama rin ang veins at arteries.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Hnb8qC0L-yXHUgaqazRaZxNN1eoui6sP), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why is a group of similar cells called a tissue?

The word tissue comes from a Latin word meaning to weave, because cells that make up tissues are sometimes woven together like threads.
statements.tl:
Bakit tinatawag na tissue ang grupo ng magkakaparehong cells?

Ang salitang tissue ay galing sa salitang Latin na ibig sabihin ay maghabi, dahil ang mga cells na bumubuo ng tissues ay minsan parang hinahabi na parang mga sinulid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IIMDuf3ISQ9muKYz6uRY8xIFEwEipbvB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Life begins with a cell, and when cells group together they form tissues, then organs, and finally organ systems.
statements.tl: Nagsisimula ang buhay sa isang cell, at kapag nagsama-sama ang mga cell, bumubuo sila ng tissues, pagkatapos organs, at sa huli organ systems.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1LjE7J1arKizDqj78MFr_wHCkV96NzvI6), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Biological organization is like a ladder of life, arranged from the smallest parts—subatomic particles—up to the largest, the biosphere, which is all of Earth where life exists.
statements.tl: Ang biological organization ay parang hagdan ng buhay, mula sa pinakamaliit na bahagi—subatomic particles—hanggang sa pinakamalaki, ang biosphere, na buong mundo kung saan may buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_EtP8HytXKZBF-b7gyIZACRQqCSSv9tS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A community is all the different species living and interacting in one area, like the frogs, insects, birds, and plants that share a pond.
statements.tl: Ang community ay lahat ng iba't ibang species na naninirahan at nakikipag-ugnayan sa isang lugar, tulad ng mga palaka, insekto, ibon, at halaman na magkakasama sa isang lawa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_EtP8HytXKZBF-b7gyIZACRQqCSSv9tS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Biomes are very large areas with similar climate and life, like deserts or rainforests, and the biosphere is the biggest level of all—every biome on Earth where life exists.
statements.tl: Ang biomes ay napakalalaking lugar na may magkakatulad na klima at buhay, tulad ng disyerto o rainforest, at ang biosphere ang pinakamalaking level sa lahat—bawat biome sa mundo kung saan may buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1_EtP8HytXKZBF-b7gyIZACRQqCSSv9tS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do some places feel crowded with animals while others look empty?

It depends on population density — the number of individuals of a species living in each unit of area.
statements.tl:
Bakit parang siksikan ang mga hayop sa ibang lugar habang ang iba naman ay parang walang laman?

Depende ito sa population density — ang bilang ng mga indibidwal ng isang species na nakatira sa bawat unit ng area.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1bmb-qmRVtMuetCuFvMwyJlSymZfXg9D6), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Biological organization arranges living things from the simplest parts, like tiny molecules, to the most complex, like the entire biosphere, so scientists can study life step by step.
statements.tl: Inaayos ng biological organization ang mga bagay na may buhay mula sa pinakasimpleng bahagi, tulad ng maliliit na molecule, hanggang sa pinakakomplikado, tulad ng buong biosphere, para mapag-aralan ng mga scientist ang buhay nang hakbang-hakbang.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1n_na2R8mjL1ylpfiUIZ6jsZCWh7I-bH5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Aquatic ecosystems also have energy pyramids, with phytoplankton as producers at the bottom and larger fish as consumers at higher levels.
statements.tl: Ang mga aquatic ecosystem ay mayroon ding energy pyramid, kung saan ang phytoplankton ang mga producer sa ilalim at ang mas malalaking isda ang mga consumer sa mas mataas na level.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1OOypi6eGTfKOdHeU-cjaRCh8A1ImLr0e), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why is an energy pyramid pyramid-shaped?

An energy pyramid is wide at the bottom, where producers are, and narrow at the top, because energy is lost at each level of the food chain.
statements.tl:
Bakit hugis-piramide ang energy pyramid?

Ang energy pyramid ay malapad sa ibaba kung saan naroon ang mga producers, at makitid sa itaas dahil nawawalan ng enerhiya sa bawat antas ng food chain.

statements.text: In a Philippine rice field, palay is the producer! Rats eat the palay, and snakes eat the rats, forming a three-level food pyramid.
statements.tl: Sa isang palayan sa Pilipinas, ang palay ang producer! Kinakain ng mga daga ang palay, at kinakain ng mga ahas ang mga daga, na bumubuo ng food pyramid na may tatlong antas.

statements.text: Terrestrial ecosystems have energy pyramids too, with grasses and trees as producers at the bottom and predators like eagles at the top.
statements.tl: Ang mga terrestrial ecosystem ay may energy pyramid din, kung saan ang mga damo at puno ang mga producer sa ilalim at ang mga predator tulad ng agila ang nasa tuktok.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1OOypi6eGTfKOdHeU-cjaRCh8A1ImLr0e), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Biomass is the total mass of organic molecules minus water in an organism, and it usually decreases at higher trophic levels in terrestrial ecosystems.
statements.tl: Ang biomass ay ang kabuuang mass ng organic molecules minus water sa isang organismo, at karaniwang nababawasan ito sa mas matataas na trophic level sa mga terrestrial ecosystem.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1QY-fwPsIBtYV15fzaE64LQe3tDjnyLD4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why are Philippine Eagles so rare?

The Philippine Eagle sits at the very top of the food pyramid, so there are very few of them — one family needs a whole big forest just to survive!
statements.tl:
Bakit kakaunti ang Agila ng Pilipinas?

Ang Agila ng Pilipinas ay nasa tuktok ng food pyramid kaya napakakaunti nito — kailangan ng isang malaking gubat para mabuhay ang isang pamilya nito!
statements.source: Philippine Eagle apex predator; PH-native; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
Why is most food chain energy lost?

At each step in a food chain, only about 10% of the energy passes to the next level — the rest fuels life processes, leaves as waste, or is released as heat!
statements.tl:
Bakit karamihan ng enerhiya sa food chain nawawala?

Sa bawat hakbang ng food chain, mga 10% lamang ng enerhiya ang napupunta sa susunod na antas — ang natitira ay ginagamit sa mga proseso ng buhay, naiiwan sa dumi, o nailalabas bilang init!

statements.text:
Why is there no predator above the top predator?

Almost nothing eats the topmost predator — there's simply too little energy left over to support yet another level in the food chain.
statements.tl:
Bakit walang kumakain sa pinakamataas na mandaragit?

Halos walang hayop na kumakain sa pinakamataas na mandaragit — dahil kulang na ang enerhiyang matitira para sa isa pang antas.
statements.source: energy limit on chain length; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: In the ocean, tiny plankton form the huge base of the food pyramid, while sharks at the very top are far fewer in number.
statements.tl: Sa dagat, ang maliliit na plankton ang malaking pundasyon ng food pyramid, habang ang mga pating sa tuktok ay kakaunti lang.

statements.text:
Why is the energy pyramid wide at the bottom?

Because less and less energy is available at each higher level — that's why it's wide at the bottom and narrow at the top!
statements.tl:
Bakit malapad sa ibaba ang pyramid ng enerhiya?

Dahil paunti nang paunti ang enerhiya habang paakyat sa bawat antas — kaya malapad ito sa ibaba at makitid sa itaas!

statements.text:
Why is the top of an energy pyramid always smallest?

It shows the energy available at each level — less energy reaches higher levels, so the top level is smallest!
statements.tl:
Bakit laging pinakamaliit ang tuktok ng energy pyramid?

Ipinapakita nito ang enerhiyang magagamit sa bawat antas — mas kaunti ang umaabot sa mas mataas na antas, kaya pinakamaliit ang tuktok!

statements.text: There are so many plants at the base of the food pyramid because they're the starting source of energy for the consumers above them.
statements.tl: Napakarami ng halaman sa ilalim ng food pyramid dahil sila ang nagsisimulang bukal ng enerhiya para sa mga consumer sa itaas nila.

statements.text: Energy doesn't get recycled back through the food pyramid -- fresh energy from the sun must keep arriving.
statements.tl: Hindi na-uulit o nababalik ang enerhiya sa food pyramid -- kailangang laging may bagong enerhiya na dumarating mula sa araw.
statements.source: energy not recycled vs matter; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
Why are there so few big predators?

Only a little energy is left at the top of the food pyramid, so there's barely enough to support large predators — that's why there are so few!
statements.tl:
Bakit kakaunti ang malalaking mandaragit?

Maliit na lang ang enerhiyang naiiwan sa tuktok ng pyramid, kaya kakaunti lang ang malalaking mandaragit na masusuportahan nito!
statements.source: energy flow limits predator numbers; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
What is a trophic level?

A trophic level is one feeding step in a food chain, like a producer, herbivore, or carnivore. Each step holds a different amount of energy!
statements.tl:
Ano ang trophic level?

Ang trophic level ay isang feeding step sa isang food chain, tulad ng producer, herbivore, o carnivore. Bawat step ay may magkaibang dami ng energy!

statements.text: Most food pyramids have only four or five trophic levels. This is because the energy left after each step is too small to support another level!
statements.tl: Karamihan ng food pyramid ay may apat o limang trophic levels lang. Ito ay dahil ang natitirang energy pagkatapos ng bawat step ay napakaliit na para suportahan ang isa pang level!

statements.text: When energy is lost as heat in a food pyramid, it is not destroyed! However, it becomes completely unusable for the next trophic level.
statements.tl: Kapag ang energy ay nawala bilang init sa food pyramid, hindi ito nasisira! Pero, hindi na ito magagamit para sa susunod na trophic level.

statements.text: Only about 10% of the energy at one feeding level passes to the next; the rest is used up for breathing and moving, or lost as heat.
statements.tl: Tinatayang 10% lamang ng enerhiya sa isang antas ng pagkain ang naipapasa sa susunod; ang iba ay nagagamit sa paghinga at galaw, o nawawala bilang init.
statements.source: NRC LS2.B (small fraction transferred); consensus 10% rule

statements.text: Small schooling fish eat plankton, and in turn they get eaten by bigger fish like tuna.
statements.tl: Ang maliliit na isdang nagkakawan ay kumakain ng plankton, at sila naman ang kinakain ng malalaking isda gaya ng tuna.

statements.text: At each step of a food chain, a lot of energy is lost as heat — so less and less gets passed on to the next animal.
statements.tl: Sa bawat hakbang ng food chain, marami sa enerhiya ang nawawala bilang init — kaya kakaunti na lang ang naipapasa sa susunod.

statements.text: Energy flows in only one direction along a food chain — from plants to the animals that eat them.
statements.tl: Ang enerhiya ay dumadaloy sa isang direksyon lamang sa kadena ng pagkain — mula sa halaman patungo sa mga hayop na kumakain nito.

statements.text:
Why are there so few top predators?

Less and less energy reaches each higher level of a food chain, so only a few big predators can be supported at the very top.
statements.tl:
Bakit kakaunti ang mga nangungunang mandaragit?

Paunti nang paunti ang enerhiyang umaabot sa bawat mas mataas na antas, kaya kakaunti lamang na malalaking mandaragit ang kayang suportahan sa tuktok ng food chain.
statements.source: NRC LS2.B (grade 12: fewer organisms at higher levels)

statements.text: In the forest, fruit bats eat fruit from trees, and a python may eat the bat — showing how energy flows along a food chain.
statements.tl: Sa gubat, kinakain ng paniking kumakain ng prutas ang prutas ng puno, at ang paniki naman ay maaaring kainin ng sawa — nagpapakita ito kung paano dumadaloy ang enerhiya sa food chain.

statements.text:
Why can a food chain support only limited numbers of large predators?

Less energy reaches each higher feeding level because organisms use energy and release heat. This limits the energy available to predators. An energy pyramid shows energy, not a rule that every level has fewer organisms.
statements.tl:
Bakit limitado ang kayang suportahang malalaking predator ng isang food chain?

Mas kaunting enerhiya ang nakakarating sa bawat mas mataas na antas dahil gumagamit ng enerhiya at naglalabas ng init ang mga organismo. Nililimitahan nito ang enerhiya para sa mga predator. Enerhiya ang ipinapakita ng energy pyramid, hindi ang bilang ng mga organismo.

statements.text: As you move up a food chain, the total amount of available energy decreases because only a fraction of energy transfers from one trophic level to the next.
statements.tl: Habang umaakyat ka sa isang food chain, ang kabuuang dami ng available na energy ay bumababa dahil maliit na bahagi lamang ng energy ang lumilipat mula sa isang trophic level papunta sa susunod.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JMcpS_i4X3TpDO4BEX-msBYyYxZm8Mvn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Energy is lost at each trophic level because organisms use much of it for their own functions and some is lost as heat.
statements.tl: Nawawalan ng energy sa bawat trophic level dahil ginagamit ng mga organismo ang malaking bahagi nito para sa sarili nilang mga gawain at ang iba ay nawawala bilang init.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1QY-fwPsIBtYV15fzaE64LQe3tDjnyLD4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Zooplankton eat phytoplankton, and they in turn get eaten by bigger ocean animals.
statements.tl: Kumakain ang zooplankton ng phytoplankton, at sila naman ang kinakain ng mas malalaking hayop sa dagat.

statements.text: The maya is a small brown bird you'll spot around houses and fields all over the Philippines — it loves eating grains and seeds like rice.
statements.tl: Ang maya ay maliit at kayumangging ibon na madalas makita sa mga bahay at bukid sa Pilipinas — kumakain ito ng mga butil at buto tulad ng palay.

statements.text: In an ecosystem, matter like carbon cycles round and round, but energy flows only one way and slowly turns into heat.
statements.tl: Sa ecosystem, ang materya tulad ng carbon ay paulit-ulit na umiikot, pero ang enerhiya ay dumadaloy lang nang minsan at unti-unting nawawala bilang init.

statements.text:
Why is it called a food 'chain'?

In a food chain, energy passes along each time something is eaten — from plant, to the animal that ate it, to the next animal. That's why it's a 'chain' — the links join together!
statements.tl:
Bakit tinatawag itong food 'chain'?

Sa food chain, lumilipat ang enerhiya tuwing may kumakain: mula sa halaman, patungo sa hayop na kumain nito, saka sa susunod na hayop. Kaya nga 'chain' — magkakadugtong parang kadena!

statements.text: Goats are pickier than people think — they like fresh, clean grass and often refuse grass that's been stepped on or is dirty.
statements.tl: Mas mapili ang kambing kaysa sa karaniwang akala — gusto nito ng sariwa at malinis na damo, at madalas itong tumatanggi sa damong natapakan na o marumi.

statements.text: Only about 10% of the energy at one feeding level passes to the next; the rest is used up for breathing and moving, or lost as heat.
statements.tl: Tinatayang 10% lamang ng enerhiya sa isang antas ng pagkain ang naipapasa sa susunod; ang iba ay nagagamit sa paghinga at galaw, o nawawala bilang init.
statements.source: NRC LS2.B (small fraction transferred); consensus 10% rule

statements.text:
Do plants eat like people do?

No! Plants make their own food through a process called photosynthesis, instead of eating like people do.
statements.tl:
Kumakain ba ang halaman tulad ng tao?

Hindi! Gumagawa ang mga halaman ng sarili nilang pagkain sa pamamagitan ng proseso na tinatawag na photosynthesis.
statements.source: NRC LS1.C; AAAS BSL Ch.5E; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: Even carnivores depend on plants for energy — they eat herbivores that ate plants, so almost all animal energy traces back to the sun through plants.
statements.tl: Kahit ang carnivore ay umaasa sa halaman para sa enerhiya — kinakain nila ang herbivore na kumain ng halaman, kaya halos lahat ng enerhiya ng hayop ay nagmula sa araw sa pamamagitan ng halaman.
statements.source: NRC LS2.B; AAAS BSL Ch.5; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
Where does all our food's energy come from?

Almost all food traces back to plants — and the energy in it first came from sunlight, captured through photosynthesis.
statements.tl:
Saan nanggagaling ang enerhiya ng ating pagkain?

Halos lahat ng pagkain ay nagmumula sa mga halaman — at ang enerhiya nito ay unang galing sa liwanag ng araw, nakuha sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis.
statements.source: NRC LS2.B (energy ultimately from sun); AAAS 5E

statements.text:
Where does almost every food chain start?

With the Sun. Plants use its light to make food, so the Sun is the first source of energy in the chain.
statements.tl:
Saan nagsisimula ang halos lahat ng food chain?

Sa araw. Ginagamit ng mga halaman ang liwanag ng araw para gumawa ng pagkain, kaya ang araw ang unang pinagmulan ng enerhiya.
statements.source: NRC LS2.B; AAAS BSL Ch.5; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: When you suck on a straw, you lower the air pressure inside it, so air pressure pushes your drink up!
statements.tl: Kapag sumipsip ka sa straw, pinabababa mo ang presyon sa loob nito, kaya itinutulak ng presyon ng hangin ang inumin pataas!

statements.text: The gravity of Earth pulls on the Moon, keeping it safely circling around our planet!
statements.tl: Ang grabidad ng Daigdig ang humihila sa Buwan, kaya patuloy itong umiikot sa paligid natin!

statements.text: Did you know? The newton (N) is the special unit we use to measure force!
statements.tl: Alam mo ba? Ang newton (N) ang yunit na ginagamit natin para sumukat ng force!

statements.text: The strength of a force is measured in a special unit called the newton!
statements.tl: Sinusukat ang lakas ng puwersa sa yunit na tinatawag na newton!

statements.text: The unit of force is the newton! Its symbol is N, named after Isaac Newton.
statements.tl: Ang yunit ng force ay ang newton! Ang simbolo nito ay N, ipinangalan kay Isaac Newton.

statements.text: In the MKS system, force is measured in newtons, where one newton equals one kilogram meter per second squared.
statements.tl: Sa MKS system, ang puwersa ay sinusukat sa newtons, kung saan ang isang newton ay katumbas ng isang kilogram meter per second squared.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1FVvpmh6R9MaMTg5THFFLXGi31dUpAnal), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you write with a pen, the contact force between the pen tip and the paper lets you create marks.
statements.tl: Kapag nagsusulat ka gamit ang panulat, ang contact force sa pagitan ng dulo ng panulat at ng papel ang nagbibigay-daan para makagawa ka ng mga marka.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1KA0b-G-5GNxZwtAwWMk0EwOqYOKMz4eP), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Bouncing a ball involves contact forces between your hand and the ball, which change how the ball moves.
statements.tl: Ang pagpapatalsik ng bola ay may kinalaman sa mga contact force sa pagitan ng iyong kamay at ng bola, na nagbabago sa galaw ng bola.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1KA0b-G-5GNxZwtAwWMk0EwOqYOKMz4eP), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Pushing a chair, carrying a bag by its handle, and sliding a box on a table are all examples of contact forces in everyday life.
statements.tl: Ang pagtulak ng upuan, pagbitbit ng bag sa hawakan nito, at pag-slide ng kahon sa mesa ay mga halimbawa ng contact forces sa pang-araw-araw na buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Mql0M8-bOg6QCZQ2D0A9NbiFnb1fcgvY), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gravity is the invisible pulling force that keeps the Sun, Moon, and Earth moving together in the solar system.
statements.tl: Ang gravity ay ang hindi nakikitang puwersang humihila kaya nananatiling magkakasama ang Araw, Buwan, at Daigdig sa solar system.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1OOljMRiEn6dGwQ1wxns3wb_ZgyPKepvG), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Contact forces happen when two objects touch each other, like your hand pushing a book across a table.
statements.tl: Ang contact forces ay nangyayari kapag magkadikit ang dalawang bagay, tulad ng kamay mo na nagtutulak ng libro sa mesa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TUjnIi4TLNx1MqEM0WYuZvlEJ-Ri6f35), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Tension is the pulling force carried by a string, rope, or wire when it is stretched tight, like a t-shirt hanging on a clothesline.
statements.tl: Ang tension ay ang puwersang humihila na dala ng string, lubid, o wire kapag ito ay nakaunat, tulad ng t-shirt na nakasabit sa sampayan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TUjnIi4TLNx1MqEM0WYuZvlEJ-Ri6f35), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Everyday chores like pushing a grocery cart, sweeping the floor, and lifting a pail of water all use forces to move objects.
statements.tl: Ang mga gawaing bahay tulad ng pagtulak ng grocery cart, pagwawalis ng sahig, at pagbubuhat ng timba ng tubig ay gumagamit ng forces para mapagalaw ang mga bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TUjnIi4TLNx1MqEM0WYuZvlEJ-Ri6f35), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Electrostatic force is the push or pull from a charged body, meaning an object with an imbalance of charge, on another charged or uncharged body.
statements.tl: Ang electrostatic force ay ang tulak o hila mula sa charged body, ibig sabihin isang bagay na may imbalance ng charge, papunta sa isa pang charged o uncharged na bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ifuaucwTpMgwIxJqiB9nbCiMzIwerf7s), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A force is a push or pull on an object that results from the interaction of that object with its environment.
statements.tl: Ang force ay isang tulak o hila sa isang bagay na nagmumula sa interaksyon ng bagay na iyon sa kanyang kapaligiran.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1n1edItwUB0gZNTZu3qyKz0ABbHACm0xC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When a baseball pushes a glove leftward, the glove pushes the baseball rightward with an equal force.
statements.tl: Kapag itinulak ng baseball ang glove pakaliwa, itinutulak naman ng glove ang baseball pakanan nang may parehong lakas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1xjd6qNDasRyhPdYSFigtnJAWBxMhiTJA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Magnitude is the size or strength of a force, and it is commonly measured in units called Newtons.
statements.tl: Ang magnitude ay ang laki o lakas ng isang force, at karaniwan itong sinusukat sa mga unit na tinatawag na Newton.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-24679), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A ball pushed on the floor experiences applied force, frictional force opposing motion, normal force from the floor, and gravitational force from Earth.
statements.tl: Ang bolang tinulak sa sahig ay nakararanas ng applied force, frictional force na sumasalungat sa galaw, normal force mula sa sahig, at gravitational force mula sa Earth.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-24679), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A car moving at a constant speed on a straight road has balanced forces, because the forward push of the engine equals the backward pull of friction and air resistance.
statements.tl: Ang kotse na umaandar sa constant speed sa tuwid na daan ay may balanced forces, dahil ang pasulong na tulak ng makina ay kapareho ng paatras na hila ng friction at air resistance.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-qY_z10GH5wroNqZLv_SRb2Xe-p8rhv0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do falling objects stop speeding up after a while?

Air resistance grows until it balances gravity! Once they match, the object stops speeding up and falls at a constant speed called terminal velocity.
statements.tl:
Bakit humihinto sa pagbilis ang mga nahuhulog na bagay?

Lumalakas ang air resistance hanggang balansehin ang grabidad! Kapag nag-match, tumitigil ang pagbilis at bumabagsak na ito sa constant speed na terminal velocity.

statements.text:
Why doesn't a book fall through the table?

The table pushes back up! This is the normal force. It equals the book's weight, balancing the forces so the book stays still.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi bumabagsak ang libro sa mesa?

Tumutulak pabalik ang mesa! Ito ang normal force. Katumbas ito ng timbang ng libro, kaya balanse ang puwersa at hindi gumagalaw.
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; AAAS BSL Ch.4 (book-on-table example)

statements.text:
Do balanced forces always mean an object is standing still?

Nope! Balanced forces can also mean an object is moving straight at a constant speed, like a plane cruising level!
statements.tl:
Laging nakatigil ba ang bagay kapag balanseng puwersa?

Hindi! Maaari ring nangangahulugang gumagalaw nang tuwid sa pare-parehong bilis ang balanseng puwersa, tulad ng eroplanong patag na lumilipad!

statements.text:
Ever played tug-of-war?

If one team is stronger, the forces become unbalanced and the rope moves toward them!
statements.tl:
Nakapaglaro ka na ba ng tug-of-war?

Kung mas malakas ang isang grupo, di-balanse na ang pwersa at gumagalaw ang lubid patungo sa kanila!

statements.text: A book on a table is in static equilibrium — the table's normal force equals the book's weight, so net force is zero and it stays still!
statements.tl: Ang libro sa mesa ay nasa static equilibrium — ang normal force ng mesa ay katumbas ng bigat ng libro, kaya net force ay zero at hindi ito gumagalaw!
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; DepEd G5-6 forces and motion

statements.text:
What happens to the rope in a tug-of-war?

It stays still when both sides pull equally, but moves when one side pulls harder!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa lubid sa hilahan ng lubid?

Hindi ito gumagalaw kung magkapantay ang hila, pero gumagalaw ito kapag mas malakas ang hila ng isang panig!

statements.text: Philippine National Railways trains need a big unbalanced force from their diesel engines to overcome inertia and start moving from a station!
statements.tl: Ang mga tren ng Philippine National Railways ay kailangan ng malaking unbalanced force mula sa diesel engine para mapagtagumpayan ang inertia at makapagsimula sa istasyon!

statements.text: An accelerating falling apple experiences unbalanced forces because the downward pull of gravity is much stronger than the upward push of air resistance.
statements.tl: Ang pabilis na nahuhulog na mansanas ay nakakaranas ng unbalanced forces dahil ang pababang hila ng gravity ay mas malakas kaysa sa pataas na tulak ng air resistance.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-qY_z10GH5wroNqZLv_SRb2Xe-p8rhv0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: As a projectile rises, the vertical distance it covers each second gets smaller, but as it falls, the vertical distance each second gets larger.
statements.tl: Habang umaangat ang projectile, ang vertical distance na natatakpan nito bawat segundo ay lumiliit, pero habang bumabagsak, lumalaki ang vertical distance bawat segundo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MCGrpz4wxlu8YLGJCuY3yO_DImjqCahp), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do sprinters start slowly and then get faster?

They accelerate - their velocity increases as they push harder against the ground!
statements.tl:
Bakit nagsisimula nang mabagal ang mga sprinter at pagkatapos ay bumibilis?

Nag-a-accelerate sila - tumataas ang kanilang velocity habang mas malakas silang tumutulak sa lupa!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1cR9AA2X4i7yw53qj_Yo-eu1c-c4MGZPe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A roller coaster is exciting because it keeps changing speed and direction, which means it is constantly accelerating.
statements.tl: Nakakatuwa ang roller coaster dahil patuloy itong nagbabago ng bilis at direksyon, ibig sabihin patuloy itong nag-a-accelerate.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1cR9AA2X4i7yw53qj_Yo-eu1c-c4MGZPe), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A book resting on a table has two main forces: gravity pulling it down and the table pushing it up, and these forces are equal and opposite.
statements.tl: Ang isang aklat na nakapatong sa mesa ay may dalawang pangunahing force: ang gravity na humihila dito pababa at ang mesa na tumutulak dito pataas, at ang mga force na ito ay magkapantay at magkasalungat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hFxuKLGPzFLg4QyCmJtqCfJT9wCjF4o-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An athlete accelerating at 1.5 m/s² from an initial velocity of 3 m/s will have a final velocity of 9 m/s after 4 seconds.
statements.tl: Ang isang atleta na nag-a-accelerate sa 1.5 m/s² mula sa initial velocity na 3 m/s ay magkakaroon ng final velocity na 9 m/s pagkatapos ng 4 na segundo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1n9i5RkPhq-EZ7j6YJH8ck7MExr7-1Zvz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In an Atwood machine, when one hanging mass is larger, the net force is unbalanced, so the larger mass accelerates downward and the smaller mass accelerates upward.
statements.tl: Sa isang Atwood machine, kapag mas malaki ang isang nakabiting mass, ang net force ay unbalanced, kaya ang mas malaking mass ay bumibilis pababa at ang mas maliit na mass ay bumibilis paitaas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1xxJZO8WIwN5lvohg8Gt5li3GU5fhsPC7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Objects at rest, like a block of wood on a table, still have forces acting on them, but these forces are balanced so the object does not move.
statements.tl: Ang mga bagay na nakahinto, tulad ng bloke ng kahoy sa mesa, ay may mga force pa ring kumikilos sa kanila, pero balanced ang mga force na ito kaya hindi gumagalaw ang bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-24679), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why doesn't a floating object sink all the way?

It sinks only until the weight of the water it displaces equals its own weight, and then it stops!
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi lubog nang lubog ang isang lumulutang na bagay?

Lumulubog lang ito nang bahagya hanggang ang timbang ng natabig na tubig ay tumbas na sa sarili nitong timbang, tapos titigil na!

statements.text:
What happens when two people pull a rope with the exact same strength in opposite directions?

The net force combines all forces' strength and direction. When opposite forces cancel out, the net force is zero, and the object's motion does not change!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag magkapareho ang lakas ng hila ng dalawang tao sa magkasalungat na direksyon sa isang lubid?

Ang net force ay pinagsama-samang lakas at direksyon ng lahat ng puwersa. Kapag nagkansela ang magkasalungat na puwersa, zero ang net force at hindi nagbabago ang galaw!

statements.text: Ignoring air resistance, for a fruit falling from a tree, the free-body diagram shows only one force: a downward arrow for gravity, which is unbalanced and makes the fruit speed up.
statements.tl: Kung hindi isasama ang air resistance, para sa isang prutas na nahuhulog mula sa puno, ang free-body diagram ay nagpapakita lamang ng isang force: isang pababang arrow para sa gravity, na unbalanced at nagpapabilis sa prutas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VFkK8LSMr80jq34v1Wk2LYvx1HZ7ooxF), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do we draw forces?

Forces are shown using arrows, where the length stands for the strength and the point shows the direction!
statements.tl:
Paano natin iguhit ang mga pwersa?

Ipinapakita ang mga pwersa gamit ang mga palaso, kung saan ang haba ay para sa lakas at ang turo ay para sa direksyon!

statements.text: A free-body diagram is a drawing that shows all the forces acting on an object, using arrows that point in the direction and size of each force!
statements.tl: Ang free-body diagram ay isang guhit na nagpapakita ng lahat ng puwersang kumikilos sa isang bagay, gamit ang mga panang nagtuturo sa direksyon at lakas ng bawat puwersa!

statements.text: Label each arrow with short letters like F_g for gravity and F_N for normal force—now your diagram is super clear!
statements.tl: Lagyan ng maikling letra ang bawat arrow tulad ng F_g para sa gravity at F_N para sa normal force—lilinaw na ang diagram mo!

statements.text: When one arrow is longer than the one pointing opposite it, the force is unbalanced and the object accelerates!
statements.tl: Kapag mas mahaba ang isang arrow kaysa sa kabilang direksyon nito, ang puwersa ay unbalanced at magbabago ang velocity ng bagay!

statements.text: Even when moving at constant velocity, a free-body diagram shows balanced forces with equal and opposite arrows!
statements.tl: Kahit gumagalaw sa pantay na bilis at hindi nagbabago ang direksyon, ang free-body diagram ay nagpapakita ng balanseng puwersa at magkaparehong magkasalungat na arrows!

statements.text: If an object is pushed but not moving, the push arrow and friction arrow are equal in length, showing balanced forces!
statements.tl: Kapag tinutulak ang bagay pero hindi gumagalaw, magkapareho ang haba ng push arrow at friction arrow, ibig sabihin balanse ang mga puwersa!

statements.text: A force is a push or pull, and it is a vector quantity, which means it always has both a magnitude (how strong it is) and a direction.
statements.tl: Ang force ay isang tulak o hila, at ito ay isang vector quantity, ibig sabihin laging mayroon itong magnitude (kung gaano kalakas) at direksyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-qY_z10GH5wroNqZLv_SRb2Xe-p8rhv0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Arrows representing forces may point upward, downward, right, left, or diagonally, depending on the force applied.
statements.tl: Ang mga arrow na kumakatawan sa force ay maaaring nakaturo pataas, pababa, pakanan, pakaliwa, o pahilis, depende sa inilapat na force.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UCI7b9j81myy50SsqUYKBVVj_7bUwGz0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When drawing force vectors, we use cardinal directions like North, South, East, and West, where North is upward and East is to the right.
statements.tl: Kapag gumuguhit ng force vectors, ginagamit natin ang cardinal directions tulad ng North, South, East, at West, kung saan ang North ay paitaas at ang East ay pakanan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VFkK8LSMr80jq34v1Wk2LYvx1HZ7ooxF), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a free-body diagram of a book resting on a table, an upward normal force from the table and a downward gravitational force are drawn as equal arrows.
statements.tl: Sa isang free-body diagram ng isang aklat na nakapatong sa mesa, ang paitaas na normal force mula sa mesa at ang pababang gravitational force ay iginuguhit bilang magkapantay na mga arrow.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VFkK8LSMr80jq34v1Wk2LYvx1HZ7ooxF), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Force is a vector quantity because it always has both magnitude — how strong the push or pull is — and direction, like to the right or upward.
statements.tl: Ang force ay isang vector quantity dahil lagi itong may magnitude — kung gaano kalakas ang tulak o hatak — at direksyon, tulad ng pakanan o paitaas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zjq-iiyPGFUDwD_Z2sAtV47FkPi6f5Ex), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do scientists draw free-body diagrams instead of just looking at a picture?

Because a free-body diagram shows only the forces, making it easier to see which forces are balanced or unbalanced!
statements.tl:
Bakit gumuguhit ang mga scientist ng free-body diagram sa halip na tingnan lang ang isang larawan?

Dahil ang free-body diagram ay nagpapakita lamang ng mga force, kaya mas madaling makita kung aling mga force ang balanse o hindi balanse!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zjq-iiyPGFUDwD_Z2sAtV47FkPi6f5Ex), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To draw a free-body diagram, treat the object as a point, place it at the origin of an xy-coordinate system, and draw all forces as arrows from that point.
statements.tl: Upang gumuhit ng free-body diagram, ituring ang bagay bilang isang tuldok, ilagay ito sa origin ng xy-coordinate system, at iguhit ang lahat ng force bilang mga arrow mula sa tuldok na iyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zjq-iiyPGFUDwD_Z2sAtV47FkPi6f5Ex), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do you start studying the forces on an object?

First, pick one object to study and ignore everything else, so only the forces on that object appear!
statements.tl:
Paano mo sisimulan ang pag-aaral ng forces sa isang bagay?

Una, pumili ng isang bagay na pag-aaralan at huwag pansinin ang lahat ng iba pa, para ang forces lang sa bagay na iyon ang lalabas!

statements.text: Before drawing any arrows, list every force acting on the object so you do not leave a single one out!
statements.tl: Bago gumuhit ng kahit anong arrow, ilista muna ang lahat ng puwersang kumikilos sa bagay para walang makalimutan!

statements.text: Gravity's arrow always points straight down toward the center of Earth, no matter how the object is tilted!
statements.tl: Ang arrow ng gravity ay laging nakaturo diretso pababa papunta sa gitna ng Earth, kahit pa nakatagilid ang bagay!

statements.text:
Which way does the normal force arrow point?

The normal force arrow points perpendicular to the surface, meaning it makes a 90-degree angle with the surface!
statements.tl:
Saan nakaturo ang arrow ng normal force?

Ang arrow ng normal force ay nakaturo nang perpendicular sa surface, ibig sabihin gumagawa ito ng 90-degree na anggulo sa surface!

statements.text:
What is the difference between heat and temperature?

Heat is energy moving from hot to cold objects. Temperature just measures the average motion energy of tiny particles inside!
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng heat at temperature?

Ang heat ay enerhiyang lumilipat mula sa mainit patungong malamig. Ang temperature ay sukat lang ng average na motion energy ng mga particle!

statements.text:
What is the difference between heat and temperature?

Temperature measures how hot or cold something is! Heat is the energy that flows from a hotter object to a cooler one.
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng heat at temperature?

Ang temperatura ay sukat kung gaano kainit o kalamig ang isang bagay! Ang init ay ang enerhiyang dumadaloy mula sa mas mainit patungo sa mas malamig.

statements.text:
Are temperature and heat the same thing?

Nope! Temperature measures average particle kinetic energy, while heat is energy transferred from one object to another because of a temperature difference.
statements.tl:
Ang temperatura at init ba ay pareho?

Hindi! Ang temperatura ay sukatan ng average na kinetic energy ng mga particle, habang ang init ay enerhiyang inililipat mula sa isang bagay papunta sa isa pa dahil sa pagkakaiba ng temperatura.

statements.text: When a cold source like an ice pack is removed, a cooled system gradually warms back up because heat from the surroundings flows into it.
statements.tl: Kapag tinanggal ang malamig na bagay tulad ng ice pack, unti-unting iinit muli ang pinalamig na sistema dahil papasok ang init mula sa paligid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1KsAzHUz0Z8VH9Hnwq8G7jH9VCg4f2O19), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why can metal feel colder than wood at the same temperature?

They are actually at the exact same temperature, but the metal just feels colder to our hands!
statements.tl:
Bakit maaaring mas malamig ang pakiramdam ng metal kaysa kahoy kapag pareho ang temperatura?

Pareho lang sila ng temperatura, pero mas malamig lang talaga ang pakiramdam ng metal sa ating mga kamay!

statements.text:
Is a bigger ice cube actually colder than a small one?

No! Size alone does not determine temperature. A bigger ice cube just takes longer to melt because it needs to absorb more heat, not because it is colder.
statements.tl:
Mas malamig ba talaga ang malaking yelo kaysa sa maliit?

Hindi! Hindi sapat ang laki para malaman ang temperatura. Mas matagal lang matunaw ang malaking yelo dahil kailangan niyang sipsipin ang mas maraming init, hindi dahil mas malamig ito.

statements.text: Metal feels colder than wood at the same temperature because it pulls heat away from your hand super fast — it is not actually colder, just a quick heat stealer!
statements.tl: Mas malamig pakiramdam ang metal kaysa kahoy kahit pareho ang temperatura, dahil mabilis nitong kinukuha ang init mula sa kamay mo — hindi talaga ito mas malamig, mabilis lang magnakaw ng init!

statements.text:
What is the difference between heat and temperature?

Temperature measures how hot something is, while heat is the total thermal energy moving from one object to another!
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng heat at temperature?

Ang temperature ay sukat kung gaano kainit ang isang bagay, samantalang ang heat ay ang kabuuang thermal energy na lumilipat mula sa isang bagay patungo sa iba!
statements.source: NRC PS3.A; PS3.B; AAAS BSL Ch.4E

statements.text:
What happens when ice meets warm juice?

Net heat transfer stops when they reach the same temperature, called thermal equilibrium! The ice and juice settle to one temperature and stop changing.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag nagkahalo ang yelo at juice?

Humihinto ang netong paglipat ng init kapag magkasing-init na sila, na tinatawag na thermal equilibrium! Umaabot ang yelo at juice sa parehong temperatura at hindi na nagbabago.

statements.text: Heat and temperature are actually different! Heat is a form of energy, while temperature simply measures how hot something is.
statements.tl: Magkaiba pala ang init at temperatura! Ang init ay isang uri ng energy, habang ang temperatura ang sukat kung gaano kainit ang bagay.

statements.text: A big pot of warm water can hold more total thermal energy than a small cup of hot water, even if the cup feels hotter!
statements.tl: Ang malaking palayok ng maligamgam na tubig ay maaaring may mas maraming kabuuang thermal energy kaysa maliit na tasa ng mainit na tubig, kahit mas mainit ang tasa!

statements.text:
Why do we need a machine to move heat the other way?

Naturally, heat flows from hot to cold! A machine is needed to push it the opposite way.
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangan ng makina para baligtarin ang daloy ng init?

Sa natural, ang init ay dumadaloy mula sa mainit patungong malamig! Kaya kailangan ng makina para baligtarin ito.

statements.text: Heat and temperature are different! Temperature measures how hot or cold a thing is, while heat is the energy transferred from hot to cold.
statements.tl: Magkaiba ang init at temperatura! Ang temperatura ay sukat kung gaano kainit o lamig ang isang bagay, samantalang ang init ay enerhiyang naililipat mula sa mas mainit patungo sa mas malamig.

statements.text:
What happens when hot and cold things touch?

Heat flows from the hotter object to the cooler one until their temperatures equalize. This is called thermal equilibrium!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag nagkahipo ang mainit at malamig?

Dumadaloy ang init mula sa mas mainit papunta sa mas malamig hanggang maging pantay ang temperatura. Tawag dito ay thermal equilibrium!

statements.text:
What is the difference between temperature and heat in a bowl of hot soup?

Temperature indicates how hot the soup is and relates to particles' average kinetic energy. Heat is energy transferred because of a temperature difference!
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng temperature at heat sa isang mangkok ng mainit na sabaw?

Ipinapakita ng temperature kung gaano kainit ang sabaw at kaugnay ito ng karaniwang kinetic energy ng mga particle. Ang heat ay enerhiyang naililipat dahil sa pagkakaiba ng temperatura!

statements.text: Fiberglass insulation is a cool material in house walls! It reduces heat transfer to keep your indoor temperatures super comfortable.
statements.tl: Ang fiberglass insulation ay materyal sa mga pader ng bahay! Pinabababa nito ang heat transfer para maging komportable ang temperatura sa loob.

statements.text:
How does a thermometer actually work?

Its liquid expands or contracts to match the object's temperature! That's why it shows temperature, not heat.
statements.tl:
Paano ba talaga gumagana ang thermometer?

Lumalawak o lumiliit ang liquid nito para tumugma sa temperature! Kaya ipinapakita nito ang temperature, hindi ang heat.

statements.text: Heat is measured in joules, while temperature is measured in degrees Celsius! They are totally different quantities with different units.
statements.tl: Ang heat ay sinusukat sa joules, habang ang temperature ay sinusukat sa degrees Celsius! Magkaiba silang quantities na may magkaibang units.

statements.text: Philippine schools hold earthquake drills so children can practice what to do and where to go safely during a real earthquake!
statements.tl: Nagsasagawa ng earthquake drill ang mga paaralan sa Pilipinas para masanay ang mga bata kung ano ang gagawin at saan tatakbo nang ligtas kapag may totoong lindol!
statements.source: DepEd MATATAG Science CG (disaster readiness); encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
What should you do when the earthquake shaking finally stops?

Calmly go out to an open area using the evacuation route, because there might still be aftershocks!
statements.tl:
Ano ang dapat gawin kapag tumigil na ang pagyanig ng lindol?

Kalmadong lumabas sa bukas na lugar gamit ang evacuation route, dahil maaaring may aftershock pa!

statements.text: During an earthquake, remember to duck, cover under a sturdy table, and hold on tight until the shaking stops!
statements.tl: Sa lindol, tandaang yumuko, magtago sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa, at kumapit nang mahigpit hanggang tumigil ang pagyanig!

statements.text: After an earthquake, do not use elevators because they may get stuck or fall if the building has been damaged.
statements.tl: Pagkatapos ng lindol, huwag gumamit ng elevator dahil maaari itong maipit o mahulog kung nasira ang gusali.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-bmK1Aax8ir51s3Ul2z6tHdiNKSRwAZ5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: If you need to evacuate your residence after an earthquake, leave a message stating where you are going and bring your emergency supply kit.
statements.tl: Kung kailangan mong lumikas sa inyong tirahan pagkatapos ng lindol, mag-iwan ng mensahe kung saan ka pupunta at dalhin ang iyong emergency supply kit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-bmK1Aax8ir51s3Ul2z6tHdiNKSRwAZ5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Keep updated on disaster prevention instructions from battery-operated radios after an earthquake because electricity and communication lines may be down.
statements.tl: Manatiling updated sa mga panuto para sa disaster prevention mula sa battery-operated radio pagkatapos ng lindol dahil maaaring putol ang kuryente at linya ng komunikasyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-bmK1Aax8ir51s3Ul2z6tHdiNKSRwAZ5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Local disaster readiness plans guide what to do before, during, and after an earthquake, including checking for injuries, assessing damage, and evacuating to safe assembly areas.
statements.tl: Ang local disaster readiness plans ay gumagabay kung ano ang gagawin bago, habang, at pagkatapos ng lindol, kabilang ang pagsuri ng mga sugat, pagtasa ng pinsala, at paglikas sa ligtas na assembly areas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1J8RM2lOxWK9O9iG5sW4a8mtIUBdV_HgU), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: During earthquake drills, students practice the correct actions for before, during, and after shaking, including taking cover under sturdy furniture and evacuating to safe assembly areas.
statements.tl: Sa earthquake drills, sinasanay ng mga estudyante ang tamang mga hakbang bago, habang, at pagkatapos ng pagyanig, kabilang ang pagsilong sa ilalim ng matibay na kasangkapan at paglikas sa ligtas na assembly areas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1J8RM2lOxWK9O9iG5sW4a8mtIUBdV_HgU), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How can communities reduce damage from earthquakes?

By strictly following building codes, training volunteers as responders, and conducting regular earthquake drills so everyone knows what to do.
statements.tl:
Paano mababawasan ng mga komunidad ang pinsala mula sa mga lindol?

Sa pamamagitan ng mahigpit na pagsunod sa building codes, pagsasanay sa mga volunteer bilang responders, at regular na pagsasagawa ng earthquake drills upang malaman ng lahat ang gagawin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VpIp4ZKYMafomm66f2KcISsLdZ2ZSnIH), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Before an earthquake, follow your local disaster readiness plan so your family knows the safe spots, emergency kits, and meeting places ahead of time.
statements.tl: Bago lumindol, sundin ang local disaster readiness plan para alam na ng pamilya mo ang mga ligtas na lugar, emergency kit, at meeting place bago pa man mangyari ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1m9yaONs-G6ANsYODJgXaRE2_W2YGuy-O), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do schools in the Philippines hold earthquake drills?

Because earthquakes are common here! During drills, we practice to duck, cover, and hold on.
statements.tl:
Bakit nagsasagawa ng earthquake drill ang mga paaralan sa Pilipinas?

Dahil madalas ang lindol dito! Sa drill, sinasanay tayong yumuko, magtago, at kumapit.

statements.text:
What should you do during an earthquake?

Do 'Duck, Cover, and Hold'! Drop down, take cover under a sturdy table, and hold on to it until the shaking stops.
statements.tl:
Ano ang dapat gawin kapag may lindol?

Gawin ang 'Duck, Cover, and Hold'! Yumuko, sumilong sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa, at kumapit dito hangga't yumayanig ang lupa.
statements.source: DepEd MATATAG Science CG (what to do during an earthquake); PHIVOLCS, encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
What should you do after a strong earthquake?

Calmly go to an open area away from buildings and posts, because aftershocks may still follow!
statements.tl:
Ano ang dapat gawin pagkatapos ng malakas na lindol?

Kalmadong lumabas sa bukas na lugar na malayo sa gusali at poste, dahil maaari pang may sumunod na aftershocks!
statements.source: DepEd MATATAG Science CG (what to do after an earthquake); PHIVOLCS, encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: After an earthquake, check for leaking gas or broken electrical wires! These can easily start a dangerous fire.
statements.tl: Pagkatapos ng lindol, alamin kung may tumatagas na gas o nasirang kable! Maaari itong magdulot ng sunog.

statements.text:
Why do we do earthquake drills in schools and offices?

Since we are on the Ring of Fire, we practice duck, cover, and hold! This regular drilling makes everyone ready when the ground suddenly shakes!
statements.tl:
Bakit nag-e-earthquake drills sa mga paaralan at opisina?

Dahil nasa Ring of Fire tayo, regular nating ineensayo ang duck, cover, and hold! Nagiging handa ang lahat kapag biglang yumanig ang lupa!

statements.text: Earthquakes happen when tectonic plates suddenly slip, so the "drop, cover, and hold" drill is essential to protect you from falling debris!
statements.tl: Nangyayari ang lindol kapag biglang dumulas ang mga tectonic plate, kaya mahalaga ang "drop, cover, and hold" drill para protektahan ka sa falling debris!

statements.text:
What should you do when an earthquake strikes?

During an earthquake, drop to the ground and take cover under a sturdy desk to protect yourself from falling debris!
statements.tl:
Ano ang dapat mong gawin kapag may lindol?

Sa panahon ng lindol, bumaba sa sahig at magtago sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa para protektahan ang sarili mula sa bumabagsak na debris!

statements.text: If an earthquake strikes while you're indoors, drop to the floor, take cover under a sturdy desk, and hold on tight!
statements.tl: Kapag may lindol at nasa loob ka, yumuko sa sahig, magtago sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa, at hawakan ito ng mahigpit!

statements.text: When the seafloor suddenly rises or drops during an earthquake, it pushes the water above it and starts a tsunami!
statements.tl: Kapag biglang tumaas o bumaba ang sahig ng dagat sa lindol, naitutulak nito ang tubig sa itaas at gumagawa ng tsunami!

statements.text: When a tsunami reaches shallow water near the shore, it slows down. But watch out, because its waves suddenly grow much taller!
statements.tl: Pagdating sa mababaw na tubig malapit sa baybayin, bumabagal ang tsunami. Pero mag-ingat, dahil biglang tumataas at nagiging mas malaki ang mga alon!

statements.text: A powerful tsunami can cross an entire ocean and strike coasts far from where it began!
statements.tl: Ang isang malakas na tsunami ay maaaring tumawid sa buong karagatan at tumama sa mga baybaying malayo sa pinagmulan!

statements.text: An underwater earthquake can disturb the ocean water above it, and strong disturbances can push huge waves toward the shore.
statements.tl: Ang isang underwater earthquake ay maaaring gumambala sa tubig ng karagatan sa itaas nito, at ang malakas na pagkagambala ay maaaring magtulak ng malalaking alon papunta sa dalampasigan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-mRKB-lnLRyq-YoKVkTnTIqM_jw1qcNE), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A tsunami can flood coastal communities, sweep away buildings and boats, and leave behind salt water that ruins farmland and drinking water.
statements.tl: Ang tsunami ay maaaring bumaha sa mga komunidad sa baybayin, tangayin ang mga gusali at bangka, at mag-iwan ng tubig-alat na sumisira sa sakahan at inuming tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1xfuPNq2aKjATZHqQXxTYaCg3K7LvCoB0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does a tsunami get so much energy?

A strong earthquake under the sea gives the water enormous energy, creating a tsunami that can reach and damage the coast!
statements.tl:
Paano nakakakuha ng napakalaking enerhiya ang isang tsunami?

Ang malakas na lindol sa ilalim ng dagat ay nagbibigay ng napakalaking enerhiya sa tubig, lumilikha ng tsunami na kayang sirain ang baybayin!

statements.text: A tsunami is not a tidal wave! It starts from a large underwater disturbance like an earthquake or landslide, not from tidal forces caused by the Moon.
statements.tl: Ang tsunami ay hindi tidal wave! Nagsisimula ito sa malaking underwater disturbance tulad ng earthquake o landslide, hindi sa tidal forces na galing sa Buwan.

statements.text:
What causes a tsunami?

A strong earthquake under the sea! It creates huge waves that are low in deep water but grow very tall at the shallow shore.
statements.tl:
Ano ang sanhi ng tsunami?

Malakas na lindol sa ilalim ng dagat! Gumagawa ito ng napakalalaking alon na tumataas nang husto pagdating sa mababaw na baybayin.

statements.text: Most tsunamis are actually caused by very strong earthquakes happening under the seafloor!
statements.tl: Karamihan sa mga tsunami ay sanhi ng mga napakalakas na lindol sa ilalim ng dagat.

statements.text:
What happened in the Moro Gulf in 1976?

A strong earthquake caused a massive tsunami! The huge waves struck the coasts of Mindanao.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyari sa Moro Gulf noong 1976?

Isang malakas na lindol ang nagdala ng isang malaking tsunami! Sinalanta ng mga alon ang baybayin ng Mindanao.
statements.source: PHIVOLCS historical tsunami records; USGS; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: A strong underwater earthquake suddenly moves the ocean floor, creating a tsunami with very large waves that rush toward the coast!
statements.tl: Ang malakas na lindol sa ilalim ng dagat ay biglang nagpapagalaw ng sahig nito, na lumilikha ng tsunami na may napakalalaking alon patungo sa baybayin!
statements.source: DepEd MATATAG Science CG (underwater earthquakes and tsunamis); encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: Most tsunamis are caused by strong undersea earthquakes that suddenly lift or drop the ocean floor!
statements.tl: Ang karamihan sa tsunami ay dulot ng malakas na lindol sa ilalim ng dagat na nagtataas o nagpapababa ng sahig!

statements.text: When the seafloor shifts, it pushes a huge amount of water upward, and energy spreads outward as waves!
statements.tl: Kapag gumalaw ang sahig ng dagat, naitutulak nito ang malaking dami ng tubig pataas, at kumakalat ang enerhiya bilang mga alon!

statements.text:
Did you know a huge tsunami hit the Philippines in 1976?

Yes! A strong earthquake in the Moro Gulf caused a tsunami, making it one of the worst disasters in Philippine history.
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba na may naging malaking tsunami sa Pilipinas noong 1976?

Oo! Isang malakas na lindol sa Look ng Moro ang nagdulot ng tsunami na isa sa pinakagrabeng sakuna sa kasaysayan ng Pilipinas.

statements.text:
What happens when a strong earthquake shakes the ocean floor?

It can create a tsunami, which is a huge, powerful wave that can strike the coast and cause flooding!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag malakas na lindol ang yumanig sa ilalim ng dagat?

Maaari itong lumikha ng tsunami, isang napakalaking alon na maaaring tumama sa baybayin at magdulot ng pagbaha!

statements.text:
What causes a giant tsunami?

A tsunami isn't a normal wind wave! It's caused by a strong underwater earthquake or eruption that creates a giant wave crashing on shore.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagdudulot ng malaking tsunami?

Hindi karaniwang alon ang tsunami! Dulot ito ng malakas na lindol o pagsabog sa ilalim ng dagat na gumagawa ng higanteng alon.

statements.text:
How does an earthquake make a tsunami?

When the seafloor suddenly rises or drops during a quake, it pushes a huge amount of water up. That sudden push gives the water energy to become a tsunami!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng tsunami ang lindol?

Kapag biglang tumaas o bumaba ang sahig ng dagat sa lindol, natutulak nito ang napakaraming tubig pataas. Ang biglang tulak na ito ang nagbibigay ng energy para maging tsunami!

statements.text:
Why do tsunamis grow so tall near the shore?

In shallow water, the tsunami slows down and piles up, making the wave very tall and super dangerous!
statements.tl:
Bakit lumalaki ang tsunami malapit sa baybayin?

Sa mababaw na tubig, bumabagal ang tsunami at nagsisiksikan, kaya tumataas nang husto at nagiging super delikado ang alon!

statements.text: When there is a tsunami warning, don't wait! Quickly move to high ground far away from the shore to stay safe.
statements.tl: Kapag may babala sa tsunami, huwag maghintay! Mabilis na tumakbo sa mataas na lugar na malayo sa baybayin para maging ligtas.

statements.text:
Is it safe to go back to the beach after the first tsunami wave?

No! Do not return to the shore right away because bigger waves can still come.
statements.tl:
Safe ba na bumalik sa baybayin pagkatapos ng unang alon ng tsunami?

Hindi! Huwag agad bumalik sa baybayin dahil maaari pang dumating ang mas malalaking alon.

statements.text: Authorities use communication channels like sirens, loudspeakers, text messages, and social media alerts to issue tsunami warnings and guide evacuation procedures.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang mga awtoridad ng communication channels tulad ng sirens, loudspeakers, text messages, at social media alerts para magbigay ng tsunami warnings at gabayan ang evacuation procedures.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1J8RM2lOxWK9O9iG5sW4a8mtIUBdV_HgU), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Families should create an evacuation plan that includes a meeting place, a route to higher ground, and important contact numbers.
statements.tl: Dapat gumawa ang bawat pamilya ng evacuation plan na may meeting place, ruta papunta sa mataas na lugar, at mahahalagang contact number.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aLcTDt27ut93fo0DPvTzKfHvYhV4tD0m), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In the Philippines, PHIVOLCS watches for earthquakes. They issue a warning when a tsunami may threaten our shores!
statements.tl: Sa Pilipinas, ang PHIVOLCS ang nagbabantay sa mga lindol. Naglalabas sila ng babala kapag may panganib na tsunami!

statements.text:
What should you do during a tsunami warning?

Never go to the shore to watch! Move away and stay on high ground.
statements.tl:
Ano ang dapat mong gawin kapag may babalang tsunami?
