Methanogens! Ang mga Archaebacteriang ito ay nabubuhay kung saan kakaunti o walang oxygen at gumagawa ng methane gas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aSEszzXZuOWbN541NzpJHigpGkMtXsXV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: All living things are sorted into three huge groups called domains: Archaea, Bacteria, and Eukarya, which includes every plant, animal, and fungus.
statements.tl: Ang lahat ng may buhay ay pinangkat sa tatlong malalaking grupo na tinatawag na domains: Archaea, Bacteria, at Eukarya, na kabilang ang lahat ng halaman, hayop, at fungus.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j0eZi4Jq2ZWac_LboNInoUIjFz_czlvV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Are butterflies and moths related?

Yes! They both belong to the same group called Lepidoptera, which means 'scaly wings.'
statements.tl:
Magkamag-anak ba ang paru-paro at gamu-gamo?

Oo! Parehong kabilang sila sa grupong Lepidoptera, na ang ibig sabihin ay 'may-kaliskis na pakpak.'

statements.text: Among the seven main taxonomy ranks, the Kingdom is the biggest — it splits living things into huge groups like Animalia (animals) and Plantae (plants).
statements.tl: Sa pitong pangunahing antas ng taxonomy, ang Kaharian (Kingdom) ang pinakamalaki — hinahati nito ang mga organismo sa malalaking grupo gaya ng Animalia at Plantae.

statements.text:
What is taxonomy?

Taxonomy is the branch of science that names and classifies living things based on how they're related to each other.
statements.tl:
Ano ang taksonomiya?

Ang taksonomiya ay ang sangay ng agham na nagpapangalan at nag-uuri sa mga buhay na bagay ayon sa kanilang pagkakaugnay.

statements.text:
Why do scientists group life into kingdoms?

It's easier to study millions of living things when they're sorted into kingdoms — just like sorting library books by subject helps us see how things are related.
statements.tl:
Bakit ginagrupo sa kaharian ang mga buhay?

Mas madali pag-aralan ang milyon-milyong buhay na bagay kapag naka-grupo sa kaharian — parang pag-aayos ng libro sa aklatan ayon sa paksa.

statements.text:
What is the animal kingdom called?

It's called Animalia! This big group includes birds, fish, and even us humans.
statements.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa kaharian ng mga hayop?

Tinatawag itong Animalia! Kasama rito ang mga ibon, isda, at maging ang mga tao.

statements.text: Humans belong to Order Primates, a group of mammals that includes monkeys and apes, because we share grasping hands and forward-facing eyes.
statements.tl: Ang tao ay kabilang sa Order Primates, isang grupo ng mammals na kasama ang mga unggoy at apes, dahil pareho tayong may nakakahawak na mga kamay at mga matang nakaharap sa unahan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RIXq3QQIM8Sd_F2-V1VTZlkCK4SjwRct), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The tarsier is not a monkey at all — it's a primate, a distant relative of both humans and monkeys.
statements.tl: Ang tarsier ay hindi unggoy kundi isang primate, na malayong kamag-anak ng tao at ng mga unggoy.

statements.text: Humans belong to Class Mammalia! Just like other mammals, we have mammary glands that can produce milk to feed our young.
statements.tl: Ang mga tao ay kabilang sa Class Mammalia! Tulad ng ibang mammals, may mammary glands tayo na gumagawa ng gatas para sa mga anak.

statements.text: Like other primates, humans have flexible fingers and toes, nails instead of claws, and eyes that work together to judge depth.
statements.tl: Tulad ng ibang primates, ang tao ay may flexible na mga daliri sa kamay at paa, mga kuko imbes na claws, at mga matang nagtutulungan para masukat ang lalim.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RIXq3QQIM8Sd_F2-V1VTZlkCK4SjwRct), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Understanding how humans are classified with other primates helps scientists trace the shared ancestors that connect us through evolution.
statements.tl: Ang pag-unawa kung paano inuuri ang tao kasama ng ibang primates ay tumutulong sa mga scientist na matunton ang mga shared ancestors na nag-uugnay sa atin sa pamamagitan ng evolution.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RIXq3QQIM8Sd_F2-V1VTZlkCK4SjwRct), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Humans are classified step by step as Domain Eukarya, Kingdom Animalia, Phylum Chordata, Class Mammalia, Order Primates, Family Hominidae, Genus Homo, and Species Homo sapiens.
statements.tl: Ang tao ay inuuri nang hakbang-hakbang bilang Domain Eukarya, Kingdom Animalia, Phylum Chordata, Class Mammalia, Order Primates, Family Hominidae, Genus Homo, at Species Homo sapiens.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j0eZi4Jq2ZWac_LboNInoUIjFz_czlvV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mammals, including humans, are endothermic, meaning they make their own body heat, have hair or fur, and produce milk to feed their babies.
statements.tl: Ang mga mammal, kabilang ang tao, ay endothermic, ibig sabihin gumagawa sila ng sariling init ng katawan, may buhok o balahibo, at gumagawa ng gatas para pakainin ang kanilang mga sanggol.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j0eZi4Jq2ZWac_LboNInoUIjFz_czlvV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Primates have forward-facing eyes that give them binocular vision, meaning both eyes work together to see one clear image and judge depth, which helps when jumping between branches.
statements.tl: Ang mga primate ay may forward-facing eyes na nagbibigay sa kanila ng binocular vision, ibig sabihin ang dalawang mata ay nagtutulungan upang makakita ng isang malinaw na imahe at mahusgahan ang lalim, na nakakatulong sa pagtalon sa pagitan ng mga sanga.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j0eZi4Jq2ZWac_LboNInoUIjFz_czlvV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Compared to their body size, primates have relatively large brains, which support their problem-solving skills, memory, and complex social lives.
statements.tl: Kung ikukumpara sa laki ng kanilang katawan, ang mga primate ay may relatively large brains, na sumusuporta sa kanilang kakayahang lumutas ng problema, memorya, at masalimuot na buhay panlipunan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j0eZi4Jq2ZWac_LboNInoUIjFz_czlvV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Genetics, the study of heredity and variation, helps scientists understand how humans are related to each other and to other primates by comparing the order of chemical letters in our genes.
statements.tl: Ang genetics, ang pag-aaral ng pagmamana at pagkakaiba-iba, ay tumutulong sa mga siyentista na maunawaan kung paano magkakaugnay ang mga tao sa isa't isa at sa iba pang mga primate sa pamamagitan ng paghahambing ng pagkakasunod-sunod ng mga chemical letters sa ating mga gene.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j0eZi4Jq2ZWac_LboNInoUIjFz_czlvV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Where does the milk we drink come from?

Cows and goats provide milk! Farmers milk them every day so families can drink fresh, nutritious milk.
statements.tl:
Saan nanggagaling ang gatas na iniinom natin?

Ang mga baka at kambing ang nagbibigay ng gatas! Araw-araw silang ginagatasan ng mga magsasaka para may sariwa at masustansyang gatas ang mga pamilya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-22563), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Is the tarsier really a monkey?

Many think the tarsier is a monkey, but it's not! It's a primate like monkeys and humans, but belongs to its own group and looks very different.
statements.tl:
Unggoy ba ang tarsier?

Maraming nag-aakalang unggoy ang tarsier, pero hindi! Primate ito gaya ng unggoy at tao, pero may sariling grupo at ibang-iba ang itsura.

statements.text:
What class do humans belong to?

Humans belong to the class Mammalia — that makes you a mammal too, just like dogs, cats, and whales!
statements.tl:
Anong klase ng hayop ang tao?

Ang tao pala ay kabilang sa klaseng Mammalia — ibig sabihin, ikaw ay mammal din, tulad ng aso, pusa, at balyena!

statements.text: Humans are mammals because we grow hair! This is the same body covering that helps classify dogs, cats, and bats in Mammalia as fur.
statements.tl: Mammals ang mga tao dahil tumutubo tayo ng buhok! Ito ang parehong panakip na tumutulong sa pag-uri ng aso, pusa, at paniki sa Mammalia.

statements.text: Having three tiny middle-ear bones is a special mammal trait! Humans have them too, which is one anatomical reason we belong in Class Mammalia.
statements.tl: Ang tatlong maliliit na buto sa gitna ng tainga ay katangian ng mammal! Mayroon nito ang mga tao, kaya tayo kabilang sa Class Mammalia.

statements.text: Humans keep a steady, warm body temperature using metabolism! This endotherm trait is shared with other mammals and helps scientists classify us.
statements.tl: Pinapanatili ng mga tao ang pantay at mainit na temperatura ng katawan gamit ang metabolism! Ito ay endotherm trait na nakatutulong sa pag-uri natin.

statements.text:
Why are humans in Class Mammalia?

We give birth to live young that grow inside the mother! This typical mammalian pattern is why we belong to Class Mammalia.
statements.tl:
Bakit tayo nasa Class Mammalia?

Nanganganak tayo ng buhay na sanggol na lumalaki sa loob ng ina! Ito ang karaniwang mammalian pattern kaya tayo nasa Class Mammalia.

statements.text: We share another cool mammal feature: a muscular diaphragm that powers our breathing! This helps support our spot in Class Mammalia.
statements.tl: May isa pa tayong mammal feature: ang muscular diaphragm na nagpapagana ng paghinga! Ito ay sumusuporta sa paglagay natin sa Class Mammalia.

statements.text: Forests release huge amounts of water into the air through transpiration.
statements.tl: Naglalabas ang mga gubat ng napakaraming tubig sa hangin sa pamamagitan ng transpirasyon.

statements.text: While making their food, plants release fresh oxygen back into the air for us!
statements.tl: Habang gumagawa ng pagkain, naglalabas ang mga halaman ng oxygen sa hangin para sa atin!

statements.text: Animals return water to the air when they breathe out and sweat. They help keep the water cycle moving!
statements.tl: Ibinabalik ng mga hayop ang tubig sa hangin kapag humihinga at pinagpapawisan. Nakakatulong sila na gumalaw ang water cycle!

statements.text: Biogeochemical cycles are nature's recycling routes, where nutrients move through living things and the air, water, and soil.
statements.tl: Ang biogeochemical cycles ay parang mga rutang paikot ng kalikasan, kung saan ang nutrients ay dumadaan sa mga may buhay at sa hangin, tubig, at lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17vVB3STqrffR_jsAYvIE9mIYPPfrbSJf), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The rate of transpiration gets higher with higher temperatures, so plants release more water vapor on hot days.
statements.tl: Ang rate ng transpiration ay tumataas kapag mas mataas ang temperatura, kaya mas maraming water vapor ang inilalabas ng mga halaman sa mainit na araw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Lsdb3aaujVWygOBr5EalkAld7zWtZUNB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Essential elements like carbon, oxygen, and nitrogen move between living things and the non-living environment, so the materials of life are recycled again and again.
statements.tl: Ang mahahalagang elemento tulad ng carbon, oxygen, at nitrogen ay umiikot sa pagitan ng mga bagay na may buhay at ng kapaligirang walang buhay, kaya ang mga materyales ng buhay ay paulit-ulit na nire-recycle.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1mRFhiVTHSErq9Tb7LqNOrTkcqB8A4tGr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: During the light-dependent reactions, water molecules are split to provide free electrons and release oxygen gas into the air.
statements.tl: Sa light-dependent reactions, hinahati ang mga water molecule para magbigay ng free electrons at maglabas ng oxygen gas sa hangin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1slX0_5odwVm9TJNZKhzhwWApgttgOCxD), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Oxygen you breathe in passes through the thin walls of your alveoli into your blood, while carbon dioxide moves out of the blood to be breathed away.
statements.tl: Ang oxygen na nilalanghap mo ay dumadaan sa manipis na pader ng alveoli papunta sa dugo, habang ang carbon dioxide naman ay lumalabas mula sa dugo para mailabas sa paghinga.

statements.text: Transpiration speeds up with warmer weather and stronger wind, but slows down when the air is more humid.
statements.tl: Ang transpiration ay bumibilis kapag mas mainit ang panahon at mas malakas ang hangin, ngunit bumabagal kapag mas humid ang hangin.

statements.text: Fast-growing trees absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen through photosynthesis, helping keep our climate healthy.
statements.tl: Sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis, sinisipsip ng mabilis-tumubong puno ang carbon dioxide at naglalabas ng oksiheno, kaya nakakatulong ito sa klima.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; photosynthesis and carbon sequestration references

statements.text: Mangroves soak up and store huge amounts of carbon in their mud, helping fight climate change.
statements.tl: Sinisipsip at iniimbak ng mangrove ang malaking halaga ng carbon sa kanilang putik, na tumutulong laban sa pagbabago ng klima.

statements.text: Mangrove trees are climate heroes—they lock away huge amounts of carbon in their soil!
statements.tl: Ang mga bakawan ay bayani ng klima—nag-iimbak sila ng napakaraming carbon sa lupa nila!

statements.text: Seagrass meadows quietly trap carbon in the mud beneath them — a hidden way they help fight global warming!
statements.tl: Kinukuha at itinatago ng damong-dagat ang carbon sa putik sa ilalim nito — tulong ito laban sa init ng mundo!

statements.text: Plants use carbon dioxide to make sugar and store that carbon in their roots, stems, and leaves.
statements.tl: Ginagamit ng halaman ang carbon dioxide para gumawa ng asukal at iniimbak ang carbon sa kanilang ugat, tangkay, at dahon.

statements.text: The lungs are excretory organs too — the carbon dioxide made by your body's cells gets pushed out every time you breathe out.
statements.tl: Ang baga ay isa ring organo ng excretion — ang carbon dioxide na ginawa ng mga selula ng katawan ay inilalabas tuwing tayo ay humihinga palabas.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; NRC LS1.A; DepEd G5 Science

statements.text: A tree doesn't just breathe in carbon dioxide -- it locks the carbon inside its trunk, branches, and roots as it grows, which is why big trees help clean the air.
statements.tl: Hindi lang sinisipsip ng puno ang carbon dioxide -- itinatago nito ang carbon sa katawan, sanga, at ugat habang lumalaki, kaya nakakatulong ang malalaking puno na bawasan ang carbon sa hangin.

statements.text: Forests in the Philippines store huge amounts of carbon because it builds up and stays inside the trees.
statements.tl: Ang mga gubat sa Pilipinas ay nag-iimbak ng maraming karbon dahil naiipon ito sa mga puno.

statements.text: Carbon never disappears — it just travels! It loops between air, living things, oceans, and soil through photosynthesis, breathing, and decay.
statements.tl: Hindi nawawala ang carbon — naglalakbay lang ito! Umiikot ito sa hangin, mga buhay na bagay, karagatan, at lupa sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis, paghinga, at pagkabulok.

statements.text: Aerobic respiration requires oxygen and produces carbon dioxide, water, and ATP, which is the energy currency of cells.
statements.tl: Ang aerobic respiration ay nangangailangan ng oxygen at gumagawa ng carbon dioxide, tubig, at ATP, na siyang energy currency ng mga cell.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15_Uk1qBQ8xLfUFpj0unZ4NyjujLPaz8x), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does a plant make its own food?

In photosynthesis, a plant uses sunlight, carbon dioxide from the air, and water to make sugar for food — and it releases oxygen too!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng sariling pagkain ang halaman?

Sa photosynthesis, ginagamit ng halaman ang sikat ng araw, carbon dioxide mula sa hangin, at tubig para gumawa ng asukal na pagkain — at naglalabas din ito ng oxygen!
statements.source: NRC LS1.C; AAAS Benchmarks 5E; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: The glucose your body uses for respiration comes from the food you eat and digest.
statements.tl: Ang glucose na ginagamit sa respirasyon ay nagmumula sa pagkaing kinakain at tinutunaw natin.

statements.text:
What does glycolysis mean?

Glycolysis means "splitting of sugar," and it is the first stage of cellular respiration where a six-carbon glucose molecule is split into two three-carbon pyruvate molecules in the cytoplasm.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng glycolysis?

Ang glycolysis ay nangangahulugang "paghahati ng asukal," at ito ang unang stage ng cellular respiration kung saan ang six-carbon na glucose molecule ay hinahati sa dalawang three-carbon na pyruvate molecule sa cytoplasm.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1FmPjNNwM_znBbzFQmadGdkj-qX0gkFXZ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Which stage of cellular respiration makes the most ATP?

The electron transport chain produces the most ATP, and it uses oxygen as the final electron acceptor to form water.
statements.tl:
Aling stage ng cellular respiration ang gumagawa ng pinakamaraming ATP?

Ang electron transport chain ang gumagawa ng pinakamaraming ATP, at ginagamit nito ang oxygen bilang final electron acceptor para makabuo ng tubig.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1FmPjNNwM_znBbzFQmadGdkj-qX0gkFXZ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Aerobic cellular respiration uses glucose, a simple sugar from food, and oxygen from the air as its raw materials.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang aerobic cellular respiration ng glucose, isang simpleng asukal mula sa pagkain, at oxygen mula sa hangin bilang mga raw materials nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1P_8vze6V_XydZrF4U_oLSTKWet-yw9Jk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cellular respiration has three main stages: glycolysis, the Krebs cycle, and the electron transport chain.
statements.tl: Ang cellular respiration ay may tatlong pangunahing yugto: glycolysis, Krebs cycle, at electron transport chain.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1P_8vze6V_XydZrF4U_oLSTKWet-yw9Jk), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The overall equation for aerobic respiration is glucose plus oxygen yields carbon dioxide, water, and about 30 to 32 ATP molecules of energy.
statements.tl: Ang kabuuang equation ng aerobic respiration ay glucose plus oxygen na nagiging carbon dioxide, tubig, at humigit-kumulang 30 hanggang 32 ATP molecules ng enerhiya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1awznCkqi_7cr7xdT1bfpQo6FtSPcFFN7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Does all of photosynthesis need sunlight?

No! Only the light-dependent reactions need light directly. The Calvin cycle can run in the dark as long as it has the ATP and NADPH made in the light.
statements.tl:
Kailangan ba ng buong photosynthesis ang sikat ng araw?

Hindi! Tanging ang light-dependent reactions lang ang direktang nangangailangan ng liwanag. Ang Calvin cycle ay maaaring tumakbo sa dilim basta mayroon itong ATP at NADPH na ginawa sa liwanag.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1c_-Ss80KA8VSe47Z4u9MTYZgb9nwo4K-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Fermentation is a backup pathway that lets cells release energy from sugar when oxygen is not available, though it makes less ATP than cellular respiration.
statements.tl: Ang fermentation ay isang backup pathway na nagpapahintulot sa mga cell na maglabas ng enerhiya mula sa asukal kapag walang oxygen, kahit mas kaunti ang nagagawang ATP kaysa sa cellular respiration.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1hijmUiwK3vEd1qgvYZf-_dK7ufmKuQqY), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does sugarcane make its sugar?

Sugarcane makes its own sugar through photosynthesis — its leaves use sunlight to turn water and carbon dioxide into sweet sugar stored in the stalk.
statements.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng asukal ang tubo?

Ginagawa mismo ng tubo ang asukal nito sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis — ginagamit ng dahon ang sikat ng araw para gawing matamis na asukal ang tubig at carbon dioxide, at iniimbak ito sa tangkay.

statements.text:
Do plants eat soil?

No! Plants make their own food from sunlight through photosynthesis, only taking in water and minerals from the ground.
statements.tl:
Kumakain ba ng lupa ang halaman?

Hindi! Gumagawa ang halaman ng sarili nilang pagkain gamit ang sikat ng araw sa photosynthesis, tubig at mineral lang ang kinukuha nila sa lupa.

statements.text: During photosynthesis, plants take in carbon dioxide from the air to make food.
statements.tl: Sa fotosintesis, sinisipsip ng mga halaman ang carbon dioxide mula sa hangin para gawing pagkain.

statements.text: Like other plants, malunggay's green leaves make their own food from sunlight, water, and air through photosynthesis.
statements.tl: Tulad ng ibang halaman, gumagawa ang berdeng dahon ng malunggay ng sariling pagkain mula sa araw, tubig, at hangin sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis.

statements.text: In the oxygen cycle, plants release oxygen during photosynthesis, while animals and plants use it up when they breathe — so the air's oxygen keeps getting replaced.
statements.tl: Sa siklo ng oxygen, naglalabas ng oxygen ang mga halaman sa photosynthesis, habang ginagamit naman ito ng mga hayop at halaman sa paghinga — kaya patuloy itong napapalitan sa hangin.
statements.source: NRC LS2.B; PS1 (oxygen proportion in carbon cycle)

statements.text:
How do plants make their own food?

In photosynthesis, a plant uses sunlight to combine water and carbon dioxide to make sugar (glucose) — that's its food and energy!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng pagkain ang halaman?

Sa potosintesis, ginagamit ng halaman ang sikat ng araw para pagsamahin ang tubig at carbon dioxide para gumawa ng asukal (glucose) — iyon na ang pagkain at enerhiya nito!
statements.source: AAAS ch.5; NRC LS1.C; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
How do plants make their own food?

Chlorophyll helps the plant turn light, water, and air into its own food, in a process called photosynthesis.
statements.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng sariling pagkain ang halaman?

Tinutulungan ng klorophil ang halaman na gawing pagkain ang liwanag, tubig, at hangin, sa proseso na tinatawag na potosintesis.

statements.text:
What does a plant need to make its own food?

To make its own food, a plant needs three things: sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide from the air!
statements.tl:
Anong kailangan ng halaman para makagawa ng pagkain?

Para makagawa ng sariling pagkain, kailangan ng halaman ng tatlong bagay: sinag ng araw, tubig, at carbon dioxide mula sa hangin!
statements.source: NRC LS1.C; AAAS BSL Ch.5E; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text: A mixture has no fixed ratio, so you can add a little or a lot of salt to your soup!
statements.tl: Ang isang mixture ay walang fixed ratio, kaya pwede kang maglagay ng kaunti o maraming asin sa iyong sabaw!

statements.text: A pure compound has a fixed ratio of its constituent elements. For example, each water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom. A larger sample contains more atoms, but their ratio stays the same. A mixture can have different proportions.
statements.tl: May tiyak na ratio ng mga bumubuong elemento ang purong compound. Halimbawa, bawat molekula ng tubig ay may dalawang hydrogen atom at isang oxygen atom. Mas maraming atom ang mas malaking sample, ngunit pareho ang ratio. Maaaring magkaiba ang proporsiyon sa mixture.

statements.text: The atomic number of carbon (C) is 6, so it has exactly 6 protons!
statements.tl: Ang atomic number ng carbon (C) ay 6, kaya may 6 proton ito!

statements.text: A solution can have different amounts of solute and solvent, so its composition is variable, not fixed.
statements.tl: Ang isang solution ay maaaring magkaroon ng iba't ibang dami ng solute at solvent, kaya nagbabago ang komposisyon nito, hindi ito nakapirmi.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 14G3Aq2H7Q_XfQKcQjZG5SNEGog81rtDV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A copper wire is made of copper atoms packed together, and held together by metallic bonds, so copper is an element, not a molecule or compound.
statements.tl: Ang copper wire ay gawa sa mga copper atom na magkakadikit, at pinagdurugtong sila ng metallic bonds, kaya ang copper ay element, hindi molecule o compound.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1CjelWcxW4JPq8g6e9k-jq4Eo05sAKeDr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Helium is an element, not a compound, because it is made of only one kind of atom, and it is used to fill balloons.
statements.tl: Ang helium ay isang element, hindi compound, dahil ito ay gawa sa iisang uri lamang ng atom, at ginagamit ito sa pagpapalobo ng mga lobo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TRBVi24YbCDyvZDxvDqzl9k5i6M6gKL4), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Carbon is a nonmetal in Group 4A with atomic number 6, so a neutral carbon atom has six protons and six electrons.
statements.tl: Ang carbon ay isang nonmetal sa Group 4A na may atomic number 6, kaya ang neutral na carbon atom ay may anim na proton at anim na electron.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1TjB-rMJsImrdQAqxIEc3EbD-Qri9i7hE), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What's the difference between an element, a compound, and a mixture?

An element is one kind of atom. A compound joins elements in a fixed ratio with new properties. A mixture just combines things without making something new — so you can separate them!
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng element, compound, at mixture?

Ang element ay iisang uri ng atom. Ang compound ay pinagsamang elements sa fixed ratio na may bagong properties. Ang mixture ay pinaghalo lang nang walang bagong substance — kaya pwedeng paghiwalayin!

statements.text:
What is an element?

An element is a pure substance made of only one kind of atom! Examples include oxygen, carbon, gold, and iron.
statements.tl:
Ano ang element?

Ang element ay isang purong sangkap na gawa sa iisang uri lang ng atom! Ang oxygen, carbon, gold, at iron ay mga halimbawa nito.

statements.text: When two or more elements chemically bond, they form a compound with new properties! Like water, made from two gases (hydrogen and oxygen) yet is a drinkable liquid.
statements.tl: Kapag kemikal na nagbuklod ang dalawa o higit pang element, nabubuo ang compound na may bagong katangian! Gaya ng tubig na gawa sa dalawang gas (hydrogen at oxygen) pero likido at maiinom.

statements.text: An element is a pure substance made of only one kind of atom, like oxygen, carbon, or gold!
statements.tl: Ang elemento ay purong sangkap na gawa sa iisang uri lang ng atomo, gaya ng oksiheno, karbon, o ginto!

statements.text:
What decides which element an atom is?

The number of protons in the nucleus! One proton makes it hydrogen, and eight protons make it oxygen.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagtatakda kung anong elemento ang isang atomo?

Ang bilang ng proton sa nucleus! Isang proton ay hydrogen, at walong proton ay oksiheno.

statements.text: When atoms of two or more elements combine, they form a compound with new properties! Water is different from hydrogen and oxygen gases.
statements.tl: Kapag nagsama ang mga atomo ng dalawa o higit pang elemento, bumubuo sila ng compound na may bagong katangian! Ang tubig ay iba sa hydrogen at oxygen na gas.

statements.text:
Is the ratio of different atoms in a compound always the same?

Yes! In a compound, the ratio is always fixed. Water always has two hydrogen atoms for every one oxygen atom!
statements.tl:
Palaging pareho ba ang proporsiyon ng iba't ibang atomo sa isang compound?

Oo! Sa compound, tiyak palagi ang proporsiyon. Ang tubig ay laging may dalawang atomo ng hydrogen sa bawat isang atomo ng oksiheno!

statements.text: Elements in the periodic table are arranged by increasing atomic number, which is simply the number of protons in each atom!
statements.tl: Ang mga elemento sa periodic table ay nakaayos ayon sa pagdami ng atomic number, na siyang bilang ng proton sa bawat atomo!

statements.text: The number of protons, called the atomic number, decides what element an atom is. Every atom with 6 protons is carbon!
statements.tl: Ang bilang ng proton, o atomic number, ang nagtatakda kung anong elemento ang isang atomo. Lahat ng may 6 na proton ay carbon!

statements.text: An element cannot be broken down into simpler substances by ordinary chemical reactions. It is the simplest kind of matter!
statements.tl: Ang isang elemento ay hindi na mahahati sa ibang substansya sa karaniwang reaksyong kemikal. Ito ang pinakasimpleng uri ng bagay!

statements.text: In a mixture, you can combine substances in any amount! Add a little or a lot of salt to water, unlike a compound with a fixed ratio.
statements.tl: Sa timpla, pwedeng kahit anong dami ng sangkap ang pagsamahin! Maglagay ng kaunti o maraming asin sa tubig, ibang-iba sa compound na may tiyak na sukat.

statements.text: Dormant periods, when a volcano is quiet, may last tens of thousands of years before it erupts again.
statements.tl: Ang dormant periods, kapag tahimik ang bulkan, ay maaaring tumagal ng sampu-sampung libong taon bago ito muling pumutok.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MlIecBDGb8BzALVXtpFlCLb9iWWodlal), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A phreatic eruption is a steam-driven blast that happens when hot rocks touch water, turning it instantly into steam.
statements.tl: Ang phreatic eruption ay isang steam-driven na pagsabog na nangyayari kapag ang maiinit na bato ay dumikit sa tubig, na agad itong ginagawang singaw.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1QJKsk9IY2SYqXsQEWUcu0BSqfqd-n0Q2), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What's the difference between mantle convection and a mantle plume?

Mantle convection is the broad churning of rock across the whole mantle. A mantle plume is a narrow column of extra-hot rock rising from very deep — it makes hotspots like Hawaii!
statements.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng mantle convection at mantle plume?

Ang mantle convection ay malawak na pag-ikot ng bato sa buong mantle. Ang mantle plume naman ay makitid na haligi ng sobrang-init na bato mula sa malalim — gumagawa ito ng hotspots tulad ng Hawaii!

statements.text:
What's a mantle plume?

A mantle plume is a narrow column of extra-hot rock rising from deep in the mantle. When it hits a plate, it can create a hotspot volcano!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mantle plume?

Ang mantle plume ay isang makitid na haligi ng sobrang init na bato mula sa malalim na mantle. Kapag umabot ito sa plato, lumilikha ito ng hotspot na bulkan!

statements.text:
Can an eruption change the shape of a mountain?

Yes! Explosive eruptions can blow away parts of a mountain and change the landscape.
statements.tl:
Maaari bang baguhin ng pagsabog ang hugis ng bundok?

Oo! Ang mga explosive eruption ay kayang tangayin ang mga bahagi ng bundok at baguhin ang landscape.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Q7uzbhZpetgGp8T_OSC_9Z9xI46WYmZb), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Volcanoes come in three types: active ones like Taal and Mayon that erupt or may erupt again, dormant ones sleeping quietly but able to wake, and extinct ones unlikely to ever erupt.
statements.tl: May tatlong uri ng bulkan: active gaya ng Taal at Mayon na sumasabog o maaaring sumabog muli, dormant na parang natutulog pero pwedeng magising, at extinct na malabong sumabog pa.

statements.text: Volcanoes differ! Some erupt gently with runny lava, while others explode violently with thick lava and ash. Mayon Volcano is famous for its perfect cone shape!
statements.tl: Magkakaiba ang mga bulkan! Ang iba ay marahang pumuputok, pero ang iba ay sumasabog nang malakas. Tanyag ang Bulkang Mayon sa perpekto nitong hugis-kono!

statements.text:
What are the three kinds of volcanoes?

Active — erupted recently or could soon. Dormant — sleeping for a long time but might wake up. Extinct — not expected to erupt again. PHIVOLCS studies which kind each volcano is!
statements.tl:
Ano ang tatlong uri ng bulkan?

Aktibo — pumutok kamakailan o maaaring pumutok. Dormant — matagal nang natutulog pero pwedeng magising. Extinct — hindi na inaasahang pumutok. Sinusuri ng PHIVOLCS kung anong uri ang bawat bulkan!

statements.text: A volcano is active if it may erupt, dormant if it's been quiet a long time, and extinct if it is not expected to erupt again!
statements.tl: Ang bulkan ay aktibo kung maaaring sumabog, tulog kung matagal nang tahimik, at patay kung hindi na inaasahang muling sasabog!

statements.text: Mayon Volcano in Albay is famous worldwide for its nearly perfect cone shape and is one of the most active volcanoes in the Philippines!
statements.tl: Ang Bulkang Mayon sa Albay ay tanyag sa buong mundo dahil sa halos perpektong hugis-kono nito, at isa sa pinakaaktibong bulkan sa Pilipinas!

statements.text:
What are the three types of volcanoes?

Volcanoes can be active (able to erupt), dormant (sleeping but able to wake up), or extinct (not expected to ever erupt again)!
statements.tl:
Ano ang tatlong uri ng bulkan?

Ang mga bulkan ay maaaring active (maaaring sumabog), dormant (natutulog ngunit puwedeng magising), o extinct (hindi na inaasahang sumabog kailanman)!
statements.source: DepEd MATATAG Science CG (active and inactive volcanoes); encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
Which is the most active volcano in the Philippines?

Mayon! It is the most active volcano, having erupted more than 50 times in the past few centuries.
statements.tl:
Alin ang pinaka-aktibong bulkan sa Pilipinas?

Bulkang Mayon! Ito ang pinaka-aktibong bulkan, na pumutok nang mahigit 50 beses sa nakaraang mga siglo.

statements.text: According to PHIVOLCS, the Philippines has about 24 active volcanoes that can erupt!
statements.tl: Ayon sa PHIVOLCS, may mga 24 na aktibong bulkan sa Pilipinas na maaaring pumutok!

statements.text: Mayon Volcano in Albay is famous for its nearly perfect cone shape and is one of the most active volcanoes in the Philippines!
statements.tl: Ang Bulkang Mayon sa Albay ay kilala sa halos perpektong hugis-kono at isa sa pinakaaktibong bulkan sa Pilipinas!

statements.text:
What makes a volcano "active"?

An active volcano erupted recently or could erupt again anytime! It is still "alive" inside because hot magma is moving beneath it.
statements.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng "aktibong" bulkan?

Ang aktibong bulkan ay pumutok kamakailan o maaari pa itong pumutok kahit anong oras! May buhay pa ito sa loob dahil may mainit na magma na kumikilos sa ilalim.

statements.text: Bulusan is an active volcano in Sorsogon, Bicol that often puffs out ash and steam! It sits beside the beautiful Bulusan Lake and is watched by PHIVOLCS for its frequent phreatic activity.
statements.tl: Ang Bulusan ay isang aktibong bulkan sa Sorsogon, Bicol na madalas nagpapalabas ng abo at singaw! Nasa tabi ito ng magandang Bulusan Lake at binabantayan ng PHIVOLCS dahil sa madalas na phreatic na aktibidad.

statements.text:
Why do Philippine volcanoes like Mayon erupt so explosively?

Most Philippine volcanoes are stratovolcanoes (composite cones) with steep sides made of alternating layers of lava and pyroclastic material. Their thick, viscous lava traps gases, causing very explosive eruptions!
statements.tl:
Bakit napakalakas ng pagsabog ng mga bulkan sa Pilipinas tulad ng Mayon?

Karamihan sa bulkan ng Pilipinas ay mga stratovolcano (composite cone) na may matarik na gilid at alternating layers ng lava at pyroclastic material. Ang malapot na lava nito ay nagkukulong ng gas, kaya napakalakas ng pagsabog!

statements.text: A cinder cone is the smallest volcano type, built from cinders and scoria thrown out of a single vent! It forms quickly, and its activity usually ends within months to years.
statements.tl: Ang cinder cone ay ang pinakamaliit na uri ng bulkan, binubuo ng cinders at scoria na inihagis mula sa isang volcanic vent! Mabilis itong nabubuo, at ang aktibidad nito ay karaniwang natatapos sa ilang buwan o taon.

statements.text: Basaltic magma contains a lot of iron and magnesium but little silica, so it is fluid and flows freely.
statements.tl: Ang basaltic magma ay maraming iron at magnesium pero kakaunti ang silica, kaya malabnaw ito at malayang dumadaloy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18ZNU080K8uzmKL9594WKqlAAGd0PGILa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Thin runny lava flows far easily, while thick sticky lava moves slowly and often causes more explosive eruptions!
statements.tl: Ang manipis na lava ay madaling umagos nang malayo, habang ang malapot na lava ay mabagal at madalas magdulot ng mas malakas na pagsabog!

statements.text: A stratovolcano is a tall, steep cone built from alternating layers of lava and ash!
statements.tl: Ang stratovolcano ay matayog at matulis na kono na binubuo ng patong-patong na lava at abo!

statements.text: Runny lava spreads far from the vent before hardening to widen the base, while sticky lava hardens close by to build height!
statements.tl: Ang malabnaw na lava ay kumakalat nang malayo mula sa bunganga bago tumigas para lumapad ang paanan, habang ang malagkit na lava ay tumitigas malapit lang para tumataas!

statements.text: Shield volcanoes are tall and broad with gentle slopes, formed by low-viscosity basaltic lava that flows easily and spreads over large distances.
statements.tl: Ang shield volcanoes ay matataas at malalapad na may banayad na slope, nabubuo mula sa low-viscosity basaltic lava na madaling dumaloy at kumakalat sa malalayong distansya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1MlIecBDGb8BzALVXtpFlCLb9iWWodlal), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Shield volcanoes can grow to be very big, with a tall broad and flat rounded shape, low slopes, and large craters, like Mauna Loa in Hawaii.
statements.tl: Ang shield volcanoes ay maaaring lumaki nang napakalaki, may malapad at patag na bilugang hugis, mababang slope, at malalaking crater, tulad ng Mauna Loa sa Hawaii.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-23844), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Viscosity is the ability of a substance to resist flow, and a magma's viscosity is largely controlled by its temperature, composition, and gas content.
statements.tl: Ang viscosity ay ang kakayahan ng isang substance na labanan ang pagdaloy, at ang viscosity ng magma ay pangunahing kinokontrol ng temperatura, komposisyon, at gas content nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-23844), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mayon Volcano in Albay is famous for its nearly perfect cone shape! It is one of the most active volcanoes in the Philippines, so PHIVOLCS watches it closely.
statements.tl: Sikat ang Bulkang Mayon sa Albay sa halos perpektong hugis-kono nito! Isa ito sa pinakaaktibong bulkan sa Pilipinas, kaya madalas itong bantayan ng PHIVOLCS.

statements.text:
What is Mayon Volcano in Albay famous for?

It is famous for its nearly perfect cone shape!
statements.tl:
Ano ang tanyag sa Bulkang Mayon sa Albay?

Tanyag ito sa halos perpektong hugis-kono nito!

statements.text: Some volcanoes are broad and gently sloped like a shield, while others are steep cones, depending on the kind of lava!
statements.tl: Ilang bulkan ay malapad at patag na parang kalasag, habang ang iba ay matarik na kono, depende sa uri ng lava!

statements.text:
Which volcano in the Philippines is famous for its perfect cone shape?

It’s Mayon Volcano in Albay! It is one of our most active volcanoes. It erupts often, so experts watch it very closely!
statements.tl:
Aling bulkan sa Pilipinas ang sikat sa halos perpektong hugis-kono?

Bulkang Mayon sa Albay! Isa ito sa pinakaaktibong bulkan natin. Madalas itong pumutok, kaya binabantayan ito nang mabuti ng mga eksperto!

statements.text:
Why are shield volcanoes so wide and flat?

Their basaltic lava is very fluid (low viscosity) and flows far before cooling, giving them wide, gentle slopes. Unlike Philippine stratovolcanoes, they usually erupt more gently!
statements.tl:
Bakit malapad at banayad ang shield volcano?

Ang basaltic lava nito ay napakalabnaw (low viscosity) at dumadaloy nang malayo bago lumamig, kaya malapad at banayad ang mga gilid nito. Karaniwang mas banayad ang pagsabog nito kaysa ng stratovolcano ng Pilipinas!

statements.text:
What makes Mayon Volcano so famous?

Mayon Volcano is a stratovolcano (composite volcano) known for its nearly perfect cone shape!
statements.tl:
Bakit sikat ang Bulkang Mayon?

Ang Bulkang Mayon ay isang stratovolcano (composite volcano) na kilala sa halos perpektong hugis kono nito!

statements.text:
Why does Mayon have a perfect cone shape?

Because layers of lava and ash pile up evenly into a steep cone!
statements.tl:
Bakit perpektong kono ang hugis ng Mayon?

Dahil bumubuo ito ng hugis mula sa patong-patong na lava at abo na nagtutumpok nang pantay!

statements.text:
Why is a shield volcano low and broad?

A shield volcano is low and broad because its runny lava flows far before it cools and hardens!
statements.tl:
Bakit mababa at malapad ang shield volcano?

Mababa at malapad ang shield volcano dahil ang malabnaw nitong lava ay umaagos nang malayo bago tumigas!

statements.text:
What makes a complex volcano special?

It has several vents or cones! Taal Volcano is a great example of this.
statements.tl:
Ano ang espesyal sa isang complex volcano?

May maraming bunganga o kono ito! Ang Bulkang Taal ay isang magandang halimbawa.

statements.text: Mayon Volcano in Albay is famous worldwide! It is known for having an almost perfect cone shape.
statements.tl: Ang Bulkang Mayon sa Albay ay sikat sa buong mundo! Kilala ito dahil sa halos perpektong hugis-kono nito.

statements.text:
What makes Mayon Volcano so special?

Mayon Volcano in Albay is famous for its nearly perfect cone shape!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagpapatangi sa Bulkang Mayon?

Ang Bulkang Mayon sa Albay ay sikat sa halos perpektong hugis-kono (cone) nito!

statements.text: The Philippines sits on plate boundaries in the Pacific Ring of Fire! That's why we often feel earthquakes and see volcanoes.
statements.tl: Nasa hangganan ng mga plaka ang Pilipinas sa Pacific Ring of Fire! Kaya madalas tayong makararanas ng lindol at bulkan.

statements.text: The same plate movement that builds our mountains also causes earthquakes here in the Philippines!
statements.tl: Ang parehong paggalaw ng plates na bumubuo ng bundok ang nagdudulot ng mga lindol dito sa Pilipinas!

statements.text:
Where do earthquakes and volcanic eruptions happen most often?

They happen along the edges where tectonic plates meet!
statements.tl:
Saan madalas mangyari ang mga lindol at pagputok ng bulkan?

Nangyayari ito sa mga gilid kung saan nagtatagpo ang mga tectonic plate!

statements.text: New oceanic crust is born at mid-ocean ridges, while old oceanic crust sinks back into Earth at deep ocean trenches!
statements.tl: Ang bagong oceanic crust ay nabubuo sa mid-ocean ridges, habang ang lumang oceanic crust ay lumulubog pabalik sa Earth sa deep ocean trenches!

statements.text: Huge mountain belts like the Alps form where continents crash into each other over millions of years!
statements.tl: Ang mga malalaking bulubundukin tulad ng Alps ay nabubuo kung saan nagbanggaan ang mga kontinente sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon!

statements.text: The Ring of Fire is a geographic area around the Pacific Ocean where many active volcanoes are found along plate boundaries.
statements.tl: Ang Ring of Fire ay isang geographic area sa paligid ng Pacific Ocean kung saan maraming aktibong bulkan ang matatagpuan sa mga plate boundary.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 130utqrpVVXt9JXlDvfrBcmBrGhxVmIts), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do scientists care where earthquake epicenters are located?

Many epicenters cluster near the edges of tectonic plates, so mapping them helps scientists identify roughly where one plate ends and another begins.
statements.tl:
Bakit mahalaga kung saan matatagpuan ang mga earthquake epicenter?

Maraming epicenter ang nagkukumpol malapit sa mga gilid ng tectonic plates, kaya ang pagmapa sa mga ito ay tumutulong sa mga siyentista na makita kung saan humigit-kumulang nagtatapos ang isang plate at nagsisimula ang isa pa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j8nMnJQ0zhFC8nVcRkTo1b_4wbqWP719), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A volcanic arc is a chain of volcanoes that forms on the land above a subducting oceanic plate, arranged in a curved line parallel to the trench.
statements.tl: Ang volcanic arc ay isang hanay ng mga bulkan na nabubuo sa lupa sa itaas ng lumulubog na oceanic plate, na nakaayos sa isang kurbadong linya na kahanay ng trench.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-18002), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why are earthquakes and volcanoes so common in the Philippines?

The Philippines sits right where tectonic plates meet! The movement of these plates causes earthquakes and volcanoes, and PHIVOLCS monitors their activity to keep us safe.
statements.tl:
Bakit madalas ang lindol at bulkan sa Pilipinas?

Ang Pilipinas ay nasa pagtatagpo ng mga tectonic plates! Ang paggalaw ng mga plates na ito ang nagdudulot ng lindol at bulkan, at binabantayan ng PHIVOLCS ang kanilang aktibidad para sa ating kaligtasan.

statements.text: The Philippines has many active volcanoes like Taal, Pinatubo, Kanlaon, and Bulusan! We sit on the Pacific Ring of Fire, a zone full of volcanoes and earthquakes.
statements.tl: Maraming aktibong bulkan ang Pilipinas tulad ng Taal, Pinatubo, Kanlaon, at Bulusan! Nasa Pacific Ring of Fire tayo, isang zone na puno ng bulkan at lindol.

statements.text: Most active volcanoes form where Earth's huge plates meet! In the Philippines, on the Ring of Fire, water from a sinking plate helps mantle rock melt into magma.
statements.tl: Karamihan sa aktibong bulkan ay nabubuo kung saan nagtatagpo ang malalaking plate ng Earth! Sa Pilipinas, sa Ring of Fire, ang tubig mula sa lumulubog na plate ay tumutulong sa pagkatunaw ng bato sa mantle para maging magma.

statements.text: The Philippines is still being shaped today! In geology, it's a young land where active plates beneath us cause earthquakes and volcanoes to erupt.
statements.tl: Patuloy pang hinuhubog ang Pilipinas ngayon! Sa heolohiya, ito ay batang lupain kung saan ang aktibong plaka sa ilalim ay nagdudulot ng lindol at pagsabog ng bulkan.

statements.text: Most of Earth's volcanoes are actually underwater! They sit along the Mid-Ocean Ridge, a massive mountain range rising from the ocean floor.
statements.tl: Karamihan sa mga bulkan ng mundo ay nasa ilalim ng dagat! Nasa Mid-Ocean Ridge sila, isang napakalaking bundok na nakatago sa ilalim.

statements.text: Where oceanic crust sinks under continental crust, earthquakes happen deep underground — the slab keeps breaking far below the surface!
statements.tl: Kapag lumulubog ang oceanic crust sa ilalim ng continental crust, nagkakaroon ng lindol nang malalim — patuloy na nabibiyak ang slab malayo sa surface!

statements.text: Continental crust floats higher on the mantle because it is less dense — that's why much of it lies above sea level!
statements.tl: Ang continental crust ay lumulutang nang mas mataas sa mantle dahil ito ay less dense — kaya malaking bahagi nito ay nasa itaas ng sea level!

statements.text:
What happens when you plot all earthquake epicenters on a world map?

They form narrow bands that trace the edges of Earth's tectonic plates!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag minarkahan mo ang lahat ng epicenter ng lindol sa world map?

Bumubuo sila ng makikitid na guhit na sumusunod sa mga gilid ng tectonic plates ng Earth!

statements.text: Volcanoes aren't scattered randomly — many line up near plate boundaries, forming long chains!
statements.tl: Ang mga bulkan ay hindi nagkalat nang basta-basta — marami ang nakahilera malapit sa mga hangganan ng plates, bumubuo ng mahahabang hanay!

statements.text: Some earthquakes happen far from plate edges, deep inside a single plate, when old faults suddenly slip!
statements.tl: May ilang lindol na nangyayari malayo sa gilid ng plate, sa loob mismo nito, kapag biglang dumulas ang mga lumang fault!

statements.text:
What is the lithosphere made of?

The crust and the very top of the mantle form a rigid layer called the lithosphere! It's broken into large pieces called tectonic plates that slowly float on the softer mantle below.
statements.tl:
Ano ang bumubuo sa lithosphere?

Ang crust at pinakaitaas na bahagi ng mantle ang bumubuo ng matigas na layer na tinatawag na lithosphere! Nahahati ito sa malalaking piraso na tinatawag na tectonic plates na dahan-dahang lumulutang sa mas malambot na mantle sa ibaba.

statements.text: The lithosphere is Earth's rigid outer shell made of the crust and the very top of the mantle! It is broken into tectonic plates.
statements.tl: Ang lithosphere ang matigas na panlabas na balat ng Daigdig na gawa sa crust at pinakaitaas ng mantle! Ito ang nahahati sa mga tectonic plate.

statements.text: Magma rising above a sinking oceanic plate cools into lighter rock, adding fresh material to continental crust!
statements.tl: Ang magma na umaangat sa itaas ng lumulubog na oceanic plate ay lumalamig at nagiging bagong bato na mas magaan, nadadagdagan ang continental crust!

statements.text: Oceanic crust is generally thinner and denser than continental crust. Density compares mass in the same volume; it does not mean a whole oceanic plate must weigh more than a whole continental plate. At many convergent boundaries, dense oceanic lithosphere sinks beneath another plate in subduction.
statements.tl: Karaniwang mas manipis at mas dense ang oceanic crust kaysa continental crust. Inihahambing ng density ang mass sa parehong volume; hindi nito ibig sabihing laging mas mabigat ang buong oceanic plate kaysa buong continental plate. Sa maraming convergent boundary, lumulubog ang dense na oceanic lithosphere sa ilalim ng ibang plate sa subduction.

statements.text: Ophiolite complexes in the Philippines, like those in Zambales, are slices of ancient oceanic crust! They were thrust up onto land by plate collision.
statements.tl: Ang mga ophiolite complex sa Pilipinas, tulad ng nasa Zambales, ay mga piraso ng sinaunang oceanic crust! Itinulak ang mga ito sa lupa sa pamamagitan ng plate collision.

statements.text: Water from a sinking ocean plate lowers the melting point of the mantle above it, creating volcanoes in a line along the subduction zone.
statements.tl: Ang tubig mula sa lumulubog na oceanic plate ay nagpapababa sa melting point ng mantle sa itaas, kaya nagkakaroon ng mga bulkan na nakahilera sa subduction zone.

statements.text: Earthquakes along a sinking oceanic plate can go as deep as 700 kilometers, tracing the cold slab's path as it dives into the mantle!
statements.tl: Ang mga lindol sa lumulubog na oceanic plate ay maaaring mangyari hanggang 700 kilometers ang lalim, sinusundan ang malamig na slab habang sumisisid sa mantle!

statements.text:
Can new ocean crust form far from a mid-ocean ridge?

Yes! Behind some volcanic arcs, the overriding plate stretches and tears open a small ocean basin, creating new oceanic crust far from a mid-ocean ridge.
statements.tl:
Pwede bang mabuo ang bagong oceanic crust malayo sa mid-ocean ridge?

Oo! Sa likod ng ilang bulkan, ang nakapatong na plate ay umuunat at nabibiyak para bumukas ang maliit na basin sa dagat, kaya nagkakaroon ng bagong oceanic crust malayo sa mid-ocean ridge.

statements.text:
Why is continental crust lighter than oceanic crust?

Continental crust is rich in silica, making it light and pale. Oceanic crust has less silica, so it's dark and dense!
statements.tl:
Bakit mas magaan ang continental crust kaysa oceanic crust?

Ang continental crust ay maraming silica kaya magaan at maputla. Ang oceanic crust ay kakaunti ang silica kaya maitim at siksik!

statements.text: Scientists tell oceanic crust from continental crust by timing earthquake waves—the dense rocks of the ocean floor carry waves faster!
statements.tl: Nalalaman ng mga scientist kung oceanic crust o continental crust sa pamamagitan ng pag-time sa earthquake waves—mas mabilis ang alon sa siksik na bato ng sahig ng dagat!

statements.text: Fresh oceanic crust near mid-ocean ridges releases more heat than old continental crust—it's still cooling from molten rock beneath!
statements.tl: Ang bagong oceanic crust malapit sa mid-ocean ridges ay naglalabas ng mas maraming init kaysa lumang continental crust—lumalamig pa ito mula sa tunaw na bato sa ilalim!

statements.text:
How are oceanic and continental crust layers different?

Oceanic crust has a simple three-layer stack: sediment, basalt, and gabbro. Continental crust is a complex jumble of many rock types!
statements.tl:
Paano magkaiba ang mga patong ng oceanic at continental crust?

Ang oceanic crust ay may simpleng tatlong patong: sediment, basalt, at gabbro. Ang continental crust ay magulong halo ng maraming uri ng bato!

statements.text: Over hundreds of millions of years, oceans open where continents split and close where oceanic crust sinks—Earth's crust cycles through breakups and collisions!
statements.tl: Sa daan-daang milyong taon, ang mga karagatan ay bumubukas kung saan naghihiwalay ang mga kontinente at nagsasara kung lumulubog ang oceanic crust—nag-cycle ang crust ng Earth!

statements.text: Earth's lithospheric plates are not just crust! Each plate includes the crust and the rigid top layer of the mantle, moving as one single slab.
statements.tl: Ang mga lithospheric plate ng Earth ay hindi lang crust! Bawat isa ay may kasamang crust at ang matigas na tuktok na layer ng mantle, na gumagalaw bilang isang buong slab.

statements.text:
How fast do tectonic plates drift every year?

They move about 2 to 5 centimeters per year, roughly the length of a paperclip! Their movement is too slow to feel.
statements.tl:
Gaano kabilis ang paggalaw ng mga tectonic plate bawat taon?

Gumagalaw ang mga ito ng 2 hanggang 5 sentimetro bawat taon, halos kasinghaba ng isang paperclip! Napakabagal para maramdaman.

statements.text: Continental crust generally has a granitic composition! Oceanic crust has dark, dense basalt above gabbro.
statements.tl: Karaniwang granitic ang komposisyon ng continental crust! May maitim at siksik na basalt sa ibabaw ng gabbro ang oceanic crust.

statements.text:
Which crust is older, continental or oceanic?

Continental crust! Some are over 3 billion years old. Most oceanic crust is less than about 200 million years old because it gets recycled.
statements.tl:
Alin ang mas matanda, continental crust o oceanic crust?

Continental crust! May mahigit 3 bilyong taon na ang tanda. Ang karamihan sa oceanic crust ay wala pang halos 200 milyong taon dahil nare-recycle ito.

statements.text: When an oceanic plate collides with a continental plate, ocean floor can sink! The land edge crumples into mountains, and rising magma can build volcanoes.
statements.tl: Kapag bumangga ang oceanic plate sa continental plate, maaaring lumubog ang sahig ng dagat! Natutupi ang gilid ng lupa bilang mga bundok, at maaaring bumuo ng bulkan ang umaakyat na magma.

statements.text:
In what year did Mendeleev create his periodic table?

Mendeleev created his famous periodic table way back in the year 1869!
statements.tl:
Saang taon ginawa ni Mendeleev ang kanyang periodic table?

Ginawa ni Mendeleev ang kanyang periodic table noong taong 1869!

statements.text:
Who created the periodic table of elements back in 1869?

A Russian chemist named Dmitri Mendeleev created this awesome chart to organize all the elements!
statements.tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng periodic table of elements noong 1869?

Isang Rusong kemiko na si Dmitri Mendeleev ang gumawa ng napakahusay na tsart na ito para sa mga elemento!

statements.text:
How did Mendeleev predict undiscovered elements?

He left gaps in his table and correctly predicted elements that had not yet been discovered!
statements.tl:
Paano nahulaan ni Mendeleev ang mga elementong hindi pa natutuklasan?

Nag-iwan siya ng mga puwang sa kanyang table at tama niyang hinulaan ang mga elementong hindi pa natutuklasan!

statements.text: Moseley used X-rays to show that atomic number, not atomic mass, is the true basis for ordering the elements!
statements.tl: Gumamit si Moseley ng X-rays upang ipakita na ang atomic number, hindi ang atomic mass, ang tunay na batayan sa pag-aayos ng mga elemento!

statements.text: The periodic table lets scientists predict how an unknown element will react based on its position among known neighbors!
statements.tl: Pinapayagan ng periodic table ang mga scientist na hulaan kung paano magre-react ang isang hindi pa kilalang element batay sa posisyon nito sa mga kilalang elementong kapitbahay!

statements.text:
Why did Dobereiner group elements into sets of three?

He noticed that in some triads, the middle element's atomic mass is close to the average of the other two!
statements.tl:
Bakit pinangkat ni Dobereiner ang mga elemento sa tatluhan?

Napansin niya na sa ilang triad, ang atomic mass ng gitnang elemento ay malapit sa average ng dalawa pa!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-8yznyWppT66H5YOPGNdRYJVDsdXpEj7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Not all elements fit Dobereiner's triad pattern, so scientists kept searching for a better way to organize them.
statements.tl: Hindi lahat ng elemento ay sumusunod sa triad pattern ni Dobereiner, kaya naghanap pa ang mga scientist ng mas maayos na paraan para i-organisa sila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-8yznyWppT66H5YOPGNdRYJVDsdXpEj7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Who created the first periodic table?

Russian scientist Dmitri Mendeleev created the first widely used periodic table in 1869 by grouping elements with similar properties together.
statements.tl:
Sino ang gumawa ng unang periodic table?

Ang Rusong siyentista na si Dmitri Mendeleev ang gumawa ng unang malawakang ginamit na periodic table noong 1869 sa pamamagitan ng pagpapangkat ng magkakatulad na elemento.

statements.text:
How did Mendeleev predict new elements?

Mendeleev left empty gaps in his table and predicted what undiscovered elements would be like. When found, his predictions matched closely!
statements.tl:
Paano nahulaan ni Mendeleev ang mga bagong elemento?

Nag-iwan si Mendeleev ng mga puwang sa kanyang talahanayan at hinulaan ang mga elementong hindi pa natutuklasan. Nang matagpuan ang mga ito, tumama ang kanyang hula!

statements.text: Dmitri Mendeleev was a Russian scientist who created the first widely used periodic table of the elements!
statements.tl: Si Dmitri Mendeleev ay isang siyentipikong Ruso na gumawa ng unang malawak na ginamit na periodic table!

statements.text:
How did Mendeleev know about undiscovered elements?

He left gaps in his periodic table and predicted elements like gallium and germanium!
statements.tl:
Paano nalaman ni Mendeleev ang mga hindi pa natutuklasang elemento?

Nag-iwan siya ng mga puwang sa periodic table at hinulaan ang mga elemento tulad ng gallium at germanium!

statements.text:
How did Mendeleev organize the elements?

He arranged the elements in order of increasing atomic mass and by their similar properties!
statements.tl:
Paano inayos ni Mendeleev ang mga elemento?

Inayos niya ang mga elemento ayon sa pataas na atomic mass at sa magkakatulad na katangian nila!

statements.text: Dmitri Mendeleev created the periodic table that neatly arranges all the elements by their properties! It helps us learn science.
statements.tl: Si Dmitri Mendeleev ang gumawa ng periodic table na nag-aayos ng mga elemento ayon sa kanilang mga katangian! Nakakatulong ito sa pag-aaral natin.

statements.text:
How did early scientists compare different elements?

John Dalton assigned relative atomic weights to elements he studied! This shared number let early scientists easily compare them.
statements.tl:
Paano inihambing ng mga unang siyentista ang iba't ibang elemento?

Binigyan ni John Dalton ang mga elementong pinag-aralan niya ng relatibong atomic weight! Ginamit ng mga siyentista ang numerong ito para paghambingin sila.

statements.text: Lothar Meyer plotted atomic volume against atomic mass! He saw a periodic pattern that perfectly matched Mendeleev's table.
statements.tl: Nag-plot si Lothar Meyer ng atomic volume laban sa atomic mass! Nakakita siya ng pattern na tumugma sa table ni Mendeleev.

statements.text:
Did Mendeleev just copy old numbers?

Nope! He used his table to correct the atomic masses of known elements because their positions showed the old values were wrong!
statements.tl:
Kinopya lang ba ni Mendeleev ang mga lumang numero?

Hindi! Ginamit niya ang kanyang talahanayan para itama ang atomic mass ng ilang elemento, dahil ipinakita ng posisyon nila na mali ang lumang halaga!

statements.text: Henry Moseley discovered that arranging elements by atomic number, the number of protons, fixed the confusing order caused by atomic mass!
statements.tl: Natuklasan ni Henry Moseley na ang pagsasaayos ng mga elemento ayon sa atomic number, o bilang ng protons, ang nag-ayos sa nakakalitong pagkakasunod-sunod ng atomic mass!

statements.text:
Where do the heavy actinide elements go?

Glenn Seaborg moved the actinide elements to a separate row below the main periodic table, reshaping how heavy elements are shown!
statements.tl:
Saan napupunta ang mga mabibigat na actinide elements?

Inilipat ni Glenn Seaborg ang mga actinide elements sa hiwalay na hanay sa ibaba ng main periodic table, kaya nabago ang pagpapakita sa mga mabibigat na elemento!

statements.text: The chemical symbol for oxygen is simply the letter O!
statements.tl: Ang simbolong kemikal ng oxygen ay ang letrang O!

statements.text: The chemical symbol for hydrogen is simply the letter H!
statements.tl: Ang simbolong kemikal ng hydrogen ay ang letrang H!

statements.text: Did you know? The chemical symbol for calcium is Ca!
statements.tl: Alam mo ba? Ang chemical symbol ng calcium (kalsyum) ay Ca!

statements.text: The chemical symbol for aluminum is Al!
statements.tl: Ang chemical symbol ng aluminum (aluminyo) ay Al!

statements.text: The six most common elements in biomolecules are carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus, and sulfur, remembered as CHNOPS.
statements.tl: Ang anim na pinakakaraniwang elemento sa biomolecules ay carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus, at sulfur, na tinatawag na CHNOPS.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 11rlBmDYYeBKkf4JWfT9Dqf3aeIoILCvS), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is the empirical formula of a compound with sodium, aluminum, and fluorine?

With 32.79% Na, 13.02% Al, and 54.19% F, the empirical formula is Na3AlF6, a mineral called cryolite!
statements.tl:
Ano ang empirical formula ng isang compound na may sodium, aluminum, at fluorine?

Sa 32.79% Na, 13.02% Al, at 54.19% F, ang empirical formula ay Na3AlF6, isang mineral na tinatawag na cryolite!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 16_vWKOKw6tJwTeIBBX0bOpOAZmQb2dzt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Neon, with the symbol Ne, is a representative element found in Group 18, the column of gases called the noble gases that rarely react with other elements.
statements.tl: Ang neon, na may symbol na Ne, ay isang representative element na matatagpuan sa Group 18, ang column ng mga gas na tinatawag na noble gases na bihirang makipag-react sa ibang elemento.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18dQJakZHEC0ewQvVaNdQNFmVM0APW-RM), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Magnesium is involved in over 300 metabolic reactions in the body, meaning it helps with many chemical processes that keep us alive.
statements.tl: Ang magnesium ay kasangkot sa mahigit 300 metabolic reactions sa katawan, ibig sabihin tumutulong ito sa maraming chemical processes na nagpapanatili sa atin na buhay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1CjelWcxW4JPq8g6e9k-jq4Eo05sAKeDr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Iron is an element with the symbol Fe, made of only one type of atom, so it cannot be broken down into simpler substances.
statements.tl: Ang bakal ay isang element na may symbol na Fe, gawa sa iisang uri lang ng atom, kaya hindi ito mahahati sa mas simpleng substance.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1KiyHKY5i6coJnOnbN9Ymf6YS0VMUX4xN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Baking soda has the chemical formula NaHCO3, which means it contains the elements sodium, hydrogen, carbon, and oxygen.
statements.tl: Ang baking soda ay may chemical formula na NaHCO3, na nangangahulugang naglalaman ito ng mga elementong sodium, hydrogen, carbon, at oxygen.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1NH0eUpQRtoiRyTPtQz3L7ThhnsuGPtx0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl) is a compound found in some bleaches, and it is made of the elements sodium, oxygen, and chlorine.
statements.tl: Ang sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl) ay isang compound na matatagpuan sa ilang mga bleach, at ito ay gawa sa mga elementong sodium, oxygen, at chlorine.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1NH0eUpQRtoiRyTPtQz3L7ThhnsuGPtx0), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Diboron monosilicide has the formula B2Si, because di- means 2 boron atoms and mono- means 1 silicon atom.
statements.tl: Ang diboron monosilicide ay may formula na B2Si, dahil ang di- ay nangangahulugang 2 boron atoms at ang mono- ay nangangahulugang 1 silicon atom.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1QQVPx5gTh9yEEAXDkBGgrjBjPXg_itUY), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is the formula for diphosphorus tetroxide?

Di- means 2 phosphorus atoms and tetra- means 4 oxygen atoms, so the formula is P2O4!
statements.tl:
Ano ang formula para sa diphosphorus tetroxide?

Ang di- ay nangangahulugang 2 phosphorus atoms at ang tetra- ay nangangahulugang 4 oxygen atoms, kaya ang formula ay P2O4!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1QQVPx5gTh9yEEAXDkBGgrjBjPXg_itUY), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What is the formula for disulfur trioxide?

Di- means 2 sulfur atoms and tri- means 3 oxygen atoms, so the formula is S2O3!
statements.tl:
Ano ang formula para sa disulfur trioxide?

Ang di- ay nangangahulugang 2 sulfur atoms at ang tri- ay nangangahulugang 3 oxygen atoms, kaya ang formula ay S2O3!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1QQVPx5gTh9yEEAXDkBGgrjBjPXg_itUY), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Sodium nitrate (NaNO3) is 27.05% sodium, 16.48% nitrogen, and 56.47% oxygen by mass.
statements.tl: Ang sodium nitrate (NaNO3) ay 27.05% sodium, 16.48% nitrogen, at 56.47% oxygen ayon sa bigat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1fho5_vuRaN4zeZF-PJveoROwbZ2SsCN7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The modern periodic table lists 118 known elements, each with its own unique chemical symbol and atomic number.
statements.tl: Ang modernong periodic table ay naglalaman ng 118 kilalang element, bawat isa ay may sariling natatanging chemical symbol at atomic number.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1wJ1XNpQQftA2smaT-ZcxrgWJifOb3tiz), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Is helium a compound?

No! Helium is an element, not a compound, because it is made of only one kind of atom. Ammonia, hydrogen peroxide, and table sugar are compounds.
statements.tl:
Ang helium ba ay isang compound?

Hindi! Ang helium ay isang element, hindi compound, dahil gawa ito sa iisang uri lang ng atom. Ang ammonia, hydrogen peroxide, at table sugar ay mga compound.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yBBQ8qWfSyCPNeuVJO4vS43PLtKH27QJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Chemical symbols like Cu for copper, W for tungsten, Fe for iron, and Au for gold come from the first letters or Latin names of elements.
statements.tl: Ang mga chemical symbol tulad ng Cu para sa copper, W para sa tungsten, Fe para sa iron, at Au para sa gold ay galing sa mga unang letra o Latin na pangalan ng mga element.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1yBBQ8qWfSyCPNeuVJO4vS43PLtKH27QJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Elements in the periodic table are arranged by atomic number! This is simply the number of protons in their atoms.
statements.tl: Ang mga elemento sa periodic table ay nakaayos ayon sa atomic number! Ito yung bilang ng proton sa kanilang mga atomo.

statements.text: The vertical columns in the periodic table are called groups! Elements in the same group usually share similar properties.
statements.tl: Ang mga patayong hanay sa periodic table ay tinatawag na mga grupo! Ang mga elemento sa isang grupo ay karaniwang may magkakatulad na katangian.

statements.text: The periodic table also has 18 groups! These are the vertical columns that stand tall and organize the elements from top to bottom.
statements.tl: Mayroon ding 18 na group ang periodic table! Ito yung mga patayong hanay na nakatayo nang matatag mula itaas hanggang ibaba.

statements.text: The noble gases live in Group 18 of the periodic table, and they almost never react with other elements!
statements.tl: Ang mga noble gas ay nasa Group 18 ng periodic table, at halos hindi sila nakikipagreaksyon sa ibang elemento!

statements.text:
Where do halogens live on the periodic table?

The halogens are in Group 17! They are highly reactive nonmetals.
statements.tl:
Nasaan ang mga halogen sa periodic table?

Ang mga halogen ay nasa Group 17! Sila ay highly reactive na nonmetals.

statements.text:
What do we call the horizontal rows in the periodic table?

They are called periods! The main periodic table has exactly seven horizontal periods.
statements.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa mga pahalang na hanay sa periodic table?

Tinatawag silang periods! Ang pangunahing periodic table ay may eksaktong pitong pahalang na period.

statements.text: Halogens like fluorine and chlorine are in Group 17. They are reactive nonmetals that have exactly seven valence electrons!
statements.tl: Ang mga halogen gaya ng fluorine at chlorine ay nasa Group 17. Sila ay mga reaktibong di-metal na may pitong valence electrons!

statements.text: Electron affinity, the energy change when an atom gains an electron, shows periodic trends across periods and groups.
statements.tl: Ang electron affinity, ang pagbabago ng energy kapag tumatanggap ng electron ang isang atom, ay nagpapakita ng periodic trends sa mga period at group.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-8yznyWppT66H5YOPGNdRYJVDsdXpEj7), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Noble gases belong to Group VIIIA and are known for being stable because their outermost shell is full.
statements.tl: Ang noble gases ay kabilang sa Group VIIIA at kilala sa pagiging stable dahil puno ang kanilang pinakalabas na shell.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 11Z82LSVMtO0A-VWBD3BRTNhq_2XUrecl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The periodic table is a map of elements arranged in columns called groups and rows called periods, so each element has a group number and a period number that tell its location.
statements.tl: Ang periodic table ay parang mapa ng mga elemento na nakaayos sa mga column na tinatawag na group at row na tinatawag na period, kaya bawat elemento ay may group number at period number na nagsasabi kung saan ito matatagpuan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18dQJakZHEC0ewQvVaNdQNFmVM0APW-RM), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Francium, with the symbol Fr, belongs to Group 1, the column of soft, very reactive metals called the alkali metals, and it is named after the country France.
statements.tl: Ang francium, na may symbol na Fr, ay kabilang sa Group 1, ang column ng malalambot at napaka-reactive na metal na tinatawag na alkali metals, at ito ay ipinangalan sa bansang France.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18dQJakZHEC0ewQvVaNdQNFmVM0APW-RM), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In Group 17, the halogens, reactivity generally decreases from top to bottom: fluorine is extremely reactive and iodine much less so.
statements.tl: Sa Group 17, ang mga halogen, karaniwang bumababa ang reactivity mula itaas pababa: ang fluorine ay sobrang reactive at ang iodine ay hindi gaanong reactive.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1A33wIXqvdUF0ZswX0cOqHUx-86szx2UZ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Can the periodic table tell you about an element you have never seen?

Yes! The periodic law lets scientists predict melting point, density, and reactivity based on where the element sits in the table.
statements.tl:
Masasabi ba ng periodic table ang tungkol sa isang elementong hindi mo pa nakikita?

Oo! Ang periodic law ay nagbibigay-daan sa mga siyentista na hulaan ang melting point, density, at reactivity batay sa kung saan nakaupo ang elemento sa table.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1A33wIXqvdUF0ZswX0cOqHUx-86szx2UZ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Halogens like fluorine and chlorine are nonmetals that are very reactive, meaning they easily combine with other elements.
statements.tl: Ang halogens tulad ng fluorine at chlorine ay mga nonmetal na napaka-reactive, ibig sabihin madali silang sumama sa ibang element.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1CjelWcxW4JPq8g6e9k-jq4Eo05sAKeDr), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Metals are mostly located on the left side of the periodic table and make up the largest class of elements, with examples like iron, copper, and aluminum.
statements.tl: Ang mga metal ay kadalasang matatagpuan sa kaliwang bahagi ng periodic table at sila ang pinakamalaking klase ng elemento, tulad ng bakal, tanso, at aluminum.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1IIRcY8Mf1r8GQDgkc7YgacvZq5uxNuqj), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Groups 1, 2, and 13 through 18 are called representative elements or main group elements, and they show the most regular patterns in chemical behavior.
statements.tl: Ang Groups 1, 2, at 13 hanggang 18 ay tinatawag na representative elements o main group elements, at sila ang nagpapakita ng pinaka-regular na pattern sa chemical behavior.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1fWrjwTGLfYS7udgEf7dxrFfAY6lE7AjT), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Chlorine has the electron configuration 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p5, with seven valence electrons, placing it in group 17 of the periodic table.
statements.tl: Ang chlorine ay may electron configuration na 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p5, na may pitong valence electrons, kaya ito ay nasa group 17 ng periodic table.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1sxhJG0I1u3GY6CsBxS8c-XUBvBVk_Nwg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why are noble gases so special?

Noble gases like helium and neon are in the last column of the periodic table. They rarely react, so helium safely fills balloons and neon glows in signs!
statements.tl:
Bakit espesyal ang noble gases?

Ang noble gases tulad ng helium at neon ay nasa huling haligi ng periodic table. Bihira silang mag-react, kaya ligtas ang helium sa lobo at ang neon sa mga nagliliwanag na karatula!

statements.text: An element's electron structure, especially its valence electrons, determines its position in the periodic table.
statements.tl: Ang electron structure ng isang elemento, lalo na ang mga valence electron nito, ang tumutukoy sa posisyon nito sa periodic table.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qUYN0USdQvm1dkGeaiOJnqaHhKmWuEJq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An element's period number tells exactly how many electron shells, or energy levels, its atoms have!
statements.tl: Ang numero ng period ng isang elemento ay nagsasabi kung ilang electron shell o energy level mayroon ang atomo nito!

statements.text: The outermost shell of an atom is called the valence shell. Its electrons are the ones that join in chemical bonds!
statements.tl: Ang pinakalabas na shell ng isang atom ay tinatawag na valence shell. Ang mga electron nito ang sumasali sa mga chemical bond!

statements.text: Noble gases like helium, neon, and argon are in Group 18. They almost never react because their outer electron shell is already full!
statements.tl: Ang mga noble gas gaya ng helium, neon, at argon ay nasa Group 18. Halos hindi sila nakikipagreaksyon dahil puno na ang panlabas na shell nila!

statements.text: Lithium has one valence electron in its outermost shell, which is why its electron dot diagram shows a single dot next to its symbol.
statements.tl: Ang Lithium ay may isang valence electron sa pinakalabas nitong shell, kaya ang electron dot diagram nito ay nagpapakita ng isang tuldok sa tabi ng simbolo nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1JuD1DgG__dcHh86xu0R6B3oLftUvefHc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Neon has the electron configuration 1s2 2s2 2p6, meaning its outermost energy level is completely full with eight electrons.
statements.tl: Ang neon ay may electron configuration na 1s2 2s2 2p6, ibig sabihin ang pinakalabas nitong energy level ay punong-puno ng walong electron.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qUYN0USdQvm1dkGeaiOJnqaHhKmWuEJq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why is an element located where it is on the periodic table?

Its electron structure, especially the number of valence electrons, determines its group and period!
statements.tl:
Bakit matatagpuan ang isang elemento sa kinaroroonan nito sa periodic table?

Ang electron structure nito, lalo na ang bilang ng valence electron, ang tumutukoy sa grupo at period nito!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qUYN0USdQvm1dkGeaiOJnqaHhKmWuEJq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Electron configuration, the arrangement of electrons in shells around an atom, can help determine an element's properties and its location on the periodic table.
statements.tl: Ang electron configuration, ang pagkakaayos ng mga electron sa shells sa paligid ng atom, ay makakatulong upang malaman ang katangian ng isang element at ang kinalalagyan nito sa periodic table.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1sG3JI7A_58gRgWEkhx2NLTEIyiyHFUL8), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Sodium has the electron configuration 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s1, which tells us it is in period 3, group 1, and has one valence electron.
statements.tl: Ang sodium ay may electron configuration na 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s1, na nagsasabi sa atin na ito ay nasa period 3, group 1, at may isang valence electron.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1sxhJG0I1u3GY6CsBxS8c-XUBvBVk_Nwg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What happens to atoms as you move down the periodic table?
