Each row adds a new electron shell! Because of this, the atoms get larger as you move down.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa mga atomo habang bumababa ka sa periodic table?

Bawat hanay ay nagdaragdag ng bagong balat ng elektron! Kaya lumalaki ang mga atomo habang bumababa ka.

statements.text:
Where does sodium belong on the periodic table?

Sodium's 11 electrons sit in three shells as 2-8-1! So, it belongs in period 3, group 1, right below lithium.
statements.tl:
Saan nabibilang ang sodium sa periodic table?

Ang 11 electrons ng sodium ay nasa tatlong shells bilang 2-8-1! Kaya ito ay kabilang sa period 3, group 1, sa ilalim ng lithium.

statements.text: Many atoms gain, lose, or share electrons to reach eight in their outer shell! This drive shapes how elements in each group behave.
statements.tl: Maraming atom ang kumukuha, nawawalan, o nagbabahagi ng electrons para umabot sa walo sa kanilang outer shell! Ito ang humuhubog kung paano kumilos ang mga elements sa bawat group.

statements.text: Halogens in group 17 have seven outer electrons! They need just one more to fill their shell, making them very reactive nonmetals.
statements.tl: Ang mga halogens sa group 17 ay may pitong outer electrons! Kailangan na lang nila ng isa pa para mapuno ang shell, kaya napaka-reactive nila bilang nonmetals.

statements.text: In transition metals, new electrons go into an inner shell rather than the outer one! That's why they sit in the middle block of the table.
statements.tl: Sa mga transition metal, ang bagong electron ay pumapasok sa inner shell imbes na sa outer shell! Kaya sila nasa gitnang block ng table.

statements.text: The lanthanides and actinides sit below the main table! Their extra electrons fill deep inner f-orbitals, not the outer shell.
statements.tl: Ang mga lanthanides at actinides ay nasa ibaba ng main table! Ang extra electrons nila ay pumupuno sa malalim na inner f-orbitals, hindi sa outer shell.

statements.text:
Why does helium sit with the noble gases?

Helium has only two electrons! But because its first shell is full, it sits with the noble gases in group 18.
statements.tl:
Bakit kasama ang helium sa mga noble gases?

Ang helium ay may dalawang electron lang! Pero dahil puno na ang first shell nito, kasama ito ng mga noble gas sa group 18.

statements.text:
Why does every element get its own special box on the table?

Because neutral atoms of different elements have different electron arrangements in their shells!
statements.tl:
Bakit may sariling kahon ang bawat elemento sa table?

Dahil magkakaiba ang electron arrangement sa shells ng neutral na atoms ng iba't ibang elemento!

statements.text:
How does chlorine's electron setup help it make table salt?

Its 17 electrons are arranged 2-8-7! This places it in period 3, group 17, pairing with sodium.
statements.tl:
Paano nakakatulong ang electron setup ng chlorine para gumawa ng table salt?

Ang 17 electrons nito ay nakaayos na 2-8-7! Kaya nasa period 3, group 17 ito, sumasama sa sodium.

statements.text: A boron atom with mass number 11 and atomic number 5 has 5 protons, 5 electrons, and 6 neutrons.
statements.tl: Ang boron atom na may mass number 11 at atomic number 5 ay may 5 protons, 5 electrons, at 6 neutrons.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-24693), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a neutral atom, the number of protons perfectly equals the number of electrons!
statements.tl: Sa isang neutral na atomo, ang bilang ng proton ay eksaktong katumbas ng bilang ng electron!

statements.text: To find the number of neutrons, subtract the atomic number from the mass number! For example, 12 minus 6 gives us 6 neutrons in carbon.
statements.tl: Para malaman ang bilang ng neutron, ibawas ang atomic number sa mass number! Halimbawa, 12 binawasan ng 6 ay nagbibigay ng 6 na neutron sa carbon.

statements.text:
What are isotopes?

They are different versions of the same element with the same number of protons but a different number of neutrons, like carbon-12 and carbon-14!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mga isotope?

Ito ay magkakaibang bersyon ng iisang element na may parehong bilang ng proton pero magkaibang bilang ng neutron, gaya ng carbon-12 at carbon-14!

statements.text: The atomic number of helium (He) is 2, so it has exactly 2 protons!
statements.tl: Ang atomic number ng helium (He) ay 2, kaya may 2 proton ito!

statements.text: The atomic number of lithium (Li) is 3, so it has exactly 3 protons!
statements.tl: Ang atomic number ng lithium (Li) ay 3, kaya may 3 proton ito!

statements.text: The atomic number of carbon (C) is 6, so it has exactly 6 protons!
statements.tl: Ang atomic number ng carbon (C) ay 6, kaya may 6 proton ito!

statements.text: Aluminum (Al) has an atomic number of 13. Because of this, it contains exactly 13 protons!
statements.tl: Ang aluminum (Al) ay may atomic number na 13. Dahil dito, ito ay may 13 proton!

statements.text:
How many valence electrons does boron have?

Boron's configuration is 1s2 2s2 2p1, so its highest level is 2, and adding the electrons there (2 + 1) gives it 3 valence electrons!
statements.tl:
Ilang valence electron mayroon ang boron?

Ang configuration ng boron ay 1s2 2s2 2p1, kaya ang pinakamataas na level nito ay 2, at kapag pinagsama ang mga electron doon (2 + 1), mayroon itong 3 valence electron!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qUYN0USdQvm1dkGeaiOJnqaHhKmWuEJq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Carbon, with six electrons, has the electron configuration 1s2 2s2 2p2, filling the first level and starting the second.
statements.tl: Ang carbon, na may anim na electron, ay may electron configuration na 1s2 2s2 2p2, pinupuno ang unang level at sinisimulan ang ikalawa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qUYN0USdQvm1dkGeaiOJnqaHhKmWuEJq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Oxygen has three stable isotopes, O-16, O-17, and O-18, which all have 8 protons but 8, 9, and 10 neutrons.
statements.tl: Ang oxygen ay may tatlong stable isotopes, ang O-16, O-17, at O-18, na lahat ay may 8 protons pero may 8, 9, at 10 neutrons.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1zy9Fv7IX9sF61gDVJzjs3w1I9xmIMARK), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The mass number is the total count of protons and neutrons hiding inside the nucleus!
statements.tl: Ang mass number ay ang kabuuang bilang ng proton at neutron na nagtatago sa loob ng nucleus!

statements.text: Isotopes are atoms of the same element with the same proton number but different neutron numbers. For example, carbon-12 and carbon-14 are both carbon but have different masses!
statements.tl: Ang mga isotope ay mga atom ng parehong elemento na may parehong proton number pero iba ang neutron number. Halimbawa, ang carbon-12 at carbon-14 ay parehong carbon pero iba ang mass!

statements.text: Zinc (Zn) has an atomic number of 30, which means every zinc atom has exactly 30 protons!
statements.tl: Ang atomic number ng zinc (Zn) ay 30, kaya ang bawat atom nito ay may eksaktong 30 proton!

statements.text: Mercury (Hg) has an atomic number of 80, which means every mercury atom contains 80 protons!
statements.tl: Ang atomic number ng mercury (Hg) ay 80, ibig sabihin ang bawat atom nito ay may 80 proton!

statements.text: Carbon-12 and carbon-14 are awesome isotopes of carbon! They both have 6 protons, but they have a different number of neutrons.
statements.tl: Ang carbon-12 at carbon-14 ay magagandang isotopo ng carbon! Pareho silang may 6 na proton, pero magkaiba ang bilang ng neutron.

statements.text:
What is the mass number of an atom?

It's the total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus! For example, carbon with 6 protons and 6 neutrons has a mass number of 12.
statements.tl:
Ano ang mass number ng isang atom?

Ito ang kabuuang bilang ng proton at neutron sa nucleus! Halimbawa, ang carbon na may 6 na proton at 6 na neutron ay may mass number na 12.

statements.text:
What makes isotopes of the same element different from each other?

They have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons, like carbon-12 and carbon-14!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagpapaiba sa mga isotopo ng parehong elemento?

May parehong bilang ng proton sila ngunit magkaibang bilang ng neutron, gaya ng carbon-12 at carbon-14!

statements.text:
Why does helium have only two valence electrons but still belong to Group VIIIA?

Helium's outermost shell can only hold two electrons, so it is already full and stable!
statements.tl:
Bakit dalawa lang ang valence electrons ng helium pero kabilang pa rin sa Group VIIIA?

Ang pinakalabas na shell ng helium ay dalawang electron lang ang kayang hawakan, kaya puno na ito at stable!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 11Z82LSVMtO0A-VWBD3BRTNhq_2XUrecl), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Main-group elements in the same group usually have the same number of valence electrons, helping explain similar chemical properties. Helium is an exception: it has 2 outer electrons, while the other group 18 elements have 8. Transition metals do not follow this simple counting rule in the same way.
statements.tl: Karaniwang pareho ang bilang ng valence electron ng mga elemento sa parehong main group, kaya magkatulad ang ilang katangiang kemikal. Eksepsiyon ang helium: may 2 electron sa labas, samantalang may 8 ang iba sa group 18. Hindi sumusunod sa parehong simpleng pagbilang ang transition metals.

statements.text: Halogens like fluorine and chlorine are in Group 17. They are reactive nonmetals that have exactly seven valence electrons!
statements.tl: Ang mga halogen gaya ng fluorine at chlorine ay nasa Group 17. Sila ay mga reaktibong di-metal na may pitong valence electrons!

statements.text: Transition metals in the middle columns skip the simple group-number rule for valence electrons, so let's focus on the main groups!
statements.tl: Ang mga transition metals sa gitnang column ay hindi sumusunod sa simpleng group-number rule para sa valence electrons, kaya mag-focus tayo sa main groups!

statements.text: Helium has two valence electrons, while other noble gases have eight! This complete set makes them super stable and happy.
statements.tl: Ang helium ay may dalawang valence electrons, habang ang ibang noble gases ay may walo! Ang kumpletong set na ito ang nagpapaging super stable sa kanila.

statements.text:
Why do elements in the same group often behave alike?

Because many have the same number of outer electrons! This helps control how they react with other things.
statements.tl:
Bakit magkakatulad ang katangian ng mga elemento sa iisang group?

Dahil marami sa kanila ay pare-pareho ang bilang ng kanilang panlabas na elektron! Tumutulong ito na magtakda kung paano sila mag-react.

statements.text: Noble gases like helium, neon, and argon almost never bond! Their outer shell is already full, so they don't need to gain or share electrons.
statements.tl: Halos hindi nagbobond ang mga noble gas gaya ng helium, neon, at argon! Puno na ang kanilang panlabas na shell, kaya hindi na sila nangangailangang tumanggap o magbahagi ng elektron.

statements.text: In the periodic table, main-group elements in the same group usually have the same number of valence electrons, with helium an exception and similar chemical properties. For example, noble gases are almost unreactive!
statements.tl: Sa periodic table, karaniwang pareho ang bilang ng valence electron ng mga main-group element sa parehong grupo, maliban sa helium at similar chemical properties. Halimbawa, ang noble gases ay halos hindi nagre-react!

statements.text:
Why do elements in the same main group behave similarly?

Because they have usually the same number of valence electrons! This makes them act alike in chemical reactions.
statements.tl:
Bakit magkakatulad ang pag-uugali ng mga elemento sa parehong main group?

Dahil karaniwang pareho ang bilang ng valence electrons nila! Kaya magkakatulad ang kanilang pag-uugali sa chemical reactions.

statements.text:
Why are alkali metals like sodium and potassium so reactive in Group 1?

They are very reactive because they have just one valence electron!
statements.tl:
Bakit napakareaktibo ng mga alkali metal gaya ng sodium at potassium sa Group 1?

Napakareaktibo nila dahil may isang valence electron lamang sila!

statements.text: Elements in a family behave alike because they usually share the same number of valence electrons, letting us predict their reactions!
statements.tl: Magkakatulad ang pag-uugali ng mga elemento sa isang pamilya dahil karaniwang pareho ang bilang ng kanilang valence electrons, kaya maaaring hulaan ang kanilang reaksyon!

statements.text:
What does the group number tell us about an atom?

For the main groups, the group number tells you how many valence electrons an atom has! Like group 2 means two.
statements.tl:
Ano ang sinasabi ng group number tungkol sa isang atom?

Para sa mga pangunahing grupo, ang numero ng grupo ang nagsasabi kung ilang valence electron mayroon ang atom! Tulad ng grupo 2 na ibig sabihin ay dalawa.

statements.text:
Why do magnesium and calcium react in similar ways?

Magnesium and calcium are in group 2! So both have two valence electrons and react in similar ways.
statements.tl:
Bakit magkatulad ang paraan ng reaksyon ng magnesium at calcium?

Ang magnesium at calcium ay nasa grupo 2! Kaya pareho silang may dalawang valence electron at magkatulad ang paraan ng kanilang reaksyon.

statements.text: Carbon and silicon are in group 14! With four valence electrons each, they can form four bonds.
statements.tl: Nasa group 14 ang carbon at silicon! Dahil may apat na valence electrons sila, nakakagawa sila ng apat na bonds.

statements.text:
Why do nitrogen and phosphorus often make three bonds?

They are in group 15 with five valence electrons each, which helps them make three bonds!
statements.tl:
Bakit madalas gumagawa ng tatlong bonds ang nitrogen at phosphorus?

Nasa group 15 sila at may limang valence electrons, kaya madalas silang gumagawa ng tatlong bonds!

statements.text: Group 1 metals have one valence electron and react more easily than group 2 metals, which have two!
statements.tl: Ang group 1 metals ay may isang valence electron at mas madaling mag-react kaysa group 2 na may dalawa!

statements.text:
What happens to valence electrons when you move across a period or down a group?

Moving across a period changes the number, but moving down a group keeps the number the same!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa valence electrons kapag gumalaw pahalang sa period o pababa sa group?

Kapag pumahalang sa period, nagbabago ang bilang, pero pababa sa group, nananatili itong pareho!

statements.text:
Do elements in the same group have the same number of electron shells?

No! They don't have the same electron shells, but they do have the same number of valence electrons.
statements.tl:
Magkakapareho ba ng bilang ng electron shells ang mga elemento sa parehong group?

Hindi! Hindi pareho ang electron shells nila, pero pareho sila ng bilang ng valence electrons.

statements.text: About 71% of Earth's surface is covered by water! That's exactly why our planet looks blue from space.
statements.tl: Mga 71% ng ibabaw ng Earth ay natatakpan ng tubig! Kaya naman asul itong tingnan mula sa kalawakan.

statements.text:
How much of Earth is actually land?

Only about 29% of Earth's surface is land! The rest of the surface is water.
statements.tl:
Gaano karami sa ibabaw ng Mundo ang lupa?

Halos 29% lang ng ibabaw ng Mundo ang lupa! Ang natitira sa ibabaw ay tubig.

statements.text: The ocean covers about 71 percent of Earth's surface, which is way more than the land!
statements.tl: Saklaw ng karagatan ang halos 71 porsiyento ng ibabaw ng Earth — mas malaki kaysa sa lupa!

statements.text: Wow, about 71 percent of Earth's surface is covered by water!
statements.tl: Naku, halos 71 porsyento ng ibabaw ng Daigdig ay natatakpan ng tubig!

statements.text:
How much of Earth is actually dry land?

Only about 29 percent of Earth's surface is land—the rest is water!
statements.tl:
Gaano karami sa Earth ang tuyong lupa?

Humigit-kumulang 29 porsyento lamang ng ibabaw ng Earth ang lupa—ang iba ay tubig!

statements.text:
Why is Earth called the "blue planet"?

Because oceans cover more than half of it! About 7 out of 10 parts of Earth's surface are water.
statements.tl:
Bakit tinatawag ang Earth na "blue planet"?

Dahil tumatakip ang mga karagatan sa higit sa kalahati nito! Mga 7 sa bawat 10 bahagi ng Earth ay tubig.

statements.text: Most meteorites splash into the ocean because water covers most of Earth's surface!
statements.tl: Karamihan sa mga meteorite ay nahuhulog sa dagat dahil tubig ang nakatatakip sa karamihan ng ibabaw ng Mundo!

statements.text: From space, Earth looks blue — that's why it's called the "blue planet"! Much of its surface is covered with oceans. Other planets have different colors because of their atmospheres and surfaces.
statements.tl: Mula sa espasyo, ang Earth ay mukhang asul — kaya tinatawag itong "blue planet"! Malaking bahagi ng ibabaw nito ay natatakpan ng mga karagatan. Iba-iba ang kulay ng ibang planeta dahil sa kanilang atmospera at ibabaw.

statements.text: Did you know the ocean is the main source of water vapor? That's because a huge 71% of Earth's surface is covered by water!
statements.tl: Alam mo ba na ang dagat ang pangunahing pinagkukunan ng singaw ng tubig? Ito ay dahil 71% ng ibabaw ng Mundo ay natatakpan ng tubig!

statements.text:
Why do we call Earth the "blue planet"?

About three-quarters of Earth's surface is covered by water! That huge amount of water is exactly why our home is called the "blue planet"!
statements.tl:
Bakit tinatawag nating "blue planet" ang Earth?

Halos tatlong-kapat ng ibabaw ng Mundo ay natatakpan ng tubig! Kaya nga tinatawag itong "blue planet"!

statements.text: About 71% of Earth's surface is covered by water! That is why we call it the Blue Planet.
statements.tl: Halos 71% ng ibabaw ng Mundo ay natatakpan ng tubig! Kaya naman tinatawag natin itong Asul na Planeta.

statements.text: Oceans cover about 71% of Earth's surface and hold roughly 97% of all the water on our entire planet!
statements.tl: Ang mga karagatan ay sumasakop ng halos 71% ng ibabaw ng Mundo at naglalaman ng halos 97% ng lahat ng tubig sa planeta!

statements.text:
Are Earth's land and ocean both split into separate pieces?

Earth's land is split into separate continents, while the ocean is one connected body of water covering most of the surface!
statements.tl:
Nakahati ba ang lupa at karagatan ng Earth sa magkakahiwalay na piraso?

Ang lupa ng Earth ay nahahati sa magkakahiwalay na kontinente, habang ang karagatan ay isang konektadong katawan ng tubig na tumatakip sa karamihan ng surface!

statements.text: The Pacific Ocean alone spreads over a larger area than all of Earth's land put together!
statements.tl: Ang Pacific Ocean lamang ay kumakalat sa mas malaking lugar kaysa sa pinagsama-samang lahat ng lupa ng Earth!

statements.text:
Why do continents and islands stick out?

Earth's water fills the low ocean basins, so the higher land sticks out as continents and islands!
statements.tl:
Bakit lumalabas ang mga kontinente at isla?

Pinupuno ng tubig ng Earth ang mabababang ocean basins, kaya ang mas matataas na lupa ay lumalabas bilang mga kontinente at isla!

statements.text:
Is land actually bigger than water on Earth?

Because people live on land, it's easy to think it's bigger, but water actually covers most of Earth's surface!
statements.tl:
Mas malaki ba talaga ang lupa kaysa tubig sa Earth?

Dahil nakatira ang mga tao sa lupa, madaling isipin na mas malaki ito, pero ang totoo, mas maraming bahagi ng surface ng Earth ang natatakpan ng tubig!

statements.text:
What would you see looking at Earth as a whole from space?

You would see far more blue ocean than brown or green land!
statements.tl:
Ano ang makikita mo kung titingnan ang buong Earth mula sa kalawakan?

Mas marami kang makikitang asul na karagatan kaysa kayumanggi o luntiang lupa!

statements.text: On an equal-area world map, the blue of oceans takes up more space than all the other colors of land put together!
statements.tl: Sa equal-area na mapa ng mundo, ang asul ng mga karagatan ay kumukuha ng mas maraming espasyo kaysa sa pinagsama-samang lahat ng iba pang kulay ng lupa!

statements.text:
How thick is Earth's crust?

The oceanic crust is only about 5 kilometers thick! But the continental crust can be up to 70 kilometers thick.
statements.tl:
Gaano ang kapal ng crust ng Earth?

Ang oceanic crust ay mga 5 kilometro lang ang kapal! Pero ang continental crust ay maaaring umabot hanggang 70 kilometro.

statements.text: Earth's crust isn't the same thickness everywhere! The oceanic crust under the seas is thinner, while the continental crust under land is thicker.
statements.tl: Hindi pare-pareho ang kapal ng crust! Mas manipis ang oceanic crust sa ilalim ng karagatan, at mas makapal ang continental crust sa ilalim ng lupain.

statements.text: Oceanic crust is the thinner, denser part of the crust, made mostly of basalt rock, and it forms the floors of the ocean basins.
statements.tl: Ang oceanic crust ay ang mas manipis at mas siksik na bahagi ng crust, na karamihan ay gawa sa basalt na bato, at ito ang bumubuo sa sahig ng mga ocean basin.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12mpqjtcxxoOinB8-VVhbfToSTBjAWWO-), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Plains, mountain ranges, and plateaus are landforms found on continental crust, which forms the continents and larger landmasses.
statements.tl: Ang mga kapatagan, bulubundukin, at talampas ay mga anyong lupa na matatagpuan sa continental crust, na bumubuo sa mga kontinente at malalaking landmass.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1RK_HH4DdzgEdRKZNqzoUiA-FIdvgXk7D), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The crust is Earth's thinnest, outermost layer of solid rock! It's the land, mountains, and ocean floor where we live.
statements.tl: Ang crust ang pinakamanipis at pinakalabas na patong ng Earth na gawa sa matigas na bato. Dito tayo nakatira!

statements.text: Continental crust is thicker and less dense than oceanic crust, so it floats higher on the mantle like a light block on water!
statements.tl: Ang continental crust ay mas makapal at mas magaan kaysa oceanic crust, kaya lumulutang ito nang mas mataas sa mantle parang magaan na bloke sa tubig!

statements.text: The mantle is about 2,900 kilometers thick, making it by far the thickest layer of the solid Earth!
statements.tl: Ang mantle ay halos 2,900 kilometers ang kapal, kaya ito talaga ang pinakamakapal na layer ng solid Earth!

statements.text: The crust makes up less than one percent of Earth's total volume, just like the thin skin of a huge fruit!
statements.tl: Ang crust ay wala pang isang porsyento ng buong bolyum ng Earth, parang manipis na balat ng isang malaking prutas!

statements.text:
Who discovered the Moho and how?

A Croatian scientist named Andrija Mohorovičić discovered the Moho in 1909 by studying how earthquake waves travel!
statements.tl:
Sino ang nakatuklas ng Moho at paano?

Isang Croatian scientist na nagngangalang Andrija Mohorovičić ang nakatuklas ng Moho noong 1909 sa pamamagitan ng pag-aaral kung paano gumagalaw ang earthquake waves!

statements.text:
What is peridotite and what does it look like?

Peridotite is the main rock of the upper mantle! It is dark green and much denser than the granite and basalt of the crust.
statements.tl:
Ano ang peridotite at ano ang itsura nito?

Ang peridotite ang pangunahing bato ng upper mantle! Ito ay dark green at mas siksik kaysa sa granite at basalt ng crust.

statements.text: In the upper crust, temperature rises about 25 to 30 degrees Celsius for every kilometer you dig deeper!
statements.tl: Sa upper crust, tumataas ang temperatura ng mga 25 hanggang 30 degrees Celsius sa bawat kilometrong paghukay mo palalim!

statements.text: Earthquakes usually begin in rigid lithosphere, including sinking slabs! The hot asthenosphere below usually deforms without producing earthquakes.
statements.tl: Karaniwang nagsisimula ang mga lindol sa matigas na lithosphere, kasama ang lumulubog na mga slab! Karaniwang nagbabago ng hugis ang mainit na asthenosphere nang hindi lumilikha ng lindol.

statements.text:
Did you know mountains have secret underground roots?

Mountain ranges have deep crustal roots, just like an iceberg has most of its mass hidden underwater!
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba na ang mga bundok ay may sikretong ugat sa ilalim ng lupa?

Ang mga bulubundukin ay may malalim na crustal roots, parang iceberg na ang karamihan ng laki nito ay nakatago sa ilalim ng tubig!

statements.text:
How do continents and oceans move around the Earth?

The lithosphere is broken into large plates that move in different directions, carrying continents and oceans with them!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagalaw ang mga kontinente at karagatan sa buong mundo?

Ang lithosphere ay nahahati sa malalaking plates na gumagalaw sa iba't ibang direksyon, dala-dala ang mga kontinente at karagatan!

statements.text: The Moho is shallower under the oceans and much deeper under tall mountain ranges, following the crust's thickness!
statements.tl: Ang Moho ay mas mababaw sa ilalim ng mga karagatan at mas malalim sa ilalim ng matataas na bulubundukin, sumusunod sa kapal ng crust!

statements.text: Continental crust is rich in silicon and aluminum, while the upper mantle holds more iron and magnesium, which is why it is denser!
statements.tl: Ang continental crust ay mayaman sa silicon at aluminum, habang ang upper mantle ay may mas maraming iron at magnesium, kaya ito ay mas siksik!

statements.text: The asthenosphere is not fully liquid! It is mostly solid rock that flows slowly under high heat and pressure, with small amounts of melt in some places.
statements.tl: Ang asthenosphere ay hindi ganap na likido! Karamihan dito ay solidong batong dahan-dahang dumadaloy sa mataas na init at pressure, na may kaunting tunaw na materyal sa ilang lugar.

statements.text:
What elements make up most of the crust's mass?

Oxygen and silicon make up about three-quarters of it! They are mostly combined together as silicate minerals.
statements.tl:
Anong mga elemento ang bumubuo sa karamihan ng bigat ng crust?

Ang oxygen at silicon ang bumubuo sa halos tatlong-kapat ng bigat ng crust! Kadalasan, magkasama sila bilang silicate minerals.

statements.text:
Where do most typhoons in the Philippines form?

Most form over the warm Pacific Ocean to our east! There, warm water and rising air swirl and grow stronger until they become a typhoon.
statements.tl:
Saan nabubuo ang karamihan ng mga bagyo sa Pilipinas?

Karamihan ay nabubuo sa mainit na Pacific Ocean sa silangan natin! Doon, ang mainit na tubig at umaakyat na hangin ay umiikot hanggang maging bagyo.

statements.text:
How do typhoons get their strong winds?

Warm ocean water evaporates into vapor. When the vapor condenses into clouds, it releases heat that fuels the strong typhoon winds!
statements.tl:
Paano nagkakaroon ng malakas na hangin ang mga bagyo?

Nag-e-evaporate ang mainit na tubig-dagat at nagiging vapor. Kapag nag-condense ito sa ulap, naglalabas ng init na nagpapalakas ng hangin ng bagyo!

statements.text: A typhoon is a mature tropical cyclone that develops in the western part of the North Pacific Ocean.
statements.tl: Ang typhoon ay isang mature tropical cyclone na nabubuo sa kanlurang bahagi ng North Pacific Ocean.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1rpVDp0acYVj51Yr1UR1N4FM0-ykuPPuq), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The ITCZ is a low-pressure zone where trade winds converge, helping warm, moist air rise and sometimes supporting storm formation.
statements.tl: Ang ITCZ ay isang lugar ng low pressure kung saan nagtatagpo ang trade winds, na tumutulong sa pag-angat ng mainit at mamasa-masang hangin at kung minsan ay sa pagbuo ng bagyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1s9mCkaX3hrmM6p8G3V-T9-BTV1JVF4Ux), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A typhoon begins with a low pressure center, a place where air is warmer and lighter, so surrounding air rushes inward to fill the space.
statements.tl: Nagsisimula ang typhoon sa low pressure center, isang lugar kung saan mas mainit at mas magaan ang hangin, kaya ang hangin sa paligid ay sumusugod papasok para punan ang espasyo.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-19286), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Tropical cyclones need water vapor to form, and the warm ocean near the equator is the best source of this moisture.
statements.tl: Kailangan ng tropical cyclones ang water vapor para mabuo, at ang mainit na karagatan malapit sa equator ang pinakamahusay na pinagmumulan ng moisture na ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-19286), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Warm Pacific Ocean water above 26°C fuels typhoons through evaporation! The warmer the water, the more energy for stronger typhoons.
statements.tl: Ang mainit na tubig ng Pacific Ocean na higit sa 26°C ay nagbibigay ng enerhiya sa mga bagyo sa pamamagitan ng evaporation! Mas mainit na tubig, mas maraming enerhiyang maaaring magpalakas sa bagyo.

statements.text: Typhoons form over warm oceans! Warm, moist air rises and cools into clouds, releasing the energy that powers the spinning storm.
statements.tl: Nabubuo ang mga bagyo sa mainit na karagatan! Ang mainit at mahalumigmig na hangin ay pumapaitaas, lumalamig, at nagiging ulap na nagbibigay ng enerhiya sa umiikot na bagyo.

statements.text:
Why do typhoon winds spin counterclockwise in the Philippines?

In the northern half of the world, including the Philippines, a typhoon's winds spin counterclockwise because of the Earth's rotation!
statements.tl:
Bakit pakaliwa ang pag-ikot ng hangin ng bagyo sa Pilipinas?

Sa hilagang bahagi ng mundo, kasama ang Pilipinas, umiikot ang hangin ng bagyo nang pakaliwa (counterclockwise) dahil sa pag-ikot ng Earth!

statements.text:
Ever wonder what makes a typhoon so powerful?

At the typhoon's center, air pressure drops super low! Surrounding air rushes in and spirals toward it — that spinning motion is what gives the storm its incredible strength.
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba kung bakit napakalakas ng bagyo?

Sa gitna ng bagyo, napakababa ng presyon ng hangin! Ang hangin mula sa paligid ay pumapasok at umiikot patungo dito — iyan ang nagbibigay ng lakas sa bagyo.

statements.text:
How does a typhoon grow stronger?

Over warm seas, the rising vapor from the warm water gives the typhoon lots of energy!
statements.tl:
Paano lumalakas ang isang bagyo?

Sa mainit na dagat, ang umuusbong na singaw mula sa mainit na tubig ang nagbibigay ng lakas dito!

statements.text: The air inside the eye is warmer than the air around it. This warmth helps keep the typhoon strong!
statements.tl: Ang hangin sa loob ng eye ay mas mainit kaysa sa paligid niya. Ang init na ito ang nagpapatatag sa bagyo!

statements.text: The Coriolis effect happens because Earth spins on its axis, making moving air and water appear to curve.
statements.tl: Nangyayari ang Coriolis effect dahil umiikot ang Earth sa axis niya, kaya parang lumiliko ang hangin at tubig.

statements.text: As wind spirals inward because of Coriolis, it creates the calm, quiet eye of the storm right in the middle!
statements.tl: Habang umiikot ang hangin papunta sa sentro dahil sa Coriolis, nabubuo ang tahimik na mata ng bagyo sa gitna!

statements.text: A storm spins because rushing air heads for the center, but the spinning Earth bends it into a circle!
statements.tl: Umiikot ang bagyo dahil papasok ang hangin sa gitna, pero iniliko ito ng pag-ikot ng Mundo kaya nagiging paikot!

statements.text:
What exactly is a typhoon?

A typhoon is a huge spinning storm with super strong winds and heavy rain that forms over warm ocean waters!
statements.tl:
Ano ba ang isang bagyo?

Ang bagyo ay isang malaking umiikot na unos na may napakalakas na hangin at malakas na ulan na nabubuo sa mainit na karagatan!

statements.text: During the wet season, typhoons visit the Philippines more often! They form over the warm Pacific Ocean, where water vapor and swirling winds come together. Most typhoons arrive from June to October.
statements.tl: Sa tag-ulan, mas madalas ang bagyo sa Pilipinas! Nabubuo ito sa mainit na Pacific Ocean, kung saan nagtatagpo ang singaw ng tubig at umiikot na hangin. Karamihan ay mula Hunyo hanggang Oktubre.

statements.text: A typhoon is a powerful storm with spinning winds and heavy rain that forms over warm oceans. They often pass through the Philippines, so always be prepared!
statements.tl: Ang bagyo (typhoon) ay malakas na bagyo na may umiikot na hangin at ulan, na nabubuo sa mainit na karagatan. Madalas dumaan sa Pilipinas, kaya mahalagang maging handa!

statements.text: The higher an object is above the ground, the more gravitational potential energy it has!
statements.tl: Kapag mas mataas ang isang bagay mula sa lupa, mas malaki ang gravitational potential energy nito!

statements.text: Kinetic energy is simply the energy of a moving object!
statements.tl: Ang kinetic energy ay ang enerhiya ng isang bagay na gumagalaw!

statements.text: When an object falls down, its stored potential energy changes right into kinetic energy!
statements.tl: Kapag nahuhulog pababa ang isang bagay, nagiging kinetic energy ang potential energy nito!

statements.text: Taking ground level as the zero reference, at ground level, a falling object's potential energy is zero because its height above the ground is zero.
statements.tl: Kung ground level ang piniling zero reference, sa antas na ito, ang potential energy ng bumabagsak na bagay ay zero dahil ang taas nito mula sa lupa ay zero.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1-xD4W0f8HOQtq0Uu_bMyMB9DbiVROCGC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Which has more potential energy, a coconut on a low branch or one on a high branch?

If both have the same mass, the higher coconut has more potential energy, because PE=mgh means more height (h) gives more stored energy!
statements.tl:
Alin ang may mas maraming potential energy, ang niyog sa mababang sanga o ang nasa mataas na sanga?

Kung pareho ang kanilang mass, ang mas mataas na niyog ay may mas maraming potential energy, dahil sa PE=mgh, ang mas mataas na h ay nagbibigay ng mas maraming nakaimbak na energy!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12pJGs5nfMWZhxzvVCwkjLiQVDBbfKrQV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: At the same height, a heavier object has more potential energy than a lighter one because mass is part of the formula PE=mgh.
statements.tl: Sa parehong taas, ang mas mabigat na bagay ay may mas maraming potential energy kaysa sa mas magaan dahil ang mass ay bahagi ng formulang PE=mgh.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12pJGs5nfMWZhxzvVCwkjLiQVDBbfKrQV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Kinetic energy is calculated using KE=1/2mv^2, where m is the object's mass and v is its speed.
statements.tl: Ang kinetic energy ay kinakalkula gamit ang KE=1/2mv^2, kung saan ang m ay mass ng bagay at ang v ay ang bilis nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12pJGs5nfMWZhxzvVCwkjLiQVDBbfKrQV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Which has kinetic energy: a parked car or a travelling car?

The travelling car has kinetic energy because it is moving, while the parked car has none!
statements.tl:
Alin ang may kinetic energy: nakaparadang kotse o bumibiyaheng kotse?

Ang bumibiyaheng kotse ay may kinetic energy dahil ito ay gumagalaw, habang ang nakapark na kotse ay wala!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12pJGs5nfMWZhxzvVCwkjLiQVDBbfKrQV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A bouncing ball has the greatest potential energy at its highest point and the greatest kinetic energy just before it hits the ground.
statements.tl: Ang tumatalbog na bola ay may pinakamalaking potential energy sa pinakamataas nitong punto at pinakamalaking kinetic energy bago ito tumama sa lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12pJGs5nfMWZhxzvVCwkjLiQVDBbfKrQV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: On a swing, you have maximum potential energy at the highest points and maximum kinetic energy at the lowest point in the middle.
statements.tl: Sa isang swing, may pinakamataas kang potential energy sa pinakamataas na mga punto at pinakamataas na kinetic energy sa pinakamababang punto sa gitna.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12pJGs5nfMWZhxzvVCwkjLiQVDBbfKrQV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A balloon-powered car converts stored potential energy from the stretched balloon into kinetic energy when the air rushes out and the car moves.
statements.tl: Ang balloon-powered car ay ginagawang kinetic energy ang nakaimbak na potential energy mula sa nakaunat na lobo kapag lumabas ang hangin at umandar ang sasakyan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17kpGXvW04jQjQb_vVKG-XRxgrPnODmFm), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Cathode rays travel in straight lines and carry kinetic energy, showing that electrons are moving particles.
statements.tl: Ang cathode rays ay naglalakbay sa tuwid na linya at may dalang kinetic energy, na nagpapakita na ang mga electrons ay gumagalaw na particles.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1HQQtE_IPwA_sr4_4V5Nt2bfZaSZ1-idA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The total energy along a track includes potential energy, kinetic energy, and dissipated forms such as heat and sound that have spread away from the moving object.
statements.tl: Ang kabuuang energy sa isang track ay binubuo ng potential energy, kinetic energy, at mga dissipated na anyo tulad ng init at tunog na kumalat palayo sa gumagalaw na bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Kcf0LLsVoQqlk9Hr708eQ9FoGIT94mSO), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Potential energy depends on the object's mass, its height above the ground, and the pull of gravity on it.
statements.tl: Ang potential energy ay nakadepende sa mass ng bagay, sa taas nito mula sa lupa, at sa hatak ng gravity dito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aVCkJ-w4ZSphAieg-sgpyJ1xMyIdg4ML), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What potential energy does a 190 N bell have on a 45 m tower?

Use PE = weight x height. That is 190 N times 45 m, which equals 8,550 Joules!
statements.tl:
Anong potential energy ng 190 N na kampana sa 45 m na tore?

Gamitin ang PE = weight x height. Iyan ay 190 N times 45 m, na katumbas ng 8,550 Joules!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aVCkJ-w4ZSphAieg-sgpyJ1xMyIdg4ML), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The higher an object is lifted, the more potential energy it stores, because height is one of the factors in the potential energy formula.
statements.tl: Kung mas mataas ang pagkakaangat ng isang bagay, mas marami itong naiimbak na potential energy, dahil ang taas ay isa sa mga factor sa formula ng potential energy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aVCkJ-w4ZSphAieg-sgpyJ1xMyIdg4ML), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Potential energy can also be found by multiplying the object's weight, which is a force measured in newtons, by its height.
statements.tl: Ang potential energy ay maaari ring makuha sa pamamagitan ng pag-multiply ng weight ng bagay, na isang puwersa na sinusukat sa newtons, sa taas nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aVCkJ-w4ZSphAieg-sgpyJ1xMyIdg4ML), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An object sitting on the ground has zero potential energy due to height, because its height above the ground is zero meters.
statements.tl: Ang isang bagay na nasa lupa ay may zero na potential energy dahil sa taas, dahil ang taas nito mula sa lupa ay zero meters.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1aVCkJ-w4ZSphAieg-sgpyJ1xMyIdg4ML), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does energy swap on a swing or pendulum?

Potential energy is highest at the top, and kinetic energy is highest at the bottom. They trade back and forth as it swings!
statements.tl:
Paano nagpapalitan ang enerhiya sa duyan o pendulum?

Pinakamalaki ang potential energy sa pinakamataas, at pinakamalaki ang kinetic energy sa pinakamababa. Palit-palit sila habang umuugoy!

statements.text: As a roller coaster climbs without added power, some kinetic energy changes into gravitational potential energy. It can still be moving at the crest, so it can have both forms of energy there. Friction and air resistance also transfer some energy into thermal energy.
statements.tl: Habang umaakyat ang roller coaster nang walang dagdag na power, nagiging gravitational potential energy ang ilan sa kinetic energy. Maaari pa rin itong gumalaw sa tuktok, kaya maaari itong magkaroon ng parehong anyo ng energy doon. Naililipat din ng friction at air resistance ang ilang energy bilang thermal energy.

statements.text: A falling coconut gains kinetic energy as gravity pulls it faster toward the ground!
statements.tl: Habang bumabagsak ang niyog, tumataas ang kinetic energy nito dahil pinapabilis ito ng gravity papunta sa lupa!

statements.text:
How does a mantis shrimp punch so hard?

It stores energy in a spring-like part of its arm, then suddenly releases it to throw a punch with incredible force!
statements.tl:
Paano nakakasuntok nang napakalakas ang mantis shrimp?

Nag-iipon ng enerhiya sa parang spring sa loob ng braso nito, tapos biglang binibitawan para makasuntok nang napakalakas!

statements.text:
How does a frog jump so far?

Before jumping, a frog stores energy in the long tendons of its legs, like a stretched rubber band; when that energy suddenly releases, its legs snap out and fling it far.
statements.tl:
Paano nakakalukso nang malayo ang palaka?

Bago lumukso, nag-iipon ang palaka ng lakas sa mahahabang litid ng binti nito, parang naka-igting na goma; pagbitaw ng naipong lakas, biglang humahataw ang binti at nakakalukso ito nang malayo.

statements.text:
Why does a pendulum swing fastest at the bottom?

At the top, it pauses with the most potential energy. As it swings down, that becomes kinetic energy — so it moves fastest at the lowest point!
statements.tl:
Bakit pinakamabilis ang pendulum sa pinakamababang punto?

Sa pinakamataas, sandaling tumitigil ito na may pinakamaraming potential energy. Habang bumababa, nagiging kinetic energy ito — kaya pinakamabilis ito sa pinakamababang punto!

statements.text: As an object falls, its gravitational potential energy decreases while its kinetic energy increases — so it speeds up until it hits the ground!
statements.tl: Habang nahuhulog ang isang bagay, nababawasan ang gravitational potential energy nito habang tumataas ang kinetic energy nito — kaya bumibilis ito hanggang tumama sa lupa!

statements.text: At the top of its swing, a pendulum stores potential energy. At the bottom, it turns into motion energy and moves the fastest!
statements.tl: Sa pinakataas ng ugoy, ang pendulum ay may nakaimbak na potential energy. Sa gitna, nagiging motion energy ito at pinakamabilis gumalaw!

statements.text: At the highest ends of its swing, a pendulum stops for a quick instant before heading back the other way!
statements.tl: Sa pinakamataas na dulo ng ugoy, saglit na huminto ang pendulum bago ito bumalik sa kabilang gilid.
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; velocity zero at turning points

statements.text:
Why do things speed up when falling or rolling downhill?

As an object falls or rolls down, its potential energy turns into kinetic energy, making it go faster!
statements.tl:
Bakit bumibilis ang mga bagay kapag nahuhulog o gumulong pababa?

Kapag nahulog o gumulong pababa ang isang bagay, nagiging kinetic energy ang potential energy nito, kaya bumibilis ito!

statements.text: On a roller coaster, the car has the most potential energy at the highest hill. This becomes kinetic energy, speeding it up going down!
statements.tl: Sa roller coaster, pinakamarami ang potential energy ng sasakyan sa pinakamataas na burol. Ito ay nagiging kinetic energy, kaya bumibilis ito pababa!

statements.text:
What happens to energy when something falls?

When an object falls, its stored potential energy magically changes into moving kinetic energy! It transforms as it drops.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa enerhiya kapag may nahuhulog?

Kapag nahuhulog ang isang bagay, ang potential energy nito ay nagiging kinetic energy! Nagbabago ito habang bumababa.

statements.text: Watch a swinging pendulum! Its potential energy is greatest at the very top, while kinetic energy peaks at the bottom!
statements.tl: Tingnan ang umuugoy na pendulum! Pinakamataas ang potential energy sa itaas, at pinakamataas ang kinetic energy sa ibaba!

statements.text: The stretched rubber of a slingshot stores energy that sends a stone flying high when released!
statements.tl: Ang nakaunat na goma ng tirador ay nag-iimbak ng enerhiya na nagpapalipad sa bato kapag binitawan!

statements.text: Many toys and click pens work using a spring that stores energy when squeezed and lets it out when released!
statements.tl: Maraming laruan at click pens ang gumagana gamit ang spring na nag-iimbak ng enerhiya kapag inipit at naglalabas nito kapag binitawan!

statements.text: On a roller coaster, kinetic and potential energy keep swapping! At the top, it has lots of potential energy but moves slowly. Zooming down, potential turns to kinetic—fastest at the bottom!
statements.tl: Sa roller coaster, palitan ng kinetic at potential energy! Sa pinakataas, marami itong potential energy pero mabagal. Habang bumababa, nagiging kinetic energy ang potential—kaya pinakamabilis ito sa pinakamababang bahagi ng track!

statements.text: As waves move, two kinds of energy swap! At the crest, water has stored potential energy — and as it drops, it turns into kinetic energy of motion.
statements.tl: Habang umaalon, nagpapalitan ang dalawang uri ng enerhiya! Sa tuktok, may nakaimbak na potential energy — at pagbaba nito, nagiging kinetic energy ng galaw.

statements.text:
Why does a diving board help swimmers jump higher?

When a swimmer stands on the tip, the board bends and stores elastic potential energy. When they jump, it springs back and launches them up!
statements.tl:
Bakit nakakatulong ang diving board para mas mataas ang talon ng manlalangoy?

Kapag tumayo sa dulo, ang board ay bumabaluktot at nag-iimbak ng elastic potential energy. Kapag tumalon, ito ay bumabalik pataas at itinutulak ang manlalangoy pataas!

statements.text:
What does 'work' really mean in science?

Work happens when a force has a component along an object's displacement!
statements.tl:
Ano ba talaga ang ibig sabihin ng 'trabaho' sa agham?

Nangyayari ang trabaho kapag may bahagi ng puwersa na kahilera ng displacement ng isang bagay!

statements.text: Work depends on the force component along an object’s displacement. A force in the same direction does positive work; an opposite force, such as braking friction, does negative work. A perpendicular force does zero work. For a constant force, W = Fd cos θ, where θ is the angle between force and displacement.
statements.tl: Nakabatay ang work sa bahagi ng puwersang kahilera ng displacement ng bagay. Positive work ang nagagawa ng puwersang kapareho ng direksiyon; negative work ang kabaligtarang puwersa, gaya ng friction sa pagpreno. Zero work ang perpendicular na puwersa. Para sa constant force, W = Fd cos θ, kung saan θ ang anggulo sa pagitan ng puwersa at displacement.

statements.text: If a force pushes at right angles to the direction of motion, it does no work on the object at all!
statements.tl: Kung ang puwersa ay patayo (right angles) sa direksyon ng paggalaw, walang work na nagagawa sa bagay!

statements.text: The normal force from a table does zero work on a sliding block because it points upward while the block moves sideways.
statements.tl: Ang normal force mula sa mesa ay gumagawa ng zero work sa dumudulas na bloke dahil ito ay nakaturo paitaas habang ang bloke ay gumagalaw patagilid.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PK_lndujUEPUWZHZMQKdIopgrLM2S5EV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A man plowing a field does work because the force he applies moves the plow through the soil in the same direction.
statements.tl: May work ang taong nag-aararo sa bukid dahil ang puwersang ginagamit niya ay nagpapagalaw sa araro sa lupa sa parehong direksyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ztuJ63yVn_LVr8RH7GgZSrgu5XxprlVK), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A child thinking about lessons does no work in physics because there is no force moving an object through a distance.
statements.tl: Walang work sa physics ang batang nag-iisip ng leksyon dahil walang puwersang nagpapagalaw sa isang bagay sa isang distansya.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ztuJ63yVn_LVr8RH7GgZSrgu5XxprlVK), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Students arranging chairs by pushing and pulling them along the floor are doing work because the chairs move in the direction of the force.
statements.tl: Ang mga estudyanteng nag-aayos ng mga upuan sa pamamagitan ng pagtulak at paghila sa mga ito sa sahig ay gumagawa ng work dahil gumagalaw ang mga upuan sa direksyon ng puwersa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-16253), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do we measure work and energy?

They are measured in joules (J)! One joule happens when a force of one newton moves an object one meter in the force's direction.
statements.tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang work at energy?

Sinusukat natin ito sa joules (J)! Isang joule ang nagagawa kapag isang newton na force ang nagpagalaw ng bagay ng isang metro sa direksyon ng puwersa.
statements.source: AAAS BSL Ch.4E; encyclopedia-stable consensus (SI units)

statements.text:
How do we calculate the amount of work?

Work equals the force used multiplied by the distance moved in the force's direction! So, work is greater when the force is stronger or the distance is longer.
statements.tl:
Paano natin kinakalkula ang dami ng work?

Ang work ay katumbas ng force na ginamit beses ang distansya sa direksyon ng puwersa! Kaya mas malaki ang work kapag mas malakas ang force o mas mahaba ang distance.

statements.text: When you carry an object while walking on level ground, you do no work on it! The upward force holding it is perpendicular to your motion.
statements.tl: Kapag bitbit mo ang isang bagay habang naglalakad sa patag, hindi ka gumagawa ng work dito! Ang upward force pataas ay perpendicular sa direksyon ng iyong paggalaw.
statements.source: Encyclopedia-stable physics consensus (work as force along displacement)

statements.text:
When is work actually done in physics?

In physics, work is only done when a force successfully moves an object through a distance!
statements.tl:
Kailan talaga nagkakaroon ng work sa pisika?

Sa pisika, may work lang kapag ang isang puwersa ay nakapaglipat ng bagay sa isang layo!

statements.text: Pushing a wall without moving it means zero work in physics, even if you feel super tired!
statements.tl: Kapag itinulak mo ang pader pero hindi ito gumalaw, zero work sa pisika, kahit napapagod ka!

statements.text:
How do we measure work and energy?

They are measured in joules! One joule equals one newton of force moving over one meter in the force's direction.
statements.tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang trabaho at enerhiya?

Sinusukat sila sa joules! Ang isang joule ay katumbas ng isang newton na puwersa sa isang metrong galaw sa direksyon ng puwersa.

statements.text: When you lift a bag upward, you are doing work against the invisible pull of gravity!
statements.tl: Kapag binubuhat mo ang isang bag pataas, gumagawa ka ng trabaho laban sa pull ng gravity!

statements.text:
Do you do work against gravity when carrying a load on flat ground?

Almost no work! Because the load doesn't rise while walking on flat ground, you aren't doing work against gravity.
statements.tl:
Gumagawa ka ba ng trabaho laban sa gravity kapag may pasan kang bigat sa patag?

Halos wala! Dahil hindi tumataas ang bigat habang naglalakad sa patag, hindi ka gumagawa ng trabaho laban sa gravity.

statements.text:
Does every push or pull actually do work?

Nope! Only the part of a force that points along the direction of motion does work.
statements.tl:
Ginagawa ba ng bawat puwersa ang trabaho?

Hindi! Tanging ang bahagi ng puwersang kasabay ng direksyon ng paggalaw lang ang gumagawa ng trabaho.

statements.text: Pushing an object that won't budge? No work is done in science!
statements.tl: Kung itinutulak mo ang bagay pero hindi gumagalaw, walang trabahong nagagawa sa agham!

statements.text:
Is carrying a heavy bag while walking a lot of work against gravity?

Almost no work against gravity, because the load does not rise while walking on flat ground!
statements.tl:
Malaki ba ang trabaho laban sa grabidad kapag pasan mo ang mabigat habang naglalakad?

Halos walang trabaho laban sa grabidad, dahil hindi umaangat ang pasan habang naglalakad sa patag!

statements.text: Power shows how fast work is done! It is calculated by dividing the work by the time taken.
statements.tl: Ang power ay kung gaano kabilis nagagawa ang trabaho! Kinakalkula ito sa paghahati ng trabaho sa oras.

statements.text: Did you know? One kilowatt (kW) is exactly equal to 1,000 watts!
statements.tl: Alam mo ba? Ang isang kilowatt (kW) ay eksaktong katumbas ng 1,000 watts!

statements.text:
How many joules per second equal one watt?

One watt equals one joule of energy per second! That means 1 W = 1 joule/second.
statements.tl:
Ilang joule bawat segundo ang katumbas ng isang watt?

Ang isang watt ay katumbas ng isang joule ng energy bawat segundo! Kaya 1 W = 1 joule/segundo.

statements.text:
Why does our bill go up so much when we use the air conditioner longer?

An air conditioner has a high power rating, so every extra hour adds a big amount of kilowatt-hours to the bill!
statements.tl:
Bakit tumataas nang husto ang bill natin kapag mas matagal nating ginagamit ang air conditioner?

May mataas na power rating ang air conditioner, kaya bawat dagdag na oras ay nagdadagdag ng malaking kilowatt-hour sa bill!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1AH3VYawMvIcfxJCk5j7pSBX-Fx7nz373), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Power can also be calculated as P equals F times v times cosine theta, where F is force, v is velocity, and theta is the angle between them.
statements.tl: Ang power ay maaari ring kalkulahin bilang P katumbas ng F times v times cosine theta, kung saan ang F ay puwersa, v ay velocity, at theta ay ang anggulo sa pagitan nila.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PK_lndujUEPUWZHZMQKdIopgrLM2S5EV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do you calculate power if 500 joules are used in 8 seconds?

Divide the work by the time: five hundred joules divided by eight seconds equals sixty-two point five watts of power.
statements.tl:
Paano mo kinakalkula ang power kung 500 joules sa 8 segundo?

Hatiin ang work sa oras: limang daang joules divided by walong segundo ay katumbas ng sixty-two point five watts na power.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PK_lndujUEPUWZHZMQKdIopgrLM2S5EV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do power plants need to be powerful?

Power plants must transfer a huge amount of energy quickly to supply electricity to homes, so they need high power to do that work in a short time.
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangang maging malakas ang power plants?

Ang mga power plant ay kailangang maglipat ng napakalaking energy nang mabilis para mag-supply ng kuryente sa mga tahanan, kaya kailangan nila ng mataas na power para magawa ang work na iyon sa maikling oras.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PK_lndujUEPUWZHZMQKdIopgrLM2S5EV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Electrical energy consumption is calculated by multiplying an appliance's power rating, measured in watts, by the time it is used.
statements.tl: Ang konsumo ng electrical energy ay kinukuwenta sa pamamagitan ng pagmu-multiply ng power rating ng appliance, na sinusukat sa watts, sa oras na ginamit ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1gLlsocYxWQJOAqTxRTsyzzM4srvXGHaO), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Megawatt electric, or MWe, is a unit of electrical power used in the electric power industry to measure how much electricity a plant can produce.
statements.tl: Ang megawatt electric, o MWe, ay isang yunit ng electrical power na ginagamit sa industriya ng kuryente upang sukatin kung gaano karaming kuryente ang kayang gawin ng isang planta.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1nIoLuwWsTGjRxJC2rQ9XBp6v3Hp72_Z3), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How is power measured?

Power is measured in watts (W)! One watt equals one joule of energy used or produced every single second.
statements.tl:
Paano sinusukat ang power?

Ang power ay sinusukat sa watts (W)! Isang watt ang katumbas ng isang joule ng energy na ginagamit o ginagawa bawat segundo.
statements.source: AAAS BSL Ch.4E; encyclopedia-stable consensus (SI units)

statements.text:
How do we find power?

Power equals the work done divided by the time taken! If two machines do the same work, the faster one has greater power.
statements.tl:
Paano natin nalalaman ang power?

Ang power ay katumbas ng work na nagawa hinati sa oras! Kung dalawang makina ang gumagawa ng parehong work, mas malaki ang power ng mas mabilis.

statements.text: If two people of equal mass climb the same stairs, they do the same work. But the one who runs has greater power — same work in less time!
statements.tl: Kung dalawang taong magkapareho ang masa ang umakyat ng parehong hagdan, pareho lang ang work nila. Pero mas malaki ang power ng tumakbo — parehong work sa mas maikling panahon!

statements.text: We measure power in watts! One watt simply means one joule of energy is used every second.
statements.tl: Sinusukat natin ang power sa watts! Ang isang watt ay isang joule ng enerhiya na ginagamit kada segundo.

statements.text: The watt rating on an appliance like an iron tells you exactly how much energy it uses each second!
statements.tl: Ang watt rating sa isang appliance tulad ng plantsa ay nagsasabi kung gaano karaming enerhiya ang ginagamit nito kada segundo!

statements.text: Running up the stairs needs more power than walking! The work is the same, but running is faster.
statements.tl: Ang pagtakbo paakyat sa hagdan ay nangangailangan ng mas malaking power kaysa paglalakad! Pareho ang trabaho, pero mas mabilis ito.

statements.text: Power is how fast energy is used or produced, measured in watts! Higher wattage means the work gets done faster.
statements.tl: Ang power ay kung gaano kabilis ginagamit o nililikha ang enerhiya, sinusukat sa watt! Mas mataas ang watt, mas mabilis ang trabaho.
statements.source: AAAS BSL Ch.4 Energy Transformations; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text: If you do the exact same work in a shorter time, you need more power! Speeding up takes extra power.
statements.tl: Kung gagawin mo ang parehong trabaho sa mas maikling oras, kailangan mo ng mas malaking power! Ang pagbilis ay nangangailangan ng karagdagang power.

statements.text: Power is how fast work gets done! It equals work divided by time — measured in watts (one watt = one joule per second).
statements.tl: Ang power ay kung gaano kabilis nagagawa ang trabaho! Ito ay trabaho na hinati sa oras — sinusukat sa watts (isang watt = isang joule bawat segundo)!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; NRC PS3.A; DepEd G6 Science

statements.text: When work is done, energy is transferred from one object to another!
statements.tl: Kapag may nagagawang trabaho, may enerhiyang inililipat mula sa isang bagay patungo sa iba!

statements.text: Mechanical energy is the total of kinetic energy plus potential energy — without friction, this total stays the same as energy shifts between the two forms!
statements.tl: Ang mechanical energy ay kabuuan ng kinetic energy at potential energy — kapag walang friction, mananatiling pareho ang kabuuang halaga habang nagpapalitan ang dalawang porma!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; NRC PS3.A; DepEd G6 Science

statements.text: Mechanical energy is kinetic plus potential energy still available to do work! This includes lifting, turning, or speeding something up.
statements.tl: Ang mechanical energy ay kinetic plus potential energy na maaaring gumawa ng work! Kasama rito ang pagbubuhat, pagpapaikot, o pagpapabilis.

statements.text:
How much work does it take to lift a heavy bag onto a table?

The work done lifting against gravity is W=mgh, where m is mass, g is gravity, and h is the height you lift it!
statements.tl:
Gaano karaming work ang kailangan para iangat ang isang mabigat na bag papunta sa mesa?

Ang work na ginagawa sa pag-angat laban sa gravity ay W=mgh, kung saan ang m ay mass, g ay gravity, at h ay ang taas ng pag-angat mo!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12pJGs5nfMWZhxzvVCwkjLiQVDBbfKrQV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Work is a way to transmit energy, so when a man lifts a box, he loses energy and the box gains energy.
statements.tl: Ang work ay isang paraan para magpadala ng energy, kaya kapag ang isang tao ay nag-angat ng kahon, nawawalan siya ng energy at ang kahon ay nagkakaroon ng energy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 12pJGs5nfMWZhxzvVCwkjLiQVDBbfKrQV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Work can also be measured in ergs, where one joule equals ten million ergs, a very small unit of work.
statements.tl: Ang work ay maaari ring sukatin sa ergs, kung saan ang isang joule ay katumbas ng sampung milyong ergs, isang napakaliit na yunit ng work.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1PK_lndujUEPUWZHZMQKdIopgrLM2S5EV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When only conservative forces do work, energy lost as potential energy is gained as kinetic energy, so the total mechanical energy of a system remains the same.
statements.tl: Kapag conservative forces lamang ang gumagawa ng work, ang energy na nawala bilang potential energy ay nakukuha bilang kinetic energy, kaya ang total mechanical energy ng isang system ay nananatiling pareho.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qL-YcOP8oj2OwHORJrva17J83VTCcoRC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Mechanical energy is the sum of kinetic energy (from motion) and potential energy (from position). Together, they tell us an object's total mechanical energy!
statements.tl: Ang mechanical energy ay ang kabuuan ng kinetic energy (mula sa paggalaw) at potential energy (mula sa posisyon). Magkasama, alam natin ang kabuuang mechanical energy ng isang bagay!

statements.text: Mechanical energy is the total sum of an object's kinetic energy and potential energy!
statements.tl: Ang mechanical energy ay ang kabuuan ng kinetic energy at potential energy ng isang bagay!

statements.text: To state an object's mechanical energy, add the energy of its motion to the energy stored by its position or shape!
statements.tl: Para sabihin ang mechanical energy ng isang bagay, idagdag ang energy ng paggalaw nito sa energy ng posisyon o hugis nito!

statements.text:
Can something have energy without moving?

Yes! A book sitting high on a shelf has mechanical energy from potential alone. A ball rolling on the floor has mechanical energy from kinetic alone.
statements.tl:
Pwede bang magkaroon ng energy ang isang bagay kahit hindi ito gumagalaw?

Oo! Ang isang aklat na nakapatong sa mataas na istante ay may mechanical energy mula sa potential lamang. Ang bolang gumugulong sa sahig ay may mechanical energy mula sa kinetic lamang.

statements.text:
How much potential energy does a 1-kilogram ball have 10 meters high?

It has about 100 joules of potential energy, which is part of its mechanical energy!
statements.tl:
Ilang potential energy ang may 1-kilogram na bola sa 10 metrong taas?

May mga 100 joules itong potential energy, na bahagi ng mechanical energy nito!

statements.text: A 1-kilogram ball moving at 2 meters per second has about 2 joules of kinetic energy! This is a part of its total mechanical energy.
statements.tl: Ang 1-kilogram na bola na gumagalaw nang 2 metro bawat segundo ay may mga 2 joules na kinetic energy! Ito ay bahagi ng mechanical energy nito.

statements.text:
How does a pendulum clock keep time?

Energy stored in a raised weight or wound spring keeps the pendulum swinging steadily, showing how stored energy does work!
statements.tl:
Paano nagsusukat ng oras ang pendulum clock?

Ang enerhiyang nakaimbak sa nakataas na pabigat o nakaikot na spring ay nagpapanatili ng pantay na pag-ugoy ng pendulum, na nagpapakita kung paano gumagawa ng work ang nakaimbak na energy!

statements.text: An object's mechanical energy depends on your chosen reference point for height! Because of this, the exact same ball can have different potential energies.
statements.tl: Ang mechanical energy ng isang bagay ay nakadepende sa reference point na pipiliin mo para sa taas! Kaya ang parehong bola ay maaaring magkaroon ng magkaibang potential energy.

statements.text:
Why do real pendulums eventually stop swinging?

They slowly lose mechanical energy to air resistance, so they stop on their own!
statements.tl:
Bakit kalaunan humihinto ang mga tunay na pendulum?

Unti-unti silang nawawalan ng mechanical energy dahil sa air resistance, kaya humihinto sila nang mag-isa!

statements.text: A windmill's blades have mechanical energy from their motion! That energy can turn a generator to produce electricity for us.
statements.tl: Ang mga blade ng windmill ay may mechanical energy mula sa paggalaw nila! Ang energy na iyon ay kayang magpaikot ng generator para makagawa ng kuryente.

statements.text: An object's mechanical energy can be zero! This happens if it has no motion and no height relative to your chosen reference point.
statements.tl: Ang mechanical energy ng isang bagay ay pwedeng maging zero! Nangyayari ito kung walang galaw at walang taas mula sa napili mong reference point.

statements.text: Every time a ball bounces, it rises a little lower because some energy turns into heat and sound at each hit!
statements.tl: Tuwing tumatalbog ang bola, mas mababa ang taas nito dahil nagiging init at tunog ang ilang enerhiya sa bawat pagtama!

statements.text: The law of conservation of energy says energy cannot be created or destroyed, only changed from one form to another!
statements.tl: Ayon sa law of conservation of energy, hindi maaaring likhain o sirain ang enerhiya; nagbabago lamang ito ng anyo!

statements.text: When an object falls down, its stored potential energy changes right into kinetic energy!
statements.tl: Kapag nahuhulog pababa ang isang bagay, nagiging kinetic energy ang potential energy nito!

statements.text:
Where does the energy go when a rolling basketball finally stops on the court?

It doesn't just disappear! Its kinetic energy actually transforms into heat and sound instead of vanishing.
statements.tl:
Saan napupunta ang energy kapag huminto na ang gumugulong na basketball sa court?

Hindi ito nawawala! Ang kinetic energy nito ay nagiging init at tunog imbes na mawala sa hangin.

statements.text: Galileo's inclined plane experiments showed a ball returns to its release height under ideal conditions without friction and air resistance.
statements.tl: Ipinakita ng mga eksperimento ni Galileo sa inclined plane na bumabalik ang bola sa taas kung saan ito pinakawalan sa ilalim ng ideal na kondisyon na walang friction at air resistance.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1FVvpmh6R9MaMTg5THFFLXGi31dUpAnal), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In an isolated system with only conservative forces, total mechanical energy is conserved, meaning it remains constant over time.
statements.tl: Sa isang isolated system na may conservative forces lamang, ang total mechanical energy ay conserved, ibig sabihin nananatili itong pareho sa paglipas ng panahon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qL-YcOP8oj2OwHORJrva17J83VTCcoRC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Ignoring friction and air resistance, as a pendulum swings down, potential energy is lost and kinetic energy is gained, so the total mechanical energy stays the same.
statements.tl: Kung walang friction at air resistance, habang bumababa ang pendulum, nababawasan ang potential energy at nadadagdagan ang kinetic energy, kaya ang total mechanical energy ay nananatiling pareho.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qL-YcOP8oj2OwHORJrva17J83VTCcoRC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: By the law of conservation of energy, energy cannot be created or destroyed! It only changes form, so the total amount of energy always stays exactly the same.
statements.tl: Ayon sa batas ng konserbasyon ng enerhiya, ang enerhiya ay hindi maaaring likhain o sirain! Nagbabago lamang ito ng anyo, kaya't ang kabuuang enerhiya ay nananatiling pareho.
statements.source: NRC PS3.B; AAAS BSL Ch.4 Energy Transformations

statements.text: By the law of conservation of energy, energy cannot be created or destroyed. It only changes form while the total amount stays the same!
statements.tl: Ayon sa batas ng conservation of energy, hindi nalilikha o nawawala ang enerhiya. Nagbabago lang ito ng anyo habang pareho ang kabuuang dami!

statements.text: A machine running forever without added energy is impossible! Some energy is always lost as heat through friction.
statements.tl: Imposible ang makinang gagalaw nang walang hanggan nang walang dagdag na enerhiya! Laging may nawawalang enerhiya bilang init dahil sa friction.
statements.source: NRC PS3.B; AAAS BSL Ch.4 Energy Transformations

statements.text: When a bouncing ball finally stops, its kinetic energy isn't destroyed—it transforms into thermal energy and sound!
statements.tl: Kapag huminto na ang tumatalbog na bola, hindi nawawala ang kinetic energy nito—nagiging thermal energy at sound ito!

statements.text: When only conservative forces do work, energy lost as potential energy is gained as kinetic energy, so the total mechanical energy of a system remains the same.
statements.tl: Kapag conservative forces lamang ang gumagawa ng work, ang energy na nawala bilang potential energy ay nakukuha bilang kinetic energy, kaya ang total mechanical energy ng isang system ay nananatiling pareho.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1qL-YcOP8oj2OwHORJrva17J83VTCcoRC), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why does a pendulum swing fastest at the bottom?

At the top, it pauses with the most potential energy. As it swings down, that becomes kinetic energy — so it moves fastest at the lowest point!
statements.tl:
Bakit pinakamabilis ang pendulum sa pinakamababang punto?

Sa pinakamataas, sandaling tumitigil ito na may pinakamaraming potential energy. Habang bumababa, nagiging kinetic energy ito — kaya pinakamabilis ito sa pinakamababang punto!

statements.text:
Why do things speed up when falling or rolling downhill?

As an object falls or rolls down, its potential energy turns into kinetic energy, making it go faster!
statements.tl:
Bakit bumibilis ang mga bagay kapag nahuhulog o gumulong pababa?

Kapag nahulog o gumulong pababa ang isang bagay, nagiging kinetic energy ang potential energy nito, kaya bumibilis ito!

statements.text:
How does energy swap on a swing or pendulum?

Potential energy is highest at the top, and kinetic energy is highest at the bottom. They trade back and forth as it swings!
statements.tl:
Paano nagpapalitan ang enerhiya sa duyan o pendulum?

Pinakamalaki ang potential energy sa pinakamataas, at pinakamalaki ang kinetic energy sa pinakamababa. Palit-palit sila habang umuugoy!

statements.text:
What happens to energy when something falls?

When an object falls, its stored potential energy magically changes into moving kinetic energy! It transforms as it drops.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa enerhiya kapag may nahuhulog?

Kapag nahuhulog ang isang bagay, ang potential energy nito ay nagiging kinetic energy! Nagbabago ito habang bumababa.

statements.text: Watch a swinging pendulum! Its potential energy is greatest at the very top, while kinetic energy peaks at the bottom!
statements.tl: Tingnan ang umuugoy na pendulum! Pinakamataas ang potential energy sa itaas, at pinakamataas ang kinetic energy sa ibaba!

statements.text: When you lift an object up, you give it potential energy that can be released when it drops!
statements.tl: Kapag itinaas mo ang isang bagay, binibigyan mo ito ng potential energy na maaaring ilabas kapag bumagsak!

statements.text: In hydropower, falling water from a dam spins the turbine to make clean electricity!
statements.tl: Sa hydropower, ang bumabagsak na tubig mula sa dam ang umiikot sa turbina para gumawa ng kuryente!

statements.text: The Angat Dam in Bulacan generates electricity by using the kinetic energy of falling water to spin massive turbines!
statements.tl: Ang Angat Dam sa Bulacan ay gumagawa ng electricity gamit ang galaw ng bumabagsak na tubig para paikutin ang mga malalaking turbine!

statements.text: Civil engineers design hydroelectric dams to take advantage of the conversion of water's potential energy into kinetic energy, which then becomes mechanical and electrical energy.
statements.tl: Ang mga civil engineer ay nagdidisenyo ng mga hydroelectric dam upang samantalahin ang pagbabago ng potential energy ng tubig tungo sa kinetic energy, na nagiging mechanical at electrical energy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1ZDRiZkqDRf8BTNrF3wXPAM8dVD517ec5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does a dam store energy like a battery?

Water held high behind a dam is like a giant battery! As long as it stays up high it stores energy, and that energy is released when the water falls onto the turbine.
statements.tl:
Paano nag-iimbak ng enerhiya ang dam na parang baterya?

Ang tubig na nakaimbak sa likod ng mataas na dam ay parang malaking baterya! Hangga't naka-angat ito, may nakatagong enerhiya, at lumalabas ang enerhiyang iyon kapag pinababagsak ang tubig sa turbine.

statements.text:
How does pumped storage work like a water battery?

When there's extra electricity, it pumps water back uphill into a high reservoir. When electricity is short, the water is released again to make power — like a water battery!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagana ang pumped storage na parang bateryang tubig?

Kapag sobra ang kuryente, ginagamit ito para itulak pabalik pataas ang tubig sa mataas na imbakan. Kapag kulang ang kuryente, pinababagsak muli ang tubig para gumawa ng kuryente — parang bateryang tubig!

statements.text:
Which renewable energy source makes the most electricity?

Hydroelectric power from flowing water! It makes the most and is one of the oldest, because people have harnessed the force of water for a very long time.
statements.tl:
Aling renewable na pinagkukunan ang pinakamaraming gumagawa ng kuryente?

Hydroelectric mula sa umaagos na tubig! Ito ang pinakamarami at isa sa pinakaluma, dahil matagal nang ginagamit ng tao ang lakas ng tubig.

statements.text:
How does a dam make electricity?

A dam blocks a river to collect water high up! When released downward, the water moves with great force to spin a turbine and make electricity.
statements.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng kuryente ang isang dam?

Ang dam ay humaharang sa ilog para tumipon ang tubig sa mataas! Kapag pinakawalan pababa, ang lakas ng tubig ay pumapaikot ng turbine para gumawa ng kuryente.

statements.text:
How does a hydroelectric dam like Magat make electricity?

Water's potential energy at the top becomes kinetic energy as it falls. This spins a turbine and turns into electricity!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng kuryente ang hydroelectric dam tulad ng Magat?

Ang potential energy ng tubig sa itaas ay nagiging kinetic energy habang bumababa. Pinapaikot nito ang isang turbine at nagiging kuryente!
statements.source: NRC PS3.B; DepEd G8 energy; encyclopedia-stable

statements.text:
How do hydroelectric dams make electricity?

In hydroelectric dams like Magat in Isabela, the power of flowing water spins the turbine and generator to make electricity!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng kuryente ang mga hydroelectric dams?

Sa mga hydroelectric dams tulad ng Magat sa Isabela, ang lakas ng dumadaloy na tubig ang nagpapaikot sa turbine at generator para gumawa ng kuryente!

statements.text:
Why does the height of a water drop matter for hydropower?

Higher drops give water more energy to drive a turbine and make electricity! That's why many hydro plants are built where water drops a long way down.
statements.tl:
Bakit mahalaga sa hydropower ang taas na pinanggagalingan ng bumabagsak na tubig?

Mas mataas na pagbagsak, mas maraming enerhiya ang tubig para magpaikot ng turbina at gumawa ng kuryente! Kaya maraming hydro plant ang itinatayo kung saan malayo ang bagsak ng tubig pababa.

statements.text: Height isn't the only thing that matters! The more water that flows past each second, the more electricity a hydro plant can make.
statements.tl: Hindi lang taas ang mahalaga! Mas maraming tubig na dumadaloy bawat segundo, mas malaking kuryente ang nagagawa ng hydro plant.

statements.text:
How does water reach the turbine?

Water from the dam flows down through a big pipe called a penstock, which carries the water with force straight to the turbine!
statements.tl:
Paano dumadaloy ang tubig papunta sa turbina?

Ang tubig mula sa dam ay dumadaloy pababa sa isang malaking tubo na tinatawag na penstock, na nagdadala ng tubig nang may lakas patungo sa turbina!

statements.text: At night, pumped-storage uses extra electricity to pump water up to a high lake. By day, the water falls to spin a turbine and make power!
statements.tl: Sa gabi, ang pumped-storage ay gumagamit ng extra electricity para ibomba ang tubig sa mataas na lawa. Sa araw, bubuhos ang tubig para paikutin ang turbine!

statements.text: Magat Dam in Isabela is one of the largest in the Philippines! It makes hydroelectric power and supplies irrigation water to Cagayan Valley rice farms.
statements.tl: Ang Magat Dam sa Isabela ay isa sa pinakamalaki sa Pilipinas! Gumagawa ito ng hydroelectric power at nagbibigay ng irrigation water sa mga palayan sa Cagayan Valley.

statements.text:
How does Mindanao get a large share of its electricity?

The hydroelectric plants along the Agus River, flowing from Lake Lanao, have long supplied a large share of Mindanao's electricity!
statements.tl:
Paano nakakakuha ng malaking bahagi ng kuryente ang Mindanao?

Ang mga hydroelectric plant sa Agus River na umaagos mula sa Lake Lanao ay matagal nang nagbibigay ng malaking bahagi ng kuryente sa Mindanao!

statements.text:
How do hydro plants react when we suddenly need more power?

They can open or shut water flow quickly! This helps them respond fast when electricity demand suddenly rises.
statements.tl:
Paano kaya tumutugon ang hydro plant kapag biglang kailangan natin ng maraming kuryente?

Madali nilang bubuksan o isasara ang daloy ng tubig! Kaya sila mabilis makatugon kapag biglang tumaas ang pangangailangan sa kuryente.
