statements.text: Lead is used as a shield to provide protection from penetrating X-rays and gamma rays, like the lead blanket dentists place on patients.
statements.tl: Ang lead ay ginagamit bilang shield para magbigay ng proteksyon laban sa tumatagos na X-rays at gamma rays, tulad ng lead blanket na inilalagay ng mga dentista sa mga pasyente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1N3fXFyacGhWO4usif7RQxDCKC9GHXvi5), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: X-rays and gamma rays are used in medicine: X-rays take pictures of bones, while gamma rays can target and destroy cancer cells in radiation therapy.
statements.tl: Ang X-rays at gamma rays ay ginagamit sa medisina: ang X-rays ay kumukuha ng larawan ng mga buto, habang ang gamma rays ay kayang puntiryahin at sirain ang cancer cells sa radiation therapy.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1XTiPka8t1U8gbBabNMc0aNM17hGu8vfa), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: X-rays are used in industry to find cracks in structures, metals, and plastics, just like doctors use them to find cracks in bones.
statements.tl: Ginagamit ang X-rays sa industriya upang makita ang mga crack sa structures, metals, at plastics, tulad ng paggamit ng mga doktor nito sa mga crack sa buto.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1bMacIlxnYJ46hjJUNCY0fUvdpZa7XTFI), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why do heat lamps feel warm?

They give off infrared radiation, which is also known as radiant energy emitted by objects because of their temperature, and this warms our skin and muscles.
statements.tl:
Bakit mainit ang pakiramdam ng heat lamps?

Naglalabas sila ng infrared radiation, na kilala rin bilang radiant energy na inilalabas ng mga bagay dahil sa kanilang temperatura, at ito ang nagpapainit sa ating balat at muscles.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1lTkxClihYNkt8QS1wN_HtscFozeOGH8P), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Gamma rays are highly penetrating waves, meaning they can pass through many materials, which is why they are used carefully in medical treatments.
statements.tl: Ang gamma rays ay highly penetrating waves, ibig sabihin kaya nilang tumagos sa maraming materyales, kaya maingat silang ginagamit sa mga medikal na paggamot.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1mRUSWxp2etzLm3SbsR8dFiV0EApC5R_N), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How do we get fast internet connections across the Philippines?

We use optical fibers! These thin glass fibers carry light signals over long distances with minimal loss, powering our internet and telecommunications connections.
statements.tl:
Paano tayo nakakakuha ng mabilis na internet connection sa buong Pilipinas?

Gumagamit tayo ng optical fibers! Ang mga manipis na glass fibers na ito ay nagdadala ng light signals sa malalayong distansya para sa ating internet at telecommunications.

statements.text:
Whose hand was in the very first famous X-ray photo?

It was the hand of Roentgen's wife! The photo clearly showed all the bones inside.
statements.tl:
Kaninong kamay ang nasa unang sikat na X-ray na larawan?

Kamay ito ng asawa ni Roentgen! Malinaw na nakita sa larawan ang lahat ng buto sa loob.

statements.text:
Why don't Wi-Fi, radio, and phone signals mix up?

They all use invisible radio waves, but each is tuned to its own frequency, just like different radio stations!
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi nagkakagulo ang wifi, radyo, at telepono?

Gumagamit sila ng invisible radio waves, pero bawat isa ay naka-tune sa sarili nitong frequency, parang iba't ibang radio station!

statements.text: A microwave mainly heats the food, while the plate can also get hot! It makes the water molecules inside your food vibrate super fast, and that shaking creates heat.
statements.tl: Pangunahing pinapainit ng microwave ang pagkain, pero maaari ring uminit ang plato! Pinapayanig nito nang super bilis ang water molecules sa loob ng pagkain, at ang pagyanig ay nagiging init.

statements.text: A thermal camera can detect infrared, allowing it to see the heat of a body even in the dark!
statements.tl: Ang thermal camera ay nakakakita ng infrared, kaya makikita nito ang init ng katawan kahit sa madilim!

statements.text: Excessive exposure to ionizing radiation can alter molecules within cells and may cause eventual harm such as skin or tissue damage, cancer, and death.
statements.tl: Ang labis na pagkakalantad sa ionizing radiation ay maaaring magbago ng mga molecules sa loob ng cells at magdulot ng pinsala tulad ng pagkasira ng balat o tissue, cancer, at kamatayan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 14iTKsqxfIKLJTH9tzmqXljcRk6OxgnMV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Ultraviolet light from the sun causes sunburn, which makes our skin turn red and get damaged!
statements.tl: Ang ultraviolet mula sa araw ang nagdudulot ng sunburn, na nagpapula at nakakasira sa ating balat!

statements.text:
How does sunlight damage DNA?

Ultraviolet light from the sun can create thymine dimers, where two thymine bases stick together and distort the DNA double helix.
statements.tl:
Paano nasisira ng sikat ng araw ang DNA?

Ang ultraviolet light mula sa araw ay maaaring lumikha ng thymine dimers, kung saan magkadikit ang dalawang thymine bases at nababaluktot ang DNA double helix.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1DmCoJIJKHoF-CSXwI-YyTi5jwZDWG0pA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What protects our skin from harmful sun rays?

The epidermis, the skin's outer layer, has special cells called melanocytes that make melanin to protect us from ultraviolet radiation.
statements.tl:
Ano ang bumabantay sa balat laban sa UV rays?

Ang epidermis, ang panlabas na patong ng balat, ay may melanocyte na gumagawa ng melanin para protektahan tayo laban sa UV radiation.

statements.text: The ozone layer in the stratosphere acts like Earth's sunscreen! It absorbs harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation, protecting us from skin cancer, eye damage, and harm to ecosystems.
statements.tl: Ang ozone layer sa stratosphere ay parang sunscreen ng Earth! Sumisipsip ito ng mapanganib na ultraviolet (UV) radiation, pinoprotektahan tayo sa skin cancer, pinsala sa mata, at pinsala sa ecosystem.

statements.text:
What protects us from the sun's harmful rays high up in the sky?

The ozone layer high in the atmosphere absorbs most of the harmful ultraviolet light coming from the sun!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nagpoprotekta sa atin mula sa nakasasamang rays ng araw sa itaas ng langit?

Ang ozone layer sa itaas ng atmospera ay sumisipsip ng karamihan sa nakakapinsalang ultraviolet mula sa araw!

statements.text: For light, higher frequency means more energy per photon! That's why ultraviolet sunlight can cause sunburn, while ordinary visible light does not cause sunburn.
statements.tl: Para sa liwanag, mas mataas na frequency ay nangangahulugang mas maraming enerhiya bawat photon! Kaya kayang magdulot ng sunburn ang ultraviolet mula sa araw, samantalang hindi nagdudulot nito ang karaniwang nakikitang liwanag.

statements.text: Cellphone radio waves are non-ionizing! Each photon has too little energy to ionize atoms the way X-rays can. Safety also depends on how strong an exposure is.
statements.tl: Non-ionizing ang mga radio wave ng cellphone! Napakababa ng enerhiya ng bawat photon para mag-ionize ng atomo tulad ng X-ray. Nakadepende rin ang kaligtasan sa tindi ng pagkakalantad.

statements.text:
What band of sunlight causes sunburn on our skin?

Ultraviolet (UV) is the band of sunlight that causes sunburn on the skin!
statements.tl:
Anong banda ng sikat ng araw ang nagdudulot ng sunburn sa balat?

Ang ultraviolet (UV) ang banda ng sikat ng araw na nagdudulot ng sunburn sa balat!

statements.text: Sunscreen with a high SPF blocks harmful ultraviolet radiation, protecting your skin cells from DNA damage and sunburn!
statements.tl: Ang sunscreen na may mataas na SPF ay humaharang sa harmful ultraviolet radiation, pinoprotektahan ang skin cells mo mula sa DNA damage at sunburn!

statements.text: Because UV rays carry high energy, they can damage skin cells! Too much exposure causes sunburn and even skin cancer. That's why sunscreen and shade are so important!
statements.tl: Dahil may mataas na energy ang UV rays, kayang-sira nila ang mga skin cells! Sobrang exposure ay nagdudulot ng sunburn at skin cancer. Kaya mahalaga ang sunscreen at lilim!
statements.source: NRC PS4.B (short-wavelength radiation ionizes, damages cells); AAAS 4F/H6

statements.text: X-rays carry high energy that can ionize atoms and damage living cells! That's why doctors carefully control the amount used and wear protective shields like lead aprons in hospitals.
statements.tl: Ang X-rays ay may mataas na energy na kayang mag-ionize ng atoms at makasira ng living cells! Kaya kontrolado ng mga doktor ang dami ng ginagamit at nagsusuot ng protective shields tulad ng lead aprons sa ospital.
statements.source: NRC PS4.B (ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays ionize atoms, damage cells)

statements.text: Short-wavelength EM waves like X-rays and gamma are ionizing—they can knock out electrons and damage cells! Radio, microwave, and infrared are non-ionizing and much safer.
statements.tl: Ang maiikling wavelength na EM waves tulad ng X-rays at gamma ay ionizing—kaya nilang tanggalin ang electrons at sirain ang cells! Ang radio, microwave, at infrared ay non-ionizing at mas ligtas.
statements.source: NRC PS4.B (short-wavelength radiation ionizes atoms, damages cells)

statements.text: If the ozone layer suddenly disappeared, way too much UV would reach the ground! It would cause more sunburn, skin and eye problems, and damage plants and tiny sea animals too.
statements.tl: Kung biglang mawala ang ozone layer, masyadong maraming UV ang aabot sa lupa! Magdudulot ito ng mas maraming sunburn, sakit sa balat at mata, at sisira rin ng mga halaman at maliliit na hayop sa dagat.

statements.text:
Why don't we get sunburned right away outside?

The ozone layer blocks most of the dangerous UV rays! Without it, even a short time in the strong sun could badly burn our skin.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi tayo agad napapaso sa labas?

Hinahadlangan ng ozone layer ang karamihan sa mapanganib na UV rays! Kung wala ito, kahit sandali lang sa matinding araw ay maaari nang makapaso ang ating balat.

statements.text:
Why does ozone need to block UV?

UV rays carry very strong energy! They can burn skin, harm eyes, and in large amounts cause skin cancer — so it's great that ozone blocks them.
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangan harangin ng ozone ang UV?

Ang UV rays ay sobrang lakas ng enerhiya! Nakakapaso ng balat, nakakasama sa mata, at sa sobrang dami pwedeng magdulot ng skin cancer — kaya mabuti na lang at hinaharang ito ng ozone.

statements.text:
Does ozone block every single UV ray?

Nope! Ozone blocks the most dangerous UV, but a little UV still slips through — so we can still get sunburned if we stay too long in the sun.
statements.tl:
Hinaharang ba ng ozone ang lahat ng UV?

Hindi lahat! Hinaharang ng ozone ang pinakadelikadong UV, pero may konting UV pa ring nakakalusot — kaya pwede pa rin tayong mapaso kung sobra sa araw.

statements.text:
Did you know ozone protects more than just us?

Yes! It shields plants, animals, and tiny sea creatures from too much UV. Without it, our food and air-giving plants would struggle to survive!
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba na hindi lang tayo ang pinoprotektahan ng ozone?

Pinoprotektahan din nito ang halaman, hayop, at maliliit na nilalang sa dagat sa sobrang UV! Kung wala ito, mahihirapang mabuhay ang mga halaman na nagbibigay ng pagkain at hangin.

statements.text: The Appalachian Mountains of eastern North America link with the Scottish Highlands, showing these lands were once connected.
statements.tl: Ang Appalachian Mountains ng silangang North America ay konektado sa Scottish Highlands, na nagpapakitang dating magkadikit ang mga lupaing ito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1CC-09Q5LWQPrHRoQx1Ofzr4JXiruUTAW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Because the plates move, the continents slowly drifted apart to where they are today!
statements.tl: Dahil sa galaw ng mga plaka, dahan-dahang naghiwalay ang mga kontinente patungo sa kinaroroonan nila ngayon!

statements.text: The coastlines of South America and Africa fit together like puzzle pieces — a clue they were once joined!
statements.tl: Ang baybayin ng South America at Africa ay magkasya na parang mga piraso ng palaisipan — isang palatandaan na dati silang magkadikit!

statements.text:
Why do we find the same ancient fossils on continents far apart?

Identical fossils of the same ancient plants and animals are found on far-apart continents, showing that these lands were once joined together!
statements.tl:
Bakit may magkatulad na fossils ng sinaunang hayop at halaman sa mga kontinenteng magkalayo na?

May magkatulad na fossils ng parehong sinaunang halaman at hayop sa mga kontinenteng magkalayo na, na nagpapakita na dating magkadikit ang mga lupain!

statements.text:
Could Mesosaurus swim across the Atlantic Ocean?

No! Mesosaurus was a coastal reptile that could not have crossed such a large ocean, so the continents must have been joined.
statements.tl:
Kaya bang lumangoy ng Mesosaurus patawid ng Atlantic Ocean?

Hindi! Ang Mesosaurus ay isang coastal reptile na hindi kayang tumawid sa napakalaking karagatan, kaya malamang na magkadikit noon ang mga kontinente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1CC-09Q5LWQPrHRoQx1Ofzr4JXiruUTAW), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Alfred Wegener first proposed the continental drift theory in the early 20th century, changing how we understand Earth's geological history.
statements.tl: Si Alfred Wegener ang unang nagmungkahi ng continental drift theory noong unang bahagi ng ika-20 siglo, na nagbago sa ating pag-unawa sa geological history ng Earth.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1S-4LS2g30cEO6gb3ujdksKPiilxVouBx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What kinds of evidence support the existence of Pangaea?

Biological evidence like fossils, geological evidence like matching rocks, climate evidence like glacial deposits, and seafloor spreading!
statements.tl:
Anong mga uri ng ebidensya ang sumusuporta sa pag-iral ng Pangaea?

Biological evidence tulad ng fossils, geological evidence tulad ng magkatugmang bato, climate evidence tulad ng glacial deposits, at seafloor spreading!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1S-4LS2g30cEO6gb3ujdksKPiilxVouBx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What evidence did Wegener use to support his theory?

He used matching coastlines, similar rock formations, identical fossils on separate continents, and climate clues like glacial deposits!
statements.tl:
Anong ebidensya ang ginamit ni Wegener upang suportahan ang kanyang teorya?

Ginamit niya ang magkatugmang coastlines, magkakatulad na rock formations, magkakaparehong fossils sa magkakahiwalay na kontinente, at mga climate clue tulad ng glacial deposits!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1S-4LS2g30cEO6gb3ujdksKPiilxVouBx), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The continental drift theory states that Earth's continents were once joined together in a single landmass and have slowly moved apart over millions of years.
statements.tl: Sinasabi ng continental drift theory na ang mga kontinente ng Earth ay dating magkakadikit sa isang malaking lupain at dahan-dahang nagkahiwalay sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1fPGla1FN3DHCh2rLsSH4BmifaHcv_FZw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Paleomagnetism is the study of magnetic minerals in ancient rocks, and it reveals the latitude where those rocks formed, helping scientists reconstruct past continental positions.
statements.tl: Ang paleomagnetism ay pag-aaral ng magnetic minerals sa mga sinaunang bato, at ipinapakita nito ang latitude kung saan nabuo ang mga batong iyon, na tumutulong sa mga scientist na buuin muli ang dating posisyon ng mga kontinente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1mR0GE1ma0E0eiqhu0yPxWv1S54gDRh9E), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: After facing criticism, Wegener searched for evidence to support his theory, looking at fossils, rock features, and ancient climates.
statements.tl: Matapos punahin, naghanap si Wegener ng mga ebidensya upang suportahan ang kanyang teorya, tinitingnan ang mga fossil, katangian ng bato, at sinaunang klima.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-17946), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Were all the continents always in the same place?

Millions of years ago, all continents were joined in one huge landmass called Pangaea!
statements.tl:
Nasa parehong lugar ba palagi ang mga kontinente?

Milyon-milyong taon na ang nakaraan, ang lahat ng kontinente ay magkadikit sa iisang malaking lupa na tinatawag na Pangaea!

statements.text: Matching fossils of animals and plants are found on separate continents, proving they were once connected!
statements.tl: Magkatulad na fossil ng mga hayop at halaman ang natagpuan sa magkahiwalay na kontinente, nagpapatunay na dati silang magkadikit!

statements.text:
Did you know our continents were once joined together as one giant landmass?

The supercontinent Pangaea started breaking apart about 200 million years ago, slowly forming the continents we see today!
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba na ang mga kontinente ay dati nang magkakadikit bilang isang malaking lupain?

Nagsimulang mawasak ang supercontinent na Pangaea mga 200 milyong taon na ang nakaraan, at unti-unting naging mga kontinente ngayon!

statements.text:
Did all Philippine islands come from volcanoes?

Nope! Palawan was once part of Asia's big landmass and slowly drifted to its spot. That's why some Palawan animals look more like those in Borneo!
statements.tl:
Lahat ba ng isla ng Pilipinas ay galing sa bulkan?

Hindi! Ang Palawan ay dating bahagi ng malaking lupain ng Asya at dahan-dahang lumipat. Kaya ang ilang hayop doon ay mas kahawig ng nasa Borneo!

statements.text:
Did all the continents used to be connected?

Yes! Millions of years ago, they formed one giant landmass called Pangaea, slowly drifting apart as the tectonic plates moved.
statements.tl:
Magkadikit ba dati ang lahat ng kontinente?

Oo! Milyon-milyong taon na ang nakalipas, bumuo sila ng isang malaking lupain na Pangaea, at dahan-dahang naghiwalay habang gumagalaw ang mga tectonic plate.
statements.source: NRC ESS2.B; DepEd G8 Earth Science

statements.text:
What is continental drift?

In 1912, Alfred Wegener proposed continental drift! It means continents were once joined and slowly moved apart over millions of years.
statements.tl:
Ano ang continental drift?

Noong 1912, iminungkahi ni Alfred Wegener ang continental drift! Ibig sabihin, ang mga kontinente ay dating magkadikit at dahan-dahang naglayo sa paglipas ng milyon-milyong taon.
statements.source: AAAS BSL 4C/H; consensus history of geology

statements.text:
Did you know Earth's continents were once one giant puzzle?

About 300 million years ago, all continents were joined in one giant landmass called Pangaea before slowly breaking apart to form today's continents!
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba na ang mga kontinente ng Earth ay dati isang higanteng puzzle?

Mga 300 milyong taon na ang nakalipas, nagsama-sama ang lahat ng kontinente sa isang higanteng lupa na tinatawag na Pangaea bago unti-unting humati!

statements.text: Deep ocean trenches are topographical evidence of plate boundaries because they form where one plate slides beneath another!
statements.tl: Ang malalalim na trench sa dagat ay topographical evidence ng plate boundaries dahil nabubuo ang mga ito kung saan dumudulas ang isang plate sa ilalim ng isa pa!

statements.text: Scientists map plate boundaries by plotting where volcanoes and earthquakes cluster. The Philippines shows a very clear pattern!
statements.tl: Minamapa ng mga scientist ang plate boundaries sa pamamagitan ng pag-plot kung saan nag-cluster ang mga bulkan at lindol. Malinaw ang pattern ng Pilipinas!

statements.text:
What did the Tharp-Heezen map reveal that changed science?

It showed underwater mountain ranges, valleys, and faults on the ocean floor, giving strong evidence that Earth's crust is broken into moving plates!
statements.tl:
Ano ang ipinakita ng Tharp-Heezen map na nagbago sa agham?

Ipinakita nito ang mga underwater mountain ranges, lambak, at faults sa sahig ng karagatan, na nagbigay ng matibay na ebidensya na ang crust ng Earth ay basag at nahahati sa mga gumagalaw na plate!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1j8nMnJQ0zhFC8nVcRkTo1b_4wbqWP719), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Folds, faults, and thrusts are geological structures that form in response to the stresses and strains generated by plate motion, providing evidence of past tectonic activity.
statements.tl: Ang folds, faults, at thrusts ay mga geological structures na nabubuo bilang tugon sa stresses at strains na dulot ng plate motion, na nagbibigay ng ebidensya ng nakaraang tectonic activity.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1mR0GE1ma0E0eiqhu0yPxWv1S54gDRh9E), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Which two large plates squeeze the Philippines?

The Philippines is squeezed right between two large plates: the Philippine Sea Plate and the Eurasian Plate!
statements.tl:
Anong dalawang malaking plaka ang nakaiipit sa Pilipinas?

Nakaipit ang Pilipinas sa pagitan ng dalawang malaking plaka: ang Philippine Sea Plate at ang Eurasian Plate!

statements.text: The Philippine Trench lies along the eastern side of the Philippines, hidden beneath the Pacific Ocean!
statements.tl: Ang Philippine Trench ay matatagpuan sa silangang bahagi ng Pilipinas, nakatago sa ilalim ng Karagatang Pasipiko!

statements.text: The Philippine Trench is a subduction zone! Here, the Philippine Sea Plate sinks right beneath the Philippine plate.
statements.tl: Ang Philippine Trench ay isang subduction zone! Dito, lumulubog ang Philippine Sea Plate sa ilalim ng Philippine plate.

statements.text: The Philippine Trench is actually deeper than Mount Everest is tall! It's deeper than the tallest mountain on Earth.
statements.tl: Mas malalim pa ang Philippine Trench kaysa sa taas ng Mount Everest! Mas malalim ito kaysa sa pinakamataas na bundok sa mundo.

statements.text: The Manila Trench goes really deep! It reaches a depth of about 5,400 meters under the ocean waves.
statements.tl: Napakalalim ng Manila Trench! Umaabot ito sa lalim na halos 5,400 metro sa ilalim ng mga alon.

statements.text: A plate boundary is the meeting line where two tectonic plates touch, and the Philippines sits on several of these lines!
statements.tl: Ang plate boundary ay ang linyang pinagtatagpuan kung saan nagdidikit ang dalawang tectonic plates, at ang Pilipinas ay nakaupo sa ilan sa mga linyang ito!

statements.text:
Did you know volcanoes line up in chains?

Yes! They form chains along plate boundaries. The row of Philippine volcanoes helps reveal nearby plate boundaries!
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba na nakapila ang mga bulkan?

Oo! Bumubuo sila ng chain sa plate boundaries. Ang hanay ng bulkan sa Pilipinas ay tumutulong matukoy ang malalapit na hangganan ng mga plate!

statements.text: The Sierra Madre mountain range rose from the collision of plates! This shows cool geological evidence of a plate boundary.
statements.tl: Ang bulubundukin ng Sierra Madre ay tumaas mula sa banggaan ng mga plate! Nagpapakita ito ng geological evidence ng isang boundary.

statements.text: Hot springs and geothermal areas in the Philippines mark places where underground heat warms groundwater!
statements.tl: Ang mga hot spring at geothermal areas sa Pilipinas ay nagmamarka ng mga lugar kung saan pinapainit ng init sa ilalim ng lupa ang tubig sa lupa!

statements.text: The curved chains of Philippine islands mirror the curved lines where the plates meet beneath the sea!
statements.tl: Ang mga kurbadong chain ng mga isla ng Pilipinas ay sumasalamin sa mga kurbadong linya kung saan nagsasalubong ang mga plate sa ilalim ng dagat!

statements.text: Scientists use GPS instruments to measure how the Philippine plates move a few centimeters each year!
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang mga scientist ng GPS instruments para sukatin kung paano gumagalaw ang mga plate ng Pilipinas ng ilang sentimetro bawat taon!

statements.text: The Philippines is not one single plate! It is a jigsaw of small crustal blocks called the Philippine Mobile Belt, squeezed between two big plates.
statements.tl: Ang Pilipinas ay hindi isang buong plate! Ito ay parang jigsaw puzzle ng maliliit na piraso ng crust na tinatawag na Philippine Mobile Belt, na pinipiga sa pagitan ng dalawang malalaking plate.

statements.text:
What are the subduction zones around the Philippines?

Besides the Philippine Trench, the Manila, Negros, and Cotabato trenches are other subduction zones where plates dive beneath the Philippines!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mga subduction zones sa paligid ng Pilipinas?

Bukod sa Philippine Trench, ang Manila, Negros, at Cotabato trenches ay iba pang subduction zones kung saan sumisisid ang mga plate sa ilalim ng Pilipinas!

statements.text: Deep earthquakes happening hundreds of kilometers underground trace the sinking slab beneath the Philippines, proving that subduction is happening!
statements.tl: Ang malalalim na lindol na nangyayari daan-daang kilometro sa ilalim ng lupa ay sumusubaybay sa lumulubog na slab sa ilalim ng Pilipinas, na nagpapatunay na may subduction!

statements.text: There are three plate boundaries: convergent — plates collide and one subducts or land crunches up; divergent — plates move apart and new crust forms; transform — plates slide horizontally past each other with no crust created or destroyed.
statements.tl: May tatlong plate boundaries: convergent — nagtatagpo ang mga plato at isa ang nagsa-subduct o kumukulubot ang lupa; divergent — lumalayò ang mga plato at nabubuo ang bagong crust; transform — pahalang na dumudulas ang mga plato nang walang crust na nabubuo o nawawala.

statements.text: At a divergent boundary, two plates pull apart! Magma rises from below, cools down, and forms brand new crust.
statements.tl: Sa divergent boundary, naghihiwalay ang dalawang plato! Umaakyat ang magma mula sa ilalim, lumalamig, at bumubuo ng bagong crust.

statements.text:
What happens when plates crash into each other?

At a convergent boundary, plates push and collide! This creates tall mountains, deep trenches, and lots of earthquakes and volcanoes.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag nagbanggaan ang mga plato?

Sa convergent boundary, nagtutulak at nagbabanggaan ang mga plato! Dito nabubuo ang matataas na kabundukan, malalalim na trench, lindol, at bulkan.

statements.text: At a transform boundary, plates slide and grind past each other sideways! This rough rubbing often causes strong earthquakes.
statements.tl: Sa transform boundary, nagdadaplis at nagkikiskisan ang mga plato nang pahalang! Ang pagkiskis na ito ay kadalasang nagdudulot ng malalakas na lindol.

statements.text: When an oceanic plate subducts beneath a continental plate, the rising magma creates a line of volcanoes on the continent called a volcanic arc.
statements.tl: Kapag ang oceanic plate ay sumusubduct sa ilalim ng continental plate, ang umaakyat na magma ay bumubuo ng hanay ng mga bulkan sa kontinente na tinatawag na volcanic arc.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 10Pb80v8BbgFnZCIDMDfQtXCNqWaYMFrp), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: There are three types of convergent plate interactions: oceanic-continental, oceanic-oceanic, and continental-continental, each forming different landforms.
statements.tl: May tatlong uri ng convergent plate interactions: oceanic-continental, oceanic-oceanic, at continental-continental, na bawat isa ay bumubuo ng iba't ibang anyong lupa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 121-uDtX-5IqzkiXeWEKqkzlKaCideMpg), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Convergent boundaries are destructive zones where two tectonic plates move toward each other and collide.
statements.tl: Ang convergent boundaries ay mga destructive zone kung saan ang dalawang tectonic plate ay kumikilos palapit sa isa't isa at nagbabanggaan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 130utqrpVVXt9JXlDvfrBcmBrGhxVmIts), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Off the coast of South America, the oceanic Nazca Plate subducts beneath the continental South American Plate along the Peru-Chile Trench.
statements.tl: Sa baybayin ng South America, ang oceanic Nazca Plate ay sumusubduct sa ilalim ng continental South American Plate sa Peru-Chile Trench.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 130utqrpVVXt9JXlDvfrBcmBrGhxVmIts), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Convergent boundaries, where tectonic plates push toward each other, come in three kinds: oceanic-oceanic, oceanic-continental, and continental-continental.
statements.tl: Ang convergent boundaries, kung saan nagsasalpukan ang mga tectonic plate, ay may tatlong uri: oceanic-oceanic, oceanic-continental, at continental-continental.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1B4l2r7cVpGHRA9JXjWIV5GIVJMM6Ihz8), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The South American Plate and African Plate form a divergent boundary, so South America is moving away from Africa.
statements.tl: Ang South American Plate at African Plate ay bumubuo ng divergent boundary, kaya ang South America ay lumalayo sa Africa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1VHHZVuic8Wx0_ZbypEXpvvNB6x6wBl2Q), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Scientists now describe plate movement as a gravity-driven convection system: young hot plates are pushed away from spreading ridges, and old cold plates are pulled down into subduction zones.
statements.tl: Inilalarawan ngayon ng mga scientist ang plate movement bilang gravity-driven convection system: ang mga batang mainit na plate ay itinutulak palayo sa spreading ridges, at ang mga lumang malamig na plate ay hinihila pababa sa subduction zones.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1mR0GE1ma0E0eiqhu0yPxWv1S54gDRh9E), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Subduction is the sideways and downward movement of a tectonic plate's edge as it is forced to sink beneath another plate into the mantle.
statements.tl: Ang subduction ay ang patagilid at pababang paggalaw ng gilid ng isang tectonic plate habang ito ay pinipilit lumubog sa ilalim ng isa pang plate papasok sa mantle.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-18002), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
What happens to tectonic plates around the Philippines?

One plate slides beneath another in a process called subduction, forming deep ocean trenches!
statements.tl:
Anong nangyayari sa mga plaka sa palibot ng Pilipinas?

Lumulubog ang isang plaka sa ilalim ng isa pa sa proseso na tinatawag na subduction, na lumilikha ng malalalim na kanal sa karagatan!

statements.text:
What happens to the dirt and rocks when a tectonic plate dives underwater?

When a plate subducts, sediment on its surface is scraped off and piles up as an accretionary prism! It's a chaotic, mixed pile of rocks found in front of subduction zones around the Philippines!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa lupa at bato kapag sumisid ang tectonic plate?

Na-scrape ang sediment at nagtitipon bilang accretionary prism! Ito ay magulong, mixed na bato sa harapan ng subduction zone sa Pilipinas.

statements.text:
What is a plate boundary?

It’s the meeting line where two moving pieces of Earth's lithosphere, made of crust and uppermost mantle touch! Most earthquakes and volcanoes happen here.
statements.tl:
Ano ang plate boundary?

Ito yung linya kung saan nagtatagpo ang dalawang gumagalaw na piraso ng lithosphere ng Earth, na binubuo ng crust at pinakataas na mantle! Dito madalas nangyayari ang lindol at bulkan.

statements.text: At the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, new crust is born! Magma fills the gap, pushing plates apart 2 to 5 centimeters yearly.
statements.tl: Sa Mid-Atlantic Ridge, nabubuo ang bagong crust! Pinupuno ng magma ang puwang, na nagtutulak sa mga plate nang 2 hanggang 5 sentimetro bawat taon.

statements.text: Earth's outer shell is like a giant puzzle! It has about seven large plates and smaller ones, all moving at different speeds.
statements.tl: Ang panlabas na balat ng Earth ay parang giant puzzle! May pitong malalaking plate at mas maliliit, lahat gumagalaw sa iba't ibang bilis.

statements.text: Divergent boundaries create new crust, while subduction zones recycle old crust! This cycle helps keep Earth's surface roughly the same size.
statements.tl: Ang divergent boundaries ay gumagawa ng bagong crust, habang nire-recycle ng subduction zones ang lumang crust! Tumutulong ang siklong ito na panatilihing halos pareho ang laki ng surface ng Earth.

statements.text: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, through changes in speed or direction! It happens when a vehicle speeds up, slows down, or turns.
statements.tl: Ang aselerasyon ay bilis ng pagbabago ng velocity, sa pamamagitan ng pagbabago sa bilis o direksyon! Nangyayari ito kapag bumibilis, bumabagal, o lumiliko ang sasakyan.
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; AAAS BSL Ch.4 Motion

statements.text: Even at constant speed, an object in circular motion has an acceleration pointing toward the center because its velocity direction keeps changing!
statements.tl: Kahit sa constant speed, ang isang bagay sa circular motion ay may acceleration na nakaturo papasentro dahil patuloy na nagbabago ang direksyon ng velocity nito!
statements.source: consensus physics; AAAS 4F/M3; DepEd G10 Q4

statements.text: A car slows down after a ride because friction between the tires and the road, and air resistance, work together to oppose its motion.
statements.tl: Bumabagal ang isang kotse pagkatapos ng biyahe dahil ang friction sa pagitan ng mga gulong at kalsada, at ang air resistance, ay nagtutulungan upang salungatin ang galaw nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 130hlDFWaD5jlzcff92h4ErXr17vZZ5Nn), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A falling fruit accelerates downward because the unbalanced force of gravity acts on it, changing its state of motion.
statements.tl: Ang isang nahuhulog na prutas ay bumibilis pababa dahil ang hindi balanseng puwersa ng gravity ay kumikilos dito, na nagbabago sa estado ng paggalaw nito.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 17CV5foo-VojUN0GWnRVIKbrlA1RTueDt), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
If you throw a ball upward at 30 m/s, how fast is it moving just before you catch it?

It is moving at 30 m/s again, but now downward, so its velocity is negative 30 m/s!
statements.tl:
Kung ihahagis mo ang bola pataas sa 30 m/s, gaano ito kabilis bago mo ito saluhin?

Kumikilos ito ng 30 m/s muli, ngunit pababa na ngayon, kaya ang velocity nito ay negative 30 m/s!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id lrmds-17949), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An object's acceleration is always in the direction of the net force! A forward net force speeds it up, backward slows it down, and sideways makes it turn.
statements.tl: Ang acceleration ng isang bagay ay laging nasa direksyon ng net force! Kung pasulong, bumibilis; kung pabalik, bumabagal; at kung patagilid, lumiliko ito.

statements.text: When something slows down, it still has acceleration! The force points opposite to its motion, called deceleration.
statements.tl: Kapag bumabagal ang isang bagay, may aselerasyon pa rin ito! Nakaturo ang puwersa pabaliktad sa galaw, kaya tinatawag itong deceleration.
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; encyclopedia-stable consensus; DepEd G9-10 kinematics

statements.text: In physics, acceleration means ANY change in speed OR direction! A force can speed up, slow down, or turn an object. Even a car turning at constant speed is accelerating!
statements.tl: Sa physics, ang acceleration ay anumang pagbabago sa bilis O direksyon! Ang force ay puwedeng pabilisin, pabagalin, o pabaguhin ang direksyon ng isang bagay. Kahit pareho ang bilis ng kotse na lumiliko, may acceleration pa rin ito!

statements.text:
Is a car accelerating when it turns?

Yes! Acceleration is any change in speed or direction. So a car speeding up, slowing down, or turning a corner is all accelerating!
statements.tl:
Nag-a-accelerate ba ang kotse kapag lumiliko?

Oo! Ang acceleration ay pagbabago ng bilis o direksyon. Kaya kapag bumibilis, bumabagal, o lumiliko sa kurba ang kotse, nag-a-accelerate ito!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; NRC PS2.A; DepEd G5 Science

statements.text: A hockey puck is a flat disk used in ice hockey. When it slides over ice, kinetic friction acts against its motion and helps slow it down. A decrease in speed is called deceleration.
statements.tl: Ang hockey puck ay isang patag na disk na ginagamit sa ice hockey. Kapag dumudulas ito sa yelo, kumikilos ang kinetic friction salungat sa galaw nito at tumutulong na pabagalin ito. Ang pagbaba ng bilis ay tinatawag na deceleration.

statements.text: A heavier object needs a larger net force for the same acceleration, so, under the same net force, a loaded truck accelerates slower than an empty jeepney!
statements.tl: Kailangan ng mas malaking net force ng mas mabigat na bagay para sa parehong acceleration, kaya, sa parehong net force, mas mabagal bumilis ang kargadong trak kaysa sa walang lamang jeepney!

statements.text:
How does a jeepney speed up?

When it speeds up, the road's forward force on the driven tires is larger than backward resistance, so the net force pushes it forward to accelerate!
statements.tl:
Paano bumibilis ang jeepney?

Kapag bumibilis, mas malaki ang pasulong na puwersa ng kalsada sa pinapaandar na gulong kaysa sa paatras na resistensya, kaya ang net force ay pasulong at bumibilis ang jeepney!

statements.text:
What happens to the forces when a car brakes?

The road's friction acts backward, making the net force backward. The car accelerates backward, which we feel as slowing down!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa mga puwersa kapag pumreno ang kotse?

Kumikilos paatras ang friction ng kalsada, kaya paatras ang net force. May acceleration paatras ang kotse, na nararamdaman natin bilang pagbagal!

statements.text:
What happens to a ball thrown straight up at its highest point?

Its speed is zero for an instant, but its acceleration is still downward because gravity never stops pulling it!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa bolang inihagis nang diretso pataas sa pinakamataas nitong punto?

Ang bilis nito ay zero sa isang saglit, pero pababa pa rin ang acceleration nito dahil hindi tumitigil ang paghila ng gravity!

statements.text:
Why does a rocket accelerate upward?

The upward thrust from its engines is greater than gravity's downward pull, creating an upward net force!
statements.tl:
Bakit may acceleration paitaas ang rocket?

Mas malaki ang paitaas na thrust ng makina kaysa sa paghila pababa ng gravity, kaya paitaas ang net force!

statements.text: Pedaling harder increases the forward net force, so the bike's acceleration increases and it speeds up faster!
statements.tl: Ang mas malakas na pagpadyak ay nagpapalaki ng pasulong na net force, kaya tumataas ang acceleration ng bisikleta at mas mabilis itong bumibilis!

statements.text: When a bus turns left, the road's friction pulls it left. It accelerates left, even if passengers feel pushed right!
statements.tl: Kapag kumaliwa ang bus, hinihila ito ng friction ng kalsada pakaliwa. May acceleration ito pakaliwa, kahit pakiramdam ng pasahero ay itinutulak sila pakanan!

statements.text:
How do we measure a car's acceleration?

If a car goes from rest to 60 km/h in 10 seconds, its average acceleration is about 6 km/h per second — its speed increases by that much per second on average!
statements.tl:
Paano natin sinusukat ang acceleration ng isang kotse?

Kung ang kotse ay mula sa tigil papunta sa 60 km/h sa loob ng 10 segundo, ang average acceleration nito ay mga 6 km/h bawat segundo — ganoon ang karaniwang pagtaas ng bilis bawat segundo!

statements.text: Newton's second law means acceleration equals net force divided by mass (F=ma). This means a heavier object needs more force to achieve the same acceleration as a lighter one!
statements.tl: Sa ikalawang batas ni Newton, ang acceleration ay katumbas ng netong puwersa na hinati sa masa (F=ma). Kaya ang mas mabigat na bagay ay nangangailangan ng mas malaking puwersa para makamit ang parehong acceleration ng mas magaan!
statements.source: encyclopedia-stable; NRC PS2.A; DepEd G5 Science

statements.text: The equation for Newton's second law is F=ma (net force = mass x acceleration)!
statements.tl: Ang ekwasyon ng ikalawang batas ni Newton ay F=ma (net force = masa x acceleration)!

statements.text: During a collision, objects with different masses accelerate differently, so a lighter object changes speed more quickly than a heavier one when the same force is applied.
statements.tl: Sa panahon ng collision, ang mga bagay na magkaiba ang mass ay magkaiba rin ang acceleration, kaya mas mabilis magbago ang bilis ng magaan na bagay kaysa mabigat kapag pareho ang puwersa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15f54pBDlTb4wJnKOQdhwGWMdU1qPK_CV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: In a paper ball race, a ball with gravel inside has more mass, so it accelerates slower than a pure paper ball when the same force is applied.
statements.tl: Sa paper ball race, ang bola na may graba sa loob ay may mas maraming mass, kaya mas mabagal itong mag-accelerate kaysa sa purong paper ball kapag parehong puwersa ang inilapat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 15jwZia9QxjKBU-ZelB1InsYCSYycTWHZ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How much force is needed to accelerate a 2500 kg truck at 1.5 m/s²?

Use F=ma: multiply 2500 kg by 1.5 m/s². The force needed is 3750 newtons!
statements.tl:
Gaano karaming force ang kailangan para mapabilis ang isang 2500 kg na trak sa 1.5 m/s²?

Gamitin ang F=ma: i-multiply ang 2500 kg sa 1.5 m/s². Ang kailangang force ay 3750 newtons!
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1sJr7EA2T0BNWbhi_KhQRzKLQWHVcW22h), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To find mass, divide the force by the acceleration, so a 6-newton force causing 12 m/s² acceleration means the object has a mass of 0.5 kilograms.
statements.tl: Para mahanap ang mass, hatiin ang force sa acceleration, kaya ang 6-newton na puwersa na nagdudulot ng 12 m/s² na acceleration ay nangangahulugang ang bagay ay may mass na 0.5 kilograms.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1sJr7EA2T0BNWbhi_KhQRzKLQWHVcW22h), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: For the same mass, doubling the force doubles the acceleration! Force is directly proportional to acceleration, shown by the formula F = ma.
statements.tl: Para sa parehong masa, kapag dinoble mo ang force, dinodoble mo rin ang acceleration! Direktang proporsyonal ang force sa acceleration (F = ma).

statements.text: For the same force, doubling the mass halves the acceleration! Acceleration is inversely proportional to mass, which we can see in the formula a = F/m.
statements.tl: Sa parehong force, kapag dinoble mo ang mass, nababawasan ng kalahati ang acceleration! Baligtad na proporsyonal ang acceleration sa mass (a = F/m).

statements.text:
Why does a carabao need more force for a loaded cart?

Bigger mass means smaller acceleration! For the same force (F = ma), a heavy loaded cart accelerates slower than an empty one.
statements.tl:
Bakit kailangan ng kalabaw ng mas malaking puwersa para sa punong kariton?

Mas malaking masa, mas maliit na acceleration! Sa parehong puwersa (F = ma), mas mabagal pabilisin ang punong kariton kaysa sa walang laman.
statements.source: NRC PS2.A (Newton's second law); DepEd G8

statements.text:
Why is it harder to push a heavy box than a light one?

Newton's second law says a heavier object needs a bigger force to speed it up! Force equals mass times acceleration (F = ma).
statements.tl:
Bakit mas mahirap itulak ang mabigat na kahon kaysa sa magaan?

Ayon sa ikalawang batas ni Newton, mas malaking puwersa ang kailangan para pabilisin ang mas mabigat na bagay! Ang puwersa ay masa na minultiply sa acceleration (F = ma).
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; AAAS BSL Ch.4 Motion

statements.text:
Do equal forces make things move at the same speed?

Even if action and reaction forces are equal in size, the lighter object speeds up more than the heavier object!
statements.tl:
Pareho ba ang bilis ng galaw kapag magkapareho ang lakas ng aksyon at reaksyon?

Kahit magkapareho ang lakas ng aksyon at reaksyon, mas malaki ang acceleration ng magaan na bagay kaysa sa mabigat!

statements.text:
Why is it harder to paddle a heavily loaded banca?

A heavy load needs more force to move! When loaded with many passengers or fish, you need stronger or more paddle strokes to start and speed up the heavier boat.
statements.tl:
Bakit mas mahirap isagwan ang banca kapag mabigat ang lulan?

Kailangan ng mas malaking puwersa para igalaw ang mabigat na lulan! Kapag maraming pasahero o isda, kailangan mo ng mas malakas o mas maraming paghagod ng sagwan para mabilis ito.

statements.text:
Why is it harder to push a heavy cart?

For the same force, a heavier object's motion changes less! An empty cart is easy to push, but a loaded cart is hard to push. The more mass an object has, the more it resists change in motion.
statements.tl:
Bakit mas mahirap itulak ang mabigat na kariton?

Sa parehong force, mas kaunti ang pagbabago ng galaw sa mas mabigat na bagay! Madaling itulak ang bakanteng kariton, pero mahirap itulak ang punong-punong kariton. Mas malaki ang mass, mas lumalaban ito sa pagbabago ng galaw.

statements.text: Push a heavy cannonball and a light feather with the same net force. The feather accelerates much faster because it has much less mass!
statements.tl: Tulakin ang mabigat na bola ng kanyon at magaan na balahibo ng parehong netong puwersa. Mas malaki ang acceleration ng balahibo dahil mas maliit ang masa nito!

statements.text:
How do we calculate force in Newton's second law?

Newton's second law says that net force equals mass times acceleration, which is written as F=ma!
statements.tl:
Paano natin kinakalkula ang puwersa sa ikalawang batas ni Newton?

Ang ikalawang batas ni Newton ay nagsasabing ang net force ay katumbas ng masa na pinarami sa acceleration, na isinusulat bilang F=ma!

statements.text: In the equation F=ma, the letter F stands for net force!
statements.tl: Sa F=ma, ang F ay nangangahulugang net force!

statements.text: In the equation F=ma, the letter m stands for mass!
statements.tl: Sa F=ma, ang m ay nangangahulugang masa (mass)!

statements.text: One newton (1 N) is the exact force that gives a 1-kilogram mass an acceleration of 1 m/s²!
statements.tl: Ang isang newton (1 N) ay ang puwersang nagbibigay ng 1 m/s² na aselerasyon sa isang masa na 1 kilogramo!

statements.text: The action and reaction forces act on two different objects, which is why they do not cancel each other out!
statements.tl: Ang puwersang aksyon at reaksyon ay tumatama sa dalawang magkaibang bagay, kaya hindi sila nagkakansela!

statements.text:
Did you know every action has a reaction?

Newton's third law says that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction!
statements.tl:
Alam mo ba na bawat aksyon ay may reaksyon?

Ang ikatlong batas ni Newton ay nagsasabing sa bawat aksyon, may katumbas at kabaligtarang reaksyon!

statements.text:
Why does a fisherman lean back when pulling a net?

When a fisherman pulls the net, they pull on each other! He must lean back so the net doesn't drag him forward.
statements.tl:
Bakit sumusandal pabalik ang mangingisda habang hinihila ang lambat?

Kapag hinihila ng mangingisda ang lambat, pareho silang naghihila! Kailangan niyang sumandal pabalik para hindi siya mahila pasulong.

statements.text: Action and reaction forces always act in opposite directions: if you push a wall to the right, the wall pushes you back to the left.
statements.tl: Ang action at reaction forces ay palaging kumikilos sa magkasalungat na direksyon: kung itulak mo ang pader papuntang kanan, itutulak ka ng pader pabalik papuntang kaliwa.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Sz5_6FUAkluxtAO9CzFQigpBQXsd3hqc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you throw a heavy bag forward while sitting on a movable chair, the bag pushes back on you, making your chair roll backward.
statements.tl: Kapag inihagis mo ang isang mabigat na bag pasulong habang nakaupo sa isang movable chair, itinutulak ka ng bag pabalik, kaya gumugulong ang iyong upuan paatras.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Sz5_6FUAkluxtAO9CzFQigpBQXsd3hqc), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: An action-reaction pair is a pair of forces simultaneously applied on two interacting objects, equal in strength but opposite in direction.
statements.tl: Ang action-reaction pair ay isang pares ng pwersa na sabay na inilalapat sa dalawang bagay na nag-iinteract, magkapareho ang lakas pero magkasalungat ang direksyon.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1vDVGIO-w7cfNEAeG_yCE262KyR9rXHEw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Forces always come in pairs called action-reaction force pairs, acting on two interacting objects at the same time.
statements.tl: Ang mga force ay laging magkapares na tinatawag na action-reaction force pairs, na kumikilos sa dalawang bagay na nag-iinteract nang sabay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1xjd6qNDasRyhPdYSFigtnJAWBxMhiTJA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A rocket moves in airless space! It throws gas downward, gaining equal momentum upward, which keeps the total momentum exactly the same.
statements.tl: Nakakagalaw ang rocket sa kalawakan na walang hangin! Itinataboy nito ang gas pababa, kaya nakakakuha ito ng kapantay na momentum pataas.
statements.source: NRC PS2.A (Newton's third law; conservation of momentum)

statements.text:
How does a tricycle move forward?

Its tire pushes the road backward using friction! The road pushes the tricycle forward. That's why it skids on wet roads with weak friction.
statements.tl:
Paano umaarangkada ang traysikel?

Itinutulak ng gulong ang kalsada pabalik gamit ang friction! Kaya itinutulak ng kalsada ang traysikel pasulong. Kaya ito dumudulas kapag basa at mahina ang friction.

statements.text: When a cannon fires, the cannonball flies forward while the cannon pushes back, because the total momentum must always stay balanced!
statements.tl: Kapag pumutok ang kanyon, lumilipad pasulong ang bala habang umuurong ang kanyon, dahil ang total momentum ay dapat manatiling balanced!
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; DepEd G9-10 momentum conservation; encyclopedia-stable consensus

statements.text:
What happens when you push against a solid wall?

Newton's third law says for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction! The wall pushes back on you just as hard.
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag itinulak mo ang isang dingding?

Ayon sa ikatlong batas ni Newton, sa bawat aksyon ay may pantay at magkabaliktad na reaksyon! Itinutulak ka rin nito pabalik nang kapareho.
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; AAAS BSL Ch.4 Motion

statements.text: A wing pushes air down, and the air pushes the wing right back up! That's action-reaction. Tilt the wing more, and it pushes even more air down for extra lift!
statements.tl: Ang pakpak ay nagtutulak ng hangin pababa, at itinutulak ng hangin pataas ang pakpak! Yan ang action-reaction. Ikiniling mo pa, mas maraming hangin ang matutulak pababa para sa mas malaking lift!

statements.text: The angle of attack is the angle between a wing and the incoming airflow! Increasing it slightly can push more air down to increase lift.
statements.tl: Ang angle of attack ay ang anggulo sa pagitan ng pakpak at papalapit na daloy ng hangin! Ang bahagyang pagtaas nito ay maaaring magtulak ng mas maraming hangin pababa para lumaki ang lift.

statements.text: Newton's third law says that for every action, there is always an equal and opposite reaction!
statements.tl: Ayon sa ikatlong batas ni Newton, sa bawat aksyon ay mayroong katumbas at kasalungat na reaksyon!

statements.text:
Do forces work alone?

No, forces always come in pairs! When one object pushes on another, that other object pushes back.
statements.tl:
Nag-iisa ba ang mga puwersa?

Hindi, ang mga puwersa ay laging dumarating nang pares! Kapag may isang bagay na nagtutulak sa iba, ang ibang bagay ay nagtutulak din pabalik.

statements.text:
Is the reaction force weaker?

Nope! The reaction force is always the same size as the action force, but it points in the opposite direction.
statements.tl:
Mas mahina ba ang puwersa ng reaksyon?

Hindi! Ang puwersa ng reaksyon ay laging kasinglaki ng puwersa ng aksyon, pero patungo sa kabilang direksyon.

statements.text:
How do rockets fly in empty space?

A rocket works even in the airless vacuum of space! It pushes against its own gas, not the surrounding air.
statements.tl:
Paano lumilipad ang mga raketa sa walang hangin na kalawakan?

Gumagana ang raketa kahit sa kalawakan na walang hangin! Dahil itinutulak nito ang sariling gas, hindi ang hangin sa paligid.

statements.text: Did you know? When you walk, your foot pushes the ground backward, and the ground pushes you forward! It's like a magic team-up!
statements.tl: Alam mo ba? Kapag naglalakad ka, itinutulak ng paa mo ang lupa pabalik, at itinutulak ka ng lupa pasulong! Parang magic team-up!

statements.text: A force diagram can represent action-reaction pairs by drawing arrows that show the direction and strength of each force on the two interacting objects.
statements.tl: Ang force diagram ay maaaring kumatawan sa action-reaction pairs sa pamamagitan ng pagguhit ng mga arrow na nagpapakita ng direksyon at lakas ng bawat pwersa sa dalawang bagay na nag-iinteract.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1vDVGIO-w7cfNEAeG_yCE262KyR9rXHEw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When a boatman pushes water backward with a paddle, the water pushes the boat forward—making it move!
statements.tl: Kapag itinulak ng bangkero ang tubig pabalik gamit ang paddle, itutulak din ng tubig ang bangka pasulong—kaya gumagalaw ito!

statements.text: Force diagrams can explain how action-reaction pairs affect the motion of objects by showing that the forces do not balance because they act on different objects.
statements.tl: Maaaring ipaliwanag ng force diagrams kung paano naaapektuhan ng action-reaction pairs ang galaw ng mga bagay sa pamamagitan ng pagpapakita na hindi nagbabalanse ang mga pwersa dahil kumikilos sila sa magkaibang bagay.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1vDVGIO-w7cfNEAeG_yCE262KyR9rXHEw), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
Why don't action and reaction forces cancel each other out?

They act on TWO DIFFERENT objects! When you push a wall, your force is on the wall, and its reaction force is on you.
statements.tl:
Bakit hindi nagkakansela ang action at reaction forces?

Kumikilos sila sa DALAWANG MAGKAIBANG bagay! Kapag itinulak mo ang dingding, ang force mo ay nasa dingding, at ang reaction force nito ay nasa iyo.
statements.source: NRC PS2.A; AAAS BSL Ch.4 (misconception note)

statements.text:
How does a banca move forward when you row?

When the paddle pushes water backward (action), the water pushes the banca forward (reaction) with equal strength! This is Newton's third law in action.
statements.tl:
Paano gumagalaw pasulong ang banca kapag nagsasagwan?

Kapag itinutulak pabalik ng sagwan ang tubig (action), itinutulak ito ng tubig pasulong (reaction) nang pantay na lakas! Ito ang ikatlong batas ni Newton.

statements.text: When a basketball player jumps, they push hard on the floor downward (action), and the floor pushes them upward (reaction) to lift them into the air!
statements.tl: Kapag tumalon ang basketball player, malakas niyang itinutulak ang sahig pababa (action), at itinutulak siya ng sahig pataas (reaction) para umangat sa ere!

statements.text: Swimmers move forward by pushing water backward with their hands and feet! In return, the water pushes them forward (Newton's third law).
statements.tl: Sumusulong ang manlalangoy sa pagtulak sa tubig pabalik gamit ang kamay at paa! Kaya itinutulak siya ng tubig pasulong (ikatlong batas ni Newton).

statements.text: Your bicycle moves forward because the pedal-driven wheel pushes the ground backward using friction, and the ground pushes the bike forward in reaction!
statements.tl: Sumusulong ang bisikleta mo dahil ang gulong na pinapaikot ng pedal ay itinutulak pabalik ang lupa gamit ang friction, at itinutulak ito ng lupa pasulong bilang reaksiyon!

statements.text:
How does a helicopter fly straight up?

Its long spinning blades, called the rotor, act like wings to make lift. They push air downward to rise!
statements.tl:
Paano lumilipad pataas ang helicopter?

Ang mahahabang umiikot na blades (rotor) ay gumagawa ng lift tulad ng pakpak. Itinutulak nito ang hangin pababa para tumaas!

statements.text:
How does an airplane get thrust?

Its engine or propeller pushes air strongly backward to thrust the plane forward. It needs this speed before its wings can make lift!
statements.tl:
Paano nakakakuha ng thrust ang eroplano?

Itinutulak ng makina o propeller ang hangin pabalik para i-thrust ang eroplano pasulong. Kailangan nito ang bilis na ito bago makagawa ng lift ang pakpak!

statements.text: A rocket lifts off because it pushes hot gas downward! In reaction, the gas pushes the rocket upward.
statements.tl: Umaangat ang raketa dahil itinutulak nito ang mainit na gas pababa! Bilang reaksyon, itinutulak ng gas ang raketa pataas.

statements.text: While swimming, you push the water backward with your hands, and the water pushes you forward! Splash and glide!
statements.tl: Habang lumalangoy, itinutulak mo ang tubig pabalik gamit ang mga kamay mo, at itinutulak ka ng tubig pasulong! Splash and glide!

statements.text:
How does a boat move when you paddle it?

When you paddle a boat, the paddle pushes the water backward, and the water pushes the boat forward!
statements.tl:
Paano gumagalaw ang bangka kapag sinasagwan mo ito?

Kapag sinasagwan ang bangka, itinutulak ng sagwan ang tubig pabalik, at ang tubig naman ay itinutulak ang bangka pasulong!

statements.text:
How do jellyfish and squid swim so fast?

Jellyfish and squid move by squirting water in one direction, which pushes them in the opposite direction!
statements.tl:
Paano lumangoy nang mabilis ang dikya at pusit?

Ang dikya at pusit ay gumagalaw sa pamamagitan ng pagbuga ng tubig sa isang direksyon, kaya sila ay itinutulak pasalungat!

statements.text:
Why does a gun kick back when it fires?

It pushes the bullet forward, and as a reaction the gun recoils backward!
statements.tl:
Bakit umaatras ang baril kapag pinaputok ito?

Itinutulak nito ang bala pasulong, at bilang reaksyon, ang baril ay umaatras pabalik!

statements.text:
What happens when you let go of a blown-up balloon?

The air rushes out one end and the balloon zips off in the opposite direction! Whoosh!
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag binitawan mo ang lobong puno ng hangin?

Lumalabas ang hangin sa isang dulo at lumilipad ang lobo sa kabilang direksyon! Whoosh!

statements.text:
How does a jet engine push an airplane forward?

The engine blasts hot gas backward, and the reaction pushes the airplane forward!
statements.tl:
Paano tinutulak ng jet engine ang eroplano pasulong?

Nagbubuga ang jet engine ng mainit na gas paatras, at ang reaksyon ay nagtutulak sa eroplano pasulong!

statements.text:
What happens when a hammer hits a nail?

The hammer pushes the nail, and the nail pushes back on the hammer with equal force!
statements.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag pinukpok ng martilyo ang pako?

Itinutulak ng martilyo ang pako, at ang pako ay itinutulak din ang martilyo pabalik nang pantay!

statements.text: An electric current flowing in a metal wire is really just electrons moving along together!
statements.tl: Ang dumadaloy na kuryente sa metal na alambre ay talagang mga elektron na sabay-sabay na gumagalaw!

statements.text: Closing a switch completes an electrical circuit, letting electrons flow through and light up a bulb!
statements.tl: Ang pagsara ng switch ay nagkukumpleto sa electrical circuit, hinahayaan ang electrons na dumaloy at magpailaw ng bombilya!

statements.text: Electric current is the net flow of electrons, tiny charged particles, moving through a wire like water flowing through a hose.
statements.tl: Ang electric current ay ang net flow ng mga electron, maliliit na charged particles, na dumadaloy sa wire tulad ng tubig na dumadaloy sa hose.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 18zsgbDgtmFevtifLN-YNkeze5zPomCgs), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: If an electrical cord is cracked or broken, a licensed electrician should repair it because they know how to handle electricity safely.
statements.tl: Kung ang kord ng kuryente ay may bitak o sira, dapat itong ipaayos sa isang lisensyadong electrician dahil alam nila kung paano hawakan ang kuryente nang ligtas.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UfW6o5Rjb5rfFPqn_Ey_gMB5MXqTapKA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Appliances like electric stoves and flat irons should be unplugged after using them to keep everyone safe.
statements.tl: Ang mga appliances tulad ng electric stove at plantsa ay dapat tanggalin sa saksakan pagkatapos gamitin upang mapanatiling ligtas ang lahat.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UfW6o5Rjb5rfFPqn_Ey_gMB5MXqTapKA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Playing with electrical devices inside the house is not safe because you might break them or get hurt by electricity.
statements.tl: Ang paglalaro ng mga de-koryenteng kagamitan sa loob ng bahay ay hindi ligtas dahil maaari mong masira ang mga ito o ikaw ay mapahamak sa kuryente.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1UfW6o5Rjb5rfFPqn_Ey_gMB5MXqTapKA), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How does rubber keep us safe from electricity?

Rubber does not let electricity flow through it! It is wrapped around wires to keep us safe from shocks.
statements.tl:
Paano tayo pinoprotektahan ng goma sa kuryente?

Hindi pinagdadaanan ng kuryente ang goma! Kaya ginagamit itong pambalot sa mga kawad para hindi tayo makuryente.

statements.text:
What should you do if there is an electrical fire?

Do not pour water on an electrical fire! Instead, switch off the main power first to stay safe.
statements.tl:
Ano ang gagawin kung may sunog mula sa kuryente?

Huwag buhusan ng tubig ang sunog na galing sa kuryente! Sa halip, patayin muna ang main switch para maging ligtas.

statements.text:
Why is copper wire wrapped in plastic?

The copper inside carries the electricity, while the plastic wrapper blocks the current! This keeps us safe from getting shocked when we touch it.
statements.tl:
Bakit may balot na plastic ang tansong wire?

Ang tanso sa loob ang nagdadala ng kuryente, pero ang plastic ang humahadlang! Kaya hindi tayo makukuryente kapag nahawakan natin ang wire.

statements.text:
Did you know salty water can carry electricity?

When salt dissolves in water, it can carry electricity — pure water barely can. That's why touching electricity with salty wet hands is dangerous!
statements.tl:
Alam mo bang ang maalat na tubig ay nakakadala ng kuryente?

Kapag natunaw ang asin sa tubig, nakakadala ito ng kuryente — ang dalisay na tubig ay halos hindi. Kaya delikado ang paghawak ng kuryente kapag basa sa maalat na tubig!

statements.text: In unconnected metal, free electrons move randomly, so no electricity flows. But connect a battery, and its voltage gives a push! Electrons drift together in one direction, creating an electric current.
statements.tl: Sa hindi nakakabit na metal, gumagalaw ang free electrons nang random, kaya walang kuryente. Pero kapag kinabit sa baterya, ang voltage nagtutulak! Magdadaan sila sa iisang direksyon, na siyang electric current.

statements.text: Many think electricity gets used up in a wire, but it doesn't! The same electrons just keep circling the closed circuit. What actually gets used up is the energy they carry, not the electrons!
statements.tl: Maraming akala na nauubos ang kuryente sa wire, pero hindi! Ang parehong mga electrons ay paikot lang sa saradong circuit. Ang naubos talaga ay ang energy na dala nila, hindi ang mga electrons!

statements.text:
Which materials let electricity flow easily?

Metals like copper and iron are good conductors of electricity — their free electrons can move! But plastic, rubber, and dry wood are insulators — they don't let electricity flow easily!
statements.tl:
Anong mga materyales ang pinapadaanan ng kuryente?

Ang mga metal tulad ng tanso at bakal ay magandang conductors ng kuryente — ang kanilang free electrons ay nakakagalaw! Pero ang plastic, goma, at tuyong kahoy ay mga insulator — hindi pinapadaloy ng kuryente nang madali!

statements.text: Rubber is an electrical insulator that resists electric current! Ordinary rubber-soled shoes, however, do not guarantee protection from electric shocks.
statements.tl: Ang goma ay electrical insulator na lumalaban sa pagdaloy ng kuryente! Pero hindi tiyak na proteksiyon laban sa electric shock ang karaniwang sapatos na may gomang suwelas.

statements.text: Lightning is a superheated gas called plasma, where electrons are stripped from air molecules to conduct electricity!
statements.tl: Ang kidlat ay isang superheated gas na tinatawag na plasma, kung saan ang electrons ay inaalis mula sa air molecules para mag-conduct ng electricity!

statements.text: Solar panels don't make electricity by getting hot! When light hits the special silicon inside, tiny particles called electrons are knocked loose, and that flow creates the electricity.
statements.tl: Hindi sa pag-init gumagawa ng kuryente ang solar panel! Kapag tinamaan ng liwanag ang espesyal na silicon sa loob, natutulak ang maliliit na electrons, at ang daloy nila ang kuryente.

statements.text: Electrical wires are coated with rubber or plastic. This safe covering protects us from getting shocked when we touch them!
statements.tl: Ang mga kawad ng kuryente ay binabalutan ng goma o plastic. Protektahan tayo nito para hindi makuryente kapag hinawakan!

statements.text:
Why do metals conduct electricity so easily?

Metals have free electrons inside them that can move around easily and carry the electricity!
statements.tl:
Bakit madaling nagpapadaloy ng kuryente ang mga metal?

May mga malayang elektron ang mga metal sa loob nito na madaling gumagalaw para ipadala ang kuryente!

statements.text: Ohm's law says current in a circuit equals voltage divided by resistance! It's a simple math rule: I = V/R.
statements.tl: Sinasabi ng Batas ni Ohm na ang kuryente sa sirkito ay katumbas ng boltahe hinati sa resistensya. Simple lang: I = V/R!

statements.text:
What voltage for a heater with 100 A and 1.1 ohms?

110 volts! Multiply current by resistance: 100 times 1.1 equals 110.
statements.tl:
Anong voltage sa heater na may 100 A at 1.1 ohms?

110 volts! I-multiply ang current sa resistance: 100 times 1.1 ay katumbas ng 110.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1HmupIwDVhZuE9kXnw83t1PgfPp0IWlbB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: When you graph voltage against current for a constant resistance, the result is a straight line with a positive slope, showing direct proportionality.
statements.tl: Kapag ginawa mong graph ang voltage laban sa current para sa hindi nagbabagong resistance, ang resulta ay isang tuwid na linya na may positive slope, na nagpapakita ng direct proportionality.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1HmupIwDVhZuE9kXnw83t1PgfPp0IWlbB), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: For a series circuit, the total voltage is the sum of the individual voltages, written as VT = V1 + V2 + V3.
statements.tl: Sa series circuit, ang total voltage ay ang kabuuan ng mga individual voltage, isinusulat bilang VT = V1 + V2 + V3.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1Pf8W4VS1D2y3Km1FGuA372SStY-mehBJ), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The voltage equation for a parallel circuit is V total equals V one equals V two equals V three, meaning every branch has the same voltage.
statements.tl: Ang voltage equation para sa parallel circuit ay V total equals V one equals V two equals V three, ibig sabihin bawat sanga ay may parehong voltage.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SoUxm6UF8J8J0QuzMWK_LdYDP59bPdZV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: The current equation for a parallel circuit is I total equals I one plus I two plus I three, because the total current is the sum of all branch currents.
statements.tl: Ang current equation para sa parallel circuit ay I total equals I one plus I two plus I three, dahil ang total current ay ang sum ng lahat ng branch currents.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SoUxm6UF8J8J0QuzMWK_LdYDP59bPdZV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: You can find the voltage drop across any single resistor in a series circuit by multiplying its resistance by the current flowing through it, using V=IR.
statements.tl: Mahahanap mo ang voltage drop sa kahit anong resistor sa series circuit sa pamamagitan ng pag-multiply ng resistance nito sa current na dumadaloy dito, gamit ang V=IR.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1g429tyGCPy0seeW_b44IfSlLfONkL245), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To solve a series circuit problem, first add all resistances to get total resistance, then use Ohm's law to find total current, and finally calculate each voltage drop with V=IR.
statements.tl: Para masagutan ang series circuit problem, pagsamahin muna ang lahat ng resistances para makuha ang total resistance, pagkatapos gamitin ang Ohm's law para mahanap ang total current, at sa huli kalkulahin ang bawat voltage drop gamit ang V=IR.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1g429tyGCPy0seeW_b44IfSlLfONkL245), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: To find voltage, multiply current by resistance: a 0.50-ampere current through a 1500-ohm resistor gives V = IR = 0.50 A × 1500 Ω = 750 volts.
statements.tl: Para makuha ang voltage, imultiplika ang current sa resistance: ang 0.50-ampere na current sa 1500-ohm na resistor ay nagbibigay ng V = IR = 0.50 A × 1500 Ω = 750 volts.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1nUGp--3idi2zx9VY69gD3NNchRFcSfnN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Adding more dry cells in series can increase the voltage, which is the push that moves electric charges through the circuit.
statements.tl: Ang pagdaragdag ng dry cells na naka-series ay nakakapagpataas ng voltage, na siyang tulak na nagpapagalaw sa mga electric charge sa circuit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1nhjKo5pixZnt1rXfCL3Cce_ZFVPvpu37), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Connect two or more batteries end-to-end in series! Their voltages add up to push the current harder, making the bulb shine much brighter than with just one battery.
statements.tl: Pagdugtungin ang dalawa o higit pang baterya nang magkasunod (series)! Nagkakasama ang boltahe para mas malakas itulak ang kuryente, kaya mas maliwanag ang bombilya kaysa sa isang baterya.

statements.text: When you connect batteries end-to-end in series, their voltages add up to give a much stronger push!
statements.tl: Kapag pinagsunod-sunod mo ang mga baterya in series, nagdadagdag ang kanilang boltahe para mas malakas ang tulak!

statements.text:
What happens when you add more batteries in series?

The bulb glows brighter! More batteries give a stronger push to the current, making it shine more, up to the limit the bulb can handle.
statements.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kapag nagdagdag ka ng baterya sa series?

Mas maliwanag ang bombilya! Mas malakas ang tulak sa kuryente, kaya mas nagliliwanag ito — hanggang sa maabot ng bombilya ang hangganan nito.

statements.text: Voltage measures how strongly a battery pushes the current! It's measured in volts. A common AA battery? Just 1.5 volts!
statements.tl: Ang voltage ay sumusukat kung gaano lakas ang pagtulak ng baterya sa kuryente! Sinusukat ito sa volts. Ang karaniwang AA battery? 1.5 volts lang!

statements.text:
Why does a bulb's filament glow?

A bulb's filament is thin with high resistance, so it pushes back against the current! That resistance makes it heat up until it glows bright!
statements.tl:
Bakit nagliliwanag ang filament ng bombilya?

Ang filament ng bombilya ay manipis at may mataas na resistance, kaya naglalaban ito sa daloy ng kuryente! Ang paglaban na ito ang nagpapainit dito hanggang sa magliwanag!

statements.text: Current is how much electric charge flows past a point every second! It's measured in amperes (A). Bigger current means more charge is flowing through!
statements.tl: Ang current ay kung gaano karaming kargang elektrikal ang dumadaloy sa isang punto bawat segundo! Sinusukat ito sa amperes (A). Mas malaking current, mas maraming charge ang dumadaloy!

statements.text:
How does current behave in a series circuit?

Bulbs connect in a single loop. The current is the same everywhere! None is lost—what passes the first bulb passes the next.
statements.tl:
Paano ang current sa series circuit?

Magkasunod ang mga bombilya sa iisang loop. Pareho ang current sa bawat bahagi! Walang nawawala—kung gaano ang dumadaan sa una, ganoon din sa susunod.

statements.text: Ohm's law is V = I x R! Voltage (V) equals current (I) times resistance (R). Know two? You can solve for the third!
statements.tl: Ang formula ng batas ni Ohm ay V = I x R! Ang boltahe (V) ay katumbas ng kuryente (I) na pinarami sa resistensya (R). Alam mo ang dalawa? Hanapin ang pangatlo!

statements.text: A voltmeter connects in parallel to measure voltage, while an ammeter connects in series! Their connection methods are completely opposite.
statements.tl: Ang voltmeter ay kinokonekta nang parallel para sukatin ang boltahe, habang ang ammeter ay kinokonekta nang series! Magkaiba ang paraan ng koneksyon ng dalawa.

statements.text: In a diagram, a switch looks like a broken wire with a small lever. If it's open, no current flows!
statements.tl: Sa diagram, ang switch ay mukhang putol na wire na may maliit na lever. Kapag open, walang current na dumadaloy!

statements.text:
How do we draw a battery in a circuit diagram?

A cell is drawn as a long line (positive!) and a short line (negative!). Several cells in series? That's alternating long-short-long-short lines!
statements.tl:
Paano natin iguhit ang baterya sa circuit diagram?

Ang cell ay iginuguhit bilang mahabang guhit (positive!) at maikling guhit (negative!). Maraming cell sa series? Pattern iyan ng mahaba-maikli-mahaba-maikli na guhit!

statements.text:
Why are parallel circuits more complicated to design than series circuits?

They need more wires and careful planning because each branch must be connected separately to the source.
statements.tl:
Bakit mas komplikadong idisenyo ang parallel circuits kaysa series circuits?

Kailangan nila ng mas maraming wires at maingat na pagpaplano dahil bawat sanga ay dapat ikabit nang hiwalay sa source.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SoUxm6UF8J8J0QuzMWK_LdYDP59bPdZV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A switch in one branch of a parallel circuit controls only the components on that branch, not the whole circuit.
statements.tl: Ang switch sa isang sanga ng parallel circuit ay kumokontrol lamang sa mga bahagi sa sanga na iyon, hindi sa buong circuit.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SoUxm6UF8J8J0QuzMWK_LdYDP59bPdZV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text:
How can I see what happens in a parallel circuit without building one?

Use a circuit simulation where you can place bulbs, wires, ammeters, and voltmeters on screen and read the current and voltage values.
statements.tl:
Paano ko makikita ang nangyayari sa parallel circuit nang hindi gumagawa ng totoo?

Gumamit ng circuit simulation kung saan maaari kang maglagay ng bulbs, wires, ammeters, at voltmeters sa screen at basahin ang mga value ng current at voltage.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1SoUxm6UF8J8J0QuzMWK_LdYDP59bPdZV), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: A parallel circuit gives electric current several branches to flow through, so each appliance can have its own separate path.
statements.tl: Ang parallel circuit ay nagbibigay ng maraming sanga na dadaanan ng electric current, kaya bawat appliance ay may sariling daan.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1YkAZ32RguspGzm3rwZm2NGW9YMYmNV4v), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: Schematic diagrams use standard symbols to represent circuit parts, like a long and short line for a battery and a zigzag line for a resistor.
statements.tl: Gumagamit ang schematic diagrams ng mga standard na simbolo para kumatawan sa mga bahagi ng circuit, tulad ng mahaba at maikling linya para sa battery at zigzag na linya para sa resistor.
statements.source: DepEd self-learning module (Drive id 1nUGp--3idi2zx9VY69gD3NNchRFcSfnN), paraphrased in a Hiraia card

statements.text: We measure current using an ammeter! It connects right into the loop's path so current passes through it, showing in amperes how much electricity is flowing.
statements.tl: Sinusukat natin ang current gamit ang ammeter! Ikinakabit ito sa daanan ng loop para dumaan ang current, at ipinapakita sa amperes kung gaano karami ang umaagos.

statements.text: When drawing a circuit diagram, put the ammeter symbol in the main loop and the voltmeter across a load to show their real connections!
statements.tl: Kapag nagguhit ng circuit diagram, ilagay ang ammeter symbol sa main loop at ang voltmeter across a load para makita ang tunay na connections!

statements.text: With power disconnected, to check if a wire is broken, set the multimeter to ohmmeter and touch the probes to the ends. A near-zero reading means it's continuous!
statements.tl: Nang nakapatay ang kuryente, para i-check kung putol ang wire, i-set ang multimeter sa ohmmeter at idikit ang probes sa dulo. Ang halos zero na reading ay ibig sabihin tuloy-tuloy ito!

statements.text:
Why use a battery eliminator when testing resistors?

Use a battery eliminator to keep the voltage constant! Batteries weaken and drain, but an eliminator stays strong while testing different resistors.
statements.tl:
Bakit gumamit ng battery eliminator kapag nagte-test ng resistors?

Gumamit ng battery eliminator para panatilihing constant ang voltage! Humihina ang batteries, pero ang eliminator ay nananatiling malakas habang sinusubok ang resistors.

statements.text:
How do we compare bulb brightness in circuits?

Record each bulb as bright, dim, or off in a table! We do this because brightness is a qualitative measure in series and parallel circuits.
statements.tl:
